text.body:
<3.1.1>
atha skānde mahāpurāṇa tṛtīyaṃ brāhmakhaṇḍam || 3 || atha brāhmakhaṇḍe prathamaṃ setumāhātmyam || 3.1 || ||śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīvedavyāsāyanamaḥ || śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam || prasannavadanaṃdhyāyetsarvavighnopaśāṃtaye||1 || naimiṣāraṇya nilayā ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ || aṣṭāṃgayoganiratā brahmajñānaikatatparāḥ || 1 || mumukṣavo mahātmāno nirmamā brahmavādinaḥ || dharmajñā anasūyāśca satyavataparāyaṇāḥ || 2 || jiteṃdriyājitakrodhāḥ sarvabhūtadayālavaḥ || bhaktyāparamayāviṣṇumarcayaṃtaḥ sanātanam ||3 || tapastepurmahāpuṇye naimiṣe muktidāyini || ekadā te mahātmānaḥ samājaṃ cakruruttamam|| 4 || kathayaṃto mahāpuṇyāḥ kathāḥ pāpapraṇāśinī || bhuktimuktyorupāyaṃ ca jijñā saṃtaḥ parasparam || 5 || ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām || teṣāṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyāṇāṃ saṃkhyā kartuṃ na śakyate|| 6 || atrāṃta remahāvidvānvyā saśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ || āgamannaimiṣāraṇyaṃ sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ || 7 || tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā jvalaṃtamiva pāvakam || arghyādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsurmunayaḥ| śaunakādayaḥ || 8 || sukhopaviṣṭaṃ taṃ sūtamāsane parame śubhe || papracchuḥ paramaṃ guhyaṃ lokānugrahakāṃkṣayā || 9 || sūta dharmārthatattvajña svāgataṃ munipuṃgava || śrutavāṃstvaṃ purāṇāni vyāsātsatyavatīsutāt || 3.1.1.10 || ataḥ sarvapurāṇānāmarthajño'si mahāmune || kāni kṣetrāṇi puṇyāni kāni tīrthāni bhūtale || 11 || kathaṃ vā lapsyate muktirjīvānāṃ bhavasāgarāt || kathaṃ hare harau vāpi nṛṇāṃ bhaktiḥ prajāyate || 12 || kena sidhyeta ca phalaṃ karmaṇāstrividhā tmanaḥ || etaccānyacca tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā vada sūtaja || 13 || brūyuḥ snigdhāya śiṣyāya guravo guhyamapyuta || iti pṛṣṭastadā sūto naimiṣāraṇyavāsibhiḥ || || 14 || vaktuṃ pracakrame natvā vyāsaṃ svagurumāditaḥ || śrīsūta uvāca || || samyakpṛṣṭamidaṃ viprā yuṣmābhirjagato hitam || 15 || rahasyame tadyuṣmākaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇutādarāt || mayā noktamidaṃ pūrvaṃ kasyāpi munipuṃgavāḥ || 16 || mano niyamya vipreṃdrāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || asti rāmeśvaraṃ nāma rāmasetau pavitritam || 17 || kṣetrāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāmapi cottamam || dṛṣṭamātre rāmasetau muktiḥ saṃsārasāgarāt || 18 || hare harau ca bhaktiḥ syāttathā puṇyasamṛddhitā || karmaṇastrividhasyāpi siddhiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 19 || yo naro janmamadhye tu setuṃ bhaktyāvalokayet || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ||3.1.1.20 || mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva dvikoṭikulasaṃyutaḥ || nirviśya śaṃbhunā kalpaṃ tato mokṣaṃ samaśnute|| 21 || gaṇyaṃte pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyaṃte divi tārakāḥ || setudarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ śeṣeṇāpi na gaṇyate || 22 || samastadevatārūpaḥ setuvaṃdhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || taddarśanavataḥ puṃsaḥ kaḥ puṇyaṃ gaṇituṃ kṣamaḥ || 23 || setuṃ dṛṣṭvā naro viprāḥ sarvayāgakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || snātaśca sarvatīrtheṣu tapo'tapyata cākhilam ||24|| setuṃ gaccheti yo brūyādyaṃ kaṃ vāpi naraṃ dvijāḥ || so'pi tatphalamāpnoti kimanyairbahubhāṣaṇaḥ || 25 || setusnānakaro martyaḥ saptakoṭikulānvitaḥ || saṃprāpya viṣṇubhavanaṃ tatraiva parimucyate || 26 || setuṃ rāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvatam || ciṃtayanmanujaḥ satyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 27 || mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva lakṣakoṭikulānvitaḥ || saṃprāpya viṣṇubhavanaṃ tatraiva parimucyate || kalpatrayaṃ śaṃbhupade sthitvā tatraiva mucyate || 28 || mūṣāvasthāṃ vasākūpaṃ tathā vaitaraṇī nadīm || śvabhakṣaṃ mūtrapānaṃ ca setusnāyī na paśyati || 29 || taptaśūlaṃ taptaśilāṃ purī ṣahradameva ca || tathā śoṇitakūpaṃ ca setusnāyī na paśyati || 3.1.1.30 || śālmalyārohaṇaṃ raktabhojanaṃ kṛmibhojanam || svamāṃsabhojanaṃ caiva vahnijvālāpraveśanam || 31 || śilāvṛṣṭiṃ vahnivṛṣṭiṃ narakaṃ kālasūtrakam || kṣārodakaṃ coṣṇatoyaṃ neyātsetvavalokakaḥ || 32 || setusnāyī naro viprāḥ paṃcapātakavānapi || mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva śatakoṭikulānvitaḥ || 33 || kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade sthitvā tatraiva mucyate || adhaḥśiraḥśoṣaṇaṃ ca narakaṃ kṣārasevanam || 34 || pāṣāṇayantrapīḍāṃ ca marutprapatanaṃ tathā || purīṣalepanaṃ caiva tathā krakacadāraṇam || 35 || purīṣabhojanaṃ retaḥpānaṃ saṃdhiṣu dāhanam || aṃgāraśayyābhramaṇaṃ tathā musalamarddanam || 36 || etāni narakāṇyaddhā setusnāyī na paśyati || setu snānaṃ kariṣye'hamiti buddhyā viciṃtayan || 37 || gacchecchatapadaṃ yastu sa mahāpātako'pi san || bahūnāṃ kāṣṭhayaṃtrāṇāṃ karṣaṇaṃ śastrabhedanam|| 38 || patanotpatanaṃ caiva gadādaṇḍanipīḍanam || gajadantaiśca hananaṃ nānābhujagadaṃśanam || 39 || dhūmapānaṃ pāśabandhaṃ nānāśūlanipīḍanam || mukhe ca nāsikāyāṃ ca kṣārodakaniṣecanam || 3.1.1.40 || kṣārāṃbupānaṃ narakaṃ taptāyaḥ sūcibhakṣaṇam || etāni narakānyaddhā na yāti gatapātakaḥ || 41 || kṣārāṃbupūrṇaraṃdhrāṇāṃ praveśaṃ malabhojanam || snāyucchedaṃ snāyudāhamasthibhedanameva ca || 42 || śleṣmādanaṃ pittapānaṃ mahātiktaniṣevaṇam || atyuṣṇa tailapānaṃ ca pānaṃ kṣārodakasya ca || 43 || kaṣāyodakapānaṃ ca taptapāṣāṇabhojanam || atyuṣṇasikatāsnānaṃ tathā daśanamardanam || 44 || taptāyaḥśayanaṃ caiva saṃtaptāṃbuniṣecanam || sūciprakṣepaṇaṃ caiva netrayormukhasaṃdhiṣu || 45 || śiśne savṛṣaṇe caiva hyayobhārasya bandhanam || vṛkṣāgrātpatanaṃ caiva durgaṃdhaparipūrite || 46 || tīkṣṇadhārāstraśayyāṃ ca retaḥpānādikaṃ tathā || ityādi narakānghorāsetusnāyī na paśyati || 47 || setusaikatamadhye yaḥ śete tatpāṃsukuṃṭhitaḥ || yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo lagnāstasyāṃge viprasattamāḥ || 48 || tāvatāṃ brahmahatyānāṃ nāśaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || setumadhyastha vātena yasyāṃgaṃ spṛśyate'khilam || 49 || surāpānāyutaṃ tasya tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || vartaṃte yasya keśāstu vapanātsetumadhyataḥ || 3.1.1.50 || gurutalpā yutaṃ tasya tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || yasyāsthi setumadhye tu sthāpitaṃ putrapautrakaiḥ || svarṇasteyāyutaṃ tasya tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 51 || smṛtvā yaṃ setumadhye tu snānaṃ kuryāddvijottamāḥ || mahāpātakisaṃsargadoṣastasya layaṃ vrajet || 52 || mārgabhedī svārthapākī yatibrāhmaṇadūṣakaḥ || atyāśī vedavikretā paṃcaite brahmaghātakāḥ || 53 || brāhmaṇānyaḥ samāhūya dāsyāmīti dhanādikam || paścānnāstīti yo brūte brahmahā sopi kīrtitaḥ || 54 || parijñāya yato dharmāṃstasmai yo dveṣamācaret || avajānāti vā viprānbrahmahā sopi kīrtitaḥ || 55 || jalapānārthamāyātaṃ govṛndaṃ tu jalāśaye || nivārayati yo viprā brahmahā sopi kīrtitaḥ || 56 || setumetya tu te sarve mucyaṃte doṣasaṃcayaiḥ || brahmaghātakatulyā ye saṃti cānye dvijottamāḥ || || 57 || te sarve setumāgatya mucyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || aupāsanaparityāgī devatānnasya bhojakaḥ ||58|| surāpayoṣitsaṃsargī gaṇikānnāśanastathā || gaṇānnabhojakaścaiva patitānnarataśca yaḥ || 59 || ete surāpinaḥ proktāḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || setusnānena mucyaṃte te sarve hatakilbiṣāḥ || 3.1.1.60 || surāpatulyā ye cānye mucyaṃte setumajjanāt || kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca kastūrīpaṭṭavāsasām || 61 || payaścaṃdanakarpūrakramukāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || madhvājyatā mrakāṃsyānāṃ rudrākṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 62 || corakāstu parijñeyā suvarṇasteyinaḥ samāḥ || te setukṣetramāgatya mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 69 || anye ca steyinaḥ sarve setusnānena vai dvijāḥ || mucyaṃte sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 64 || bhaginīṃ putrabhāryāṃ ca tathaiva ca rajasvalām || bhrātṛbhāryāṃ mitrabhāryāṃ madyapāṃ ca parastriyam ||65|| hīnastriyaṃ ca viśvastāṃ yo'bhigacchati rāgataḥ || gurutalpī sa vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||66|| ete cānye ca ye saṃti gurutalpagatulyakāḥ || te sarve pravimucyaṃte setusnānena vai dvijāḥ || 67 || etaiḥ saṃsargiṇo viprā ye cānye saṃti pāpinaḥ || setusnānena mahatā te'pi mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ||69|| yāgaṃ vinā devaloke ghṛtācīmenakādibhiḥ|| saṃbhogakāmino viprāḥ snātuṃ saṃtāvaghāpahe || 69 || aniṣevya raviṃ vahnimanupāsya parānsurān || śubhakāmī janaḥ setaukuryātsnānaṃ sabhaktikam ||3.1.1.7||| tilānbhūmiṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dhānyaṃ taṃdulameva ca || adattvecchaṃti te svargaṃ snātuṃ setau tu te dvijāḥ ||71|| upavāsairvrataiḥ kṛtsnairasaṃtāpya nijāṃ tanum || svargābhilāṣiṇaḥ puṃsaḥ snāṃtu setau vimuktide||72|| setusnānaṃ mokṣadaṃ hi manaḥśuddhipradaṃ tathā || japāddhomāttathā dānādyāgācca tapaso'pi ca || 73 || setusnānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ hi purāṇe paripaṭhyate || akāmanākṛtaṃ snānaṃ setau pāpavināśane || 74 || apunarbhavadaṃ proktaṃ satyamuktaṃ dvijottamāḥ || yaḥ saṃpadaṃ samuddiśya snāti setau naro mudā || 75 || sa saṃpadamavāpnoti vipulāṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || śuddhyarthaṃ snāti cetsetau tadā śuddhimavāpnuyāt || 76 || ratyarthaṃ yadi ca snāyādapsarobhirnaro divi || tadā ratimavāpnoti svargaloke'marījanaiḥ || 77 || muktyarthaṃ yadi ca snāyātsetau muktipradāyini || tadā muktimavāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitām ||78|| setusnānena dharmaḥ syātsetusnānādaghakṣayaḥ || setusnānaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 79 || sarvavratādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvayajñottaraṃ smṛtam || sarvayogādhikaṃ proktaṃ sarva tīrthādhikaṃ smṛtam || 3.1.1.80 || iṃdrādilokabhogeṣu rāgo yeṣāṃ pravartate || snātavyaṃ tairdvijaśreṣṭhāḥ setau rāmakṛte sakṛt || 81 || brahmaloke ca vaikuṇṭhe kailāse'pi śivālaye || raṃtumicchā bhavedyeṣāṃ te setau snāṃtu sādaram || 82 || āyurārogyasaṃpattimatirūpaguṇāḍhyatām || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ sāṃgānāṃ pāragāminām || 83 || sarvaśāstrādhigaṃtṛtvaṃ sarvamaṃtreṣvabhijñatām || samuddiśya tu yaḥ snāyātsetau sarvārthasiddhide || 84 || tattatsiddhima vāpnoti satyaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || dāridryānnarakādye ca manujā bhuvi bibhyati || 85 || snānaṃ kurvaṃtu te sarve rāmasetau vimuktide || śraddhayā sahito martyaḥ śraddhayā rahito'pi vā || 86 || ihaloke paratrāpi setusnāyī na duḥkhabhāk || setusnānena sarveṣāṃ naśyate pāpasaṃcayaḥ || 87 || varddhate dharmarāśiśca śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī || yathā ratnāni varddhaṃte samudre vividhānyapi || 88 || tathā puṇyāni varddhaṃte setusnānena vai dvijāḥ || kāma dhenuryathā loke sarvākāmānprayacchati || 89 || ciṃtāmaṇiryathā dadyātpuruṣāṇāṃ manorathān || yathā'maratarurdadyātpuruṣāṇāmabhīpsitam || 3.1.1.90 || setusnānaṃ tathā nṛṇāṃ sarvābhīṣṭānpradāsyati || aśaktaḥ setuyātrāyāṃ dāridryeṇa ca mānavaḥ || 91 || yācitvā sa dhanaṃ śiṣṭātsetau snānaṃ samāca ret || setusnānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra dātā samaśnute || 92 || tathā pratigṛhītāpi prāpnotyavikalaṃ phalam || setuyātrāṃ samuddiśya gṛhṇīyādbrāhmaṇāddha nam || 93 || kṣatriyādapi gṛhṇīyānna dadyurbrāhmaṇā yadi || vaiśyādvā pratigṛhṇīyānna prayacchaṃti cennṛpāḥ || 94 || śūdrānna pratigṛhṇīyātkathaṃcidapi mānavaḥ || yaḥ setuṃ gacchataḥ puṃso dhanaṃ vā dhānyameva vā || 95 || dattvā vastrādikaṃ vāpi pravartayati mānavaḥ || so'śvamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalamāpto tyanuttamam || 96 || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || tulāpuruṣamukhyānāṃ dānānāṃ phalamaśnute || 97 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśaḥ syā nnātra saṃśayaḥ || bahunā kiṃ pralāpena sarvānkāmānsamaśnute || 98 || evaṃ pratigṛhītāpi tattulyaphalamaśnute || yācataḥ setuyātrārthaṃ na pratigrahakalmaṣam || 99 || setuṃ gaccha dhanaṃ te'haṃ dāsyāmīti pralobhya yaḥ || paścānnāstīti ca brūyāttamāhurbrahmaghātakam || 3.1.1.100 || lobhena setuyātrārthaṃ saṃpanno'pi daridravat || mānavo yadi yāceta tamāhusteyinaṃ budhāḥ || 101 || gamiṣye setumiti vai yo gṛhītvā dhanaṃ naraḥ || na yāti setuṃ lobhena tamāhurbrahmaghā takam || 102 || yena kenāpyupāyena setuṃ gacchennaro mudā || aśakto dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā gamayedvā dvijottamam ||103|| yācitvā yajñakaraṇe yathā doṣo na vidyate || yācitvā setuyātrāyāṃ tathā doṣo na vidyate || 104 || yācitvāpyanyato dravyaṃ setusnāne pravartayet || so'pi tatphalamāpnoti setu snāyī naro yathā || 105 || jñānena mokṣamabhiyāṃti kṛte yuge tu tretāyuge yajanameva vimuktidāyi || śreṣṭhaṃ tathānyayugayorapi dānamāhuḥ sarvatra setva bhiṣavo hi varo narāṇām ||106|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye setugamanaphalādivarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||
<3.1.2>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ sūta mahābhāga rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || seturbaddho nadīnāthe hyagādhe varuṇālaye ||1|| setau ca kati tīrthāni gaṃdhamādanaparvate || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ brūhi paurāṇikottama || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || rāmeṇa hi yathāseturnibaddho varuṇālaye || tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 3 || ājñayā hi pitū rāmo nyavasaddaṃḍakānane|| sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyuktaḥ paṃcavaṭyāṃ samāhitaḥ|| 4 || tasminniva satastasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ || rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā mārīcacchadmanā dvijāḥ ||5 || mārgamāṇo vane bhāryāṃ rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ|| paṃpātīre jagā māsau śokamohasamanvitaḥ ||6|| dṛṣṭavānvānaraṃ tatra kaṃciddaśarathātmajaḥ || vānareṇātha pṛṣṭo'yaṃ ko bhavāniti rāghavaḥ || 7 || āditaḥ svasya vṛttāṃttaṃ tasmai provāca tattvataḥ || atha rāghavasaṃpṛṣṭo vānaraḥ ko bhavāniti || 8 || sopi vijñāpayāmāsa rāghavāya mahātmane || ahaṃ sugrīvasacivo hanūmā nnāma vānaraḥ || 9 || tena ca prerito'bhyāgāṃ yuvābhyāṃ sakhyamicchatā || āgacchataṃ tadbhadraṃ vāṃ sugrīvāṃtikamāśu vai || 3.1.2.10 || tathāstviti sa rāmo pi tena sākaṃ munīśvarāḥ || sugrīvāṃtikamāgapya sakhyaṃ cakre'gnisākṣikam || 11 || pratijajñe'tha rāmo'pi tasmai vālivadhaṃ prati || sugrīvaścāpi vai dehyāḥ punarānayanaṃ dvijāḥ || 12 || ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā viśvāsya ca parasparam || mudā paramayā yuktau nareśvarakapīśvarau ||13|| āsāte brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā ṛṣyamūkagirau tathā || sugrīvapratyayārthaṃ ca duṃdubheḥ kāyamāśu vai|| 14 || pādāṃguṣṭhena cikṣepa rāghavo bahuyojanam || saptatālā vinirbhinnā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā || 15 || tataḥ prītamanā vīraḥ sugrīvo rāmamabravīt || iṃdrādidevatābhyo'pi nāsti rāghava me bhayam|| 16 || bhavānmitraṃ mayā labdho yasmādati parākramaḥ || ahaṃ laṃkeśvaraṃ hatvā bhāryāmānayitāsmi te || 17 || tataḥ sugrīvasahito rāmacaṃdro mahābalaḥ || salakṣmaṇo yayau tūrṇaṃ kiṣkiṃdhāṃ vālipālitām || 18 || tato jagarja sugrīvo vālyāgamanakāṃkṣayā || amṛṣyamāṇo vālī ca garjitaṃ svānujasya vai|| || 19 || aṃtaḥpurādviniṣkramya yuyudhe'varajena saḥ || vālimuṣṭiprahāreṇa tāḍito bhṛśavihvalaḥ || 3.1.2.20 || sugrīvo nirgatastūrṇaṃ yatra rāmo mahābalaḥ || tato rāmo mahābāhussugrīvasya śirodhare || 21 || latāmābadhya cihnaṃ tu yuddhāyācodayattadā || garjitena samāhūya sugrīvo vālinaṃ punaḥ || 22 || rāmapreraṇayā tena bāhuyuddhamathākarot || tato vālinamājaghne śareṇaikena rāghavaḥ || 23 || hate vālini sugrīvaḥ kiṣkiṃdhāṃ pratyapadyata || tato varṣāsvatītāsu sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ || 24 || sītāmānayituṃ tūrṇaṃ vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūm || samādāya samāgacchadaṃtikaṃ nṛpaputrayoḥ || 25 || prasthāpayāmāsa kapīnsītānveṣaṇakāṃkṣayā || viditāyāṃ tu vaidehyā laṃkāyāṃ vāyusūnunā || 26 || datte cūḍāmaṇau cāpi rāghavo harṣaśokavān|| sugrīveṇānujenāpi vāyuputreṇa dhīmatā || 27 || tathānyaiḥ kapibhiścaiva jāṃbavannalamukhyakaiḥ || anvīyamāno rāmo'sau muhūrte'bhijiti dvijāḥ ||28|| vilaṃghya vividhā ndeśānmaheṃdraṃ parvataṃ yayau || cakratīrthaṃ tato gatvā nivāsamakarottadā || 29 || tatraiva tu sa dharmātmā samāgacchadvibhīṣaṇaḥ || bhrātā vai rākṣaseṃdrasya caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ saha || 3.1.2.30 || pratijagrāha rāmastaṃ svāgatena mahātmanā || sugrīvasya tu śaṃkā'bhūtpraṇidhiḥ syādayaṃ tviti || 31 || rāghavastasya ceṣṭābhiḥ samyaksvacaritairhitaiḥ || aduṣṭamenaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva tata enamapūjayat || 32 || sarvarākṣasarājye tamabhyaṣiṃcadvibhīṣaṇam || cakre ca maṃtripravaraṃ sadṛśaṃ ravisūnunā || 33 || cakratīrthaṃ samāsādya nivasadraghunaṃdanaḥ || ciṃtayanrāghavaḥ śrīmānsugrīvādīnabhāṣata || 34 || madhye vānaramu khyānāṃ prāptakālamidaṃ vacaḥ || upāyaḥ ko nu bhavatāmetatsāgaralaṃghane || 35 || iyaṃ ca mahatī senā sāgaraścāpi dustaraḥ || aṃbhorāśirayaṃ nīlaścaṃcalormmisamākulaḥ || 36 || udyanmatsyo mahānakraśaṃkhaśuktisamākulaḥ || kvacidaurvānalākrāṃtaḥ phenavānatibhīṣaṇaḥ || || 37 || prakṛṣṭapavanākṛṣṭanīlameghasamanvitaḥ || pralayāṃbhodharārāvaḥ sāravānaniloddhataḥ || 38 || kathaṃ sāgaramakṣobhyaṃ tarāmo varuṇā layam || sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇāṃ mahaujasām || 39 || upāyairadhigacchāmo yathā nadanadīpatim || kathaṃ tarāmaḥ sahasā sasainyā varuṇālayam || 3.1.2.40 || śatayojanamāyātaṃ manasāpi durāsadam || ato nu vighnā bahavaḥ kathaṃ prāpyā ca maithilī || 41 || kaṣṭātkaṣṭataraṃ prāptā vayamadya nirāśrayāḥ || mahājale mahāvāte samudre hi nirāśraye || 42 || upāyaṃ kaṃ vidhāsyāmastaraṇārthaṃ vanaukasām || rājyādbhraṣṭo vanaṃ prāpto hṛtā sītā mṛtaḥ pitā || 43 || ito'pi duḥsahaṃ duḥkhaṃ yatsāgaravilaṃghanam || dhigdhiggarjitamaṃbhodhe dhigetāṃ vārirāśitām || 44 || kathaṃ tadvacanaṃ mithyā maharṣeḥ kumbhajanmanaḥ || hatvā tvaṃ rāvaṇaṃ pāpaṃ pavitre gaṃdhamādane || pāpopaśamanāyāśu gacchasveti yadīritam ||45|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti rāmavacaḥ śrutvā sugrīvapramukhāstadā || 46 || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ saṃrme rāghavaṃ taṃ mahābalam || naubhirenaṃ tariṣyāmaḥ plavaiśca vividhairiti || 47 || madhye vānarakoṭīnāṃ tadovāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ || samudraṃ rāghavo rājā śaraṇaṃ gantumarhati || 48 || khanitaḥ sāgaraireṣa samudro varuṇālayaḥ || kartumarhati rāmasya tajjñāteḥ kāryamaṃbudhiḥ || 49 || vibhīṣaṇenaivamukto rākṣasena vipaścitā || sāṃtvayanrāghavaḥ sarvānvānarānidamabravīt || 3.1.2.50 || śatayojana vistāramaśaktāḥ sarvavānarāḥ || tartuṃ plavoḍupairenaṃ samudramatibhīṣaṇam || 51 || nāvo na saṃti senāyā bahvyā vānarapuṃgavāḥ || vaṇijāmupaghātaṃ ca kathamasmadvidhaścaret || 52 || vistīrṇaṃ caiva naḥ sainyaṃ hanyācchidreṣu vā paraḥ || plavoḍupapratāro'to naivātra mama rocate || 53 || vibhīṣeṇoktame vedaṃ modate mama vānarāḥ || ahaṃ tvimaṃ jalanidhimupāsye mārgasiddhaye || 54 || no ceddarśayitā mārgaṃ dhakṣyāmyenamahaṃ tadā || mahāstrairapratihatairatyagnipavanojjvalaiḥ || 55 || ityuktvā sahasaumitrirupaspṛśyātha rāghavaḥ || pratiśiśye jalanidhiṃ vidhivatkuśasaṃstare || 56 || tadā rāmaḥ kuśā stīrṇe tīre nadanadīpateḥ || saṃviveśa mahābāhurvedyāmiva hutāśanaḥ || 57 || śeṣabhoganibhaṃ bāhumupadhāya raghūdvahaḥ || dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumupāste makarālayam || 58 || tasya rāmasya suptasya kuśāstīrṇe mahītale || niyamādapramattasya niśāstisro'ticakramuḥ || 59 || sa trirātroṣitastatra nayajño dharmatatparaḥ || upāstesma tadā rāmaḥ sāgaraṃ mārgasiddhaye || 3.1.2.60 || na ca darśayate mandastadā rāmasya sāgaraḥ || prayatenāpi rāmeṇa yathārhamapi pūjitaḥ || 61 || tathāpi sāgaro rāmaṃ na darśayati cātmanaḥ || samudrāya tataḥ kruddho rāmo raktāṃtalocanaḥ || 62 || samīpavartinaṃ cedaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ pratyabhāṣata || adya madbāṇanirbhinnairmakarairvaruṇālayam || 63 || niruddhatoyaṃ saumitre kariṣyāmi kṣaṇādaham || saśaṃkhaśuktājālaṃ hi samīnamakaraṃ śanaiḥ || 64 || adya bāṇairamoghāstrairvāridhiṃ pariśoṣaye || kṣamayā hi samāyuktaṃ māmayaṃ makarālayaḥ || 69 || asamarthaṃ vijānāti dhikkṣamāmīdṛśe jane || na darśayati sāmnā me sāgaro rūpamātmanaḥ || 66 || cāpamānaya saumitre śarāṃścāśīviṣopamān|| sāgaraṃ śoṣayiṣyāmi padbhyāṃ yāṃtu plavaṃgamāḥ || 67 || enaṃ laṃghitamaryādaṃ sahasrormisamākulam || nirmaryādaṃ kariṣyāmi sāyakairvaruṇālayam || 68 || mahārṇavaṃ śoṣayiṣye mahādānavasaṃkulam || mahāmakaranakrāḍhyaṃ mahāvīcisamākulam || 69 || evamuktvā dhanuṣpāṇiḥ krodhaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ || rāmo babhūva durdharṣastripuraghno yathā śivaḥ || 3.1.2.70 || ākṛṣya cāpaṃ kopena kampayitvā śarairjagat || mumoca viśikhānugrāṃstripureṣu yathā bhavaḥ || 71 || dīptā bāṇāśca ye ghorā bhāsayanto diśo daśa || prāviśanvāridhestoyaṃ dṛptadānavasaṃkulam ||72|| samudrastu tato bhīto vepamānaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || ananyaśaraṇo viprāḥ pātā lātsvayamutthitaḥ||73|| śaraṇaṃ rāghavaṃ bheje kaivalyapadakāraṇam || tuṣṭāva rāghavaṃ viprā bhūtvā śabdairmanoramaiḥ || 74 || || samudra uvāca|| || namāmi te rāghava pādapaṃkajaṃ sītāpate saukhyada pādasevanāt || namāmi te gautamadāramokṣajaṃ śrīpādareṇuṃ suravṛndasevyam||76|| sundapriyādehavidāriṇe namo namostu te kauśikayāgarakṣiṇe || namo mahādevaśarāsabhedine namo namo rākṣasasaṃghanāśine || 76 || rāmarāma namasyāmi bhaktānāmiṣṭadāyinam || avatīrṇo raghukule devakāryacikīrṣayā || 77 || nārāyaṇamanādyaṃtaṃ mokṣadaṃ śivamacyutam || rāmarāma mahābāho rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 78 || kopaṃ saṃhara rājeṃdra kṣamasva karuṇālaya || bhūmirvāto viyaccāpo jyotīṃṣi ca raghūdvaha || 79 || yatsvabhāvāni sṛṣṭāni brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || vartaṃte tatsvabhā vāni svabhāvo me hyagādhatā || 3.1.2.80 || vikārastu bhavedgādha etatsatyaṃ vadāmyaham || lobhātkāmādbhayādvāpi rāgādvāpi raghūdvaha || 81 || na vaṃśajaṃ guṇaṃ hātumutsaheyaṃ kathaṃcana || tatkariṣye ca sāhāyyaṃ senāyāstaraṇe tava || 82 || ityuktavantaṃ jaladhiṃ rāmo'vādīnnadīpatim || sasainyo'haṃ gami ṣyāmi laṃkāṃ rāvaṇapālitām || 83 || tacchoṣamupayāhi tvaṃ taraṇārthaṃ mamādhunā || ityuktastaṃ punaḥ prāha rāghavaṃ varuṇālayaḥ || 84 || śṛṇuṣvāva hito rāma śrutvā kartavyamācara || yadyājñayā te śuṣyāmi sasainyasya yiyāsataḥ ||85|| anye'pyājñāpayiṣyaṃti māmevaṃ dhanuṣo balāt || upāyamanyaṃ vakṣyāmi taraṇārthaṃ balasya te || 86 || asti hyatra nalonāma vānaraḥ śilpisaṃmataḥ || tvaṣṭuḥ kākutstha tanayo balavānviśvakarmaṇaḥ || 87 || sa yatkāṣṭhaṃ tṛṇaṃ vāpi śilāṃ vā kṣepsyate mayi || sarvaṃ taddhārayiṣyāmi sa te seturbhaviṣyati || 88 || setunā tena gaccha tvaṃ laṃkāṃ rāvaṇapāli tām || uktvetyaṃtarhite tasminrāmo nalamuvāca ha || 89 || kuru setuṃ samudre tvaṃ śakto hyasi mahāmate || tadā'bravīnnalo vākyaṃ rāmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam || 3.1.2.90 || ahaṃ setuṃ vidhāsyāmi hyagādhe varuṇālaye || pitrā dattavaraścāhaṃ sāmarthye cāpi tatsamaḥ || 91 || māturmama varo datto mandare viśvaka rmaṇā || śilpakarmaṇi mattulyo bhavitā te sutastviti || 92 || putro'hamaurasastasya tulyo vai viśvakarmaṇā || adyaiva kāmaṃ badhnaṃtu setuṃ vānarapuṃ gavāḥ || 93 || tato rāmanisṛṣṭāste vānarā balavattarāḥ || parvatāngiriśṛṃgāṇi latātṛṇamahīruhān || 94 || samājahrurmahākāyā garuḍānilaraṃhasaḥ || nalaścakre mahāsertumadhye nadanadīpateḥ || 95 || daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyatam || jānakīramaṇo rāmaḥ setumevamakārayat || 96 ||| nalena vānarendreṇa viśvakarmasutena vai || tamevaṃ setumāsādya rāmacandreṇa kāritam || 97 || sarve pātakino martyā mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ || vratadāna tapohomairna tathā tuṣyate śivaḥ || 98 || setumajjanamātreṇa yathā tuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ || na tulyaṃ vidyate tejoyathā saureṇa tejasā || 99 || setusnānena ca tathā na tulyaṃ vidyate kvacit || tatsetumūlaṃ laṃkāyāṃ yatrarāmo yiyāsayā || 3.1.2.100 || vānaraiḥ setumārebhe puṇyaṃ pāpa praṇāśanam || taddarbhaśayanaṃ nāmnā paścāllokeṣu viśrutam || 101|| evamuktaṃ mayā viprāḥ samudre setubaṃdhanam || atra tīrthānyanekāni saṃti puṇyānyanekaśaḥ || 102 || na saṃkhyāṃ nāmadheyaṃ vā śeṣo gaṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ || kiṃ tvahaṃ prabravīmyadya tatra tīrthāni kānicit || 103 || caturviṃśati tīrthāni saṃti setau pradhānataḥ|| prathamaṃ cakatīrthaṃ syādvetālavaradaṃ tataḥ || 104 || tataḥ pāpavināśārthaṃ tīrthaṃ lokeṣu viśrutam || tataḥ sītāsaraḥ puṇyaṃ tato maṃgalatīrthakam|| || 105 || tataḥ sakalapāpaghnī nāmnā cāmṛtavāpikā || brahmakuṇḍaṃ tatastīrthaṃ tataḥ kuṃḍaṃ hanūmataḥ || 106 || āgastyaṃ hi tatastīrthaṃ rāmatīrtha mataḥ param || tato lakṣmaṇatīrthaṃ syājjaṭātīrthamataḥ param || 107 || tato lakṣmyāḥ paraṃ tīrthamagnitīrthamataḥ param || cakratīrthaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ śivatīrthamataḥ param || 108 || tataḥ śaṃkhābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ tato yāmunatīrthakam || gaṃgātīrthaṃ tataḥ paścādgayātīrthamanantaram || 109 || tataḥ syātkoṭitīrthākhyaṃ sādhyānāmamṛtaṃ tataḥ || mānasākhyaṃ tatastīrthaṃ dhanuṣkoṭistataḥ param || 3.1.2.110 || pradhānatīrthānyetāni mahāpāpaharāṇi ca || kathitāni dvijaśreṣṭhāssetumadhyagatāni vai || 111 || yathā setuśca baddho'bhūdrāmeṇa jaladhau mahān || kathitaṃ tacca viprendrāḥ puṇyaṃ pāpahāraṃ tathā || 112 || yacchrutvā ca paṭhitvā ca mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 113 || adhyāyamenaṃ paṭhate manuṣyaḥ śṛṇoti vā bhaktiyuto dvijeṃdrāḥ || so naṃtamāpnoti jayaṃ paratra punarbhavakleśamasau na gacchet || 114 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye setunirmāṇādivarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || ||
<3.1.3>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || caturviṃśatitīrthāni yānyuktāni tvayā mune || teṣāṃ pradhānatīrthānāṃ setau pāpavināśane || 1 || ādimasya tu tīrthasya cakratīrthamiti prathā || kathaṃ samāgatā sūta vadāsmākaṃ hi pṛcchatām || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || caturviṃśatitīrthānāṃ pradhānānāṃ dvijottamāḥ || yaduktamādimaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || || 3 || smaraṇāttasya tīrthasya garbhavāso na vidyate || vilayaṃ yāṃti pāpāni lakṣajanmakṛtānyapi || 4 || tasmiṃstīrthe sakṛtsnānā tsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi || loke tatodhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tattulyaṃ vā dvijottamāḥ || 5 || na vidyate muniśreṣṭhāḥ satyamuktamidaṃ mayā || gaṃgā sarasvatī revā paṃpā godāvarī nadī || 6 || kāliṃdī caiva kāverī narmadā maṇikarṇikā || anyāni yāni tīrthāni nadyaḥ puṇyā mahītale || || 7 || asya tīrthasya vipreṃdrāḥ koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ || dharmatīrthamiti prāhustattīrthaṃ hi purāvidaḥ || 8 || yathā samāgatā tasya cakratīrthamiti prathā || tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 9 || setumūlaṃ hi tatproktaṃ taddarbhaśayanaṃ matam || tatraiva cakratīrthaṃ tu mahāpātakamarddanam || ||3.1.3.10||| purā hi gālavonāma munirviṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ || dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhestīre hālāsyādavidūrataḥ ||11|| phullagrāmasamīpe ca tathā kṣīrasaroṃtike || dharma puṣkariṇītīre so'tapyata mahattapaḥ || 12 || yugānāmayutaṃ brahma gṛṇanviprāḥ sanātanam|| dayāyukto nirāhāraḥ satyavānvijiteṃdriyaḥ ||13|| ātmavatsarvabhūtāni paśyanviṣayaniḥspṛhaḥ || sarvabhūtahito dāṃtaḥ sarvadvaṃdvavivarjitaḥ || 14 || varṣāṇi katicitso'yaṃ jīrṇaparṇāśano'bhavata || kiṃcitkālaṃ jalāhāro vāyubhakṣaḥ kiyatsamāḥ || 15 || evaṃ paṃcasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi sa mahāmuniḥ || atapyata tapo ghoraṃ devairapi suduṣkaram || 16 ||| tataḥ paṃcasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi munipuṃgavaḥ || nirāhāro nirāloko nirucchvāso nirāspadaḥ || 17 || varṣāsvāsārasahanaṃ hemaṃteṣu jaleśayaḥ|| grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyastho viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ|| 18 || japannaṣṭākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ dhyāyanhṛdi janārdanam|| tatāpa sumahātejā gālavo munipuṃgavaḥ || 19 || evaṃ tvayutava varṣāṇi sa samatītāni vai muneḥ|| atha tattapasā tuṣṭo bhagavānkamalāpatiḥ||3.1.3.20||| pratyakṣatāmagāttasya śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ|| vikacāṃbujapatrākṣaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ||21|| vinatānaṃdanārūḍhaśchatracāmaraśobhitaḥ|| hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakādivibhūṣitaḥ||22|| viṣvaksenasunaṃdādikiṃkaraiḥ parivāritaḥ || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādivādakairnāradādibhiḥ || 23 || upagīyamānavijayaḥ pītāṃbaravirājitaḥ || lakṣmīvirājitorasko nīlameghasamacchaviḥ|| || 24 || dhunānaḥ padmamekena pāṇinā madhusūdanaḥ || sanakādimahāyogisevitaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ || 25 || maṃdasmitena sakalaṃ mohayanbhuvanatrayam || svabhāsā bhāsayansarvāndiśo daśa ca bhūsurāḥ || 26 || kaṃṭhalagrena maṇinā kaustubhena ca śobhitaḥ || suvarṇavetrahastaiśca sauvidallairanekaśaḥ || || 27 || ananyadurlabhāciṃtyagīyamānanijādbhutaḥ || subhaktasulabho devo lakṣmīkāṃto hariḥ svayam || 28 || sannyadhatta purastasya gālavasya mahāmuneḥ || āvirbhūtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasam || 29 || pītāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭiṃ prāpa mahāmuniḥ || bhaktyā paramayā yuktastuṣṭāva jagadīśvaram|| ||3.1.3.30| || gālava uvāca || namo devādidevāya śaṃkhacakragadābhṛte || namo nityāya śuddhāya saccidānaṃdarūpiṇe ||31|| namo bhaktārti haṃtre te havyakavyasvarūpiṇe|| namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ sṛṣṭisthityaṃtakāriṇe||32|| namaḥ pareśāya namo vibhūmne namostu lakṣmīpataye vidhātre|| namostu sūryeṃduvilocanāya namo viriṃcyādyabhivaṃditāya ||33|| yo nāmajātyādivikalpahīnaḥ samastadoṣairapi varjito yaḥ || sramastasaṃsārabhayāpahāriṇe tasmai namo daityavināśanāya || 34 || vedāṃtavedyāya rameśvarāya vaikuṇṭhavāsāya vidhātṛpitre || namonamaḥ satyajanārtihāriṇe nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya|| 35|| namastubhyaṃ bhaga vate vāsudevāya śārṅgiṇe || bhūyobhūyo namastubhyaṃ śeṣaparyaṃkaśāyine || 36 || iti stutvā hariṃ viprāstūṣṇīmāste sa gālavaḥ || śrutvā stutiṃ śruti sukhāṃ haristasyamahātmanaḥ || 37 || avāpa paramaṃ toṣaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || athāliṃgya muniṃ śauriścaturbhirbāhubhistadā || 38 || babhāṣe prītisaṃ yukto varo vai vriyatāmiti || tuṣṭo'smi tapasā te'dya stotreṇāpi ca gālava || 39 || namaskāreṇa ca prīto varado'haṃ tavāgataḥ || || gālava uvāca || || nārāyaṇa ramānātha pītāṃbara jaganmaya || 3.1.3.40 || janārdana jagaddhāmangoviṃda narakāṃtaka || tvaddarśanātkṛtārtho'smi sarvasmādadhikastathā || 41 || tvāṃ na paśyaṃtyadharmiṣṭhā yatastvaṃ dharmapālakaḥ || yanna vetti bhavo brahmā yanna vetti trayī tathā || 42 || taṃ vedmi paramātmānaṃ kimasmā dadhikaṃ varam|| yogino yaṃ na paśyanti yaṃ na paśyaṃti karmaṭhāḥ || 43 || taṃ paśyāmi parātmānaṃ kimasmādadhikaṃ varam || etena ca kṛtārtho'smi janārdana jagatpate || 44 || yannāmasmṛtimātreṇa mahāpātakino'pica|| muktiṃ prayāṃti munayastaṃ paśyāmi janārdanam|| 45 || tvatpādapadmayugale niścalā bhaktirastume || || hariruvāca || || mayi bhaktirdṛḍhā te'stu niṣkāmā gālavādhunā|| 46 || śṛṇu cāpyaparaṃ vākyamucyamānaṃ mayā mune || madarthaṃ karma kurvāṇo maddhyāno matparāyaṇaḥ ||47|| etatprārabdhadehāṃte matsvarūpamavāpsyasi || asminnevāśrame vāsaṃ kuruṣva munipuṃgava ||48|| dharmapuṣkariṇī ceyaṃ puṇyā pāpavināśinī || asyāstīre tapaḥ kurvaṃstapaḥsiddhimavāpnuyāt || 49 || dharmaḥ purā samāgatya dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe || tapastepe mahādevaṃ ciṃtayanmanasā tadā || 3.1.3.50 || snānārthamekaṃ tīrthaṃ ca cakre dharmo mahāmune || dharmapuṣkariṇī tena prasiddhā tatkṛtā yataḥ || 51 || tvayā yathā tapastaptamidānīṃ munisattama || tathā taptaṃ tapastena dharmeṇa harasevinā || 52 || tapasā tasya tuṣṭaḥ sañchūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ || prādurāsīstvayā dīptyā diśodaśavibhāsayan || 53 || athāśramamanuprāptaṃ mahādevaṃ kṛpānidhim || dharmaḥ paramasantuṣṭastuṣṭāva parameśvaram|| 54 || || dharma uvāca || || praṇamāmi jagannāthamīśānaṃ praṇavātmakam || samastadevatārūpamādimadhyāṃtavarjitam || 55 || ūrdhvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpaṃ namāmya ham || samastajagadādhāramanantamajamavyayam ||56|| yamāmananti yogīndrāstaṃ vande puṣṭivardhanam || namo lokādhināthāya vaṃcate parivaṃcate ||57 || namo'stu nīlakaṇṭhāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || namaḥ kalmaṣanāśāya namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya ca || 58 || namo rudrāya devāya kadrudrāya pracetase || namaḥ pinākahastāya śūlahastāya te namaḥ || 59 || namaścaitanyarūpāya puṣṭīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || namaḥ paṃcāsyadevāya kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 3.1.3.60 || iti stuto mahādevaḥ śaṃkarolokaśaṃkaraḥ || dharmasya paramāṃ tuṣṭimāpannastamuvāca vai || 61 || || maheśvara uvāca || || prītosmyanena stotreṇa tava dharma mahāmate || varaṃ matto vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ mā vilaṃbaṃ kuruṣva vai || 62 || īśvareṇaivamuktastu dharmo devamathābravīt || vāhanaṃ te bhaviṣyāmi sadāhaṃ pārvatīpate ||| || 63 || ayameva varo mahyaṃ dātavyastripurāṃtaka || tavodvahanamātreṇa kṛtārtho'haṃ bhavāmi bhoḥ || 64 || itthaṃ dharmeṇa kathito devo dharmamathābravīt || || īśvara uvāca || || vāhanaṃ bhava me dharma sarvadā lokapūjitaḥ || 65 || mama codvahane śaktiramoghā te bhaviṣyati || tvatsevināṃ sadā bhaktirmayi syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 66 || ityukte śaṃkareṇātha dharmopi vṛṣarūpadhṛk || uvāha parameśānaṃ tadāprabhṛti gālava || 67 || mahādevastamāruhya dharmaṃ vai vṛṣarūpiṇam || śobhamāno bhṛśaṃ dharmamuvāca paramāmṛtam ||68 || || īśvara uvāca || tvayā kṛtaṃ hi yattīrthaṃ dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe || dharmapuṣkariṇītyeṣā loke khyātā bhaviṣyati ||69|| asyāstīre japohomo dānaṃ svādhyāya eva ca || anye ca dharmanivahāḥ kriyamāṇā narairmudā || 3.1.3.7||| anaṃtaphaladā jñeyā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai dharmatīrthāya śaṃkaraḥ || 71 || āruhya vṛṣabhaṃ dharmaṃ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ yayau || dharmapuṣkariṇītīre gālava tvamatodhunā || 72 || śarīrapātaparyaṃtaṃ tapaḥ kurvansamāhitaḥ || vasa tvaṃ muni śārdūla paścānmāmāpsyase dhruvam || 73 || yadā te jāyate bhītistadā tāṃ nāśayāmyaham || mamāyudhena cakreṇa preritena mayā kṣaṇāt ||74|| ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || || śrīsūta uvāca || || tasminnaṃtarhite viṣṇau gālavo munipuṃgavaḥ ||75|| dharmapuṣkariṇītīre viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || trikālamarcayanviṣṇuṃ śālagrāme vimuktide || 76 || uvāsa matimāndhīro virakto vijiteṃdriyaḥ || kadācinmāghamāse tu śuklapakṣe harerdine || 77 || upoṣya jāgaraṃ kṛtvā rātrau viṣṇumapūjayat || snātvā paredyurdvādaśyāṃ dharmapuṣkariṇījale || 78 || saṃdhyāvandanapūrvāṇi nityakarmāṇi cākarot ||| tataḥ pūjāṃ vidhātuṃ sa hareḥ samupacakrame || 79 || tulasyādīni puṣpāṇi samāhṛtya ca gālavaḥ || vidhāya pūjāṃ kṛṣṇasya stotrametadudairayat || 3.1.3.80 || || gālava uvāca || || sahasraśirasaṃ viṣṇuṃ matsyarūpadharaṃ harim || namasyāmi hṛṣīkeśaṃ kūrmavārāharūpiṇam || 81 || nārasiṃhaṃ vāmanākhyaṃ jāma dagnyaṃ ca rāghavam || balabhadraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kalkiṃ viṣṇuṃ namāmyaham || 82 || vāsudevamanādhāraṃ praṇatārtivināśanam || ādhāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ praṇamāmi janārdanam || 83 || sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ saccidānaṃdavigraham || apratarkyamanirdeśyaṃ praṇato'smi janārdanam || 84 || evaṃ stuvanmahā yogī gālavo munipuṃgavaḥ || dharmapuṣkariṇītīre tasthau dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 85 || etasminnaṃtare kaścidrākṣaso gālavaṃ munim || āyayau bhakṣituṃ ghoraḥ kṣudhayā pīḍito bhṛśam || 86 || gālavaṃ tarasā so'yaṃ rākṣaso jagṛhe tadā || gṛhītastarasā tena gālavo naiṛtena saḥ || 87 || pracukrośa dayāṃ bhodhimāpannānāṃ parāyaṇam || nārāyaṇaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ rakṣarakṣeti vai muhuḥ || 88 || pareśa paramānaṃda śaraṇāgatapālaka || trāhi māṃ karuṇāsiṃdho rakṣovaśe mupāgatam || 89 || lakṣmīkāṃta hare viṣṇo vaikuṃṭha garuḍadhvaja || māṃ rakṣa rakṣasākrāṃtaṃ grāhākrāṃtaṃ gajaṃ yathā || 3.1.3.90 || dāmodara jagannātha hiraṇyāsura marddana || prahrādamiva māṃ rakṣa rākṣasenātipīḍitam || 91 || ityevaṃ stuvatastasya gālavasya dvijottamāḥ || svabhaktasya bhayaṃ jñātvā cakrapāṇivṛṣā kapiḥ || 92 || svacakraṃ preṣayāmāsa bhaktarakṣaṇakāraṇāt || preritaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ tadviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 93 || ājagāmātha vegena dharmapuṣkariṇī taṭam || anaṃtādityasaṃkāśamanaṃtāgnisamaprabham || 94 || mahājvālaṃ mahānādaṃ mahāsuravimardanam || dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ viṣṇo rākṣaso'tha pradudruve || || 95 || dravamāṇasya tasyāśu rākṣasasya sudarśanam|| śiraścakarta sahasā jvālāmālādurāsadam || 96 || tatastu gālavo dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi || mudā paramayā yuktastuṣṭāva ca sudarśanam || 97 || || gālava uvāca || || viṣṇucakraṃ namastestu viśvarakṣaṇadīkṣita || nārāyaṇakarāṃbhojabhūṣaṇāya namo'stu te || 98 || yuddheṣvasurasaṃhārakuśalāya mahārava || sudarśana namastubhyaṃ bhaktānāmārtināśine || 99 || rakṣa māṃ bhayasaṃvignaṃ sarvasmādapi kalmaṣāt || svāminsudarśana vibho dharmartīrthe sadā bhavān || 3.1.3.100 || saṃnidhehi hitāya tvaṃ jagato muktikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || gālavenaivamuktaṃ tadviṣṇucakraṃ munīśvarāḥ || taṃ prāha gālavamuniṃ prīṇayanniva sauhṛdāt || 101 || || sudarśana uvāca || || gālavaitanmahāpuṇyaṃ dharmatorthamanuttamam || 102 || asminvasāmi satataṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā|| tvatpīḍāṃ pariciṃtyāha rākṣasena durātmanā ||103|| prerito viṣṇunā vipra tvarayā samupāgataḥ|| tvatpīḍakotha nihato mayāyaṃ rākṣasādhamaḥ ||104|| mocitastvaṃ bhayādasmāttvaṃ hi bhakto hareḥ sadā || puṣkariṇyāmahaṃ tvasyāṃ dharmasya munipuṃgava ||105|| satataṃ lokarakṣārthaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ karomi vai || asyāṃ matsaṃnidhānātte tathānyeṣāmapi dvija ||106|| itaḥ paraṃ na pīḍā syādbhūtarākṣasasaṃbhavā || dharmapuṣkariṇī hyeṣā sarvapāpavināśinī || 107 || devīpaṭṭaṇaparyaṃtā kṛtā dharmeṇa vai purā || atra sarvatra vatsyāmi sarvadā munipuṃgava || 108 || asyā matsaṃnidhā nātsyāccakratīrthamiti prathā|| snānaṃ ye'tra prakurvaṃti cakratīrthe vimuktide || 109. || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca vaṃśajāḥ sarva eva hi || vidhūtapāpā yāsyaṃti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 3.1.3.110 || pitṝnuddiśya piṃḍānāṃ dātāro ye'tra gālava || svargaṃ prayāṃti te sarve pitaraścāpi tarppitāḥ || 111 || ityuktvā viṣṇucakraṃ tadgālavasyāpi paśyataḥ|| anyeṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ paśyatāṃ sahasā dvijāḥ || 112 || dharmāpuṣkāriṇīṃ tāṃ tu prāviśatpāpanāśinīm || śrīsūta uvāca|| dharmatīrthasya vipraṃdrāścakratīrthamiti prathā||113|| prāptā yathā tatkathitaṃ yuṣmākaṃ hi mayā mudā|| cakratīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati||114|| atra snātā narā viprā mokṣabhājo na saṃśayaḥ|| kīrtayedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ|| cakra tīrthābhiṣekasya prāpnoti phalamuttamam || iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya paratrāpisukhaṃ labhet || 116 || yo dharmatīrthaṃ ca tathaiva gālavaṃ kurvāṇagatyugrasamādhiyo gam || sudarśanaṃ rākṣasanāśanaṃ ca smaretsakṛdvā na sa pāpabhāgjanaḥ || 117 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe. setumāhātmye gālavākhyāne dharmatīrthasya cakratīrthaprathāvarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<3.1.4>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavanrākṣasaḥ ko'sau sūta paurāṇikottama|| viṣṇubhaktaṃ mahātmānaṃ yo gālavamabādhata||1|| śrīsūta uvāca|| vakṣyāmi rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ taṃ viprāḥ śṛṇutādarāt || yathā sa rākṣaso jāto munīnāṃ śāpavaibhavāt || 2 || purā kailāsaśikhare hālāsye śivamaṃdire || caturviśatisāhasrā munayo brahmavādinaḥ || 3 || vasiṣṭhātrimukhāḥ sarve śivabhaktā mahaujasaḥ || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgāstripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakāḥ || 4 || rudrākṣa mālābharaṇāḥ paṃcākṣarajape ratāḥ || hālāsyanāthaṃ bhūteśaṃ caṃdracūḍamumāpatim || 5 || upāsāṃcakrire muktyai madhurāpuravāsinaḥ || kadācittatra gaṃdharvo viśvāvasusuto balī || 6 || durddamonāma vipreṃdrā viṭagoṣṭhīparāyaṇaḥ || lalanāśatasaṃyukto vivastraḥ salilāśaye || 7 || cikrīḍa sa vivastrābhiḥ sākaṃ yuvatibhirmudā || hālāsyanāthatīrthaṃ tadvasiṣṭho munibhiḥ saha || 8 || mādhyaṃdinaṃ kartumanā yayau śaṃkaramaṃdirāt || tānṛṣīnavalokyātha rāmāstā bhayakātarāḥ || 9 || vāsāṃsyācchādayāmāsurdurddamo na tu sāhasī || tato vasiṣṭhaḥ kupitaḥ śaśāpainaṃ gata trapam || 3.1.4.10 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yasmāddurdama gaṃdharva dṛṣṭvāsmām̐llajjayā tvayā || vāso nācchāditaṃ śīghraṃ yāhi rākṣasatāṃ tataḥ || 11 || ityuktvā tā striyaḥ prāha vasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ || yasmādācchāditaṃ vastraṃ dṛṣṭvāsmām̐llalanottamāḥ || 12 || tato na yuṣmāñchapiṣyāmi ganchadhvaṃ tridivaṃ tataḥ || evamuktā vasiṣṭhena rāmāḥ prāṃjalayastadā || 13 || praṇipatya vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ bhaktinamreṇa cetasā || munimaṃḍalamadhye taṃ vasiṣṭhamidamabruvan || 14|| || || rāmā ūcuḥ || || bhagavansarvadharmajña caturānananaṃdana || dayāsiṃdho'valokyāsmānna kopaṃ kartumarhasi || 15 || patirevahi nārīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ paramucyate || patihīnā tu yā nārī śataputrāpi sā mune ||16|| vidhavetyucyate loke tatstrīṇāṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtam || tatprasādaṃ kuru mune patyāvasmāka mādarāt || 17 || eko'parādhaḥ kṣaṃtavyo munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || kṣamāṃ kuru dayāsiṃdho yuṣmacchiṣye'tra durdame || 19 || vasiṣṭhaḥ prārthitastvaivaṃ durdama syāṃganājanaiḥ || provāca vacanaṃ bhūyaḥ prasannaḥ sa dvijottamāḥ || 19 || na me syādvacanaṃ mithyā kadācidapi subhruvaḥ || upāyaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ śraddhayā saha || 3.1.4.20 || ṣoḍaśābdāvadhiḥ śāpo bharturvo bhavitā dhruvam || ṣoḍaśābdāvadhau caiṣa durdamo rākṣasākṛtiḥ || 21 || yadṛcchayācakra tīrthaṃ gamiṣyati surāṃganāḥ || āste tatra mahāyogī gālavo viṣṇutatparaḥ ||22|| bhakṣyārthaṃ taṃ muniṃ so'yaṃ rākṣasobhigamiṣyati || tato gālavarakṣārthaṃ preritaṃ cakramuttamam||23|| viṣṇunāsya śiro rāmā hariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| tataḥ svarūpamāsādya śāpānmuktaḥ sudurdamaḥ ||24|| patirvastridivaṃ bhūyo gaṃtāstyatra na saṃśayaḥ || tatastridivamāsādya durddamo'yaṃ patirhi vaḥ || 25 || ramayiṣyati sundaryo yuṣmānsundaraveṣabhṛt || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ityuktvā tu vasiṣṭhastā durdamasya varāṃganāḥ || 26 || svāśramaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ hālāsyeśvarabhaktimān || atha rāmāstamāliṃgya durddamaṃ patimāturāḥ || 27 || ruruduḥ śokasaṃvignā duḥkhasāgaramadhyagāḥ || pra paśyaṃtīṣu tāsveva durdamo rākṣaso'bhavat || 28 || mahādaṃṣṭro mahākāyo raktaśmaśruśiroruhaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayasaṃvignā jagmū rāmāstriviṣṭapam || 29 || tato rākṣasaveṣo'yaṃ durdamo bhairavākṛtiḥ || bhakṣayanprāṇinaḥ sarvāndeśāddeśaṃ vanādvanam|| 3.1.4.30 || bhramanna nilavego'sau dharmatīrthaṃ tato yayau || evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi bhramato'sya yayustadā || 31 || tatastu ṣoḍaśābdāṃte rākṣasoyaṃ munīśvarāḥ || bhakṣituṃ gālavamuniṃ dharmatīrthanivāsinam || 32 || upādravadvāyuvegaḥ sacāstauṣījjanārdanam || gālavena stuto viṣṇustadā cakramacodayat || 33 || rakṣituṃ gāla vamuniṃ rākṣasena prapīḍitam || athāgatya hareścakraṃ rākṣasasya śiro'harat || 34 || tato'yaṃ rākṣasaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā divyakalevaraḥ || vimānavaramāruhya durdamaḥ puṣpavarṣitaḥ || 35 || prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā vavande taṃ sudarśanam || tuṣṭāva śrutiramyābhirvāgbhiragryābhirādarāt || 36 || || durdama uvāca ||| sudarśana namaste'stu viṣṇuhastaikabhūṣaṇa || namaste'surasaṃhartre sahasrādityatejase || 37 || kṛpāleśena bhavatastyaktvāhaṃ rākṣasīṃ tanum || svarūpamabhajaṃ viṣṇoścakrāyudha namo'stu te || 38 || anujānīhi māṃ gantuṃ tridivaṃ viṣṇuvallabha || bhāryā me pariśocaṃti virahāturacetasaḥ || 39 || tvanmanasko bhaviṣyāmi yāvajjīvaṃ yathāhyaham || tathā kṛpāṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mayi cakra namo'stu te || 3.1.4.40 || evaṃ stutaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ durdamena sabhaktikam || anujagrāha sahasā tathāstviti munīśvarāḥ || 41 || cakrāyudhābhyanujñāto durdamo gālavaṃ munim || praṇamya tenānujñāto gandharvastridivaṃ yayau || 42 ||| durdame tu gate svargaṃ gālavo munipuṃgavaḥ || sa cakraṃ prārthayāmāsa viṣṇvāyudhamanuttamam || 43 || cakrāyudha namāmi tvāṃ mahāsuravimarddana || devīpaṭṭaṇa paryaṃte dharmatīrthe hyanuttame || 44 || sannidhānaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || tvatsannidhānātsarveṣāṃ snātānāṃ pāpināmiha || 45 || pāpanāśaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mokṣaṃ ca kuru śāśvatam || cakratīrthamiti khyātiṃ lokasya parikalpaya || 46 || tvatsannidhānādatratyamunīnāṃ bhayanāśanam || itaḥ paraṃ bhavatvārya cakrāyudha namo'stu te || 47 || bhūtapretapiśācebhyo bhayaṃ mā bhavatu prabho || iti saṃprārthitaṃ cakraṃ gālavena munīśvarāḥ || 48 || tathaivā stviti sambhāṣya tasmiṃstīrthe tirohitam || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathito viprā rākṣasassa bhavo mayā || 49 || māhātmyaṃ cakra tīrthasya kathitaṃ ca malāpaham|| yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 3.1.4.50 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vyāsaśiṣya mahāprājña sūta paurāṇikottama || ārabhya darbhaśayanamādevīpattanāvadhi || 51 || bahuvyāyāmasaṃyuktaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam || yayau vicchinnatāṃ madhye kathaṃ kathaya sāṃpratam || || 52 || enaṃ manasi tiṣṭhantaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi || || śrīsūta uvāca || || purā hi parvatāḥ sarve jātapakṣā manojavāḥ || 53 || paryaṃtaparvatai sārddhaṃ cerurākāśamārgagāḥ || nagareṣu ca rāṣṭreṣu grāmeṣu ca vaneṣu ca || 54 || āplutyāplutya tiṣṭhaṃti parvatāḥ sarvato bhuvi || ākramyākramya tiṣṭhaṃti yatrayatra mahīdharāḥ || 55 || tatratatra narā gāvastathānye prāṇisaṃcayāḥ || maraṇaṃ sahasā prāpuḥ pīḍyamānā mahīdharaiḥ || 56 || brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu naṣṭeṣu samanantaram || yajñādyabhāvātsahasā devatā vyasanaṃ yayuḥ || 57 || tata indro mahākruddho vajramādāya vegavān || ciccheda sahasā pakṣānparvatānāṃ tarasvinām || 58 || chidyamānacchadāḥ sarve vāsavena mahīdharāḥ || ananyaśaraṇā bhūtvā samudraṃ prāviśanbhayāt || 59 || acaleṣu ca sarveṣu patatsu lavaṇārṇave || nipeturarṇavabhrāṃtyā cakratīrthepi kecana || 3.1.4.60 || patitaiḥ parvataistaistu madhyataḥ pūritodaram || cakratīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ madhye vicchedamāyayau || 61 || yadṛcchayā mahāśailāḥ pārśvayostatra nāpatan || ato vai darbhaśayane tathā devīpure'pi ca || 62 || vicchinnamadhyaṃ taddvedhā vibhakramiva dṛśyate || madhyataḥ patitaiḥ śailaiścakratīrthaṃ sthalīkṛtam ||63|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || yuṣmākamevaṃ kathitaṃ munīndrā yanmadhyatastīrthamidaṃ sthalī kṛtam || yathā mahīdhrāḥ sahasā biḍaujasā vicchinnapakṣā iha peturunnatāḥ || 64 || || iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye durdamagaṃdharvaśāpamocanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<3.1.5>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || prastutya cakratīrthaṃ tu puṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam || punarapyadbhutaṃ kiñcitprabravīmi munīśvarāḥ || 1 || vidhūmanāmā hi vasurdevastrī cāpyalaṃbuṣā || brahmaśāpānmahāghorātpurā prāptau manuṣyatām|| || 2 || cakratīrthe mahāpuṇye snātvā śāpādvimocitau || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūtasūta mahāprājña purāṇārthaviśārada|| 3 || prājñatvādvyāsaśiṣya tvādajñātaṃ te na kiṃcana || brahmā kenāparādhena sahālaṃbusayā vasum || 4 || purā vidhūmanāmānaṃ śaptavāṃścaturānanaḥ || brahmaśāpena ghoreṇa kayostau putratāṃ gatau || 5 || śāpasyāntaḥ kathamabhūdbrahmaṇā śaptayostayoḥ || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi || 6 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || purā hi bhagavānbrahmā svayambhūścaturānanaḥ || sāvitryā ca sarasvatyā pārśvayoḥ pravirājitaḥ || 7 || sanātanena muninā sanakena ca dhīmatā || sanatkumāranāmnā ca nāradena mahātmanā || 8 || sanandanādibhiścānyaiḥ sevyamāno munīśvaraiḥ || suparvavṛndajuṣṭena stūyamāno biḍaujasā || 9 || ādityādi grahaiścaiva stūyamānapadāṃbujaḥ || siddhaiḥ sādhyairmarudbhiśca kiṃnaraiśca samāvṛtaḥ || 3.1.5.10 || gaṇaiḥ kiṃpuruṣāṇāṃ ca vasubhiścāṣṭabhirvṛtaḥ || urvaśīpramukhānāṃ ca svarveśyānāṃ manoramam || 11 || nṛtyaṃ vāditrasahitaṃ vīkṣyamāṇo muhurmuhuḥ || goṣṭhīṃ cakre sabhāmadhye satyaloke kadācana || 12 || meghagarjitagambhīro janānāṃ naṃdayanmuhuḥ || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ dhvanistatra vyasarpata || 13 || gaṃgātaraṃgamālānāṃ śīkarasparśaśītalaḥ || pavamānaḥ sukhasparśo mandaṃ mandaṃ vavau tadā || 14 || paryāyeṇa tadā sarvā nanṛturdevayoṣitaḥ || nṛtyaśrameṇa khinnāsu veśyāsvanyāsu sādaram || 15 || alaṃbusā devanārī rūpayau vanaśālinī || madayantī janānsarvānsabhāmadhye nanarta vai || 16 || tasminnavasare tasyā nṛtyaṃtyāḥ saṃsadi dvijāḥ || vastramābhyaṃtaraṃ vāyurlīlayā samu dakṣipat || 17 || tatkṣipte vasane spaṣṭamūrumūlamadṛśyata || tathābhūtāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve brahmādayo hriyā || 19 || sabhāmadhye samāsīnā nimīlita dṛśo'bhavan || vidhūmanāmā tu vasuḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ || 19 || tāmeva brahmabhavane dṛṣṭvānilahṛtāṃśukām || harṣasaṃphullanayano hṛṣṭaromā tato'bhavat || 3.1.5.20 || alaṃbusāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu jātakāmaṃ vilokya tam || vasuṃ vidhūmanāmānaṃ śaśāpa caturānanaḥ || 21 || yasmāttvamīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ vidhūma kṛtavā nasi || tasmāddhi martyaloke tvaṃ mānuṣatvamavāpsyasi || 22 || iyaṃ ca devayoṣitte tatra bhāryā bhaviṣyati || evaṃ sa brahmaṇā śapto vidhūmaḥ khinnamā nasaḥ || 23 || prasādayāmāsa vasurbrahmāṇaṃ praṇipatya tu || || vidhūma uvāca || || asya śāpasya ghorasya bhagavanbhaktavatsala || 24 || nāha marho'smi deveśa rakṣa māṃ karuṇānidhe || evaṃ prasāditastena bhāratīpatiravyayaḥ || 25 || kṛpayā parayā yukto vidhūmaṃ prāha sāṃtvayan || || brahmovāca || || tvayi śāpo'pyayaṃ datto na cāsatyaṃ bravīmyaham || 26 || tato'vadhiṃ kalpayāmi śāpasyāsya tavādhunā || martyabhāvaṃ samāpannaḥ sahālaṃbusayā'nayā || 27 || tatra bhūtvā mahārājaḥ śāsayitvā ciraṃ mahīm || putramapratimaṃ tvasyāṃ janayitvā mahīpatim || 28 || abhiṣicya ca rājye taṃ rājyarakṣāvicakṣaṇam || etacchāpasya śāṃtyarthaṃ dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe || phullagrāmasamīpasthe cakratīrthe mahattare || 29 || anayā bhāryayā sārddhaṃ yadā snānaṃ kariṣyasi || tadā tvaṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ jīrṇatvacamivoragaḥ || 3.1.5.30 || visṛjya bhāryayā sārddhaṃ svaṃ lokaṃ pratipatsyase || cakratīrthe vinā snānaṃ na naśyecchāpa īdṛśaḥ||31|| iti brahmavacaḥ śrutvā vidhūmo nātihṛṣṭavān || svaveśma prāviśattūrṇamāmaṃtrya caturānanam||32|| ciṃtayāmāsa tatrāsau martyatāṃ yāsyato mama|| ko vā pitā bhavedbhūmau kā vā mātā bhaviṣyati||33|| bahudhetthaṃ samālocya vidhūmo niścikāya saḥ|| kauśāṃbīnagare rājā śatānīka iti śrutaḥ ||34|| asti vīro mahābhāgo bhāryā cāpi pativratā || tasya viṣṇumatīnāma viṣṇoḥ śrīriva vallabhā ||35|| tameva pitaraṃ kṛtvā mātaraṃ ca vidhāya tām || saṃbhaviṣyāmi bhūloke svakarmaparipākataḥ ||36|| tataḥ sa mālyavantaṃ ca puṣpadaṃtaṃ balotkaṭam|| trīnāhūyātmano bhṛtyānvṛttametannyave dayat || 37 || bhṛtyāḥ śṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo brahmaśāpānmahābhayāt || janiṣyāmi śatānīkādviṣṇumatyāmahaṃ sutaḥ || 38 || iti śrutvā vaco bhṛtyāstasyā prāṇā bahiścarāḥ || vāṣpapūrṇamukhāḥ sarve vidhūmaṃ vākyamabruvan ||39 || || bhṛtyā ūcuḥ || || tvadviyogaṃ vayaṃ sarve trayo'pi na sahāmahe || tasmānmānuṣa bhāvatvamasmābhiḥ saha yāsyasi || 3.1.5.40 || śatānīkasya rājarṣermaṃtrī yo'yaṃ yugandharaḥ || senānīrvipratīkaśca yo'yaṃ prāgrasaro raṇe ||41|| narmakarmasu hṛdvipro vallabhākhyo mahāṃśca yaḥ || teṣāṃ putrāstrayo'pyete bhaviṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || śatānīkasya rājarṣeḥ putrabhāvaṃ gatasya te || śuśrūṣāṃ saṃvidhāsyāmasteṣu teṣu ca karmasu || tānevaṃvādinaḥ so'yaṃ vidhūmo vākyamabravīt || 43 || || vidhūma uvāca || || jāne'haṃ bhavatāṃ snehaṃ tādṛśaṃ mayya nuttamam || 44 || tathāpi kathayāmyadya tacchṛṇudhvaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ || brahmaśāpena ghoreṇa svena duṣkarmaṇā kṛtam|| 45 || kutsitaṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvamahameko' nuvartaye || vihitaṃ na hi yuṣmākametacchāpānuvartanam || 46 || jugupsite'to mānuṣye mā kurudhvaṃ mano'dhunā || ataḥ śāpāvadhiryāvanmadviyogo viṣa hyatām || 47 || ityuktavantaṃ te sarve mālyavatpramukhāstadā || ūcuḥ praṇamya śirasā prārthayaṃtaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 48 || rakṣitvā kṛpayā hyasmānmā kuruṣva ca sāhasam || parityajasi naḥ sarvānbhaktānadya nirāgasaḥ || 49 || tvadviyogānmahāghorānmānuṣyamapi kutsitam || bahu manyāmahe deva tasmānna strāhi sāṃpratam || 3.1.5.50 || evaṃ sa yācamānāṃstrīnanvamanyata bhṛtyakān || taistribhiḥ sahitaḥ so'yaṃ kauśāṃbīṃ gantumaicchata || 51 || etasminneva kāle tu somavaṃśavivarddhanaḥ || arjunābhijane jāto janamejayasaṃbhavaḥ || 52 || śatānīko mahīpālaḥ pṛthivīmanvapālayat || buddhimānnītimānvāgmī prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 53 || caturaṃgabalopeto vikramaikadhano yuvā || sa kauśāṃbīṃ mahārājo nagarīmadhyuvāsa vai || 54 || tasya mantraraha syajño mantrī jāto yugaṃdharaḥ || senānīrvipratīkaśca tasya prāgrasaro raṇe || 55 || narmakarmasu tasyāsīdvallabhākhyaḥ sakhā dvijaḥ || tasya viṣṇumatī nāma viṣṇoḥ śrīriva vallabhā || 56 || sa sarvaguṇasaṃpannaḥ śatānīko mahāmatiḥ || putramātmasamaṃ tasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ nānvaviṃdata || 57 || ātmānamasutaṃ jñātvā sa bhṛśaṃ paryatapyata || sa yugaṃdharamāhūya maṃtriṇaṃ mantravittamam || 58 || putralābhaḥ kathaṃ me syāditi kāryamamantrayat || yugandharo mahī pālaṃ putrālābhena pīḍitam || harṣayanvacasā svena vākyametadabhāṣata || 59 || || yugandhara uvāca || || asti śāṃḍilyanāmā tu maharṣiḥ satya vākchuciḥ || 3.1.5.60 || śatrumitrasamo dāṃtastapaḥsvādhyāyatatparaḥ || tameva munimāsādya jvalaṃtamiva pāvakam || 61 || putramātmasamaṃ rājanprārthayethā vinītavat || kṛpāvānsa maharṣistu putraṃ te dāsyati dhruvam || 62 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣasaṃphullalocanaḥ || maṃtriṇā tena saṃyuktastasyāgādā śramaṃ muneḥ || 63 || tamāśrame samāsīnaṃ praṇanāma mahīpatiḥ || śāṃḍilyastu mahātejā rājānaṃ prāptamāśramam || 64 || dṛṣṭvā pādyādibhiḥ pūjya svāgataṃ vyājahāra saḥ || || śāṃḍilya uvāca || || śatānīka kimarthaṃ tvamāśramaṃ prāptavānmama || 65 || yatkartavyabhidānīṃ te tadvadasva karomyaham || munimevaṃ vadaṃtaṃ taṃ pratyavādīdyugaṃdharaḥ || 66 || bhagavanneṣa vai rājā putrālābhena karṣitaḥ || bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ putrakāraṇāt || 67 || asyāputratvajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tvamapākartumarhasi || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṃḍilyo munisattamaḥ ||68|| putralābhavaraṃ tasmai pratijajñe nṛpāya vai || sa rājño varadaḥ śrīmānkauśāṃbīmetya sādaram || 69 || putreṣṭyā putrakāmasya yājako'bhūnmahāmuniḥ || tato muniprasādena rājā daśarathopamaḥ || 3.1.5.70 || yajvā rāmamiva prāpa sahasrānīkamātmajam || evaṃ vidhūmaḥ saṃjajñe śatānīkānnṛpottamāt || 71 || atrāṃtare maṃtrivarassenānīstu mahīpateḥ || dvijo narmavayasyaśca putrānprāpuḥ kulocitān || 72 || putro yugaṃdharasyāsīnmālyavānnāma bhṛtyakaḥ || yaugaṃdharāyaṇo nāmnā mantraśāstreṣu kovidaḥ || || 73 || vipratīkasya tanayaḥ puṣpadanto babhūva ha || rumaṇvāniti vikhyātaḥ parasainyavimardanaḥ || 74 || vallabhasya tadā jajñe tanayo vai balo tkaṭaḥ || vasaṃtaka iti khyāto narmakarmasu kovidaḥ || 75 || atha te vavṛdhuḥ sarve rājaputrapurogamāḥ || pañcahāyanatāṃ teṣu yāteṣu tadanaṃtaram || 76 || alaṃbusāpi svarveśyā bhūpateḥ kṛtavarmaṇaḥ || ayodhyāyāṃ mahāpuryāṃ kanyā jātā mṛgāvatī || 77 || evaṃ vidhūmamukhyāste jajñire kṣitimaṇḍale || atrāṃtare mahāsattvo duṣṭasānucaro balī || 78 || ahidaṃṣṭra iti khyāto mahādaityo balotkaṭaḥ || yuktaḥ sthūlaśironāmā sahāyena durātmanā ||79|| rurodha devanagaraṃ babādha vibudhānapi || vartamāne divi mahāsamare surarakṣasām || 3.1.5.80 || ānināya śatānīkaṃ sahāyārthaṃ puraṃdaraḥ || sa yauvarājye tanayaṃ vidhāya vidhinā nṛpaḥ || 81 || pratasthe rathamāsthāya yuddhāya ditijaiḥ saha || nīto mātalinābhyetya sādaraṃ sa dhanurdharaḥ || 82 || vidhāya prekṣakāndevāñjaghāna ditijānraṇe || atha daityādhipaḥ so'pi nihataḥ samare divi || 83 || tataḥ śakrasya vacasā paretaṃ nṛpapuṃgavam || rathamāropya sahasā kauśāṃbīṃ mātaliryayau || 84 || nītvā mahītalamasau tatsutāya nyavedayat || tataḥ sahasrānīkopi vilapya vahudukhitaḥ || 85 || maṃtribhiḥ saha saṃbhūya pretakāryaṃ nyavartayat || mṛtaṃ jñātvā patiṃ rājñī sahaivānumamāra ca || 86 || mahiṣyā saha saṃprāpte bhūpāle kīrtiśeṣatām || bheje rājyaṃ śatānīkatanayo maṃtriṇāṃ girā || 87 || yugandhare vipratīke vallabhe ca mṛte sati || yaugandharāyaṇamukhāstatputrāḥ sarva eva hi || 88 || śatānīka sutasyāsya tattatkāryamakurvata || evaṃ sa pālayāmāsa mahīṃ rājasuto balī || 89 || yāte kāle mahendreṇa sanandanamahotsave || nimaṃtritastatkathitāṃ bhāvinīmaśṛṇotkathām || 3.1.5.90 || svaryoṣidbrahmaṇaḥ śāpādayodhyāyāyāmalaṃbusā || jātā mṛgāvatī kanyā bhūpateḥ kṛtavarmaṇaḥ || 91 || vidhūma nāmā ca vasustvaṃ nākalalanāṃ purā || tāmeva brahmasadane dṛṣṭvānilahṛtāṃśukām || 92 || tadaiva mādanākrāṃtaḥ śāpānmartyatvamāgataḥ || saiva te dayitā rājanbhāvinī na cirātsakhe || 93 || yadā tvamātmanaḥ putraṃ rājye saṃsthāpya bhūpate || mṛgāvatyā striyā sārddhaṃ dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe || 94 || cakratīrthe mahāpuṇye phullagrāmasamīpataḥ || snānaṃ kariṣyasi tadā śāpānmukto bhaviṣyasi || 95 || iti provāca bhagavansatyaloke pitāmahaḥ || itīṃdravacanaṃ śrutvā sahasrānīkabhūpatiḥ || 96 || tathodvāhakṛtotsāhaḥ samāmaṃtrya śacīpatim || kauśāṃbīṃ prasthito hṛṣṭaḥ sa tilottamayā pathi || || 97 || smarankimapi tāṃ kāṃtāṃ bhāṣamāṇāmananyadhīḥ || dhyāyañchatakratuvaco nāluloke mahīpatiḥ || 98 || sā śaśāpa nṛpaṃ subhrūranādaratira skṛtā || āhūyamānopi mayā sahasrānīka bhūpate || 99 || mṛgāvatīṃ hṛdā dhyāyankimarthaṃ māmupekṣase || saubhāgyamattā māninyo na sahaṃte'vadhīra ṇām|| 3.1.5.100 || māmavajñāya yāṃ rājanhṛdā dhyāyasi sāṃpratam || tayā caturdaśasamā viyuktastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 101 || iti śaptavatīṃ rājā tāmu vāca tilottamām|| tāmeva yadi labhyeyaṃ tanujāṃ kṛtavarmaṇaḥ || 102 || caturdaśasamā duḥkhaṃ sahiṣye tadviyogajam|| ityuktvā tadgatamanā nṛpaḥ prāyā nnijāṃ purīm || 103 || tataḥ kālena tanayā bhūpateḥ kṛtavarmaṇaḥ || tamāsasāda dayitā sarvasvaṃ puṣpadhanvanaḥ || 104 || mṛgāvatī samāsādya vilā sataruvallarīm|| vibhramāṃbhodhilaharīṃ nanaṃda madanadyutiḥ || 105 || sā tasmādgarbhamādhatta bhavānīveṃduśekharāt || pāṃḍimnā śaśilekheva pīpūṣakṣālitā babhau || 106 || sundarī daurhṛdavyakteratha pauraṃdarīva dik || rarāja rājamahiṣī rajanīkaragarbhiṇī || 107 || sā daurhṛdavaśādrājñī yaṃyaṃ kāmamakāma yat || sudurlabhamapipremṇā tattatsarvaṃ samāharat || 108 || patyau samīhitakare sā kadācinmṛgāvatī || svecchayā vai matiṃ cakre raktavāpīnimajjane || 109 || abhilāṣaṃ savijñāya mṛgāvatyā mahīpatiḥ || kausumbhasalilaiḥ pūrṇāṃ kṣaṇādvāpīmakārayat || 3.1.5.110 || tasminraktajale rājñī snānaṃ sādaramātanot|| tatastāṃ raktatoyārdrāṃ phullakiṃśukasannibhām||111|| rājastrīmāmiṣadhiyā suparṇakulasaṃbhavaḥ|| jahāra vikaṭaḥ pakṣī mugdhāṃ dagdhavidhervaśāt|| ||112|| nītvā vihāyasā dūraṃ sa tāmacalasannibhaḥ|| tatyājamohavivaśāmudayācalakaṃdare||113|| labdhasaṃjñā śanaiḥ kaṃpavilolatanuvallarī|| dṛgbhyāmutpalatulyābhyāṃ muhuraśrūṇyavartayat||114|| hā nātha maṃdabhāgyāhaṃ tvadviyogenapīḍitā|| kā gatiḥ kva nu gacchāmi drakṣyāmi tvanmukhaṃ kadā||115|| ityuktvā gajasiṃhānāṃ purobhūdvadhakāṃkṣiṇī || sā sarvakesarigajaistyaktā na nidhanaṃ gatā||116|| āpatkāle nṛṇāṃ nūnaṃ maraṇaṃ naiva labhyate|| atidīnaṃ samākarṇya tasyāḥ kraṃditamunmukhāḥ||117|| mṛgā niṣpaṃdagatayo na tṛṇānyapyabhakṣayan|| tatastāṃ karuṇāsiṃdhurmuniputrastathāsthitām||118|| rudatīṃ kṛpayā rājñīṃ samā nīya svamāśramam || nyavedayacca tāṃ rājñīṃ gurave jamadagnaye || jamadagnistu dharmātmā tāmāśvāsayadaṃtike || 119 || || jamadagniruvāca || || tathā jānīhi māṃ bhadre kṛtavarmā yathā tava || 3.1.5.120 || evamāśvāsitā tatra kṛpayā jamadagninā || cakre tatraiva sā vāsamāśrame munisaṃkule || 121 || | tatassvalpena kālena viśākhamiva pārvatī || asūta tanayaṃ bālā śauryadhairyaguṇānvitam || 122 || sūtikāgṛhakṛtyāni yāni kāryāṇi baṃdhubhiḥ || cakrire mātṛvattāni mṛgāvatyā munistriyaḥ || 123 || taṃ sujātaṃ nṛpasutaṃ kāpi vāgaśarīriṇī || udayācalajātatvāccakārodayanābhidham|| || 124 || āśrame sa munīndreṇa kṛtacūḍādikavrataḥ || jagrāha sakalā vidyā jamadagnermahāmuneḥ ||125|| yuvā nṛpasutaḥ so'yaṃ kadācinmṛgayāparaḥ || apaśyadekaṃ bhujagaṃ vyādhena dṛḍhasaṃyatam || 126 || uvāca sa kṛpāyukto vyādha muṃca bhujaṃgamam || kiṃ kariṣyasyanena tvaṃ nainaṃ hiṃsiturmahasi ||127|| tamuvāca tato vyādhaḥ sarpeṇānena pūruṣa || dhanadhānyādikaṃ lapsye grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca || 128 || atohaṃ jīvikāmenaṃ naiva mokṣye kathaṃcana || ityuktvā peṭikāyāṃ taṃ vabaṃdha śabarādhamaḥ || 129 || baddhamālokya bhujagaṃ śabarāya dhanārthine || amocayatsvajananīdattaṃ dattvā sa kaṃkaṇam || 3.1.5.130 || mocitastena sarpo'sau naro bhūtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || sakhyaṃ kṛtvā ca sahasā taṃ pātālaṃ nināya vai || 131 || kinnarākhyena nāgena dhṛtarāṣṭrasutena saḥ|| pātālaṃ prāviśattatra nyavasatpūjitassukham || 132 || dhṛtarāṣṭrasya tanayāṃ bhaginīṃ kinnarasya ca || lalitākhyāṃ guṇopetāṃ priyāṃ bheje nṛpātmajaḥ || || 133 || sā tasmājjanayāmāsa putramapratimaujasam || tataḥ sā lalitā prāha tvaritodayanaṃ prati || 134 || || lalitovāca || || ahaṃ vidyā dharī pūrvaṃ sukarṇī nāma nāmataḥ || śāpātsarpatvamāptāsmi śāpāṃto garbha eṣa me || 135 || tato'muṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva putramapratimaujasam || tāṃbūlīṃ srajamamlānāṃ vīṇāṃ ghoṣavatīmapi || 136 || tatheti pratijagrāha tatsarvaṃ nṛpanaṃdanaḥ.|| paśyatāṃ sarvasarpāṇāṃ sāpyagacchadvihāyasam || 137 || tataḥ so'pi gṛhītvā tu vīṇāṃ mālāṃ ca putrakam || duḥkhitāmātmajananīṃ draṣukāmastvarānvitaḥ || 138 || śvaśurādīnanujñāpya sahasā svāśramaṃ yayau || jananīṃ śokasaṃtaptāmāśvastāṃ jamadagninā || 139 || sametya toṣayāmāsa vṛttaṃ cāsyai nyavedayat || tadā prahṛṣṭahṛdayā sā babhūva mṛgāvatī || 3.1.5.140 || atrāṃtare sa śabaraḥ kauśāṃbyāṃ vaṇijaṃ yayau || sahasrānīkanāmāṃkaṃ vikretuṃ maṇikaṃkaṇam||141|| rājamudrāṃ samālokya kaṃkaṇe sa vaṇigvaraḥ || śabareṇa samaṃ gatvā sarvaṃ rājñe nyavedayat||142|| tataḥ sahasrānīko'yaṃ tatprāpya maṇikaṃkaṇam || mṛgāvatīviprayogaviṣāgniparipīḍitaḥ || 143 || tadbāhusaṃgapīyūṣa śīkarāsāraśītalam|| kaṃkaṇaṃ hṛdaye nyasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 144 || uvāca ca kathaṃ labdhaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ śabara tvayā || sa caivamuktastatprāpti kramaṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 145 || śabarasya vacaḥ śrutvā sahasrānīkabhūpatiḥ || pratasthe maṃtribhiḥ sārddhaṃ priyālokanakautukī || 146 || yatreṃdubhāska ramukhā labhaṃte sahasodayam || tameva girimuddiśya sahasā so'bhyagacchata || 147 || kiṃcinmārgaṃ samullaṃghya tasthau viśrāṃtasainikaḥ || tasminvinidre dayitāsaṃgamadhyānatatpare || 148 || vasaṃtako vicitrāstu kathayāmāsa vai kathāḥ || tatkathāśravaṇenaiva tāṃ rātriṃ sa nināya vai || 149 || tataḥ kālena kakubhaṃ prāpya jaṃbhāripālitām || jamadagnyāśramaṃ gatvā nirvairaharikuṃjaram || 3.1.5.150 || tapasyaṃtaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śirasā praṇanāma saḥ || āśīrvādena sa muniḥ pratijagrāha taṃ nṛpam || 151 || vidhivatpūjayāmāsa pādyārghyācamanīyakaiḥ || uvāca ca mahīpālaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ || 152 || naranātha mṛgāvatyāṃ jāto'yaṃ tanayastava || yaśonidhirmahātejā rāmacaṃdra ivāparaḥ || 193 || bhaviṣyati diśāṃ jetā siṃhasaṃhanano yuvā || pautra eṣa mahābhāga tathā dyudayanātmajaḥ || 154 || iyaṃ mṛgāvatī bhāryā pāti vratyaparāyaṇā || tadetāṃstrīnmahārāja pratigṛhṇīṣva mā ciram || 155 || uktvaivaṃ muninā dattāṃstāngṛhītvā mahīpatiḥ || priyāsahāyaḥ svapurīṃ pratasthe maṃtribhirvṛtaḥ || 156 || tataḥ praviśya kauśāṃbīṃ nagarīṃ sa nṛpottamaḥ || smarañchakrasya vacanaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma kutsayan || 157 || mahīmudayanāyaiva dadau putrāya dhīmate || tasminnudayane putra rājyapālanadakṣiṇe ||158|| rājyabhāraṃ vinikṣipya sa śāpavinivṛttaye|| vasaṃtakarumaṇvadbhyāṃ mṛgāvatyā ca bhāryayā || 159|| yaugandharāyaṇenāpi maṃtriputreṇa saṃyutaḥ || cakratīrthe mahāpuṇye dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe || 3.1.5.160 || snānaṃ kartuṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ sarvatīrthotta mottame || vāhanairvātaraṃhobhiracirāllavaṇodadhim || 161 || saṃprāpya cakratīrthaṃ ca snānaṃ cakruryathāvidhi || teṣu ca snātamātreṣu cakratīrthe nṛpādiṣu || ||162|| vinaṣṭaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva mānuṣyamatikutsitam || tato vidhūtapāpāste svaṃ rūpaṃ pratipedire ||163|| divyāṃbaradharāḥ sarve divyamālyānulepanāḥ || vimānāni mahārhāṇi samāruhya vibhūṣitāḥ || 164 || tattīrthaṃ bahu manvānāḥ svaśāpacchedakāraṇam || paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ svargalokaṃ yayustadā || ||165|| tadāprabhṛti te sarve jñātvā tattīrthavaibhavam || pāvane cakratīrthe'sminsnānaṃ kurvaṃti sarvadā ||166|| evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ ye samāgatya mānavāḥ || snānaṃ sakṛcca kurvaṃti te sarve svargavāsinaḥ || 167 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā vidhūmacaritaṃ mahat || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ sarvaṃ śīghramāpnuyāt|| 168 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyebrahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye cakratīrthapraśaṃsāyāmalaṃbusāvidhūmaśāpavimocanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<3.1.6>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || dvaipāyanavineya tvaṃ sūta paurāṇikottama || devīpattanaparyaṃtaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam || 1 || ityabravīḥ purāsmākamataḥ pṛcchāma kiṃcana || devīpuraṃ hi tatkutra yadantaṃ cakratīrthakam || 2 || devīpattana mityākhyā kathaṃ tasyābhavattathā || śrīrāmasetumūle ca snātānāṃ pāpināmapiḥ|| 3 || kīdṛśaṃ vā bhavetpuṇyaṃ cakratīrthe tathaiva ca || etaccānyānviśe ṣāṃśca brūhi paurāṇikottama || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || sarvametatpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caitadākhyānaṃ pāpanāśa nam || 5 || yatra pāṣāṇanavakaṃ sthāpayitvā raghūdvahaḥ || babandha prathamaṃ setuṃ samudre maithilīpatiḥ || 6 || devīpuraṃ tu tatraiva yadantaṃ cakratīrthakam || devīpattanamityākhyā yathā tasya samāgatā || 7 || tadbravīmi muniśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ śraddhayā saha || purā devāsure yuddhe devairnāśitaputriṇī || ditiḥ provāca tanayāmātmanaḥ śokamohitā || 8 || || ditiruvāca || || yāhi putri tapaḥ kartuṃ tapovanamanuttamam|| 9 || putrārthaṃ tava suśroṇi niyatā niyatendriyā || indrādayo na śiṣyeranyena putreṇa vai surāḥ || 3.1.6.10 || uditā tanayā caivaṃ jananyā tāṃ praṇamya sā || svīkṛtya māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ vanaṃ pañcāgnimadhyagā || 11 || tapo'tapyata sā ghoraṃ tena lokāścakaṃpire || tasyāṃ tapaḥ prakurvaṃtyāṃ trilokyāsīdbhayāturā || 12 || indrādayaḥ sura gaṇā mohamāpurdvijottamāḥ || supārśvastapasā tasyā muniḥ kṣubdho'vadattu tām || 13 || || supārśva uvāca || || parituṣṭo'smi suśroṇi putrastava bhaviṣyati || mukhena mahiṣākāro vapuṣā nararūpavān || 14 || mahiṣo nāmaputraste bhaviṣyatyativīryavān || pīḍayiṣyati yaḥ svargaṃ devendraṃ ca sasainikam || 15 || supārśvastvevamuktvā tāṃ vinivārya tapastathā || āgacchadātmano lokamanunīya tapasvinīm || 16 || atha jajñe sa mahiṣo yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā purā || vyavarddhata mahāvīryaḥ parvaṇīva mahodadhiḥ || 17 || tataḥ putro vipracittervidyunmālyasurāgraṇīḥ || anye'pyasuravaryāste saṃti ye bhūtale dvijāḥ || 18 || te sarve mahiṣasyāsya śrutvā dattavaraṃ mudā || samāgamya muniśreṣṭhāḥ prāvadanmahiṣāsuram || 19 || svargādhipatyamasmākaṃ pūrva masīnmahāmate || devairviṣṇuṃ samāśritya rājyaṃ no hṛtamojasā || 3.1.6.20 || tadrājyamānaya valādasmākaṃ mahiṣāsura || vīryaṃ prakaṭayasvādya prabhāvamapi cātmanaḥ ||21|| atulyabalavīryastvaṃ brahmadattavaroddhataḥ|| pulomajāpatiṃ yuddhe jahi devagaṇaiḥ saha||22|| danujairevamukto'sau yoddhukāmo'maraiḥ saha|| mahā vīryo'tha mahiṣaḥ prayayāvamarāvatīm ||23|| devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca saṃvatsaraśataṃ raṇam || purā babhūva vipreṃdrāstumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam|| 24 || devavṛndaṃ tato bhī tyā puraskṛtya purandaram|| kāṃdiśīkamabhūdviprā brahmāṇaṃ ca yayau tadā || 25 || brahmā tānamarāsarvānsamādāya yayau punaḥ|| nārāyaṇaśivau yatra vartete viśvapālakau ||26|| tatra gatvā namaskṛtya stutvā stotrairanekaśaḥ || brahmā nivedayāmāsa mahiṣāsuraceṣṭitam || 27 || surāṇāmasuraiḥ pīḍāṃ devayoḥ śaṃbhukṛṣṇayoḥ || iṃdrāgniyamasūryeṃdukuberavaruṇādikān || 28 || nirākṛtyādhikāreṣu teṣāṃ tiṣṭhatyayaṃ svayam || anyeṣāṃ devavṛṃdānāmadhikārepi tiṣṭhati || 29 || nirastaṃ devavṛṃdaṃ tatsvarlokādavanītale || manuṣyavadvicarate mahiṣāsurabādhitam || 3.1.6.30 || etajjñāpayituṃ devau yuvayorahamāgataḥ|| sārddhaṃ deva gaṇairatra rakṣataṃ tānsamāgatān || 31 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā rameśvaramaheśvarau || kopātkarālavadanau duṣprekṣyau tau babhūvatuḥ || 32 || atyantakopajvalitānmukhādviṣṇoratha dvijāḥ || niścakrāma mahattejaḥ śaṃbhoḥ sraṣṭustathaiva ca || 33 || apareṣāṃ surāṇāṃ ca dehādiṃdraśarīrataḥ || tejaḥ samudabhūtkrūraṃ tadekaṃ samajāyata || 34 || teṣāṃ tu tejasāṃ rāśirjvalatparvatasaṃnibhaḥ || dadṛśe devavṛṃdaistairjvālāvyāptadigaṃtaraḥ || 35 || tejasāṃ samudāyo'sau nārī kāci dabhūttadā || śivatejo mukhamabhūdviṣṇutejo bhujau dvijāḥ || 36 || brahmatejastu caraṇau madhyamaiṃdreṇa tejasā || yamasya tejasā keśāḥ kucau caṃdrasya tejasā || 37 || jaṃghorū kalpitau viprā varuṇasya tu tejasā || nitaṃbaḥ pṛthivītejaḥ pādāṃgulyo'rkatejasā || 38 || karāṃgulyo vasūnāṃ ca tejasā kalpitāstathā || kuberatejasā viprā nāsikāparikalpitā || 39 || navaprajāpatīnāṃ ca tejasā daṃtapaṃktayaḥ || cakṣurdvayaṃ samajani havyavāhanatejasā || || 3.1.6.40 || ubhe saṃdhye bhruvau jāte śravaṇe vāyutejasā || itareṣāṃ ca devānāṃ tejobhiratidāruṇaiḥ || 41 || kṛtānyāvayavā nārī durgā paramabhāsvarā || babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ || 42 || sarvavṛṃdārakānīkatejaḥsaṃghasamudbhavā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prītimāpuste devā mahiṣabādhitāḥ || 43 || tato rudrā dayo devā viniṣkṛṣyāyudhānnijāt || āyudhāni dadustasyai śūlādīni dvijottamāḥ || 44 || bhūṣaṇāni dadustasyai vastramālyāni caṃdanam || sāpi devī tadā vastrairbhūṣaṇaiścaṃdanādibhiḥ || 45 || kusumairāyudhairhārairbhūṣitā paricārakaiḥ || sāṭṭahāsaṃ pramuṃcaṃtī bhairavī bhairavasvanā || 46 || nanāda kaṃpayatīva rodasī devasevitā || devyā bhairavanādena cacāla sakalaṃ jagat || 47 || siṃhavāhanamārūḍhāṃ devīṃ tāmamarāstadā || munayaḥ siddhagaṃdharvāstuṣṭuvurjayaśa bdataḥ || 49 || atibhīṣaṇanādena devyāḥ kṣubdhaṃ jagattrayam || dṛṣṭvā devārayo daityāḥ samuttasthurudāyudhāḥ || 49 || mahiṣo'pi mahākrodhātsamudyata mahāyudhaḥ || taṃ śabdamavalakṣyātha yayāvasurasaṃvṛtaḥ || 3.1.6.50 || vyalokayattato devīṃ tejovyāptajagattrayīm || sāyudhānaṃtabāhvāḍhayāṃ nādakaṃpitabhūtalām || 51 || kṣobhitāśeṣaśeṣādimahānāgaparaṃparām || vilokya devīmasurāḥ samanahyannudāyudhāḥ || 52 || tato devyā tayā sārddhamasurāṇāmabhūdraṇaḥ || astraiḥ śastraiḥ śaraiścakrairgadābhirmusalairapi || 53 || gajāśvarathapādātairasaṃkhyeyairmahāvalaḥ || mahiṣo yuyudhe tatra devyā sākamariṃdamaḥ || 54 || lakṣako ṭisahasrāṇi pradhānāsurayūthapāḥ || ekaikasya tu senāyāsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 55 || te sarve yugapaddevīṃ śastrairāvavrurojasā || sāpi devī tato bhīmā daityamuktāstrasaṃcayam || 56 || bibheda līlayā bāṇaiḥ svakārmukaviniḥsṛtaiḥ || sasarja daityakāyeṣu bāṇapūgānyanekaśaḥ || 57 || devyāśrayabalā ddevā nirbhayā daityayūthapaiḥ || yuyudhuḥ saṃyuge śastrairastrairapyāyudhāṃtaraiḥ || 58 || tato devā balotsiktā devīśaktyupabṛṃhitāḥ || niḥśeṣamasurānsarvānāyu dhairniramūlayan || 59 || svasainye tu kṣayaṃ yāte saṃkṣubdho mahiṣāsuraḥ || cāpamādāya vegena vikṛṣya ca mahāsvanam || 3.1.6.60 || saṃdhāya mumuce bāṇāndeva sainyeṣu bhūsurāḥ || iṃdre tu daśasāhasraṃ yame paṃcasahasrakam || 61 || varuṇe cāṣṭasāhasraṃ kubere ṣaṭsahasrakam || sūrye caṃdre ca vahnau ca vāyau vasuṣu cāśvinoḥ || 62 || anyeṣvapi ca deveṣu mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ || pratyekamayutaṃ bāṇānmumuce balināṃ varaḥ || 63 || palāyaṃte tato devā mahiṣāsuramardditāḥ || devīṃ śaraṇamājagmustrāhitrāhītivādinaḥ || 64 || tato devī gaṇānsvasya bhūtavetālakādikān || yūyaṃ nāśayata kṣipramāsuraṃ balamityaśāt ||| || 65 || ahaṃ tu mahiṣaṃ yuddhe yodhayāmi valoddhatam || tato devyā gaṇaiḥ sarvamāsuraṃ kṣatamāśu vai || 66 ||| tataḥ sainyaṃ kṣayaṃ nīte gaṇai rdevīpracoditaiḥ || yoddhukāmaḥ sa mahiṣo gaṇaiḥ sākaṃ vyatiṣṭhata || 67 || atrāṃtare mahānādaḥ sucakṣuśca mahāhanuḥ || mahācaṃḍo mahābhakṣo mahodarama hotkaṭau || 68 || pañcāsyaḥ pādacūḍaśca bahunetraḥ prabāhukaḥ || ekākṣastvekapādaśca bahupādo'pyapādakaḥ || 69 || ete cānye ca bahavo mahiṣāsura maṃtriṇaḥ || yoddhukāmā raṇe devyāḥ puratastvavatasthire || 3.1.6.70 || siṃhaṃ vāhanamāruhya tato devī manojavam || pralayāṃbudanirghoṣaṃ cāpamādāya bhairavam || || 71 || visphoṭya mumuce bāṇānvajravegasamānyudhi || daśalakṣagajaiścāpi śatalakṣaiśca vājibhiḥ || 72 || śatalakṣai rathaiścāpi lakṣāyutapadātibhiḥ || yukto mahāhanurdaityo devyā yudhi nipātitaḥ ||73|| sainye ca tasya nihatā devyā bāṇairdvijottamāḥ || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi pradhānāsuranāyakāḥ ||74|| mahiṣasya hi vidyante mahābalaparākramāḥ || ekaikasya pradhānasya caturaṅgabalaṃ tathā || 75 || mahāhanoryathā viprāstathaivāsti mahadbalam || tatsarvaṃ nihataṃ devyā śaraiḥ kāṃcanapuṃkhitaiḥ || 76 || yāmamātreṇa vipreṃdrāstadadbhutamivābhavat || 77 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye cakratīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ devīpurābhidhānakathane devīmahiṣāsurayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<3.1.7>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || svasainyamavalokyātha mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ || hataṃ devyā mahākrodhāccaṃḍakopamathābravīt || 1 || || mahiṣa uvāca || || caṃḍakopa mahāvīrya yuddhyasvaināṃ durātmikām || tathāstviti sa coktvātha caṃḍakopaḥ pratāpavān || 2 || avākiradbāṇavarṣairdevīṃ samaramūrddhani || bāṇajālāni tasyāśu caṃḍakopasya līlayā || 3 || chittvā jaghāna śastreṇa caṃḍakopasya sāṃbikā || cakarta vājino'pyasya sārathiṃ ca dhvajaṃ dhanuḥ || 4 || unmamātha rathaṃ cāpi taṃ bāṇairhṛdyatāḍayat || sa bhagnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || 5 || caṃḍakopastato devīṃ khaḍgacarmadharo'bhyagāt || khaḍgena siṃhamājaghne devyā vāhaṃ mahāsuraḥ || 6 || devīmapi bhuje savye khaḍgena prajaghāna saḥ || khaṅgo devyā bhuje savye vyaśīryata sahasradhā || 7 || tataḥ śūle na mahatā caṃḍakopaṃ tadāṃbikā || jaghāna hṛdaye so'pi papāta ca mamāra ca || 8 || caṃḍakope hate tasminmahāvīrye mahābale || citrabhānurgajārūḍho devīṃ tāmabhyadhāvata || 9 || divyāṃ śaktiṃ sasarjātha mahāghaṃṭāravākulām || nyavārayata huṃkārairdevī śaktiṃ nirākulām || 3.1.7.10 || tataḥ śūlena sā devī citrabhānuṃ vyadārayat || mṛte tasmiṃstato yuddhe karālo drutamabhyagāt || 11 || karamuṣṭiprahāreṇa so'pi devyā nipātitaḥ || tato devī madonmattaṃ gadayā vyasumātanot || 12 || bāṣkalaṃ paṭṭiśenāpi cakreṇāpi tathāṃtikam || prāhiṇodyamalokāya durgā devī dvijottamāḥ || 13 || evamanyānmahākāyānmaṃtriṇo mahiṣasya ca || śūlena prothayitvātha prāhiṇodyamasādanam || 14 || ātmasainye hate tvevaṃ durgayā mahiṣāsuraḥ || māhiṣeṇātha rūpeṇa gaṇāndevyā abhakṣayat || 15 || tuṇḍena nijaghānaikānsurāghātaistathāparān || niśvāsavāyubhiścānyānpātayāmāsa roṣitaḥ || 16 || devyā bhūtagaṇaṃ tvevaṃ nihatya mahiṣāsuraḥ || siṃhaṃ mārayituṃ devyāścukrodha ca nanāda ca || 17 || tataḥ siṃho'bhavatkruddho mahāvīryo mahābalaḥ || surābhi ghātanirbhinnamahītalamahīdharaḥ || 18 || mahiṣāsuramāyāṃtaṃ nakhairenaṃ vyadārayat || caṃḍikāpi tataḥ kruddhā vadhe tasyākaronmatim || 19 || babandha pāśairmahiṣaṃ caṃḍikā kopamūrcchitā|| mocayitvā tataḥ pāśāṃstyaktamāhiṣaveṣavān||3.1.7.2||| siṃhaveṣo'bhavaddaityo mahābalaparākramaḥ|| devī tasya śiroyāvacchettuṃ buddhimadhārayat||21|| tāvatsa puruṣo bhūtvā khaḍgapāṇiradṛśyata|| atha taṃ puruṣaṃ devī khaḍgahastaṃ śarotkaraiḥ||22|| jaghāna tīkṣṇadhārāgraiḥ paramarmavidāraṇaiḥ || tataḥ sa puruṣo viprā gajo'bhūddhastadantavān || 23 || durgāyā vāhanaṃ siṃhaṃ kareṇa vicakarṣa ca || tataḥ siṃhaḥ karaṃ tasya vicakarta nakhāṃkuraiḥ || 24 || bhūyo mahāsuro jāto māhiṣaṃ veṣamāśritaḥ || tataḥ kruddhā bhadrakālī mahatpānamasevata || 25 || tataḥ pānavaśā nmattā jahāsāruṇalocanā || mahiṣaḥ so'pi garveṇa śṛṃgābhyāṃ parvatotkarān ||26|| caṃḍikāṃ pratiṃ cikṣepa sā ca tānacchinaccharaiḥ || tato devī jaga nmātā mahiṣāsuramabravīt || 27 || || devyuvāca || || kuru garvaṃ kṣaṇaṃ mūḍha madhu yāvatpibāmyaham || nivṛttamadhupānāhaṃ tvāṃ nayiṣye yamakṣayam|| ||28|| hate tvayi durādharṣe mayā daivatakaṃṭake|| svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ prapadyaṃtāṃ siddhā sādhyā marudgaṇāḥ||29|| uktvaivaṃ tāḍayāmāsa muṣṭinā mahiṣāsuram|| tāḍito'yaṃ tato devyā mahiṣo bhṛśavihvalaḥ||3.1.7.3||| dakṣiṇasyodadhestīrepradudrāva tvarānvitaḥ|| anududrāva taṃ devī siṃhamāruhya vāhanam||31|| anudrutastato devyā mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ|| dharmapuṣkīraṇītoye daśayojanamāyate||32|| praviśyāṃtarhitastasthau durgātāḍanavihvalaḥ|| tato durgā samāsādya dharmapuṣkariṇītaṭam || ||33|| nadadarśāsuraṃ tatra mahiṣaṃ caṃḍikā tadā || aśarīrā tato vāṇī durgā devīmabhāṣata||34|| bhadrakāli mahādevi mahiṣo dānavastvayā || tāḍito muṣṭinā bhadre dharmapuṣkariṇījale ||35|| asminnaṃtarhitaḥ śete bhayārto mārayasva tam || yenakenāpyupāyena cainaṃ prāṇairviyojaya ||36|| evaṃ vācā'śarī riṇyā kathitā caṃḍikā tadā || prāha svavāhanaṃ siṃhamasureṃdravadhodyatā ||37|| mṛgeṃdra siṃhavikrāṃta mahāvalaparākrama || dharmapuṣkīraṇītoyaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ pīya tāṃ tvayā || 38 || devyaivamuktaḥ paṃcāsyo dharmapuṣkariṇījalam || niḥśeṣaṃ ca papau viprā yathā pāṃsurbhavettathā || 39 || niragānmahiṣo dīnastatastasmā jjalāśayāt || āyāṃtamasuraṃ devī pādenākramya mūrddhani || 3.1.7.40 || kaṃṭhaṃ śūlena tīkṣṇena pīḍayāmāsa kopitā || tato devyasimādāya cakartāsya śiro mahat || 41 || evaṃ sa mahiṣo viprāḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || durgayā nihato bhūmau papāta ca mamāra ca || 42 || tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || stutvā devīṃ tataḥ stotraistuṣṭā jahṛṣire tadā || 43 || anujñātāstato devyā devā jagmuryathāgatam || tato devī jaganmātā sva nāmnā puramuttamam || 44 || dakṣiṇasya samudrasya tīre cakre tadottare || tato devyanuśiṣṭāste devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 45 || pūrayāmāsuramṛtairdharmapuṣka riṇīṃ tadā || tato hyamṛtatīrthākhyāṃ lebhe tattīrthamuttamam || 46 || tato devī varamadātsvapurasya mudānvitā || paśavyaṃ cāparogaṃ ca purametadbhavatviti || 47 || dadau tīrthāya ca varaṃ snātānāmatra vai nṛṇām || yathābhilāṣaṃ siddhiḥ syādityuktvā sā divaṃ yayau || 49 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || yatsvanāmnā cakāredaṃ devī puramanuttamam || devīpattanamityuktaṃ tena devyāḥ purottamam || 49 || devīpattanamārabhya sumuhūrte dine dvijāḥ || vighneśvaraṃ praṇamyādau salilasvāminaṃ tathā || 3.1.7.50 || mahādevābhyanujñāto rāmacaṃdro'tidhārmikaḥ || sthāpayitvā svahastena pāṣāṇanavakaṃ mudā|| 91 || setu mārabdhavānviprā yāvallaṃkāmataṃdritaḥ || siṃhāsanaṃ samāruhya rāmo nalakṛtaṃ śubham|| 52 || vānaraiḥ kārayāmāsa setumabdhau nalādibhiḥ || parvatāñchākhinovṛkṣāndṛṣadaḥ kāṣṭhasaṃcayān || 53 || tṛṇāni ca samājahrurvānarā vanamadhyataḥ || 54 || nalastāni samādāya cakre setuṃ mahodadhau || paṃcabhirdivasaiḥ seturyāvallaṃkāsamīpataḥ || 55 || daśayojanavistīrṇaśśatayojanamāyataḥ || kṛtaḥ seturnalenābdhau puṇyaḥ pāpavināśanaḥ || 56 || devīpurasya nikaṭe navapāṣāṇarūpake || setumūle naraḥ snāyātsvapāpapariśuddhaye || 57 || cakratīrthe tathā snāyādbhajetsetvadhipaṃ harim|| devīpattanamārabhya yatkṛtaṃ setubaṃdhanam || 58 || tatsetumūlaṃ vipreṃdrā yathārthaṃ parikalpitam || setostu paścimā koṭirdarbhaśayyā prakīrtitā || 59 || devīpurī ca prākkoṭirubhayaṃ setumūlakam || ubhayaṃ puṇyamākhyātaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || 3.1.7.60 || yatsetumūlaṃ gacchaṃti yena mārgeṇa vai narāḥ|| tattanmārgagatāste te tasmiṃstasminvimuktide || 61 || snātvādau setumūle tu cakratīrthe tathaiva ca || saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ paścādgaccheyuḥ setubaṃdhanam|| 62 || devīpure tathā darbhaśayyāyāmapi bhūsurāḥ || cakratīrthe śive snānaṃ puṇyapāpavināśanam ||63|| smaraṇādubhayatrāpi cakratīrthasya vai dvijāḥ || bhasmībhavaṃti pāpāni lakṣajanmakṛtānyapi || 64 || janmāpi vilayaṃ yāyānmuktiścāpi kare sthitā || cakratīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 65 || bhūloke yāni tīrthāni gaṃgādīni dvijottamāḥ || cakratīrthasya tānyaddhā kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 66 || ādau tu navapāṣāṇamadhye'bdhau snānamācaret || kṣetrapiṃḍe tataḥ kuryāccakratīrthe tathaiva ca || 67 || setunāthaṃ hariṃ sevetsvapāpapariśuddhaye || evaṃ hi darbhaśayyāyāṃ kuryustanmārgato gatāḥ || 68 || ārūḍhaṃ rāmacaṃdreṇa yo namaskurute janaḥ || siṃhāsanaṃ nalakṛtaṃ na tasya narakādbhayam|| 69 || setumādau namaskuryādrāmaṃ dhyāyanhṛdā tadā || raghuvīrapadanyāsa pavitrīkṛtapāṃsave || 3.1.7.70 || daśakaṃṭhaśiraśchedahetave setave namaḥ || ketave rāmacaṃdrasya mokṣamārgaikahetave || 71 || sītāyā mānasāṃbhojabhānave setave namaḥ || || sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatyādau maṃtreṇānena vai dvijāḥ || 72 || tato vetālavaradaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchenmahābalam || tatra snānādavāpnoti siddhiṃ pārāmikāṃ naraḥ || 73 || yo'dhyāyamenaṃ paṭhate manuṣyaḥ śṛṇoti vā bhaktiyuto dvijeṃdrāḥ || svargādayastasya na durlabhāḥ syuḥ kaivalyamapyasya karasthameva || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye cakatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ devīpurābhidhānakathane mahiṣāsurasaṃhāravarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<3.1.8>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhagavansūtasarvajña kṛṣṇadvaipāyanapriya || tvanmukhādvai kathāḥ śrutvā śrotrakāmṛtavarṣiṇīḥ || 1 || tṛptirna jāyate'smākaṃ tvadvacomṛtapāyinām || ataḥ śuśrūṣamāṇānāṃ bhūyo brūhi kathāḥ śubhāḥ || 2 || vetālavaradaṃnāma cakratīrthasya dakṣiṇe || tīrthamasti mahāpuṇyamityavādīdbhavānpurā || 3|| vetālavaradābhikhyā tīrthasyāsyāgatā katham || kiṃprabhāvaṃ ca tattīrthametanno vaktumarhasi || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || sādhupṛṣṭaṃ hi yuṣmābhiratiguhyaṃ munīśvarāḥ || śṛṇudhvaṃ manasā sārddhaṃ bravīmyatyadbhutāṃ kathām || 5 || pāmarā api modante yāṃ vai śrutvā kathāṃ śubhām || kathā ceyaṃ mahāpuṇyā purā kailāsaparvate || 6 || kelikāleṣu pāvatyai śaṃbhunā kathitā dvijāḥ || tāṃ bravīmi kathāmenāmatyadbhutatarāṃ hi vaḥ || 7 || purā hi gālavonāma maharṣiḥ satyavākchuciḥ || ciṃtayānaḥ paraṃ brahma tapastepe nijāśrame|| || 8 || tasya kanyā mahābhāgā rūpayauvanaśālinī || nāmnā kāṃtimatī bālā vyacaratpituraṃtike || 9 || āharaṃtī ca puṣpāṇi balyarthaṃ tasya vai muneḥ || vedisaṃmārjanādīni samidāharaṇāni ca || 3.1.8.10 || kurvatī pitaraṃ bālā samyakparicacāra ha || kadācitsā tu valyarthaṃ puṣpāṇyāhartumudyatā || || 11 || tasminvane kāṃtimatī sudūramagamattadā || tatra puṣpāṇi ramyāṇi samāhṛtya ca peṭake || 12 || tūrṇaṃ nivavṛte bālā pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratā || nivartamānāṃ tāṃ kanyāṃ vidyādharakumārakau || 13 || sudarśanasukarṇākhyau vimānasthau dadarśatuḥ || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā gālavasutāṃ rūpayauvanaśālinīm ||14|| kāmasya patnīṃ lalitāṃ ratiṃ mūrtimatīmiva || sudarśanābhidho jyeṣṭho vidyādharakumārakaḥ || 15 || harṣasaṃphullanayanaścakame kāmamohitaḥ || pūrṇacandrānanāṃ tāṃ vai vīkṣamāṇo muhurmuhuḥ || 16 || tayā riraṃsukāmo'sau vimānāgrādavātarat || tāmupetya muneḥ kanyāmityuvāca sudarśanaḥ || 17 || || || sudarśana uvāca || || kāsi bhadre sutā kasya rūpayauvanaśālinī || rūpamapratimaṃ hyetadāhlādayati me manaḥ || 18 || tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ratisaṃkāśāṃ bādhate māṃ manobhavaḥ || sukaṇṭhanāmadheyasya vidyādharapateraham || 19 || ātmajo rūpasaṃpanno nāmnā caiva sudarśanaḥ || pratigṛhṇīṣva māṃ bhadre rakṣa māṃ karuṇādṛśā || 3.1.8.20 || bhartāraṃ māṃ samāsādya sarvānbhogānavāpsyasi || ityākarṇya vacastasya vidyādharasutasya sā || 21 || tadā kāṃtimatī vākyaṃ dharmayuktamabhāṣata || sudarśana mahābhāga vidyādharapateḥ suta ||22 || ātmajāṃ māṃ vijānīhi gālavasya mahātmanaḥ || kanyā cāhamanūḍhāsmi pitṛśu śrūṣaṇe ratā || 23 || balyarthaṃ hi pituścāhaṃ puṣpāṇyāhartumāgatā || āharaṃtyāśca puṣpāṇi yāma eko nyavartata || 24 || madvilaṃbena sa munirdeva tārcanatatparaḥ || kopaṃ vidhāsyate nūnaṃ tapasvī munipuṃgavaḥ || 25 || tacchīghramadya gacchāmi puṣpāṇyapyāhṛtāni me || kanyāśca piturādhīnā na svatantrāḥ kadācana ||26|| yadi māmicchati bhavānpitaraṃ mama yācaya || iti vidyādharasutamuktvā kāṃtimatī tadā || 27 || piturāśaṃkitā tūrṇamā śramaṃ gantumudyatā || gacchantīṃ tāṃ samālokya vidyādharakumārakaḥ || 28 || tūrṇaṃ jagrāha keśeṣu dhāvitvā madanārditaḥ || abhyetya nijakeśeṣu gṛhṇante taṃ vilokya sā || 29 || uccaiścakraṃda sahasā kurarīva muneḥ sutā || asmādvidyādharasutājjanaka trāhi māṃ vibho || 3.1.8.30 || balādgṛhṇāti duṣṭātmā vidyādharasuto'dya mām || itthamuccaiḥ pracukrośa svāśramānnātidūrataḥ || 31 || tadākraṃditamākarṇya gandhamādanavāsinaḥ || munayastu puraskṛtya gālavaṃ munipuṃgavam || 32 || kimetaditi vijñātuṃ taṃ deśaṃ tūrṇamāyayuḥ || taṃ deśaṃ tu samāgatya sarve te ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ || 33 || vidyādharagṛhītāṃ tāṃ dadṛśurmu nikanyakām || vidyādharasutaṃ cānyamaṃtike samupasthitam || 34 || etaddṛṣṭvā mahāyogī gālavo munipuṃgavaḥ || gataḥ kopavaśaṃ kiṃciddurāpmānaṃ śaśāpa tam || 35 || kṛtavānīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ yattvaṃ vidyādharādhama || tadyāhi mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ svasya duṣkarmaṇaḥ phalam || 36 || saṃprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma bahuduḥkhasamākulam || acireṇa tu kālena tasminneva tu janmani || 37 || manuṣyairapi niṃdyaṃ tadvetālatvaṃ prayāsyasi || māṃsāni śoṇitaṃ caiva sarvadā bhakṣayiṣyasi || 38 || vetālā rākṣasaprāyā balādgṛhṇanti yoṣitaḥ || tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā vetālatvamavāpsyasi || 39|| tava duṣkarmaṇo yo'sāvanumaṃtā kaniṣṭhakaḥ || sukarṇa iti vikhyāto bhavitā sopi mānuṣaḥ || 3.1.8.40 || kiṃtu sākṣānna kṛtavānyato'sāvīdṛśīṃ kriyām|| tanmānuṣatva mevāsya vetālatvaṃ tu no bhavet || 41 || vijñaptikautukābhikhyaṃ yadā vidyādharādhipam || drakṣyate'sau kaniṣṭhaste tadā śāpādvimokṣyate || 42 || īdṛśasyatu yaḥ kartā mahāpāpasya karmaṇaḥ || sa tvaṃ saṃprāpya mānuṣyaṃ tasminneva tu janmani || 43 || vetālajanma saṃprāpya ciraṃ loke cariṣyasi || ityuktvā gālavaḥ kanyāṃ gṛhītvā munibhiḥ saha || 44 || vidyādharasutau śaptvā svāśramaṃ prati niryayau || tatastasminmahābhāge niryāte munipuṃgave || || 45 || sudarśanasukarṇākhyau vidyādharapateḥ sutau|| muniśāpena duḥkhārtau ciṃtayāmāsaturbhṛśam || 46 || kartavyaṃ tau viniścitya sudarśanasukarṇakau || goviṃdasvāmināmānaṃ yamunātaṭavāsinam || 47 || brāhmaṇaṃ śīlasaṃpannaṃ pitṛtve parikalpya tau || parityajya svakaṃ rūpamajāyetāṃ tadā tmajau || 48 || vijayāśokadattākhyau tasya putraubabhūvatuḥ || suto vijayadattākhyo jyeṣṭho jajñe sudarśanaḥ || 49 || aśokadattanāmā tu sukarṇaśca kaniṣṭhakaḥ || vijayāśokadattau tu kramādyauvanamāpatuḥ || 3.1.8.50 || etasminneva kāletu yamunāyāstaṭe śubhe || anāvṛṣṭyā tu
