durbhikṣamabhūddvādaśavārṣi kam || 51 || goviṃdasvāmināmā tu brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || durbhikṣopahatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tadānīṃ sa nijāṃ purīm || 52 || prayayau kāśanigaraṃ saputraḥ saha bhāryayā || sa prayāgaṃ samāsādya dvaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvaṭam|| 53 || kapālamālābharaṇaṃ so'paśyadyatinaṃ puraḥ || goviṃdasvāmināmā tu namaścakre sa taṃ munim || 54 || saputrasya sabhāryasya so'vādīdāśiṣo muniḥ || idaṃ ca vacanaṃ prāha goviṃdasvāminaṃ prati || 55 || jyeṣṭhenānena putreṇa sāṃprataṃ brāhmaṇottama || kṣipraṃ vijayadattena viyogaste bhaviṣyati || 56 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā goviṃdasvāmināmakaḥ || sūrye cāstaṃ gate tatra sāṃdhyaṃ karma samāpya ca || 57 || sabhāryaḥ sasuto vipraḥ sudūrādhvasamākulaḥ || uvāsa tasyāṃ śarvaryyāṃ śūnye vai devatālaye || 58 || tadā tvaśokadattaśca brāhmaṇī ca samākulau || vastreṇāstīrya pṛthivīṃ rātrau nidrāṃ samāpatuḥ || 59|| tato vijayadattastu dūramārgavilaṃghanāt || babhūvātyaṃtamalaso bhṛśaṃ śītajvarārditaḥ || 3.1.8.60 || goviṃdasvāminā pitrā śītavabādhānivṛttaye || gāḍhamāliṃgyamāno'pi śītabādhāṃ na so'tyajat || 61 || bādhate'tyarthamadhunā tāta māṃ śītalo jvaraḥ || etadbādhānivṛttyarthaṃ vahnimānaya mā ciram || 62 || iti putravacaḥ śrutvā sarvatrāgniṃ gaveṣayan || alabdhavahniḥ provāca puna rabhyetya putrakam || 63 || na vahniṃ putra viṃdāmi mārgamāṇo'pi sarvaśaḥ || rātrimadhye tu saṃprāpte dvāreṣu pihiteṣu ca || 64 || nidrāparavaśāḥ paurā naiva dāsyaṃti pāvakam || itthaṃ vijayadatto'sāvuktaḥ pitrā jvarāturaḥ || 65 || yayāce vahnimevāsau pitaraṃ dīnayā girā || śītajvarasamudbhūtaśītabādhāprapīḍitam || 66 || himaśīkaravānvāyurdviguṇaṃ bādhate'dya mām || vahnirna labdha iti vai mithyaivoktaṃ pitastvayā || 67 || dūrādeṣa purobhāge jvālāmālāsamākulaḥ || śikhābhirlelihānobhraṃ dṛśyate paśya pāvakaḥ || 68 || taṃ vahnimānaya kṣipraṃ tāta śītanivṛttaye || ityuktavantaṃ taṃ putraṃ sa pitā pratyabhāṣata || 69 || nānṛtaṃ vacmi putrādya satyameva bravīmyaham || vahnimānyo'yamuddeśo dūrādeva vilokyate || 3.1.8.70 || pitṛkānanadeśaṃ taṃ putra jānīhi sāṃpratam || yadyeṣobhraṃlihajvālaḥ purastājjvalate'nalaḥ || 71 || putra vitrāsajanakaṃ taṃ jānīhi citānalam || amaṃgalo na sevyo'yaṃ citāgniḥ sparśadūṣitaḥ || 72 || tasya cāyuḥkṣayaṃ yāti sevate yaścitānalam || tasmāttavāyurhānirmā bhūyāditi mayā suta || 73 || amaṃgalastathā spṛśyo nānīto'yaṃ citānalaḥ || ityuktavaṃtaṃ pitaraṃ sa dīnaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 74 || ayaṃ śavānalo vā syādadhvarānala eva vā || sarvathānīyatāmeṣa nocenme maraṇaṃ bhavet || 75 || putrasnehābhibhūto'tha samāhartuṃ citānalam || goviṃdasvāmināmā tu śmaśānaṃ śīghramabhyagāt || 76 || goviṃdasvāmini gate samāhartuṃ citānalam|| tūrṇaṃ vijayadatto'pi tadā gacchaṃtamanvayāt || 77 || saṃprāpya tāpanikaṭaṃ vikīrṇāsthi citānalam || āliṃganniva sodvegaṃ śanairnirvṛtimāptavān || 79 || athāvādītsa pitaraṃ tadidaṃ parivartulam || atidīptaṃ vibhātyagnau kiṃ raktāṃbujasannibham ||79 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā putrasya brāhmaṇottamaḥ || nipuṇaṃ taṃ nirūpyaitadvacanaṃ punarabravīt || 3.1.8.80 || || goviṃdasvāmyuvāca || || etatkapālamanalajvālāvalayavartulam || vasākīkasamāṃsāḍhyametadraktāṃbujopamam || 81 || dvijasya sūnuḥ śrutveti kāṣṭhāgreṇa jaghāna tat || yena tatsphuṭanodgīrṇavasāsiktamukho'bhavat || 82 || kapālaghaṭṭanādraktaṃ yatsaṃsaktaṃ mukhe tadā || jihvayā lelihāno'sau muhustadraktamā svadat || 83 || āsvādyaivaṃ samādāya tatkapālaṃ samākulaḥ || pītvā vasāṃ mahākāyo babhūvātibhayaṃkaraḥ || 84 || sadyo vetā latāṃ prāpa tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrastadā niśi || tasyāṭṭahāsaghoṣeṇa diśaśca pradiśastadā || 85 || dyauratarikṣaṃ bhūmiśca sphuṭitā iva sarvaśaḥ || tasminvegātsamākṛṣya pitaraṃ hantumudyate || 86 || mā kṛthāḥ sāhasamiti prādurāsīdvaco divi || sa divyāṃ giramākarṇya vetālo'tibhayaṃkaraḥ || 87 || pitaraṃ taṃ parityajya mahāvegasamanvitaḥ || tūrṇamākāśamāviśya prayayāvaskhaladgatiḥ ||88|| sa gatvā dūramadhvānaṃ vetālaiḥ saha saṃgataḥ || tamāgataṃ samālokya vetolāssarva eva te || 89 || kapālasphoṭanādeṣa vetālatvaṃ yadāptavān || kapālasphoṭanāmānamāhvayāṃcakrire tataḥ ||3.1.8.9||| tataḥ kapālasphoṭo 'sau vetālaiḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ|| narāsthibhūṣaṇākhyasya sadyo vetālabhūpateḥ ||91|| antikaṃ sahasā prāpa mahābalasamanvitaḥ|| narāsthibhūṣaṇaścainaṃ senāpa timakalpayat || 92 || taṃ kadācittu gandharvaścitrasenābhidho balī || narāsthibhūṣaṇaṃ saṃkhye nyavadhītso'pi saṃsthitaḥ || 93|| narāsthibhūṣaṇe tasmi ngandharveṇa hate yudhi || tadā kapālasphoṭo'sau tatpadaṃ samavāptavān || 94 || vidyādharendrasya sutaḥ sudarśano manuṣyatāṃ vai prathamaṃ sa gatvā || vetālatāṃ prāpya maharṣiśāpātkramācca vetālapatirbabhūva || 95 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setu māhātmye vetālavaradatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ sudarśanavetālatvaprāptivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<3.1.9>
tataḥ sa vipraḥ pratyūṣe putraśokena pīḍitaḥ || aśoka dattasaṃyukto bhāryayā vilalāpa ha || 1 || vilapaṃtaṃ samālokya goviṃdasvāminaṃ dvijāḥ || vaṇiksamudradattākhyaḥ samāninye nijaṃ gṛham || 2 || samānīya samāśvāsya dayāyukto vaṇigvaraḥ || svadhanānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ rakṣitāramakalpayat || 3 || smaranmahāyativacaḥ putradarśanalālasaḥ || sa tasthau vaṇijo gehe putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ || 4 || aśokadattanāmā tu dvitīyo vipranaṃdanaḥ || śastre caiva tathā śāstre babhūvātivicakṣaṇaḥ || 5 || tathānyāsvapi vidyāsu nāsti tatsadṛśo bhuvi || kṛtavidyo dvijasutaḥ prakhyāto nagare'bhavat || 6 || atrāṃtare narapatiṃ pratāpamukuṭābhidham || kāśīdeśādhipo mallaḥ kaścidabhyāyayau balī || 7 || pratāpamukuṭo rājā mallasyāsya jayāya saḥ || balinaṃ dvijaputraṃ tamāhvayāmāsa bhṛtyakaiḥ || 8 || tamāgataṃ samālokya pratāpamukuṭo'bravīt || aśokadatta sahasā mallamenaṃ balotkaṭam || 9 || durjayaṃ jahi saṃgrāme tvaṃ vai valavatāṃ varaḥ || dākṣiṇātyamahāmallapatāvasmiñjite tvayā || 3.1.9.10 || yadiṣṭaṃ tava tatsarvaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā valavāndvijanaṃdanaḥ || 11 || dākṣiṇātyamahāmallanṛpatiṃ samatāḍayat || tāḍito dvijaputreṇa mallaḥ sa balinā balī || 12 || sadyo vivṛttanayanaḥ parāsurnyapatadbhuvi || dvija putrasya tatkarma devairapi suduṣkaram || 13 || pratāpamukuṭo dṛṣṭvā prasannahṛdayo'bhavat || dattvā vahudhanāngrāmānsamīpe'sthāpayattadā || 14 || sa kadācinmahārāja sahito dvijasūnunā || saṃdhyāyāṃ vijane deśe cacāra turageṇa vai || 15 || dvijasūnusakhastatra dīnāṃ vāṇīmathāśṛṇot || rājannalpāparādho'haṃ śatrupreraṇayāsakṛt || 16 || daṇḍapālena nihitaḥ śūle nirghṛṇacetasā || dinamadya caturthaṃ me śūlasthasyaiva jīvataḥ || 17 || prāṇāḥ sukhena niryāṃti na hi duṣkṛtakarmaṇām || bhṛśaṃ māṃ bādhate tṛṣṇā tāṃ nivāraya bhūpate ||18 || iti dīnāṃ samākarṇya vācaṃ rājā dvijā tmajam || aśokadattanāmānaṃ dhairyavaṃtamabhāṣata || 19 || asmai niraparādhāya śūlaprotāya jaṃtave || tṛṣṇārditāya dātavyaṃ dvijasūno tvayā jalam || || 3.1.9.20 || ityādiṣṭo narendreṇa sahasā dvijanandanaḥ || jalapūrṇaṃ samādāya kalaśaṃ vegavānyayau || 21 || tacchmaśānaṃ samāsādya bhūtavetālasaṃkulam || śūlaprotāya vai tasmai jalaṃ dātuṃ samutsukaḥ || 22 || dadarśātha sthitāṃ nārīṃ navayauvanaśālinīm || udaikṣata mahākāṃtiṃ mūrtāmiva ratiṃ dvijaḥ || || 23 || tāmālokya tataḥ prāha dhairyavāndvijanaṃdanaḥ || kāsi bhadre varārohe śmaśāne vijane sthitā || 24 || asyādhastātkimarthaṃ tvaṃ śūlaprotasya tiṣṭhasi || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sā prāha rucirānanā || 25 || puruṣo vallabho'yaṃ me śūle rājñā samarpitaḥ || dhanaṃ yathā ca kṛpaṇaḥ paśya prāṇānna muṃcati || 26 || āsannamaraṇaṃ cainamanuyātumiha sthitā || tṛṣito yācate vāri māmayaṃ vyathate muhuḥ || 27 || śūlaproto ddhatagrīvaṃ mumūrṣuṃ prāṇanāyakam|| nāsmi pāyayituṃ śaktā jalamenamadhaḥsthitā||28|| aśokadattastacchrutvā karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ || tatkālasadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ tāṃ vadhūmabravīttadā ||29|| || aśokadatta uvāca || || mātarmatskaṃdhamāruhya dehyasmai śītalaṃ jalam|| sā tatheti tamābhāṣya taruṇī tvarayānvitā||3.1.9.30|| ānamravapuṣastasya skaṃdhaṃ padbhyāṃ ruroha vai || dvijasūnurdadarśātha śoṇitaṃ nūtanaṃ patat||31|| kimetaditi sopaśyadunnamya sahasā mukham || bhakṣyamāṇaṃ tayā tatsa vijñāya dvijanaṃdanaḥ||32|| aśokadatto jagrāha tasyāḥ pādaṃ sanūpuram|| tato'gānnūpuraṃ tyaktvā baddharatnaṃ vihāya tat||33|| pratyuptānekaratnāḍhyaṃ tadādāyaca nūpuram|| aśokadattaḥ prayayau tacchmaśānānnṛpāṃtikam||34|| smaśānavṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ sa nṛpāya nivedya vai|| mahārghyaratnapratyuptaṃ nūpuraṃ ca dadau tadā ||35|| jñātvā tadvīracaritaṃ vīrairanyaiḥ suduṣkaram|| dadau madanalekhākhyāṃ sutāṃ tasmai mahīpatiḥ||36|| kadācidatha tāddivyaṃ nūpuraṃ vīkṣya bhūpatiḥ|| asya nūpuravaryasya tulyaṃ vai nūpurāṃtaram|| 37 || kuto vā labhyata iti sādaraṃ samaciṃtayat || aśokadattastu tadā vijñāya nṛpakāṃkṣitam || 38 || nṛpurāṃtarasi ddhyarthaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa cetasā || śmaśāne nūpuramidaṃ yataḥ prāptaṃ mayā purā ||39|| tāṃ nūpurāṃtaraprāptyai kutra drakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || itthaṃ vitarkya bahudhā ni ścikāya mahāmatiḥ||3.1.9.40|| vikreṣyāmi mahāmāṃsaṃ sametya pitṛkānanam|| tatra rākṣasavetālapiśācādiṣu sarvaśaḥ||41|| maṃtrairāhūyamāneṣu sāpyāyāsya ti rākṣasī || tāmāgatāṃ balādgṛhya tadgrahīṣyāmi nūpuram||42|| rākṣasānāṃ sahasraṃ vā piśācānāṃ tathāyutam || vetālānāṃ tathā koṭirna lakṣyaṃ balino mama ||43|| iti niścitya manasā śmaśānaṃ sahasā yayau || vikrīṇāno mahāmāṃsaṃ maṃtrairāhūya rākṣasān ||44|| gṛhāṇetyuccayā vācā cacāra śrāvayandi śaḥ || vikrīyate mahāmāṃsaṃ gṛhyatāṃgṛhyatāmiti || 45 || tatra rākṣasavetālāḥ kaṃkālāśca piśācakāḥ || anye ca bhūtanivahāḥ samājagmuḥ praharṣitāḥ || || 46 || bhakṣayiṣyāmahe sarve māṃsamiṣṭatamaṃ tviti || tatrāgacchatsu sarveṣu rakṣaḥkanyāsamāvṛtā || 47 || āyayau rākṣasī sāpi māṃsabhakṣaṇalālasā || gaveṣayaṃstadā viprastāṃ samudvīkṣya rākṣasīm|| 48 || seyaṃ dṛṣṭā puretyeṣa pratyabhijñānamāptavān || tāmāha dvijaputro'nyaddehi me nūpuraṃ tviti || 49 || sā tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prītā vākyamathā'bravīt || mamaiva ca tvayā nītaṃ purā vīreṃdra nūpuram || 3.1.9.50 || gṛhāṇa ratnaruciraṃ dvitīyamapi nūpuram || ityuktvā nūpuraṃ tasmai svasutāṃ ca dadau priyām|| 51 || vidyutkeśyā tadā dattāṃ priyāṃ vidyutprabhābhidhām || vipraḥ saṃprāpya mumude rūpayauvanaśāli nīm || 52 || vidyutkeśī tu jāmātre hemābjamapi sā dadau || vidyutprabhāṃ nūpuraṃ ca hemābjamapilabhya saḥ || 53 || śvaśrūmābhāṣya sahasā punaḥ prāyānnṛpāṃtikam|| tataḥ pratāpamukuṭo nūpuraprāptinaṃditaḥ || 54 || śauryadhairyasamāyuktaṃ praśaśaṃsa dvijātmajam|| atha vidyutprabhāṃ vipraḥ so'bravīdrahasi priyām||55|| mātrā tava kuto labdhametaddhemāṃbuja priye|| etattulyāni cānyāni yataḥ prāpsye varānane||56|| dvijātmajaṃ tataḥ prāha patiṃ vidyutprabhā rahaḥ || prabho kapālavisphoṭanāmno vetālabhūpateḥ || 57 || asti divyaṃ saraḥ kiṃciddhemāṃbujapariṣkṛtam || tava śvaśrvā jalakrīḍāṃ vitanvaṃ tyedamāhṛtam || 58 || iti śrutvā vacastatra māṃ nayeti jagāda saḥ || tataḥ sā sahasā vipraṃ ninye tatkāṃcanaṃ saraḥ || 59 || tataḥ sa hemapadmānāmājihīrṣurdvijātmajaḥ || tadviprakāriṇaḥ sarvānvetālādīṃstato'vadhīt || 3.1.9.60 || svayaṃ kapālavisphoṭaṃ nihatāśeṣasainikam || dadarśa vetālapatiṃ taṃ ca haṃtuṃ pracakrame || 61 || atrāṃtare mahātejā nāmnā vijñaptikautukaḥ || vidyādharapatiḥ prāpya vimānenainamabravīt || 62 || aśokadattaṃ vipreṃdra sāhasaṃ mā kṛthā iti || tadākarṇya dvijasuto vimānavarasaṃsthitam ||63|| dadarśa prabhayā yuktaṃ vidyādharapatiṃ divi || tasya darśanamātreṇa śāpāmukto dvijā tmajaḥ || 64 || saṃtyajya mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ rūpamavāptavān || vimānavaramārūḍhaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam || 65 || śāpānmuktaṃ sukarṇaṃ taṃ prāha vijñapti kautukaḥ || ayaṃ sukarṇa te bhrātā gālavasya mahāmuneḥ || 66 || śāpādvetālatāṃ prāpa tatkanyāsparśapātakī || tvaṃ ca śaptaḥ purā tena tatpāpasyānu modakaḥ || 67 || tavāyamalpapāpasya śāpo maddarśanāvadhiḥ || kalpistatena muninā śāpāṃto nāsya kalpitaḥ || 68|| tadehi muktaśāposi sukarṇa svargamāruha || tataḥ sukarṇastaṃ prāha vidyādharakulādhipam || 69 || vidyādharapate bhrātrā vinā jyeṣṭhena sāṃpratam || sarvabhogayutaṃ svargaṃ naiva gaṃtuṃ samutsahe || 3.1.9.70 || śāpasyāṃto yathā bhūyānmama bhrātustathā vada || tamuvāca mahātejāstathā vijñaptikautukaḥ || 71 || durnivāramimaṃ śāpamanyaḥ ko vā nivārayet || kiṃ tu guhyatamaṃ kiṃcittava vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam||72|| brahmaṇā sanakādibhyo munibhyaḥ kathitaṃ purā|| sarvatīrthāśraye puṇye dakṣiṇasyo dadhestaṭe||73|| cakratīrthasamīpe tu tīrthamastimahattaram|| mahāpātakasaṃghāśca yasya darśanamātrataḥ||74|| naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇādeva na jāne snānajaṃ phalam|| tatra gatvā tava jyeṣṭho yadi snāyānmahattare ||75|| vetālatvaṃ tyajennūnaṃ tadā gālavaśāpajam|| sukarṇastadvacaḥ śrutvā bhrātrā vetālarūpiṇā ||76|| sahitaḥ sahasā prāyāddakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭam || dakṣiṇaṃ cakratīrthākhyāduttaraṃ gaṃdhamādanāt || 77 || brahmaṇā sanakādibhyaḥ kathitaṃ tīrthamabhyagāt || tattīrthakūlamāsādya bhrātaraṃ cedamabravīt || 78 || bhrātargālavaśāpasya ghorasyāsya nivṛttaye || tīrthe'sminnacirātsnāhi sarvatīrthottamottame || 79 || tasminna vasare viprāstasya tīrthasya śīkarāḥ || nyapataṃstasya gātreṣu vāyunā vai samāhṛtāḥ || 3.1.9.80 || sa tacchīkarasaṃsparśāttyaktvā vetālatāṃ tadā || tadeva mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ dvijaputratvamāptavān|| 81 || tataḥ saṃkalpya sahasā tasmiṃstīrthottamottame || manuṣyatvanivṛttyarthaṃ nimamajja dvijātmajaḥ || 82 || uttiṣṭhanneva sahasā divyaṃ rūpamavāptavān || vimānavaramārūḍho devastrīparivāritaḥ || 83 || sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaḥ saha bhrātrā sudarśanaḥ || ślāghamānaśca tattīrthaṃ namaskatya punaḥpunaḥ || 84 || vijñaptikautukaṃ cāpi puraskṛtya divaṃ yayau || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vetālavaradābhidham|| 85 || vetālatvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ yacchīkarasparśamātrataḥ || ya idaṃ tīrthamāsādya cakratīrthasya dakṣiṇe || 86 || snānaṃ kadācitkurvaṃti jīvanmuktā bhavaṃti te|| etattīrthasamaṃ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 87 || ghorāṃ vetālatāṃ tyaktvā divyatāṃ sa yadāptavān || 88 || atra saṃkalpya ca snātvā vetālavarade śubhe || pitṛbhyaḥ piṃḍadānaṃ ca kuryādvai niyamānvitaḥ || 89 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāstasya tīrthasya vaibhavam || vetālavaradābhikhyā yathā cāsya samāgatā ||| || 3.1.9.90 || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā sa mucyate || 91 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye vetālavaradatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ sudarśanasukarṇaśāpamokṣaṇaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<3.1.10>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || vetālavarade tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dvijottamāḥ || tataḥ śanaiḥśanairgacchedgandhamādanaparvatam || 1 || yoṃ'budhau seturūpeṇa vartate gandhamādanaḥ || sa mārgo brahmalokasya viśvakartrā vinirmitaḥ || 2 || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sarāṃsi saritastathā || samudrāśca mahāpuṇyā vanānyapyāśramāṇi ca || 3 || puṇyāni kṣetrajātāni vedāraṇyā dikāni ca || munayaśca vasiṣṭhādyā siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ || 4 || lakṣmyā saha dharaṇyā ca bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || sāvitryā ca sarasvatyā sahaiva catu rānanaḥ || 5 || heraṃbaḥ ṣaṇmukhaścaiva devāśceṃdrapurogamāḥ || ādityādigrahāścaiva tathāṣṭau vasavo dvijāḥ || 6 || pitarolokapālāśca tathānye devatā gaṇāḥ || mahāpātakasaṃghānāṃ nāśane lokapāvane || 7 || divāniśaṃ vasaṃtyatra parvate gaṃdhamādane || atra gaurī sadā tuṣṭā hareṇa saha vartate || || atra kinnarakāṃtānāṃ krīḍā jāgarti nityaśaḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa buddhisaukhyaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhavet || 9 || tanmūrdhani kṛtāvāsāḥ siddhacāraṇayoṣitaḥ || pūjayaṃti sadā kālaṃ śaṃkaraṃ girijāpatim || 3.1.10.10 || koṭayo brahmahatyānāmagamyāgamakoṭayaḥ || aṃgalagnairvinaśyaṃti gandhamādanamārutaiḥ || 11 || asāvullolakallole tiṣṭhanmadhye mahāṃbudhau || āsīnmunigaṇaiḥ sevyaḥ purā vai gandhamādanaḥ || 12 || tato nalena setau tu baddhe tanmadhyagocaraḥ || rāmājñayākhilaiḥ sevyo babhūva manujairapi || 13 || seturūpaṃ giriṃ taṃ tu prārthayedgaṃdhamādanam || kṣamādhara mahāpuṇya sarvadevanamaskṛta || 14 || viṣṇvā dayo'pi ye devāssevaṃte śraddhayā saha || taṃ bhavaṃtamahaṃ padbhyāmākramāmi nagottama || 15 || kṣamasva pādaghātaṃ me dayayā pāpacetasaḥ || tvanmūrddhani kṛtāvāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ darśayasva me || 16 || prārthayitvā narastvevaṃ seturūpaṃ nagottamam || tato mṛdupadaṃ gacchetpāvanaṃ gandhamādanam || 17 || abdhau tatra naraḥ snātvā parvate gandhamādane || piṃḍadānaṃ tataḥ kuryādapi sarṣapamātrakam || 18 || tṛptiṃ prayāṃti pitarastasya yāvadyugakṣayaḥ || śamīdalasamānānvā dadyātpiṃḍānpitṝnprati || 19|| svargasthā mokṣamāyāṃti svargaṃ narakavāsinaḥ || tatastasyopari mahātīrthaṃ lokeṣu viśrutam ||3.1.10.2||| sarvatīrthottamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāmnā pāpavināśanam || asti puṇyatamaṃ viprāḥ pavitre gandhamādane ||21|| yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva garbhavāso na vidyate || tatprāpya tu naraḥ snāyātsvade hamalanāśanam || tatra snānānnaro yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||22|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta pāpavināśākhya tīrthasya brūhi vaibhavam || vyāsena bodhitastvaṃ hi vetsi sarvaṃ mahāmune||23|| ||śrīsūta uvāca|| || brahmāśramapade vṛttāṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe|| vakṣyāmi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ tu kathāṃ śubhām||24|| asyāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmāśramapade śubhe || nānāvṛkṣagaṇākīrṇaṃ pārśve himavataḥ śubhe || 25 || vahugulmalatākīrṇaṃ mṛgadvipaniṣevitam || siddhacāraṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitakānanam || 26 || vṛtibhirbahubhiḥ kīrṇaṃ tāpasairuśobhitam || brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ sūryajvalanasaṃnibhaiḥ || 27 || niyamavratasaṃ pannaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ tapasvibhiḥ || dīkṣitairyāgahetośca yatāhāraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ || 28 || vedādhyayanasaṃpannairvaidikaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || varṇibhiśca gṛhasthaiśca vānaprasthaiśca bhikṣubhiḥ || 29 || svāśramācāranirataiḥ svavarṇoktavidhāyibhiḥ || vālakhilyaiśca munibhiḥ saṃprāptaiśca marīcibhiḥ || 3.1.10.30 || tatrāśrame purā kaścicchūdro dṛḍhamatirdvijāḥ || sāhasī brāhmaṇābhyāśamājagāma mudānvitaḥ || 31 || āgato hyāśramapadaṃ pūjitaśca tapasvibhiḥ || nāmnā dṛḍhamatiḥ śūdraḥ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇanāma vai || 32 || tānsa dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāndevakalpānmahaujasaḥ || kurvato vividhānyajñānsaṃprahṛṣya sa śūdrakaḥ || 33 || athāsya buddhirabhavattapaḥkartumanuttamam || tato'bravītkulapatiṃ munimāgatya tāpasam || 34 || || dṛḍhamatiruvāca || || tapodhana namaste'stu rakṣa māṃ karuṇānidhe || tava prasādādicchāmi dharmaṃ cartuṃ dvijarṣabha || 35 || tasmādabhigataṃ māṃ tvaṃ yāge dīkṣaya suvrata || brahmannavaravarṇo'haṃ śūdro jātyāsmi sattama || 36 || śuśrūṣāṃ kartumicchāmi prapannāya prasīda me || evamukte tu śūdreṇa tamāha brāhmaṇastadā || 37 || || kulapatiruvāca || yāge dīkṣayituṃ śakyo na śūdro hīnajanmabhāk || śrūyatāṃ yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣānirato bhava || 38 || upadeśo na kartavyo jātihīnasya karhicit || upadeśe mahāndoṣa upādhyāyasya vidyate || 39 || nādhyāpayedbudhaḥ śūdraṃ tathā naiva ca yājayet || na pāṭhayettathā śūdraṃ śāstraṃ vyākaraṇādikam || 3.1.10.40 || kāvyaṃ vā nāṭakaṃ vāpi tathālaṃkārameva ca || purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca śūdraṃ naiva tu pāṭhayet || 41 || yadi copadiśedvipraḥ śūdraṃ caitāni karhicit || tyajeyurbrāhmaṇā vipraṃ taṃ grāmādbrahmasaṃkulāt || 42 || śūdrāya copadeṣṭāraṃ dvijaṃ caṃḍālavattyajet || śūdraṃ cākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||43 || ataḥ śuśrūṣa bhadraṃ te brāhmaṇāñchraddhayā saha|| śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā manvādibhirudīritā||44|| nahi naisargikaṃ karma parityaktuṃ tvamarhasi || evamuktastu muninā sa śūdro'ciṃtayattadā || 45 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā tvadya vrate śraddhā hi me purā || yathā syānmama vijñānaṃ yatiṣye'haṃ tathādya vai || 46 || iti niścitya manasā śūdro dṛḍhamatistadā || gatvāśramapadāddūraṃ kṛtavānuṭajaṃ śubham || 47 || tatra vai devatāgāraṃ puṇyānyāyatanānica || puṣpārāmādikaṃ cāpi taṭākakhananādikam || 48 || śraddhayā kārayāmāsa tapaḥsiddhyarthamātmanaḥ || abhiṣekāṃśca niyamānupavāsādikānapi || 49 || baliṃ ca kṛtvā hutvā ca daivatānyabhyapūjayat || saṃkalpaniyamopetaḥ phalāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || 3.1.10.50 || nityaṃ kaṃdaiśca mūlaiśca puṣpairapi tathā phalaiḥ || atithīnpūjayāmāsa yathāvatsamupāgatān || 51 || evaṃ hi sumahānkālo vyaticakrāma tasya vai || athāśramamagāttasya sumatirnāma nāmataḥ || 52 || dvijo gargakulodbhūtaḥ satyavādī jiteṃdriyaḥ || svāgatena muniṃ pūjya toṣayitvā phalādikaiḥ || 53 || kathayanvai kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchata || itthaṃ sapraṇipātādyairupacāraistu pūjitaḥ || 54 || āśīrbhirabhinaṃdyainaṃ pratigṛhya ca satkriyām || tamāpṛchya prahṛṣṭāpmā svāśramaṃ punarāyayau || 55 || evaṃ dinedine vipraḥ śūdresminpakṣapātavān || āgacchadāśramaṃ tasya draṣṭuṃ taṃ śūdrayonijam || 56 || bahukālaṃ dvijasyābhūtsaṃsargaḥ śūdrayoninā|| snehasya vaśamāpannaḥ śūdroktaṃ nāticakrame || 57 || athāgataṃ dvijaṃ śūdraḥ prāha snehavaśīkṛtam || havyakavyavidhānaṃ me kṛtsnaṃ brūhi munīśvara || 58 || pitṛkāryavidhānārthaṃ devakāryārthameva ca || maṃtrānupadiśa tvaṃ me mahālayavidhiṃ tathā || 59 || aṣṭakāśrāddhakṛtyaṃ ca vaidikaṃ yacca kiṃcana || sarvametadrahasyaṃ me brūhi tvaṃ vai gururmataḥ|| 3.1.10.60 || evamuktaḥ sa śūdreṇa sarvametadupādiśat || kārayāmāsa tasyāyaṃ pitṛkāryādikaṃ tathā || 61 || pitṛkārye kṛte tena visṛṣṭaḥ sa dvijo gataḥ || atha dīrgheṇa kālena poṣitaḥ śūdrayoninā || 62 || tyakto vipragaṇaiḥ so'yaṃ paṃcatvamagamaddvijaḥ vaivasvatabhaṭairnītvā pātito narakeṣvapi || 63 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || bhuktvā krameṇa narakāṃstadaṃte sthā varo'bhavat || 64 || gardabhastu tato jajñe viḍvarāhastataḥ param || jajñe'tha sārameyo'sau paścādvāyasatāṃ gataḥ || 65 || atha caṃḍālatāṃ prāpa śūdrayonimagāttataḥ || gatavānvaiśyatāṃ paścātkṣatriyastadanaṃtaram || 66 || prabalairbādhyamāno'sau brāhmaṇo vai tadā'bhavat || upanītaḥ sa pitrā tu varṣe garbhāṣṭame dvijaḥ || 67 || vartamānaḥ piturgehe svācārābhyāsatatparaḥ || gacchankadācidgahane gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā || 68 || rudanbhramanskhala nmūḍhaḥ prahasanvilapannasau || śaśvaddhāheti ca vadanvaidikaṃ karma so'tyajat || 69 || dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ tathābhūtaṃ pitā duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ || sutamādāya ca snehā dagastyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 3.1.10.70 || bhaktyā muniṃ praṇamyāsau pitā tasya sutasya vai || tasmai nivedayāmāsa svaputrasya viceṣṭitam || 71 || abravīcca tadā vipraḥ kumbhajaṃ munipuṃgavam|| eṣa me tanayo brahmangṛhīto brahmarakṣasā || 72 || sukhaṃ na bhajate brahmanrakṣa taṃ karuṇādṛśā || nāsti me tanayo' pyanyaḥ pitṝṇāmṛṇamuktaye || 73 || asya pīḍāvināśārthamupāyaṃ brūhi kumbhaja || tvatsamastriṣu lokeṣu tapaḥśīlo na vidyate || 74 || agraṇīḥ śivabhaktānāmuktastvaṃ hi maharṣibhiḥ || tvāṃ vināsya paritrāṇaṃ na meputrasya vidyate || 75 || pitre kṛpāṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ dayāśīlā hi sādhavaḥ || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktastadā tena kumbhajo dhyānamāsthitaḥ || 76 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālamabravīdbrāhmaṇaṃ tataḥ || || agastya uvāca || || pūrvajanmani te putro brāhmaṇo'yaṃ mahāmate || 77 || sumatirnāma vipro'yaṃ matiṃ śūdrāya vai dadau || karmāṇi vaidikānyeṣa sarvāṇyupadi deśa vai || 78 || ato'yaṃ narakānbhuktvā kalpakoṭisahasrakam || jāto bhuvi tadaṃteṣu sthāvarādiṣu yoniṣu || 79 || idānīṃ brāhmaṇo jātaḥ karmaśeṣeṇa te sutaḥ || yamena preṣitenātra gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā || 3.1.10.80 || krūreṇa pātakenāddhā pūvajanmakṛtena vai || upāyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi brahmarakṣovināśane || 81 || śṛṇuṣva śraddhayā yuktaḥ samādhāya ca mānasam || dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhau vipra seturūpo mahāgiriḥ || 82 || vartate daivataiḥ sevyaḥ pāvano gandhamādanaḥ || tasyopari mahātīrthaṃ nāmnā pāpavināśanam || 83 || asti puṇyaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ vetālabrahma rakṣasām|| 84 || mahatāṃ caiva rogāṇāṃ tīrthaṃ tannāśakaṃ smṛtam || sutamādāya gaccha tvaṃ tattīrthaṃ setumadhyagam || 85 || prayataḥ snāpaya sutaṃ tīrthe pāpavināśane || snānena tridinaṃ tatra brahmarakṣo vinaśyati || 86 || naivopāyāṃtaraṃ tasya vināśe vidyate bhuvi || tasmācchīghraṃ prayāhi tvaṃ rāmasetuṃ vimuktidam || 87 || tatra pāpavināśākhyatīrthe snāpaya te sutam || mā vilaṃbaṃ kuruṣvātra tvarayā yāhi vai dvija || 88 || ityuktaḥ sa dvijo'gastyaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat|| anujñātaśca tenāsau prayayau gaṃdhamādanam || 89 || sutena sākaṃ vipreṃdro gatvā pāpavināśanam || saṃkalpapūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya dinatrayamasausutam|| 3.1.10.9||| sasnau svayaṃ ca vipreṃdrāḥ pitā pāpavināśane || atha tasya sutastatra vimukto brahmarakṣasā || 91 || samajāyata nīrogaḥ svasthaḥ sundararūpadhṛk || sarvasaṃpatsamṛddho'sau bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 92 || dehāṃte prayayau muktiṃ snānātpāpavināśane || pitāpi tatra snānena dehāṃte muktimāptavān|| 93 || tenopadiṣṭo yaḥ śūdraḥ sa bhuktvā narakānkramāt || anekāsu janitvā ca kutsitāsvapiyoniṣu || 94 || gṛdhrajanmā bhavatpaścādgaṃdhamādanaparvate || sa kadācijjalaṃ pātuṃ tīrthe pāpavināśane || 95 || samāgataḥ papau toyaṃ siṣice cātmanastanum || tadaiva divyadehaḥ sansarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 96 || divyamālyāṃbaradharo raktacaṃdanarūṣitaḥ || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya śobhitaśchatracāmaraiḥ || 97 || uttamastrīparivṛtaḥ prayayāvamarālayam ||98|| śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ prabhāvametadvai tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam || svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyaṃ prāyaścittakaraṃ tathā || brahmaviṣṇumahe śānaiḥ sevitaṃ surasevitam || 99 || pāpānāṃ nāśanādviprāḥ pāpanāśābhidhaṃ hi tat || śreyorthī puruṣastasmātsnāyātpāpavināśane ||3.1.10.100|| itthaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ munīṃdrāstadvaibhavaṃ pāpavināśanasya || yatrābhiṣekātsahasā vimuktau dvijaśca śūdraśca viniṃdyakṛtyau ||101|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setu māhātmye gaṃdhamādanapraśaṃsāyāṃ pāpavināśaprabhāvakathanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || śrīsūta uvāca || ||
<3.1.11>
pāpanāśe naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpanibarhaṇe || tataḥ sītāsaro gacchetsnātuṃ niyamapūrvakam || 1 || yāni kāni ca puṇyāni brahmāṃḍāṃtargatāni vai || tāni gaṃgāditīrthāni svapāpapariśuddhaye || 2 || sītāsarasi vartaṃte mahāpātakanāśane || kṣetrāṇyapi mahārhāṇi kāśyādīni divāniśam || 3 || sītāsarotra sevaṃte svasvakalmaṣaśāṃtaye || tasyāḥ sarasi saṃgītaguṇenākṛṣya bāliśaḥ || 4 || paṃcānano'pi vasate paṃcapātakanāśanaḥ || tadetattīrthamāgatya snātvā vai śraddhayā saha || puraṃdaraḥ purā viprā mumuce brahmahatyayā || 5 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || brahmahatyā kathamabhūdvāsavasya purā mune || sītāsarasi snānātkathaṃ mukto'bhavattayā || 6|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || kapālābharaṇonāma rākṣaso'bhūtpurā dvijāḥ || || 7 || avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ so'bhavadbrahmaṇo varāt || śavabhakṣaṇanāmā tu tasyāsīnmaṃtrisattamaḥ || 8 || akṣauhiṇīśataṃ tasya hayebharathasaṃkulam || asti tasya puraṃ cāpi vaijayaṃtamiti śrutam || 9 || vasatyasminpure so'yaṃ kapālābharaṇo balī || śavabhakṣaṃ samāhūya babhāṣe maṃtriṇaṃ dvijāḥ || || 3.1.11.10 || śavabhakṣa mahāvīrya maṃtraśāstreṣu kovida || vayaṃ devapurīṃ gatvā vinirjitya surānraṇe || 11 || śakrasya bhavane ramye sthāsyāmassainikaiḥ saha || ramāvo naṃdane tasya raṃbhādyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 12 || kapālābharaṇasyedaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ tadā || śavabhakṣo'bravīdviprā vacastatra tathāstviti || || 13 || tataḥ kapālābharaṇaḥ putraṃ durmedhasaṃ balī || pratiṣṭhāpya pure śūraṃ senayā parivāritaḥ || 14 || yuyutsuramaraiḥ sākaṃ prayayāvamarāvatīm || gajāśvarathapādātairuddhatai reṇusaṃcayaiḥ || 15 || śoṣayañjaladhīnsiṃdhūṃścūrṇayanparvatānapi || niḥsāṇadhvaninā viprā nādayanrodasī tathā || 16 || aśvānāṃ heṣitaravairgajānāmapi bṛṃhitaiḥ || rathanemisvanairugraiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ padātinām || 17 || śrotrāṇi diggajānāṃ ca vitanvanbadhirāṇi saḥ || agamaddevanagarīṃ yuyutsuramaraiḥ saha || 18 || tata indrādayo devāḥ senākalakaladhvanim || śrutvābhiniryyayuḥ puryā yuddhābhimanaso dvijāḥ || 19 || tato yuddhaṃ samabhavaddevānāṃ rākṣasaiḥ saha || adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ jagati tathaivāśrutapūrvakam || 3.1.11.20 || tata indrādayo devā rākṣasāñjaghnurāhave || rākṣasāśca surāñjaghnuḥ samare vijigīṣavaḥ || 21 || dvandvayuddhaṃ ca samabhūdanyonyaṃ surarakṣasām || kapālābharaṇenājau yuyudhe balavṛtrahā || 22 || yamena śavabhakṣaśca varuṇena ca kauśikaḥ || kubero rudhirākṣeṇa yuyudhe brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 23 || māṃsapriyo madyasevī krūradṛṣṭirbhayāvahaḥ || catvāra ete vikrāṃtāḥ kapālābharaṇānujāḥ || 24 || aśvibhyāmagnivāyubhyāṃ yuddhe yuyudhire mithaḥ || tato yamo mahāvīryaḥ kāladaṇḍena vegavān || 25 || śavabhakṣaṃ nihatyājāvanayadyamasādanam|| tasya cākṣauhiṇīstriṃśannijaghne samare yamaḥ || 26 || varuṇaḥ kauśikasyājau prāsena prāharacchiraḥ || kubero rudhirākṣasya kuntenābhyaharacchiraḥ || 27 || aśvibhyāmagnivāyubhyāṃ kapālābharaṇānujāḥ || nihatāḥ samare viprāḥ prayayuryamasādanam || 28 || akṣauhiṇīśataṃ cāpi devendreṇa mṛdhe dvijāḥ || yāmārddhena hataṃ yuddhe prayayau yamasādanam || 29 || tataḥ kapālābharaṇaḥ prekṣya senāṃ nijāṃ hatām || cāpamādāya niśitāñcharāṃścāpi mahājavān || 3.1.11.30 || abhyayātsamare śakraṃ tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt || tataḥ śakrasya śirasi vyadhamaccharapaṃcakaiḥ || 31 || tānaprāptānpraciccheda śarairyuddhe sa vṛtrahā || tataḥ śūlaṃ samādāya kapālābharaṇo mṛdhe || 32 || deveṃdrāya pracikṣepa taṃ śaktyā nijaghāna saḥ || tataḥ kapālābharaṇaḥ śatahastāyatāṃ gadām|| 33 || āyasīṃ paṃcasāhasratulābhāreṇanirmitām || ādade samare śakraṃ vakṣodeśe jaghāna ca ||34|| tataḥ sa mūrcchitaḥ śakro rathopastha upāviśat || mṛtasaṃjīvinīṃ vidyāṃ japitvātha bṛhaspatiḥ || 35 || pulomajāpatiṃ yuddhe samajīvayadadbhutam || airāvataṃ tadāruhya kapālābharaṇāṃtikam|| 36 || ājagāma śacībhartā prahartuṃ kuliśena tam || ekaprahāreṇa tadā maheṃdraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ || 37 || kapālābharaṇaṃ yuddhe vajreṇa sarathāśvakam || sacāpaṃ sadhvajaṃ caiva satūṇīraṃ savarmakam ||38|| cūrṇayāmāsa kupitastilaśaḥ kaṇaśastathā || hate tasminmahāvīre kapālābharaṇe raṇe||39|| sukhaṃ sarvasya lokasya babhūva ciraduḥkhinaḥ || rākṣasasya vadhotpannā brahmahatyā puraṃdaram || anvadhāvattadā bhīmā nādayaṃtī diśo daśa ||3.1.11.40|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || na vipro rākṣasaḥ sūta kapālābharaṇo mune || tatkathaṃ brahmahatyeṃdraṃ tadvadhātsamupādravat || 41 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || vakṣyāmi paramaṃ guhyaṃ munīṃdrāḥ paramādbhutam ||42|| śṛṇuta śraddhayā yūyaṃ samādhāya svamānasam || purā viṃdhyapradeśeṣu trivakro nāma rākṣasaḥ || 43 || tasya bhāryā guṇopetā sauṃdaryaguṇaśālinī || suśīlā nāma suśroṇī sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 44 || sā kadācinmanojñāṃgī suveṣā cāruhāsinī || viṃdhyapādavanoddeśe vicacāra vilāsinī || 45 || tasminvane śucirnāma vartatesma mahāmuniḥ || tapasamādhisaṃyukto vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || 46 || tasyāśramasamīpaṃ tu sā yayau varavarṇinī || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa munirdhairyaṃ mumocānaṃgapīḍitaḥ|| tāmāsādya varārohāṃ babhāṣe munisattamaḥ || 47|| || śuciruvāca || || lalane svāgataṃ te'stu kasya bhāryā śucismite || 48 || kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te vane'sminnatibhīṣaṇe || śrāṃtāsi tvaṃ varārohe vasāsminnuṭaje mama || 49 || tathoktā sā tu suśroṇī taṃ muniṃ pratyabhāṣata || trivakrarakṣobhāryāhaṃ suśīlā nāmato mune ||3.1.11.5||| puṣpāvacayakāmena vanametatsamāgatā || aputrāhaṃ mune bhartrā preritā putramicchatā || 51 || śuciṃ muniṃ samārādhya tasmātputramavāpnuhi || iti pratisamādiṣṭā patinā tvāṃ samāgatā ||52|| putramutpādaya tvaṃ me kṛpāṃ kuru mune mayi || evamuktaḥ sa tu śuciḥ suśīlāṃ tāmabhāṣata || 53 || || śuciruvāca |||| tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā mama ca prītiḥ suśīle vidyate'dhunā|| manorathamahāṃbhodhiṃ tvamāpūraya māmakam || 54 || ityuktvā sa munistatra tayā reme dinatrayam || tāmuvāca muniḥ prītaḥ suśālāṃ sundarākṛtim || || 55 || tavodare mahāvīryaḥ kapālābharaṇābhidhaḥ || bhaviṣyati ciraṃ rājyaṃ pālayiṣyati medinīm || 56 || sahasraṃ vatsarānvatsastapasā prīṇayanvidhim || puraṃdaraṃ vinānyebhyo devebhyo nāsya vadhyatā||57|| īdṛśaste suto bhūyādiṃdratulyaparākramaḥ || ityuktvā sa munirnārīṃ kāśīṃ śivapurīṃ yayau ||58|| suśīlā sāpi suṣuve kapālābharaṇaṃ sutam || taṃ jaghāna mṛdhe śakro vajreṇa munipuṃgavāḥ ||59|| śucerbījasamudbhūtaṃ tamiṃdro nyavadhīdyataḥ || tataḥ puraṃdaraḥ śakro jagṛhe brahmahatyayā ||3.1.11.60|| dhāvati sma tadā śakraḥ sarvāṃllokānbhayākulaḥ|| dhāvaṃtamanudhāvaṃtī brahmahatyā tamanvagāt||61|| anudruto hi vipreṃdrāḥ śakro'yaṃ brahmahatyayā || pitāmahasadaḥ prāpa saṃtaptahṛdayo bhṛśam ||62|| nyavedayadbrahmahatyāṃ brahmaṇe sa puraṃdaraḥ || bhagavam̐llokanātheyaṃ brahmahatyāti bhīṣaṇā||63|| bādhate māṃ prajānātha tasyā nāśaṃ bravīhi me || puraṃdareṇaivamukto brahmā prāha divaspatim||64|| brahmovāca || sītākuṇḍaṃ prayāhīṃdra gaṃdhamādanaparvate|| sītākuṇḍasya tīre tvaṃ iṣṭvā yāgaiḥ sadāśivam|| 65 || tasminsarasi ca snāyāḥ sarvapāpahare śubhe || tataḥ pūto bhaveśśakra bahmahatyāvimocitaḥ||66|| devalokaṃ punaryāyāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sītākuṇḍaṃ vimuktidam ||67|| mahāpātakasaṃghānāṃ nāśakaṃ paramāmṛtam || sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvadāridryanāśanam || 69 || dhanadhānyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhādipadapradam|| tasmāttatra kuruṣveṣṭiṃ sītāsarasi vṛtrahan || 69 || ityuktaḥ surarājo'sau prayayau gaṃdhamādanam || prāpya sītāsaro viprāḥ snātveṣṭvā ca tadaṃtike || 3.1.11.70 || prayayau svapurīṃ bhūyo brahmahatyāvimocitaḥ || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ sītāyāḥ kuṇḍamuttamam || 71 || rāghavapratyayārthaṃ hi praviśya hutavāhanam || saṃnidhau sarvadevānāṃ maithilī janakātmajā || 72 || vinirgatā punarvahneḥ sthitā sarvāṃgaśobhanā || nirmame lokarakṣārthaṃ svanāmnā tīrthamuttamam || 73 || tatra sasnau svayaṃ sītā tena sītāsaraḥ smṛtam || tatra yo mānavaḥ snāti sarvānkāmām̐llabheta saḥ || 74 || tasminnupaspṛśya naro dvijeṃdrā dattvā ca dānāni pṛthagvidhāni || kṛtvā ca yajñānbahudakṣiṇābhirlokaṃ prayāyātparameśvarasya || 75 || yuṣmākamevaṃ prathitaṃ munīṃdrāḥ sītāsaro vaibhavametaduktam || śṛṇvanpaṭhanvai tadihaiva bhogānbhuktvā paratrāpi sukhaṃ labheta || 76|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyebrahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye sītāsaraḥpraśaṃsāyāmiṃdrabrahmahatyāvimokṣaṇanāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<3.1.12>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || sītākuṇḍe mahāpuṇye naraḥ snātvā dvijottamāḥ || tatastu maṃgalaṃ tīrthamabhigacchetsamāhitaḥ || 1 || sannidhatte sadā yatra kamalā viṣṇuvallabhā || alakṣmīparihārāya yasminsarasi vai surāḥ || 2 || śatakratumukhāḥ sarve samāgacchaṃti nityaśaḥ || tadetattīrthamuddiśya ṛṣayo lokapāvanam || 3 || itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam || purā manojavo nāma rājā somakulodbhavaḥ || 4 || pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa dharāṃ sāgaramekhalām || ayaṣṭa sa surānyajñai rbrāhmaṇānannasaṃcayaiḥ || 5 || tarpayāmāsa kavyena pratyabdaṃ pitṛdevatāḥ || trayīmadhyaiṣṭa satatamapāṭhīcchāstramarthavat | 6 || vyajeṣṭa śatrūnvīryeṇa prāṇaṃ sīdīśakeśavau || araṃsta nītiśāstreṣu tathāpāṭhīnmahāmanūn ||7|| evaṃ sa dharmato rājā pālayāmāsa medinīm || rakṣatastasya rājño'bhūdrājyaṃ nihata kaṃṭakam || 8 || ahaṃkāro'bhavattasya putrasaṃpadvināśanaḥ || ahaṃkāro bhavedyatra tatra lobho madastathā ||9|| kāmaḥ krodhaśca hiṃsā ca tathā'sūyā vimohinī || bhavaṃtyetāni vipreṃdrāḥ saṃpadāṃ nāśahetavaḥ || 3.1.12.10 || etāni yatra vidyaṃte puruṣe sa vinaśyati || kṣaṇena putrapautraiśca sārddhaṃ cākhilasaṃpadā || || 11 || babhūva tasyāsūyā ca janavidveṣiṇī sadā || asūyākulacittasya vṛthāhaṃkāriṇastathā || 12 || lubdhasya kāmaduṣṭasya matirevaṃ babhūva ha || vipragrāme karādānaṃ kariṣyāmīti niścitaḥ || 13 || akarocca tathā rājā niścitya manasā tadā || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ jahāra kila lobhataḥ || || 14 || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ vittānyādatta rāgataḥ || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ viprāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām || 15 || kṣetrāṇyapajahārāyamahaṃkāra vimūḍhadhīḥ || evamanyāyayuktasya devadvijavirodhinaḥ || 16 || duṣkarmaparipākena krūreṇa dvijapuṃgavāḥ || puraṃ rurodha balavānparadeśādhipo ripuḥ || 17 || golabhonāma vipreṃdrāścaturaṃgabalairyutaḥ || ṣaṇmāsaṃ yuddhamabhavadgolabhena durātmanaḥ || 19 || manojavasya nṛpaterahaṃkāraratātmanaḥ || tataḥ sa golabhenājau jito rājyātparicyutaḥ || 19 || vanaṃ saputradāraḥ sanprapede sa manojavaḥ || golabhaḥ pālayannāste manojavapure ciram ||3.1.12.20|| caturaṃgabalopetastamudvāsya raṇe balī || manojavopi vipreṃdrāḥ śocanstrīputrasaṃyutaḥ || 21 || kṣutkṣāmaḥ praskhalañchaśvatpraviveśa mahāvanam || jhillikāgaṇasaṃghuṣṭaṃ vyāghraśvāpada bhīṣaṇam || 22 || vyāptadviradacītkāraṃ varāhamahiṣākulam || tasminvane mahāghore kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ || 23 || ayācatānnaṃ pitaraṃ manojavasutaḥ śiśuḥ || aṃba mennaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ kṣudhā māṃ bādhate bhṛśam ||24 || evaṃ svajananīṃ cāpi prārthayāmāsa bālakaḥ || tanmātāpitarau tatra śrutvā putrasya bhāṣitam || 25 || śokābhibhūtau sahasā mohaṃ samupajagmatuḥ || bhāryāmathābravīdrājā sumitrānāma nāmataḥ || 26 || muhyamānaśca sa muhuḥ śuṣkakaṃṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ || sumitre kiṃ kariṣyāmi kutra yāsyāmi kā gatiḥ || 27 || mariṣyatyacirādeṣa suto me kṣudhayārditaḥ || kimarthaṃ sasṛje vedhā durbhāgyaṃ māṃ vṛthā priye || 28 || ko vā mocayitā duḥkhametadduṣkarmajaṃ mama || na pūjito mayā śaṃbhurharirvā pūrvajanmasu || 29 || tathānyā devatāḥ sūryavibhāvasumukhāḥ priye || tena pāpena cādyāhamasmiñjanmani śobhane || 3.1.12.30 || ahaṃkārābhibhūto'smi viprakṣetrāṇyapāharam || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ vittaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ mayā || 31 || evaṃ duṣkarmabāhulyādgolabhena parājitaḥ || vanaṃ yātosmi vijanaṃ tvayā saha sutena ca || 32 || niranno nirdhano duḥkhī kṣudhito 'haṃ pipāsitaḥ || kathamannaṃ pradāsyāmi kṣudhitāya sutāya me || 33 || na mayānnāni dattāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śucismite || na mayā pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇurvā devatāṃtaram || 34 || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam || na mayāgnau hutaṃ pūrvaṃ na tīrthamapi sevitam || 35 || mātṛśrāddhaṃ pitṛśrāddhaṃ mṛtāha divase tayoḥ|| naikoddiṣṭavidhānena pārvaṇenāpi vai priye ||36|| kṛtaṃ na hi mayā bhadre bhūribhojanameva vā || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam || || 37 || caitramāse priye citrānakṣatre pānakaṃ mayā || panasānāṃ phalaṃ svādu kadalīphalameva vā || 38 || tathā chatraṃ sadaṃḍaṃ ca ramyaṃ pādukayordvayam || tāṃbūlāni ca puṣpāṇi caṃdanaṃ cānulepanam || 39 || na dattaṃ vedavidbhyastu citraguptasya tuṣṭaye || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam || 3.1.12.40 || nāśvatthaścūtavṛkṣo vā nyagrodhastiṃtiṇī tathā || picumaṃdaḥ kapittho vā tathaivāmalakītaruḥ || 41 || nārikelatarurvāpi sthāpito'dhvagaśāṃtaye || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam|| 42 || sammārjanaṃ ca na kṛtaṃ śivaviṣṇvālaye mayā || na khānitaṃ taṭākaṃ ca na kūpopi hrado'pivā || || 43 || na ropitaṃ puṣpavanaṃ tathaiva tulasīvanam || śivaviṣṇvālayau vāpi nirmito na mayā priye || 44 || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam || na mayā paitṛke māsi pitṝnuddiśya śobhane || mahālayaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhamaṣṭakāśrāddhameva vā || 45 || nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā kāmyaṃ śrāddhaṃ naimittikaṃ priye || na kṛtāḥ kratavaścāpi vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇāḥ || 46 || māsopavāso na kṛtaḥ ekādaśyāmupoṣaṇam || dhanurmāsepyuṣaḥkāle śaṃbhuviṣṇvādidevatāḥ || 47 || saṃpūjya vidhivadbhadre naivedyaṃ na kṛtaṃ mayā || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamā gatam || 48|| hariśaṃkarayornāmnāṃ kīrtanaṃ na mayā kṛtam || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca jābāloktaiśca saptabhiḥ || 49 || na dhṛtaṃ bhasmanā bhadre rudrākṣaṃ na dhṛtaṃ mayā || japaśca rudrasūktānāṃ paṃcākṣarajapastathā || 3.1.12.50 || tathā puruṣasūktasya japo'pyaṣṭākṣarasya ca || naivakāri mayā bhadre naivānyo dharmasaṃcayaḥ || 51 || tena pāpena me tvadya duḥkhametatsamāgatam || evaṃ sa vilapanrājā bhāryāmābhāṣya khinnadhīḥ || 52 || mūrcchāmupāyayau viprāḥ papāta ca dharātale || sumitrā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāryā sā patimaṃganā || 53 || āliṃgya vilalāpātha saputrā bhṛśaduḥkhitā || mama nātha mahārāja somānvayadhuraṃdhara || 54 || māṃ vihāya kva yāto'si saputrāṃ vijane vane || anāthāṃ tvāmanugatāṃ siṃhatrastāṃ mṛgīmiva || 55 || mṛto'si yadi rājeṃdra tarhi tvāmahamapyaram || anuvrajāmi vidhavā na sthāsye kṣaṇamapyuta|| 56 || pitaraṃ paśya patitaṃ candrakāṃta suta kṣitau || ityuktaścaṃdrakāṃto'pi suto rājñaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ || 57 || pitaraṃ parirabhyātha niḥśabdaṃ praruroda saḥ || etasminnaṃtare viprā jaṭāvalkalasaṃvṛtaḥ || 58 || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgastripuṇḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ || rudrākṣamālābharaṇaḥ sitayajñopavītavān || 59 || parāśaronāma munirājagāma yadṛcchayā || taṃ śabdamabhilakṣyāsau sādhusajjanasaṃmataḥ || 3.1.12.60 || tataḥ sumitrā taṃ dṛṣṭvā parāśaramupāgatam || vavaṃde caraṇau tasya saputrā sā pativratā || 61 || tataḥ parāśareṇeyaṃ sumitrā parisāṃtvitā || āśvāsitā ca muninā mā śocasveti bhāmini || tataḥ sumitrāṃ papraccha śaktiputro mahāmuniḥ || 62 || || parāśara uvāca || kā tvaṃ suśroṇi kaścāsau yaścāyaṃ patito'grataḥ || 63 || ayaṃ śiśuśca kaste syādvada tattvena me śubhe || pṛṣṭaivaṃ muninā sādhvī tamuvāca mahāmunim || 64 || || sumitrovāca || || patirmamāyamasyāhaṃ bhāryā vai munisattama || āvābhyāṃ janitaścāyaṃ caṃdrakāṃtābhidhaḥ sutaḥ || 65 || ayaṃ manojavo nāma rājā somakulodbhavaḥ || vikramāḍhyasya tanayaḥ śaurye viṣṇusamo balī || 66 || sumitrā nāma tasyāhaṃ bhāryā patimanuvratā || yuddhe vinirjito rājā golabhena manojavaḥ || 67 || rājyādbhraṣṭo nirālaṃbo mayā putreṇa cānvitaḥ || vanaṃ viveśa brahmarṣe krūrasattvabhayānakam ||68|| kṣudhayā pīḍitaḥ putro hyāvāmannamayācata || niranno vidhuro rājā dṛṣṭvā putraṃ kṣudhārditam || 69 || śokākulamanā brahmanmūrcchitaḥ patito bhuvi || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śokaparyākulākṣaram || 3.1.12.70 || śaktiputro muniḥ prāha sumitrāṃ tāṃ pativratām || manojavasya nṛpaterbhāryāmagniśikhopamām || || 71 || || parāśara uvāca || || manojavasya bhārye te mā bhīrbhūyātkathaṃcana || yuṣmākamaśubhaṃ satyamacirānnāśameṣyati || 72 || mūrcchāṃ vihāya te bhadre kṣaṇādutthāsyate patiḥ || tataḥ parāśaro vipraḥ pāṇinā taṃ narādhipam || 73 || pasparśa maṃtraṃ prajapandhyātvā devaṃ triyaṃbakam || tato manojavo rājā karaspṛṣṭo mahāmuneḥ || 74 || utthitaḥ sahasā tatra tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ tamomayīm || tataḥ parāśaramuniṃ praṇamya jagatīpatiḥ || uvāca paramaprītaḥ prāṃjalirviprasattamam || 75 || || manojava uvāca || || parāśaramune tvadya tvatpādābjaniṣevaṇāt || 76 || mūrcchā me vigatā sadyaḥ pātakaṃ caiva nāśitam || tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ naiva sidhyetkadācana || 77 || rakṣa māṃ karuṇādṛṣṭyā cyāvitaṃ śatrubhiḥ purāt || ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ prāha rājānaṃ taṃ manojavam || 78 || || parāśara uvāca || || upāyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi rājañcchatrujayāya vai || rāmasetau mahāpuṇye gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 79 || | vidyate maṃgalaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam || sarvalokopakārāya tasminsarasi rāghavaḥ || 3.1.12.80 || sannidhatte sadā lakṣmyā sītayā rājasattama || saputrabhāryastvaṃ tatra gatvā snātvā sabhaktikam || 81 || kṣetraśrāddhādikaṃ cāpi tattīre kuru bhūpate || evaṃ kṛte tvayā rājannalakṣmīḥ kleśakāriṇī || 92 || vaibhavāttasya tīrthasya nāśaṃ yāsyatyasaṃśayam || maṃgalāni ca sarvāṇi prāpsyase na cirānnṛpa || 83 || vijitya śatrūṃśca raṇe punarbhūmiṃ prapatsyase || atastvaṃ bhāryayā sārddhaṃ putreṇa ca manojava || 84 || gaccha maṃgalatīrthaṃ tadgandhamādanaparvate || ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi tavānugrahakāmyayā || 85 || parāśarastvevamuktvā rājamukhyaistribhiḥ saha || prāyātsetuṃ samuddiśya snātuṃ maṃgalatīrthake || 86 || rājādibhiḥ saha munirvilaṃghya vividhaṃ vanam || vanapradeśadeśāṃśca dasyugrāmānanekaśaḥ || 87 || prayayau maṃgalaṃ tīrthaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || tatra saṃkalpya vidhivatsasnau sa munipuṃgavaḥ || 88 || tānapi snāpayāmāsa rājādīnvidhipūrvakam || tatra śrāddhaṃ ca bhūpālaścakāra pitṛtṛptaye || 89 || tatra māsatrayaṃ sasnau rājā patnīsutastathā || tataḥ parāśaramuniḥ sasnau niyamapūrvakam ||| || 3.1.12.90 || evaṃ māsatrayaṃ sasnau taiḥ sākaṃ munipuṃgavaḥ || maṃgalākhye mahāpuṇye sarvāmaṃgalanāśane || 91 || tataḥ parāśaramuniḥ sarvānarthavināśanam || rāmasyaikākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ tadaṃte samupādiśat || 92 || catvāriṃśaddinaṃ tatra maṃtramekākṣaraṃ nṛpaḥ || tatra tīrthe jajāpāsau munyuktenaiva vartmanā || 93 || evamabhyasatastasya maṃtramekākṣaraṃ dvijāḥ || muniprasādātpurato dhanuḥ prādurabhūddṛḍham || 94 || akṣayāviṣudhī cāpi khaḍgau ca kanakatsarū || ekaṃ carma gadā caikā tathaiko musalottamaḥ || 95 || ekaḥ śaṃkho mahānādo vājiyukto rathastathā || sasārathiḥ patākā ca tīrthāduttasthuragrataḥ || 96 || | kavacaṃ kāṃcanamayaṃ vaiśvānarasamaprabham || prādurbabhūva tattīrthātprasādena munestathā || 97 || hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakādivibhūṣaṇam|| tīrthānāṃ pravarāttasmādutthitaṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ || 98 || divyāṃbarasahasraṃ ca tīrthātprādurabhūttadā || mālā ca vaijayaṃtyākhyā svarṇapaṃkajaśobhitā || 99 || etatsarvaṃ samālokya munaye'sau nyavedayat || tataḥ parāśaramunirjalamādāya tīrthataḥ || 3.1.12.100 || abhyaṣiṃcannarapatiṃ maṃtrapūtenavāriṇā || tato'bhiṣikto nṛpatirmuninā pariśobhitaḥ || 101 || sannaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī cāpabāṇadharo yuvā || hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakādivibhūṣitaḥ || 102 || divyāṃbaradharaścāpi vājiyukta rathasthitaḥ || śuśubhe'tīva nṛpatirmadhyāhna iva bhāskaraḥ || 103 || tasmai nṛpataye tatra brahmādyastraṃ mahāmuniḥ || sāṃgaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca sotsargaṃ sopa saṃhṛti || 104 || upādiśacchaktiputraḥ sumitrājānaye tadā || manojavo'tha muninā hyāśīrvādapuraḥsaram || 105 || prerito rathamāsthāya praṇamya munipuṃgavam || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadābhyanujñāto maharṣiṇā || 106 || sārddhaṃ patnyā ca putreṇa prayayau vijayāya saḥ || sa gatvā svapuraṃ rājā pradadhmau jalajaṃ tadā || 107 || tataḥ śaṃkharavaṃ śrutvā golabhastu sasainikaḥ || yuddhāya niryayau tūrṇaṃ manojavanṛpeṇa saḥ || 108 || dinatrayaṃ raṇaṃ jajñe golabhena nṛpasya vai || tataścaturthe divase golabhaṃ tu sasainikam || 109 || manojavo nṛpo yuddhe brahmāstreṇa vyanāśayat || tataḥ saputra bhāryo'yaṃ puraṃ prāpya nijaṃ nṛpaḥ || 3.1.12.110 || pālayanpṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ bubhuje bhāryayā saha || tadāprabhṛti rājāsau nāhaṃkāraṃ cakāra vai || 111 || asūyādīṃstathā doṣānvarjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || ahiṃsānirato dāṃtaḥ sadā dharmaparo'bhavat || 112 || sahasraṃ vatsarānevaṃ rarakṣa sa mahīpatiḥ || tato virakto rājendraḥ putre rājyaṃ nidhāya tu || 113 || jagāma maṃgalaṃ tīrthaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || tapaścacāra tatrāsau dhyāyanhṛdi sadāśivam || 114 ||| tato'cireṇa kālena tyaktvā dehaṃ manojavaḥ || śivalokaṃ yayau rājā tasya tīrthasya vaibhavāt || 115 || tasya bhāryā sumitrāpi tasyāliṃgya tanuṃ tadā || anvārūḍhā citāṃ viprāḥ prāpa tallokameva sā || 116 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ śrīmanmaṃgalanāmakam || manojavo nṛpo yatra snātvā tīrthe mahattare || 117 || śatrūnvijitya dehāṃte śivalokaṃ yayau striyā || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sevyaṃ maṃgalatīrthakam || 118|| tīrthametadatiśobhanaṃ śivaṃ bhuktimuktiphaladaṃ nṛṇāṃ sadā || pāparāśitṛṇatūlapāvakaṃ sevata dvijavarā vimuktaye || 119 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye maṃgalatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ manojavālakṣmīvināśavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<3.1.13>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || maṃgalākhye mahātīrthe naraḥ snātvā vikalmaṣaḥ || ekāṃtarāmanāthākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ gacchettataḥ param || 1 || tatra rāmo jagannātho jānakyā lakṣmaṇena ca || hanumatpramukhaiścāpi vānaraiḥ parivāritaḥ || 2 || sannidhatte sadā viprā lokānugrahakāmyayā || vidyate puṇyadā tatra nāmnā hyamṛtavāpikā || 3 || tasyāṃ nimajjatāṃ nṛṇāṃ na jarāṃtakajaṃ bhayam || asyāmamṛtavāpyāṃ yaḥ saśraddhaṃ snāti mānavaḥ || 4 || amṛtatvaṃ bhajatyeṣa śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ || mahāpātakanāśinyāmasyāṃ vāpyāṃ nimajjatām || 5 || amṛtatvaṃ haro dātuṃ sannidhatte sadā taṭe || || | ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || iyaṃ hyamṛtavāpīti kuto hetornigadyate || 6 || asmākametadbrūhi tvaṃ kṛpayā vyāsaśāsita || tathaivāmṛtanāminyā vāpikāyāśca vaibhavam || tṛptirna jāyate'smākaṃ tvadvaco'mṛtapāyinām || |7 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || asyā amṛtanāmatvaṃ vaibhavaṃ ca manoharam || 8 || pravakṣyāmi viśeṣeṇa śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ || purā himavataḥ pārśve nānāmunisamākule || 9 || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvadevakinnarasevite || siṃhavyāghravarāhebhamahiṣādisamākule || 3.1.13.10 || tamālatālahiṃtālacaṃpakāśokasaṃtate || haṃsakokiladātyūhacakravākādiśobhite || 11 || padmeṃdīvarakahlārakumudāḍhyasaro vṛte || satyavāñchīlavānvāgmī vaśī kuṃbhajasodaraḥ || 12 || āste tapaścarannityaṃ mokṣārthī śaṃkarapriyaḥ || trikālamarcayañchaṃbhu vanyairmūlaphalādibhiḥ ||| 13 || āgatānsvāśramābhyāśamatithīnvanyabhojanaiḥ || pūjayannarcayannagniṃ saṃdhyopāsanatatparaḥ || 14 || gāyatryādīnmahāmaṃtrānkālekāle japanmudā || nidrāṃ parityajanbrāhme muhūrte viṣṇuciṃtakaḥ || 15 || snānaṃ kurvannuṣaḥkāle namansaṃdhyāṃ prasannadhīḥ || gāyatrīṃ prajapanviprāḥ pūjayanhariśaṃkarau || 16 || vedādhyāyī śāstrapāṭhī madhyāhne'tithipūjakaḥ || śrotāpurāṇapāṭhānāmagnikāryeṣvataṃdritaḥ || 17 || paṃcayajñaparo nityaṃ vaiśvadevabalipradaḥ || pratyabdaṃ śrāddhakṛtpitrostathānyaśrāddhakṛddvijāḥ || 18 || evaṃ nināya kālaṃ sa nityānuṣṭhānatatparaḥ || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya tapaścarata uttamam || 19 || sahasravarṣāṇyagamañcchaṃkarāsaktacetasaḥ || tathāpi śaṃkaro nāsyāyayau pratyakṣatāṃ tadā || 3.1.13.20 || tatastvagastyabhrātāsau grīṣme paṃcānimadhyagaḥ || bhāskaraṃ dattadṛṣṭiśca maunavratasamanvitaḥ || 21 || tiṣṭhankaniṣṭhikāṃgulyāṃ vāmapādasya niścalaḥ || ūrdhvabāhurnirālaṃbastapastepe'tidāruṇam || 22 || atha tasya prasannātmā mahādevo ghṛṇānidhiḥ || prādurāsītsvayā dīptyā diśo daśa vibhāsayan || 23 || tato'drākṣīnmuniḥ śaṃbhuṃ sāṃbaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃsthi tam || dṛṣṭvā praṇamya tuṣṭāva bhavānīpatimīśvaram || 24 || || muniruvāca || || namaste pārvatīnātha nīlakaṃṭha maheśvara|| śiva rudra mahādeva nama ste śaṃbhave vibho || 25 || śrīkaṃṭhomāpate śūlinbhaganetraharāvyaya || gaṃgādhara virūpākṣa namaste rudra manyave || 26 || aṃtakāre kāmaśatro devadeva jagatpate || svāminpaśupate śarva namaste śatadhanvane || dakṣayakṣavināśāya snāyūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || nicerave namastubhyaṃ puṣṭānāṃ pataye namaḥ || || 28 || bhūyobhūyo namastubhyaṃ mahādeva kṛpālaya || dustarādbhavasiṃdhormāṃ tārayasva trilocana || 29 || agastyasodareṇaivaṃ stutaḥ śaṃbhurabhāṣata ||| prīṇayanvacasā svena kuṃbhajasyānujaṃ munim || 3.1.13.30 || || īśvara uvāca || || kuṃbhajānuja vakṣyāmi muktyupāyaṃ tavānagha || setumadhye mahātīrthaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 31 || maṃgalākhyasya tīrthasya nātidūreṇa vartate || tatra gatvā kuru snānaṃ tato muktimavāpsyasi ||32|| tattīrthasevanānnānyomokṣo pāyo laghustava || na hi tattīrthavaiśiṣṭyaṃ vaktuṃ śakyaṃ mayāpi ca || 33 || saṃdeho nātra kartavyastvayādya munisattama|| tasmāttatraiva gaccha tvaṃ yadīcchasi bhavakṣayam || 34 || ityuktvā bhagavānīśastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || tato devasya vacanādagastyasya sahodaraḥ || 35 || gatvā setuṃ samudre tu gaṃdhamādanaparvate|| īśvaraṇaiva gaditaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchīghramāsadat || 36 || tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇye snātānāṃ muktidāyini || ekāṃtarāmanāthākhye kṣetrālaṃkaraṇe śubhe || 37 || sasnau niyamapūrvaṃ sa trīṇi varṣāṇi vai dvijaḥ || tataścaturthavarṣe tu samādhistho mahāmuniḥ || 38 || brahmanāḍyā prāṇavāyuṃ mūrddhanyāropyayogataḥ || prāṇānnirgamayāmāsa brahmaraṃdhreṇa tatra saḥ || 39 || tato'gastyānujaḥ soyaṃ parityajya kalevaram || avāpa muktiṃ paramāṃ tasya tīrthasya vaibhavāt ||3.1.13.4||| vinaṣṭāśeṣaduḥkhasya tattīrthasnānavaibhavāt || mṛtatvamabhūdyasmādagastyānujajanmanaḥ||41|| tato hyamṛtavāpītiprathā'syāsīnmunīśvarāḥ|| atra tīrthe narā ye tu varṣatrayamataṃdritāḥ||42|| snānaṃ kurvaṃti te satyamamṛtatvaṃ prayāṃti hi || evaṃ tvamṛtavāpīti prathā tadvaibhavaṃ tathā || yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kiṃbhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha || 43 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || ekāṃtarāmanāthākhyā tasya kṣetrasya vai mune || 44 || kathaṃ samāgatā sūta vaktumetattvamarhasi || asmākaṃ muniśārdūla tacchuśrūṣātibhūyasī || 45 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || purā dāśarathī rāmaḥ sasugrīvabhibhīṣaṇaḥ || lakṣmaṇena yuto bhrātrā maṃtrajñena hanūmatā || 46 || vānarairbadhyamāne tu setāvaṃbudhimadhyataḥ || ciṃtayanmanasā sītāmekāṃte samamaṃtrayat || 47 || teṣu maṃtra yamāṇeṣu rāvaṇādivadhaṃ prati || ullolatarakallolo jughoṣa jaladhirbhṛśam || 48 || arṇavasya mahābhīme jṛṃbhamāṇe mahādhvanau || anyonyakathitāṃ vārtāṃ nāśṛṇvaṃste parasparam || 49 || tataḥ kiṃcidiva kruddho bhṛkuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇaḥ || bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā rāmo niyamya jaladhiṃ tadā || || 3.1.13.50 || nyamaṃtrayata vipreṃdrā rākṣasānāṃ vadhaṃ prati || ekāṃte'maṃtrayattatra taiḥ sārdhaṃ rāghavo yataḥ || 51 || ekāṃtarāmanāthākhyaṃ tatkṣetramabhavadvijāḥ || soyaṃ niyamito vārdhī rāmabhrūbhaṃgalīlayā || 52 || adyāpi niścalajalastatpradeśeṣu dṛśyate || ekāṃtarāmanāthākhyaṃ tadetatkṣetramuttamam || 53 || āgatyāmṛtavāpyāṃ ca snātvā niyamapūrvakam || rāmādīnapi sevaṃte te sarve muktimāpnuyuḥ || 54 || advaitavijñānavivekaśūnyā viraktihīnāśca samādhi hīnāḥ || yāgādyanuṣṭhānavivarjitāśca snātvātra yāsyaṃtyamṛtaṃ dvijeṃdrāḥ || 55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye amṛtavāpīpraśaṃsāyām agastyabhrātṛvimuktivarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<3.1.14>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || snātvā tvamṛta vāpyāṃ vai sevitvaikāṃtarāghavam || jiteṃdriyo naraḥ snātuṃ brahmakuṃḍaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || setumadhye mahātīrthaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || brahmakuḍamiti khyātaṃ sarva dāridryabheṣajam || 2 || vidyate brahmahatyānāmayutāyutanāśanam || darśanaṃ brahmakuṃḍasya sarvapāpaughanāśanam || 3 || kiṃ tasya bahubhistīrthaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || mahādānaiśca kiṃ tasya brahmakuṃḍavilokinaḥ || 4 || brahmakuṃḍe sakṛtsnānaṃ vaikuṃṭhaprāptikāraṇam || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtaṃ bhasma yena dhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ|| || 5 || tasyānugāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtabhasmanā yastripuṃḍrakam || 6 || karoti tasya kaivalyaṃ karasthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || tadbhasmaparamāṇurvā yo lalāṭe dhṛto bhavet || 7 || tāvadevāsya muktiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || tatkuṃḍabhasmanā martyaḥ kuryāduddhūlanaṃ tu yaḥ || 8 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ śaṃkaro vetti vā na vā || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtaṃ bhasma yo naiva dhārayet || 9 || raurave narake so'yaṃ patedācaṃdratārakam || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ vā brahmakuṃḍasthabhasmanā || 3.1.14.10 || narādhamo na kuryādyaḥ sukhaṃ nāsya kadācana || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtabhasmaniṃdāratastu yaḥ || 11 || utpattau tasya sāṃkaryamanumeyaṃ vipaścitā || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtaṃ bhasmaitallokapāvanam || 12 || anyabhasmasamaṃ yastu nyūnaṃ vā vakti mānavaḥ || utpattau tasya sāṃkarya manumeyaṃ vipaścitā || 13 || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūte'pyasminbhasmani jāgrati || bhasmāṃtareṇa manujo dhārayedyastripuṃḍrakam || 14 || utpattau tasya sāṃka ryamanumeyaṃ vipaścitā || kadācidapi yo martyo bhasmaitattu na dhārayet || 15 || utpattau tasya sāṃkaryamanumeyaṃ vipaścitā || brahmakuṃḍasamudbhūtaṃ bhasma dadyāddvijāya yaḥ || 16 || caturarṇavaparyaṃtā tena dattā vasundharā || saṃdeho nātra kartavyastrirvā śapathayāmyaham || 17 || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate || brahmakuṃḍodbhavaṃ bhasma dhārayadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 18 || etaddhi pāvanaṃ bhasma brahmayajñasamudbhavam || purā hi bhagavānbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || 19 || sannidhau sarvadevānāṃ parvate gaṃdhamādane || īśaśāpanivṛttyarthaṃ kratūnsarvānsamātanot || 3.1.14.20 || vidhāya vidhivatsarvānadhvarānbahudakṣiṇān || mumuce sahasā brahmā śaṃbhuśāpāddvijottamāḥ || 21 || tadetattīrthamāsādya snānaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || te mahādevasāyujyaṃ prāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vyāsaśiṣya mahāprājña purāṇārthaviśārada || caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ caturānanam || 23 || śaṃbhuḥ kenāparādhena śaptavānbhāratīpatim || śāpaśca kīdṛśastasya purā datto hareṇa vai || etatsarvaṃ mune brūhi tattvato'smākamādarāt || 24 || || śrīsūta uvāca || purā babhūva kalaho brahmaviṣṇvoḥ parasparam|| 25 || kaṃciddhetuṃ samuddiśya spardhayā ślāghamānayoḥ || ahaṃ karttā na matto'nyaḥ karttāsti jagatītale || || 26 || evamāha hariṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ ca haristathā || evaṃ vivādaḥ sumahānprāvarttata purā tayoḥ || 27 || etasminnaṃtare viprāḥ kurvatoḥ kalahaṃ mithaḥ || tayorgarvavināśāya prabodhārthaṃ ca devayoḥ || 28 || madhye prādurabhūlliṃgaṃ svayaṃjyotiranāmayam || tau dṛṣṭvā vismitau liṃgaṃ brahmaviṣṇu parasparam || 29 || samayaṃ cakraturviprā devānāṃ sannidhau purā || anādyaṃtaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ yadetaddṛśyate puraḥ || 3.1.14.30 || anaṃtādityasaṃkā śamanaṃtāgnisamaprabham || āvayorasya liṃgasya yoṃ'tamādiṃ ca drakṣyati || 31 || sa bhavedadhiko loke lokakartā ca sa prabhuḥ || ahamūrdhvaṃ gamiṣyāmi liṃgasyātaṃ gaveṣayan || 32 || gaveṣaṇāya mūlasya tvamadhastāddhare vraja || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathe tyāha ramāpatiḥ || 33 || evaṃ tau samayaṃ kṛtvā mārgaṇāya vinirgatau || viṣṇurvarāharūpeṇa gato'dhastādgaveṣitum || 34 || haṃsatāṃ bhāratījāniḥ svīkṛtyopari niryayau || adho lokānvicityātho viṣṇurvarṣagaṇānbahūn || yathāsthānaṃ samāgatya vabhāṣe devasannidhau || 35 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || ahaṃ liṃgasya nādrākṣamādimasyeti satyavāk|| 36 || ūrdhvaṃ gaveṣayitvātha brahmāpyāgacchadatra saḥ || āgatya ca vacaḥ prāha chadmanā caturānanaḥ || || 37 || || brahmovāca || || ahamadrākṣamasyāṃtaṃ liṃgasyeti mṛṣā punaḥ || tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā vrahmaviṣṇvormaheśvaraḥ || mithyāvādinamāhedaṃ prahasya caturānanam || 38 || || īśvara uvāca || || asatyaṃ yadavocastvaṃ caturānana matpuraḥ || 39 || tasmātpūjā na te bhūyālloke sarvatra sarvadā || atha viṣṇuṃ punaḥ prāha bhagavānparameśvaraḥ || 3.1.14.40 || yasmātsatyamavocastvaṃ kamalāyāḥ pate hare || tasmātte matsamā pūjā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || tato brahmā viṣaṇṇaḥ sañchaṃkaraṃ pratyabhāṣata || svāminmamāparādhaṃ tvaṃ kṣamasva karuṇānidhe || 42 || ekoparādhaḥ kṣaṃtavyaḥ svāmi bhirjagadīśvaraiḥ || tato maheśvaro'vādīdbrahmāṇaṃ parisāṃtvayan || 43 || || īśvara uvāca || || na mithyāvacanaṃ me syādbrahmanvakṣyāmi te śṛṇu || gaccha tvaṃ sahasā vatsa gandhamādanaparvatam ||44|| tatra kratūnkuruṣva tvaṃ mithyādoṣapraśāṃtaye || tato vidhūtapāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || ||45|| tena śrauteṣu te brahmansmārteṣvapi ca karmasu || pūjā bhaviṣyati sadā na pūjā pratimāsu te||46|| ityuktvā bhagavānīśastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || tato brahmā yayau viprā gaṃdhamādanaparvatam || 47 || īje ca kratukartāraṃ kratubhiḥ pārvatīpatim || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi munipuṃgavāḥ || 48 || pauṃḍarīkādibhiḥ sarvairadhvarairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || indrādisarvadevānāṃ sannidhāvayajacchivam || tena tuṣṭobhavacchaṃbhurvaramasmai pradattavān || 49 || || īśvara uvāca || || mithyoktidoṣaste naṣṭaḥ kṛtairetairmakhairiha || 3.1.14.50 || caturānana te pūjā śrautasmārteṣu karmasu || bhaviṣyatyamalā brahmanna pūjā pratimāsu te || 51 || yāgasthalamidaṃ te'dya brahmakuṇḍamiti prathām || gamiṣyati trilokesminpuṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam || 52 || brahmakuṇḍābhidhe tīrthe sakṛdyaḥ snānamā caret || muktidvārārgalaṃ tasya bhidyate tatkṣaṇādvidhe || 53 || brahmakuṇḍasamudbhūtaṃ lalāṭe bhasma dhārayan || māyākapāṭaṃ nirbhidya muktidvāraṃ prayā syati || 54 || brahmakuṇḍotthitaṃ bhasma lalāṭe yo na dhārayet || svapiturbījasaṃbhūto na mātari sutastu saḥ ||55|| brahmakuṇḍasamudbhūtabhasmadhāraṇato vidhe || brahmahatyāyutaṃ naśyetsurāpānāyutaṃ tathā || 56 || gurutalpāyutaṃ naśyetsvarṇasteyāyutaṃ tathā || tatsaṃsargāyutaṃ naśyetsatyamuktaṃ mayā vidhe || || 57 || brahmakuṇḍasamudbhūtabhasmadhāraṇavaibhavāt || bhūtapretapiśācādyā naśyaṃti kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 58 || ityuktvā bhagavānīśastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || yajñeṣvatha samāpteṣu munayaśca jiteṃdriyāḥ || 59 || indrādidevatāścaiva siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ || anye ca devanivahā gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 3.1.14.60 || tāṃ yajñabhūmimāśritya svayaṃ rudreṇa sevitām || niraṃtaramavartaṃta viditvā tasya vaibhavam || 61 || yathāvidhi tato yajñānsamāpya bahudakṣiṇān || satyalokamagādbrahmā śivāllabdhamanorathaḥ || 62 || tadāprabhṛti devāśca munayaśca dvijottamāḥ || brahmakuṇḍaṃ samāsādya cakruryāgānvidhānataḥ || 63 || tasmādiyakṣavo martyāḥ kuryuryajñānihaiva hi || 64 || manujadevamunīśvaravaṃditaṃ sakalasaṃsṛtināśakaraṃ dvijāḥ || jalajasaṃbhavakuṇḍamidaṃ śubhaṃ sakala pāpaharaṃ sakalārthadam || 65 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye brahmakuṇḍapraśaṃsāyāṃ brahmaśāpavimokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<3.1.15>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || brahmakuṇḍe mahāpuṇye snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ || naro hanūmataḥ kuṇḍamatha gacchedvijottamāḥ || 1 || purā hateṣu rakṣaḥsu samāpte raṇakarmaṇi || rāmādiṣu nivṛtteṣu gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 2 || sarva lokopakārāya hanūmānmārutātmajaḥ || sarvatīrthottamaṃ cakre svanāmnā tīrthamuttamam || 3 || viditvā vaibhavaṃ yasya svayaṃ rudreṇa sevyate || tasya tīrthasya sadṛśaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 4 || yatra snātā narā yāṃti śivalokaṃ sanātanam || yasmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye mahāpātakanāśane || 5 || sarvalokopakārāya nirmite vāyusūnunā || sarvāṇi narakāṇyāsañcchūnyānyeva cirāya vai || 6 || vaibhavaṃ tasya tīrthasya śaṃkaro vetti vā na vā || yatra dharmasakhonāma rājā kekayavaṃśajaḥ || 7 || bhaktyā saha purā snātvā śataṃ putrānavāpta vān || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta dharmasakhasyādya caritaṃ vaktumarhasi || hanūmatkuṇḍatīrthe yo lebhe snātvā śataṃ sutān || 8 || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śṛṇudhvamṛṣayo yūyaṃ caritaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ || 9 || adya dharmasakhasyāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || rājā dharmasakhonāma vijitāriḥ sudhārmikaḥ || 3.1.15.10 || babhūva nītimānpūrvaṃ prajāpālanatatparaḥ || tasya bhāryāśataṃ viprā vabhūva patidaivatam || 11 || sa pālayanmahīṃ rājā saśailavanakānanām || tāsu bhāryāsu tanayaṃ nāviṃdadvaṃśavarddhanam || 12 || putrārthaṃ sa mahīpālo bahūyatnānathākarot ||5 akarocca mahādānaṃ putrārthaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ || 13 || aśvamedhādibhiryajñairayajacca surānprati || tulāpuruṣamukhyāni dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ || 14 || āmadhyarātramannāni sarvebhyo'pyanivāritam || prāyacchadbahusūpāni sasyopetāni bhūmipaḥ || 15 || pitṝnuddiśya ca śrāddhamakarodvidhipūrvakam || saṃtānadāyino maṃtrāñjajāpa niyatedriyaḥ || 16 || evamādīnbahūndharmānputrārthaṃ kṛtavānnṛpaḥ || putramuddiśya satataṃ kurvandharmānanuttamān || 17 || rājā dīrgheṇa kālena vṛddhatāṃ pratyapadyata || kadācittasya vṛddhasya yatamānasya bhūpateḥ || 18 || putrassucaṃdranāmābhūjjyeṣṭhapatnyāṃ manoramaḥ || jātaṃ putraṃ jananyastāḥ sarvā vaiṣamyavarjitāḥ || 19 || samaṃ saṃvarddhayāmāsuḥ kṣīrādibhiranuttamāḥ || rājñaśca sarvamātṝṇāṃ paurāṇāmmaṃtriṇāṃ tathā || 3.1.15.20 || manonayanasaṃtoṣajanako'yaṃ suto'bhavat || lālayānaḥ sutaṃ rājā mudaṃ lebhe parātparām||21|| āṃdolikāśayānasya sūnostasya kadācana || vṛściko'kuṭṭayatpāde pucchenodyadviṣāgninā || 22 || kuṭṭanādvṛścikasyāsāvarudattanayo bhṛśam || tatastanmātaraḥ sarvāḥ prārudañcchokakātarāḥ || 23 || parivāryātmajaṃ viprāḥ sadhvaniḥ saṃkulo'bhavat || ārtadhvaniṃ sa śuśrāva rājā dharmasakhastadā || 24 || upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye sahāmātyapurohitaḥ || atha prātiṣṭhipadrājā sauvidallaṃ sa veditum || 25 || antaḥpurabahirdvāraṃ sauvidallaḥ sametya saḥ || ṣaṃḍhavṛddhānsamāhūya vākyametadabhāṣata || 26 || ṣaṃḍhāḥ kimarthamadhunā rudatyantaḥpura striyaḥ || tatparijñāyatāṃ tatra gatvā rodanakāraṇam || 27 || etadarthaṃ hi māṃ rājā prerayāmāsa saṃsadi || ityuktāstu parijñāya nidānaṃ rodanasya te || 28 || nirgamyāṃtaḥpurāttasmai yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat || sa ṣaṃḍhakavacaḥ śrutvā sauvidallaḥ sabhāṃ gataḥ || 29 || rājñe nivedayāmāsa putraṃ vṛścikapīḍitam || tato dharmasakho rājā śrutvā vṛttāṃtamīdṛśam || 3.1.15.30 || tvaramāṇaḥ samutthāya sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || praviśyāṃtaḥpuraṃ sārddhaṃ māṃtrikairviṣahā ribhiḥ || 31 || cikitsayāmāsa sutamauṣadhādyairanekaśaḥ || jātasvāsthyaṃ tataḥ putraṃ lālayitvā sa bhūpatiḥ || 32 || mānayitvā ca maṃtrajñānratnakāṃ canamauktikaiḥ || niṣkramyāṃtaḥpurādrājā bhṛśaṃ ciṃtāsamākulaḥ || 33 || ṛtvikpurohitāmātyaistāṃ sabhāṃ sanupāviśat || tatra dharmasakho rājā samāsīno varāsane || uvācedaṃ vaco yuktamṛtvijaḥ sapurohitān || 34 || || dharmasakha uvāca || || duḥkhāyaivaikaputratvaṃ bhavati brāhmaṇo ttamāḥ || 35 || ekaputratvato tṛṇāṃ varā caiva hyaputratā || nityaṃ vyapāyayuktatvādvarameva hyaputratā || ahaṃ bhāryāśataṃ viprā udavoḍha viciṃtya tu || 36 || vayaśca samatikrāṃtaṃ sapatnīkasya me dvijāḥ || prāṇā mama ca bhāryāṇāmasminputre vyavasthitāḥ || 37 || tannāśe mama bhāryāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca mṛtirdhruvā || mamāpi prāṇanāśaḥ syādekaputrasya māraṇe || 38 || ato me bahuputratvaṃ kenopāyena vai bhavet || tamupāyaṃ mama brūta brāhmaṇā vedavi ttamāḥ || 39 || ekaikaḥ śatabhāryāsu putro me syādyathā guṇī || tatkarma vrata yūyaṃ tu śāstramālokya dharmataḥ || 3.1.15.40 || mahatā laghunā vāpi karmaṇā duṣkareṇa vā || phalaṃ yadyapi tatsādhyaṃ kariṣye'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || yuṣmābhiruditaṃ karma kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || kṛtameva hi tadvitta śape'haṃ sukṛtairmama || 42 || asti cedīdṛśaṃ karma yena putraśataṃ bhavet || tatkarma kutra kartavyaṃ mayeti vadatādhunā || 43 || iti pṛṣṭāstadā rājñā ṛtvijaḥ sapurohitāḥ || saṃbhūya sarve rājānamidamūcuḥ suniścitam || 44 || || ṛtvija ūcuḥ || || asti rājanpravakṣyāmo yena putraśataṃ tava || bhaveddharmeṇa mahatā śatabhāryāsu kaikaya || 45 || asti kaścinmahāpuṇyo gandhamādanaparvataḥ || dakṣiṇāṃbudhimadhye yaḥ seturūpeṇa vartate || 46 || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvadevarṣigaṇasaṃkulaḥ || darśanātsparśanānnṛṇāṃ mahāpātakanāśanaḥ || 47 || tatrāsti hanumatkuṃḍamiti lokeṣu viśrutam || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ svargamokṣaphalapradam|| 48 || narakakleśaśamanaṃ tathā dāridryamocanam || putrapradamaputrāṇāmastrīṇāṃ strīpadaṃ nṛṇām || 49 || tatra tvaṃ prayataḥ snātvā sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīm|| putrīyeṣṭiṃ ca tattīre kuruṣva susamāhitaḥ ||3.1.15.50 || tena te śatabhāryāsu pratyekaṃ tanayo nṛpa || ekaikastu bhavecchīghraṃ mā kuru ṣvātra saṃśayam|| 51 || tathokto nṛpatirvipraiṛtvikbhiḥ sapurohitaiḥ || tatkṣaṇenaiva ṛtvikbhirbhāryābhiśca purodhasā || 52 || vṛtomātyaiśca bhṛtyaiśca yajñasaṃbhārasaṃyutaḥ || prayayau dakṣiṇāṃbhodhau gandhamādanaparvatam || 53 || hanumatkuṃḍamāsādya tatra sasnau sasainikaḥ || māsamātraṃ sa tattīre nyavasa tsnānamācaran || 54 || tato vasaṃte saṃprāpte caitramāsi nṛpottamaḥ || iṣṭimārabdhavāṃstatra putrīyāṃ sapurohitaḥ || 55 || samyakkarmāṇi cakruste ṛtvijaḥ sapurodhasaḥ || sapatnīkasya rājarṣestathādharmasakhasya tu || 56 || iṣṭau tasya samāptāyāṃ hanūmatkuṃḍatīrataḥ || purohito hutocchiṣṭaṃ prāśa yadrājayoṣitaḥ || 57 || tato dharmasakho rājā hanūmatkuṃḍavāriṣu || samyakcakārāvabhṛthasnānaṃ bhāryāśatānvitaḥ || 58 || ṛtvikbhyo dakṣiṇāḥ prādādasaṃkhyātāstu bhūriśaḥ || grāmāṃśca pradadau rājā bāhmaṇebhyo dvijottamāḥ || 59 || sāmātyaḥ saparīvāraḥ sapatnīkaḥ sa dhārmmikaḥ || rājā tato nivavṛte purīṃ svāṃ prati naṃditaḥ || 3.1.15.60 || tataḥ katipaye kāle gate daśamamāmi vai || śataṃ bhāryāḥ śataṃ putrānsuṣuvurguṇavattarān || 61 || atha prītamanā rājā vīro dharmasakho mahān || snātaḥ śuddhaśca saṃkalpya jātakarmākarottadā||62 || gobhūtilahiraṇyādi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau bahu || dvau putrau jyeṣṭhabhāryāyāḥ pūrvajo'varajastadā || 63 || sarve vavṛdhire putrā ekādhikaśataṃ dvijāḥ || prauḍheṣu teṣu rājāsau tebhyo rājyaṃ vibhajya tu || 64 || dattvā ca prayayau setuṃ sabhāryo gandhamādanam|| hanumatkuṃḍamāsādya tapo'tapyata tattaṭe || 65 || mahānkālo vyatīyāya rājña stasya tapasyataḥ || rājño dharmasakhasyāsya dhyāyamānasya śūlinam || 66 || tato bahutithe kāle gate dharmasakho nṛpaḥ || kāladharmaṃ yayau tatra dhārmmikaśśāṃtamānasaḥ || 67 || patnyopi tasya rājarṣeranujagmuḥ patiṃ tadā || jyeṣṭhaputraḥ sucandropi saṃskṛtya pitaraṃ tataḥ || 68 || akarocchrāddha paryaṃtaṃ karmāṇi śraddhayā saha || rājā sabhāryo vaikuṃṭhaṃ maraṇādatra jagmivān || 69 || sucandramukhyāste sarve rājaputrā mahaujasaḥ || svasvarājyaṃ bubhujire bhrātarastyaktamatsarāḥ || 3.1.15.70 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā hanūmatkuṃḍavaibhavam || rājño dharmasakhasyāpi caritraṃ paramādbhutam || 71 || tatsarvaṃ kāmasi ddhyarthaṃ snāyātkuṃḍe hanṛmataḥ || 72 || adhyāyamenaṃ paṭhate manuṣyaḥ śṛṇoti vā yaḥ susamāhito dvijāḥ || so'naṃtamāpnoti sukhaṃ paratra krīḍeta sārddhaṃ divi devavṛndaiḥ || 73 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye hanumatkuṃḍapraśaṃsāyāṃ dharmasakhaśatapuutrāvāptivarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<3.1.16>
|| sūta uvāca || || kuṃḍe hanumataḥ snātvā svayaṃ rudreṇa sevite || agastitīrthaṃ vipreṃdrāstato gacchetsamāhitaḥ || 1 || etadvinirmitaṃ tīrthaṃ sākṣādvai kumbhayoninā || pravartamāne kalahe purā vai meruviṃdhyayoḥ || 2 || niruddhabhuvanābhogo vavṛdhe viṃdhyaparvataḥ || tadā prāṇiṣu sarveṣu nirucchvāseṣu devatāḥ || 3 || kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatvā śaṃbhave tadvyajijñapan|| tadā sa pārvatīpāṇigrahaṇotsukakautukī || 4 || preṣayitvā vasiṣṭhādīnpārvatīṃ yācituṃ munīn|| kuṃbhaja tvaṃ nigṛhṇīṣva viṃdhyādrimiti so'nvaśāt || 5 || tataḥ sa kumbhajaḥ prāha bhagavaṃtaṃ pinākinam || udvāhaveṣaṃ te deva na drakṣyehaṃ kathaṃ vibho || 6 || iti vijñāpitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ punaḥ kuṃbhajamabravīt|| kuṃbhajodvāhaveṣaṃ te pārvatyā sahito hyaham || 7 || vedāraṇye mahāpuṇye darśayiṣyāmyasaṃśayaḥ || tadgaccha śīghraṃ viṃdhyādriṃ nigrahītuṃ munīśvara || 8 || evamuktastatogastyo vindhyādriṃ sa nigṛhya ca || pādākramaṇamātreṇa samīkurvanmahītalam || 9 || caritvā dakṣi ṇāndeśāngandhamādanamanvagāt || sa viditvā maharṣistu gandhamādanavaibhavam || 3.1.16.10 || tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ svanāmnā nirmame muniḥ || lopāmudrāsakhastatra vartate'dyāpi kuṃbhajaḥ || 11 || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet || iha loke trikālepi tattīrthasadṛśaṃ dvijāḥ || || 12 || tīrthaṃ na vidyate puṇyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ yattīrthasnānavaibhavāt|| 13 || sudīrghatamasaḥ putraḥ kakṣīvānnāma nāmataḥ || lebhe manoramāṃ nāma svanayasya sutāṃ priyām || 14 || kakṣīvataḥ kathā seyaṃ puṇyāpāpavināśinī || tāṃ kathāṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇudhvaṃ munīśvarāḥ ||| 15 || asti dīrghatamā nāma muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || tasya putraḥ samabhavatkakṣīvāniti viśrutaḥ || 16 || upanītaḥ sa kakṣīvānbrahmacārī jiteṃ driyaḥ || vedābhyāsāya sa guroḥ kule vāsamakalpayat || 17|| udaṃkasya gurorgehe vasandīrghatamaḥsutaḥ || so'dhyeṣṭa caturo vedānsāṃgāñchāstrāṇi ṣaṭ tathā || 18 || itihāsapurāṇāni tathopaniṣado'pica || uṣitvā ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi kakṣīvāngurusannidhau || 19 || prayāsyansvagṛhaṃ viprā gurave dakṣi ṇāmadāt || uvāca vai gururvidvānkakṣīvānbrahmavittamaḥ || 3.1.16.20 || || kakṣīvānuvāca || || ahaṃ gṛhaṃ prayāsyāmi kurvanujñāṃ mahāmune || avalokya kṛpādṛṣṭyā māṃ rakṣodaṃka sāṃpratam || udaṃkastveva muditaḥ kakṣīvaṃtamathābravīt || 21 || || udaṃka uvāca || anujānāmi kakṣīvangaccha tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ prati || 22 || udvāhārthamupāyaṃ te vatsa vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || rāmasetuṃ prayāhi tvaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvatam|| 23 || tatrāgastyakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradā yakam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam|| 24 || vidyate snāhi tatra tvaṃ sarvamaṃgalasādhane || trivarṣaṃ vasa tatra tvaṃ niyamācārasaṃyutaḥ || 25 || varṣeṣu triṣu yāteṣu caturthe vatsare tataḥ || nirgamiṣyati mātaṃgaḥ kaścittīrthottamāttataḥ || 26 || caturdaṃto mahākāyaḥ śaradabhrasamacchaviḥ || taṃ gajaṃ girisaṃkāśaṃ snātvā tatra samāruha || 27 || āruhya taṃ gajaṃ vatsa svanayasya purīṃ vraja || caturdaṃtagajasthaṃ tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā śakramivāparam ||28 || rājarṣiḥ svanayo dhīmānharṣavyākulalocanaḥ || svakanyāyāḥ kṛte duḥkhaṃ tyajedeva hṛdisthitam || 29 || purā hi pratijajñe sā tasya putrī manoramā || caturdaṃtaṃ mahākāyaṃ gajaṃ sarvāṃgapāṃḍuram || 3.1.16.30 || āruhya yaḥ samāgacchetsa me bhartā bhavediti || svakanyāyāḥ pratijñāṃ tāṃ samākarṇya sa bhūpatiḥ || || 31 || duḥkhākulamanā bhūtvā satataṃ paryaciṃtayat || svanaye ciṃtayatyevaṃ nāradaḥ samupāgamat || 32 || tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā rājarṣiratidhārmikaḥ || pratyudgamya mudā yuktaḥ pādyārghyādyairapūjayat || 33 || praṇamya nāradaṃ rājā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || kanyeyaṃ mama devarṣe pratijñāmakarotpurā || 34 || catu rdaṃtaṃ mahākāyaṃ gajaṃ sarvāṃgapāṃḍuram || āruhya yaḥ samāgacchetsa me bhartā bhavediti || 35 || caturdaṃto mahākāyo gajaḥ sarvāṃgapāṃḍuraḥ || saṃbhavediṃdrabhavane bhūtale naiva vidyate || 36 || iyaṃ ca dustarāmenāṃ pratijñāṃ bāliśā'karot || iyaṃ pratijñātitarāṃ satataṃ bādhate hi mām || 37 || anūḍhā hi pituḥ kanyā sarvadā śokamāvahet || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā svanaye nārado'bravīt || 38 || mā viṣīdasva rājarṣe tasyā īdṛgvidhaḥ patiḥ || bhaviṣyatyacirādeva pṛthivyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ || 39 || kakṣīvāniti vikhyāto jāmātā te bhaviṣyati || ityuktvā nāradamuniryayāvākāśamārgataḥ || 3.1.16.40 || sva nayastadvacaḥ śrutvā nāradena prabhāṣitam || ākāṃkṣate divārātraṃ tādṛgvidhasamāgamam || 41 || ataḥ saumya mahābhāga kakṣīvanbālatāpasa || agastyatīrthamadya tvaṃ snātuṃ gaccha tvarānvitaḥ || 42 || sarvamaṃgalasiddhiste bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || udaṃkenaivamukto'tha kakṣīvāndvijapuṃgavaḥ || 43 || anu jñātaśca guruṇā prayayau gaṃdhamādanam || saṃprāpyāgastyatīrthaṃ ca tatra sasnau jiteṃdriyaḥ || 44 || kṣetropavāsamakaroddinamekaṃ munīśvaraḥ || aparedyuḥ punaḥ snātvā pāraṇāmakaroddvijaḥ || 45 || rātrau tatraiva suṣvāpa kakṣīvāndharmatatparaḥ || evaṃ niyamayuktasya tasya kakṣīvato muneḥ || 46 || ekena divase nonaṃ varṣatrayamathāgamat || atha varṣatrayasyāṃte tasminneva dine muniḥ || 47 || anvāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ sukhaṃ suṣvāpa tattaṭe || yāmamātrāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ vibhāvaryāṃ mahādhvaniḥ || 48 || udabhūtpralayāṃbhodhivīcikolāhalopamaḥ || tena śabdena mahatā kakṣīvānpratyabudhyata || 49 || tatastu svanayo nāma rājā sānucaro balī || mṛgayākautukī tatra madhurāpatirāyayau || 3.1.16.50 || vinighnansa gajānsiṃhānvarāhānmahiṣānnurūn || anyānmṛgaviśeṣāṃśca sa rājā nyavadhīccharaiḥ || 851 || sāmātyo mṛgayāsakto rathavājigajairyutaḥ || agastyatīrthasavidhamāsasāda bhaṭānvitaḥ || 52 || sa rājā mṛgayāśrāṃtaḥ śrāṃtasainikasaṃvṛtaḥ || tattīrthatīraprāṃteṣu niṣasāda mahīpatiḥ || 53 || tataḥ prabhāte vimale kakṣī vānmunisattamaḥ || agastyatīrthe snātvā'sau saṃdhyāṃ pūrvāmupāsya ca || 54 || tasya tīre japanmatrāṃstasthau niyamasaṃyutaḥ || atrāṃtare tīrthavarādgaja eko viniryayau || 55 || caturdaṃto mahākāyaḥ kailāsa iva mūrtimān || sa samutthāya tattīrthādagātkakṣīvadaṃtikam || 56 || tamāgatamudaṃkokta lakṣaṇairupalakṣitam || tadā nirīkṣya kakṣīvānāroḍhuṃ snānamātanot || 57 || namaskṛtya ca tattīrthaṃ ślāghamāno muhurmuhuḥ || āruroha ca kakṣīvāṃścaturdaṃtaṃ mahāgajam || 58 || āruhya taṃ caturdaṃtaṃ rajatācalasaṃnibham || svanayasya purīmeva kakṣīvāngaṃtumaicchata || 59 || tamārūḍhaṃ caturdaṃtaṃ śvetadaṃtāvalottamam || sa vīkṣya niścikāyainaṃ kakṣīvāniti bhūpatiḥ || 3.1.16.60 || prasannahṛdayo rājā tasyāṃtikamupāgamat || tadābhyāśamupāgamya kakṣīvaṃtaṃ nṛpo'bravīt || 61 || || svanaya uvāca || || tvaṃ brahmankasya putro'si nāma kiṃ tava me vada || gajamenaṃ samāruhya kutra vā gantumicchasi || svanayenaivamuktastu kakṣīvānvākyamabravīt || 62 || || kakṣīvānuvāca || || putro'haṃ dīrghatamasaḥ kakṣīvāniti viśrutaḥ || 63 || svanayasya tu rājarṣergacchāmi nagaraṃ prati || ahamudvoḍhumicchāmi tasya kanyā manoramām|| 64 || caturdaṃtagajārūḍhastatpratijñāṃ ca pūrayan || svanayasya sutāpāṇiṃ grahīṣyāmi narādhipa || 65 || tadbhāṣitaṃ samākarṇya śrotrapīyūṣavarṣaṇam || harṣasaṃphullanayanaḥ svanayo vākyama bravīt || 66 || kakṣīvanbhoḥ kṛtārthosmi sa eva svanayo hyaham || udvoḍhumicchati bhavānyasya kanyāṃ manoramām || 67 || svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha kakṣīvanbālatāpasa || mama kanyāṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ tapodhana manoramām || 68 || tayā saha carandharmāngārhasthyaṃ pratipālaya || rājñoktaḥ sa tadovāca kakṣīvāndharmatatparaḥ || rājānaṃ svanayaṃ prītaṃ madhurāpuravāsinam || 69 || || kakṣīvānuvāca || || pitā dīrghatamānāma vedāraṇye mama prabho || || 3.1.16.70 || āste tapaścaransaumyo niyamācāratatparaḥ || tasyāṃtikaṃ preṣaya tvaṃ vipramekaṃ dharāpate || 71 || tathoktaḥ sa tadā rājā svanayo hṛṣṭamā nasaḥ || anekasenayā sārdhaṃ prāhiṇotsvapurodhasam || 72 || vipraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma vedāraṇyasthalaṃ prati || sudarśanaḥ samādiṣṭaḥ svanayena nṛpeṇa saḥ || 73 || mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ prayayau vedakānanam || tatroṭaje samāsīna taṃ dīrghatamasaṃ munim || 74 || tapaścaratamāsīnaṃ dhyāyanvedāṭavī patim || purohito dadarśātha japaṃtaṃ maṃtramuttamam || 75 || praṇāmamakarottasmai munaye sa sudarśanaḥ || uvāca dīrghatamasaṃ muniṃ prahlādayanniva || 76 || || || sudarśana uvāca || || kaccitte kuśalaṃ brahmankaccitte vardhate tapaḥ || āśrame kuśalaṃ kaccitkacciddharme sukhaṃ vada || 77 || pṛṣṭaḥ sudarśanenaivaṃ munirdīrghatamāstadā || sudarśanamuvācedamarghyādividhipūrvakam || 78 || || dīrghatamā uvāca || || sarvatra kuśalaṃ brahmansudarśana mahāmate || mama vedāṭavīnāthakṛpayā nāśubhaṃ kvacit|| 79 || tavāpi kuśalaṃ brahmankiṃ sukhāgamanaṃ tathā || kiṃvā''gamanakāryaṃ te sudarśana mamāśrame || 3.1.16.80 ||| svanayasya purodhāstvaṃ khalu vedavidāṃvaraḥ || taṃ vihāya mahārāja madhurāpuravāsinam || 81 || mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ kimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ || ityukto dīrghatamasā tadānīṃ sa sudarśanaḥ || 82 || uvāca taṃ mahātmānaṃ muniṃ jvalitatejasam || sarvatra me sukhaṃ brahmanbhavataḥ kṛpayā sadā || 83 || bhagavansva nayo rājā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya tu|| tvāṃ prāha praśritaṃ vākyaṃ manmukhena śṛṇuṣva tat || 84 || || svanaya uvāca || || kakṣīvāṃste suto brahma ngaṃdhamādanaparvate || snānaṃ kurvannagastyasya tīrthe saṃprati vartate || 85 || tasya rūpaṃ tapo dharmamācārānvaidikāṃstathā || vedaśāstrapravīṇatvamābhi jātyaṃ ca tādṛśam || 86 || lokottaramidaṃ sarvaṃ vijñāya tava naṃdane || manoramāṃ sutāṃ tasmai dātumicchāmyahaṃ mune || 87 || mṛgayākautukī cāhaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvatam || āgato muniśārdūla vartte yuṣmatsutāṃtike ||88|| pitranujñāṃ vinā nāhamudvaheyaṃ sutāṃ tava || iti brūte tava sutaḥ kakṣīvānmunisa ttama ||89|| tadbhāvāṃ matsutāṃ tasmai dātuṃ me'nugrahaṃ kuru || praiṣayaṃ ca samīpaṃ te senayā ca sudarśanam || 3.1.16.90 || || sudarśana uvāca |||| iti māṃ bhagavanrājā prāhiṇottava sannidhim|| tadbhavānanumanyasva rājñastasya cikīrṣitam || 91 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ityuktvā virarāmātha svanayasya purohitaḥ || tato dīrghatamāḥ prāha svanayasya purohitam || 92 || || dīrghatamā uvāca || || sudarśana bhavatvevaṃ kathitaṃ svanayena yat || mamābhīṣṭatamaṃ hyetatpāṇigrahaṇamaṃgalam || 93 || āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ vipra gandhamādanaparvatam || ityuktvā sa munirviprā mahādīrghatamā muniḥ || 94 || vedāṭavīpatiṃ natvā bhaktipravaṇacetasā || sudarśanena sahitaḥ setumuddiśya niryayau || 95 || ṣaṭbhirdinairmuniḥ puṇyaṃ prayayau gandhamādanam || agastitīrthatīraṃ ca gatvā dīrghatamā muniḥ || 96 || atha putraṃ dadarśāgre kakṣīvaṃtaṃ mahāmuniḥ || kakṣīvānpitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vavande nāma kīrtayan || 97 || tato dīrghatamā yogī svāṃkamāropya taṃ sutam || mūrdhnyupāghrāya sasnehaṃ sasvaje pulakākulaḥ || 98 || kuśalaṃ paripapraccha tadā dīrghatamā ṛṣiḥ || sarvavedāstvayādhītāḥ kakṣīvankimu vatsaka || 99 || śāstrāṇyapāṭhīḥ kiṃ tvaṃ vā vatsa sarvaṃ vadasva me || iti pṛṣṭaḥ svapitrā sa sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ tamavravīt || || 3.1.16.1|||| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyebrahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye'gastitīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ kakṣīvadudvāhodyogavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||
<3.1.17>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || punarityāha kakṣīvānpitaraṃ taṃ munīśvarāḥ || yathodaṃkena guruṇā preṣito'hamihā dhunā || 1 || samāgatosmi tīrthe'sminnāgastye munisattama || svanayasya sutodvāhasiddhyarthaṃ gurucoditaḥ || 2 || upāyaṃ tannigaditamatra kurva nnyavartiṣam || varṣatrayāvasāne māmudvāhopāyasaṃyutam || 3 || svanayotraiva tiṣṭhantamāsasāda yadṛcchayā || sa ca māmetya kanyāṃ te dāsyāmīti vaco'bravīt || 4 || tatosmadanurodhena tvāmāhvayadayaṃ nṛpaḥ || itīrayitvā pitaraṃ kakṣīvānvirarāma saḥ || 5 || sudarśano'tha vipreṃdraḥ purodhāḥ svana yasya saḥ || prayayau rājasavidhaṃ svanayāya niveditum || 6 || rājānaṃ taṃ samāsādya svanayaṃ sa sudarśanaḥ || prāptaṃ nivedayāmāsa taṃ dīrghatamasaṃ munim|| 7 || tataḥ sa rājā svanayo muniṃ prāptaṃ purohitāt || śrutvā viniryayau draṣṭuṃ mahasā paṭamaṇḍapāt || 8 || agastyatīrthatīre taṃ saputramṛṣi sattamam|| dadarśa rājā svanayo brahmāṇamiva devarāṭ || 9 || vavaṃde dīrghatamasaścaraṇau lokamaṃgalau || utthāpya nṛpatiṃ viprāstadā dīrghatamā muniḥ || || 3.1.17.10 || āśiṣaṃ prayuyojātha svanayāya nṛpāya saḥ || atrāṃtare samāyāta udaṃko'pi mahānṛṣiḥ || 11 || rāmasetau dhanuṣkoṭau snātuṃ śiṣyagaṇairvṛtaḥ || lakṣasaṃkhyo munigaṇastena sākaṃ munīśvaraḥ || 12 || udaṃko'gastyatīrthesminsnātuṃ saṃprāptavānmuniḥ || udaṃkamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā kakṣīvānpraṇanāma tam || 13 || akarodāśiṣaṃ vipraḥ śiṣyāyātha gurustadā || atha dīrghatamā viprastamudaṃkaṃ mahāmunim || 14 || kuśalaṃ paripapraccha so'pi taṃ muni puṃgamam || ubhau tau muniśārdūlau sarvalokeṣu viśrutau || 15 || kathayāmāsatustatra kathāḥ pāpapraṇāśinīḥ || atha rājāpyudaṃkaṃ taṃ praṇanāma munīśva ram || 16 || udaṃkopyāśiṣaṃ tasmai prāyuṃkta svanayāya vai || rājātha svanayaḥ prītastatra vākyamabhāṣata || 17 || muniṃ taṃ dīrghatamasaṃ vivāhaḥ kriya tāmiti || tathāstvityavadatso'pi tadā dīrghatamā muniḥ || 18 || śva eva kriyatāṃ rājansumuhūrte mahāmate || atraiva pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyatāṃ gandhamā dane || 19 || tasmādihānaya kṣipraṃ kanyāmaṃtaḥpuraṃ tathā || ityuktaḥ svanayo rājā gatvā svapaṭamaṇḍapam || 3.1.17.20 || āhūya śatasaṃkhyākānvṛddhānvarṣa varāṃstadā || ānetuṃ preṣayāmāsa kanyāmaṃtaḥpuraṃ tathā || 21 || te varṣavaramukhyāstu svanayena pracoditāḥ || manojavānsamāruhya vājino madhurāṃ yayuḥ || 22 || gatvā cāṃtaḥpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ vṛttaṃ sarvaṃ nivedyaca || kanyayāṃtaḥpureṇāpi sahitāḥ punarāyayuḥ || 23 || tataḥ parasmindivase śubhe dīrghatamā ṛṣiḥ || godānādīni putrasya vidhivanniravartayat || 24 || nirvṛtteṣvatha kakṣīvāngodānādiṣu karmasu || udvoḍhuṃ rājatanayāṃ pitrā ca guruṇā saha || || 25 || caturdaṃtaṃ mahākāyaṃ gajaṃ sarvāṃgapāṃḍuram || āruhya harṣasaṃyukto dvitīya iva devarāṭ || 26 || manoramāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pūrayaṃśca manoratham || brāhmaṇairbahusāhasraiḥ sahitaḥ svastivācakaiḥ ||27|| toraṇālaṃkṛtadvāraṃ rājarṣe paṭamaṇḍapam || kṛtamaṃgalakṛtyo'sau kakṣīvānmudito yayau ||28|| tataḥ svanayakanyā sā kṛtamaṃgalabhūṣaṇā || caturdaṃtamahākāyaśvetadaṃtāvalasthitam|| 29 || kakṣīvaṃtaṃ samāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā svodvāhanotsukam || pratijñā matkṛte dānīṃ nirvṛtteti mudaṃ yayau || 3.1.17.30 || kakṣīvāndīrghatamasā tathodaṃkena saṃyutaḥ || paṭākārabahirdvāraṃ kramādrājñaḥ samāyayau || 31 || svanayastu tato dṛṣṭvā kakṣīvaṃtaṃ samāgatam || pratyujjagāma sahitaḥ sudarśanapurodhasā || 32 || kakṣīvato varasyātha kanyakāparicārikāḥ || rājataiḥ svarṇapātraiśca cakru rnīrājanāvidhim || 33 || svanayena samāhūto brāhmaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ || praviveśātha lakṣmīvānkakṣīvānrājamaṃdiram || 34 || tato vareṇa sahitaṃ taṃ dīrghatamasaṃ munim || sodaṃkamanayadrājā svagṛhaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 35 || udaṃkadīrghatamasorarghyaṃ ca pradadau nṛpaḥ || alaṃkṛte prapāmadhye vastracāmaratoraṇaiḥ || 36 || varo dīrghatamāścānye sodaṃkā munayastadā || nyaṣīdansvanayaścāpi sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || 37 || tato duhitaraṃ kanyāṃ sukeśīṃ tāṃ mano ramām || bhūṣaṇālaṃkṛtāṃ gātre divyavastradharāṃ śubhām || 38 || biṃboṣṭhīṃ cārusarvāṃgīṃ pīnonnatapayodharām || prapāyāmadhyamanayanmahājanasamākulam || || 39 || tato varasya kaṃṭhe sā mālāṃ caṃpakanirmitām
