|| niveśayāmāsa śubhā janamadhye manoramā || 3.1.17.40 || udaṃkastata āgatya pratiṣṭhāpyānalaṃ sthale || kṛtvāgnimukhaparyaṃtaṃ lājāhomādikaṃ tathā || 41 || pāṇimagrāhayattasyāḥ kanyāyāśca vareṇa tu || udaṃkaḥ sarvakarmāṇi kārayāmāsa tatra vai || || 42 || varavadhvostadā viprāḥ prāyuṃjata tadāśiṣaḥ || tataḥ sa rājā svanayo varaṃ dīrghatamomunim||43|| udaṃkaṃ varapakṣīyānsvapakṣīyāṃstathādvijāḥ || trilakṣaṃ brāhmaṇānannairbhojayāmāsa ṣaḍrasaiḥ || 44 || tataḥ saṃbhāvayāmāsa tāṃbūlādyairanekadhā || athāmaṃtrya muniśreṣṭhamudaṃkaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau ||45 || anye ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve svadeśānprayayustadā || evaṃ vivāhe nirvṛtte kakṣīvadrājakanyayoḥ ||46|| praviśyāgastyatīrthaṃ sa tirodhatta gajottamaḥ || tato dīrghatamā viprāḥ putreṇa snuṣayā saha || 47 || agastyasya mahātīrthe snānaṃ kṛtveṣṭadāyini || ślāghamānaśca tattīrthaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || 48 || prayātuṃ svā śramaṃ puṇyaṃ vedāraṇyaṃ mano dadhe || rājānaṃ ca tamāgaṃtumāpṛcchanmunisattamaḥ || 49 || svanayo'pi tadā rājā svaduhitre mudānvitaḥ || dadau śatasahasrāṇi svarṇāni strīdhanaṃ tadā || 3.1.17.50 || gavāṃ sahasraṃ pradadau dāsīnāṃ ca sahasrakam || grāmaṃ paṃcaśataṃ cāpi dadau duhitṛvatsalaḥ || 51 || divyavastrā yutaṃ cāpi śataṃ bhūṣaṇapeṭikāḥ || hāramālāsahasraṃ ca dadau duhitṛsauhṛdāt || 52 || etatsarvaṃ samādāya sa putraḥ sasnuṣo muniḥ || rājñā ca samanujñātaḥ prayayau vedakānanam ||53 || vedāraṇyaṃ samāsādya tadā dīrghatamā muniḥ || uvāsa sasukhaṃ viprāḥ putreṇa snuṣayā saha || 54 || sevanvedāṭavīnāthaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || nyavasattu ciraṃ kālaṃ kakṣīvānapi bhāryayā || 55 || svanayopi sa rājarṣiḥ snātvā kuṃbhajanirmite || tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇye sahitaḥ sarvasainikaiḥ || 56 || ataḥpuraṃ samādāya muditaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || agastyatīrthamāhātmyādevaṃ kakṣīvato muneḥ || ananyasulabho viprā vivāhaḥ samajāyata || 57 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || itihāsastvayaṃ puṇyo vedasiddho munīśvarāḥ || 58 || dhanyo yaśasya āyuṣyaḥ kīrtisaubhāgya varddhanaḥ || śrotavyaḥ paṭhitavyo'yaṃ sarvathā mānavairdvijāḥ || 59 || paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cemamitihāsaṃ purātanam || nehāmutrāpi vā kleśo dāridyaṃ cāpi no bhavet || 3.1.17.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye kakṣīvadvivāhaniṣpattivarṇanaṃnāma sapta daśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<3.1.18>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || kuṃbhasaṃbhavatīrthe'sminvidhāyābhiṣavaṃ naraḥ || rāmakuṃḍaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ gacchetpāpavimuktaye || 1 || raghunāthasaraḥ puṇyaṃ dvijāḥ pāpaharaṃ tathā || raghunāthasarastīre kṛto yajño'lpadakṣiṇaḥ || 2 || saṃpūrṇaphalado bhūyātsvādhyāyo'pi japastathā || raghunātha sarastīre muṣṭimātramapi dvijāḥ || 3 || dattaṃ cedvedaviduṣe tadanaṃtaguṇaṃ bhavet || rāmatīrthaṃ samuddiśya vakṣyāmi munipuṃgavāḥ || 4 || itihāsaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || sutīkṣṇanāmā vipreṃdro munirniyatamānasaḥ || 5 || agastyaśiṣyo rāmasya caraṇābjaviciṃtakaḥ || rāmacaṃdrasarastīre tapastepe suduṣkaram || 6 || japanṣaḍakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ rāmacaṃdrādhidaivatam || nityaṃ sa paṃcasāhasraṃ matrarājamataṃdritaḥ ||7 || jajāpa kurvansnānaṃ ca raghunāthasarojale || bhikṣāśī niyatāhāro jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || 8 || evaṃ sutīkṣṇo vipreṃdrā bahukālamavartata || tataḥ kadācitsa munīrāmaṃ dhyāya nsadā hṛdi || tuṣṭāva sītāsahitaṃ rāmacaṃdraṃ sabhaktikam || 9 || || sutīkṣṇa uvāca || || namaste jānakīnātha namaste hanumatpriya || 3.1.18.10 || namaste kauśikamuneryāgarakṣaṇadīkṣita || namaste kausaleyāya viśvāmitrapriyāya ca || 11 || namaste harakodaṇḍabhaṃjakāmarasevita || mārīcāṃtaka rājeṃdra tāṭakāprāṇanāśana || 12 || kabaṃdhāre hare tubhyaṃ namo daśarathātmaja || jāmadagnyajite tubhyaṃ kharavidhvaṃsine namaḥ || 13 || namaḥ sugrīvanāthāya namo vāliharāya te || vibhīṣaṇabhayakleśahāriṇe malahāriṇe || 14 || ahalyāduḥkhasaṃhartre namaste bharatāgraja || aṃbhodhigarvasaṃhartre tasminsetu kṛte namaḥ || 15 || tārakabrahmaṇe tubhyaṃ lakṣmaṇāgraja te namaḥ || rakṣaḥsaṃhāriṇe tubhyaṃ namo rāvaṇamarddine || 16 || kodaṇḍadhāriṇe tubhyaṃ sarva rakṣāvidhāyine || iti stuvanmuniḥ so'yaṃ sutīkṣṇo rāmamanvaham || 17 || nināya kālamaniśaṃ rāmacaṃdraniṣaṇṇadhīḥ || evamabhyasatastasya rāma mantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram|| 18 || stuvato rāmacaṃdraṃ ca stotreṇānena suvratāḥ || tīrthe ca raghunāthasya kurvataḥ snānamanvaham || 19 || abhavanniścalā bhaktī rāmacaṃdretinirmalā || abhūdadvaitavijñānaṃ pratyagātmaikalakṣaṇam || 3.1.18.20 || anadhītatrayījñānaṃ tathaivāśrutavedanam || parakāyapraveśe ca sāmarthyamabhavaddvijāḥ ||21 || ākāśagamane śaktiḥ kalāvaidagdhyameva ca || aśrutānāṃ ca śāstrāṇāmabhijñānaṃ vinā gurum || 22 || gamanaṃ sarvalokeṣu prati ghātavivarjitam || atīṃdriyārthadraṣṭṛtvaṃ devaiḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā || 23 || pipīlikādijaṃtūnāṃ vārtājñānamapi dvijāḥ || brahmaviṣṇumahādevalokeṣu gamanaṃ tathā||24 || caturdaśasu lokeṣu svādhīnagamanaṃ tathā || etānyanyāni sarvāṇi yogilabhyāni sattamāḥ || 25 || sutīkṣṇasyābhavanviprā rāmā tīrthaniṣevaṇāt || evaṃprabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 26 || mahāsiddhikaraṃ puṇyamapamṛtyuvināśanam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṃsāṃ narakakleśanā śanam || 27 || rāmabhaktipradaṃ nityaṃ saṃsārocchedakāraṇam || asya tīre mahalliṃgaṃ sthāpayitvā raghūdvahaḥ || pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ lokānugrahakā myayā || 28 || rāmatīrthe mahāpuṇye snātvā talliṃgadarśanāt || narāṇāṃ muktireva syātkimutānyā vibhūtayaḥ || 29 || tatra snātvā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharma putraḥ purā dvijāḥ || anṛtoktisamudbhūtadoṣānmukto'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 3.1.18.30 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || asatyamuditaṃ kasmāddharmaputreṇa sūtaja || yaddoṣaśāṃtaye sasnau rāmatīthe'tipāvane || 31 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || yuṣmākamṛṣayo vakṣye yathoktamanṛtaṃ raṇe || chalena dharmaputreṇa yannaṣṭaṃ rāmatīrthake || 32 || anyonyaṃ pāṃḍavā viprā dharmaputrādayaḥ purā || dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāśca durnodhanamukhāstadā || 33 || mahadvai vairamāsādya rājyārthaṃ viprasattamāḥ || mahatyā senayā sārddhaṃ kurukṣetre sametya ca || 34 || ayudhyansamare vīrāḥ samareṣvanivartinaḥ || yuddhaṃ kṛtvā daśadinaṃ gāṃgeyaḥ patito bhuvi || 35 || tataḥ paṃcadinaṃ bhūyo dhṛṣṭadyumnena vīryavān || ācāryo yuyudhe droṇo mahābalaparākramaḥ || 36 || anekāstrāṇi śastrāṇi droṇācaryo mahābalī || visṛjanpāṃḍavānīkaṃ pīḍayāmāsa vīryavān || 37 || atha divyāstravicchūro dhṛṣṭadyumno mahābalaḥ || abhinadbāṇavarṣeṇa droṇasenāmanekadhā || 38 || dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tadā droṇaḥ śaravarṣairavākirat || pārthasenā tathā droṇabāṇavarṣātipīḍitā || 39 || daśadikṣu bhayākrāṃtā vidrutā dvijasattamāḥ || tato'rjuno raṇe droṇaṃ yuyudhe rathināṃ varaḥ || 3.1.18.40 || raṇapravīṇayostatra vijayadroṇayo raṇe || draṣṭuṃ samāgatairdevairabhūdvyomaniraṃ taram || 41 || droṇaphālgunayorviprā nāsti yuddhopamā bhuvi || sāmarṣayostadācāryaśiṣyayorabhavadraṇaḥ || 42 || droṇaphālgunayoryuddhaṃ droṇaphālguna yoriva || bahu mene'tha manasā droṇo'rjunaparākramam || 43 || tato droṇo mahāvīryaṃ priyaśiṣyaṃ sa phālgunam || vihāya pāṃcālabalaṃ samayudhyata vīryavān || 44 || saviṃśatisahasrāṇi daśa tatrāyutāni ca || droṇācāryo'vadhīdrājñāṃ yuddhe sagajavājinām || 45 || dhṛṣṭadyumno'tha kupito droṇa mabhyahanaccharaiḥ || droṇaśca paṭṭiśaṃ gṛhya dhṛṣṭadyumnamatāḍayat || 46 || śarairvivyādha taṃ yuddhe tīkṣṇairagniśikhopamaiḥ || paraṅmukho'bhavattatra dhṛṣṭa dyumnaḥ śarāhataḥ || 47 || tato virathamāgatya dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ vṛkodaraḥ || svaṃ syaṃdanaṃ samāropya droṇācāryamathābravīt || 48 || svakarmabhirasaṃtuṣṭāḥ śikṣitāstrā dvijādhamāḥ || na yuddhyeranyadi krūrā na naśyerannṛpā raṇe || 49 || ahiṃsā hi paro dharmo brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā smṛtaḥ || hiṃsayā dāraputrādīnrakṣaṃte vyādhajātayaḥ || 3.1.18.50 || hiṃsīstvamekaputrārthe yuddhe sthitvā bahūnnṛpān || sa cāpi te suto brahmanhataḥ śete raṇājire || 51 || tathāpi lajjā te nāsti śoko'pīha na jāyate || vacanaṃ tviti bhīmasya satyaṃ śrutvā yudhiṣṭhirāt || 52 || nijāyudhaṃ sa tatyāja papāta syaṃdano pari || yogavitprāyamātasthe droṇācāryastadā dvijāḥ || 53 || tadaṃtaraṃ parijñāya droṇācāryasya pārśvataḥ || khaṅgapāṇiḥ śiracchettumabhyadhāvadraṇā jire || 54 || vāryamāṇo'pi pārthādyaistacchiraśchettumudyayau || yogavittvāddroṇamūrdhno jyotirūrdhvaṃ divaṃ yayau || 55 || dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇārjunakṛpadharmaputrādi bhirmṛdhe || droṇasyāsya gataprāṇāccharīrādacchinacchiraḥ || 56 || bhāradvāje hate yuddhe kauravāḥ prādravanbhayāt || jahṛṣuḥ pāṃḍavā viprā dhṛṣṭadyumnādaya stadā || 57 || senāṃ tāṃ vidrutāṃ dṛṣṭvā drauṇirūce suyodhanam || etaddravati ki sainyaṃ tyaktapraharaṇaṃ nṛpa || 58 || tadā duryodhano rājā svayaṃ vaktu maśaknuvan || yuddhe droṇavadhaṃ vaktuṃ kṛpācāryamacodayat || drauṇaye'tha kṛpācāryo vadhamūce gurostadā || 59 || || kṛpa uvāca || || aśvatthāmaṃstava pitā brahmāstreṇa mṛdhe ripūn || hatvā nināya sadanaṃ yamasya śataśo balī || 3.1.18.60 || durādharṣatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadvīryaṃ keśavastadā || pāṃḍavānprāha vipreṃdra vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ || 61 || || keśava uvāca || || droṇaṃ jetumupāyo'sti pāṃḍavā yudhi durjayam || 62 || aśvatthātmā tava suto hato droṇa mṛdhe'dhunā || satyavādī vadedevaṃ yadi prāmāṇiko janaḥ || 63 || droṇo nivarteta raṇāttadā tyaktvāyudhaṃ kṣaṇāt || ata enāṃ mṛṣāvārtāṃ dharmarājo'dhunā vadet|| 64 || nānyathā śakyate jetuṃ droṇo yuddhaviśāradaḥ || dharmājjetumaśakyaṃ ceddharmaṃ tyaktvā'pyariṃ jayet || 65 || iti keśavavākyaṃ tacchrutvā bhīmaḥ pṛthāsataḥ || pitaraṃ te samabhyetya mithyāvākyamabhāṣata || 66 || aśvatthāmā hato droṇa yuddhe'tra patito'dhunā || droṇācāryopi tadvākyamamanyata yathārthataḥ || 67 || aviśvasya punaḥ so'tha dharmajaṃ prāpya cābravīt || dharmātmaja mṛdhe sūnuraśvatthāmā mamādhunā || 68 || hataḥ kiṃ tvaṃ vadasvādya satyavādī bhavānmataḥ || dharmaputro'satyabhīrurāsīccārijayotsukaḥ || 69 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayādyeti dolālolamanā abhūt || sa dṛṣṭvā bhīmanihatamaśvatthāmābhidhaṃ gajam ||3.1.18.7||| aśvatthāmā hato yuddhe bhīmenādya raṇe mahān || itthaṃ droṇaṃ babhāṣe'sau dharmaputraśchaloktitaḥ || 71 || tacchrutvā tvatpitā śastraṃ tyaktvā yuddhānnyavarttata || atha dharmasutaḥ prāha paraṃ vāraṇa ityapi || 72 || tyaktaṃ śastraṃ na gṛhṇīyāṃ yuddhe punariti sma saḥ || pratijajñe tava pitā vatsa droṇo balī punaḥ || 73 || ataḥ śastraṃ na jagrāha pratijñābhaṃgakātaraḥ || dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā pitā te mṛtyumātmanaḥ || 74 || matvā prāyopaveśena rathopasthe sa yogavit || aśayiṣṭa samādhisthaḥ prāṇānāyamya vāgyataḥ || 75 || tato nirbhidya mūrdhānaṃ tatprāṇā niryayuḥ kṣaṇāt || tadā mṛtasya droṇasya vatsa khaṅgena tacchiraḥ || 76 || keśāgṛhītvā hastena dhṛṣṭadyumno'cchinadyudhi || māvadhīriti pārthādyāḥ procuḥ sarve ca sainikāḥ || sarvairnivāryamāṇopi tvattātaṃ pārśvato'vadhīt || 77 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || pitaraṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rudandrauṇiściraṃ dvijāḥ || || 78 || kopena mahatā tatra jvalanvākyamathābravīta || anṛtaṃ procya pitaraṃ nyastaśastraṃ cakāra yaḥ || 79 || pitaraṃ me'dya taṃ pārthamapyanyā tha pāṃḍavān || gṛhītvā keśapāśaṃ yastyaktaśastraśiro'hanat || 3.1.18.80 || chadmanā pārṣataṃ taṃ ca haniṣyāmyacirādaham || kṛṣṇena saha paśyaṃtu pāṇḍavā matparākramam || 81 || iti drauṇirdvijāstatra pratijajñe bhayaṃkaram || tatostaṃ gata āditye rājānaḥ sarva eva te || 82 || ubhaye nihate droṇe prāviśanpaṭamaṇḍapam || aṣṭādaśadinairevaṃ nivṛttamabhavadraṇam || 83 || śalyaṃ karṇaṃ tathānyāṃśca duryodhanamukhāṃstataḥ || dhārtarāṣṭrānnihatyājau dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 84 || svīyānāṃ ca pareṣāṃ ca mṛtānāṃ sāṃparāyikam || akarodvidhivadviprāḥ sārdhaṃ dhaumyā dibhirdvijaiḥ || 85 || vaṃditvā dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca sarve saṃbhūya pāṇḍavāḥ || dhṛtarāṣṭrābhyanujñātā hataśiṣṭajanairvṛtāḥ || 86 || saṃprāpya hāstinapuraṃ prāviśaṃste svamaṃdiram|| tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu gateṣu kila nāgarāḥ || 87 || dhaumyādimunibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dharmajasya mahātmanaḥ || rājyā bhiṣecanaṃ kartuṃ prārabhaṃta munīśvarāḥ || || rājyābhiṣecane tasya pravṛtte dharmajasya tu || aśarīrā tato vāṇī babhāṣe dharmanaṃdanam || 89 || dharma putra mahābhāga ripūṇāmapi vatsala || rājyābhiṣekaṃ mā kārṣīrnārhastvaṃ rājyapālane || 3.1.18.90 || yatastvaṃ chadmanācāryamuktvā satyaṃ dvijottamam || nyasta śastraṃ raṇe rājannaghātayadalajjakaḥ || 91 || ataste pāpabāhulyaṃ vidyate dharmanaṃdana || prāyaścittamakṛtvāsya rājyapālanakarmaṇi || 92 || nārhatā vidyate yasmātprāyaścittamataścara || ityuktvā virarāmātha sā tu vāgaśarīriṇī || 93 || tato dharmasuto rājā tadvākyaṃ bhṛśakātaraḥ || mūḍho'haṃ sāhasī krūraḥ piśuno lobhamohitaḥ || 94 || tuccharājyābhilāṣeṇa kṛtavānpāpamīdṛśam|| etatpāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi kā gatiḥ || 95 || kiṃ vā dānaṃ pradāsyāmi kutra yāsyāmi vā punaḥ || iti śokasamāviṣṭe tasminrājani dharmaje || 96 || kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāsassamāyātastadaṃtikam || tato'bhivaṃdya taṃ vyāsaṃ pratyutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 97 || saṃpūjyārghyādinā viprā bhaktiyuktena cetasā || adehavācā yatproktaṃ tatsarvamakhilena saḥ || || 98 || vyāsāya śrāvayāmāsa duḥkhito dharmanaṃdanaḥ || śrutvā tadakhilaṃ vākyaṃ dharmajasya mahāmuniḥ || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ tato vaktuṃ praca krame ||99|| || vyāsa uvāca || || mā kārṣīstvaṃ bhayaṃ rājannupāyaṃ prabravīmi te|| asya pāpasya śāṃtyarthaṃ śrutvānuṣṭhīyatāṃ tvayā || 3.1.18.100 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kiṃ tadbrūhi mahāyoginpārāśarya kṛpānidhe || yena me pāpanāśaḥ syādacirāttadvadādhunā || 101 || || vyāsa uvāca || || dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhau setau gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 102 || rāmasetau mahārāja rāmatīrthamiti śrutam || asti puṇyaṃ saraḥ siddhaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 103 || yasya darśanamātreṇa mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ || prayāṃti vilayaṃ sadyastamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ||104|| rāmatīrthaṃ yadā paśyetsvayaṃ rāmeṇa nirmitam || tadaiva brahmahatyāyā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 105 || tatra gatvā mahārāja rāmatīrthe vimuktide || snāhi te pāpaśuddhiḥ syādrājyarakṣārhatāpi ca || 106 || dānaṃ kuruṣva tattīre gobhūmitilavāsasām || suvarṇarajatānāṃ ca dānaṃ kuru yudhiṣṭhira || avaśyametatpāpānāṃ śuddhiste na cirādbhavet || 107 || || śrīsūta uvāca || vyāsena dharmaputro'yamevamukto dvijottamāḥ || 109 || tatkṣaṇenaiva dhaumyena sahitaḥ sānujastadā || sahadevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya rājye dharmātmajastadā || 109 || rāmasetuṃ samuddiśya pratasthe vāhanaṃ vinā || dinaiḥ katipayaireva rāmasetuṃ jagāma saḥ || 3.1.18.110 || rāmatīrthaṃ samāsādya dhaumyena saha pāṃḍavaḥ || purohitoktamārgeṇa saṃkalpya vidhipūrvakam|| 111 || sasnau rāmasarastīrthe puṇye pāpavināśane || snātvācamya viśuddhātmā kṣetrapiṃḍaṃ pradāya ca || 112 || vyāso ktākhiladānāni pradadau sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || māsamekaṃ nirāhāraḥ sasnau tatra sa dharmajaḥ || 113 || pratyahaṃ ca dadau dānaṃ vittalobhaṃ vinā dvijāḥ || eka māse gate tvevaṃ kasmiṃściddivase tataḥ || 114 || āha dharmātmajaṃ vāṇī punarapyaśarīriṇī || rājaṃste vilayaṃ yātaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 115 || chale nāsatyavacanādācāryasya vadhena yaḥ || doṣaste samabhūtpūrvaṃ so'pi naṣṭaḥ paraṃtapa || 116 || yāhi svanagaraṃ rājangatvā pālaya medinīm || abhiṣecaya cātmānaṃ rājyarakṣārhatāsti te || 117 || ityuktvā virarāmātha sāpi vāgaśarīriṇī || tato dharmātmajaḥ prītastāmuddiśya diśaṃ prati || 118 || namaskṛtvāśarīriṇyai tasyai vāce sahānujaḥ || prayayau hāstinapuraṃ suprītenāṃtarātmanā|| 119 || abhiṣikto'tha rājye'sau pālayāmāsa medinīm || itthaṃ dharmātmajo viprā rāmatīrthanimajjanāt || 3.1.18.120 || gatapāpo viśuddhātmā yogyo'bhūdrājyarakṣaṇe || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ citraṃ rāmatīrthasya vaibhavam || 121 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktimuktipradāyakam || yatra snānādvimukto'bhūnmithyādoṣātsa dharmajaḥ || 122 || paṭhaṃti ye' dhyāyamidaṃ dvijottamāḥ śṛṇvaṃti vā ye manujā vipātakāḥ || yāsyaṃti kailāsamananyalabhyaṃ gatvā na saṃyāṃti punaśca janma || || 123 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ maṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ dharmaputramithyā kathanadoṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<3.1.19>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || tārakabrahmaṇastasya tīrthe snātvā dvijottamāḥ || lakṣmaṇasya tatastīrthamabhigacchetsamāhitaḥ || 1 || śrīlakṣmaṇasya tīrthe tu snātvā pāpairvimocitāḥ || muktiṃ prayāṃti vimalāmapunarbhavalakṣaṇām||2|| snānāllakṣmaṇatīrthe tu dāridryaṃ naśyatekhilam || āyuṣmānguṇavānvidvānputraścaivāsya jāyate || 3 || kūle lakṣmaṇatīrthasya tanmantraṃ japate tu yaḥ || sa sarvaśāstravettā syāccaturvedavidapyasau || 4 || tasya kūle mahalliṃgaṃ sthāpayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ || tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sevate lakṣmaṇeśvaram || 5|| iha dāridryarogābhyāṃ saṃsārācca vimucyate || snātvā lakṣmaṇatīrthe tu sevitvā lakṣmaṇeśvaram || balabhadraḥ purā viprā mumuce brahmahatyayā || 6 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || brahmahatyā kathamabhūdrauhiṇeyasya sūtaja || kathaṃ cātra vinaṣṭā sā tanno brūhi mahāmune || 7 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śeṣāvatāro bhagavānbalabhadraḥ purā dvijāḥ || 8 || kurūṇāṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca yuddhodyogaṃ vilokya tu || baṃdhūnāṃ sa vadhaṃ soḍhumasamartho halāyudhaḥ || 9 || vicāramevamakarodbalabhadro mahāmatiḥ || yadyahaṃ kururājasya kariṣyāmi sahāyatām || 3.1.19.10 || kopaḥ syātpāṃḍuputrāṇāṃ mayyavāryaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || upakāraṃ kariṣyāmi pāṃḍavānāmahaṃ yadi || 11 || duryodhanasya kopaḥ syāditi buddhvā halāyudhaḥ || tīrthayātrācchalenāsau madhyasthaḥ prayayau tadā || 12 || prabhāsamabhigamyātha snātvā saṃkalpapūrvakam|| devānṛṣīnpitṛgaṇāṃstarpayāmāsa vāriṇā || 13 || sarasvatīṃ tataḥ prāyātpratīcyabhimukhāṃ halī || pṛthūdakaṃ biṃdusaro muktidaṃ brahmatīrthakam|| 14 || gaṃgāṃ ca yamunāṃ siṃdhuṃ śatadrūṃ ca sudarśanam || saṃprāpya balabhadro'yaṃ snātvā tīrtheṣu dharmataḥ || 15 || prapede naimiṣāraṇyaṃ munīṃdrairabhisevitam || āgataṃ taṃ vilokyātha naimiṣīyāstapasvinaḥ || 16 || dīrghasatre sthitāḥ samyaṅniyatā dharmatatparāḥ || abhyudgamya yaduśreṣṭhaṃ praṇamyotthāya cāsanāt || 17 || apūjayanviṣṭarādyaiḥ kaṃdamūlaphalaistadā || āsanaṃ parigṛhyāyaṃ pūjitaḥ sapuraḥsaraḥ || 18 || uccāsane sthitaṃ sūtamanamaṃtamanutthitam || akṛtāṃjalimāsīnaṃ vyāsaśiṣyaṃ vilokya saḥ || 19 || viprāṃścānamato dṛṣṭvā vilokyātmānamāgatam || cukrodha rohiṇīsūnuḥ sūtaṃ paurāṇikottamam|| 3.1.19.20 || madhye munīnāṃ sūto'yaṃ kasmānniṃdyo'nulomajaḥ || uccāsane samadhyāste na yuktamidamaṃjasā || || 21 || avamatya bhṛśaṃ cāsmāndharmasaṃrakṣakānayam || āste'nutthāya nirbhītirna ca praṇamate tathā || 22 || paṭhitvāyaṃ purāṇāni dvaipāyanasakāśataḥ || setihāsāni sarvāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ || 23 || na māṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamate naiva tyajati cāsanam || dvaipāyanasya mahataḥ śiṣyāḥ pailādayo dvijāḥ || 24 || evaṃvidhamadharmaṃ te naiva kuryuryathā tvayam || tasmādenaṃ vadhiṣyāmi durātmānamacetanam || 25 || duṣṭānāṃ nigrahārthaṃ hi bhūrlokamahamāgamam || mayā hato hi duṣṭātmā śuddhimeṣyatyasaṃśayam || 26 || ityuktvā bhagavānrāmo musalī prabalo halī || pāṇisthena kuśāgreṇa tacchiraḥ prācchinadruṣā || 27 || tatratyā munayaḥ sarve hā kaṣṭamiti cukruśuḥ || avādiṣustadā rāmaṃ munayo brahmavādinaḥ || 28 || rāmādharmaḥ kṛtaḥ kaṣṭastvayā saṃkarṣaṇa prabho || asya sūtasya cāsmābhirdattaṃ brahmāsanaṃ mahat || 29 || akṣayaṃ cāyurasmābhirasya dattaṃ halāyudha || bhavatā''jānataivādya kṛto brahmavadho mahān || 3.1.19.30 || yogeśvarasya bhavato nāsti kaścinniyāmakaḥ || asyāstu brahmahatyāyā yatkarttavyaṃ vicārya tat || 31 || prāyaścittaṃ bhavāneva lokasaṃgrahaṇāya tu || kuruṣva bhagavanrāma nānyena preritaḥ kuru || ityukto bhagavānrāmastānuvāca munīnprati || 32 || || rāma uvāca || || prāyaścittaṃ cariṣyābhi pāpaśodhakamāstikāḥ || 33 || lokasaṃgrahaṇārthāya nānyakāmanayā'dhunā || yādṛśo niyamo'smābhiḥ kartavyaḥ pāpaśāṃtaye || 34 || tādṛśaṃ niyamaṃ tvadya bhavataḥ prabruvaṃtu naḥ || bhavadbhirasya sūtasya yadāyurdattamakṣayam || iṃdriyāṇi ca sattvaṃ ca kariṣye yogamāyayā ||35 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || parākramasya testrasya mṛtyornaśca yathā prabho || syātsatyavacanaṃ rāma tadbhavānkartumarhati || 36 || || || rāma uvāca || || ātmā vai putrarūpeṇa bhavatīti śrutissadā ||37 || udghoṣayati vipreṃdrāstasmādasya śarīrataḥ || putro bhavatu dīrghāyuḥ sattveṃdriya balorjitaḥ || 39 || kathayiṣyati yuṣmākaṃ purāṇādīni so'nvaham || saṃbhaviṣyati sarvajño yogamāyābalānmama || 39 || ityuktvā rauhiṇeyastānpunaḥ praśritamabravīt || manobhilaṣitaṃ kiṃ vā yuṣmākaṃ karavāṇyaham || 3.1.19.40 || tadbrūta munayo yūyaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || ajñānānmatkṛtasyāsya pāpasyāpi nivartakam || prāyaścittaṃ bhavanto me prabrūta munisattamāḥ || 41 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || ilvalasyātmajaḥ kaściddānavo balvalābhidhaḥ || 42 || sa dūṣayati no yāgaṃ rāmehāgatya parvaṇi || duṣṭaṃ taṃ dānavaṃ pāpaṃ jahi lokaikakaṇṭakam ||43 || anena pūjā hyasmākaṃ kṛtā syādbhavatādhunā || asthiviṇmūtraraktāni surāmāṃsāni ca kratau || 44 || sadābhivarṣate'smākamatrāgatya sa dānavaḥ || asminbhāratabhūbhāge yāni tīrthāni saṃti hi || 45 || teṣu snāhyabdamekaṃ tvaṃ sarveṣu susamāhitaḥ || tena te pāpaśāṃtiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 46 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || parvakāle tu vipreṃdrāḥ samāvṛtte munikratau || mahābhīmo rajovarṣo jhaṃjhāvātaśca bhīṣaṇaḥ || 47 || prādurbabhūva vipreṃdrāḥ pūyaraktaiśca varṣaṇam || tato viṣṭhāmayā vṛṣṭirbalvalena kṛtāpyabhūt || 49 || asuraṃ yajñaśālāyāṃ śūlapāṇimatha kṣaṇāt || apaśyadbalabhadro'sau mahābalaparākramam || 49 || tamālokya mahādehaṃ dagdhādripratimaṃ tadā || prataptatāmrasaṃkāśaśmaśrudaṃṣṭrotkaṭānanam || 3.1.19.50 || ciṃtayāmāsa musalaṃ rāmaḥ paravidāraṇam|| sīraṃ ca dānavaharaṃ gadāṃ daityavidāriṇīm || 51 || yānyāyudhāni taṃ rāmaṃ ciṃtitānyupatasthire || sīrāgreṇa tamākṛṣya balvalaṃ khecaraṃ tadā || 52 || musalena nijaghne sa kupito mūrdhni vegataḥ || papāta bhuvi saṃkṣuṇṇalalāṭo raktamudvaman || 53 || balvalo dīnakathano girirvajrahato yathā || stutvātha munayo rāmaṃ proccārya vimalāśiṣaḥ || 94 || abhyaṣiṃcañcchubhaistoyairvṛtraśatruṃ yathā surāḥ || mālāṃ dadurvaijayantīṃ śrīmadaṃbuja śobhitām || 55 || mādhavāya śubhe vastre bhūṣaṇāni śubhāni ca || dhārayaṃstāni sarvāṇi rauhiṇeyo mahābalaḥ ||56|| puṣpitānokahopetaḥ kailāsa iva parvataḥ || anujñāto'tha munibhiḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sa dvijāḥ || 57 || ekamabdaṃ caransasnau niyamācārasaṃyutaḥ || tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kāliṃdībhedano balaḥ || 58 || samāptatīrthayātraḥ sanpurīṃ gantuṃ pracakrame || tatastamomayīṃ chāyāṃ pṛṣṭhatonugatāṃ kṛśām || 59 || apaśyadbaladevoyaṃ mahānādavirāviṇīm || atha vārtā sa śuśrāva samudbhūtāṃ tadāṃbare || 3.1.19.60 || rāmarāma mahābāho rauhiṇeya sitaprabha || tīrthābhigamanenādya caritena tvayā'nagha || || 61 || na naṣṭā brahmahatyā te niḥśeṣaṃ rohiṇīsuta || iti vārtāṃ samākarṇya ciṃtayāmāsa vai balaḥ || 62 || prāyaścittaṃ mayā cīrṇamekābdaṃ tīrtha sevayā || tathāpi brahmahatyā sā na naṣṭeti śrutaṃ vacaḥ || 63 || kiṃ kurma iti saṃciṃtya naimiṣāraṇyamabhyagāt || tatra gatvā munīnāṃ tannyavedayadariṃdamaḥ || 64 || yacchrutaṃ gagane vākyaṃ yā ca dṛṣṭā tamomayī || nyavedayata tatsarvaṃ munīnāṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ || tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve rāmaṃ vākyamathābruvan || 65 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || yadi rāma na naṣṭā te brahmahatyā tu kṛtsnaśaḥ || 66 || tarhi gaccha mahābhāga gaṃdhamādanaparvatam || mahāduḥkha praśamanaṃ mahārogavināśanam || 67 || rāmasetau mahāpuṇye gandhamādanaparvate || asti lakṣmaṇatīrthākhyaṃ saraḥ pāpavināśanam || 68 || snānaṃ kuruṣva tatra tvaṃ talliṃgaṃ ca namaskuru || niḥśeṣaṃ tena naṣṭā syādbrahmahatyā na saṃśayaḥ || 69 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktastadā rāmo gandhamādanaparvatam || gatvā lakṣmaṇatīrthaṃ ca prāptavānmunipuṃgavāḥ || 3.1.19.70 || snātvā saṃkalpapūrvaṃ tu tatra tīrthe halāyudhaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittaṃ dhānyaṃ gāśca vasundharām || 71 || tasminnavasare tatra rāmamāhāśarīravāk || niḥśeṣaṃ rāma naṣṭā te brahmahatyādhunā tviha || 72 || saṃdeho nātra kartavyaḥ sukhaṃ yāhi purīṃ nijām || tacchrutvā balabhadro'tha tattīrthaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha || 73 || tatastatratyatīrtheṣu snātvā sarveṣu mādhavaḥ || dhanuṣkoṭau tathā snātvā rāmanāthaṃ niṣevya ca || dvārakāṃ svapurīṃ prāyānnaṣṭapātakasaṃcayaḥ || 74 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ śrīlakṣmaṇasaro'malam || 75 || puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ brahmahatyādiśodhakam || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || 76 || sa yāti muktiṃ vipreṃdrāḥ punarāvṛttivarjitām || 77 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye lakṣmaṇatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ balabhadrabrahmahatyāvimokṣaṇanāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<3.1.20>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || lakṣmaṇasya mahātīrthe brahmahatyāvināśane || snātvā svacittaśuddhyarthaṃ jaṭātīrthaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || janmamṛtyujarākrāṃtasaṃsārāturacetasām || ajñānanāśakaṃ nāsti jaṭātīrthādṛte dvijāḥ || 2 || loke mumukṣavaḥ keciccittaśuddhimabhīpsavaḥ || vācā paṭhaṃti vedāṃtāṃstūṣṇīnnānubhavaṃti te || 3 || pūrvapakṣamahāgrāhe siddhāṃtajhaṣasaṃkule || vedāṃtābdhāvihājñānaṃ muhyaṃti patitā dvijāḥ || 4 || prathamaṃ cittaśuddhyarthaṃ vedāṃtānsaṃpaṭhaṃti ye || vivadaṃte paṭhitvā te kalahaṃ ca vitanvate || 5 || cittaśuddhirna vedāṃtādbahuvyāmohakāraṇāt || tato vayaṃ na vedāṃtānmunīṃdrā bahu manmahe || 6 || cittaśuddhiṃ yadīcchadhvaṃ laghūpāyena tāpasāḥ || udghoṣayāmi sarveṣāṃ jaṭātīrthaṃ niṣevata || 7 || purā sarvopakārārthaṃ tīrthamajñānanāśanam || etadvinirmitaṃ sākṣācchambhunā gandhamādane || 8 || nihate rāvaṇe viprā jaṭāṃ rāmastu dhārmikaḥ || kṣālayāmāsa yattoye tajjaṭātīrthamucyate || 9 || varṣāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ jāhnavījalamajjanam || godāvaryāṃ sakṛtsnānaṃ siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau || 3.1.20.10 || tāvatsahasrasnānāni siṃhaṃ devagurau gate || gomatyāṃ labhyate varṣaistajjaṭātīrthadarśanāt || 11 || jaṭātīrthe manuṣyāṇāṃ snātānāṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || antaḥkaraṇaśuddhiḥ syāttato'jñānaṃ vinaśyati || 12 || ajñānanāśe jñānaṃ syāttato muktimavāpsyasi || akhaṇḍasaccidānaṃdasaṃpūrṇaḥ syāttataḥ param || 13 || atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || pituḥ putrasya saṃvādaṃ vyāsasya ca śukasya ca || 14 || purā munivaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhāvi tātmānamacyutam || pāraṃparyaviśeṣajñaṃ sarvaśāstrārthakovidam || praṇamya śirasā vyāsaṃ śukaḥ papraccha vai dvijāḥ || 15 || || śrīśuka uvāca || || bhagavaṃstāta sarvajña brūhi guhyamanuttamam || 16 || antaḥkaraṇaśuddhiḥ syāttathājñānavināśanam || jñānodayaśca yena syādaṃte muktiśca śāśvatī || 17 || tamupāyaṃ vadasvādya snehānmama mahāmune || vedāṃtāścetihāsāśca purāṇādīni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 18 || adhītāni mayā tvattaḥ śodhayaṃti na mānasam || ato me cittaśuddhiḥ syādyathā tāta tathā vada || 19 || iti pṛṣṭastadā vyāsaḥ śukena munisattamāḥ || rahasyaṃ kathayāmāsa yenāvidyā vina śyati || 3.1.20.20 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śuka vakṣyāmi te guyamavidyāgranthibhedanam || buddhiśuddhipradaṃ puṃsāṃ janmādibhayanāśanam || 21 || rāmasetau mahāpuṇyaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || vidyate pāpasaṃhāri jaṭātīrthamiti śrutam || 22 || jaṭāṃ svāṃ śodhayāmāsa yatra rāmo hariḥ svayam || rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmāṃstīrthāya ca varaṃ dadau || 23 || snāti ye'tra samāgatya jaṭātīrthe'tipāvane || antaḥkaraṇaśuddhiśca teṣāṃ bhūyāditi sma saḥ || 24 || vinā yajñaṃ vinā jñānaṃ vinā jāpyamupoṣaṇam || snānamātrājjaṭātīrthe buddhiśuddhirbhavennṛṇām || 25 || sarvadānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ snānādatra bhaviṣyati || durgāṇyanena tarati puṇyalokānsamaśnute || 26 || mahattvamaśnute snānājjaṭātīrthe śubhodake || jaṭātīrthaṃ vinā nānyadaṃtaḥkaraṇa śuddhaye || 27 || vidyate niyamo vāpi japo vā nānyadevatā || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || 28 || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca jaṭātīrthaṃ śukādhunā || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam || 29 || bhṛgurvai vāruṇiḥ pūrvaṃ varuṇaṃ pitaraṃ śuka || buddhiśuddhipradopāyamapṛcchatpāvanaṃ śubham || provāca varuṇastasmai buddhiśuddhipradaṃ śubham || 3.1.20.30 || || varuṇa uvāca || || rāmasetau bhṛgo puṇye gandhamādanaparvate || 31 || snānamātrājjaṭā tīrthe buddhiśuddhirbhaveddhruvam || sa piturvacanātsadyo bhṛgurvai varuṇātmajaḥ || 32 || gatvā snātvā jaṭātīrthe buddhiśuddhimavāptavān || vinaṣṭājñānasaṃtānastayā śuddhyā tadā bhṛguḥ || 33 || utpannādvaitavijñānaḥ svapiturvaruṇādayam || akhaṇḍasaccidānaṃdapūrṇākāro'bhavacchuka || 34 || śaṃkarāṃśo'pi durvāsā jaṭātīrthe'bhiṣekataḥ || manaḥśuddhimavāpyāśu brahmānaṃdamayo'bhavat || 35 || dattātreyo'pi viṣṇvaṃśastīrthe'sminnabhiṣecanāt || śuddhāṃtaḥkaraṇo bhūtvā brahmākāro'bhavacchuka || 36 || icchedajñānanāśaṃ yaḥ sa snāyāttu jaṭābhidhe || tīrthe śuddhatame puṇye sarvapāpavināśane || 37 || jaṭātīrthamatastvaṃ ca śuka gaccha mahāmate || manaḥśuddhipradaṃ tasminsnānaṃ ca kuru puṇyade || 38 || pitraivamukto vyāsena śukaḥ putrastadā dvijāḥ || rāmasetuṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam || 39 || agamatsnātukāmaḥ sañjaṭātīrthe viśuddhide || snātvā saṃkalpapṛrvaṃ ca jaṭātīrthe śuko muniḥ || 3.1.20.40 || manaḥśuddhimanuprāpya tena cājñānanāśane || svasvarūpaṃ samāpannaḥ paramānaṃdarūpakam || 41 || ye cāpyanye manaḥśuddhikāmāḥ saṃti dvijottamāḥ || jaṭātīrthe tu te sarve snātuṃ bhaktipuraḥsarama || 42 || aho janā jaṭātīrthe kāmadhenusame śubhe || vidyamāne'pi kiṃ tucche ramaṃtenyatra mohitāḥ || 43 || bhuktikāmo labhedbhuktiṃ muktikāmastu tāṃ labhet || snānamātrājjaṭātīrthe satyamuktaṃ mayā dvijāḥ || 44 || vedānuvaca nātpuṇyādyajñāddānāttapovratāt|| upavāsājjapādyogānmanaḥśuddhirnṛṇāṃ bhavet || 45 || vināpyetāni vipreṃdrā jaṭātīrthe'tipāvane || snānamātrānmanaḥśuddhirbrāhmaṇānāṃ dhruvaṃ bhavet || 46 || jaṭātīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || śaṃkaro vetti tattīrthaṃ harirvetti vidhistathā || 47 || jaṭātīrthasamaṃtīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati|| jaṭātīrthasya tīre yaḥ kṣetrapiṃḍaṃ samācaret||48|| gayāśrāddhasamaṃpuṇyaṃtasya syānnātra saṃśayaḥ|| jaṭātīrthe naraḥ snātvā na pāpena vilipyate|| dāridryaṃ na samāpnoti neyācca narakārṇavam||49|| śrīsūta uvāca|| evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā jaṭātīrthasya vaibhavam || 3.1.20.50 || yatra vyāsasuto yogī snātvā pāpavimocane || avāptavānmanaḥśuddhimadvaitajñānasādhanām || 51 || yastvimaṃ paṭhate'dhyāyaṃ śṛṇute vā samāhitaḥ || sa vidhūyeha pāpāni labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 52 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyebrahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye jaṭātīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ śukacittaśuddhivarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || <3.1.21>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || jaṭā tīrthābhidhe tīrthe sarvapātakanāśane || snānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhātmā lakṣmītīrthaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ samuddiśya lakṣmītīrthe dvijottamāḥ || snānaṃ samācarenmartyastaṃtaṃ kāmaṃ samaśnute || 2 || mahādāridryaśamanaṃ mahādhānyasamṛddhidam || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ mahāsaṃpadvivardhanam || 3 || atra snātvā dharmaputro mahadaiśvaryamāptavān || indraprasthe vasanpūrvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇena pracoditaḥ || 4 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yathaiśvaryaṃ dharmaputro lakṣmītīrthe nimajjanāt || āptavānkṛṣṇavacanāttanno brūhi mahāmune || 5 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || indraprasthe purā viprā dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa coditāḥ || nyavasanpāṃḍavāḥ paṃca mahābalaparākramāḥ || 6 || indraprasthaṃ yayau kṛṣṇaḥ kadācittānnirīkṣitum || tamāgatamebhiprekṣya pāṃḍavāste samutsukāḥ || 7 || svagṛhaṃ prāpayāmāsurmudā paramayā yutāḥ || kañcitkālamasau kṛṣṇastatrāvātsītpurottame || 8 || kadācitkṛṣṇamāhūya pūjayitvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || papraccha puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatim || 9 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa mahāprājña yena dharmeṇa mānavāḥ || labhaṃte mahadaiśvaryaṃ tanno brūhi mahāmate || ityukto dharmaputreṇa kṛṣṇaḥ prāha yudhiṣṭhiram || 3.1.21.10 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || dharmaputra mahābhāga gandhamādanaparvate || 11 || lakṣmī tīrthamiti khyātamastyaiśvaryaikakāraṇam || tatra snānaṃ kuruṣva tvamaiśvaryaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 12 || tatra snānena vardhaṃte dhanadhānyasamṛddhayaḥ || sarve sapatnā naśyaṃti kṣātrameṣāṃ vivarddhate || 13 || tīrthe sasnuḥ purā devā lakṣmīnāmani puṇyade || alabhantsarvamaiśvaryaṃ tena puṇyena dharmaja || 14 || asurāṃśca mahāvīryānsamare jaghnuraṃjasā || mahī lakṣmīśca dharmaśca tattīrthasnāyināṃ nṛṇām || 15 || bhaviṣyatyacirādeva saṃśayaṃ mā kṛthā iha || tapobhiḥ kratubhirdānairāśīrvādaiśca pāṃḍava || 16 || aiśvaryaṃ prāpyate yadvallakṣmītīrthanimajjanāt || sarvapāpāni naśyaṃti viprā yāṃti layaṃ sadā || || 17 || vyādhayaśca vinaśyaṃti lakṣmītīrthaniṣevaṇāt || śreyaḥ suvipulaṃ loke labhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 || snānamātreṇa vai lakṣmyāstīrthe'smi ndharmanaṃdana || raṃbhāmapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ labdhavānavadho nṛpaḥ || 19 || snātvātra tīrthe puṇye tu kubero naravāhanaḥ || sa mahāpadmamukhyānāṃ nidhīnāṃ nāyako' bhavat ||3.1.21.2||| tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra lakṣmītīrthe śubhaprade || snātvā vṛkodaramukhairanujairapi saṃvṛtaḥ ||21|| lapsyase mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ jeṣyase ca ripūnapi|| saṃdeho nātra kartavyaḥ paitṛṣvaseya dharmaja ||22|| ityukto dharmaputro'yaṃ kṛṣṇenādbhutadarśanaḥ || sānujaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ gandhamādanaparvatam ||23|| lakṣmī tīrthaṃ tato gatvā mahadaiśvaryakāraṇam || sasnau yudhiṣṭhirastatra sānujo niyamānvitaḥ||24|| lakṣmatīrthasya toye sa sarvapātakanāśane || sānujo māsamekaṃ tu sasnau niyamapūrvakam ||25|| gobhūtilahiraṇyādīnbrāhmaṇebhyo dadau bahūn || sānujo dharmaputro'sāviṃdraprasthaṃ yayau tataḥ || 26 || rājasūyakratuṃ kartuṃ tata ecchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ || kṛṣṇaṃ samāhvayāmāsa yiyakṣurdharmanaṃdanaṃ || 27 || kṛṣṇo dharmajadūtena samāhūtaḥ sasaṃbhramaḥ || caturbhiraśvaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ rathamā ruhya veginam || 28 || satyabhāmāsahacara iṃdraprasthaṃ samāyayau || tamāgataṃ samālokya pramodāddharmanaṃdanaḥ || 29 || nyavedayatsa kṛṣṇāya rājasūyodyamaṃ tadā || anvamanyata kṛṣṇopi tathaiva kriyatāmiti || 3.1.21.30 || vākyaṃ ca yuktisaṃyuktaṃ dharmaputramabhāṣata || paitṛṣvasreya dharmātmañcchṛṇu pathyaṃ vaco mama || || 31 || duṣkaro rājasūyo'yaṃ sarvairapi mahīśvaraiḥ || anekaśatapādātarathakuṃjaravājimān || 32 || mahīpatirimaṃ yajñaṃ kartumarhati netaraḥ || diśo daśa vijetavyā prathamaṃ valinā tvayā || 33 || parājitebhyaḥ śatrubhyo gṛhītvā karamuttamam || tena kāṃcanajātena kartavyo'yaṃ kratūttamaḥ || 34 || rocaye yuktividahaṃ na hi tvāṃ bhīṣayāmi bhoḥ || ataḥ kratusamāraṃbhātpūrvaṃ digvijayaṃ kuru || 35 || tato dharmātmajaḥ śrutvā kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ hitam || praśaṃsandevakīputramājuhāva nijānujān || 36 || āhūya caturo bhrātṝndharmajaḥ prāha harṣayan || ayi bhīma mahābāho bahuvīrya dhanaṃjaya || 37 || yamau ca sukumāgaṃgau śatrusaṃhāradīkṣitau || cikīrṣāmi mahāyajñaṃ rājasūyamanuttamam || 38 || sa ca sarvānraṇe jitvā kartavyaḥ pṛthivīpatīn || ato vijetuṃ bhūpālāṃścatvaro'pi sasainikāḥ || 39 || diśaścatasro gacchaṃtu bhavaṃto vīryavattarāḥ || yuṣmābhirāhatairdravyaiḥ kariṣyāmi mahākratum || 3.1.21.40 || ityuktāḥ sādaraṃ sarve vṛkodaramukhāstadā || prasannavadanā bhūtvā dharmaputrānujāḥ purāt || 41 || rājñāṃ jayāya sarvāsu niryayurdikṣu pāṃḍavāḥ || te sarve nṛpatīñjitvā caturdikṣu sthitānbahūn || 42 || svavaśe sthāpayitvā tānnṛpatīnpāṃḍunaṃdanāḥ || tairdattaṃ bahudhā dravyamasaṃkhyātamanuttamam || 43 || ādāya svapuraṃ tūrṇamāyayuḥ kṛṣṇasaṃśrayāḥ || bhīmaḥ samāyayau tatra mahābalaparākramaḥ || 44 || śatabhārasuvarṇāni samādāya purottamam || sahasraṃ bhāramādāya suvarṇānāṃ tato'rjunaḥ || 45 || śakraprasthaṃ samāyāto mahābalaparākramaḥ || śatabhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ pragṛhya nakulastathā || 46 || samāgato mahātejāḥ śakraprasthaṃ purottamam || dattānvibhīṣaṇenātha svarṇatālāṃścaturdaśa || 47 || dākṣiṇātyamahīpānāṃ gṛhītvā dhanasaṃcayam || sahadevopi sahasā samā yāto nijāṃ purīm || 48 || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatānyapi || suvarṇāni dadau kṛṣṇo dharmaputrāya yādavaḥ || 49 || svānujairāhṛtairevamasaṃ khyātairmahādhanaiḥ || kṛṣṇadattairasaṃkhyātairdhanairapi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 3.1.21.50 || kṛṣṇāśrayo'yajadviprā rājasūyena pāṃḍavaḥ || tasminyāge dadau dravyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yatheṣṭataḥ || 51 || annāni pradadau tatra brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || vastrāṇi gāśca bhūmiṃ ca bhūṣaṇāni dadau tathā || 52 || arthinaḥ parituṣyaṃti yāvatā kāṃcanādinā || tatopi dviguṇaṃ tebhyo dāpayāmāsa dharmajaḥ || 53 || iyaṃti dattānyarthibhyo dhanāni vividhānyapi || itīyattāṃ paricchettuṃ na śaktā brahmakoṭayaḥ || 54 || arthibhirdīyamānāni dṛṣṭvā tatra dhanāni vai || sarvasvamapyaho rājñā dattamityabravījjanaḥ || 55 || dṛṣṭvā kośāstathā naṃtānanaṃtamaṇikāṃcanān || 5 || svalpaṃ hi dattamarthibhya ityavocañjanāstadā || iṣṭvaivaṃ rājasūyena dharmaputraḥ sahānujaḥ || 57 || bahuvittasamṛddhaḥ sanreme tatra purottame || lakṣmītīrthasya māhātmyāddharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 58 || lebhe sarvamidaṃ viprā aho tīrthasya vaibhavam || idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahā dāridyanāśanam || 59 || dhanadhānyapradaṃ puṃsāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || mahānarakasaṃhartṛ mahāduḥkhanivartakam || 3.1.21.60 || mokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ nityaṃ mahāṛṇa vimocanam || sukalatrapradaṃ puṃsāṃ suputrapradameva ca || 61 || etattīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprā lakṣmītīrthasya vaibhavam || 62|| duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaprasādhakam || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇute vā sabhaktikam || 63 || dhanadhānyasamṛddhaḥ syātsa naro nāsti saṃśayaḥ || bhuktveha sakalānbhogāndehāṃte muktimāpnuyāt || 64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye lakṣmītīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ dharmaputraniratiśayasaṃpadavāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<3.1.22>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || lakṣmītīrthe śubhe puṃsāṃ sarvaiśvaryaikakāraṇe || snātvā narastato gacchedagnitīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 1 || agnitīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaikasādhanam || tatra snāyānnaro bhaktyā svapāpapariśuddhaye || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || agnirtārthamitikhyātiḥ kathaṃ tasya munīśvara || || 3 || kutraidamagnitīrthaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ tasya vaibhavam || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || samyakpṛṣṭaṃ hi yuṣmābhiḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || purā hi rāghavo hatvā rāvaṇaṃ saparicchadam || 5 || sthāpayitvā tu laṃkāyāṃ bhartāraṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam || sītāsaumitrisaṃyukto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || 6 || siddhacāraṇagaṃdhavairdevairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || stūyamāno munigaṇaiḥ satyāśīstīrthakautukī || 7 || dhārayam̐llīlayā cāpaṃ rāmo'sahyaparākramaḥ || ātmanaḥ śuddhimādhātuṃ jānakīṃ śodhitu tathā || 8 || iṃdrādidevavṛndaiśca munibhiḥ pitṛbhistathā || vibhīṣaṇena sahitaḥ sarverapi ca vānaraiḥ||9|| āyayau setumārgeṇa gaṃdhamādanaparvatam|| lakṣmītīrthataṭe sthitvā jānakīśodhanāya saḥ||3.1.22.10|| agnimāvāhayāmāsa devarṣipitṛsannidhau|| athottasthau mahāṃbhodherlakṣmītīrthādvidūrataḥ||11|| paśyatsu sarvalokeṣu lihannaṃbhāṃsi pāvakaḥ|| ātāmralocanaḥ pītavāsā dhanurdharaḥ || 12 || saptabhiścaiva jihvābhirlelihāno diśo daśa || dṛṣṭvā raghupatiṃ śūraṃ līlāmānuṣarūpiṇam || 13 || jagāda vacanaṃ ramyaṃ jānakīśuddhikāraṇāt || rāmarāma mahābāho rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvaha || 14 || pātivratyena jānakyā rāvaṇaṃ hatavānbhavān || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 15 || kamaleyaṃ jaganmātā līlāmānuṣavigrahā || devatve devadeheyaṃ manuṣyatve ca mānuṣī || 16 || viṣṇordehānurūpāṃ vai karotye ṣātmanastanum || yadāyadā jagatsvāmindevadeva janārddana || 17 || avatārānkaroṣi tvaṃ tadeyaṃ tvatsahāyinī || yadā tvaṃ bhārgavo rāmastadābhūddharaṇī tviyam || 18 || adhunā jānakī jātā bhavitrī rukmiṇī tataḥ || anyeṣu cāvatāreṣu viṣṇoreṣā sahāyinī || 19 || tasmāmadvacanādenāṃ prati gṛhṇīṣva rāghava || pāvakasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā devā maharṣayaḥ || 3.1.22.20 || vidyādharāśca gaṃdharvā mānavāḥ pannagāstathā || anye ca bhūtanivahā rāmaṃ daśa rathātmajam || 21 || jānakīṃ maithilīṃ caiva praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥpunaḥ || rāmo'gnivacanātsītāṃ pratijagrāha nirmalām || 22 || evaṃ sītāviśuddhyarthaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || āvāhane kṛte vahnirlakṣmītīrthādvidūrataḥ || 23 || yataḥ pradeśāduttasthāvaṃbudherdvijasattamāḥ || agnitīrthaṃ vijānīta taṃ pradeśamanuttamam || 24 || tato vinirgamādagneragnitīrthamitīryate || atra snātvā naro bhaktyā vahnestīrthe vimuktide || 25 || upoṣya vedaviduṣo brāhmaṇā napi bhojayet || tebhyo vastraṃ dhanaṃ bhūmiṃ dadyātkanyāṃ ca bhūṣitām || 26 || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt || agnitīrthasya kūlesmi nnannadānaṃ viśiṣyate || 27 || agnitīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || duṣpaṇyopi mahāpāpo yatra snānātpiśācatām || 28 || parityajya mahā ghorāṃ divyaṃ rūpamavāptavān || paśumānnāma vaiśyo'bhūtpurā pāṭaliputrake || 29 || sa vai dharmaparo nityaṃ brāhmaṇārādhane rataḥ || kṛṣiṃ niraṃtaraṃ kurvango rakṣāṃ caiva sarvadā || 3.1.22.30 || paṇyavīthyāṃ ca vikrīṇankāṃcanādīni dharmataḥ || paśumannāmadheyasya vaṇikchreṣṭhasya tasya vai || 31 || babhūva bhāryātritayaṃ patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratam || jyeṣṭhā trīnsuṣuve putrānvaiśyavaṃśavivarddhanān || 32 || supaṇyaṃ paṇyavataṃ ca cārupaṇyaṃ tathaiva ca || madhyamā suṣute putrau sukośa bahukośakau || 33 || tṛtīyāyāṃ trayaḥ putrāstasya vaiśyasya jajñire || mahāpaṇyo mahākośo duṣpaṇya iti viśrutāḥ || 34 || evaṃ paśumatastasya vaiśyasya dvijasattamāḥ || babhūvuraṣṭau tanayāstāsu strīṣu tisṛṣvapi|| 35 || te supaṇyamukhāḥ sarve putrā vavṛdhire kramāta || dhūlikeliṃ vitanvantaḥ pita rau toṣayaṃti te || 36 || paṃcahāyanatāṃ prāptāḥ kramātte vaiśyanaṃdanāḥ || paśumānapi vaiśyeṃdraḥ sarvānapi ca tānsutān || 37 || bālyamārabhya satataṃ svakṛtyeṣu vyaśikṣayat|| kṛṣigotrāṇavāṇijyakarmasu kramaśikṣitāḥ ||38 || supaṇyamukhyāḥ saptaiva pitṛvākyamaśṛṇvata || paśumānvakti yatkāryaṃ tatkṣa ṇānniravartayan||39|| naipuṇyaṃ prāpuratyaṃtaṃ te suvarṇakriyāsvapi|| duṣpaṇyastvaṣṭamaḥ putro bālyamārabhya saṃtatam||3.1.22.40|| durmārganirato bhūtvā nāśṛṇotpitṛbhā ṣitam|| dhūlikeliṃ samārabhya durmārganirato'bhavat||41|| sa bāla eva sanputro bālānanyānabādhata|| duṣkarmanirataṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ pitā paśumāṃstathā||42|| upekṣā mevakṛtavānbāliśo'yamitīrayan|| athāṣṭāvapi vaiśyasya prāpuryauvanamātmajāḥ||43|| tato'yamaṣṭamaḥ putro duṣṇayo balināṃ varaḥ || gṛhītvā pāṇiyu galebālānnagaravartinaḥ || 44 || nicikṣepa sa kūpeṣu saritsu ca saraḥsvapi || na ko'pi tasya jānāti duścaritramidaṃ janaḥ || 45 || yāvanmriyaṃte te bālāstāvannikṣiptavāñjale || teṣāṃ mṛtānāṃ bālānāṃ pitaro mātarastathā ||46|| gaveṣayaṃti tānsarvānnagareṣu hi sarvaśaḥ || tān dṛṣṭvā ca mṛtānputrānke valaṃ prārudañjanāḥ || 47 || jaleṣvatha śavāndṛṣṭvā janāścakruryathocitam || evaṃ pratidinaṃ bālānduṣpaṇyo mārayanpure || 48 || janairapyaparijñātaściramevamavartata || mriyamāṇeṣu bāleṣu vaiśyaputrasya karmaṇā || 49 || prajānāṃ vṛddhirāhityācchūnyaprāyamabhūtpuram || tataḥ sametya paurāstadvṛttaṃ rājñe nyaveda yan|| 3.1.22.50 || śrutvā nṛpastadvacanamāhūya grāmapālakān || kāraṇaṃ bālamaraṇe ciṃtyatāmiti so'nvaśāt || 51 || grāmapālāstathetyuktvā tatra tatra vyavasthitāḥ || samyaggaveṣayāmāsuḥ kāraṇaṃ bālamāraṇe || 52 || te vai gaveṣaṃyato'pi nāviṃdanbālamārakam || te punarnṛpamāsādya bhītā vākyamathābru van || 53 || gaveṣayaṃto'pi vayaṃ tanna viṃdāmahe nṛpa || yo bālānnagare sthitvā satataṃ mārayatyapi || 54 || punaśca nāgarāḥ sarve rājānaṃ prāpya duḥkhitāḥ || punaḥ prajānāṃ maraṇamabruvanvāṣpasaṃkulāḥ || 55 || rājā tatkāraṇājñānāttūṣṇīmāste viciṃtya tu || kadācidvaiśyaputroyaṃ paṃcabhirbā lakaiḥ saha ||56 || taṭākāṃtikamāpede paṃkajāharaṇacchalāt || balādgṛhītvā tānbālānduṣpaṇyaḥ krośatastadā || 57 || krūrātmā majjayāmāsa kaṃṭha daghne sarojale || mṛtānmatvā ca tāñchīghraṃ duṣpaṇyaḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau || 58 || pañcānāṃ pitarasteṣāṃ mārgayaṃtaḥ sutānpure || teṣu vai mārgamāṇeṣu paṃca tenā tibālakāḥ || 59 || nikṣiptā api toyeṣu nāmriyaṃta yadṛcchayā || te śanaiḥ kūlamāsādya paṃcāpi klinnamaulayaḥ || 3.1.22.60 || aśaktā nagaraṃ gaṃtuṃ bālyāttatraiva babhramuḥ || dūrāduccāryamāṇāni svanāmāni svabaṃdhubhiḥ || 61 || śrutvā paṃcāpi te bālāḥ pratiśabdamakurvata || tatastatpitaraḥ śrutvā tatrāgatyasarastaṭe || 62 || putrāndṛṣṭvā tu saprāṇānpraharṣamatulaṃ gatāḥ || kimetaditi pitrādyaiḥ pṛṣṭāste bālakāstadā || 63 || duṣpaṇyasyātha duṣkṛtyaṃ bandhubhyaste nyavedayan|| tato viditavṛttāṃtā rājānaṃ prāpya nāgarāḥ || 64 || paṃcabhiḥ kathitaṃ vṛttaṃ duṣpaṇyasya nyavedayan || tato rājā samāhūya paśumaṃtaṃ vaṇigvaram || paureṣvapi ca śṛṇvatsu vākyametadabhāṣata || 65 || || rājovāca || || duṣpaṇyanāmā paśumanbahuprajamidaṃ puram || 66 || śūnyaprāyaṃ kṛtaṃ paśya tvatputreṇa durātmanā || idānīṃ bāliśānetānmajjayāmāsa vai jale || 67 || yadṛcchayā ca saprāṇāḥ punarapyā gatāḥ puram || asminnitthaṃ gate kārye kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā || 68 || adya tvāmeva pṛcchāmi yatastvaṃ dharmatatparaḥ || ityuktaḥ paśumānrājñā dharmajño yuktamabravīt || 69 || || paśumānuvāca || || puraṃ niḥśeṣitaṃ yena vadhamevāyamarhati || na hyatra viṣaye kiṃcitpraṣṭavyaṃ vidyate nṛpa || 3.1.22.70 || na hyayaṃ mama putraḥ syācchatrurevātipāpakṛt || na hyasya niṣkṛtiṃ paśye yena niḥśeṣitaṃ puram || 71 || vadhyatāmeva duṣṭātmā satyameva bravīmyaham || śrutvā paśumato vākyaṃ nāgarāḥ sarva eva hi || 72 || vaṇigvaraṃ ślāghamānā rājānamidamūcire || na vadhyatāmayaṃ duṣṭastūṣṇīṃ nirvāsyatāṃ purāt || 73 || tataḥ sa rājā duṣpaṇyaṃ samāhūyedamabravīt || asmāddeśādbhavāñchīghraṃ duṣṭātmangaccha sāṃpratam || 74 || yadi tiṣṭhestvama traiva daṇḍayeyaṃ vadhena vai || iti rājñā vinirbhartsya dūtairnirvāsitaḥ purāt || 75 || duṣpaṇyastvatha taṃ deśaṃ parityajya bhayānvitaḥ || munimaṃḍalasaṃbādhaṃ vanameva yayau tadā || 76 || tatrāpyekaṃ munisutaṃ sa toyeṣu nyamajjayat || kelyarthamāgatā dṛṣṭvā muniputrā mṛtaṃ śiśum || 77 || tatpitre kathayāmāsurabhyetya bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ || tata ugraśravāḥ śrutvā tebhyaḥ putraṃ jale mṛtam || 78 || tapomahimnā duṣpa ṇyacaritaṃ tadamanyata || ugraśravāḥ śaśāpainaṃ duṣpaṇyaṃ vaiśyanaṃdanam || 79 || || ugraśravā uvāca || || matsutaṃ payasi kṣipya yattvaṃ māri tavānasi || tavāpi maraṇaṃ bhūyājjala eva nimajjanāt || 3.1.22.80 || mṛtaśca suciraṃ kālaṃ piśācastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || iti śāpe śrute sadyo duṣpaṇyaḥ khinnamānasaḥ || 81 || tadvai vanaṃ parityajya ghoramanyadvanaṃ yayau || siṃhādikrūrasatvāḍhyaṃ tasminprāpte vanāṃtaram || 82 || pāṃsuvarṣaṃ mahdvarṣanvṛkṣānāmoṭaya nmuhuḥ || vajraghātasamasparśo vavau jhaṃjhānilo mahān || 83 || vegena gātraṃ bhiṃdantī vṛṣṭiścāsītsuduḥsahā || taddṛṣṭvā sa tu duṣpaṇyaściṃtayanbhṛśaduḥ khitaḥ || 84 || mṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ mahākāyaṃ gajamekamapaśyata || mahāvātaṃ mahāvarṣaṃ tadā soḍhumaśaknuvan || 85 || gajāsyavivareṇaiva viveśodaragahvaram || tasminpraviṣṭamātre tu vṛṣṭirāsītsubhūyasī || 86 || tato varṣajalaiḥ sarvaiḥ pravāhaḥ sumahānabhūt || sa pravāho vane tasminnadī kācidajāyata || 87 || atha tairvarṣasalilaiḥ sa gajaḥ pūritodaraḥ || plavamāno mahāpūre nīraṃdhraḥ samajāyata || 88 || tato nirvivarasyāsya jalapūrṇodarasya ca || gajasya jaṭharātso'yaṃ nirgaṃtu na śaśāka ha || 89 || tataśca vṛṣṭitoyānāṃ pravāho bhīmavegavān || udarasthitaduṣpaṇyaṃ samudraṃ prāpayadgajam || 3.1.22.90 || duṣpaṇyaḥ salile magnaḥ kṣaṇātprāṇairvyayujyata || mṛta eva sa duṣpaṇyaḥ piśācatvamavāptavān || 91 || pīḍitaḥ kṣutpipāsābhyāṃ durgamaṃ vanamāśritaḥ || ghoreṣu gharmakāleṣu samākrośanbhayānakam || 92 || atiṣṭhadgahane'raṇye duḥkhānyanubhavanbahu || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || 93 || sa piśāco mahāduḥkhī nyavasadghorakānane || vanādvanāṃtaraṃ dhāvandeśāddeśāddeśāṃtaraṃ tathā || 94 || sarvatrānubhavanduḥkhamāyayau daṇḍakānkramāt || agastyādāśramātpuṇyānnātidūre sa saṃcaran || 95 || nadanbhairavanādaṃ ca vākyamuccairabhāṣata || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve śṛṇudhvaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ || 96 || bhavanto hi kṛpāvantaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || kṛpādṛṣṭyānugṛhṇīta māṃ duḥkhairatipīḍitam || 97 || purā duṣpaṇyanāmāhaṃ vaiśyaḥ pāṭaliputrake || putraḥ paśu mataścāpi bahūnbālānamārayam || 98 || tato vivāsito rājñā tasmāddeśādvanaṃ gataḥ || amārayaṃ jale putraṃ tatrograśravaso muneḥ || 99 || sa munirdatta vāñchāpaṃ mamāpi maraṇaṃ jale || piśācatāṃ ca me ghorāṃ dattavānduḥkhabhūyasīm || 3.1.22.100 || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatānyapi || piśāca tānubhūteyaṃ śūnyakānanabhūmiṣu || 101 || nāhaṃ soḍhuṃ samartho'smi pipāsāṃ kṣudhameva ca || rakṣadhvaṃ kṛpayā yūyamato māṃ bahuduḥkhinam || 102 || yathā mucyeya paiśācyāttathā kuruta tāpasāḥ || iti śrutvā piśācasya vacanaṃ te tapodhanāḥ || lopāmudrāsahacaramūcire kumbhasaṃbhavam || || || || tāpasā ūcuḥ || || piśācasyāsya bhagavanbrūhi niṣkṛtimuttamām || 4 || evaṃvidhānāṃ pāpānāṃ tvaṃ samartho hi rakṣaṇe || teṣāmagastyaḥ śrutavānkṛpayā parayā yutaḥ || priyaśiṣyaṃ samāhūya sutīkṣṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || 5 || || agastya uvāca || || sutīkṣṇa gaccha tvaritaṃ parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam || 6 || tatrāgnitīrthaṃ sumahadvidyate pāpanāśanam || piśācamokṣaṇārthāya tatra snāhi mahāmate || 7 || piśācārthaṃ tvayi snāte tatra saṃkalpapūrvakam || piśācabhāvamunmucya divyatāmeṣa yāsyati || 8 || niṣkṛtiṃ nāsya paśyāmi vinā tattīrthasevanāta || ataḥ sutīkṣṇakṛpayā rakṣasvainaṃ piśācakam || 9 || agastyenaivamuktastu sutīkṣṇo gandhamādanam || prāpyāgnitīrthe saṃkalpya piśācārthaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ || 3.1.22.110 || sasnau tatra piśācārthaṃ niyamena dinatrayam || rāmanāthādikaṃ sevya tattīrthaṃ pratigṛhya ca || 11 || svāśramaṃ prati gatvātha sutīkṣṇo viprasattamaḥ || tattīrtha prokṣaṇātsadyaḥ saviyujya piśācatām || 12 || vaibhavāttasya tīrthasya sadyo divyatvamāptavān || vimānavaramārūḍho divyastrīparivāritaḥ || 13 || sutīkṣṇaṃ cāpyagastyaṃ ca tathānyāṃśca tapodhanān || punaḥpunarnamaskṛtya tāṃścāmaṃtrya praharṣitaḥ || 14 || svargamevāruhattūrṇaṃ devairapi sa pūjitaḥ || agnitīrthasya māhātmyādduṣpaṇyo vaiśyanaṃdanaḥ || 15 || paiśācyaṃ śāpajaṃ tyaktvā divyatāmitthamāptavān || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā agnitīrthasya vaibhavam || 16 || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā sabhaktikam || piśācamokṣaṇākhyānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 17 || iha bhuktvā mahābhogānparatrāpi sukhaṃ labhet || 119 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye'gnitīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ duṣpaṇyapaiśācyamokṣaṇaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<3.1.23>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || agnitīrthābhidhe tīrthe sarvapātakanāśane || snānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhātmā cakratīrthaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ samuddiśya cakratīrthe dvijottamāḥ || snānaṃ samācarenmartyastaṃtaṃ kāmaṃ samaśnute || 2 || purāhirbudhnyanāmā tu maharṣiḥ saṃśita vrataḥ || sudarśanamupāstāsmiṃstapasvī gaṃdhamādane || 3 || tapasyaṃtaṃ muniṃ tatra rākṣasā ghorarūpiṇaḥ || abādhaṃta sadā viprāstapovighnaikatatparāḥ || || 4 || sudarśanaṃ tadāgatya bhaktarakṣaṇavāṃchayā || yātudhānānbādhamānānnyavadhīrlīlayā purā || 5 || tadāprabhṛti taccakraṃ bhaktaprārthanayā dvijāḥ || ahirbudhnyakṛte tīrthe sannidhānaṃ sadā'karot || 6 || tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamitīryate || sudarśanaprasādena tatra tīrthe nimajjanāt || 7 || rakṣaḥpiśācā dikṛtā pīḍā nāstyeva karhicit || snātvāsminpāvane tīrthe chinnapāṇiḥ purā raviḥ || sa hiraṇyamayau pāṇī labdhavāṃstīrthavaibhavāt || 8 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || chinnapāṇiḥ kathamabhūdādityaḥ sūtanaṃdana || yathā ca labdhavānpāṇī sauvarṇau tadvadasva naḥ || 9 || || śrīsūta uvāca || iṃdrādayaḥ surāḥ pūrvaṃ saṃtataṃ daityapīḍitāḥ || 3.1.23.10 || kiṃ kurma iti saṃcitya saṃbhūya samamaṃtrayan || bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya maṃtrayitvā ciraṃ surāḥ || 11 || turāsāhaṃ purodhāya dhāma svāyaṃbhuvaṃ yayuḥ || te brahmāṇaṃ samāsādya dṛṣṭvā stutvā ca bhaktitaḥ || 12 || tato vyajijñapastasmai sveṣāmāgamakāraṇam || || || surā ūcuḥ || || bhagavanbhāratīnātha daityā hyasmānbalotkaṭāḥ || 13 || bādhaṃte satataṃ deva tatra brūhi pratikriyām || ityuktaḥ sa surairbrahmā tānāha kṛpayā vacaḥ || 14 || || brahmovāca || || mā bhaiṣṭa yūyaṃ vibudhāstatropāyaṃ bravīmyaham || māheśvaraṃ mahāyajñamasurāṇāṃ vināśanam || || 15 || prārabhadhvaṃ surā yūyaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || ayaṃ ca daivataiḥ sarvairvidhilobhaṃ vinā kṛtaḥ || 16 || māheśvaro mahāyajñaḥ kriyatāṃ gaṃdhamādane || yadi hyanyatra taṃ yajñaṃ kuryustadvibudharṣabhāḥ || 17 || yajñavighnaṃ tadā kuryurdurātmānaḥ suradviṣaḥ || kriyate yadyayaṃ yajño gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 18 || sudarśanaprasādena naiva vighno bhavettadā || ahirbudhnyābhidhānasya maharṣergaṃdhamādane || 19 || anugrahāya tattīrthe sannidhatte sudarśanam || ataḥ kurudhvaṃ bho yūyaṃ taṃ yajñaṃ gaṃdhamādane || 3.1.23.20 || nātidūre cakratīrthādasurāṇāṃ vināśakam || tataste brahmavacasā sahasā gaṃdhamādanam|| 21 || bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya jagmuryajñacikīrṣayā|| te praṇamya mahātmānamahirbudhnyaṃ munīśvaram ||22|| akalpayanyajñavāṭannātidūre tadāśramāt || yajñakarmasu niṣṇātaiḥ sahitāste tapodhanaiḥ || 23 || iṣṭimārebhire devā asurāṇāṃ vināśinīm || tasminkarmaṇi hotāsītsvayameva bṛhaspatiḥ || 24 || babhūva maitrāvaruṇo jayaṃtaḥ pākaśāsaniḥ || acchāvāko babhūvātra vasūnāmaṣṭamo vasuḥ || 25 || grāvastudabhavattatra śaktiputraḥ parāśaraḥ || aṣṭāvakro mahātejā adhvaryudhuramūḍhavān|| || 26 || tatra pratiprasthātābhūdviśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ || neṣṭā babhūva varuṇa unnetā ca dhaneśvaraḥ || 27 || brahmā babhūva savitā yajñasyārdhadhuraṃ vahan || babhūva brāhmaṇācchaṃsī vasiṣṭho brahmaṇottamaḥ || 28 || āgnīdhro'bhūcchunaḥśepaḥ potā jātaśca pāvakaḥ || udgātā vāyurabhavatprastotā ca paretarāṭ || || 29 || pratihartā tu tatrāsīdagastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ || subrahmaṇyo madhucchaṃdā viśvāmitrātmajo mahān|| 3.1.23.30 || yajamānaḥ svayamabhūddevarājaḥ puraṃdaraḥ|| upadraṣṭā babhūvātra vyāsaputraḥ śuko muniḥ || 31 || tataste ṛtvijaḥ sarve devarājaṃ puraṃdaram || vidhivaddīkṣayāṃcakrustatra māheśvare kratau ||32|| prāvartata mahāyajña evaṃ vai gaṃdhamādane || sudarśanaprabhāvena duḥsahenātipīḍitāḥ || 33 || nāviṃdannasurāstatra raṃdhraṃ yajñe pravartite || evanniraṃtarāyo'sau prāvartata mahā kratuḥ || 34 || bhakṣayaṃśca haristatra jajvāla hutavāhanaḥ || vidhivatkarmajālāni kṛtvādhvaryurasaṃbhramāt || 35 || maṃtrapūtaṃ puroḍāśaṃ juhavāmāsa pāvake || hutaśeṣaṃ puroḍāśaṃ vibhajyādhvaryurādarāt || 36 || ṛtvigbhyo hotṛmukhyebhyaḥ pradadau pāpanāśanam || savitre brahmaṇe caikamatyugrataratejasam || || 37 || dadau tatra puroḍāśabhāgaṃ prāśitranāmakam || pratijagrāha pāṇibhyāṃ prāśitraṃ savitā tadā || 38 || savitrā spṛṣṭamātraṃ sattatprāśitraṃ durāsadam || tasya pāṇī praciccheda paśyatāṃ sarvaṛtvijām || 39 || tataḥ saṃchinnapāṇiḥ sa prāśitreṇogratejasā || kimetaditi saṃtrasto viṣaṇṇavadano'bhavat || 3.1.23.40 || savitā ṛtvijaḥ sarvānsamāhūyedamabravīt || savitovāca || puroḍāśasya bhāgo'yaṃ mama prāśitranāmakaḥ || 41 || dattaściccheda matpāṇī miṣatsveva bhavatsvapi || ato bhavaṃtaḥ saṃbhūya sarva eva hi ṛtvijaḥ || 42 || kalpayaṃtāmimau pāṇī nocedyajñaṃ nihanmyamum || saviturvākyamākarṇya te sarve samaciṃtayan || 43 || tatra madhye munīṃdrāṇāṃ devānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ || aṣṭāvakro mahātejā ṛtvijastānabhāṣata || 44 || || aṣṭāvakra uvāca || || śṛṇudhvamṛtvijaḥ sarve mama vākyaṃ samāhitāḥ || mayi jīvati vipreṃdrā viriṃcānāṃ śataṃ gatam || 45 || jāyaṃte ca mriyaṃte ca caturānanakoṭayaḥ || paśyanneva ca tānsarvānahaṃ prāṇānadhārayam || 46 || tatra lokeśvarābhikhye vartamāne prajāpatau || vipro hariharonāma nivasañchayāmalāpure || 47 || vyādhenāraṇyavāsena kelyarthaṃ lakṣyavedhinā || chinnapādo'bhavadbāṇairlakṣya madhyaṃ samāgataḥ || 48 || sa gaṃdhamādanaṃ prāpya munibhiḥ preritastadā || snātvā ca munitīrthe'sminprāptavāṃścaraṇau purā || 49 || tadā puṇyamidaṃ tīrthaṃ munitīrthamitīritam || idānīṃ cakratīrthākhyaṃ cakranāma tvaviṃdata || 3.1.23.50 || tadatra kriyatāṃ snānaṃ prāśitracchinnapāṇinā || munitīrthe savitrāpi yuṣmākaṃ yadi rocate || 51 || ṛtvijaḥ kathitāstvevamaṣṭāvakramaharṣiṇā || savitāramabhāṣaṃta sarva eva praharṣitāḥ || 52 || savitaḥ snāhi tīrthe' smiṃstava pāṇī bhaviṣyataḥ || aṣṭāvakro yathā prāha tathā kuru samāhitaḥ || 53 || tataḥ sa savitā gatvā cakratīrthaṃ mahattaram || sasnau pāṇyoravāptyarthamiṣṭadāyini tatra saḥ || 54 || uttiṣṭhanneva sa tadā tatra snātvā sabhaktikam || yukto hiraṇmayābhyāṃ tu pāṇibhyāṃ samadṛśyata || 55 || hiraṇyapāṇiṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā jahṛṣuḥ sarvaṛtvijaḥ || tataḥ samāpya taṃ yajñaṃ daityasaṃghānvijitya ca || 56 || iṃdrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve sukhitāḥ svargamāyayuḥ || tasmādetatsamāgatya tīrthaṃ sarvaiśca mānavaiḥ || 57 || sevanīyaṃ prayatnena svasvābhīṣṭasya siddhaye || aṃdhaiśca kuṇibhirmūkairbadhiraiḥ kubjakairapi || 58 ||| khaṃjaiḥ paṃgubhirapyetadaṃgahīnaistathāparaiḥ || saṃchinnapāṇicaraṇaiḥ saṃchinnānyāṃgasaṃcayaiḥ || 59 || manuṣyaiśca tathānyaiśca vikalāṃgasya pūrtaye || sevanīyamidaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || 3.1.23.60 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāścakratīrthasya vaibhavam || yatra snātvā purā chinnau pāṇī prāpa prabhākaraḥ || 61 || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || aṃgāni vikalānyasya pūrṇāni syurna saṃśayaḥ || 62 || mokṣakāmasya martyasya muktiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 63 ||| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye cakratīrthapraśaṃsāyāmādityahiraṇmayapāṇyavāptivarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<3.1.24>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā śivatīrthaṃ tato vrajet || yatra hi snānamātreṇa mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ || 1 || tatsaṃsargāśca naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇādeva tāpasāḥ || atra snātvā brahmahatyāṃ mumuce kālabhairavaḥ || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kālabhairavarudrasya brahmahatyā mahāmune || kimarthamabhavatsūta tanno vaktumihārhasi || 3 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || vakṣyāmi munayaḥ sarve purāvṛttaṃ vimuktidam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 4 || prajāpateśca viṣṇośca babhūva kalahaḥ purā || kiṃcitkāraṇamuddiśya samastajanasannidhau || 5 || ahameva jagatkartā nānyaḥ kartāsti kaścana || ahaṃ sarvaprapaṃcānāṃ nigrahānugrahapradaḥ || 6 || matto nāstyadhikaḥ kaścinmatsamo vā sureṣvapi || evaṃ sa manute brahmā devānāṃ sannidhau purā || 7 || tadā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha prahasandvijapuṃgavāḥ || kimarthamevaṃ brūṣe tvamahaṃkāreṇa sāṃpratam || 8 || vākyamevaṃvidhaṃ bhūyo vaktuṃ nārhasi vai vidhe || ahameva jagatkartā yajño nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ || 9 || māṃ vināsya prapañcasya jīvanaṃ durlabhaṃ bhavet || matprasādājjagatsṛṣṭaṃ tvayā sthāvarajaṃgamam || 3.1.24.10 || vivādaṃ kurvatorevaṃ brahmaviṣṇvorjayaiṣiṇoḥ || devānāṃ puratastatra vedāścatvāra āgatāḥ || procurvākyamidaṃ tathyaṃ paramārthaprakāśakam ||1 1|| || vedā ūcuḥ || || tvaṃ viṣṇo na jagatkartā na tvaṃ brahmanprajāpate || 12 || kiṃ tvīśvaro jagatkartā parātparataro vibhuḥ || tanmāyāśaktisaṃklṛptamidaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam || 13 || sarvadevābhivaṃdyo hi sāṃbaḥ satyādilakṣaṇaḥ || sraṣṭā ca pālako hartā sa eva jagatāṃ prabhuḥ ||14|| evaṃ samīritaṃ vedaiḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ śubhākṣaram|| brahmā viṣṇustadā tatra procaturdvijapuṃgavāḥ||15|| ||brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ|| || pārvatyāliṃgitaḥ śaṃbhurmūrtimānpramathādhipaḥ|| kathaṃ bhavetparaṃ brahma sarvasaṃgavivarjitam||16|| tābhyāmitīrite tatra praṇavaḥ prāha tau tadā || arūpo rūpamādāya mahatā dhvaninā dvijāḥ ||17|| || || praṇava uvāca || || asau śaṃbhurmahādevaḥ pārvatyā svātiriktayā || saṃkrīḍate kadācinno kiṃ tu svātmasvarūpayā || 18 || asau śaṃbhuranīśānaḥ svaprakāśo niraṃjanaḥ || viśvādhiko mahādevo viśvādhika iti śrutaḥ || 19 || sarvātmā sarvakartāsau svatantraḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || brahmannayaṃ sṛṣṭikāle tvāṃ niyuṃkte rajoguṇaiḥ || 3.1.24.20 || sattvena rakṣaṇe śaṃbhustvāṃ preṣayati keśava || tamasā kālarudrākhyaṃ saṃprerayati saṃhṛtau || 21 || ataḥ svatantratā viṣṇo yuvayorna kadācana || nāpi prajāpaterasti kiṃ tu śaṃbhoḥ svatantratā || 22 || brahmanviṣṇo yuvābhyāṃ tu kimarthaṃ na maheśvaraḥ || jñāyate sarvalokānāṃ kartā viśvādhikastathā || 23 || sāpi śaktirumā devī na pṛthakchaṃkarātsadā || śaṃbhorānaṃdabhūtā sā devī nāgaṃtukī smṛtā || || 24 || ato viśvādhiko rudraḥ svataṃtro nirvikalpakaḥ || sarvadevairayaṃ vandyo yuvābhyāmapi śaṃkaraḥ || 25 || kartā nāsyāsti rudrasya nādhiko'smācca vidyate || na tatsamo'pi lokeṣu vidyate śataśastathā || 26 || ato mohaṃ na kurutaṃ brahmaviṣṇo yuvāṃ vṛthā || ityuktaṃ praṇavenātha śrutvā brahmā ca keśavaḥ || 27 || māyayā mohitau śaṃbhornaivājñānamamuṃcatām || etasminnaṃtare brahmā pradadarśa mahādbhutam || 28 || vyāpnuvadgaganaṃ sarvamanaṃtāditya sannibham || tejomaṇḍalamākāśamadhyagaṃ viśvatomukham || 29 || tannirūpayituṃ brahmā sasarjordhvagataṃ mukham || tapobalavisṛṣṭena paṃcamena mukhena saḥ || || 3.1.24.30 || nirūpayāmāsa vibhustattejomaṇḍalaṃ muhuḥ || tatprajajvāla kopena mukhaṃ tejovilokanāt||31|| anaṃtādityasaṃkāśaṃ jvalattatpaṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || didhakṣuḥ pralaye lokānvaḍavāgnirivābabhau || 32 || vyadṛśyata ca tattejaḥ puruṣo nīlalohitaḥ || dṛṣṭvā sraṣṭā tadā brahmā babhāṣe parameśvaram || 33 || vedāhaṃ tvāṃ mahādeva lalāṭānme purā bhavān || vinirgato'si śaṃbho tvaṃ rudranāmā mamātmajaḥ || 34 || iti garveṇa saṃyuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā maheśvaraḥ || kālabhairavanāmānaṃ puruṣaṃ prāhiṇottadā || 35 || ayuddhyata ciraṃ kālaṃ brahmaṇā kālabhairavaḥ || mahādevāṃśasaṃbhūtaḥ śūlaṭaṃkagadādharaḥ || || 36 || yuddhvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ brahmaṇā kālabhairavaḥ || vadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śubhraṃ vyalokayata paṃcamam || 37 || vilokyordhvagataṃ vaktraṃ pañcamaṃ bhāratīpateḥ || garveṇa mahatā yuktaṃ prajajvālātikopitaḥ || 38 || tatastatpaṃcamaṃ vaktraṃ bhairavaḥ prācchinadruṣā || tato mamāra brahmā'sau kālabhairavahiṃsitaḥ || || 39 || īśvarasya prasādena prapede jīvitaṃ punaḥ || tato vilokayāmāsa śaṃkaraṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam || 3.1.24.40 || vāsukyādyaṣṭabhogīṃdravibhūṣaṇavibhūṣitam || dṛṣṭvā vedhā mahādevaṃ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaram || 41 || lebhe māheśvaraṃ jñānaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ || tatastuṣṭāva giriśaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ śivam || 42 || || || brahmovāca || || mahyaṃ prasīda giriśa śaśāṃkakṛtaśekhara || yanmayāpakṛtaṃ śaṃbho tatkṣamasva dayānidhe || 43 || kṣamasva mama garvaṃ tvaṃ śaṃkareti punaḥpunaḥ || namaścakāra somaṃ taṃ somārdhakṛtaśekharam || 44 || atha devaḥ prasanno'smai brahmaṇe svāṃśajāya tu || mā bhairityabravīcchaṃbhurbhairavaṃ cābhyabhāṣata || 45 || || īśvara uvāca || || eṣa sarvasya jagataḥ pūjyo brahmā sanātanaḥ || hatasyāsya viriṃcasya dhāraya tvaṃ śiro'dhunā || 46 || brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ lokasaṃgrahakāmyayā || bhikṣāmaṭa kapālena bhairava tvaṃ mamājñayā || 47 || uktvaivaṃ śaṃkaro viprāstatraivāṃtaradhīyata || nīlakaṇṭho mahādevo girijārddhatanustataḥ || 48 || bhairavaṃ grāhayāmāsa vadanaṃ vedhaso dvijāḥ || carasva pāpaśuddhyarthaṃ lokasaṃgrahaṇāya vai || 49 || kapāladhārī hastena bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇātu bhairavaḥ || itīrayitvā giriśaḥ kanyāṃ kāṃcidbhayaṃkarīm || 3.1.24.50 || brahmahatyābhidhāṃ krūrāṃ vaḍavānalasannibhām || tāṃ prerayitvā giriśo bhairavaṃ punarabravīt || 51 || || īśvara uvāca || || bhairavaitadvrataṃ tvabdaṃ brahmahatyāviśuddhaye || cara tvaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snāhi śuddhyarthamātmanaḥ ||52|| tato vārāṇasīṃ gaccha brahmahatyāpraśāṃtaye || vārāṇasīpraveśena brahmahatyā tavādhamā ||53|| pādaśeṣā vinaṣṭā syāccaturthāṃśo na naśyati || tasya nāśaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava bhairava tacchuṇu ||54|| dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhestīre gandhamādanaparvate || sarvaprāṇyupakārāya kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ mayā śubham ||55|| śivasaṃjñaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tatra yāhi tvamādarāt|| tatpraveśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā tavāśubhā || 56 || śivatīrthasya māhātmyānniḥśeṣaṃ naśyati dhruvam || uktvaivaṃ bhairavaṃ rudraḥ kailāsaṃ prayayau kṣaṇāt || 57 || tataḥ kapālapāṇistu bhairavaḥ śivacoditaḥ || devadānavayakṣādilokeṣu vicacāra saḥ ||58|| taṃ yāṃtamanuyāti sma brahmahatyātibhīṣaṇā || bhairavaḥ sarvatīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 59 || caritvā līlayā devastato vārāṇasīṃ yayau || vārāṇasīṃ praviṣṭe tu bhairave śaṃkarāṃśaje || 3.1.24.60 || caturthāṃśaṃ vinā naṣṭā brahmahatyātikutsitā || caturthāṃśena dudrāva bhairavaṃ śaṃkarāṃśajam ||61|| tataḥ sa bhairavo devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ kapāladhṛk || śivājñayā yayau paścādgaṃdhamādanaparvatam || 62 || śivatīrthaṃ tato gatvā bhairavaḥ snātavāndvijāḥ || snānamātreṇa tatrāsya śivatīrthe mahattare || 63 || niḥśeṣaṃ vilayaṃ yātā brahmahatyātibhīṣaṇā || asminnavasare śaṃbhuḥ prādurāsīttadagrataḥ || prādurbhūto mahādevo bhairavaṃ vākyamabravīt ||64|| || || īśvara uvāca || || niḥśeṣaṃ brahmahatyā te śivatīrthe nimajjanāt || 65 || naṣṭā bhairava nāstyatra saṃdehastava suvrata || idaṃ kapālaṃ kāśyāṃ tvaṃ sthāpayasva kvacitsthale || 66 || ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || bhairavo'pi tadā viprā brahmahatyāvimocitaḥ || 67 || śivatīrthasya māhātmyādyayau vārāṇasīṃ purīm || kapālaṃ sthāpayāmāsa pradeśe kutraciddvijāḥ || kapālatīrthamityākhyāmalabhattatsthalaṃ tadā || 68 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ śivatīrthaṃ vimuktidam || 69 || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || narakakleśaśamanaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || || 3.1.24.70 || śivatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mayā proktaṃ vimuktidam || idaṃ paṭhansadā martyo duḥkhagrāmādvimucyate || 71 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye śivatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ bhairavabrahmahatyāvimokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || cha || ||
<3.1.25>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || śivatīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāvimokṣaṇe || svapāpajālaśāṃtyarthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || yatra majjanamātreṇa kṛtaghno'pi vimucyate || mātṝḥ pitṝngurūṃścāpi ye na manyaṃti mohitāḥ || 2 || ye cāpyanye durātmānaḥ kṛtaghnā nirapatrapāḥ || te sarve śaṃkhatīrthe smiñchuddhyaṃti snānamātrataḥ || 3 || śaṃkhanāmā muniḥ pūrvaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || avartata tapaḥ kurvanviṣṇuṃ dhyāyansamāhitaḥ|| 4 || sa tatra kalpayāmāsa snānārthaṃ tīrthamuttamam || śaṃkhena nirmitaṃ tīrthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthamitīryate || 5 || tatra snātvā sakṛnmartyaḥ kṛtaghno'pivimucyate || atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ pāpanāśanam||6|| yasya śravaṇamātreṇa naro muktimavāpnuyāt|| purā babhūva vipreṃdro vatsanābho mahāmuniḥ||7|| satyavāñchīlavānvāgmī sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ|| śatrumitrasamo dāṃtastapasvī vijiteṃdriyaḥ||8|| parabrahmaṇi niṣṇātastattvabrahmaikasaṃśrayaḥ|| evaṃ prabhāvaḥ sa munistapastepe nijāśrame || 9 || sa vai niścalasarvāṃgastiṣṭhaṃstatraiva bhūtale || paramāṇvaṃtaraṃ vāpi na svasthānāccacāla saḥ || 3.1.25.10 || sthitvaikatra tapasyaṃtamanekaśatavatsarān || tamācakāma valmīkaṃ chāditāṃgaṃ cakāra ca || 11 || valmīkākrāṃtadehopi vatsanābho mahāmuniḥ || akarottapa evāsau valmīkaṃ na tvabuddhyata || || 12 || tasmiṃśca tapyati tapo vāsavo munipuṃgavāḥ |1 visṛjya meghajālāni varṣayāmāsa vegavān || 13 || evaṃ dināni saptāyaṃ sa vavarṣa niraṃ taram || āsāreṇātimahatā vṛṣyamāṇopi vai muniḥ || 14 || taṃ varṣaṃ pratijagrāha nimīlitavilocanaḥ || mahatā stanitenāśu tadā badhirayañchrutī || || 15 || valmīkasyopariṣṭādvai nipapāta mahāśaniḥ || tasminvarṣati parjanye śītavātātiduḥsahe || 16 || valmīkaśikharaṃ dhvastaṃ babhūvāśanitāḍi tam || viśīrṇaśikhare tasminvalmīke'śanitāḍite || 17 || sehetiduḥsahāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ vatsanābho viciṃtayan || maharṣau varṣadhārābhiḥ pīḍyamāne divāni śam || 18 || dharmasya cetasi kṛpā saṃbabhūvātibhūyasī || sa dharmaściṃtayāmāsa vatsanābhe tapasyati || 19 || patatyapyativarṣe'yaṃ tapaso na nivartate || aho'sya vatsanābhasya dharmaikāyattacittatā || 3.1.25.20 || iti ciṃtayatastasya mātirevamajāyata || ahaṃ vai māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ sumahāṃtaṃ manoharam || 21 || varṣadhārānipātānāṃ soḍhāraṃ kaṭhinatvacam || svīkṛtya māhiṣaṃ rūpaṃ sthāsyāmyupari yoginaḥ || 22 || na hi bādhiṣyate varṣaṃ mahāvegayutaṃ tvapi || dharma evaṃ viniścitya dhārāḥ pṛṣṭhena dhārayan || 23 || vatsanābhopari tadā gātramācchādya tasthivān || tataḥ saptadināṃte tu tadvai varṣamupāramat || 24 || tato mahiṣarūpī sa dharmo'tikṛpayā yutaḥ || tadvai valmīkamutsṛjya nātidūre hyavarttata ||25|| tato nivṛte varṣe tu vatsanābho mahāmuniḥ|| nivṛttastapasastū rṇaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vyalokayan||26|| sthito'haṃ vṛṣṭisaṃpāte kurvannadya mahattapaḥ|| pṛthivī salilāklinnā dṛśyate sarvatodiśam||27|| śikharāṇi girīṇāṃ ca vanā nyupavanāni ca || āśramāṇi maharṣīṇāmāplutāni jalairnavaiḥ || 28 || evamādīni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā pramudito'bhavat || ciṃtayāmāsa dharmātmā vatsanā bho mahāmuniḥ || 29 || ahamasminmahāvarṣe nūnaṃ kenāpi rakṣitaḥ || varṣatyasminmahāvarṣe jīvitaṃ tvanyathā kutaḥ || 3.1.25.30 || viciṃtyaivaṃ muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarvatra samalokayat || tato'paśyanmahākāyamadūrādagrataḥ sthitam || 31 || mahiṣaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ ca vatsanābhastapodhanaḥ || mahiṣaṃ taṃ samuddiśya manasā samaciṃ tayat || 32 || tiryagyonipvapi kathaṃ dṛśyate dharmaśīlatā || yato hyahaṃ mahāvarṣānmahiṣeṇābhirakṣitaḥ || 33 || dīrghamāyuramuṣyāstu yanmāṃ rakṣitavā niha || ityādi sa viciṃtyaivaṃ tapase punarudyayau || 34 || taṃ punaśca tapasyaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣarūpadhṛk || romāṃcāvṛtasarvāṃgaḥ pramodamagamadbhṛśam || || 35 || vatsanābhasya hi muneḥ punaścaiva tapasyataḥ || manaḥ pūrvavadekāgraṃ parabrahmaṇi nābhavat || 36 || sa viṣaṇṇamanā bhūtvā vatsanābho vyaciṃtayat || na bhavedyadi nairmalyaṃ tadā syāccaṃcalaṃ manaḥ || 37 || manaśca pāpabāhulye nirmalaṃ naiva jāyate || pāpaleśopi me nāsti kathaṃ lolā yate manaḥ || 38 || aciṃtayaddoṣahetuṃ vatsanābhaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || sa viciṃtya viniścitya niniṃdātmānamaṃjasā || 39 || dhiṅmāmadya durātmāna maho mūḍhosmyahaṃ bhṛśam || kṛtaghnatā mahādoṣo māmadya samupāgataḥ || 3.1.25.40 || yadīdṛśānmahāvarṣāttrātāraṃ mahiṣottamam || tiṣṭhāmyapūjayanneva tato me bhūtkṛtaghnatā || 41 || kṛtaghnatā mahāndoṣaḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || kṛtaghnasya na vai lokāḥ kṛtaghnasya na bāṃdhavāḥ || 42 || kṛtaghnatādoṣa valānmama cittaṃ malīmasam || kṛtaghnā narakaṃ yāṃti ye ca viśvastaghātinaḥ || 43 || niṣkṛtiṃ naiva paśyāmi kṛtaghnānāṃ kathaṃcana || ṛte prāṇaparityāgāddharmajñānāṃ vaco yathā || 44 || pitrorabharaṇaṃ kṛtvā hyadattvā gurudakṣiṇām || kṛtaghnatāṃ ca saṃprāpya maraṇāṃtā hi niṣkṛtiḥ || 45 || tasmātprāṇānparityajya prāyaścittaṃ carāmyaham || iti niścitya manasā vatsanābho mahāmuniḥ || 46 || tṛṇīkṛtya nijānprāṇānniḥsaṃgenāṃtarā tmanā || meroḥ śikharamārūḍhaḥ prāyaścittacikīrṣayā || 47 || sumeruśikharāttasmādiyeṣa patituṃ muniḥ || tasminpatitumārabdhe mā tvariṣṭhā iti bruvan || tyaktamāhiṣarūpaḥ sandharma eva nyavārayat || 48 || || dharma uvāca || || vatsanābha mahāprājña jīvasva bahuvatsarān || 49 || parituṣṭo 'smi bhadraṃ te dehatyāgacikīrṣayā || na hi tvaddharmakakṣāyāṃ loke kaścitsamo'sti vai || 3.1.25.50 || yadyapi prāṇasaṃtyāgaḥ kṛtaghne niṣkṛtirbhavet || tathāpi dharmaśīlatvāttavānyāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ vade || 51 || śaṃkhatīrthābhidhaṃ tīrthamasti vai gaṃdhamādane || śāṃtyarthamasya pāpasya tatra snāhi samāhitaḥ || || 52 || prāpsyase cittaśuddhiṃ tvamato vigatakalmaṣaḥ|| tataśca labdhavijñānaḥ prāpsyase śāśvataṃ padam || 53 || ahaṃ dharmosmi yogīndra satya meva bravīmi te || iti dharmavacaḥ śrutvā vatsanābho mahāmuniḥ || 54 || snātukāmaḥ śaṃkhatīrthe gaṃdhamādanamanvagāt || śaṃkhatīrthaṃ ca saṃprāpya tatra sasnau mahāmuniḥ || 55 || tato vigatapāpasya mano nirmalatāṃ gatam || tato'cireṇa kālena brahmabhūyamagānmuniḥ || 56 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ śaṃkhatīrthasya vaibhavam|| yatra hi snānamātreṇa kṛtaghno'pi vimucyate || 57 || mātṛdrohī pitṛdrohī gurudrohī tathaiva ca || anye kṛtaghnanivahā mucyaṃte'tra nimajjanāt || 58 || ataḥ kṛtaghnairmanujaiḥ sevanīyamidaṃ sadā || aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ yatkṛtaghnopi mucyate || 59 || akṛtvā bharaṇaṃ pitroradattvā gurudakṣiṇām|| kṛtaghnatāṃ ca saṃprāpya maraṇāṃtā hi niṣkṛtiḥ || 3.1.25.60 || iha tu snānamātreṇa kṛtaghnasyāpi niṣkṛtiḥ || kṛtaghnatāpi tattīrthe snānamātrādvinaśyati || 61 || anyeṣāṃ tucchapāpānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kimutādhunā || 62 || adhyāyamenaṃ paṭhedbhaktiyuktaḥ kṛtaghnopi martyāḥ sa pāpādvimuktaḥ || viśuddhāṃtarātmā gataḥ satyalokaṃ samaṃ brahmaṇā mokṣamapyāśu gacchet|| 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye śaṃkhatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ vatsanābhakṛtaghnadoṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<3.1.26>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || vidhāyābhiṣavaṃ martyāḥ śaṃkhatīrthe dvijottamāḥ || yamunāṃ caiva gaṃgāṃ ca gayāṃ cāpi kramādvrajet || 1 || yamunākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ gaṃgātīrthamanu ttamam || gayātīrthaṃ ca martyānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 2 || etattīrthatrayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvarogani barhaṇam || 3 || etaddhi tīrthatritayaṃ sakalājñānanāśanam || avidyāyāṃ vinaṣṭāyāṃ tathā jñānapradaṃ nṛṇām || 4 || jānaśrutirmahārāja eṣu tīrtheṣu vai purā || snātvā raikvāddvijaśreṣṭhātprāptavāñjñānamuttamam|| 5 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta sarvārthatattvajña vyāsaśiṣya mahāmate || yamunā caiva gaṃgā ca gayā caiveti viśrutam || 6 || etattīrthatrayaṃ kasmādāgataṃ gaṃdhamādane || jānaśruteśca rājarṣeḥ snānāttīrthatraye'pi ca || jñānāvāptiḥ kathaṃ raikvādasmākaṃ sūta tadvada || 7 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || raikvanāmā maharṣistu purā vai gandhamādane || 8 || tapassuduścaraṃ kurvannyavasatta pasāṃ nidhiḥ || dīrghakālaṃ tapaḥ kurvansa vai raikvo mahāmuniḥ || 9 || tapobalena mahatā dīrghamāyuravāptavān || janmanā paṃgurevāsīdraikvanāmā mahā muniḥ || 3.1.26.10 || paṃgutvādasamartho'bhūdgaṃtuṃ tīrthānyasau muniḥ || saṃti yāni tu tīrthāni gandhamādanaparvate || 11 || tāni gacchati sāmīpyācchakaṭenai va saṃcaran || sa yadraikvo munivaro yugvena saha vartate || 12 || tapasvī vaidikairloke sayugvaityabhidhīyate || yugveti śakaṭaṃ proktaṃ sa tena saha vartate || 13 || sa khalvevaṃ muniśreṣṭhaḥ sayugvānāma vai muniḥ || pūrṇajñānastapastepe gandhamādanaparvate ||14|| grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyasthaḥ so'tapyata mahattapaḥ || varṣāyāṃ kaṇṭhadaghneṣu jaleṣu samavartata || 15 || tapasā śoṣite gātre pāmā tasya vyajāyata || kaṇḍūyata sa pāmānaṃ divārātraṃ munīśvaraḥ || 16|| kaṇḍūyamāna evāyaṃ pāmānaṃ na tapo'tyajat || ajāyata manastvevaṃ tasya sayugvano muneḥ || 17 || yamunāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ gayāyāṃ cādhunaivahi || asmiṃstīrthe traye puṇye snātavyaṃ hi mayā tviti || 18 || evaṃ viciṃtya sa muniranyāṃ ciṃtāmathākarot || ahaṃ hi janmanā paṃgurataḥ snānaṃ hi durlabham || 19 || atidūraṃ mayā gantuṃ śakaṭena na śakyate || kiṃ karomyadhunetyevaṃ sa vitarkya mahāmatiḥ || 3.1.26.20 || tīrthatrayeṣu snānārthaṃ kartavyaṃ niścikāya vai || aprasahyamanādhṛṣyaṃ vidyate me tapobalam || 21 || tenaivāvāhayiṣyāmi taddhi tīrthatrayaṃ tviha || iti niścitya manasā prāṅmukho niyateṃ driyaḥ || 22 || trirācamya ca sayugvāndadhyau kṣaṇamataṃdritaḥ || tasya maṃtraprabhāvena yamunā sā mahānadī || 23 || gaṃgā ca jahnutanayā gayā sā pāpanāśinī || bhūmiṃ nirbhidya tisropi pātālātsahasotthitāḥ || 24 || mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya sayugvānamupetya ca || ūcuḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭā harṣayaṃtyaśca taṃ munim || 25 || sayugvanraikva bhadraṃ te dhyānādasmādupārama || tvanmaṃtreṇa samākṛṣṭā vayamatra samāgatāḥ || 26 || ki kartavyaṃ tavāsmābhistadvadasva munīśvara || iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sayugvānhi mahāmuniḥ || 27 || dhyānādupāramattūrṇaṃ tāścāpaśyatpuraḥsthitāḥ || sa tāḥ saṃpūjya vidhiva draikvo vācamabhāṣata || 28 || yamune devi he gaṃge he gaye pāpanāśini || sannidhānaṃ kurudhvaṃ me gandhamādanaparvate || 29 || yatra bhūmiṃ vinirbhidya bhavatya iha nirgatāḥ || tāni puṇyāni tīrthāni bhaveyurvo'bhidhānataḥ || 3.1.26.30 || sahasāṃtaradhīyaṃta tathāstvityeva tatra tāḥ || tadāprabhṛti tīrthāni tāni trīṇyapi bhūtale || 31 || tenatenābhidhānena gīyante sarvadā janaiḥ || yatra bhūmiṃ vinirbhidya yamunā nirgatā tadā || 32 || yamunātīrthamiti vai tajjanairabhidhīyate || yato vai pṛthivīraṃdhrājjāhnavī sahasotthitā || 33 || gaṃgātīrthamiti khyātaṃ talloke pāpanāśanam || gayā hi mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ yata āsthāya niryayau || 34 || tadeva bhūmivivaraṃ gayātīrthaṃ pracakṣate || evametanmahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthatrayamanuttamam || 35 || raikvamaṃtraprabhāveṇa pṛthivyāḥ sahasotthitam || atra tīrthatraye snānaṃ ye kurvaṃti narottamāḥ || 36 || teṣāmajñānanāśaḥ syājjñānamapyudayaṃ labhet || svamaṃtreṇa samākṛṣṭe tatra tīrthatraye muniḥ || 37 || snānaṃ samācarannityaṃ sa kālānatyavāhayat || etasminneva kāle tu rājā jānaśrutirmahān || 38 || putrasaṃjñasya rājarṣeḥ pautro dharmaikatatparaḥ || deyamannādi sa tadā hyarthibhyaḥ śraddhayaiva yat || 39 || tasmādenaṃ najāloke śraddhādeyaṃ pracakṣate || yato bahutaraṃ vākyamannādyasya mahī pateḥ ||3.1.26.40 || arthināṃ kṣudhitānāṃ tu tṛptyarthaṃ vartate gṛhe || atoyamarthibhiḥ sarvairbahuvākya itīryate ||41|| sa vai pautrāyaṇo rājā jānaśrutasuto balī || priyātithirbabhūvāsau bahudāyī tathā'bhavat || 42 || nagareṣu ca rāṣṭreṣu grāmeṣu ca vaneṣu ca || catuṣpatheṣu sarveṣu mahāmārgeṣu sarvaśaḥ || 43 || bahvannapāna saṃyuktaṃ sūpaśākādisaṃyutam || ātithyaṃ kalpayāmāsa tṛptaye'rthijanasya vai ||44|| annapānādikaṃ sarvamupayuḍdhvamihārthinaḥ || ityasau ghoṣayāmāsa tatra tatra janāspade ||45|| tasya priyātithereva nṛpasya bahudāyinaḥ || arthibhyo dānaśauṃḍasya guṇāḥ sarvatra viśrutāḥ ||46|| atha pautrāyaṇasyāsya guṇa grāmeṇa vartataḥ || devarṣayo mahābhāgāstasyānugrahakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 47 || haṃsarūpaṃ samāsthāya nidāghasamaye niśi || ramaṇīyāṃ vidhāyāśu śreṇīmākāśamāgataḥ || 49 || saudhavātāyanasthasya tasyopari mahīpateḥ || uḍḍīyoḍḍīya vegena tarasā jagmuruccakaiḥ || 49 || tarasā patatāṃ teṣāṃ haṃsānāṃ pṛṣṭhato vrajan || eko haṃsastu saṃbodhya haṃsamagresaraṃ tadā || 3.1.26.50 || sopahāsamidaṃ vākyaṃ prāha śṛṇvati rājani || bhobho bhallākṣa bhallākṣa puro gaccha nmarālaka || 51 || saudhamadhye purastādvai jānaśrutasuto nṛpaḥ || vartate pūjanīyo'yaṃ na paśyasi kimaṃdhavat || 52 || yasya tejo durādharṣamābrahma bhavanādidam || anaṃtādityasaṃkāśaṃ jvalate purato bhṛśam || 53 || tamatikramya rājarṣiṃ mā gāstvamupari drutam || yadi gacchasi tattejassāṃprataṃ tvāṃ pradhakṣyati || 54 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ haṃsamagrataḥ pratyabhāṣata || aho bhavānabhijño'si ślāghanīyo'si sūribhiḥ || 55 || aślāghanīyaṃ kitavaṃ yattva mene praśaṃsase || praśaṃsase kimarthaṃ tvamalpaṃ saṃtamimaṃ janam || 56 || bhasrāvatpaśuvaccaiva kevalaṃ śvāsadhāriṇam || na hyayaṃ vetti dharmāṇāṃ rahasyaṃ pṛthivī patiḥ || 57 || tattvajñānī yathā raikvaḥ sayugvānbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || raikvasya hi mahajjyotīrahasyaṃ daivatairapi || 58 || na hyasya prāṇamātrasya tejastādṛśa masti vai || raikvasya puṇyarāśīnāmiyattā naiva vidyate || 59 || gaṇyate pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyaṃte divi tārakāḥ || raikvapuṇyamahāmerusamūho naiva gaṇyate || || 3.1.26.60 || kiṃ ca tiṣṭhaṃtvime dharmā naśvarāstasya vai muneḥ || brahmajñānamabādhyaṃ yattena sa ślāghyate muniḥ || 61 || jānaśrutestu tādṛkṣo dharma eva na vidyate || durlabhaṃ yattu yogīndraiḥ kutastajjñānavaibhavam || 062 || parityajya durātmānaṃ tadvarākamimaṃ janam || sa eva raikvaḥ sayugvāñchlāghyatāṃ bhavatā muniḥ || 63 || janmanā paṃgurapi yaḥ svasya snānacikīrṣayā || gaṃgāṃ ca yamunāṃ cāpi gayāmapi munīśvaraḥ || 64 || āhvayāmāsa mantreṇa nijā śramasamīpataḥ || tasya brahmavido raikvamaharṣerdharmasaṃcaye || 65 || aṃtarbhavaṃti dharmaughāstrailokyodaravartinām || raikvasya dharmakakṣā tu na hi trailokyavarti nām || 66 || prāṇināṃ dharmakakṣāyāmantarbhavati karhicita || evamagresare haṃse kathitvoparate sati || 67 || haṃsarūpā munīṃdrāste brahmalokaṃ yayuḥ punaḥ || atha pautrāyaṇo rājā jānaśrutirariṃdamaḥ || 68 || raikvaṃ cotkarṣakāṣṭhāyāṃ niśamya paramāvadhim || viṣaṇṇo'bhavadatyarthaṃ varāko'kṣajito yathā || 69 || ciṃtayāmāsa sa nṛpaḥ paunaḥpunyena niḥśvasan || haṃsa utkarṣayanraikvaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ māmihābravīt || 3.1.26.70 || aho raikvasya māhātmyaṃ yaṃ praśaṃ saṃti pakṣiṇaḥ || tatparityajya saṃsāraṃ sarvaṃ rājyamihādhunā || 71 || sayugvānaṃ mahātmānaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ vraje || kṛpānidhiḥ sa vai raikvaḥ śaraṇaṃ māmu pāgatam || 72 || pratigṛhyātmavijñānaṃ mahyaṃ samupadekṣyati || ityasau ciṃtayanneva kathaṃkathamapi dvijāḥ || 73 || jāgrannevāyamudvelāṃ rātriṃ tāmatyavāha yat || niśāvasāne saṃprāpte baṃdivṛndapravartitam || 74 || aśṛṇonmaṃgalaravaṃ tūryaghoṣasamanvitam || tadākarṇya mahārājastadā talpastha eva san || 75 || sārathiṃ śīghramāhūya babhāṣe sādaraṃ vacaḥ || sārathe satvaraṃ gatvā rathamāruhya vegavat || 76 || āśrameṣu maharṣīṇāṃ puṇyeṣu vipineṣu ca || vivikteṣu pradeśeṣu satāmāvāsabhūmiṣu || 77 || tīrthānāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca kūleṣu pulineṣu ca || anyeṣu ca pradeśeṣu yatra saṃti munīśvarāḥ || || 78 || teṣu sarveṣu yogīṃdraṃ paṃguṃ śakaṭasaṃsthitam || raikvābhidhānaṃ sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāmekasaṃśrayam || 79 || brahmajñānaikanilayaṃ sayugvānaṃ gaveṣaya || anviṣya tūrṇaṃ matprītyai punarāgaccha sārathe || 3.1.26.80 || sa tatheti vinirgatya vegavadrathasaṃsthitaḥ || sarvatrānveṣayāmāsa raikvaṃ brahmavidaṃ munim || 81 || guhāsu parvatānāṃ ca munīnāmāśrameṣu ca || saṃcacāra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ tatra tatra gaveṣayan || 82 || anviṣya vividhāndeśānsārathistvarayā saha || kramānmaharṣisaṃbādhaṃ gaṃdhamādanamanvagāt || 83 || mārgamāṇaḥ sa tatrāpi taṃ dadarśa munīśvaram || kaṃḍūyamānaṃ pāmānaṃ śakaṭīyasthalasthi tam || 84 || advaitaniṣkalaṃ brahma ciṃtayaṃtaṃ nirantaram || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sārathistatra sayugvānaṃ mahāmunim || 85 || raikvo'yamiti saṃciṃtya tamāsādya praṇamya ca || vinayānmunimaprākṣīdupaviśya tadantike || 86 || sayugvānraikvanāmā ca brahmankiṃ vai bhavā niti || tasya vākyaṃ samākarṇya sa muniḥ pratyabhāṣata || 87 || ahameva sayugvānvai raikvanāmeti vai tadā || ityākarṇya mune rvākyamiṃgitairbahubhistathā || 88 || kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya dhanecchāmavagamya ca || sarvaṃ nyavedayadrājñe nivṛtto gaṃdhamādanāt || 89 || jānaśrutirniśamyātha sārathervākyamādarāt || ṣaṭśatāni gavāṃ cāpi niṣkabhāraṃ dhanasya ca || 3.1.26.90 || rathaṃ cāśvatarīyuktaṃ samādāya tvarānvitaḥ || pautrāyaṇaḥ sa rājarṣistaṃ raikvaṃ praticakrame || 91 || gatvā ca vacanaṃ prāha taṃ raikvaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ || bhagavanraikva sayugvanmaddattaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 92 || ṣaṭśatāni gavāṃ cāpi niṣkabhāraṃ dhanasya ca || rathaṃ cāśvatarīyuktaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakam || 93 || gṛhītvā savametattu bho brahmannanuśādhi mām || advaitabrahmavijñānaṃ mahyaṃ samupadiśyatām || 94 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā saspṛhaṃ ca saṃsabhram || raikvaḥ pratyāha sayugvāñjānaśrutimariṃdamam || || 95 || || raikva uvāca || || etā gāvastavaivāstu niṣkabhārastathā rathaḥ || kimalpena mamānena bahukalpeṣu jīvataḥ || 96 || na me kuṭuṃba nirvāhe paryāptamidamaṃjasā || evaṃ śataguṇaṃ cāpi yadi dattaṃ tvayā mama || 97 || nālaṃ tadapi rājeṃdra kuṭuṃbabharaṇāya vai || iti raikvavacaḥ śrutvā jānaśrutirabhāṣata || 98 || || jānaśrutiruvāca || || tvayopadiśyamānasya brahmajñānasya vai mune || na hi mūlyamidaṃ brahmangodhanaṃ ratha eva ca || || 99 || pratigṛhṇīṣva vā mā vā mamaitattu gavādikam || niṣkalādvaitavijñānaṃ brahmannupadiśasva me || tadākarṇya vacastasya sayugvānvākya mabravīt || 3.1.26.100 || || raikva uvāca || || nirvedo yasya saṃsāre tathā vai puṇyapāpayoḥ || 101 || prārabdhayorvināśaśca sa vai jñānopadeśabhāk || tava yadyapi saṃsāre nirvedaḥ samajāyata || 102 || tathāpi puṇyapāpānāṃ na hi nāśo vyājayata || puṇyapāpaughasaṃghāśca punarjanmani hetavaḥ || 103 || na hi bhogaṃ vinā teṣāṃ nāśo bhavati bhūpate || tannāśopāyamadyāhaṃ tathāpi prabravīmi te || 104 || yato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ || atra tīrthatrayaṃ puṇyaṃ vartate'bhīṣṭadāyakam || 105 || mumukṣūṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sarvaprārabdhanāśanam || etaddhi yamunātīrthaṃ gaṃgātīrthaṃ tathaiva ca || 106 || gayātīrtha midaṃ cāpi tadeṣu snāhi mā ciram || sarvaprārabdhanāśaḥ syāttadā naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 107 || tataste
