śuddhacittasya jñānaṃ caiva diśāmyaham || ityukte raikvamuninā harṣasaṃphullalocanaḥ || 108 || sasaṃbhramamupāgamya sasnau tīrthatraye'pi saḥ || tattīrthasnānamātreṇa śuddhacitto'bhavannṛpaḥ || 109 || upātiṣṭhata rājā sau sayugvānaṃ guruṃ punaḥ || sayugvā sa ca raikvo'pi munīṃdrairapi durlabham || 3.1.26.110 || tajjānaśrutaye jñānaṃ kṛpayāsamupādiśat || tenopadiṣṭamātre tu vijñāne brahmarūpiṇi || 111 || abādhitānubhavavānabhavadrājasattamaḥ || brahmarūpaṃ gatasyāsya prasādādraikvayoginaḥ || 112 || ghaṭakuḍyakusūlātmā na prapaṃcassamasphurat || nirbhidya sahasā māyāmabhūdbrahmaiva kevalam || 113 || itthaṃ tīrthatraye snānājjānaśrutiraho nṛpaḥ || durlabhaṃ yogivṛṃdaiśca brahmabhūyatvamāptavān || 114 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāstattīrthatrayavaibhavam || yastvimaṃ paṭhate'dhyāyaṃ tīrthatritayavaibhavam || 115 || nirbhidyājñānatimiraṃbrahmabhūyāya kalpate || 116 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye yamunāgaṃgāgayātīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ jānaśruti jñānāvāptivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || ||
<3.1.27>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || yamunāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ gayāyāṃ ca naro mudā || snānaṃ vidhāya vidhivatkoṭitīrthaṃ tato vrajet || 1 || koṭitīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2 || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ hyetanmahāpātakanāśanam || mahāvighnapraśamanaṃ mahāśāṃtikaraṃ nṛṇām || 3 || smṛtimātreṇa yatpuṃsāṃ sarvapāpaniṣūdanam || līlayā dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā svayaṃ rāmeṇa nirmitam || 4 || purā dāśarathī rāmo nihatya yudhi rāvaṇam || brahmahatyāvimokṣāya gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 5 || prātiṣṭhipalliṃgamekaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā || liṃgasyāsyābhiṣekāya śuddhaṃ vāri gaveṣayan || 6 || nāviṃdata jalaṃ tatra pārśve daśarathātmajaḥ || liṃgābhiṣekayogyaṃ ca jalaṃ kimiti ciṃtayan || 7 || navena vāriṇā liṃgaṃ snāpanīyaṃ mayeti saḥ || niścitya manasā tatra dhanuṣkoṭyā raghūdvahaḥ || 8 || bibheda dharaṇīṃ śīghraṃ manasā jāhnavīṃ smaran || rāmakārmukakoṭiḥ sā tadā prāpa rasātalam || 9 || tata uddhārayāmāsa taddhanurdhanvināṃ varaḥ || dhanuṣyuddhriyamāṇe tu rāghaveṇa mahītalāt || 3.1.27.10 || kākutsthena smṛtā gaṃgā niryayau vivarāttataḥ || vāriṇā tena talliṃgamabhyaṣiṃcadraghūdvahaḥ || 11 || rāmakārmu kakoṭyaiva yatastannirmitaṃ purā || ataḥ koṭiriti khyātaṃ tattīrthaṃ bhuvanatraye || 12 || yāni yānīha tīrthāni saṃti vai gaṃdhamādane || prathamaṃ teṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā vigatakalmaṣaḥ || 13 || śeṣapāpavimokṣāya snāyātkoṭau narastataḥ || tīrthāṃtareṣu snānena yaḥ pāpaugho na naśyati || 14 || anekajanmakoṭībhirarjito hyasthisaṃsthitaḥ || vinaśyati sa sarvo'pi koṭisnānānna saṃśayaḥ || 15 || yadi hi prathamaṃ snāyādatra koṭau naro dvijāḥ || tasya muktasya tīrthāni vyarthānyevāparāṇi hi || 16 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta sarvārthatattvajña vyāsaśiṣya munīśvara || asmākaṃ saṃśayaṃ kaṃcicchiṃdhi paurāṇikottama || 17 || koṭau snātasya martyasya yadi tīrthāṃtaraṃ vṛthā || kimarthaṃ dharmatīrthādi tīrtheṣu snāṃti mānavāḥ ||18|| tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi samatikramya mānavāḥ|| atraiva koṭau kiṃ snānaṃ na kurvaṃti hi tadvada || 19 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || aho rahasyaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ pṛṣṭametanmunīśvarāḥ || nāradāya purā śaṃbhuḥ pṛcchate yatkilābravīt || 3.1.27.20 || tadbravīmi muniśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ śraddhayā saha || gacchanyadṛcchayā vāpi tīrthayātrāparo'pi vā || 21 || mārgamadhye dvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ devālayaṃ tathā || dṛṣṭvā śrutvāpi vā mohānna seveta narādhamaḥ || 22 || niṣkṛtistasya nāstīti prābruvanparamarṣayaḥ || setuṃ gacchaṃstato'nyeṣu na snāyādyadi mānavaḥ || 23 || tīrthātikramadoṣaiḥ sa bahiṣkāryo'tyavaddvijaiḥ || ataḥ snātavyamevaiṣu cakratīrthādiṣu dvijāḥ || 24 || snātvā caiteṣu tīrtheṣu śeṣapāpavimuktaye || prayatairmanujairatra snātavyaṃ koṭitīrthake || 25 || koṭau cābhi ṣavaṃ kṛtvā na tiṣṭhedgandhamādane || nivartettatkṣaṇādeva niṣpāpo gaṃdhamādanāt || 26 || rāmo'pi hi purā koṭitīrthasaṃbhūtavāriṇā || rāmanāthe'bhiṣikte tu svayaṃ snātvā ca tatra vai || 27 || brahmahatyāvimuktaḥ saṃstatkṣaṇādeva sānujaḥ || ārūḍhapuṣpako'yodhyāṃ prayayau kapibhirvṛtaḥ || 28 || ataḥ koṭau naraḥ snātvā pāpaśeṣavimocitaḥ || nivartettatkṣaṇādeva rāmo dāśarathiryathā || 29 || etaddhi tīrthapravaraṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || rāmanāthābhiṣekāya nirmitaṃ rāghaveṇa yat || 3.1.27.30 || svayaṃ bhagavatī yatra sannidhatte ca jāhnavī || tārakabrahmaṇā yatra rāmeṇa snātamādarāt || 31 || tasya vai koṭitīrthasya mahimā kena kathyatām || yatra snātvā purā kṛṣṇo lokasaṃgrahaṇecchayā || 32 || mātulasya tu kaṃsasya vadhadoṣādvimocitaḥ || tasya vai koṭitīrthasya mahimā kena kathyate || 33 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kimarthamavadhītkaṃsaṃ mātulaṃ yadunaṃdanaḥ || yaddoṣaśāṃtaye sūta sasnau koṭau mahā manāḥ || 34 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || vasudeva iti khyātaḥ śūraputro yadoḥ kule || āsītsa devakasutāṃ devakīmiti viśrutām || 35 || udvāhya rathamārūḍhaḥ svapuraṃ prasthitaḥ purā || atha sūto babhūvātha kaṃso hyānakadundubheḥ || 36 || aśarīrā tadā vāṇī kaṃsaṃ sārathimabravīt || bhaginīṃ ca tathā bhāmaṃ vāhayaṃtaṃ rathottame || 37 || yāmimāṃ vāhayasyatra rathena tvamariṃdama || asyāstvāmaṣṭamo garbho vadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 38 || ityākarṇya vaco divyaṃ kaṃsaḥ khaṅgaṃ pragṛhya ca || svasāraṃ haṃtumudyogaṃ cakāra dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 39 || tataḥ provāca taṃ kaṃsaṃ vasudevaḥ sa sāṃtvayan || || || vasudeva uvāca || || asyāṃ prasūtāndāsyāmi tubhyaṃ kaṃsa sutānaham || 3.1.27.40 || enāṃ svasāraṃ mā hiṃsīrnāsyāste bhītirasti hi || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ kaṃso nivṛttastadvadhāttadā || 41 || devakīvasudevābhyāṃ sahitaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || pādāvasaktanigaḍau devakīvasudevakau || 42 || sthāpayāmāsa duṣṭātmā kaṃsaḥ kārāgṛhe tadā || tataḥ kālena mahatā vasudevāddhi devakī || 43 || ṣaṭputrāñjanayāmāsa krameṇa munipuṃgavāḥ || jātāṃstānvasudevena dattānkaṃso'pi so'vadhīt || 44 || hateṣu ṣaṭasu putreṣu devakyudarajanmasu || kaṃsena krūramatinā niṣkṛpeṇa dvijottamāḥ || 45 || śeṣo'bhūtsaptamo garbho devakyā jaṭhare tadā || māyādevī tato garbhaṃ taṃ vai viṣṇupracoditā || 46 || naṃdagopagṛhasthāyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ samaveśayat || devakyāḥ saptamo garbhaḥ patito jaṭharāditi || 47 || loke prasiddhirabhavanmahatī viṣṇulīlayā || devakījaṭhare paścādviṣṇurgarbhatvamāptavān || 48 || tato daśasu māseṣu gateṣu hariravyayaḥ || devakījaṭharājjajñe kṛṣṇa ityabhiviśrutaḥ || 49 || śaṃkhacakragadākhaṅgavirājitacaturbhujaḥ || kirīṭī vanamālī ca pitroḥ śokavināśanaḥ || 3.1.27.50 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā harimīśānaṃ tuṣṭāvānakaduṃdubhiḥ || 51 || || vasudeva uvāca || || viśvaṃ bhavā nviśvapatistvameva viśvasya yonistvayi viśvamāste || mahānpradhānaśca virāṭa svarāḍ ca samrāḍasi tvaṃ bhagavansamastam || 52 || evaṃ jagatkāraṇabhūtadhāmne nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya || śrīśārṅgacakrāsigadādharāya namonamaḥ kṛtrimamānuṣāya || 53 || stuvantamevaṃ śauriṃ taṃ vasudevaṃ haristadā || avocatprīṇayaṃstaṃ ca devakīṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 54 || || hariruvāca || || ahaṃ kaṃsaṃ vadhiṣyāmi mā bhīrvāṃ pitarāviti || nandagopasya gṛhiṇī yaśodā'janayatsutām || mama māyāṃ pūrvadine sarvalokavimohinīm || 55 || māṃ tasyāḥ śayane nyasya yaśodāyāḥ sutā tu tām|| ādāya devakīśayyāṃ prāpayasva yadūttama || 56 || evamuktaḥ sa kṛṣṇena tathaiva hyakaroddvijāḥ || ruroda māyā tanayā devakīśayanesthitā || 57 || atha bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā kaṃsaḥ saṃkulamānasaḥ || sūtikāgṛhamāgamya tāmādāya ca dārikām||58|| śilāyāṃ pothayāmāsa nirdayo nirapatrapaḥ || atha taddhastamācchidya sāyudhāṣṭamahābhujā || mahādevyabravītkaṃsaṃ samāhūyātikopanā || 59 || || māyovāca || || are re kaṃsa pāpātmandurbuddhe mūḍhacetana || 3.1.27.60 || yatra kutrāpi śatruste vartate prāṇahārakaḥ || mārgayasvātmano mṛtyuṃ taṃ śatruṃ kaṃsa mā ciram || 61 || itīrayitvā sā devī divyasthānānyavāpya ca || labdhapūjā manuṣyebhyo babhūvābhīṣṭadāyinī || 62 || śrutvā sa devīvacanaṃ kaṃso 'pi bhṛśamākulaḥ || bālagrahānpūtanādīnsvāṃtakaṃ bādhituṃ ripum || 63 || preṣayāmāsa deśeṣu śiśūnanyāṃśca bādhitum|| te ca bālagrahāḥ sarve prayayu rnaṃdagokulam || 64 || hatāśca kṛṣṇena tadā prayayuryamasādanam || tataḥ katipayāhassu gateṣu dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 65 || rāmakṛṣṇau vyavarddhetāṃ gokule bālakau tadā || anekabālakrīḍābhiścikrīḍaturariṃdamau || 66 || kaṃcitkālaṃ vatsapālau veṇunādamakurvatām || kaṃcitkālaṃ ca gopālau guṃjātāpi cchabhūṣitau || 67 || remāte bahukālaṃ tau gokule rāmakeśavau || kaṃsaḥ kadācidakrūraṃ gokule rāmakeśavau || 68 || preṣayāmāsa vipreṃdrāḥ samānayitumaṃ jasā || ānayāmāsa cākrūro rāmakṛṣṇau sa gokulāt || 69 || mathurāṃ kaṃsanirdeśātsvarṇatoraṇarājitām ||3.1.27.70|| tataḥ samānīya sa rāmakeśavau yayau purīṃ gāṃdinijastadagre || dṛṣṭvā ca kaṃsaṃ vinivedya kāryaṃ tasmai svagehaṃ praviveśa paścāt ||71|| athāparāhṇe vasudevaputrāvanyedyuriṣṭaiḥ saha gopaputraiḥ || upeyatuḥ sālanikhātayuktāṃ saṃgopurāṭṭāṃ madhurāpurīṃ tau || 72 || stotrāṇi śṛṇvanpurayauvatānāṃ kṛṣṇastu rāmeṇa sahaiva gatvā || dhanurniveśaṃ saha saiva tatra dadarśa cāpaṃ ca mahadṛḍhajyam || 73 || vidrāvya sarvānapi cāpapālāndhanuḥ samādāya sa līlayā''śu || maurvyāṃ niyoktuṃ namayāṃcakāra tadaṃ tare bhagnamabhūdvidhaiva || 74 || kodaṃḍabhaṃgotthitaśabdamāśu śrutvābhiyātānbalino nihaṃtum || nijaghnatustau pratigṛhya khaṃḍau cāpasya pālānbalinau dvijeṃdrā || 75 || tataḥ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ gajaṃ dvāri sthitaṃ kṣaṇāt || nihatya rāmakṛṣṇau tau mahābalaparākramau || 76 || tasya daṃtau samutpāṭya dadhānau karayordvayoḥ || aṃse nidhāya tau daṃtau raṃgaṃ prayayatuḥ kṣaṇāt || 77 || nihatya mallaṃ cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ tośalaṃ tathā || anyāṃśca mallapravarānninyaturyamasā danam ||78|| samāruruhatustūrṇaṃ tuṃgaṃ maṃcaṃ ca tau tadā || tatra tuṃge samāsīnamāsane kaṃsametya tau || tasthatustaṃ tṛṇīkṛtya siṃhau kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā ||79|| tataḥ kaṃsaṃ samākṛṣya kṛṣṇo maṃcopari sthitam || pādau gṛhītvā vegena bhrāmayāmāsa cāṃbare || 3.1.27.80 || tatastaṃ pothayāmāsa sa bhūmau gata jīvitam || kaṃsabhrātṝnbalo'pyaṣṭau nijaghne muṣṭinā dvijāḥ || 81 || evaṃ nihatya taṃ kaṃsaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ parabalārdanaḥ || pitarau mocayāmāsa nigaḍādati duḥkhitau || 82 || sarvānāsthāpayāmāsa balena saha mādhavaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇena hataṃ kaṃsaṃ śrutvā prāpuḥ purīṃ tadā || 83 || bāṃdhavā mathurāyāṃ ye pūrvaṃ kaṃse na bādhitāḥ || ugrasenaṃ tathā rājye sthāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 84 || asahiṣṇurdvijāḥ pitrorevaṃ kaṃsakṛtāgasam || jaghāna mātulaṃ kaṃsaṃ devabrāhmaṇakaṃṭa kam || 85 || tataḥ kadācikṛṣṇo'yamātmānaṃ draṣṭumāgatān || nāradādīnmunīnsarvānidaṃ papraccha sattamaḥ || 86 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || mayā'yaṃ mātulo viprā hataḥ kaṃso'tipāpakṛt || mātulasya vadhe doṣaḥ procyate śāstravittamaiḥ|| 87 || prāyaścittamato brūta taddoṣavinivṛttaye || avocannāradastatra kṛṣṇamadbhutavikramam || vācā madhurayā viprā bhaktipraṇayapūrvakam || 88 || || nārada uvāca || || nityaśuddhaśca muktaśca bhadraścaiva bhavā nsadā || 89 || saccidānaṃdarūpaśca paramātmā sanātanaḥ || puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ca te nāsti kṛṣṇa yādavanaṃdana || 3.1.27.90 || tathāpi lokaśikṣārthaṃ bhavatā garu ḍadhvaja || prāyaścittaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vidhinānena mādhava || 91 || lokasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tāvatkartavyaṃ bhavatādhunā || rāmasetau mahāpuṇye gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 92 || rāmeṇa sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ rāmanāthābhidhaṃ purā || tasyābhiṣekatoyārthaṃ dhanuṣkoṭyā raghūdvahaḥ || 93 || gāṃ bhittvotpādayāmāsa tīrthaṃ koṭīti viśrutam || tava pūrvāvatāreṇa rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || 94 || brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ nirmitaṃ svayameva yat || tatra snānaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ dharmye pāpavināśane || 95 || tena te mātulavadhāddoṣaḥ śīghraṃ vinaṃkṣyati || koṭitīrthe hareḥ snānaṃ brahmahatyādiśodhakam || 96 || svargamokṣapradaṃ puṃsāmāyurārogyavardhanam || iti śrutvā munervākyaṃ nāradasya sa mādhavaḥ || 97 || visṛjya tānṛṣīnsarvāṃstasminneva kṣaṇe dvijāḥ || rāmasetau yayau tūrṇaṃ svadoṣapari śuddhaye || 98 || dinaiḥ katipayairgatvā koṭitīrthaṃ yadūdvahaḥ || snātvā saṃkalpapūrvaṃ ca dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ || 99 || sa mātulavadhotpannadoṣebhyo mumu ce kṣaṇāt || niṣevya rāmanāthaṃ ca svapuraṃ mathurāṃ yayau || 3.1.27.100 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ puṇyaṃ ca koṭitīrthaṃ munīśvarāḥ || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ sadyo mucyeta mānavaḥ || nānena sadṛśaṃ tīrthamanyadasti mahītale || 101 || atra snānāttrayo devā brahmaviṣṇuśivā dvijāḥ || prītāḥ syuranye devāśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 102 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ citraṃ koṭitīrthasya vaibhavam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 103 || śrutvemaṃ puṇyamadhyāyaṃ paṭhitvā ca munīśvarāḥ || brahmahatyādibhiḥ satyaṃ mucyate pātakairnaraḥ || 104 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye koṭitīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ kṛṣṇasya mātulavadhadoṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || || cha ||
<3.1.28>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || koṭitīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sevitvā kevalaṃ naraḥ || snātuṃ jiteṃdriyastīrthaṃ tataḥ sādhyāmṛtaṃ vrajet || 1 || sādhyāmṛtaṃ mahātīrtha mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || 2 || asti pāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 3 || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñairdānena vā punaḥ || gatiṃ tāṃ na labhenmartyo yāṃ sādhyāmṛtamajjanāt || 4 || spṛṣṭāni yeṣāmaṃgāni sādhyāmṛtajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || teṣāṃ dehagataṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 5 || sādhyāmṛtajale yastu sāghamarṣaṇakṛnnaraḥ || sa vidhūyeha pāpāni viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 6 || pūrve vayasi pāpāni kṛtvā karmāṇi yo naraḥ || paścātsādhyāmṛtaṃ sevetpaścāttāpasamanvitaḥ || 7 || ante vayasi muktaḥ syātsa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ || sādhyāmṛte naraḥ snātvā dehabaṃdhādvimucyate || 8 || sādhyāmṛtajale snātā manuṣyāḥ pāpaka rmiṇaḥ || anekakleśaghorāṇi narakāṇi na yāṃti hi || 9 || sādhyāmṛtajale snānātpuṃsāṃ yā syādgatirdvijāḥ || na sā gatirbhavedyajñairna vedaiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ || 3.1.28.10 || yāvadasthi manuṣyāṇāṃ sādhyāmṛtajale sthitam || tāvadvarṣāṇi tiṣṭhaṃti śivaloke supūjitāḥ || 11 || apahatya tamastīvraṃ yathā bhātyudaye raviḥ || tathā sādhyāmṛtasnāyī bhittvā pāpāni rājate || 12 || vāṃchitām̐llabhate kāmānatra snāto naraḥ sadā || yatra snātvā mahāpuṇye purā rājā purūravāḥ || viprayogaṃ sahorvaśyā jahau tuṃburuśāpajam || 13 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ sūta mahābhāga sahorvaśyāmarastriyā || 14 || prathamaṃ labdhavānyogaṃ martyo rājā purūravāḥ || viprayogaṃ sahorvaśyā jahau tuṃburuśāpajam || 15 || hetunā kena rājānaṃ śaśāpa tuṃbururmuniḥ || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistarānmunipuṃgava || 16 || || sūta uvāca || || āsītpurūravānāma śakratulyaparākramaḥ || rājarājasamo rājā purā hyamarapūjitaḥ || 17 || dharmataḥ pālayāmāsa medinīṃ sa nṛpottamaḥ || īje ca bahubhiryajñairdadau dānāni sarvadā || 18 || praśāsati mahīṃ sarvāṃ rājñi tasminmahāmatau || mitrāvaruṇaśāpena bhuvaṃ prāporvaśī dvijāḥ || 19 || sā cacārorvaśī tatra rājñastasya purāṃtike || kokilālāpamadhuravīṇayopavane jagau || 3.1.28.20 || sa rājopavane raṃtuṃ kadāciddhṛtakautukaḥ || ārūḍhaturagaḥ prāyāllalanāśatasaṃvṛtaḥ || 21 || tādṛśīmurvaśīṃ tatra karasammitamadhyamām || uvāca caināṃ rājāsau bhāryā mama bhaveti vai || 22 || sāpi kāmāturā tatra rājānaṃ pratyabhāṣata || bhavatvevaṃ naraśreṣṭha samayaṃ yadi me bhavān || 23 || kariṣyati tavābhyāśe vatsyāmi dhṛtakautukā || kariṣye samayaṃ subhru tavāhamiti so'bravīt || 24 || athorvaśī babhāṣe taṃ purūravasamutsukā || putrabhūtaṃ mama yadi rakṣasyuraṇakadvayam || 25 || na nagno dṛśyase rājankadāpi yadi vai tathā || nocchiṣṭaṃ mama dadyāścettadā vatsye tavāṃtike || 26 || ghṛtamātrāśanā cāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi nṛpottama || evamastviti rājoktāṃ tāṃ nināya nijaṃ gṛham || 27 || alakāyāṃ sa bhūpālastathā caitrarathe vane || reme sarasvatītīre padmakhaṇḍamanorame || 28 || ekaṣaṣṭiṃ sa varṣāṇi ramamāṇastayānayat || tenorvaśī pratidinaṃ vardhamānānurāgiṇī || 29 || spṛhāṃ na devaloke'pi cakāra tanumadhyamā || nābhavadramaṇīyo'sau devalokastayā vinā || 3.1.28.30 || atastāmānayiṣyāmi devalokamiti dvijāḥ || viśvāvasurvicāryaivaṃ bhūrlokamagamatkṣaṇāt || 31 || urvaśyāḥ samayaṃ rājñā viśvāvasurayaṃ saha || viditvā saha gandharvaiḥ samaveto niśāṃtare || 32 || urvaśyāḥ śayanābhyāśājjagrāhoraṇakaṃ javāt || ākāśe nīyamānasya tasya śrutvorvaśī patim ||33|| abravīnmatsutaḥ kena gṛhyate tyajyatāmayam || anāthā śaraṇaṃ yāmi kaṃ naraṃ gatacetanā||34|| purūravāḥ samākarṇya vākyaṃ tasyā niśāṃtare || māṃ na nagnaṃ nirīkṣeta devīti na yayau tadā || 35 || athānyamapyuraṇakaṃ gandharvāḥ pratigṛhya te || yayustasyoraṇasyāpi śabdaṃ śuśrāva corvaśī || 36 || anāthāyā mama suto gṛhyate taskarairiti || cukrośa devī paruṣaṃ kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ naram || 37 || amarṣavaśamāpannaḥ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ nṛpaḥ || timireṇāvṛtaṃ sarvamiti mattvā sa khaṅgadhṛk || 38 || duṣṭaduṣṭa kuto yāsītyabhyadhāvadvaco vadan || tāvatsaudāminī dīptā gandha rvairjanitā bhṛśam || 39 || tatprabhāmaṃḍalairdevī rājānaṃ vigatāṃbaram || dṛṣṭvā nivṛttasamayā tatkṣaṇādeva niryayau || 3.1.28.40 || tyaktvā hyuraṇakau tatra gaṃdharvā api niryayuḥ || rājā meṣau samādāya hṛṣṭaḥ svaśayanāṃtikam || 41 || āgato norvaśīṃ tatra dadarśāyatalocanām || tāṃ cāpaśyanvivastraśca babhrāmonmattavadbhuvi || 42 || kurukṣetraṃ gato rājā taṭāke padmasaṃkule || caturbhirapsarastrībhiḥ krīḍamānā dadarśa tām|| 43 || he jāye tiṣṭha manasā ghoreti vyāharanmuhuḥ || evaṃ bahuprakāraṃ vai sa sūktaṃ prālapannṛpaḥ || 44 || abravīdurvaśī taṃ ca krīḍatī sāpsarogaṇaiḥ || mahārājālametena ceṣṭitena tavānagha || 45 || tvatto garbhiṇyahaṃ pūrvamabdāṃte bhavatātra vai || āgaṃtavyaṃ kumāraste bhaviṣyatyatidhārmikaḥ || 46 || ekāṃ vibhāvarīṃ rājaṃstvayā vatsyāmi vai tadā || ityukto nṛpatirhṛṣṭaḥ svapurīṃ prāviśaddvijāḥ || 47|| tāsāmapsarasāṃ sā tu kathayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam || ayaṃ sa puruṣaśreṣṭho yenāhaṃ kāmarūpiṇā || 48 || etāvaṃtaṃ mahākālamanurāgavaśāturā || uṣitāsmi sahānena sakhyo nṛpatinā ciram || 49 || evamuktāstataḥ sakhyastāmūcuḥ sādhusādhviti || anena sākamāsyāmaḥ sarvakālaṃ vayaṃ sakhi || 3.1.28.50 || ityūcururvaśīṃ tatra sakhīmapsarasastadā || abde'tha pūrṇe rājāpi taṭākāṃti kamāyayau || 51 || āgataṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā purūravasamurvaśī || kumāramāyuṣaṃ tasmai dadau saṃprītamānasā || 52 || tena sākaṃ niśāmekāmuṣitā sānu rāgiṇī || paṃcaputrapradaṃ garbhaṃ tasmādāpāśu sorvaśī || 53 || uvāca cainaṃ rājānamurvaśī paramāṃganā || varaṃ dāsyaṃti gandharvā matprītyā tava bhūpate || 54 || bhavatāṃ prārthyatāṃ tebhyo varo rājarṣisattama || ityuktaḥ sa tayā rājā prāha gandharvasattamān || 55 || ahaṃ saṃpūrṇakośaśca vijitārāti maṃḍalaḥ || salokatāṃ vinorvaśyāḥ prāptavyaṃ nānyadasti me || 56 || atastayā sahorvaśyā kālaṃ netumahaṃ vṛṇe || evamukte nṛpeṇātha gandharvāstuṣṭa mānasāḥ || agnisthālīṃ pradāyāsmai procuścainaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā || 57 || || gandharvā ūcuḥ || || agniṃ vedānusārī tvaṃ tridhā kṛtvā nṛpottama || 58 || iṣṭvā yajñena corvaśyāḥ sālokyaṃ yāhi bhūpate || itīritastairādāya sthālīmagneryayau nṛpaḥ || 59 || aho batātimūḍhohamiti madhye vanaṃ nṛpaḥ || urvaśī na mayā labdhā vahnisthālyā tu kiṃ phalam || 3.1.28.60 || nidhāyaiva vane sthālīṃ svapuraṃ prayayau nṛpaḥ || ardharātre vyatīte'sau vinidro'ciṃtayatsvayam || 61 || urvaśīlokasiddhyarthaṃ mama gandharvapuṃgavaiḥ || agnisthālī saṃpradattā sā ca tyaktā mayā vane || 62|| āhariṣye punaḥ sthālīmityutthāya yayau vanam || nāgnisthālīṃ dadarśāsau vane tatra purūravāḥ || 63 || śamīgarbhamathāśvatthamagnisthāne vilokya saḥ || vyaciṃtayanmayā sthālī nikṣiptātra vane purā || 64 || sā cāśvatthaḥ śamīgarbhaḥ samabhūdadhunā tviha || tasmādenaṃ samādāya vahnirūpamahaṃ puram|| || 65 || gatvā kṛtvāraṇīṃ samyaktadutpannāgnimādarāt || upāsyāmīti niścitya svapuraṃ gatavānnṛpaḥ || 66 || ramaṇīyāraṇīṃ cakre svāṃgulaiḥ pramitā masau || nirmāṇasamaye rājā gāyatrīmajapaddvijāḥ || 67 || gāyatryāḥ paṭhyamānāyā yāni saṃtyakṣarāṇi hi || tāvadaṃgulimaryādāmakarodaraṇīṃ nṛpaḥ || 68 || tatra nirmathanādagnitrayamutpādya bhūpatiḥ || urvaśīlokasaṃprāptiphalamuddiśya kāṃkṣitam || 69 || vedānusārī nṛpatirjuhāvāgnitrayaṃ mudā || tenaiva cāgnividhinā bahūnyajñānathātanot||3.1.28.7|||| tena gandharvalokāṃśca saṃprāpya jagatīpatiḥ|| sahorvaśyā ciraṃ reme devaloke dvijottamāḥ||71|| atha sarvāmaropetaḥ kadācidbalavṛtrahā|| nṛtyaṃ surāṃganānāṃ vai vyalokayata saṃsadi||72|| purūravā nṛpopyāyāttadā deveṃdrasaṃsadam || draṣṭuṃ surāṃganānṛtyaṃ manohāri divaukasām || 73 || ekaikaśastāḥ śakrasya nanṛtuḥ puratoṃ'ganāḥ || athorvaśī samāgatya nanarta purato hareḥ || 74 || nṛttābhinayasāmarthyagarvayuktā tadorvaśī || taṃ purūravasaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahāsātimanoharā || 75 || jahāsa tatra rājāpi tāṃ vilokya tadorvaśīm || hāsasaṃkupitastatra nāṭyācāryo'tha tuṃburuḥ || śaśāpa tāvubhau kopādurvaśīṃ ca nṛpottamam || 76 || || || tuṃbururuvāca || || anekadevasaṃpūrṇasabhāyāmatra yatkṛtam || 77 || yuvābhyāṃ hasitaṃ nṛttamadhye niṣkāraṇaṃ vṛthā || tasmājjhaṭiti rājeṃdra viyogo yuvayoḥ kṣaṇāt || 78 || bhūyāditi śaśāpainaṃ sarvadaivatasaṃnidhau || atha śapto nṛpastatra nāṭyācāryeṇa duḥkhitaḥ || 79 || jagāma śaraṇaṃ tatra pāhipāhīti vajriṇam || uvāca dīnayā vācā puruhūtaṃ purūravāḥ || 3.1.28.80 || urvaśyā saha sālokyasiddhyarthamahamiṣṭavān || atastasmā viyogo me'sahyaḥ syātpākaśāsana || 81 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ prāha sahasrākṣaḥ śacīpatiḥ || śāpamokṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi mā bhaiṣīstvaṃ nṛpottama || 82 || dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhau puṇye gaṃdhamādanaparvate || sādhyāmṛtamiti khyātaṃ tīrthamasti mahattaram || 83 || sevitaṃ sarvadevaiśca siddhacāraṇakinnaraiḥ || sanakādi mahāyogimunivṛṃdaniṣevitam || 84 || bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvaśāpavimokṣadam || asti tīrthaṃ bhavāṃstatra gacchasva tvarayā nṛpa || 85 || sarveṣāmamṛtaṃ snānādatra sādhyaṃ yatastataḥ || sādhyāmṛtamiti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || 86 || tatra snānāttavorvaśyāḥ punaryogo bhaviṣyati || mama loke nivāsaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 87 || iti pratisamādiṣṭo nṛpaḥ saṃprītamānasaḥ || sādhyāmṛtaṃ mahātīrthaṃ samuddiśya yayau kṣaṇāt || 88 || sasnau sādhyāmṛte tatra mahāpātakanāśane || tatra snānānnṛpo viprāḥ sadyaḥ śāpena mocitaḥ || 89 || snānānaṃtaramevāsāvurvaśyā saha saṃgataḥ || tayā saha vimānasthaḥ prayayāvamarāvatīm || 3.1.28.90 || reme punastayā sārdhaṃ devavaddevamaṃdire || evaṃprabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ sādhyāmṛtamanuttamam || 91 || purūravā sahorvaśyā yatra snānena saṃgataḥ || ato'tra tīrthe yaḥ snāyānmahāpātakanāśane || 92|| vāṃchitām̐llabhate kāmānyāsyati svargamuttamam || niṣkāmaḥ snāti cedvi prā mokṣamāpnoti mānavaḥ ||93|| imaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnamadhyāyaṃ paṭhate tu yaḥ|| śṛṇuyādvā manuṣyo'sau vaikuṃṭhe labhate sthitim ||94|| evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā vaibhavaṃ pāpanāśanam || sādhyāmṛtasya tīrthasya vistarācchraddhayā mayā || 95 || yatpurā sanakādibhyaḥ proktavāṃścaturānanaḥ || 96 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye sādhyāmṛtatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ purūravaḥśāpavimokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo adhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<3.1.29>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || snātvā sādhyāmṛte tīrthe nṛpaśāpavimokṣaṇe || sarvatīrthaṃ tato gacchenmanujo niyamānvitaḥ || 1 || sarvatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || śuddhyeta tatkṣaṇādeva savartīrthanimajjanāt || tāvatsarvāṇi pāpāni dehe tiṣṭhaṃti suvratāḥ || 3 || na yāvatsarvatīrthesminnimajjetpāpapūruṣaḥ |1 snānārthaṃ sarvatīrthe'smindṛṣṭvā yāṃtaṃ dvijā naram|| 4 || vepaṃte sarvapāpāni nāśo'smākaṃ bhavediti || garbhavāsādiduḥkhāni tāvadyāti naro bhuvi || 5 || na snāyātsarvatīrthe'sminyāvadbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ|| anuṣṭhitairmahāyāgaistathā tīrthaniṣevaṇaiḥ || 6 || gāyatryādimahāmaṃtrajapairniyamapūrvakam || caturṇāmapi vedānāmāvṛttyā śatasaṃkhyayā || 7 || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ pūjayā bhakti pūrvakam || ekādaśyāditithiṣu tathaivānaśanena ca|| yatphalaṃ labhate martyastallabhedatra majjanāt || 8 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sarvatīrthamiti khyātiḥ sūtāsya kathamāgatā || brūhyasmākamidaṃ puṇyaṃ vistarācchṛṇvatāṃ mune || 9 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || purā sucaritonāma munirniyamasaṃyutaḥ || || 3.1.29.10 || bhṛguvaṃśasamudbhūto jātyaṃdho jarayāturaḥ || aśaktastīrthayātrāyāṃ netrābhāvena sa dvijāḥ || 11 || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ snātukāmo mahāmu niḥ || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau puṇyaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvatam || 12 || gatvā śaṃkaramuddiśya tapastepe suduṣkaram || trikālamarcayañchaṃbhumupavāsī jiteṃdriyaḥ ||13|| tathā triṣavaṇasnānāttathaivātithipūjakaḥ || śiśire jalamadhyastho grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyagaḥ || 14 || varṣāsvāsārasahana abbhakṣo vāyubhojanaḥ || uddhūlanaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ ca bhasmanā dhārayansadā || 15 || jābālopaniṣadrītyā tathā rudrākṣadhārakaḥ || evamugraṃ tapaścakre daśasaṃvatsaraṃ dvijaḥ || 16 || tapasā tasya saṃtuṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraścaṃdraśekharaḥ || prādurāsīnmunestasya dvijāḥ sucaritasya vai || 17 || samāruhya mahokṣāṇaṃ bhūtavṛṃdaniṣevitaḥ || girijārdha vapuḥ śūlī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 18 || svabhāsā bhāsayansarvā diśo vitimirāstadā || bhasmapāṃḍurasarvāṃgo jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || 19 || anaṃtā dimahānāgavibhūṣaṇavibhūṣitaḥ || prādurbhūtastataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prādāttasya vilocane || 3.1.29.20 || ātmāvalokanārthāya śaṃkaro girijāpatiḥ || tataḥ sucarito viprāḥ śaṃbhunā dattadṛgdvayaḥ || ālokya parameśānaṃ pratuṣṭāva prasannadhīḥ || 21 || || sucarita uvāca || || jaya deva maheśāna jaya śaṃkara dhūrjaṭe || 22 || jaya brahmādipūjya tvaṃ tripuraghna yamāṃtaka || jayomeśa mahādeva kāmāṃtaka jayāmala || 23 || jaya saṃsāravaidya tvaṃ bhūtapāla śivāvya ya || triyaṃbaka namastubhyaṃ bhaktarakṣaṇadīkṣita || 24 || vyomakeśa namastubhyaṃ jaya kāruṇyavigraha || nīlakaṇṭha namastubhyaṃ jaya saṃsāramocaka||25|| maheśvara namastubhyaṃ paramānaṃdavigraha || gaṃgādhara namastubhyaṃ viśveśvara mṛḍāvyaya || 26 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate vāsudevāya śaṃbhave || śarvāyogrāya garbhāya kailāsapataye namaḥ || 27 || rakṣa māṃ karuṇāsiṃdho kṛpādaṣṭyavalokanāt || mama vṛttamanālocya trāhi māṃ kṛpayā hara||28|| śrīsūta uvāca|| iti stuto mahādevastamenamidamabhyadhāt || muniṃ sucaritaṃ viprā dayodanvānumāpatiḥ || 29 || || mahādeva uvāca || || mune sucaritādya tvaṃ varaṃ varaya kāṃkṣitam || varaṃ dātuṃ tavāyātaḥ puṇyesminnāśrame śubhe || itīrito muniḥ prāha mahādevaṃ dayānidhim || 3.1.29.30 || || || sucarita uvāca || || bhagavaṃstvaṃ prasanno me yadi syāścaṃdraśekhara || 31 || tarhi tvāṃ pravṛṇomyaddhā varaṃ madabhikāṃkṣitam || jarāpalitadehohaṃ kutracidgaṃtumakṣamaḥ || 32 || sarvatīrtheṣu ca snātumākāṃkṣā mama vidyate || tasmātsarveṣu tīrtheṣu snānena manujo hi yat || phalaṃ prāpnoti me brūhi tatphalā vāptisādhanam|| 33 || || mahādeva uvāca || || ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi tīrthānyatraiva kṛtsnaśaḥ || 34 || rāmasya setunā pūte nage'smingaṃdhamādane || ityuktvā sa mahādevaḥ parvate gandhamādane || 35 || tīrthānyāvāhayāmāsa muniprītyarthamuttamaḥ || tatassucaritaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || 36 || mune sucaritedaṃ tu mahāpātakanāśanam || sāṃnidhyātsarvatīrthānāṃ sarvatīrthābhidhaṃ smṛtam || 37 || mayātra sarvatīrthānāṃ manasākarṣaṇādidam || mānasaṃ tīrthamityākhyāṃ lapsyate bhuktimuktidam || 38 || ataḥ sucaritātra tvaṃ snāhi sadyo vimuktaye || mahāpātakasaṃghānāṃ dāvānalasamadyutau || || 39 || kāmamohabhayakrodhalobharogādināśane || vinā vedāṃtavijñānaṃ sadyonirvāṇakāraṇe || 3.1.29.40 || janmamṛtyvādinakraughasaṃsārārṇavatāraṇe || kumbhīpākādisakalanarakāgnivināśane || 41 || itīritaḥ sucaritaḥ śambhunā madanāriṇā || sasnau viprāḥ sarvatīrthe mahādevasya saṃnidhau || 42 || snātvotthitaḥ sucarito dadṛśe'khilamānavaiḥ || jarāpalitanirmuktastaruṇo'tīva sundaraḥ || 43 || dṛṣṭvā svadehasauṃdaryaṃ tataḥ sucarito muniḥ || ślāghayāmāsa tattīrthaṃ bahudhā'nye ca tāpasāḥ || 44 || mahādevaḥ sucaritaṃ babhāṣe tadanaṃtaram || asya tīrthasya tīre tvaṃ vasansucarita dvija || || 45 || snānaṃ kuruṣva satataṃ smaranmāṃ muktidāyakam || deśāṃtarīyatīrtheṣu mā vraja brāhmaṇottama || 46 || asya tīrthasya māhātmyānmāmaṃte prāpsyasi dhruvam|| anye'pi ye'tra snāsyaṃti te'pi māṃ prāpnuyurdvija || 47 || ityuktvā bhagavānīśastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || tasminnaṃtarhite rudre tataḥ sucarito muniḥ || 48 || anekakālaṃ nivasansarvatīrthasya tīrataḥ || snānaṃ samācaraṃstīrthe mānase niyamānvitaḥ || 49 || dehāṃte śaṃkaraṃ prāpa sarvabandhavimocitaḥ || sāyujyaṃ cāpi saṃprāpa sarvatīrthasya vaibhavāt || 3.1.29.50 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ sarvatīrthasya vaibhavam || etatpaṭhanvā śṛṇvanvā mucyate sarva pātakaiḥ || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye sarvatīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ sarvatīrthasvarūpa kathanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || cha ||
<3.1.30>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || vihitābhiṣavo martyaḥ sarvatīrthe'tipāvane || brahmahatyādipāpaghnīṃ dhanuṣkoṭiṃ tato vrajet || 1 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa muktaḥ syānmānavo bhuvi || dhanuṣkoṭiṃ prapaśyaṃti snāṃti vā kathayaṃti ye || 2 || aṣṭāviṃśatibhedāṃste narakānnopabhuṃjate || tāmisramaṃdhatāmisraṃ mahārauravarauravau || 3 || kumbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramasipatravanaṃ tathā || kṛmibhakṣoṃ'dhakūpaśca saṃdaṃśaṃ śālmalī tathā || 4 || sūrmirvaitaraṇī prāṇarodho viśasanaṃ tathā || lālābhakṣo'pyavīciśca sārameyādanaṃ tathā || 5 || tathaiva vajrakaṇakaṃ kṣārakardamapātanam || rakṣogaṇāśanaṃ cāpi śūlaprotaṃ vitodanam || 6 || daṃdaśūkāśanaṃ cāpi paryāvartanasaṃjñitam || tirodhānābhidhaṃ viprāstathā sūcīmukhābhidham || 7 || pūyaśoṇitabhakṣaṃ ca viṣāgniparipīḍanam || aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyākamevaṃ narakasaṃcayam || 8 || na yāti manujo viprā dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || vittāpatyakalatrāṇāṃ yo'nyeṣāmapahārakaḥ || 9 || sa kālapāśanirbaddho yamadūtairbhayānakaiḥ || tāmisranarake ghore pātyate bahuvatsaram || 3.1.30.10 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || yo nihatya tu bhartāraṃ bhuṃkte tasya dhanādikān || 11 || pātyate soṃ'dhatāmisre mahāduḥkhasamākule || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 12 || bhūtadroheṇa yo martyaḥ puṣṇāti svakuṭuṃbakam || sa tāniha vihāyāśu raurave pātyate dhruvam || 13 || viṣolbaṇamahāsarpasaṃkule yamapūruṣaiḥ || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || || 14 || yaḥ svadehaṃbharo martyo bhāryāputrādikaṃ vinā || sa mahāraurave ghore pātyate nijamāṃsabhuk || 15 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasmi nnāsau nipātyate || yaḥ paśūnpakṣiṇo vāpi saprāṇānniruṇaddhi vai || 16 || kṛpāleśavihīnaṃ taṃ kravyādairapi niṃditam || kuṃbhīpāke taptataile pāta yaṃti yamānugāḥ || 17 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ viprānyo dveṣṭi puruṣādhamaḥ || 18 || sa kālasūtra narake vistṛtāyutayojane || adhastādagnisaṃtapta uparyarkamarīcibhiḥ || 19 || khale tāmramaye viprāḥ pātyate kṣudhayārditaḥ || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 3.1.30.20 || yo vedamārgamullaṃghya vartate kupathe naraḥ || so'sipatravane ghore pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 21 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || yo rājā rājabhṛtyo vā hyadaṃḍye daṃḍamācaret || 22 || śarīradaṃḍaṃ vipre vā sa śūkaramukhe dvijāḥ || pātyate narake ghore ikṣuvadyaṃtrapīḍitaḥ || || 23 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || īśvarādhīnavṛttīnāṃ hiṃsāṃ yaḥ prāṇināṃ caret || 24 || taireva pīḍyamāno'yaṃ jaṃtubhiḥ svena pīḍitaiḥ || aṃdhakūpe mahābhīme pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 25 || tatrāṃdhakārabahule vinidro nirvṛtaścaret || ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 26 || yo'śnāti paṃktibhedena sasyasūpādikaṃ naraḥ || akṛtvā paṃcayajñaṃ vā bhuṃkte mohena sa dvijāḥ || 27 || prapātyate yamabhaṭairnarake kṛmibhojane || bhakṣyamāṇaḥ kṛmiśatairbhakṣayankṛmisaṃca yān || 28 || svayaṃ ca kṛmibhūtaḥ saṃstiṣṭhedyāvadaghakṣayam|| snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 29 || yo haredvipravittāni steyena balato'pi vā || anyeṣāmapi vittāni rājā tatpuruṣo'pi vā || 3.1.30.30 || ayasmayāgnikuṃḍeṣu saṃdaṃśaiḥ so'tipīḍitaḥ || saṃdaṃśe narake ghore pātyate yamapūruṣaiḥ || 31 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || agamyāṃ yobhigaccheta striyaṃ vai puruṣādhamaḥ || 32 || agamyaṃ puruṣaṃ yoṣidabhigaccheta vā dvijāḥ || tāvayasmayanārīṃ ca puruṣaṃ cāpyayasmayam ||33 || taptāvāliṃgya tiṣṭhaṃtau yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || sūrmyākhye narake ghore pātyete bahukaṃṭake || 34 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || bādhate sarvajaṃtūnyo nāno pāyairupadravaiḥ ||35 || śālmalīnarake ghore pātyate bahukaṃṭake || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 36 || rājā vā rājabhṛtyo vā yaḥ pāṣaṃḍamanuvrataḥ || bhedako dharmasetūnāṃ vaitaraṇyāṃ nipātyate || 37 || snāni ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || vṛṣalīsaṃgaduṣṭo yaḥ śaucādyācāravarjitaḥ || 38 || tyaktalajjastyaktavedaḥ paśucaryārata stathā || sa pūyaviṣṭhāmūtrāsṛkchleṣmapittādipūrite || 39 || atibībhatsanarake pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 3.1.30.40 || aśmabhirmṛgayurhanyādbāṇai rvā bādhate mṛgān|| sa vidhyamāno bāṇaughaiḥ paratra yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 41 || prāṇarodhākhyanarake pātyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 42 || dāṃbhiko yaḥ paśūnyajñe vidhyanuṣṭhānavarjitaḥ || haṃtyasau paralokeṣu vaiśase narake dvijāḥ || 43 || kṛntyamāno yamabhaṭaiḥ pātyate duḥkhasaṃkule || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || 44 || ātmabhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ yo retaḥ pāyayate tu saḥ || paratra retaḥpāyī sanretaḥkuṃḍe nipātyate || 45 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || yo dasyumārga māśritya garado grāmadāhakaḥ || 46 || vaṇigdravyāpahārī ca sa paratra dvijottamāḥ || vajradaṃṣṭrāhikābhikhye narake pātyate ciram || 47 || snāti ceddhanuṣaḥ koṭau tasminnāsau nipātyate || vidyaṃte yāni cānyāni narakāṇi paratra vai || 48 || tāni nāpnoti manujo dhanuṣkoṭinimajjanāt || dhanuṣkoṭau sakṛtsnā nādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 49 || ātmavidyā bhavetsākṣānmuktiścāpi caturvidhā || na pāpe ramate buddhirna bhavedduḥkhameva vā || 3.1.30.50 || buddheḥ prīti rbhavetsamyagdhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || tulāpuruṣadānena yatphalaṃ labhyate naraiḥ || 51 || tatphalaṃ labhyate puṃbhirdhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || gosahasra pradānena yatpuṇyaṃ hi bhavennṛṇām || 52 || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo dhanaṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yaṃyamicchati pūruṣaḥ || 53 || taṃtaṃ sadyaḥ samāpnoti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ || 54 || sadyaḥ pūto bhavedviprā dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || prajñālakṣmīryaśaḥ saṃpajjñānaṃ dharmo viraktatā ||55|| manaḥśuddhirbhavennṝṇāṃ dhanuṣkoṭinimajjanāt|| brahmahatyāyutaṃ cāpi surāpānāyutaṃ tathā||56|| ayutaṃ gurudārāṇāṃ gamanaṃ pāpakāraṇam|| steyāyutaṃ suvarṇānāṃ tatsaṃsargaśca koṭiśaḥ||57|| śīghraṃ vilayamāpnoti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt|| brahmahatyāsamānāni surāpānasamāni ca||58|| gurustrīgamanenāpi yāni tulyāni cāstikāḥ|| suvarṇasteyatulyāni tatsaṃsargasamāni ca||59|| tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti dhanuṣko ṭi nimajjanāt|| ukteṣveteṣu saṃdeho na kartavyaḥ kadācana ||3.1.30.60||| jihvāgre paraśuṃ taptaṃ dhārayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || arthavādamimaṃ sarvaṃ bruvanvai nārakī bhavet || || 61 || saṃkaraḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ|| aho maurkhyamaho maurkhyamaho maurkhyaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 62 || dhanuṣkoṭyabhidhe tīrthe sarvapātakanāśane || advaitajñānade puṃsāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyini || 63 || iṣṭakāmyaprade nityaṃ tathaivājñānanāśane || sthite'pi tadvihāyāyaṃ ramate'nyatra vai janaḥ ||64|| aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || snātasya dhanuṣaḥ koṭau nāṃtakādbhayamasti vai ||65|| dhanuṣkoṭiṃ prapaśyaṃti tatra snāṃti ca ye narāḥ|| stuvaṃti ca praśaṃsaṃti spṛśaṃti ca namaṃti ca || na pibaṃti hi te stanyaṃ mātṝṇāṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 66 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || dhanuṣkoṭyābhidhā tasya kathaṃ sūta samāgatā || 67 || tatsarvaṃ brūhi tattvena vistarānmunipuṃgava || iti pṛṣṭo naimiṣīyairāha sūtaḥ punaśca tān || 68 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || rāmeṇa nihate yuddhe rāvaṇe lokakaṇṭake || bibhīṣaṇe ca laṃkāyāṃ rājani sthāpite tataḥ || 69 || vaidehīlakṣmaṇayuto rāmo daśarathā tmajaḥ || sugrīvapramukhairvīrairvānarairapi saṃvṛtaḥ || 3.1.30.70 || siddhacāraṇagandharvadevavidyādhararṣibhiḥ || apsarobhiśca satataṃ stūyamānanijādbhutaḥ || 71 || līlāvidhṛtakodaṇḍastripuraghno yathā śivaḥ || sarvaiḥ parivṛto rāmo gaṃdhamādanamanvagāt || 72 || tatra sthitaṃ mahātmānaṃ rāghavaṃ rāvaṇāṃtakam || prāṃjaliḥ prārthayāmāsa dharmajño'tha vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 73 || setunānena te rāma rājānaḥ sarva eva hi || balodriktāḥ samabhyetya pīḍayeyuḥ purīṃ mama || || 74 || ataḥ setumimaṃ bhiṃdhi dhanuṣkoṭyā raghūdvaha || iti saṃprārthitastena paulastyena sa rāghavaḥ || 79 || bibheda dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā svasetuṃ raghunaṃ danaḥ || ato dvijāstatastīrthaṃ dhanuṣkoṭiritiśrutam || 76 || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭyā yo rekhāṃ paśyate kṛtām|| anekakleśasaṃyuktaṃ garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati || 77 || dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ kṛtā rekhā rāmeṇa lavaṇāṃbudhau || taddarśanādbhavenmuktirna jāne snānajaṃ phalam || 78 || narmadārodhasi tapo mahāpātaka nāśanam|| gaṃgātīre tu maraṇamapavargaphalapradam|| 79 || dānaṃ dvijāḥ kurukṣetre brahmahatyādiśodhakam || tapaśca maraṇaṃ dānaṃ dhanuṣkoṭau kṛtaṃ naraiḥ ||3.1.30.80|| mahāpātakanāśāya muktyai cābhīṣṭasiddhaye || bhavetsamarthaṃ vipreṃdrā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 81 || tāvatsaṃpīḍyate jaṃtuḥ pātakaiścopapā takaiḥ || yāvannālokyate rāma dhanuṣkoṭirvimuktidā || 82 || bhidyate hṛdayagraṃthiśchidyaṃte sarvasaṃśayāḥ || kṣīyaṃte pāpakarmāṇi dhanuṣkoṭyavalo kinaḥ || 83 || dakṣiṇāṃbhonidhau setau rāmacandreṇa nirmitā || yā rekhā dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā vibhīṣaṇahitāya vai || 84 || saiva kailāsapadavīṃ vaikuṇṭhabra hmalokayoḥ || mārgaḥ svargasya lokasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 85 || tulyaṃ yajñaphalaiḥ puṇyairdhanuṣkoṭyavagāhanam || sarvamaṃtrādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadā naphalapradam || 86 || kāyakaleśakaraiḥ puṃsāṃ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || kiṃ vedaiḥ kimu vā śāstrairdhanuṣkoṭyavalokinaḥ || 87 || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭau snānaṃ cellabhyate nṛṇām || sitāsitasaritpuṇyavāribhiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || 88 || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭidarśanaṃ labhyate yadi || kāśyāṃ tu maraṇānmuktiḥ prārthyate kiṃ vṛthā naraiḥ || 89 || animajjya dhanuṣkoṭāvanupoṣya dinatrayam || adattvā kāṃcanaṃ gāṃ ca daridraḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 3.1.30.90 || dhanuṣkoṭya vagāhena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairiṣṭvāpi bahudakṣiṇaiḥ || 91 || na tatphalamavāpnoti satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmyaham || dhanuṣkoṭyabhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthādhikaṃ viduḥ || 92 || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi saṃti tīrthāni bhūtale || teṣāṃ sānnidhyamastyatra dhanuṣkoṭau dvijottamāḥ || 93 || aṣṭau vasava ādityā rudrāśca marutastathā || sādhyāśca saha gandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā ||94|| ete cānye ca ye devāḥ sānnidhyaṃ kurvate sadā || tīrthe'tra dhanuṣaḥ koṭau nityameva pitāmahaḥ || 95 || sannidhatte śivo viṣṇurumā mā ca sarasvatī || dhanuṣkoṭau tapastaptvā devāśca ṛṣayastathā || 96 || vipulāṃ siddhimagamaṃstatphalena munīśvarāḥ || snāyāttatra naro yastu pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet ||97|| sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate || atraikaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ yo naro bhaktisaṃyutaḥ||98|| iha loke paratrāpi sonaṃtasukhamaśnute|| śākamūlaphale vṛttiṃ yo na vartayate naraḥ||99|| sa naro dhanuṣaḥkoṭau snāyātta tphalasiddhaye || aśvamedhakratuṃ kartuṃ śaktiryasya na vidyate ||3.1.30.100|| dhanuṣkoṭau sa hi snāyāttena tatphalamaśnute || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāpi munī śvarāḥ||101|| niṃdyayonau na jāyaṃte dhanuṣkoṭvagāhanāt|| makarasthe ravau māghe dhanuṣkoṭau tu yo naraḥ||102|| snāyātpuṇyaṃ nigadituṃ tasyāhaṃ na kṣamo dvijāḥ|| māghamāse dhanuṣkoṭāvavagāheta yo naraḥ || 103 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu munīśvarāḥ || prāpnuyādakṣayām̐llokānmokṣaṃ cāpi labheta saḥ || 104 || janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ striyo vā puruṣasya vā || tatsarvaṃ māghamāse'tra majjanādvilayaṃ vrajet || 105 || yathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣāmuttamo raghunaṃdanaḥ || tathaiva ca dhanuṣkoṭiḥ sarvatīrthottamā smṛtā || 106 || tatra snānaṃ māghamāse sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || triṃśaddinaṃ māghamāse niyato'pi jiteṃdriyaḥ || 107 || dhanuṣkoṭau naraḥ snāyādapunarbhavasiddhaye || ekabhukto jitakrodho māghamāse'tra yo naraḥ || 108 || snānaṃ karoti vipreṃdrā mucyate brahmahatyayā || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭī māghamāse narastu yaḥ || 109 || snātvāṃte śivarātrau ca nirāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau pratiyāmaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| 3.1.30.110 || rāma nāthaṃ mahādevamabhyarcya vidhipūrvakam || paredyurudite sūrye dhanuṣkoṭau nimajya ca || 111 || anyeṣvapi ca tīrtheṣu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ || nirvartya nityakarmāṇi rāmanāthaṃ niṣevya ca || 112 || yathāśakti dvijānannairbhojayitvā dvijottamāḥ || bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca tilāndhānyaṃ dattvā vittaṃ ca śaktitaḥ || || 113 || brāhmaṇairapyanujñātaḥ svayaṃ bhuṃjati vāgyataḥ || evaṃ kṛtavataḥ puṃso rāmanātho maheśvaraḥ || 114 || vimocya sarvapāpāni bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayacchati || ataḥ sarvaprayatnena māghamāse munīśvarāḥ || 115 || snātavyaṃ hi dhanuṣkoṭau narairatra mumukṣubhiḥ || dhanuṣkoṭau naraḥ snānaṃ setāvardhodaye tu yaḥ| || 116 || karoti tasya pāpāni naśyaṃtyeva kṣaṇāddvijāḥ || snānaṃ mahodaye cātra bhuktimuktiphalapradam|| 117 || yaḥ snāyāddhanuṣaḥ koṭāvarddhodayamaho daye || tasya vaśyāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 118 || dhanuṣkoṭau dvijāḥ snānamarddhodayamahodaye|| vināpyadvaitavijñānaṃ sāyujyaprāptikāraṇam||| || 119 || tatra snānaṃ dvijāḥ puṃsāmarddhodayamahodaye || manvādyuktaṃ vinā satyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ hi pāpinām|| 3.1.30.120 || atra setau dhanuṣkoṭāvardhodayamaho daye || snāti cenmanujo viprāḥ satyaṃ yajñaṃ vināpyayam ||1 21 || yajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti saṃpūrṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu yaḥ snāyādatra mānavaḥ || 122 || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ śeṣeṇāpi na śakyate || caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu dhanuṣkoṭyavagāhanam || 123 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ prāyaścitta mudīritam || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭau caṃdrasūryoparāgayoḥ || 124 || snānaṃ sāyujyadaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu ardhodayamahodaye || 125 || snātavyamatra manujairbhuktimuktiphalecchubhiḥ || ataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya gacchadhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 126 || dhanuṣkoṭiṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ bhuktimuktiphala pradām || tatra gatvā pitṛbhyaśca kurudhvaṃ piṃḍadāpanam || 127 || ākalpaṃ pitṛtṛptiḥ syādatra piṃḍanivāpanāt || pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ sthānatrayaṃ rāmeṇa nirmi tam || 128 || setumūle dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || piṃḍaṃ dattvā pitṛbhyo'tra ṛṇānmukto bhaviṣyati || 129 || setumūlaṃ dhanuṣkoṭiṃ gaṃdhamādanameva ca || ṛṇamokṣa iti khyātaṃ tristhānaṃ devanirmitam || 3.1.30.130 || ataḥ sarvaprayatnena dhanuṣkoṭirniṣevyatām || atrāgatya dhanuṣkoṭau snātvā niyamapūrva kam || 131 || droṇācāryasutaḥ śrīmānaśvatthāmā munīśvarāḥ || suptamāraṇadoṣeṇa ghoreṇa mumuce kṣaṇāt || 132 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā dhanuṣkoṭestu vaibhavam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam || 133 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setu māhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ dhanuṣkoṭivaibhavakathanavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || || cha ||
<3.1.31>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || aśvatthāmā kathaṃ sūta suptamāraṇamācarat|| kathaṃ ca muktastatpāpāddhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || 1 || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ brūhi paurāṇikottama || tṛptirna jāyate' smākaṃ tvadvacomṛtapāyinām || 2 || iti pṛṣṭastadā sūto naimiṣāraṇyavāsibhiḥ || vaktuṃ pracakrame tatra vyāsaṃ natvā guruṃ mudā || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || rājyārthaṃ kalahe jāte pāṃḍavānāṃ purā dvijāḥ || dhārtarāṣṭrairmahāyuddhe mahadakṣauhiṇīyute || 4 || yuddhaṃ daśadinaṃ kṛtvā bhīṣme śāṃtanave hate || droṇe paṃcadinaṃ kṛtvā karṇe ca dvidinaṃ tathā || 5 || tathaivaikadinaṃ yuddhvā śalye ca nidhanaṃ gate || aṣṭādaśadine tatra raṇe duryodhane dvijāḥ || || 6 || bhagnorau bhīmagadayā patite rājasattame || sarve nṛpatayo viprā niveśāya kṛtatvarāḥ || 7 || ye jīvitāstu rājānaste yayurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṃḍayādyāḥ sṛñjayāḥ sarva eva hi || 8 || anye cāpi mahīpālā jagmuḥ svaśibirāṇyatha || atha pārthā mahāvīrā kṛṣṇasātyakisaṃyutāḥ || 9 || duryodhanasya śibiraṃ prāviśannirjanaṃ dvijāḥ || vṛddhairamātyaistatrasthaiḥ ṣaṃḍhaiḥ strīrakṣakaistathā || 3.1.31.10 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaiḥ prahvaiḥ kāṣāyamalināṃbaraiḥ || praṇamyamānāste pārthāḥ kururājasya veśmani || 11 || tatratyadravyajātāni samādāya mahā balāḥ || suyodhanasya śibire nyavasaṃta sukhena te || 12 || atha tānabravītpārthāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ prīṇayanniva || maṃgalārthāya cāsmābhirvastavyaṃ śibirādbahiḥ || 13 || ityuktā vāsudevena tathetyuktvātha pāṃḍavāḥ || kṛṣṇasātyakisaṃyuktāḥ prayayuḥ śibirādbahiḥ || 14 || vāsudevena sahitā maṃgalārthaṃ hi pāṃḍavāḥ || oghavatyāḥ samāsādya tīraṃ nadyā narottamāḥ || 15 || ūṣustāṃ rajanīṃ tatra hataśatrugaṇāḥ sukham || kṛtavarmā kṛpo drauṇistathā duryodhanāṃtikam|| 16 || ādityāstamayātpūrvamaparāhṇe samāyayuḥ || suyodhanaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā raṇapāṃsuṣu rūṣitam || 17 || bhagnorudaṇḍaṃ gadayā bhīmasena sya bhīmayā || rudhirāsiktasarvāṃgaṃ ceṣṭamānaṃ mahītale || 18 || aśocaṃta tadā tatra droṇaputrādayastrayaḥ || śuśoca so'pi tāndṛṣṭvā raṇe duryodhano nṛpaḥ || 19 || dṛṣṭvā tathā tu rājānaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanam || aśvatthāmā tadā kopājjvalanniva mahānalaḥ || 3.1.31.20 || pāṇau pāṇiṃ viniṣpiṣya krodha visphāritekṣaṇaḥ || aśruviklavayā vācā duryodhanamabhāṣata || 21 || pitā me pātitaḥ kṣudraiśchalenaiva raṇājire || na tathā tena śocāmi yathā niṣpātite tvayi || 22 || śṛṇu vākyaṃ mamādya tvaṃ yathārthaṃ vadato nṛpa || sukṛtena śape cāhaṃ suyodhana mahāmate || 23 || adya rātrau haniṣyāmi pāṃḍavā nsaha sṛṃjayaiḥ || paśyato vāsudevasya tvamanujñāṃ prayaccha me || 24 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā drauṇiṃ rājā tadā'bravīt || tathāstviti punaḥ prāha kṛpaṃ rājā dvijottamāḥ || 25 || ācāryainaṃ droṇaputraṃ kalaśotthena vāriṇā || saināpatye'bhiṣiṃcasvetyatha sopi tathā'karot || 26 || sobhiṣiktastadā drauṇiḥ pariṣvajya nṛpottamam || kṛtavarmakṛpābhyāṃ ca sahitastvaritaṃ yayau || 27 || tataste tu trayo vīrāḥ prayātā dakṣiṇonmukhāḥ || ādityāstamayātpūrvaṃ śibirāṃtikamāsata || 28 || pārthānāṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā tatra jayaiṣiṇaḥ || pāṃḍavānudrutā bhītāstadā drauṇyādayastrayaḥ || 29 || prāṅmukhā dudruvurbhītyā kiyaddūraṃ śramāturāḥ || muhurtaṃ te tato gatvā krodhāmarṣavaśānugāḥ || 3.1.31.30 || duryodhanavadhārtāste kṣaṇaṃ tatrāvatasthire || tato'paśyannaraṇyaṃ vai nānātarulatāvṛtam || 31 || anekamṛgasaṃbādhaṃ krūrapakṣigaṇākulam || samṛddhajalasaṃpūrṇataṭākapariśobhitam || 32 || padmeṃdīvarakahlārasarasī śatasaṃkulam || tatra pītvā jalaṃ te tu pāyayitvā hayāṃstathā || 33 || anekaśākhāsaṃbādhanyagrodhaṃ dadṛśustataḥ || saṃprāpya tu mahāvṛkṣaṃ nyagrodhaṃ te trayastadā || 34 || avatīrya rathebhyaśca mocayitvā turaṃgamān || upaspṛśya jalaṃ tatra sāyaṃsaṃdhyāmupāsata || 35 || atha cāstagiriṃ bhānuḥ prapede ca gataprabhaḥ || tataśca rajanī ghorā samabhūttimirākulā || 36 || rātricarāṇi sattvāni saṃcaraṃti tatastataḥ || divācarāṇi sattvāni nidrāvaśamupā yayuḥ || 37 || kṛtavarmā kṛpo drauṇiḥ pradoṣasamaye hi te || nyagrodhasyopaviviśuraṃtike śokakarśitāḥ || 38 || kṛpabhojau tadā nidrāṃ bhejāte'tipa yākramau || sukhocitāstvaduḥkhārhā niṣedurdharaṇītale || 39 || droṇaputrastu kopena kaluṣīkṛtamānasaḥ || yayau na nidrāṃ vipreṃdrā niśvasannurago yathā || 3.1.31.40 || tato'valokayāṃcakre tadaraṇyaṃ bhayānakam || nyagrodhaṃ ca tato'paśyadbahuvāyasasaṃkulam || 41 || tatra vāyasavṛndāni niśāyāṃ vāsamāya yuḥ || sukhaṃ bhinnāsu śākhāsu suṣupuste pṛthakpṛthak || 42 || kākeṣu teṣu supteṣu viśvasteṣu samaṃtataḥ || tato'paśyatsamāyāṃtaṃ bhāsaṃ drauṇirbhayaṃkaram || || 43 || kūraśabdaṃ krūrakāyaṃ babhrupiṃgakalevaram || sa bhāso'tha bhṛśaṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvālīyata śākhini || 44 || utplutya tasya śākhāyāṃ nyagrodhasya vihaṃgamaḥ || suptānkākānnijaghne'sāvanekānvāyasāṃtakaḥ || 45 || kākānāmabhinatpakṣānsa keṣāṃcidvihaṃgamaḥ || itareṣāṃ ca caraṇāñchirāṃsi caraṇā yudhaḥ || 46 || vicakarta kṣaṇenāsāvulūko valavāndvijāḥ || sa bhinnadehāvayavaiḥ kākānāṃ bahubhistadā || 47 || samaṃtādāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nyagrodhapari maṇḍalam || vāyasāṃstānnihatyāsāvulūko mumude tadā || 48 || drauṇirdṛṣṭvā tu tatkarma bhāsenaivaṃ kṛtaṃ niśi || kariṣyāmyahamapyevaṃ śatrūṇāṃ nidhanaṃ niśi || 49 || ityaciṃtayadekaḥ sannupadeśamimaṃ smaran || jetuṃ na śakyāḥ pārthā hi ṛjumārgeṇa yuddhyatā || 3.1.31.50 || mayā tacchadmanā te'tha haṃtavyā jitakāśinaḥ || suyodhanasakāśe ca pratijñāto mayā vadhaḥ || 51 || ṛjumārgeṇa yuddhe me prāṇanāśo bhaviṣyati || chalena yudhyamānasya jayaścāsya ripukṣayaḥ || 52 || yacca niṃdyaṃ bhavetkāryaṃ loke sarvajanairapi || kāryameva hi tatkarma kṣatradharmānuvartinā || 53 || pārthairapi chalenaiva kṛtaṃ karma suyodhane || asminnarthe purāvidbhiḥ proktāḥ ślokā bhavaṃti hi || 54 || pariśrāṃte vidīrṇe ca bhuṃjāne ca riporbale || prasthāne ca praveśe ca prahartavyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 55 || nidrārtamardharātre ca tathā tyaktāyudhaṃ raṇe || bhinnayodhaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ prahartavyamarātibhiḥ || 56 || evaṃ sa niyamaṃ kṛtvā suptamāraṇakarmaṇi || prābodhayadbhojakṛpau suptau rātrau sa sāhasī || drauṇirdhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tu tāvubhāvabhyabhāṣata || 57 || || || aśvatthāmovāca || || mṛtaḥ suyodhano rājā mahābalaparākramaḥ || 58 || śuddhakarmā hataḥ pārthairbahubhiḥ kṣudrakarmabhiḥ || bhīmenātinṛśaṃsena śiro rājñaḥ padā hatam || 59 || tato'dya rātrau pārthānāṃ sametya paṭamaṇḍapam || sukhasuptānhaniṣyāmaḥ śastrairnānāvidhairvayam || kṛpaḥ provāca tatraina miti śrutvā dvijottamāḥ || 3.1.31.60 || || kṛpa uvāca || || suptānāṃ māraṇaṃ loke na dharmo na ca pūjyate || 61 || tathaiva tyaktaśastrāṇāṃ saṃtyaktarathavāji nām || śṛṇu me vacanaṃ vatsa mucyatāṃ sāhasaṃ tvayā || 62 || vayaṃ tu dhṛtarāṣṭaṃ ca gāṃdhārīṃ ca pativratām || pṛcchāmo viduraṃ cāpi taduktaṃ karavā mahe || ityuktaḥ sa tadā drauṇiḥ kṛpaṃ provāca vai punaḥ || 63 || ||aśvatthāmovāca || || pāṃḍavaiśca purā yanme chalādyuddhe pitā hataḥ || 64 || tanme sarvāṇi marmāṇi nikṛntati hi mātula || droṇahaṃtāhamityetaddhṛṣṭadyumasya yadvacaḥ || 65 || kathaṃ janasamakṣe tadvacanaṃ saṃśṛṇomyaham || taireva pāṃḍavaiḥ pūrvaṃ dharmaseturnirākṛtaḥ || 66 || samakṣameva yuṣmākaṃ sarveṣāmeva bhūbhṛtām || tyaktāyudho mama pitā dhṛṣṭadyumnena pātitaḥ || 67 || tathā śāṃtanavo bhīṣmastyaktacāpo nirāyudhaḥ || śikhaṃḍinaṃ purodhāya nihataḥ savyasācinā || 68 || evamanye'pi bhūpālāśchalenaiva hatāstu taiḥ || tathaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi suptānāṃ māraṇaṃ niśi || 69 || evamuktvā tadā drauṇiḥ saṃyuktaturagaṃ ratham|| prāyādabhimukhaḥ śatrūnsamāruhya krudhā jvalan || 3.1.31.70|| taṃ yāṃtama nvagātāṃ tau kṛtavarmakṛpāvubhau || yayuśca śibire teṣāṃ saṃprasuptajanaṃ tadā || 71 || śibiradvāramāsādya droṇaputro vyatiṣṭhata || rātrau tatra samārādhya mahādevaṃ ghṛṇānidhim || 72 || avāpa vimalaṃ khaṅgaṃ mahādevādvarapradāt || tato drauṇiravasthāpya kṛtavarmakṛpāvubhau || 73 || dvāradeśe mahāvīraḥ śibi rāṃtaḥ praviṣṭavān || praviṣṭe śibire drauṇau kṛtavarmakṛpāvubhau|| 74 || dvāradeśe vyatiṣṭhetāṃ yattau paramadhanvinau || atha drauṇiḥ susaṃkruddhastejasā prajvalanniva || 75 || khaṅgaṃ vimalamādāya vyacaracchibire niśi || tatastu dhṛṣṭadyumnasya śibiraṃ maṃdamāyayau || 76 || dhṛṣṭadyumnādayastatra mahāyuddhena karśitāḥ || suṣupurniśi viśvastāḥ svasvasainyasamāvṛtāḥ || 77 || dhṛṣṭadyumnasya śibiraṃ praviśya drauṇirastravit || taṃ suptaṃ śayane śubhre dadarśārānmahābalam || 78 || pādenāghātayadroṣātsvapaṃtaṃ droṇanaṃdanaḥ || sa buddhaścaraṇāghātādutthāya śayanādatha || 79 || vyalokayattadā vīro droṇaputraṃ puraḥ sthitam || tamutpataṃtaṃ śayanāddroṇācāryasuto balī || 3.1.31.80 || keśeṣvākṛṣya bāhubhyāṃ niṣpipeṣa dharātale || dhṛṣṭadyumnastadā tena niṣpiṣṭaḥ sa bhayā turaḥ || 81 || nidrāṃdhaḥ pādaghātāto na śaśāka viceṣṭitum || drauṇistvākramya tasyoraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ baddhvā dhanurguṇaiḥ || 82 || nadaṃtaṃ visphuraṃtaṃ taṃ paśumāramamārayat || tasya sainyāni sarvāṇi nyavadhīcca tathaiva saḥ || 83 || yudhāmanyuṃ mahāvīryamamuttamaujasameva ca || tathaiva draupadīputrānavaśiṣṭāṃśca somakān || 84 || śikhaṃḍipramukhānanyānkhaṅgenāmārayadbahūn || tadbhayāddvāraniryātānsarvāneva ca sainikān || 85 || prāpayāmāsaturmṛtyuṃ kṛtavarmakṛpā vubhau || evaṃ nihatasainyaṃ tacchibiraṃ tairmahābalaiḥ || 86 || tatkṣaṇe śūnyamabhavattrijagatpralaye yathā || evaṃ hatvā tataḥ sarvāndroṇaputrādayastrayaḥ ||87|| niraguḥ śibirāttasmātpārthabhītā bhayāturāḥ || sarve pṛthakpṛthagdeśāndudruvuḥ śīghragāminaḥ || 88 || atha drauṇiryayau viprā revātīraṃ manoramam || tatra hyanekasāhasrā ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ || 89 || kathayaṃtaḥ kathāḥ puṇyāstapaścakruranuttamam || tatrāyaṃ prayayau drauṇirṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣvatha || 3.1.31.90 || praviṣṭamātre tasmiṃstu munayo brahmavādinaḥ || drauṇerduścaritaṃ jñātvā prāhuryogabalena tam || 91 || suptamā raṇakṛtpāpī drauṇe tvaṃ brāhmaṇādhamaḥ || tvaddarśanena hyasmākaṃ pātityaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 92 || tvatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyāyutaṃ bha vet || ato'smadāśramebhyastvaṃ nirgaccha puruṣādhama || 93 || ityabruvaṃstadā drauṇiṃ tatratyā munayo dvijāḥ || itīritastato drauṇirmunibhirbrahma vādibhiḥ || 94 || lajjito nilāttasmādāśramānmunisevitāt || evaṃ kāśyāditīrtheṣu puṇyeṣu prayayau ca saḥ || 95 || tatratatra dvijaiḥ sarvai rniṃdito'sau mahātmabhiḥ || vyāsaṃ śaraṇamāpede prāyaścittacikīrṣayā || 96 || tato badarikāraṇye samāsīnaṃ mahāmunim || dvaipāyanaṃ samāgamya praṇanāma sabhaktikam || 97 || tato vyāso'bravīdenaṃ droṇācāryasutaṃ muniḥ || tvamasmadāśramādadrauṇe niryāhi tvarayā tviti || 98 || suptamāraṇa doṣeṇa mahāpātakavānbhavān || ato me bhavatālāpānmahatpāpaṃ bhaviṣyati || ityuktaḥ sa tadā drauṇiḥ provācedaṃ vaco muniḥ || 99 || || aśvatthāmovāca || || bhagavanniṃditaḥ sarvaistvāmasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 3.1.31.100 || bravīṣi cettvamapyevaṃ ko'nyo me śaraṇaṃ bhavet || kṛpāṃ kuru mayi brahmansādhavo dīnavatsalāḥ || 101 || suptamāraṇadoṣasya śāṃtyarthaṃ bhagavanmama || prāyaścittaṃ vidhehi tvaṃ sarvajño'si bhavānyataḥ || ityukto drauṇinā vyāsaściraṃ dhyātvā tamabravīt || 102 || || vyāsa uvāca || || etatpāpasya śāṃtyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ smṛtau na hi || 103 || tathāpyupāyaṃ vakṣyāmi tavaitaddoṣa śāṃtaye || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau puṇye rāmasetau vimuktide || 104 || dhanuṣkoṭiritikhyātaṃ tīrthamasti mahattaram || asti puṇyatamaṃ drauṇe mahāpāta kanāśanam || 105 || svargamokṣapradaṃ puṃsāṃ brahmahatyādiśodhakam || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || 106 || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ ca tathottamam || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ narakakleśanāśanam || 107 || akālamṛtyuśamanaṃ puṃsāṃ vijayavarddhanam || dāridryanāśanaṃ puṃsāmāyurvardhanakāra ṇam || 108 || cittaśuddhipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ śāṃtidāṃtyādikāraṇam || tatra gatvā dhanuṣkoṭau rāmasetau vimuktide || 109 || snānaṃ kuruṣva drauṇe tvaṃ māsamātraṃ niraṃ taram || suptamāraṇadoṣāttvaṃ sadyaḥ pūto bhaviṣyasi || 3.1.31.110 || kuruṣva vacanaṃ śīghraṃ mama tvaṃ droṇanaṃdana || evamuktastadā drauṇirvyāsena paramarṣiṇā || 111 || rāmasetuṃ samāsādya dhanuṣkoṭiṃ pavitradām || sasnau saṃkalpapūrvaṃ tu māsamekaṃ nirantaram || 112 || trisaṃdhyaṃ rāmanāthaṃ ca siṣeve sa dine dine || tatastriṃśaddine toyasnānāddroṇātmajastadā || 113 || jajāpa ca dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ maṃtraṃ paṃcākṣaraṃ tadā || akārṣīdupavāsaṃ ca droṇaputrastu taddine || 114 || akarojjāgaraṃ rātrau rāmanāthasya sannidhau || aparedyurdhanuṣkoṭau snātvā saṃkalpapūrvakam || 115 || siṣeve rāmanāthaṃ ca stutvā bhaktipuraḥsaram || nanarta purataḥ śaṃbhorānaṃdāśrupariplutaḥ || 116 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavānprādurāsīttadagrataḥ || dṛṣṭvā tatra mahādevaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram || || 117 || || drauṇiruvāca || || namaste devadeveśa karuṇākara śaṃkara || āpadaṃbudhimagnānāṃ potāyitapadāṃbuja || 118 || mahādeva kṛpāmūrte dhūrjaṭe nīlalohita || umākāṃta virūpākṣa caṃdraśekhara te namaḥ || 119 || mṛtyuṃjaya trinetra tvaṃ pāhi māṃ kṛpayā dṛśā || pārvatīpataye tubhyaṃ tripuraghnāya śaṃbhave ||3.1.31.120||| pinākapāṇaye tubhyaṃ tryaṃbakāya namonamaḥ || anaṃtādimahānāgahārabhūṣaṇabhūṣita || 121 || śūlapāṇe namastubhyaṃ gaṃgādhara mṛḍāvyaya || rakṣa māṃ kṛpayā deva pāpasaṃghātapaṃjarāt || iti stuto mahādevo drauṇiṃ provāca harṣitaḥ || 122 || || mahādeva uvāca || || suptamāraṇadoṣaste dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || 123 || aśvatthāmanvinaṣṭo'bhūdvaraṃ varaya suvrata || mayi prasanne lokeṣu kimalabhyaṃ bhavennṛṇām || 124 || ato'bhīṣṭaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ matto droṇātmajādhunā || ityuktaḥ śaṃbhunā drauṇiḥ prāha taṃ parameśvaram || 125 || tavādya darśanenāhaṃ kṛtārthosmi maheśvaram || tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāmalabhyaṃ janmakoṭibhiḥ || 126 || ato yuṣmatpadāṃbhoje niścalā bhaktirastu me || imameva varaṃ dehi mahyaṃ śaṃbho namo'stu te ||127|| uktvā tathāstviti drauṇiṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || paśyato droṇaputrasya tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||128|| aśvatthāmāpi vipreṃdrā dhūtapāpo vinirmalaḥ || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭau snānamātreṇa tatkṣaṇe ||129|| dhūtapāpamimaṃ drauṇiṃ sarve cāpi maharṣayaḥ || śuddhaṃ pratyagrahīṣuste tadāprabhṛti nirmalam ||3.1.31.130||| evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā drauṇipāpavimokṣaṇam || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭisnānavaibhavamātrataḥ ||131|| yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || sa vidhūyeha pāpāni śivaloke mahīyate || 132 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharūyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāmaśvatthāmasuptamāraṇado ṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
<3.1.32>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || bhūyo'pisaṃpravakṣyāmi dhanuṣkoṭestu vaibhavam || yuṣmākamādareṇāhaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavā sinaḥ ||1|| naṃdonāma mahārājaḥ somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa sāgarāṃtāṃ dharāmimām ||2|| tasya putraḥ samabhavaddharmagupta iti śrutaḥ || rājya rakṣādhuraṃ naṃdo nijaputre nidhāya saḥ ||3|| jiteṃdriyo jitāhāraḥ praviveśa tapovanam || tāte tapovanaṃ yāte dharmaguptābhidho nṛpaḥ ||4|| medinīṃ pālayā māsa dharmajño nītitatparaḥ || īje bahuvidhairyajñairdevāniṃdrapurogamān || 5 || brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittaṃ kṣetrāṇi ca bahūni saḥ || sarve svadharmaniratāstasminrājani śāsati || 6 || babhūvurnābhavanpīḍāstasmiṃścorādisaṃbhavāḥ || kadāciddharmagupto'yamārūḍhasturagottamam || 7 || vanaṃ viveśa vipreṃdrā mṛgayārasakau tukī || tamālatālahiṃtālakuravākuladiṅmukhe || 8 || vicacāra vane tasminsiṃhavyāghrabhayānake || mattālikulasaṃnādasaṃmūrchitadigaṃtare || 9 || padma kalhārakumudanīlotpalavanākulaiḥ || taṭākairapi saṃpūrṇe tapasvijanamaṃḍite ||3.1.32.10|| tasminvane saṃcarato dharmaguptasya bhūpateḥ || abhūdvibhāvarī viprāsta masāvṛtadiṅmukhā || 11 || rājāpi paścimāṃ saṃdhyāmupāsya niyamānvitaḥ || jajāpa tatra ca vane gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram || 12 || siṃhavyāghrādibhītyā sminvṛkṣamekaṃ samāsthite || rājaputre tadābhyāgādṛkṣaḥ siṃhabhayārditaḥ || 13 || anvadhāvataṃ taṃ ṛkṣamaikaḥ siṃho vanecaraḥ || anudrutaḥ sa siṃhena ṛkṣo vṛkṣamupāruhat || 14 || āruhya ṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ taṃ dadarśa jagatīpatim || vṛkṣasthitaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahābalaparākramam || 15 || uvāca bhūpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛkṣoyaṃ vanagocaraḥ || mā bhītiṃ kuru rājeṃdra vatsyāvo rajanīmiha || 16 || mahāsattvo mahākāyo mahādaṃṣṭrāsamākulaḥ || vṛkṣamūlaṃ samāyātaḥ siṃho yamatibhīṣaṇaḥ || 17 || rātryardhaṃ bhaja nidrā tvaṃ rakṣyamāṇo mayāditaḥ || tataḥ prasuptaṃ māṃ rakṣa śarvaryardhaṃ mahāmate || 18 || iti tadvākyamādāya supte naṃdasute hariḥ || provāca ṛkṣaṃ supto'yaṃ nṛpaśca tyajyatāmiti || 19 || taṃ siṃhamabravīdṛkṣo dharmajño dvijasattamāḥ|| bhavāndharmaṃ na jānīṣe mṛgarāja vanecara || 3.1.32.20 || viśvāsaghātināṃ loke mahākaṣṭā bhavaṃti hi || na hi mitradruhāṃ pāpaṃ naśyeyajñāyutairapi || 21 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kathaṃcinniṣkṛtirbhavet || viśvastaghātināṃ pāpaṃ na naśyejjanmakoṭibhiḥ || 22 || nāhaṃ meruṃ mahābhāraṃ manye paṃcāsya bhūtale || mahābhāramimaṃ manye loke viśvāsa ghātakam || 23 || evamukte'tha ṛkṣeṇa siṃhastūṣṇīmabhūttadā || dharmagupte prabuddhe tu ṛkṣaḥ suṣvāpa bhūruhe ||24|| tataḥ siṃho'bravīdbhūpamenamṛkṣaṃ tyajasva me || evamukte'tha siṃhena rājā suptamaśaṃkitaḥ ||25|| svāṃkanyastaśiraskaṃ tamṛkṣaṃ tatyāja bhūtale || pātyamānastato rājñā nakhālaṃbitapādapaḥ ||26|| ṛkṣaḥ puṇyavaśādvṛkṣānna papāta mahītale || sa ṛkṣo nṛpamabhyetya kopādvākyamabhāṣata||27|| kāmarūpadharo rājannahaṃ bhṛgukulodbhavaḥ || dhyānakāṣṭhābhidho nāmnā ṛkṣarūpamadhārayam || 28 || yasmādanāgasaṃ suptamatyākṣīnmāṃ bhavānnṛpa || macchāpāttvamataḥ śīghramunmattaścara bhūpate || 29 || iti śaptvā munirbhūpaṃ tataḥ siṃhamabhāṣata || nṛsiṃhastvaṃ mahāyakṣaḥ kuberasacivaḥ purā ||3.1.32.3||| himavadgirimāsādya kadācittvaṃ vadhūsakhaḥ || ajñānādgautamābhyāśe vihāramatanormudā || || 31 || gautamopyuṭajāddaivātsamidāharaṇāya vai || nirgatastvāṃ vivasanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāpamudāharat || 32 || yasmānmamāśrame'dya tvaṃ vivastraḥ sthitavānasi || ataḥ siṃhatvamadyaiva bhavitā te na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || iti gautamaśāpena sihatvamagamatpurā || kuberasacivo yakṣo bhadranāmā bhavānpurā || || 34 || kubero dharmaśīlo hi tadbhṛtyāśca tathaiva hi || ataḥ kimarthaṃ tvaṃ haṃsi māmṛṣiṃ vanagocaram || 35 || etatsarvamahaṃ dhyānā jjānāmīha mṛgādhipa || ityukte dhyānakāṣṭhena tyaktvā siṃhatvamāśu saḥ || 36 || yakṣarūpaṃ gato divyaṃ kuberasacivātmakam || dhyānakāṣṭhamasāvāha prāṃjaliḥ praṇato munim || 37 || adya jñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ pūrvavṛttaṃ mahāmune || gautamaḥ śāpakāle me śāpāṃtamapi coktavān || 38 || dhyānakāṣṭhe na saṃvāda ṛkṣarūpeṇa te yadā || tadā nirdhūya siṃhatvaṃ yakṣarūpamavāpsyasi || 39 || iti māmabravīdbrahmangautamo munipuṃgavaḥ || adya siṃhatvanāśānme jānāmi tvāṃ mahāmune || 3.1.32.40 || dhyānakāṣṭhābhidhaṃ śuddhaṃ kāmarūpadharaṃ sadā || ityuktvā taṃ praṇamyātha dhyānakāṣṭhaṃ sa yakṣarāṭ || 41 || vimānavaramā ruhya prayayāvalakāpurīm || tasmingate tu yakṣeśe dhyānakāṣṭho mahāmuniḥ || 42 || avyāhateṣṭagamano yatheṣṭhaḥ prayayau mahīm || dhyānakāṣṭhe gate tasmi nkāmarūpadhare munau || 43 || dharmaguptau muneḥ śāpādunmattaḥ prayayau purīm || unmattarūpaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā maṃtriṇastu nṛpottamam || 44 || pituḥ sakāśamā ninyū revātīre manorame || tasmai nivedayāmāsurmatibhraṃśaṃ sutasya te || 45 || jñātvā tu putravṛttāṃtaṃ nandastasya pitā tadā || putramādāya tarasā jaiminerantikaṃ yayau || tasmai nivedayāmāsa putravṛttāntamāditaḥ || 46 || bhagavañjaimine putro mamādyonmattatāṃ gataḥ || 47 || asyonmādavināśāya brūhyupāyaṃ mahāmune || iti pṛṣṭaściraṃ dadhyau jaiminirmunipuṃgavaḥ || 48 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ nṛpaṃ naṃdamathābravīt || dhyānakāṣṭhasya śāpena hyunma ttaste suto'bhavat || 49 || tasya śāpasya mokṣārthamupāyaṃ prabravīmi te || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau setau puṇye pāpavināśane || 3.1.32.50 || dhanuṣkoṭiriti khyātaṃ tīrthamasti mahattaram || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam || 51 || śrutisiddhaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmahatyādiśodhakam || nītvā tatra sutaṃ te'dya snāpayasva mahīpate || 52 || unmādastatkṣaṇādeva tasya naśyenna saṃśayaḥ || ityuktastaṃ praṇamyāsau jaiminiṃ munipuṃgavam || 53 || naṃdaḥ putraṃ samādāya dhanuṣkoṭiṃ yayau tadā || tatra ca snāpayāmāsa putraṃ niyamapūrvakam || 54 || snānamātrāttataḥ sadyo naṣṭonmādo'bhavatsutaḥ || svayaṃ sasnau sa nandopi dhanuṣkoṭau sabhaktikam || 55 || uṣitvā dinamekaṃ tu saputrastu pitā tadā || sevitvā rāmanāthaṃ ca sāṃbamūrtiṃ ghṛṇānidhim || 56 || putramāpṛcchaya naṃdastaṃ prayayau tapase vanam || gate pitari putro'pi dharmagupto nṛpo dvijāḥ || 57 || pradadau rāmanāthāya bahuvittāni bhaktitaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ kṣetrāṇi ca dadau tadā || 58 || prayayau maṃtribhiḥ sārdhaṃ svāṃ purīṃ tadanaṃtaram || dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam ||59|| pitṛpaitāmahaṃ viprā dharmagupto'tidhārmikaḥ || unmādairapyapasmārairgrahairduṣṭaiśca ye narāḥ || 3.1.32.60 || grastā bhavaṃti vipreṃdrāste'pi cātra nimajjanāt || dhanuṣkoṭau vimuktāḥ syuḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 61 || parityajya dhanuṣkoṭiṃ tīrthamanyadvrajettu yaḥ || siddhaṃ sa gopayastyaktvā snuhīkṣīraṃ prayācate || || 62 || dhanuṣkoṭirdhanuṣkoṭirdhanuṣkoṭiriti dvijāḥ || triḥ paṭhanto narā ye tu yatra kvāpi jalāśaye || 63 || snāṃti sarve narāste vai yāsyaṃti brahmaṇaḥ padam || evaṃ vaḥ kathitā viprā dharmaguptakathā śubhā || 64 || yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vinaśyati || svarṇasteyādayaścānye naśyeyuḥ pāpasaṃcayāḥ || 65 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ dharmaguptonmā davimokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<3.1.33>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || bhūyo'pyahaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhanuṣkoṭestu vaibhavam || atyadbhutataraṃ guhyaṃ sarvalokaikapāvanam || 1 || purā parāvasurnāma brāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ || ajñānātpitaraṃ hatvā brahmahatyāmavāptavān || so'pi snātvā dhanuṣkoṭau taddoṣā nmumuce kṣaṇāt || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || pitaraṃ hatavānpūrvaṃ kathaṃ sūta parāvasuḥ || 3 || kathaṃ vā dhanuṣaḥ koṭau muktistasyāpyabhūnmune || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || āsīdrājā bṛhaddyumnaścakravartī mahābalaḥ || dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa sāgarāṃtāṃ vasundharām || 5 || ayajatsatrayāgena devāniṃdrapurogamān || yājakastasya raibhyo'bhūdvidvānparamadhārmikaḥ || 6 || āstāṃ putrāvubhau tasyāpyarvāvasu parāvasū || ṣaḍaṃgavedaviduṣau śrautasmārteṣu kovidau ||7 || kāṇāde jaiminīye ca sāṃkhye vaiyāsike tathā || gautame yogaśāstre ca pāṇinīye ca kovi dau ||8|| manvādismṛtiniṣṇātau sarvaśāstraviśāradau || satrayāge sahāyārthaṃ bṛhaddyumnena yācitau ||9|| bhrātarau samanujñātau pitrā raibhyeṇa jagmatuḥ || bṛhaddyumnasya satraṃ tāvaśvināviva rūpiṇau ||3.1.33.10|| atiṣṭhadāśrame raibhyaḥ snuṣayā jyeṣṭhayā saha || tau gatvā bhrātarau tatra rājñaḥ satramanuttamam||11|| yāja yāmāsatuḥ satre bṛhaddyumnaṃ mahīpatim || nābhavatskhalanaṃ bhrātroḥ satre sāṃgeṣu karmasu || 12 || satre saṃtanyamāne'sminbṛhaddyumnasya bhūpateḥ || munayo bhyāgamansarve rājñāhūtā nirīkṣitum ||13|| vasiṣṭho gautamaścātrirjābāliratha kaśyapaḥ || kraturdakṣaḥ pulastyaśca pulaho nārado muniḥ || 14 || mārkaṃḍeyaḥ śatānaṃdo viśvāmitraḥ parāśaraḥ || bhṛguḥ kutso'tha vālmīkirvyāsadhaumyādayo'pare || 15 || śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyairbahubhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ || tānāgatānsamālokya bṛhaddyumno mahīpatiḥ || 16 || arghyādinā munīnsarvānpūjayāmāsa sādaram || nānā digbhyaḥ samāyātāścaturaṃgabalairyutāḥ || 17 || upadāsahitā bhūpāssatraṃ vīkṣitumādarāt || vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathā varṇāścatvaro'pi samāgatāḥ || 18 || varṇino'tha gṛhasthāśca vānaprasthāśca bhikṣavaḥ || satraṃ nirīkṣituṃ tasya bṛhaddyumnasya cāyayuḥ || 19 || tānsarvānpūjayāmāsa yathārhaṃ rājasattamaḥ || dadau cānnāni sarvebhyo ghṛtasūpādikāṃstathā || 3.1.33.20 || vastrāṇi ca suvarṇāni hāraratnānyanekaśaḥ || evaṃ satkārayāmāsa rājā satre samāgatān || 21 || raibhyaputro tadā viprā arvāvasuparāvasū || adhvarādīni karmāṇi cakratuḥ skhalitaṃ vinā || 22 || taddṛṣṭvā munayassarve kauśalaṃ raibhyaputrayauḥ || ślāghaṃte saśiraḥkampaṃ vasiṣṭhapramukhāstadā || 23 || karmāṇi kāni cittatra kārayitvā parāvasuḥ || tṛtīyasavanasyāṃte gṛhakṛtyaṃ nirīkṣitum || 24 || prayayau svāśramaṃ sāyaṃ vinaivārvāvasuṃ dvijāḥ || tasminnavasare raibhyaṃ kṛṣṇājinasamāvṛtam || 25 || vane caraṃtaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sa mṛgaśaṃkayā || nidrākaluṣito rātrāvaṃdhe tamasi saṃkule || 26 || ātmānaṃ haṃtumāyāti mṛgo'yamiti ciṃtayan || jaghāna pitaraṃ so'yaṃ mahāraṇye parāvasuḥ || 27 || rirakṣuṇā śarīraṃ svaṃ tenākāmanayā pitā || rajanyāṃ hiṃsito viprā mahāpātakakāriṇā || 28 || aṃtikaṃ sa samāgatya vyalokayata taṃ hatam || jñātvā svapitaraṃ rātrau śuśoca vyathiteṃdriyaḥ || || 29 || pretakāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pituḥ sarvaṃ parāvasuḥ || bhūyopi nṛpateḥ satraṃ parāvasurupāyayau || 3.1.33.30 || svaceṣṭitaṃ tu tatsarvamanujāya tato'bravīt || mṛtaṃ svapitaraṃ śrutvā so'pi śokākulo'bhavat || 31 || jyeṣṭho'nujaṃ tataḥ prāha vacanaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || mahatsatraṃ samārabdhaṃ bṛhaddyumnasya bhūpateḥ || || 32 || voḍhutvaśaktirnāstyasya karmaṇo bālakasya te || janakaśca hato rātrau mayāpi mṛgaśaṃkayā || 33 || prāyaścittaṃ ca karttavyaṃ brahmahatyā viśuddhaye || madarthaṃ vratacaryāṃ tvaṃ cara tāta kaniṣṭhaka || 34 || ekākī dhuramudvoḍhuṃ śakto'haṃ satrakarmaṇaḥ || arvāvasuriti prokto jyeṣṭhena sa tamabhya dhāt || 35 || tathā bhavatvahaṃ jyeṣṭha cariṣye vratamuttamam || brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ tvaṃ satradhuramāvaha || 36 || ityuktvā sonu'jo jyeṣṭhaṃ tasmātsatrādvi niryayau || kārayāmāsa karmāṇi jyeṣṭhastasmingate katau || 37 || dvādaśābdaṃ kaniṣṭhopi brahmahatyāvrataṃ dvijāḥ || caritvā satrayāge'sminnājagāma punarmudā || 38 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭho bṛhaddyumnamuvāca ha || ayaṃ te brahmahā satramarvāvasurupāgataḥ || 39 || enamutsārayāśu tvamasmātsatrānnṛpo ttama || anyathā satrayāgasya phalahānirbhaviṣyati || 3.1.33.40 || itīritaḥ sa svapreṣyairyāgāttamudavāsayat || udvāsyamāno rājānamarvāvasurathābravīt || || 41 || na mayā brahmahatyeyaṃ bṛhaddyumna kṛtānagha || kintu jyeṣṭhena me sā hi brahmahatyā kṛtā vibho || 42 || brahmahatyāvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ tadarthaṃ ca mayā dhunā || evamuktopi rājāsau vacasā sa parāvasoḥ || 43 || arvāvasuṃ nijātsatrādudavāsayadāśu vai || dhikkṛto brāhmaṇaiścāyaṃ yayau tūṣṇīṃ vanaṃ tadā || 44 || munivṛndasamākīrṇaṃ tapovanamupetya saḥ || arvāvasustapaścakre devairapi suduṣkaram || 45 || tapaḥ kurvaṃstathādityamupatasthe samā hitaḥ || mūrtimāṃstapasā tasya mahatā'duṣṭadhīḥ svayam || 46 || āvirāsītsvayā dīptyā bhāsayañjagatītalam || karmasākṣī jagaccakṣurbhāskaro devatāgraṇīḥ || 47 || āvirbabhūvurdevāśca puraskṛtya śacīpatim || indrādayastato devāḥ procurarvāvasuṃ dvijāḥ ||48|| arvāvaso tvaṃ pravarastapasā brahma caryataḥ || ācāreṇa śrutenāpi vedaśāstrādiśikṣayā || 49 || nirākṛtovamānena tvaṃ parāvasunā bahu || tathāpi kṣamayā yukto na kupyati bhavānyataḥ || 3.1.33.50 || yasmājjyeṣṭho'vadhīttātaṃ na hiṃsīstvaṃ mahāmate || brahmahatyāvrataṃ yasmāttadarthaṃ caritaṃ tvayā || 51 || ataḥ svīkurma he tvāṃ tu parākurmaḥ parāvasum || uktvaivaṃ balabhinmukhyāḥ sarve ca tridivālayāḥ || 52 || taṃ te pravarayāmāsurnirāsuśca parāvasum || punariṃdrādayo devāḥ purodhāya divākaram || 53 || arvāvasuṃ procuridaṃ varaṃ tvaṃ varayeti vai || sa cāpi prārthayāmāsa janakasyotthitiṃ puna. || 54 || vadhe cāsmaraṇaṃ devānātmano janakasya vai || tathāstviti surāḥ procuḥ punarūcuridaṃ vacaḥ || 55 || varaṃ cānyaṃ pradāsyāmo varaya tvaṃ mahāmate || evamuktaḥ suraiḥ soyamarvāvasurabhāṣata || 56 || mama bhrāturaduṣṭatvaṃ bhavatu tridaśālayāḥ || arvāvasorvacaḥ śrutvā tridaśāḥ punarabruvan || 57 || brāhmaṇasya piturghātānmahāndoṣaḥ parāvasoḥ || na hyanyakṛtapāpasya pareṇānuṣṭhitena vai ||58|| prāyaścittena śāṃtiḥ syānmahāpātakapaṃcake || piturbrāhmaṇahaṃtustu sutarāṃ nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ||59|| ātmanānuṣṭhitenāpi vratena na hi duṣkṛtiḥ|| parāvasostava bhrāturato naivāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ||3.1.33.60|| ato'smābhiraduṣṭatvamasmai dātuṃ na śakyate || arvāvasuḥ punaḥprāha devāniṃdrapurogamān||61|| tathāpi yuṣmanmāhātmyātprasādādbhavatāṃ tathā|| piturbrāhmaṇahaṃturme bhrātustridaśasattamāḥ||62|| yathā syānniṣkṛtirbrūta tathaiva kṛpayā yutāḥ || evamarvāvasoḥ śrutvā vacaste tridaśālayāḥ || 63 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ viniścityedamabuvan || upāyaṃ te pravakṣyāmastatpātakanivāraṇam ||64|| dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau puṇye rāmasetau vimuktide || dhanuṣkoṭiriti khyātaṃ tīrthamasti vimuktidam || 65 || brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyavināśanam|| gurutalpagasaṃsargadoṣāṇāmapi nāśanam || 66 || akāmenāpi yaḥ snāyādapavargaphalapradam || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ narakakleśanāśanam || 67 || kailāsādipadaprāptikāraṇaṃ paramārthadam || sarvakāmamidaṃ puṃsāmṛṇadāridryanāśanam || 68 || dhanuṣkoṭirdhanu ṣkoṭirdhanuṣkoṭiritīraṇāt || svargāpavargadaṃ puṃsāṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || 69 || tatra gatvā tava bhrātā snāyādyadi parāvasuḥ || tatkṣaṇādeva te jyeṣṭho mucyate brahmahatyayā || 3.1.33.70 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ sumahatprāyaścittamudīritam || uktvetyarvāvasuṃ devāḥ prayayuḥ svapurīṃ prati || 71 || tata arvāvasurjyeṣṭhaṃ samādāya parāvasum || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭiṃ prayayau muktidāyinīm || 72 || setau saṃkalpamuktvā tu niyamena parāvasuḥ || saha bhrātrā dhanuṣkoṭau sasnau pātakaśuddhaye || 73 || snātvotthitaṃ dhanuṣkoṭau taṃ provācāśarīriṇī || parāvaso vinaṣṭā te piturbrāhmaṇaghātajā || 74 || brahmahatyā mahā ghorā narakakleśakāriṇī || ityuktvā virarāmātha sāpi vāgaśarīriṇī || 75 || parāvasustadā viprāḥ kaniṣṭhena samanvitaḥ || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭiṃ praṇamya ca sabhaktikam || 76 || rāmanāthaṃ mahādevaṃ natvā bhaktipuraḥsaram || vimuktapātako viprāḥ prayayau piturāśramam || 77 || mṛtvotthitastadā raibhyo dṛṣṭvā putrau samāgatau || saṃtuṣṭahṛdayo hyāste putrābhyāṃ svāśrame tadā || 78 || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭau snānena hatapātakam || enaṃ parāvasuṃ sarve svīcakrurmunayastadā || 79 || evaṃ parāvasoruktaṃ brahmahatyāvimokṣaṇam || snānamātrāddhanuṣkoṭau yuṣmākaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 3.1.33.80 || surā pānādayo viprā naśyaṃtyevātra majjanāt || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate || 91 || mahāpātakasaṃghāśca naśyeyurmajjanādiha || ya imaṃ paṭhate'dhyāyaṃ brahmahatyāvimokṣaṇam || 82 || brahmahatyā vinaśyeta tatkṣaṇānnāsti saṃśayaḥ || surāpānādayo'pyasya śāṃtiṃ gaccheyuraṃjasā || 83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ parāvasorbrahmahatyāvimo kṣaṇaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
<3.1.34>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || itihāsaṃ punarvakṣye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsanam || sṛgālasya ca saṃvādaṃ vānarasya ca sattamāḥ|| ||1|| sṛgālavānarau pūrvamāstāṃ jātismarāvubhau|| purāpi mānuṣe bhāve sakhāyau tau babhūvatuḥ||2|| anyāṃ yoniṃ samāpannau sārgālīṃ vānarīṃ tathā || sakhyaṃ samīyaturubhau sṛgālo vānaro dvijāḥ || 3 || kadācidrudrabhūmiṣṭhaṃ sṛgālaṃ vānaro'bravīt || śmaśānamadhye saṃprekṣya pūrvajātimanusmaran || 4 || || vānara uvāca || || sṛgāla pātakaṃ pūrvaṃ kimakārṣīḥ sudāruṇam || yastvaṃ śmaśāne mṛtakānpūtigaṃdhāṃśca kutsitān || atsītyukto'tha kapinā sṛgālastamabhāṣata || 5 || || sṛgāla uvāca || || ahaṃ pūrvabhave hyāsaṃ brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || 6 || vedaśarmābhidho vidvānsarvakarmakalāpavit || brāhmaṇāya pratiśrutya na mayā tatra janmani || 7 || kape dhanaṃ tadā dattaṃ sṛgālo'haṃ tato'bhavam|| tasmādevaṃvidhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayāmyatikutsitam || 8 || pratiśrutya durātmāno na prayacchaṃti ye narāḥ || kape sṛgālayoniṃ te prāpnuvaṃtyatikutsitām || 9 || yo na dadyātpratiśrutya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || sarvāśāstasya naṣṭāḥ syuḥ ṣaṃḍhasyeva prajodbhavaḥ || 3.1.34.10 || pratiśrutyāpradāne tu brāhmaṇāya plavaṃgama || daśajanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 11 || pratiśrutyāpradānena yatpāpamupajāyate || nāśvamedhaśatenāpitatpāpaṃ pariśudhyati || 12 || na jānehamidaṃ pāpaṃ kadā naṣṭaṃ bhavediti || tasmātpratiśrutaṃ dravyaṃ dātavyaṃ viduṣā sadā || 13 || pratiśrutyāpradānena sṛgālo bhavati dhruvam || tasmātprājñena viduṣā dātavyaṃ hi pratiśrutam || 14 || ityuktvā sa sṛgālastaṃ vānaraṃ punarabravīt || bhavatā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yena vānaratāmagāt || 15 || anāgaso vanacarānpakṣiṇo hiṃsi vānara || tatpātakaṃ vadasvādya vānaratvapradaṃ mama || ityuktaḥ sa sṛgālena sṛgālaṃ vānaro'bravīt || 16 || || vānara uvāca || || purā janmanyahaṃ vipro vedanātha iti smṛtaḥ || || 17 || viśvanātho mama pitā mamāṃbā kamalālayā || sṛgāla sakhyamabhavadāvayoḥ prāgbhave'pi hi || 19 || tvaṃ na jānāsi tatsarvaṃ vedmyahaṃ puṇya gauravāt || tapasārādhya giriśaṃ tatprasādātpurā mama || 19 || atītabhāvivijñānamasti janmāṃtare'pi ca || gomāyo tadbhave śākaṃ brāhmaṇasya hṛtaṃ mayā || 3.1.34.20 || tatpāpādvānaro jāto narakānubhavādanu || nāhartavyaṃ vipradhanaṃ haraṇānnarakaṃ bhavet || 21 || anaṃtaraṃ vānaratvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || tasmānna brāhmaṇasvaṃ tu hartavyaṃ viduṣā sadā || 22 || brahmasvaharaṇātpāpamadhikaṃ naiva vidyate || pītavaṃtaṃ viṣaṃ haṃti brahmasvaṃ sakulaṃ dahet || 23 || brahmasvaharaṇātpāpī kuṃbhīpākeṣu pacyate || paścānnarakaśeṣeṇa vānarīṃ yonimaśnute || 24 || vipradravyaṃ na hartavyaṃ kṣaṃtavyaṃ teṣvataḥ sadā || bālā daridrāḥ kṛpaṇā vedaśāstrādivarjitāḥ || 25 || brāhmaṇā nāvamaṃtavyāḥ kruddhāścedanalopamāḥ || atītānāgataṃ jñānaṃ sṛgālākhilamasti me || 26 || jñānamasti na me tvekametatpāpaviśodhanam|| jātismaro'pi hi bhavānbhāvikāryaṃ na budhyate ||27 || atīteṣvapi kiṃcijjñaḥ pratibaṃdhavaśādbhavān || ato bhavānna jānīte bhāvyatītaṃ tathākhilam || 28 || kiyatkālaṃ sṛgālāto bhuktā vyasanamīdṛśam || āvayorasya pāpasya ko vā mocayitā bhavet || || 29 || evaṃ prabruvatostatra plavaṃgamasṛgālayoḥ|| yadṛcchayā daivayogātpūrvapuṇyavaśāddvijāḥ ||3.1.34.30|| āyayau sa mahātejāḥ siṃdhudvīpāhvayo muniḥ|| bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgastripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ || 31|| rudrākṣamālābharaṇaḥ śivanāmāni kīrtayan || sṛgālavānarau dṛṣṭvā siṃdhudvīpābhidhaṃ munim || praṇamya mudi tau bhūtvā papracchaturidaṃ tadā || 32 || || sṛgālavānarāvūcatuḥ || || bhagavansarvadharmajña siṃdhudvīpa mahāmune || 33 || āvāṃ rakṣa kṛpādṛṣṭyā vilokaya muhurmudā || kapitvaṃ ca sṛgālatvamāvayoryena naśyati || 34 || tamupāyaṃ vadasvādya tvaṃ hi puṇyavatāṃ varaḥ || anāthānkṛpaṇānajñānbālānrogāturāñjanān || 35 || rakṣaṃti sādhavo nityaṃ kṛpayā nirapekṣakāḥ || tābhyāmitīritaḥ prājñaḥ siṃdhudvīpo mahāmuniḥ || prāha tau kapigomāyū dhyātvā tu manasā ciram || 36 || || siṃdhudvīpa uvāca || || jānāmyahaṃ yuvāṃ samyagghe sṛgālaplavaṃgamau || 37 || sṛgāla prāgbhave tvaṃ vai vedaśarmābhidho dvijaḥ || brāhmaṇāya pratiśrutya dhānyānāmāḍhakaṃ tvayā || 38 || na dattaṃ tena pāpena sārgālīṃ yonimāptavān || tvaṃ ca vānara pūrvasminvedanāthābhidho dvijaḥ || 39 || brāhmaṇasya gṛhācchākaṃ hṛtaṃ cauryāttvayā tata || prāptosi vānarīṃ yoniṃ sarvapakṣibhayaṃkarīm || 3.1.34.40 || yuvayoḥ pāpaśāṃtyarthamupāyaṃ pravadāmyaham || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau rāmadhanuṣkoṭau yuvāmaram || 41 || gatvātra kurutaṃ snānaṃ tena pāpādvimokṣyathaḥ || purā kirātīsaṃsargātsumatirbrāhmaṇaḥ surām || pītavāntsa dhanuṣkoṭau snātvā pāpādvimocitaḥ || 42 || || sṛgāla vānarāvūcatuḥ || || sumatiḥ kasya putro'sau kathaṃ ca sa surāṃ papau || 43 || kathaṃ kirātyāṃ sakto'bhūtsiṃdhudvīpa mahāmate || āvayorvistarādetadvada tvaṃ kṛpāyādhunā || 44 || || siṃdhudvīpa uvāca || || mahārāṣṭrābhidhe deśe brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidāstikaḥ || yajñadeva iti khyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 45 || dayālurātitheyaśca śivanārāyaṇārcakaḥ || sumatirnāma putro'bhūdyajñadevasya tasya vai || 46 || pitarau sa parityajya bhāryāmapi pativratām || prayayāvutkale deśe viṭagoṣṭhīparāyaṇaḥ || 47 || kācitkirātī taddeśe vasantī yuvamohinī || yūnāṃ samastadravyāṇi pralobhya jagṛhe ciram || 48 || tasyā gṛhaṃ sa prayayau sumatirbrāhmaṇādhamaḥ || sumatiṃ sā na jagrāha kirātī nirdhanaṃ dvijam || 49 || tayā tyakto'tha sumatistatsaṃyogaikatatparaḥ || itastataścorayitvā bahudravyāṇi saṃtatam || 3.1.34.50 || dattvā tayā ciraṃ reme tadgrahe bubhuje ca saḥ || ekena caṣakeṇāsau tayā saha surāṃ papau || 51 || evaṃ sa bahukālaṃ vai ramamāṇastayā saha || pitarau nijapatnīṃ ca nāsmaradviṣayāturaḥ || 52 || sa kadācitkirātaistu cauryaṃ kartuṃ yayau saha || dravyaṃ hartuṃ kirātāste lāṭānāṃ viṣayaṃ yayuḥ ||53|| viprasya kasyacidgehe so'pi kairātaveṣadhṛk|| yayau corayituṃ dravyaṃ sāhasī khaṅgahastavān || 54 || tadgṛhasvāminaṃ vipraṃ hatvā khaḍgena sāhasī || samādāya bahu dravyaṃ kirātībhavanaṃ yayau || 55 || taṃ yāṃtamanuyāti sma brahmahatyā bhayaṃkarī || nīlavastradharā bhīmā bhṛśaṃ raktaśiroruhā || 56 || garjaṃtī sāṭṭahāsaṃ sā kaṃpayantī ca rodasī || anudrutastayā so'yaṃ babhrāma jagatītale || 57 || evaṃ bhramanbhuvaṃ sarvāṃ kadācitsumatiḥ svayam || svaṃ grāmaṃ prayayau bhītyā he sṛgālaplavaṃgamau || 58 || anudrutastayā bhītaḥ prayayau svagṛhaṃ prati || brahmahatyāpyanudrutya tena sākaṃ gṛhaṃ yayau || 59 || pitaraṃ rakṣa rakṣeti sumatiḥ śaraṇaṃ yayau || mā bhaiṣīriti taṃ procya pitā rakṣitumudyataḥ || tadānīṃ brahmahatyeyaṃ tattātaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 3.1.34.60 || | | brahmahatyovāca || || mainaṃ tvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva yajñadeva dvijottama || 61 || asau surāpī steyī ca brahmahā cātipātakī || mātṛdrohī pitṛdrohī bhāryātyāgī ca pāpakṛt || 62 || kirātīsaṃgaduṣṭaśca nainaṃ muñcāmyahaṃ dvija || gṛhṇāsi cedimaṃ vipra mahāpātakinaṃ sutam || 63 || tvadbhāryāmasya bhāryāṃ ca tvāṃ ca putramimaṃ dvija || bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca tasmānmuñca sutaṃ tvimam || || 64 || imaṃ tyajasi cetputraṃ yuṣmānmokṣyāmi sāṃpratam || naikasyārthe kulaṃ hantumarhasi tvaṃ mahāmate || ityuktaḥ sa tayā tatra yajñadevo'bravīcca tām || 65 || || yajñadeva uvāca || || bādhate māṃ sutasnehaḥ kathamenaṃ parityaje || brahmahatyā tadākarṇya dvijoktaṃ tamabhāṣata || 66 || || brahmahatyovāca || || ayaṃ hi patito'bhūtte varṇāśramabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 67 || putresminmā kuru snehaṃ niṃditaṃ tasya darśanam|| ityuktvā brahmahatyā sā yajñadevasya paśyataḥ || 68 || talena prajahārāsya putraṃ sumatināmakam || ruroda tāta tāteti pitaraṃ prabruvanmuhuḥ || 69 || rurudurjanako mātā bhāryāpi sumatestadā || etasminnaṃtare tatra durvāsāḥ śaṃkarāṃśajaḥ || 3.1.34.70 || diṣṭavā samāyayau yogī he sṛgālaplavaṃgamau || yajñadevo'tha taṃ dṛṣṭvā muniṃ rudrāvatārakam|| śrutvā praṇamya śaraṇaṃ yayāce putrakāraṇāt || 71 || || pitovāca || || durvāsastvaṃ mahāyogī sākṣādvai śaṃkarāṃśajaḥ || 72 || tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ bhavitā na kadācana || brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī cābhūtsuto mama || 73 || enaṃ prahartumāyātā brahmahatyā vivartate || bhūyādyathā me putro'yaṃ mahāpātakamocitaḥ || 74 || ghorā ca brahmahatyeyaṃ yathā śīghraṃ layaṃ vrajet || tamupāyaṃ vadasvādya mama putre dayāṃ kuru || 79 || ayameva hi putro me nānyo'sti tanayo mune || asminmṛte tu vaṃśo me samucchidyetsamūlataḥ || 76 || tataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ piṃḍānāṃ dātāpi na bhaveddhruvam || ataḥ kṛpāṃ kuruṣva tvamasmāsu bhagavanmune || 77 || ityuktaḥ sa tadovāca durvāsāḥ śaṃkarāṃśajaḥ || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ yajñadevaṃ dvijottamam || 78 || || durvāsā uvāca || || yajñadeva kṛtaṃ pāpamatikrūraṃ sutena te || nāsya pāpasya śāṃtiḥ syātprāyaścittāyutairapi || 79 || athāpi te sutasyāhamasya pāpasya śāṃtaye || prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyāmi śṛṇu nānyamanā dvija || 3.1.34.80 || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭau dakṣiṇe salilārṇave || snāti cettava putro'yaṃ pātakānmokṣyate kṣaṇāt || 81 || durvinītābhidho vipro yatra snānāddvijottama || gurustrīgama pāpebhyastatkṣaṇādeva mocitaḥ || 82 || saiṣā śrīdhanuṣaḥ koṭī rāghavasya svayaṃ hareḥ || snānamātreṇa pāpaughaṃ nāśayettvatsutasya sā || 83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ sṛgālavānarasaṃvāde sumatimahāpātaka vimokṣopāyakathanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<3.1.35>
|| yajñadeva uvāca || || durvāsarṣe mahāprājña parāparavicakṣaṇa || durvinītābhidhaḥ ko'yaṃ yo'sau gurvaṃganāmagāt || 1 || kasya putro dhanuṣkoṭau snānena sa kathaṃ dvijaḥ || tatkṣaṇānmumuce pāpādgurustrīgamasaṃbhavāt || etanme śraddhadhānasya vistarādvaktumarhasi || 2 || || durvāsā uvāca || || pāṃḍyadeśe purā kaścidbrāhmaṇobhūdbahuśrutaḥ || 3 || idhmavāhābhidho nāmnā tasya bhāryā ruciṃstathā || babhūva tasya tanayo durvinītābhidho dvijaḥ || 4 || bālye vayasi putrasya mamāra janako'sya 3 || durvinītaḥ pitustasya sa kṛtvā caurdhvadaihikam|| 5 || kaṃcitkālaṃ gṛhe'vātsīnmātrā
