vidhavayā saha || tato durbhikṣamabhavadvādaśābdamavarṣaṇāt || 6 || tato deśāṃtaramagānmātrā sākaṃ dvijottama || gokarṇaṃ sa samāsādya subhikṣaṃ dhānyasaṃcayaiḥ || 7 || uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ mātrā vidhavayā saha || tato bahutithe kāle durvinīto gate sati || 8 || pūrvaduṣkarmapākena mūḍhabuddhiraho bata || anaṃgaśaraviddhāṃgo rāgādvikṛtamānasaḥ ||9|| māmeti vādinīmaṃbāṃ balādākṛṣya pātakī || bubhuje kāmamohātmā maithunena dvijottama || 3.1.35.10 || sa khinno durvinīto'yaṃ retaḥsekādanaṃtaram || manasā ciṃtayanpāpaṃ rurodabhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ || 11 || ahotipāpakṛdahaṃ mahāpātakināṃ varaḥ || agamaṃ jananīṃ yasmātkāmabāṇavaśānugaḥ || 12 || iti saṃcitya manasā sa tatra munisannidhau || juguptamānaścātmānaṃ tānmunīnidamabravīt|| 13 || gurustrīgamapāpasya prāyaścittaṃ mamadvijāḥ || vadadhvaṃ śāstratattvajñāḥ kṛpayā mayi kevalam || 14 || maraṇānniṣkṛtiḥ syāccenmariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || bhavadbhirucyate yattu prāyaścittaṃ mamādhunā || 15 || kariṣye taddvijāḥ satyaṃ maraṇaṃ vānyadaiva vā || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kecittatramunīśvarāḥ || 16 || anena sākaṃ vārtā tu doṣāyeti viniścitāḥ || maunitvaṃ bhejire kecinmunayaḥ kecidā bhṛśam || 17 || duṣṭātmā mātṛgāmī tvaṃ mahāpātakināṃ varaḥ || gacchagacchetibahuśo vācamūcurdvijottamāḥ || 18 || tānnivārya kṛpāśīlaḥ sarvajñaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastatra durvinītamabhāṣata || 19 || gacchāśu rāmasetau tvaṃ dhanuṣkoṭau sahāṃbayā || makarasthe ravau māghe māsamekaṃ niraṃtaram|| 3.1.35.20 || jiteṃdriyo jitakrodhaḥ paradrohavivarjitaḥ || ekamāsaṃ nirāhāraḥ kuru snānaṃ sahāṃbayā || 21 || pūto bhaviṣyasyaddhā gurustrī gamadoṣataḥ || yatpātakaṃ na naśyeta setusnānena tannahi || 22 || śrutismṛtipurāṇeṣu dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsanam || bahudhā bhaṇyate paṃcamahāpātakanāśanam || || 23 || tasmāttvaṃ tvarayā gaccha dhanuṣkoṭiṃ sahāṃbayā || pramāṇaṃ kuru madvākyaṃ vedavākyamiva dvija || 24 || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭau snātasya dvija putraka || mahāpātakakoṭyopi naiva lakṣyā itīva hi || 25 || prāyaścittāṃtaraṃ proktaṃ manvādismṛtibhiḥ smṛtau || tadgacchatvaṃ dhanuṣkoṭiṃ mahāpātaka nāśinīm || 26 || itīrito'tha vyāsena durvinītodvijottamāḥ || mātrā sākaṃ dhanuṣkoṭiṃ natvā vyāsaṃ ca niryayau || 27 || makarasthe ravau māghe māsamātraṃ niraṃtaram || mātrā saha nirāhāro jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || 28 || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭau sasnau saṃkalpapūrvakam || rāmanāthaṃ namaskurvaṃ strikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 29 || māsāṃte pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā mātrā saha viśuddhadhīḥ || vyāsāṃtikaṃ punaḥ prāyāttasmai vṛttaṃ niveditum || 3.1.35.30 || sa praṇamya punarvyāsaṃ durvinīto'bravīdvacaḥ || 31 || || durvinīta uvāca || || bhagavankaruṇāsiṃdho dvaipāyana mahattama || bhavataḥ kṛpayā rāmadhanuṣkoṭau sahāṃbayā || māghamāse nirāhāro māsamātramataṃdritaḥ || 32 || ahaṃ tvakaravaṃ snānaṃ namaskurvanmaheśvaram || itaḥ paraṃ mayā vyāsa bhagavanbhaktavatsala || 33 || yatkarttavyaṃ mune tattvaṃ mamopadiśa tattvataḥ || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā durvinītasya vai muniḥ || babhāṣe durvinītaṃ taṃ vyāso nārāyaṇāṃśakaḥ || 34 || || vyāsa uvāca || || durvinīta gataṃ te'dya pātakaṃ mātṛsaṃgajam || 35 || mātuśca pātakaṃ naṣṭaṃ tvatsaṃgatinimi ttajam || saṃdeho nātra kartavyaḥ satyamuktaṃ mayā tava || 36 || bāṃdhavāḥ svajanāḥ sarve tathānye brāhmaṇāśca ye || sarve tvāṃ saṃgrahīṣyaṃti durvinītāṃ bayā saha || 37 || matprasādāddhanuṣkoṭau viśuddhastvaṃ nimajjanāt || dārasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā gārhasthyaṃ dharmamācara || 38 || tyaja tvaṃ prāṇihiṃsāṃ ca dharmaṃ bhaja sanātanam || sevasva sajjanānnityaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā || 39 || saṃdhyopāsanamukhyāni nityakarmāṇi na tyaja || nigṛhīṣvendriyagrāmamarcayasva haraṃ harim || 3.1.35.40 || parāpavādaṃ mā brūyā māsūyāṃ bhaja karhicit || anyasyābhyudayaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtāpaṃ kṛṇu mā vṛthā || 41 || mātṛvatparadā rāṃśca tvannityamavalokaya || adhītavedānakhilānmāvismara kadācana || 42 || atithīnmāvamanyasva śrāddhaṃ pitṛdine kuru || paiśūnyaṃ mā vadasva tvaṃ svapne'pyansya karhicit || 43 || itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi saṃtatam || avalokaya vedāṃtaṃ vedāṃgāni tathā punaḥ || 44 || hariśaṃkaranā māni muktalajjo'nukīrttaya || jābālopaniṣanmaṃtraistripuṃḍroddhūlanaṃ kuru || 45 || rudrākṣāndhāraya sadā śaucācāraparo bhava || tulasyā bilvapatraiśca nārāyaṇaharāvubhau || 46 || ekaṃ kālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ cārcayasya bhoḥ || tulasīdalasaṃmiśraṃ siktaṃ pādodakena ca || 47 || naivedyānnaṃ sadā bhuṃkṣva śaṃbhunārāyaṇāgrataḥ || kuru tvaṃ vaiśvadevākhyaṃ balimannaviśuddhaye || 48 || yatīśvarānbrahmaniṣṭhāntarpayānnairgṛhāgatān || vṛddhānanyānanāthāṃśca rogiṇo brahmacāriṇaḥ || 49 || kuru tvaṃ mātṛśuśrūṣāmaupāsanaparo bhava || paṃcākṣaraṃ mahāmaṃtraṃ praṇavena samanvitam || 3.1.35.50 || tathaivāṣṭākṣaraṃ maṃtramanyamaṃtrānapi dvija || japa tvaṃ prayato bhūtvā dhyāyanmaṃtrādhidevatāḥ || 51 || evamanyāṃstathā dharmānsmṛtyuktāntsarvadā kuru || evaṃ kṛtavrataste syāddehāṃte muktirapyalam || 52 || ityukto vyāsamuninā durvinītaḥ praṇamya tam || taduktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā dehāṃte muktimāptavān || 53 || tanmātāpi mṛtā kāle dhanuṣkoṭinimajjanāta || avāpa paramāṃ muktimapunarbhavadāyinīm || 54 || || durvāsā uvāca || || evaṃ te durvinītasya tanmātuśca vimokṣaṇam || dhanuṣkoṭyabhiṣekeṇa yajñadeva mayeritam || 55 || putramenaṃ tvamapyāśu brahmahatyāviśuddhaye || samādāya vraja brahmandhanuṣkoṭiṃ vimuktidām || 56 || || siṃdhudvīpa uvāca || || iti durvāsasā prokto yajñadevo nijaṃ sutam || samādāya yayau rāma dhanuṣkoṭiṃ vimuktidām || 57|| || gatvā nivāsamakarotṣaṇmāsaṃ tatra sa dvijaḥ || putreṇa sākaṃ niyato he sṛgālaplavaṃgamau || 58 || sa sasnau ca dhanuṣkoṭau ṣaṇmāsaṃ vai sa putrakaḥ || ṣaṇmāsāṃte yajñadevaṃ prāha vāgaśarīriṇī || 59 || vimuktā yajñadevasya brahmahatyā sutasya te || svarṇasteyātsurāpānātkirātīsaṃgamāttathā || 3.1.35.60 || anyebhyopi hi pāpebhyo vimuktoyaṃ sutastava || saṃśayaṃ mā kuruṣva tvaṃ yajñadeva dvijottama || 61 || ityuktvā virarāmātha sā tu vāga śarīriṇī || tadā'śarīriṇīvākyaṃ yajñadevaḥ sa śuśruvān || 62 || saṃtuṣṭaḥ putrasahito rāmanāthaṃ niṣevya ca || dhanuṣkoṭiṃ namaskṛtya putreṇa sahi tastadā || 63 || svadeśaṃ prayayau hṛṣṭaḥ svagrāmaṃ svagṛhaṃ tathā || saputradāraḥ suciraṃ sukhamāste sunirvṛtaḥ || 64 || || sindhudvīpa uvāca || || gomāyuvānarāvevaṃ yuvayoḥ kathitaṃ mayā || yajñadevasutasyāsya sumateḥ parimokṣaṇam ||65|| pātakebhyo mahadbhyaśca dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || yuvāmato dhanuṣkoṭiṃ gacchataṃ pāpaśuddhaye || nānyathā pāpaśuddhiḥ syātprāyaścittāyutairapi ||66|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || sindhudvīpasya vacanamiti śrutvā dvijo ttamāḥ||67|| sṛgālavānarāvāśu vilaṃghitamahāpathau|| dhanuṣkoṭiṃ prayāsena gatvā snātvā ca tajjale||68|| vimuktau sarvapāpebhyo vimānavarasaṃsthitau|| devaiḥ kusumavarṣeṇa kīryamāṇau sutejasau ||69|| hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakādivibhūṣitau || devastrīdhūyamānābhyāṃ cāmarābhyāṃ virājitau || gatvā devapurīṃ ramyāmiṃdra syārddhāsanaṃ gatau || 3.1.35.70 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || yuṣmākamevaṃ kathitaṃ sṛgālasya kaperapi || 71 || pāpādvimokṣaṇaṃ viprā dhanuṣkoṭau nimajanāt || bhaktyā ya imamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇoti paṭhate'pi vā ||72|| snānajaṃ phalamāpnoti dhanuṣkoṭau sa mānavaḥ || yogivṛṃdairasulabhāṃ muktimapyāśu viṃdati ||73|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ sṛgālavānaravimokṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma paṃca triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<3.1.36>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || dhanuṣkoṭestu māhātmyaṃ bhūyo'pi prabravīmyaham || durācārābhidho yatra snātvā mukto bhavaddvijāḥ|| || 1 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || durācārābhidhaḥ ko'sau sūta tattvārthakovida || kiṃca pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tena durācāreṇa vai mune || 2 || kathaṃ vā pātakā nmukto dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || etacchuśrūṣamāṇānāṃ vistarādvada no mune || 3 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || munayaḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya durācārasya pātakam || snānena dhanuṣaḥ koṭau yathā muktaśca pātakāt || 4 || durācārābhidho vipro gautamītīramāśritaḥ || kaścidasti dvijāḥ pāpī krūrakarmarataḥ sadā || 5 || brahmaghnaiśca surāpaiśca steyibhirgurutalpagaiḥ || tadā saṃsargaduṣṭo'sau taiḥ sākaṃ nyavasadvijāḥ ||6|| mahāpātakisaṃsargaṃ doṣeṇāsya dvijasya vai || brāhmaṇyaṃ sakalaṃ naṣṭaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ || 7 || mahāpātakibhiḥ sārddhaṃ dinamekaṃ tu yo dvijaḥ || nivasetsādaraṃ tasya tatkṣaṇādvai dvijanmanaḥ || | 8 || brāhmaṇasya turīyāṃśo naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || dvidinaṃ sevanātsparśāddarśanācchayanāttathā || 9 || bhojanātsaha paṃktau ca mahāpātakibhirdvijāḥ || dvitīyabhāgo naśyeta brāhmaṇasya na saṃśayaḥ || 3.1.36.10 || tridinācca tṛtīyāṃśo naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || caturdināccaturthāṃśo vilayaṃ yāti hi dhruvam || 11 || ataḥ paraṃ tu taiḥ sākaṃ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ || tattulyapātakī bhūyānmahāpātakasaṃbhavāt || 12 || tena brāhmaṇyahīno'yaṃ durācārābhidho dvijāḥ || grasto'bhavadbhīṣaṇena vetālena balīyasā ||13|| asau paravaśastena vetālenātipīḍitaḥ || deśāddeśaṃ bhramanviprā vanāccaiva vanāṃtaram ||14|| pūrvapuṇyavipākena daivayogena sa dvijaḥ || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭiṃ mahāpātakanāśanīm || 15 || anudrutaḥ piśācena tenāviṣṭo yayau dvijāḥ || nyamajjayatsa vetālo dhanuṣkoṭijale tvamum || 16 || dhanuṣkoṭijale so'yaṃ vetālena praveśitaḥ || udatiṣṭhatkṣaṇādeva vetālena vimocitaḥ || 17 || utthito'sau dvijo viprā dhanuṣkoṭijalāttadā || svastho vyaciṃtayatko'yaṃ deśo jaladhitīrataḥ || 18 || kathaṃ mayāgatamiha gautamītīravāsinā || iti ciṃtākulaḥ so'yaṃ dhanuṣkoṭinivāsinam || 19 || dattātreyaṃ mahātmānaṃ yogipravaramuttamam || samāgamya praṇamyāsau durācāro'bhyabhāṣata || 3.1.36.20 || na jāne bhagavandeśaḥ katamo'yaṃ vadādhunā || gautamītīranilayo durācārābhidho hyaham || 21 || kṛpayā brūhi me brahmanmayātra kathamāgatam|| iti pṛṣṭo munistena durācāreṇa suvrataḥ || 22 || dhyātvā muhūrtamavadaddurācāraṃ ghṛṇānidhiḥ || mahāpātakisaṃsarge durācāra kṛte purā || 23 || brāhmaṇyaṃ naṣṭamabhavadvetālastvāṃ tato'grahīt || tenāviṣṭastvamāyāto vivaśo'tra vimūḍhadhīḥ || 24 || nyamajjayattvāṃ vetālo dhanuṣkoṭijale'tra tu || tatra majjanamātreṇa vimuktaḥ pātakādbhavān || 25 || dhanuṣkoṭau tu ye snānaṃ puṇye kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ naśyaṃti vai satyaṃ paṃcapātakasaṃcayāḥ || 26 || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭāvatra majjanamātrataḥ || mahāpātakisaṃsargadoṣaste vilayaṃ yayau || 27 || tannāśādeva vetālastvāṃ muktvā vilayaṃ gataḥ || tvāmagrahīdyo vetālaḥ purāyaṃ brāhmaṇo'bhavat || 28 || so'yaṃ bhādrapade māse kṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayam || pārvaṇena vidhānena pitṝṇāṃ nākaronmudā || 29 || tena svapitṛbhiḥ śapto vetālatvamagādayam || sopi cāsya dhanuṣkoṭeravalokanamātrataḥ || 3.1.36.30 || vetālatvaṃ vihāyeha viṣṇulokama vāptavān || ato bhādrapade māse kṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayam || 31 || uddiśya svapitṝnye tu na kurvantyatilobhataḥ || mahālobhayutāste'ddhā vetālāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ || 32 || tasmādbhādrapade māse kṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayam || pitṝnuddiśya śaktyā ye brāhmaṇānvedapāragān || 33 || bhojayeyurmahānnena na te viṃdaṃti durgatim || yastu bhādrapade māse kṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayam || 34 || svaśaktyanuguṇaṃ vipramekaṃ dvau trīnakiṃcanaḥ || bhojayennahi daurgatyaṃ bhavedasya kadācana || 35 || ayaṃ bhādrapade māse pitṝṇāmanupāsanāt || yayau vetālatāṃ vipro yastvāṃ jagrāha pāpinam || 36 || kālo bhādrapadamāsamārabhya vṛścikāvadhi || mahālayasya kathito munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 37 || māso bhādrapadaḥ kālastatrāpi hi viśiṣyate || kṛṣṇa pakṣo viśiṣṭaḥ syāddurācāraka tatra vai || 38 || tasmiñchubhe kṛṣṇapakṣe prathamāyāṃ tathā tithau || śrāddhaṃ mahālayaṃ kuryādyo naro bhaktipūrvakam|| 39 || tasya prīṇāti bhagavānpāvakaḥ sarvapāvanaḥ || sa vahnilokamāpnoti vahninā saha modate || 3.1.36.40 || tasmai ca jvalano devaḥ sarvaiśvaryaṃ dadātyapi || prathamāyāṃ tithau martyo yo na kuryānmahālayam|| 41 || vahnirgṛhaṃ dahettasya śriyaṃ kṣetrādikaṃ tathā || vedajñe brāhmaṇe bhukte prathamāyāṃ mahālaye || 42 || daśa kalpasahasrāṇi pitaro yāṃti tṛptatām || dvitīyāyāṃ tu yo bhaktyā kuryācchrāddhaṃ mahālayam || 43 || tasya prīṇāti bhagavānbhavānīpatirīśvaraḥ || sa kailāsamavāpnoti śivena saha modate|| 44 || vipulāṃ saṃpadaṃ tasmai prīto dadyānmaheśvaraḥ || dvitīyāyāṃ tithau martyo yo na kuryānmahālayam || 45 || tasya vai kupitaḥ śaṃbhurnāśayedbrahmavarcasam || rauravaṃ kālasūtrākhyaṃ narakaṃ cāsya dāsyati || 46|| vedajñe brāhmaṇe bhukte dvitīyāyāṃ mahālaye || viṃśatkalpa sahasrāṇi pitaro yāṃti tṛptatām|| 47 || anugrahātpitṝṇāṃ ca saṃtatiścāsya varddhate || tṛtīyāyāṃ naro bhaktyā kuryācchrāddhaṃ mahālayam || 48 || tasya prīṇāti bhagavām̐llokapālo dhanādhipaḥ || mahāpadmādinidhayo vartaṃte tasya vai vaśe || 49 || tasyānugāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || tṛtīyāyāṃ tithau martyo yo na kuryānmahālayam || 3.1.36.50 || dhanado bhagavāṃstasya saṃpadaṃ harati kṣaṇāt || dāridyaṃ ca dadātyasmai bahuduḥkhasamākulam || || 51 || tṛtīyāyāṃ tithau martyo yaḥ karoti mahālayam || tṛpyaṃti pitarastasya triṃśatkalpasahasrakam || 52 || caturthyāṃ tu naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || tasya prīṇāti bhagavānheraṃbaḥ pārvatīsutaḥ || 53 || tasya vighnāśca naśyaṃti gajavaktraprasādataḥ || caturthyāṃ tu tithau martyo yo na kuryānmahālayam || 54 || vighneśo bhagavāṃstasya sadā vighnaṃ karoti hi || caṇḍakolāhalābhikhye narake ca patatyatha || 55 || caturthyāṃ vai tithau martyo yaḥ karoti mahālayam || pitaraḥ kalpasāhasraṃ catvāriṃśatpraharṣitāḥ || 56 || bahūnputrānpradāsyaṃti śrāddhakarturniraṃtaram || paṃcamyāṃ tu tithau bhaktyā yo na kuryānmahālayam || 57 || tasya lakṣmīrbhagavatī parityajati maṃdiram || alakṣmīḥ kalahādhārā tasya prādurbhavedgṛhe || 58 || pacamyāṃ tu tithau martyo yaḥ karoti mahālayam || tasya tṛpyaṃti pitaraḥ paṃcakalpasahasrake || 59 || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāmasmai dāsyaṃti tarpitāḥ || pārvatī ca prasannā syānmahadaiśvaryadāyinī || 3.1.36.60 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tithau naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || tasya prīṇāti bhagavānṣaṇmukhaḥ pārvatī sutaḥ || 61 || tasya putrāśca pautrāśca ṣaṇmukhasya prasādataḥ || grahairvālagrahaiścaiva na bādhyaṃte kadācana || 62 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tithau naro bhaktyā yo na kuryānmahālayam || tasya skando mahāseno vimukhaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 63 || garbhānnirgatamātraiva prajā tasya vinaśyati || pūtanādigrahakulairbādhyate ca niraṃtaram || 64 || vahnijvālāpraveśākhye narake ca patatyadhaḥ || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tithau yaḥ śraddhāvānkuryācchrāddhaṃ mahālayam || 65 || ṣaṣṭikalpasahasraṃ tu pitaro yāmati tṛptatām || putrānapi pradāsyaṃti saṃpadaṃ vipulāṃ tathā || 66 || saptamyāṃ tu tithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || hiraṇyapāṇirbhagavānādityastasya tuṣyati || 67 || arogo dṛḍhagātraḥ syādbhāskarasya prasādataḥ || hiraṇyapāṇirbhagavānhiraṇyaṃ pāṇinā svayam || 68 || mahālayaśrāddhakartre dadāti prītamānasaḥ || saptamyāṃ tu tithau bhaktyā yo na kuryānmahālayam || 69 || vyādhibhiḥ kṣayarogādyai bādhyate sa divāniśam || tīkṣṇadhārāstraśayyākhye narake ca patatyadhaḥ || 3.1.36.70 || saptamyāṃ yo naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || saptatiṃ kalpasāhasraṃ prīṇaṃti pitaro'sya vai || 71 || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sadā || aṣṭamyāṃ tu tithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahāla yam || 72 || mṛtyuṃjayaḥ kṛttivāsāstasya prīṇāti śaṃkaraḥ || karasthaṃ tasya kaivalyaṃ śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ || 73 || mahālayena śrāddhena tuṣṭe sākṣāttri yaṃbake || caturdaśasu lokeṣu durlabhaṃ tasya kiṃ bhavet || 74 || mahālayaṃ na kuryādvai yo'ṣṭamyāṃ mūḍhacetanaḥ || saṃsārasāgare ghore sadā majjati duḥkhitaḥ || 75 || kadācidapi tasyeṣṭaṃ naiva siddhyati bhūtale || vaitariṇyākhyanarake patatyācaṃdratārakam || 76 || yo'ṣṭamyāṃ śraddhayā śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kuryānmahālayam || aśītikalpasāhasraṃ tṛpyaṃti pitaro'sya vai || 77 || āśīrbhirvarddhayaṃtyenaṃ vighnaścāsya vyapohati || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sadā || 78 || navamyāṃ tu tithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || durgādevī bhagavatī tasya prīṇāti śāṃbhavī || 79 || kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭhā dīnkṣudrapretapiśācakān || nāśayettasya santuṣṭā durgā mahiṣamardinī ||3.1.36.80 || navamyāṃ tu tithau martyo yo na kuryānmahālayam || apasmāreṇa pīḍyeta tathaiva brahmarakṣasā || 81 || abhicārārthakṛtyābhirvādhyeta ca nirantaram || navamyāṃ yastithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam|| 82 || navatiṃ kalpasāhasraṃ tṛpyanti pitaro'sya vai || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sadā || 83 || daśamyāṃ tu tithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || tasyāmṛtakalaścandraḥ ṣoḍaśātmā prasīdati || 84 || auṣadhīnāmadhīśe'smiñchrāddhenānena toṣite || vrīhyādīni tu dhānyāni dadyuroṣadhayaḥ sadā|| || 85 || yo na kuryāddaśamyāṃ tu mahālayamanuttamam || oṣadhyo niṣphalāstasya kṛṣiścāpyasya niṣphalā || 86 || daśamyāṃ yastithau martyaḥ śrāddhaṃkuryānmahālayam || śatakalpasahasrāṇi tṛpyaṃti pitaro'sya vai || 87 || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sadā || ekādaśyāṃ naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || 88 || saṃhartā sarvalokasya tasya rudraḥ prasīdati || rudrasya sarvasaṃhartuḥ prasādena jagatpateḥ || 89 || śatrūnparājaya tyeṣa śrāddhakartā nirantaram || brahmahatyāyutaṃ cāpi tasya naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || 3.1.36.90 || agniṣṭomādiyajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti puṣkalam || ekādaśyāṃ naro bhaktyā yo na kuryānmahālayam || 91 || tasya vai vimukho rudro na prasīdati karhicit || sarvato vardhamānāśca bādhante śatravo hyamum || 92 || agniṣṭomādikā yajñāḥ kṛtāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ || niṣphalā eva tasya syurbhasmani nyastahavyavat || 93 || brahmavātakatulyaḥ syācchrāddhākaraṇadoṣataḥ || ekādaśyāṃ tithau yastu śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || 94 || dviśataṃ kalpasāhasraṃ tṛpyaṃti pitaro'sya vai || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛ gaṇāḥ sadā || 95 || dvādaśyāṃ tu tithau martyaḥ kuryācchrāddhaṃ mahālayam | tasya lakṣmīpatiḥ sākṣātprasīdati janārdanaḥ || 96 || prasanne sati deveśe devadeve janārdane || carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ prītameva na saṃśayaḥ || 97 || bhūmirharipriyā cāsya sasyaṃ saṃvarddhayatyapi || lakṣmīśca varddhate tasya maṃdire harivallabhā || 98 || gadā kaumodakī nāma nārāyaṇakarasthitā || apasmārādibhūtāni nāśayatyeva sarvadā || 99 || tīkṣṇadhāraṃ tathā cakraṃ śatrūnasya dahatyapi || yātudhānapiśācādīñchaṃkhaścāsya vyapohati ||3.1.36.100|| evaṃ sarvātmanā pīḍāṃ vārayatyasya keśavaḥ || mahālayaṃ na kuryādyo dvādaśyāṃ manujā dhama || 101 || tasya kṣetrāṇi saṃpacca vinaśyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || apasmārādibhūtāni śatravaśca mahābalāḥ ||102|| yātudhānāśca bādhante taṃ vai viṣṇuparāṅmukham|| pātyate narake cāpi asthibhedananāmake||103|| dvādaśyāṃ bhaktiyukto yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || ṣaṭśataṃ kalpasāhasraṃ prīṇaṃti pitaro'sya vai ||104|| saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ pitaro'smai dadatyapi|| trayodaśyāṃ naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam||105|| prasīdatyasya bhagavānkaṃdarpo ratināyakaḥ || sragcaṃdanādayo bhogā lalanāśca manoramāḥ ||106|| kāmadevaprasādena tasya siddhyaṃti sarvadā|| ājanmamaraṇāṃtaṃ ca sukhameva sa viṃdate ||107|| yo na kuryāttrayodaśyāṃ na ca śrāddhaṃ mahālayam || kāmadevo'sya vimukhaḥ striyo bhogāṃśca nāśayet || 108 || aṃgāraśayyābhramaṇe narake pātayatyamum || pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ kuryāttra yodaśyāṃ mahālayam || 109 || sahasrakalpasāhasraṃ prīṇaṃti pitaro'sya vai || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṝgaṇāstadā || 3.1.36.110 || caturdaśyāṃ naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || tasyābhīṣṭapradānāya jāgarti bhagavācchivaḥ || 111 || upadiśya śivajñānaṃ sāyujyaṃ ca dadātyapi || surāpānāyutaṃ cāpi svarṇasteyāyutaṃ tathā || 112 || naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇādeva caturdaśyāṃ mahālayāt || caṇḍālavṛṣalastrīṇāṃ saṃgadoṣo'pi naśyati || 113 || aśvamedhasahasrasya pauṃḍarīkāyutasya ca || puṣkalā phalasiddhiḥ syāccaturdaśyāṃ mahālayāt || 114 || yo na kuryāccaturdaśyāṃ śrāddhametanmahālayam || sa kalpakoṭisāhasraṃ kalpakoṭiśataṃ tathā || 115 || saṃsārāṃdhamahākūpe patitaḥ syādaniṣkṛtiḥ || acorayitvā kanakamapītvāpi surāṃ tathā || 116 || surāpānādibhirdoṣairlipyate sa vimūḍhadhīḥ || kṛtā api vidhānena yajñāḥ syurniṣphalāstathā || 117 || caturdaśyāṃ tithau yastu kuryācchrāddhaṃ mahālayam || lakṣakoṭisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatānica ||118|| kalpāni pitarastasya tṛpyaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ || narakasthāśca pitaraḥ svargaṃ yāṃti praharṣitāḥ || 119 || saṃtatiṃ cāpyavicchinnāṃ dadyuḥ pitṛgaṇāstadā || amāyāṃ tu naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryānmahālayam || 3.1.36.120 || pitṝṇāṃ tasya tṛptiḥ syāda naṃtā nātra saṃśayaḥ || sudhāmāsvādya yā tṛptirdevānāṃdivi vai bhavet || 121 || anaṃtā tādṛśī tṛptiramāvāsyāṃ mahālayāt || amāvāsyā mahāpuṇyā pitṛdevanamaskṛtā || 122 || śāṃtā hyeṣā tu paramā śivasya ca mahāpriyā || tasyāṃ mahālaye śrāddhe bhojayedvedavittamān || 123 || tena tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ syādanaṃtā tuṣyate śivaḥ || brahmahatyādayaḥ paṃca pātakā nāśamāpnuyuḥ || 124 || kṛtāśca syurvidhānena sarve yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ || anuṣṭhitāḥ syurvidhivatsarve dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ || 125 || amāvāsyādine yena kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ mahālayam || pratyagbrahmaikatāṃ jñātvā sāyujyaṃ yātyasaṃśayam|| || 126 || yo na kuryādamāvāsyāṃ mahālayamacetanaḥ || brahmalokagatāścāsya pitaro yāṃti nārakam || 127 || saṃtatiścāsya mūḍhasya vicchi dyetaiva tatkṣaṇāt || sa eva hi mahānartho yadamāyāṃ tithau naraiḥ || 128 || mahālayārtho vipreṃdrā vidhivannaiva bhojitāḥ || māsi bhādrapade prāpte nṛtyaṃti pitṛdevatāḥ || 129 || asmānuddiśya matputrā bhojayeyurdvijottamān || tena no narakakleśo na bhaviṣyati dāruṇaḥ || 3.1.36.130 || vāsaśca svargaloke syādyāvadācandratārakam || māsi bhādrapade prāpte pitṝṇāṃ tṛdidāyinī || 131 || ekaikaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ pratyahaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || pitṛmātṛkulodbhūtāḥ pitarastṛptimāpnuyuḥ || 132 || kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇānbhojayetsudhīḥ || ghṛtasūpādisasyaiśca tailābhyaṃgapuraḥsaram || 133 || sudhāṃ pāsyaṃti pitarastasyākalpaṃ praharṣitāḥ || saptamīṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya prārabhya pratyahaṃ narāḥ || 134 || viprānyāvadamāvāsyā trīṃstrīnabhyarcya bhojayet || ārabhya dvādaśīṃ viprāṃstrīnavaśyaṃ tu bhojayet || 135 || anyathaiśvaryahāniḥ syānmahādāridryabhāgbhavet || vittalobhaṃ parityajya viprānsūpaghṛtādi bhiḥ || 136 || payasā pāyasānnena dadhnāpūpādibhistathā || peyairlehyaiśca coṣyaiśca bhakṣyaiśca vividhairapi || 137 || bhojayedvedavinmukhyāṃstṛptisteṣāṃ yathā bhavet || tena brahmā hariḥ śaṃbhustṛptāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ||138|| agniṣvāttādipitarastathaiveṃdrādidevatāḥ || bahunātra kimuktena tuṣṭaṃ tena jagattrayam ||139|| pārvaṇena vidhānena kuryācchrāddhe mahālayam|| naro mahālayaśrāddhe pitṛvaṃśyānpitṝniva ||3.1.36.140|| mātṛvaṃśyānapi pitṝnbhojayecchreyase mudā || dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti dadyādvittānusārataḥ || 141 || tasminmahālaye śrāddhe vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || dakṣiṇā khalu yajñānāṃ kathiteyaṃ purogavā || 142|| anaḥ purogavairhīnaṃ kariṣyati yathādhvani || adakṣiṇaṃ tathā soyaṃ pitṛyajño'pi riṣyati||143|| tasmādyajñeṣu dātavyā dakṣiṇālpā hi jānatā|| vidhavābhirapi strībhiraputrābhirmahālayaḥ || 144 || bharttṝnuddiśya kartavyo bhūribhojanakarmaṇā || anyathā dharmahāniḥ syānnarakaṃ ca mahadbhavet || 145 || māsi bhādrapade prāpte yo na kuryānmahālayam || tatkulaṃ nāśamāpnoti brahmahatyāṃ ca viṃdati || 146 || mahālayaṃ prakurvaṃti śraddhāvaṃtaḥ pitṝnprati || na teṣāṃ saṃtaticchedo bhavetsaṃpadabhaṃgurā || 147 || ālayaṃ hyāspadaṃ proktaṃ mahaḥ kalyāṇamucyate || kalyāṇānāmāspadatvānmahālayamudīryate || 148 || tasmānmahālayaṃ martyaḥ kuryātkalyāṇasiddhaye || amaṃgalaṃ bhavettasya na kuryāccenmahālayam || 149 || nakuryādyadyapi śrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani || kuryānmahālayaśrāddhamasmaranneva buddhimān ||3.1.36.150|| kartuṃ mahālayaśrāddhaṃ yadi śaktirna vidyate || yācitvāpi naraḥ kuryātpitṛṇāṃ tanmahālayam ||151|| brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣṭe bhyo yāceta dhanadhānyakam || patitebhyo na gṛhṇīyāddhanadhānyaṃ kadācana ||152|| brāhmaṇebhyo na labhyeta yadi dhānyadhanādikam || yāceta kṣatriyaśreṣṭhā nmahālayacikīrṣayā || 153 || dātāraścenna bhūpālā vaiśyebhyo'pi ca yācayet || vaiśyā api hi dātāro yadi loke na saṃti vai || 154 || dadyādbhādrapade māse gogrāsaṃ pitṛtṛptaye || atha vā rodanaṃ kuryādbahirnirgatya kānane || 155 || pāṇibhyāmudaraṃ svīyamāhatyāśrūṇi vartayan || teṣvaraṇyapradeśeṣu uccairevaṃ vadennaraḥ || 156 || śṛṇvaṃtu pitaraḥ sarve matkulīnā vaco mama || ahaṃ daridraḥ kṛpaṇo nirllajjaḥ krūrakarmakṛt || 157 || prāpto bhādrapado māsaḥ pitṛṇāṃ prītivarddhanaḥ || karttuṃ mahālayaśrāddhaṃ na ca me śaktirasti vai || 158 || bhramitvāpi mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ na me kiṃcana labhyate || ato mahālayaśrāddhaṃ na yuṣmākaṃ karomyaham || 159 || kṣamadhvaṃ mama tadyūyaṃ bhavaṃto hi dayāparāḥ || daridro rodanaṃ kuryādevaṃ kānanabhūmiṣu || 3.1.36.160 || tasya rodanamākarṇya pitarastatkulodbhavāḥ || hṛṣṭāstṛptiṃ prayāṃtyeva sudhāṃ pītvaiva nirjarāḥ || 161 || mahālayārthe vipraughe bhukte tṛptiryathā bhavet || gogrāsāraṇyaruditaiḥ pitṛ tṛptistathā bhavet|| 162 || māsi bhādrapade vighno yadi syātsūtakādinā || yāteṣu sūtakāhaḥsu kuryādāvṛścikāvadhi || 163 || budho mahālaya syārthe brāhmaṇānvṛṇuyānnava || pitrarthamekaṃ vṛṇuyātpitāmahakṛte tathā || 164 || prapitāmahamuddiśya tathaikaṃ vṛṇuyāddvijaḥ || tathā mātāmahārthaṃ tu ekaṃ vai vṛṇuyāddvijam || 165 || mātuḥpitāmahārthaṃ ca vṛṇuyāddvijamekakam || vṛṇuyādekamuddiśya mātuśca prapitāmaham || 166 || tathaiva viśvedevārthe vṛṇuyāddvaudvi jottamau || viṣṇvarthaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tvekaṃ vṛṇuyādvedavittamam ||167|| evaṃ mahālayaśrāddhe brāhmaṇānvṛṇuyānnava || athavā pitṛvargārthaṃ varayedvipramekakam || 168 || mātāmahādīnvoddiśya varayedvipramekakam || viśvedevārthamekaṃ ca viṣṇvarthaṃ ca tathāparam || 169 || evaṃ vai varayedviprāścaturastu mahālaye || brāhmaṇānvedasaṃpannānsuśīlānvarayetsudhīḥ || 3.1.36.170 || duḥśīlānvarayedyastu sa vai śrāddhasya ghātakaḥ || māsi bhādrapade prāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 171 || kuryā nmahālayaśrāddhaṃ yo naraḥ śraddhayā saha || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu durācāra mahāmate || 172 || agniṣṭomādayo yajñāḥ śatamapyamunā kṛtāḥ || tulāpuruṣamukhyāni dānānyapi kṛtāni vai || 173 || cāṃdrāyaṇādikṛcchrāṇi kṛtānyeva na saṃśayaḥ || caturṇāṃ sāṃgavedānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || || 174 || gāyatryādimahāmaṃtrajapapuṇyaṃ labhettathā || itihāsapurāṇānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || 175 || mahālayasamaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛttaṃ nāsti mahītale || brahmaviṣṇumaheśānalokaprāptirmahālayāt || 176 || mahālayādikaṃ śrāddhaṃ nityaṃ kāmyamapīṣyate || tasmādakaraṇe tasya pratyavāyo mahānbhavet || 177 || karaṇādiṣṭasiddhiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || mahālayasya karaṇādbhūtavetālakādayaḥ || 178 || apasmāragrahāścāpi śākinīḍākinīgaṇāḥ || yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca vetālāśca bhayānakāḥ || 179 || naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇādeva bhūtānyanyāni vai tathā || mahālayasyakaraṇādvipulāṃ śriyamaśnute || 3.1.36.180 || purā daśaratho rājā vasiṣṭhasyopadeśataḥ || māsi bhādrapade prāpte kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ mahālayam || 181 || rāmādīṃśca turaḥ putrānprāptavāṃllokasaṃmatān || viśvātiśāyinīṃ lakṣmīṃ prapede kīrtimuttamām || 182 || mahālayasya karaṇādyayātī rājasattamaḥ || yadumukhyānmahāputrānprapede vaṃśavarddhanān || 183 || ananyadurlabhaṃ svargaṃ prapede śrāddhapuṇyataḥ || duṣyaṃto bharataṃ lebhe mahālayavidhānataḥ || 184 || mahālaya vidhānena damayaṃtīpatirnalaḥ || kṛcchraṃ mahattaraṃ tīrtvā punarlebhe mahīmimām || 185 || nijagrāha kaliṃ ghoraṃ puṣkaraṃ cāpyarātinam || indrasenābhidhānaṃ ca putraṃ lebhe'tidhārmikam || 186 || hariścaṃdro mahārājo mahālayavidhānataḥ || viśvāmitrakṛtādduḥkhānmuktaḥ satyavatāṃ varaḥ || 187 || lebhe caṃdravatīṃ bhāryāṃ lohitāśvaṃ sutaṃ punaḥ || mahālayavidhānena kṛtavīryasuto balī || 188 || aṣṭādaśānāṃ dvīpānāmādhipatyamavāptavān || rāmo'pi daṇḍakāraṇye mahālayavidhānataḥ || 189 || hatvā tu rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye sītāṃ punaravāptavān || mahālayasya karaṇāddharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 3.1.36.190 || duḥkhasāgaramuttīrya dhārtarāṣṭrāñjaghāna ca || mahālayasyakaraṇādvasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ || 191 || atrirbhṛguśca kutsaśca gautamaścāṃgirāstathā || kaśyapaśca bharadvājo viśvā mitraśca kumbhajaḥ || 192 || parāśaro mṛkaṇḍaśca ye cānye munisattamāḥ || vidhāya vidhivacchrāddhaṃ mahālayamanuttamam || 193 || aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā || nivāsabhūtā saṃjātāstathā viśvātiśāyinaḥ || 194 || jīvanmuktāśca te sarve hyabhavanmunisattamāḥ || ato mahālayaśrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 195 || ato'dyāpi durācāra na kuryādyo mahālayam || bhūtavetālakādibhyo bhūyāttasya mahadbhayam || 196 || mahālayasyā karaṇādvetālatvamavāpnuyāt || tvayāviṣṭamidaṃ bhūtaṃ vipraḥ sanpūrvajanmani || 197 || nāmnā vedanidhiḥ puṇyo bharadvājasya cātmanaḥ || kuśasthalyabhidhāne ca vasangrāme mahāmanāḥ || 198 || na cakāra vidhānena śrāddhametanmahālayam || tatoyaṃ pitṛṇāṃ śāpādvetālatvamavāptavān || 199 || tasmādbhādra pade māse durācāra pitṝnprati || brāhmaṇānbhojayānnena ṣaḍrasena sabhaktikam || 3.1.36.200 || dāridryaṃ tena te na syātsukhīcaiva bhavānbhavet || mahāpātaki saṃsargaṃ mā kuru tvamitaḥ param || 201 || tvayānubhūtaṃ yadduḥkhaṃ vetālagrahaṇodbhavam || gaccha tvamanujānāmi svadeśaṃ prati mā ciram || 202 || itīritaḥ sa muninā dattātreyeṇa yoginā || taṃ praṇamya yayau deśaṃ kṛtārthenāṃtarātmanā || 203 || gatvā ca svagṛhaṃ vipro durācāro dvijottamāḥ || vimuktavetāla bhayo gatapātakakaṃcukaḥ || 204 || dattātreyeritenāsau mārgeṇa prītamānasaḥ || tyaktapātakisaṃsargaḥ svāśramācāratatparaḥ || 205 || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭitīrtha majjanagauravāt || dehāṃte paramāṃ muktiṃ durācāro yayau tadā || 206 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ durācaravimokṣaṇam || seyaṃ puṇyā dhanuṣkoṭirmahāpātakanāśinī || 207 || yatra hi snānamātreṇa durācāro vimocitaḥ || athavā dhanuṣaḥ koṭeriyattā kiṃ hi vai bhavet || 208 || yā niṣkṛtivihīnāni pāpānyapi vināśayet || prāyaścittavihīnāni yāni pāpāni saṃti vai || 209 || tānyapyatra vinaśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || śūdreṇa pūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā yo nameddvijaḥ || 3.1.36.210 || prāyaścittaṃ na tasyoktaṃ smṛtibhiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ || naśyettasyāpi tatpāpaṃ dhanuṣkoṭinimajja nāt || 211 || vipraniṃdākṛtāṃ nṛṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || viśvāsaghātakānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ na niṣkṛtiḥ || 212 || bhrātṛbhāryāratānāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || śūdrānne niyatānāṃ ca śrutiniṃdāratātmanām || 213 || kanyāvikrayiṇāṃ viprā hayavikrayiṇāṃ tathā || devavikrayiṇāṃ vedavikraye nira tātmanām||214|| dharmavikayiṇāṃ puṃsāṃ vratavikrayiṇāṃ tathā || tīrthavikrayiṇāṃ puṃsāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ||215|| teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nima jjanāt || mātṛdrohapitṛdrohayatidroharatātmanām ||216|| guruniṃdāparāṇāṃ ca śivaniṃdāratātmanām || viṣṇuniṃdāparāṇāṃ ca yatiniṃdāratātmanām || || 217 || satkathādūṣakāṇāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || teṣāṃ cātra dhanuṣkoṭau snānācchuddhirbhaviṣyati || 218 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā dhanuṣkoṭestu vaibhavam || yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi || 219 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setu māhātmye dhanuṣkoṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ durācārasaṃsargadoṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || || cha ||
<3.1.37>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobhostapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || yāvadrāmadhanuṣkoṭicakratīrthamukhāni vaḥ || 1 || caturviṃśatitīrthāni kathitāni mayādhunā || ito'nyadadbhutaṃ yūyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha || 2 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || kṣīrakuṃḍasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmahe mune || yatsamīpe tvayā cakratīrthamityuditaṃ purā || 3 || kṣīrakuṃḍaṃ ca tatkutra kīdṛśaṃ tasya vaibhavam || kṣīrakuṇḍamiti khyātiḥ kathaṃ vāsya samāgatā || 4 || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ vistarādvaktumarhasi || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bravīmi munayaḥ sarve śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 5 || devīpurānmahāpuṇyātpratīcyāṃ diśyadūrataḥ || phullagrāmamiti khyātaṃ sthānamasti mahattaram || 6 || yata ārabhya rāmeṇa setubandho mahārṇave || taddhi puṇyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ phullagrāmābhidhaṃ puram || 7 || kṣīrakuṇḍaṃ tu tatraiva mahāpātakanāśanam || darśanātsparśanāddhyānātkīrtanāccāpi mokṣadam || 8 || tasya tīrthasya puṇyasya kṣīrakuṇḍamiti prathām || bhavatāṃ sādaraṃ vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ śraddhayā saha || 9 || purā hi mudgalonāma munirvedoktamārgakṛt || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhestīre phullagrāmetipāvane || 3.1.37.10 || nārāyaṇaprītikarama karodyajñamuttamam || tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā yāgena paritoṣitaḥ || 11 || prādurbabhūva purato yajñavāṭe dvijottamāḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mudgalo viṣṇuṃ lakṣmīśobhitavigraham || 12 || kālameghatanuṃ kāṃtyā pītāṃbaravirājitam || vinatānaṃdanārūḍhaṃ kaustubhālaṃkṛtorasam || 13 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmarājadbāhucatu ṣṭayam || bhaktyā paravaśo dṛṣṭvā pulakāṃkuramaṃḍitaḥ || mudgalaḥ parituṣṭāva śabdaiḥ śrotrasukhāvahaiḥ || 14 || || mudgala uvāca || || prathamaṃ jagataḥ sraṣṭre pālakāya tataḥ param || 15 || saṃhartre ca tataḥ paścānnamo nārāyaṇāya te || namaḥ śaphararūpāya kamaṭhāya cidātmane || 16 || namo varāhavapuṣe namaḥ paṃcāsyarūpiṇe || vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ jamadagnisutāya te || 17 || rāghavāya namastubhyaṃ balabhadrāya te namaḥ || kṛṣṇāya kalkaye tubhyaṃ namo vijñānarūpiṇe || 18 || rakṣa māṃ karuṇāsiṃdho nārāyaṇa jagatpate || nirlajjaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ krūraṃ piśunaṃ dāṃbhikaṃ kṛśam || 19 || paradāraparadravyaparakṣetraikalo lupam || asūyāviṣṭamanasaṃ māṃ rakṣa kṛpayā hare || 3.1.37.20 || iti stuto hariḥ sākṣānmudgalena dvijottamāḥ || tamāha mudgalamuniṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 21 || śrīhariruvāca || || prīto'smyanena stotreṇa mudgala kratunā ca te || pratyakṣeṇa havirbhoktumahaṃ te kratumāgataḥ || 22 || ityukto hariṇā tatra mudgalastuṣṭamānasaḥ || uvācādhokṣajaṃ vipro bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 23 || || mudgala uvāca || || kṛtārtho'smi hṛṣīkeśa patnī me dhanyatāṃ yayau || adya me saphalaṃ janma hyadya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || 24 || adaya me saphalo vaṃśo hyadya me saphalāḥ sutāḥ || āśramaḥ saphalo'dyaiva sarvaṃ saphalamadya me || 25 || yadbhavānyajñavāṭaṃ me havirbhoktumihāgataḥ || yogino yoganiratā hṛdaye mṛgayaṃti yam || 26 || tamadya sākṣāttvāṃ paśye sapha lo'yaṃ mama kratuḥ || itīrayitvā taṃ viṣṇumarcayitvā''sanādibhiḥ ||27|| caṃdanaiḥ kusumairanyairdattvā cārghyaṃ sa viṣṇave || pradadau viṣṇave prītyā puro ḍāśādikaṃ haviḥ || 28 || svayameva samādāya pāṇinā lokabhāvanaḥ || havistadbubhuje viṣṇurmudgalena samarpitam || 29 || tasminhaviṣi bhukte tu viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || sāgnayastridaśāḥ sarve tṛptāḥ samabhavandvijāḥ ||3.1.37.30|| ṛtvijo yajamānaśca tatratyā brāhmaṇāstathā || yatkiṃcitprāṇiloke' smiṃścaraṃ vā yadi vā'caram ||31|| sarvameva jagattṛptaṃ bhukte haviṣi viṣṇunā || tato hariḥ prasannātmā mudgalaṃ pratyabhāṣata ||32|| prīto'haṃ varado'smyeṣa varaṃ varaya suvrata || ityukte keśavenātha maharṣistamabhāṣata || 33 || || mudgala uvāca || || yattvayā me havirbhuktaṃ yāge pratyakṣarūpiṇā || anenaiva kṛtārtho'smi kimasmādadhikaṃ varam || 34 || tathāpi bhagavanviṣṇo tvayi me niścalā sadā || bhaktirniṣkapaṭā bhūyādidaṃ me prathamaṃ varam || 35 || mādhavāhaṃ pratidinaṃ sāyaṃprātarihāgnaye || tvadrūpāya tava prītyai surabheḥ payasā hare || 36 || hotumicchāmi varada tanme dehi varāṃtaram || payasā nityahomo hi dvikālaṃ śruticoditaḥ || 37 || na me surabhayaḥ saṃti tāpasasyādhanasya ca || ityukte mudgalenātha devo nārāyaṇo hariḥ || 38 || āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāramamṛtāśinam || ekaṃ saraḥ kārayitvā śilpinā tena śobhanam || 39 || sphaṭikādi śilābhedaistenāsau viśvakarmaṇā || samīcakāra ca punastatprākārādyalaṃkṛtam || tata āhūya bhagavānsurabhiṃ vākyamabravīt || 3.1.37.40|| || śrīhariruvāca || mudgalo mama bhakto'yaṃ surabhe pratyahaṃ mudā || 41 || matprītyarthaṃ payohomaṃ kartumicchati sāṃpratam || matprītyarthamito devi tvamato matpracoditā || || 42 || sāyaṃprātarihāgatya pratyahaṃ surabhe śubhe || payasā tvatprasūtena sara etatprapūraya || 43 || tenāsau payasā nityaṃ sāyaṃprātaśca hoṣyati || omityuktvātha surabhirevaṃ nārayaṇeritā || 44 || atha nārāyaṇo devo mudgalaṃ pratyabhāṣata || surabheḥ payasā nityamasminsarasi tiṣṭhatā || || 45 || sāyaṃprātaḥ pratidinaṃ matprītyarthamihāgnaye || juhudhi tvaṃ mahābhāga tena prīṇāmyahaṃ tava || 46 || matprītyā te'khilā siddhirbhaviṣyati ca mudgala || idaṃ kṣīrasaronāma tīrthaṃ khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || 47 || asminkṣīrasarastīrthe snātānāṃ paṃcapātakam || anyānyapi ca pāpāni nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 48 || mudgala tvaṃ ca māṃ yāhi dehāṃte muktabaṃdhanaḥ || ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇustaṃ samāliṃgya mudgalam || 49 || namaskṛtaśca tenāyaṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || mudgalo'pi gate viṣṇāvanekaśatavatsaram || 3.1.37.50 || surabheḥ payasā juhvannagnaye harituṣṭaye || uvāsa prayato nityaṃ phulla grāme vimuktide || dehāṃte muktimagamadviṣṇusāyujyarūpiṇīm || 51 || || śrīsūta uvāca || evametaddvijavarā yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || 52 || yathā kṣīrasaro nāma tīrthasyāsya purā'bhavat || idaṃ kṣīrasaraḥ puṇyaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || 53 || kāśyapasya muneḥ patnī kadrūryatra dvijottamāḥ || snātvā svabhartṛvākyena noditā niyamānvitā || 54 || chalena mumuce sadyaḥ sapatnījayadoṣataḥ || ato'tra tīrthe ye snāṃti mānavāḥ śudamānasāḥ || 55 || teṣāṃ vimuktabaṃdhānāṃ muktānāṃ puṇyakarmiṇām || kiṃ yāgaiḥ kimu vā vedaiḥ kiṃ vā tīrthaniṣevaṇaiḥ || 56 || japairvā niyamairvāpi kṣīra kuṃḍavilokinām || kṣīrakuṃḍasya vātena spṛṣṭadeho naro dvijāḥ || 57 || brahmalokamanuprāpya tatraiva parimucyate || nimagnāḥ kṣīrakuṃḍe'sminnavamatyāpi bhāskarim ||58|| tasya mūrddhani tiṣṭheyurjvalataḥ pāvakopamāḥ || magnānāṃ kṣīrakuṃḍesmiñchītā vaitaraṇī nadī| ||59|| sarvāṇi narakāṇyaddhā vyarthāni ca bhavaṃti hi || kāmadhenusame tasminkṣīrakuṃḍe sthitepyaho || 3.1.37.60 || yonyatra bhramate snātuṃ sa naro viprasattamāḥ || gokṣīre vidyamāne'pi hyarkakṣīrāya gacchati || 61 || snātānāṃ kṣīrakuṃḍe'sminnālabhyaṃ kiṃcidasti hi || karaprāptaiva muktiḥ syātkimanyairbahubhāṣaṇaiḥ || 62 || bravīmi bhujamuddhatya satyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || sa kṣīrakuṃḍasnānasya labhate phalamuttamam || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye kṣīrakuṃḍapraśaṃsāyāṃ kṣīrakuṃḍasvarūpakathanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || || || ||
<3.1.38>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sūta kadruḥ kathaṃ muktā kṣīrakuṃḍanimajjanāt || chalaṃ kathaṃ kṛtavatī sapatnyāṃ pāpaniścayā || 1 || kasya putrī ca sā kadrūḥ sapatnīsā ca kasya vai || kimarthamajayatkadrūḥ svasapatnīṃ chalena tu || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ brūhi sūta kṛpānidhe || 2 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve itihāsaṃ mahāphalam || purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ prajāpatisute ubhe || 3 || kadrūśca vinatā ceti bhaginyau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || bhārye te kaśyapasyāstāṃ kadrūśca vinatā tathā || 4 || vinatā suṣuve putrāvaruṇaṃ garuḍaṃ tathā || bharttuḥ sakāśātkadrūśca lebhe sarpānbahūnsutān || || 5 || anaṃtavāsukimukhānviṣadarpasamanvitān || ekadā tu bhaginyau te kadrūśca vinatā tathā || 6 || apaśyatāṃ samāyāṃtamuccaiḥśravasamaṃ tikāt || vilokya kadrūsturagaṃ vinatāmidamabravīt || 7 || śveto'śvavālo nīlo vā vinate brūhi tattvataḥ|| ityuktvā vinatā viprāḥ kadrūṃ tāmidamabravīt || turaṃgaḥ śvetavālo me pratibhāti sumadhyame || kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase kadrūriti tāṃ vinatā'bravīt || 9 || pṛṣṭvaivaṃ vinatāṃ kadrūrbabhāṣe svamataṃ ca sā || kṛṣṇavālamahaṃ manye hayamenamaniṃdite || 3.1.38.10 || tataḥ parājaye kṛtvā dāsībhāvaṃ paṇaṃ mithaḥ || vyatiṣṭhetāṃ mahābhāge sapatnyau te dvijottamāḥ || || 11 || tataḥ kadrūrnijasutānvāsukipramukhānahīn || tasyā nāhaṃ yathā dāsī tathā kuruta putrakāḥ || 12 || tasyābhīpsitasiddhyarthamityavocadbhṛśā turā || yuṣmābhiruccaiḥśravaso bālaḥ pracchādyatāmiti || 13 || nāṃgīcakrurmataṃ tasyā nāgāḥ kadrū ruṣā tadā|| aśapatkupitā putrāñjvalaṃtī roṣamūrcchi tā || 14 || pārīkṣitasya sarve'ddhā yūyaṃ satre mariṣyatha || iti śāpe kṛte mātrā trastaḥ karkoṭakastadā || 15 || praṇamya pādayoḥ kadrūṃ dīno vacanama bravīt || ahamuccaiḥśravovālaṃ vidhāsyāmyaṃjanaprabham || 16 || mā bhīraṃba tvayā kāryetyavādīcchāpaviklavaḥ || śvetamuccaiḥśravovālaṃ tataḥ karkoṭako ragaḥ || 17 || chādayitvā svabhogena vyatanodaṃjanadyutim || atha te vinatākadrvau dāsye kṛtapaṇe ubhe || 18 || devarājahayaṃ draṣṭuṃ saṃraṃbhādabhyagaccha tām || śaśāṃkaśaṃkhamāṇikyamuktairāvatakāraṇam || 19 || yugāṃtakālaśayanaṃ yoganidrākṛto hareḥ || atītya kadrūvinate samudraṃ saritāṃ patim || 3.1.38.20 || dadṛśaturhayaṃ gatvā devarājasya vāhanam || kṛṣṇavālaṃ hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā duḥkhitā'bhavat || 21 || duḥkhitāṃ vinatāṃ kadrūrdāsīkṛtye nyayuṃkta sā || etasminnaṃtare tārkṣyo'pyaṃḍamudbhidya vahnivat || 22 || prādurbabhūva vipreṃdrā girimātraśarīravān || dṛṣṭvā taddehamāhātmyamabhūttrastaṃ jagattrayam ||23|| tatastaṃ tuṣṭuvurdevā garuḍaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ varam || dṛṣṭvā taddehamāhātmyaṃ trastaṃ syādbhuvanatrayam || 24 || ityālocyopasaṃhṛtya dehamatyaṃtabhīṣaṇam || aruṇaṃ pṛṣṭhamāropya māturaṃtikamabhyagāt || 25 || athāha vinatāṃ kadrūḥ praṇatāmativihvalām || ceṭi nāgālayaṃ gaṃtumudyogo mama vartate || 26 || tvatputro garuḍoto māṃ matputrāṃśca vahatviti || tataśca vinatā putraṃ garuḍaṃ pratyabhāṣata || 27 || ahaṃ kadrūmimāṃ vakṣye tvaṃ sarpānvaha tatsutān || tatheti garuḍo mātuḥ pratyagṛhṇadvaco dvijāḥ || 28 || avahadvinatā kadrūṃ sarvāṃstāngaruḍo'vahat || ravisāmīpyagāḥ sarpāstatkarairāhatāstadā || 29 || astauṣīdvajriṇaṃ kadrūḥ sutānāṃ tāpaśāṃtaye || sarvatāpaṃ jalāsārairdevarājo'pyaśāmayata || 3.1.38.30 || nīyamānāstadā sarpā garuḍena balīyasā || gatvā taṃ deśamacirādavadanvinatāsutam || 31 || vayaṃ dvīpāṃtaraṃ gaṃtuṃ sarve draṣṭuṃ kṛtatvarāḥ || vaha tvamasmāngaruḍa ceṭīsuta tataḥ kṣaṇāt || 32 || tato mātara maprākṣīdvinatāṃ garuḍo dvijāḥ || ahaṃ kasmādvahāmīmāṃstvaṃ cemāṃ vahase sadā || 33 || ceṭīputreti māmete ki bhaṇaṃti sarīsṛpāḥ || sarvametadvada tvaṃ me mātastattvena pṛcchataḥ || 34 || pṛṣṭaivaṃ jananī tena garuḍaṃ prābravītsutam || bhaginyā krūrayā putra cchalenāhaṃ parājitā || 35 || tasyā dāsī bhavāmyadya ceṭīputrastato bhavān || atastvaṃ vahase sarpānvahāmyenāmahaṃ sadā || 36 || ityādi sarvavṛttāṃtamādito'smai nyavedayat || atha tāṃ garuḍo'vā dīnmātaraṃ vinatāsutaḥ || 37 || asmāddāsyādvimokṣārthaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ te mayādhunā || iti pṛṣṭā sutenātha vinatā tamabhāṣata || 38 || sarpānpṛcchasva garuḍa mama mātṛvimokṣaṇe || yuṣmākaṃ mātuḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ mayeti vadatādhunā || 39 || iti mātrā samudito garuḍaḥ pannagānprati || gatvā'pṛcchadvija śreṣṭhāste'pyenamavadaṃstadā || 3.1.38.40 || yadā hariṣyase śīghraṃ sudhāṃ tvamamarālayāt || dāsyānmuktā bhavenmātā vainateya tavādya hi || 41 || tato mātaramāgamya garuḍaḥ praṇato'bravīt || sudhāmaṃba mamānetuṃ gacchato bhakṣyamarpaya || 42 || itīritā sutaṃ prāha mātā taṃ vinatā sutam || samudramadhye vartaṃte śabarāḥ katicitsuta || 43 || tānbhakṣayitvā śabarānamṛtaṃ tvamihānaya || tatra kaściddvijaḥ kāmī śavarīsaṃgakautukī || 44 || tyaja taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kaṃṭhaṃ dahaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā || pakṣādīni tavāṃgāni pāṃtu devā marunmukhāḥ || 45 || iti svamāturāśīrbhirgaruḍo vardhito yayau || śabarālayamabhyetya tasya bhakṣaya to mukham || 46 || āvṛtaṃ prāviśanvyādhā vayāṃsīva darīṃ gireḥ || atha sa brāhmaṇo'pyāgāttatkaṃṭhaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 47 || kaṇṭhaṃ dahantaṃ vipraṃ tamuvāca vinatāsutaḥ || vipra pāpo'pyavadhyo hi niryāhi tvamato bahiḥ || 48 || evamuktastadā vipro garuḍaṃ pratyabhāṣata || kirātī mama bhāryāpi nirgaṃtavyā mayā saha || 49 || evamastviti taṃ vipramuvāca patageśvaraḥ || tataḥ sa garuḍo vipramujjagāra sabhāryakam || 3.1.38.50 || vipro'pyabhīpsitāndeśānniṣādyā saha niryayau || śabarānbhakṣayitvā'tha garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ varaḥ || 51 || ātmanaḥ pitaraṃ vegātkaśyapaṃ samupeyivān || kutra yāsīti tatpṛṣṭo garuḍastama bhāṣata || 52 || māturdāsyavimokṣāya sudhāmāhartumāgamam || bahūnkirātāñjagdhvāpi tṛptirmama na jāyate || 53 || aparyaṃtakṣudhā brahmanbādhate māmaha rniśam || tannivṛttipradaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mamārpaya tapodhana || 54 || yenāhaṃ śaknuyāṃ tāta sudhāmāhartumojasā || itīritaḥ sutaṃ prāha kaśyapo vinatodbhavam || || 55 || ||kaśyapa uvāca || || munirvibhāvasurnāmnā purāsīttasya sānujaḥ || supratīka iti bhrātā tāvubhau vaṃśavairiṇau || 56 || anyonyaṃ śepaturviprā mahākrodhasamākulau || gajo'bhavatsupratīkaḥ kūrmo'bhūcca vibhāvasuḥ || 57 || evaṃ vittavivādāttau śepaturbhrātarau mithaḥ || gajaḥ ṣaḍyo janocchrāyo dviguṇāyāmasaṃyutaḥ || 58 || kūrmastriyojanocchrayo daśayojanavistṛtaḥ || baddhavairāvubhāvetau sarasyasminvihaṃgama || 59 || pūrvavairamanusmṛtya yudhyete jetumicchayā || ubhau tau bhakṣayitvā tvaṃ sudhāmāhara tṛptimān || 3.1.38.60 || evaṃ pitreritaḥ pakṣī gatvā tadgajakacchapau || samuddhatya mahākāyau mahābalaparākramau || 61 || vahannakhābhyāṃ saṃtīrthaṃ vilaṃbābhidhamabhyagāt || tatrāgataṃ samālokya pakṣirājaṃ dvijosamāḥ || 62 || tattīrajo mahāvṛkṣo rohiṇākhyo mahocchrayaḥ || vainateyamidaṃ prāha mahābalaparākramam || 63 || enāmāruha macchākhāṃ śatayojanamāyatām || sthitvātra gajakūrmau tvaṃ bhakṣayasva khagottama ||64 || ityuktastaruṇā pakṣī sa tatrāste manojavaḥ || tadbhārātsā taroḥ śākhā bhagnā'bhūddvijasattamāḥ || 65 || vālakhilyamunīṃstasmillam̐bamānānadhomukhān || dṛṣṭvā tatpātaśaṃkāvām̐stāṃ śākhāṃ garuḍo'grahīt || 66 || gajakūrmo ca tāṃ śākhāṃ gṛhītvā yāṃtamaṃ bare || pitā tasyābravīttatra garuḍaṃ vinatāsutam || 67 || tyajemāṃ nirjane śaile śākhāṃ taṃ vinatodbhava || ityuktaḥ sa tathā gatvā śākhāṃ niṣpuruṣe nage || 68 || vinyasyābhakṣayatpakṣī tau tadā gajakacchapau || athotpātaḥ samabhavattasminnavasare divi || 69 || dṛṣṭvotpātaṃ balārātiḥ papraccha svapurohitam || utpātakāraṇaṃ jīva kimatreti punaḥpunaḥ || bṛhaspatistadā śakraṃ provāca dvijasattamāḥ || 3.1.38.70 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || kāśyapo hi muniḥ pūrvamayajatkratunā hare ||71|| sarvānnṛṣīnsurānsiddhānyakṣāngaṃdharvakinnarān || yajñasaṃbhārasiddhyarthaṃ preṣayāmāsa sa dvijāḥ|| 72 || vālakhilyānsasaṃbhārānhrasvānaṃguṣṭhamātrakān || majjato goṣpadajale dṛṣṭvā hasitavānbhavān || 73 || bhavatāvamatāḥ kruddhā vālakhilyāstadā hare || juhuvuryajñavahnau te krodhena jvalitānanāḥ || 74 || deveṃdrabhayadaḥ śatruḥ kaśyapasya suto'stviti || tasya putro'dya garuḍaḥ sudhāharaṇakautukī || 75 || samāgacchati taddheturayamutpāta āgataḥ || ityuktaḥ so'bravīdiṃdro devānagnipurogamān || 76 || sudhāmāhartumāyāti pakṣī sā rakṣyatāmiti || itīṃdrapreritā devā rarakṣuḥ sāyudhāḥ sudhām || 77 || pakṣirājastadābhyāgāddevānāyudhadhāriṇaḥ || mahābalaṃ te garuḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā'kampaṃta vai surāḥ || 78 || garuḍasya surāṇāṃ ca tato yuddhamabhūnmahat || akhaṃḍi pakṣituṇḍena bhauvano'mṛtapālakaḥ || 79 || tadā nijaghnugarruḍaṃ devāḥ śastrairanekaśaḥ || atīva garuḍo devairbādhitaḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ || 3.1.38.80 || pakṣābhyāmākṣipaddūre devānagnipurogamān || tatpakṣavikṣitā devāstadā paramakopanāḥ || 81 || nārācānbhiṃdi pālāṃśca nānāśastrāṇi cākṣipan || tatastu garuḍo vegāddevadṛṣṭivilopinīm || 82 || dhūlimutthāpayāmāsa pakṣābhyāṃ vinatāsutaḥ || vāyunā śamayāmāsustānpāṃsūṃstridaśottamāḥ || 83 || rudrānvasūṃstathādityānmaruto'nyānsurāṃstathā || garuḍaḥ pakṣatuṃḍābhyāṃ vyathitānakaroddvijāḥ || 84 || palāyiteṣu deveṣu so'drākṣījjvalanaṃ puraḥ || jvalaṃtaṃ paritastvagniṃ śamāpayitumudyayau|| 85 || sa sahasramukho bhūtvā taiḥ pibañchataśo nadīḥ || tamagniṃ nāśayāmāsa taiḥ payobhistvarānvitaḥ || 86 || sitadhāraṃ bhramaccakraṃ sudhārakṣakamaṃtike || dṛṣṭvā tadariraṃdhreṇa saṃkṣiptāṃgotarāviśat || 87 || tato dadarśa dvau sarpo vyaktāsyau bhīṣaṇākṛtī.|| yābhyāṃ dṛṣṭopi bhasma syāttau sarpau garuḍastadā || 88 || ācchidya pakṣatuṃḍābhyāṃ gṛhītvā'mṛtamudyayau || yaṃtramutpāṭya codyaṃtaṃ garuḍaṃ prāha mādhavaḥ || 89 || tava tuṣṭo'smi pakṣīśa varaṃ varaya suvrata || atha pakṣī tamāha sma kamalānāyakaṃ harim || || 3.1.38.90 || tavopari sthitirme syānmā bhūtāṃ ca jarāmṛtī || tathāstviti hariḥ prāha varaṃ madvriyatāmiti || 91 || ityuktastaṃ hariḥ prāha mama tvaṃ vāhanaṃ bhava || syaṃdanopari ketuśca mama tvaṃ vinatāsuta || 92 || tathāstviti khagopyāha kamalāpatimacyutam || hṛtāmṛtaṃ khagaṃ śrutvā tata ākhaṃḍalo javāt || 93 || abhidrutyāśu kuliśaṃ pakṣe cikṣepa pakṣiṇaḥ || tato vihasya garuḍaḥ pākaśāsanamabravīt || 94 || kuliśasya nipātānme na hare kāpi vedanā || saphalo vajrapātaste bhūyācca suranāyaka || 95 || itīrayanpatramekaṃ vyasṛjatpakṣatastadā || śobhanaṃ parṇamasyeti suparṇa iti sobha vat || 96 || tasminsuparṇe hemābhe sarve vismayamāyayuḥ || tatastu garuḍaḥ śakramabravīddvijapuṃgavāḥ || 97 || bhavatā sākamakhilaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || deveṃdra satataṃ voḍhumamoghā śaktirasti me || 98 || nākhaṇḍalasahasraṃ me raṇe labhyaṃ hare bhavet || iti bruvāṇaṃ garuḍamabravītpākaśāsanaḥ ||99|| kiṃ te'mṛtena kāryaṃ syāddīyatāmamṛtaṃ mama || imāṃ sudhāṃ bhavāndadyādyebhyo hi vinatodbhava || 3.1.38.100 || te'dhunā'mṛtapānena jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ || asmadbhyo'dhikavīryāḥ syurbādheraṃstridaśāṃstathā || 1 || iti bruvaṃtaṃ devendraṃ garuḍo'pyabravīddvijāḥ || yatraitatsthāpayiṣyāmi tatrāgatya bhavānidam || || 2 || gṛhṇātu jhaṭitītyukto garuḍaṃ prāha vṛtrahā || prīto'haṃ tava dāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu mahāmate || 3 || ityuktavantaṃ garuḍaḥ pākaśāsanamabravīt || dāsye chalaprayoktāro mama mātuḥ sarīsṛpāḥ || 4 || bhakṣyā bhavaṃtu nityaṃ me pākaśāsana vṛtrahan || iti teneritaḥ śakastathāstvityavadacca tam || 5 || athāyaṃ garuḍo viprā dhārayannamṛtaṃ yayau || yāṃtaṃ tamanuyāti sma garuḍaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ || 6 || vegena sa dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sudhāharaṇakautukī || māturabhyāśamāgatya sarpānprāha sa pakṣirāṭ || 7 || kuśeṣu nyasyate sarpāssudhaivamadhunā mayā || snātvā tadbhuṅdhvamamṛtaṃ śucayaḥ susamāhitāḥ || 8 || mokṣo'pi mama mātuḥ syāddāsībhāvāddhi pannagāḥ || tathāstvityavadansarpā garuḍaṃ vinatāsutam ||9|| muktā tadaiva vinatā dāsībhāvāddvijottamāḥ || sarpāste'mṛtabhakṣārthaṃ snātuṃ sarve yayustadā ||3.1.38.110|| tasminnavasare śakrastāmādāya sudhāṃ yayau || snātvāgatya bhujaṃgāste tatrādṛṣṭvā tadā sudhām || 11 || jihvābhirlilihurda rbhāneṣu nyastā sudheti hi || tadāprabhṛti sarpāṇāṃ jihvā darbhāgrapāṭitāḥ ||12|| dvidhābhavanmuniśreṣṭhā dvijihvāstena te smṛtāḥ|| sudhāsaṃyogato darbhāḥ praya yuśca pavitratām ||13|| mocayitvā ca garuḍo dāsībhāvātsvamātaram || śaśāpakupitaḥ kadrūṃ chadmanā jitamātaram ||14|| kadrūstvaṃ jananīṃ yanme chalena jitavatyasi || bhartustvaṃ paricaryāyāmato nārhā bhaviṣyasi ||15|| śaptvaivaṃ garuḍaḥ kadrūṃ prayayau sa yathecchayā || kadrūśca vinatā cobhe yayaturbharturaṃtikam || 16 || kaśyapo vimukhastatra kadrūṃ kopādathābravīt || yasmācchalena vinatāṃ kadrūrnirjitavatyasi || 17 || ato matparicaryāyāṃ na yogyāsi durātmike || striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ vāpi nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || 18 || chalādvijayate yo'sau sa mahāpātakī bhavet || chalādvijayinā sārdhaṃ saṃbhāṣya brahmahā bhavet || 19 || steyī surāpī vijñeyo gurudārarataśca saḥ || saṃsargadoṣaduṣṭaśca munibhiḥ parikīrtyate || 3.1.38.120 || tvayā saṃbhāṣaṇāddoṣo mama syānnarakapradaḥ || tasmātprayāhi kadrūstvaṃ matsamīpāddhi dāruṇe || 21 || chalajetrā sapaṃktau yo bhuṃjīta manujo bhuvi || tena saṃbhāṣaṇātsadyaḥ pateddhi narakārṇave || 22 || vilokya cchalajetāraṃ tasya pāpasya śāṃtaye || ādityaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi pāvakaṃ vā vilokayet || 23 || chalajetā yatra tiṣṭhedāśrame'pi gṛhe'pivā || vastavyaṃ na hi tatrānyairvasannarakamaśnute || 24 || ato niryāhi niryāhi mama tvaṃ dṛṣṭimārgataḥ || svāśramātsaralāmenāṃ vinatāṃ jitavatyasi || 25 || iti dhikkṛtya sahasā kadrūṃ tāṃ kaśyapastadā || vinatāṃ svacchaśīlāṃ tāṃ svīcakāra mahāmatiḥ ||26 || kadrūritthaṃ saparuṣaṃ kathitā kaśyapena sā || rudaṃtī bhṛśaduḥkhārtā pādayostasya cāpatat || 27 || patitāṃ pādayordṛṣṭvā kaśyapo munipuṃgavaḥ || na jagrāhaiva kadrūṃ tāṃ smaranpāpaṃ tayā kṛtam || 28 || tataḥ praṇamya vinatā kaśyapaṃ vākyamabravīt || bhagavanbhaginīmenāṃ svīkuruṣva kṛpānidhe || 29 || ajñānānmugdhayā pāpaṃ kadrvā yadadhunā kṛtam|| kṣaṃtumarhasi tatsarvaṃ dayāśīlā hi sādhavaḥ || 3.1.38.130 || jananyā garuḍasyaiva kathitaḥ kaśyapo muniḥ || uvāca vinate naināṃ vinā pāpasya niṣkṛtim || 31 || grahīṣyāmi durācārāṃ tristvāṃ śapathayāmyaham || kaśyapasya vacaḥ śrutvā vinatā punarabravīt || 32 || bhaginyā mama pāpasya brahmaṃstvaṃ brūhi niṣkṛtim || yeneyaṃ paricaryāyāṃ tava yogyā bhaviṣyati || 33 || tayaivamudito viprā mārīcaḥ kaśyapastadā || dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ manasā paścādidamabhāṣata || 34 || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhestīre phullagrāme vimuktide || asti kṣīrasaronāma tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam || 65 || tattīrthasnānamātreṇa doṣaścāsyā vinaśyati || prāyaścittāyutenāpi tattīrthe majjanaṃ vinā || 36 || na naśyatyeṣa doṣo 'syāstadeṣā yātu tatsaraḥ || bhartraivamudite kadrūstaṃ praṇamya dvijottamam || 37 || tatkṣaṇātprayayau kṣīraṃ saraḥ putrasahāyinī || sā kadrūḥ putra sahitā gatvā katipayairdinaiḥ || 38 || prāpya kṣīrasaraḥ puṇyaṃ prayatā vijiteṃdriyā || sasnau niyamapūrvaṃ ca saṃkalpya kṣīrakuṃḍake || 39 || upoṣya tridinaṃ sasnau tasminkṣīrasarojale || caturthe divase tasyāṃ kurvatyāṃ snānamādarāt || adehā vyomagāvāṇī samuttasthau dvijottamāḥ || 3.1.38.140 || aśarīriṇyuvāca || || kadrūstvaṃ majjanādatra cchalajetṛtvadoṣataḥ || 41 || vimuktā bhartṛśuśrūṣāyogyā cāsi na saṃśayaḥ || śāpopi garuḍoktaste layaṃ yāto'tra majjanāt || 42 || gaccha bhartṛsakāśaṃ tvaṃ so'pi tvāṃ svīkariṣyati || ityuktvā virarāmātha vyomavāgaśarīriṇī || 43 || tasyai vāce namaskṛtya kadrūḥ sā prītamānasā || tīrthaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya natvā putrasamanvitā || 44 || prayayau bharturabhyāśaṃ tacchuśrūṣaṇakautukāt || āgatātāṃ samālokya snātāṃ kṣīrasarojale || 45 || jñātvā vidhūtapāpāṃ ca kaśyapaḥ sa samādhinā || aṃgīcakāra patnīṃ tāmātmaśuśrūṣaṇoci tām || 46 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kadrūpāpavimokṣaṇam || majjanānmuktidaṃ puṃsāṃ puṇye kṣīrasarojale || 47 || yaḥ śṛṇotīmamadhyāyaṃ paṭhate vāpi mānavaḥ || sa kṣīrakuṃḍasnānasya labhate phalamuttamam|| 48 || aśvamedhādiyajñānāṃ samagraṃ phalamaśnute || gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu sa snāto bhavati dhruvam|| || 49 || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ kṣīrakuṃḍapraśaṃsanam || gosahasrapradātṝṇāṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ phalam || 3.1.38.150 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye kṣīrakuṃḍapraśasāyāṃ kadrūkṛtacchaladoṣaśāṃtikathāvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<3.1.39>
śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kapitīrthasya vaibhavam || tattīrthaṃ sakalaiḥ pūrvaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 1 || sarveṣāmupakārāya kapibhirnirmitaṃ dvijāḥ || rāvaṇādiṣu rakṣaḥsu hateṣu tadanaṃtaram || 2 || tīrthaṃ nirmāya tatraiva sasnuste kapayo mudā || tīrthāya ca varaṃ prāduḥ kapayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || || 3|| asmiṃstīrthe nimagnā ye bhaktipravaṇacetasaḥ || te sarve muktibhājaḥ syurmahāpātakamocitāḥ || 4 || atra tīrthe nimagnānāṃ na syānnarakajaṃ bhayam || atra snātā narāḥ sarve dāridyaṃ nāpnuvaṃti hi || 5 || atra tīrthe nimagnānāṃ yamapīḍāpi no bhavet || kapitīrthaṃ prayāsye'hamiti yaḥ satataṃ bruvan || 6 || vrajecchatapadaṃ viprāḥ sa yāyātparamaṃ padam || etattīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 7 || evaṃ varaṃ tu te dattvā tīrthāyāsmai kapī śvarāḥ || rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ sarve praṇamyātha yayācire || 8 || svāmiṃstvayāsmai tīrthāya dīyatāṃ varamadbhutam|| kapibhiḥ prārthito viprā rāmacaṃdro'tiha rṣitaḥ || 9|| tattīrthāya varaṃ prādātkapīnāṃ prītikāraṇāt || atra tīrthe nimagnānāṃ gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || 3.1.39.10 || prayāgasnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtha phalaṃ tathā || agniṣṭomādiyāgānāṃ phalaṃ bhūyādanuttamam || 11 || gāyatryādimahāmaṃtrajapapuṇyaṃ tathā bhavet || gosahasrapradanṛṇāṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ phalam || 12 || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādidevapūjāphalaṃ labhet || 13 || kapitīrthāya rāmoyaṃ prādādevaṃ varaṃ dvijāḥ || evaṃ rāmeṇa datte tu vare tatra kutūhalāt ||14|| ṣaḍardhanayano brahmā sahasrākṣo yamastathā || varuṇognistathā vāyuḥ kuberaścaṃdramā api ||15|| ādityo nirṛtiścaiva sādhyāśca vasavastathā || anye'pi tridaśāḥ sarve viśvedevādayastathā || 16 || atrirbhṛgustathā kutso gautamaśca parāśaraḥ || kaṇvo'gastyaḥ sutīkṣṇaśca viśvāmitrādayo'pare || 17 || yoginaḥ sanakādyāśca nāradādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ || rāmadattavaraṃ tīrthaṃ ślāghaṃte bahudhā tadā || 18|| sasnuśca tatra tīrthe te sarvābhīṣṭapradāyini || kapibhirnirmitaṃ yasmādetattīrthamanuttamam || 19 || kapitīrthamiti khyātimato loke prayāsyati|| ityapyavocaṃste sarve devāścamunayastathā || 3.1.39.20 || tasmādavaśyaṃ gaṃtavyaṃ kapitīrthaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || raṃbhā kauśikaśāpena śilābhūtā purā dvijāḥ || 21|| tatra snātvā nijaṃ rūpaṃ prapede ca divaṃ yayau || asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 22 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || raṃbhāṃ kimarthamaśapatkau śikaḥ sūtanaṃdana || kathaṃ gatā śilābhūtā kapitīrthaṃ surāṃganā || etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistarānmunisattama || 23 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || viśvāmitrābhidho rājā prāgabhūtkuśikānvaye || 24 || sa kadācinmahārājaḥ senāparivṛto balī || medinīṃ paricakrāma rājyavīkṣaṇakautukī || || 25 || aṭitvā sa bahūndeśānvasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ yayau || ātithyāya vṛtaḥ so'yaṃ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā || 26 || tathāstvityabravītsoyaṃ daṃḍavatpraṇato nṛpaḥ || kāmadhenuprabhāvena viśvāmitrāya bhūbhuje || 27 || ātithyamakarodviprā vasiṣṭho brahmanaṃdanaḥ || kāmadhenuprabhāvaṃ vai jñātvā kuśikanaṃdanaḥ || || 28 || vasiṣṭhaṃ prārthayāmāsa kāmadhenumabhīṣṭadām || pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena pracakarṣa ca tāṃ balāt || 29 || kāmadhenuvisṛṣṭaistu mlecchādyaiḥ sa parājitaḥ || mahādevaṃ samārādhya tasmādastrāṇyavāpya ca || 3.1.39.30 || vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ gatvā vyasṛjaccharasaṃcayān || sarvāṇyastrāṇi mumuce brahmāstraṃ ca nṛpottamaḥ || 31 || tāni sarvāṇi cāstrāṇi vasiṣṭho brahmanaṃdanaḥ || ekena brahmadaṃḍena nijaghna svatapobalāt || 32 || tataḥ parājito viprā viśvāmitro'tilajjitaḥ || brāhmaṇyāvāptaye svasya tapaḥ kartuṃ vanaṃ yayau || 33 || pūrvāsu paścimāṃtāsu triṣu dikṣu tapo'carat || prādurbhūtamahā vighnastattaddikṣu sa kauśikaḥ || 34 || uttarāṃ diśamāsādya himavatparvate'male kauśikyāssaritastīre puṇye pāpavināśini || 35 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu nirāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ || nirāloko jitaśvāso jitakrodhaḥ suniścalaḥ || 36 || grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyasthaḥ śiśire vāriṣu sthitaḥ || varṣāsvākāśago nityamūrdhvabāhurnirāśrayaḥ || 37 || brāhmaṇyasiddhaye'tyugraṃ cacāra sumahattapaḥ || udvignamanasastasya tridaśāstridivālayāḥ || jaṃbhāriṇā ca sahitā raṃbhāṃ procuridaṃ vacaḥ || 39 || || devā ūcuḥ || || raṃbhe tvaṃ himavacchaile kauśikītīragaṃ munim || 39 || viśvāmitraṃ tapasyaṃtaṃ vilobhaya viceṣṭitaiḥ || yathā tattapaso vighno bhaviṣyati tathā kuru || 3.1.39.40 || evamuktā tadā raṃbhā devairiṃdra purogamaiḥ || pratyuvāca surānsarvānprāṃjaliḥ praṇatā tadā || 41 || || raṃbhovāca || || atikrūro mahākrodho viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ || sa śapsyate māṃ krodhena bibhemyasmādahaṃ surāḥ || 42 || trāyadhvaṃ kṛpayā yūyaṃ māṃ yuṣmatparicārikām || ityukto raṃbhayā tatra jaṃbhāristāma bhāṣata || 43 || || indra uvāca || || raṃbhe tvayā na bhīḥ kāryā viśvāmitrāttapodhanāt || ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi tvatsahāyaḥ samanmathaḥ || 44 || kokilālāpamadhuro vasanto'pyāgamiṣyati || atisuṃdararūpā tvaṃ pralobhaya mahāmunim || 45 || itīṃdrakathitā raṃbhā viśvāmitrāśramaṃ yayau || taddṛṣṭigocarā sthitvā lalitaṃ rūpamāsthitā || 46 || sā muniṃ lobhayāmāsa manoharaviceṣṭitaḥ || pikopi tasminsamaye cukūjānaṃdayanmanaḥ || 47 || śrutvā pikasvaraṃ raṃbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munipuṃgavaḥ || saṃśayāviṣṭahṛdayo viditvā śakrakarma tat || śaśāpa raṃbhāṃ krodhena viśvāmitrastapodhanaḥ || 48 || || || viśvāmitra uvāca || || yasmātkopayase raṃbhe māṃ tvaṃ kopajayaiṣiṇam || 49 || śilā bhavātra tasmāttvaṃ raṃbhe varṣaśatāyutam || tadaṃtare brāhmaṇena rakṣitā mokṣamāpsyasi || 3.1.39.50 || viśvāmitrasya śāpena tadaṃte sā śilā'bhavat || bahukālaṃ śilābhūtā tasthau tasyāśrame dvijāḥ || 51 || viśvāmitropi dharmātmā punastaptvā mahattapaḥ || lebhe vasiṣṭhavākyena brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ nṛpaiḥ || 52 || bahukālaṃ śilābhūtā raṃbhāpyāsīttadāśrame || tasminnevāśrame puṇye śiṣyo'gastyasya saṃmataḥ || 53 || śvetonāma muniścakre mumukṣuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ || cirakālaṃ tapastasminprakurvati mahāmunau ||54|| aṃgāraketi vikhyātā rākṣasī kācidāgatā || tasyāśramamatikrūrā meghasvanamahāsvanā || 55 || mūtraraktapurīṣādyairdūṣayāmāsa bhīṣaṇā || upadravaistathā cānyairbādhayāmāsa taṃ munim || 56 || atha kruddho muniḥ śveto vāyavyāstreṇa yojayan || śaptāṃ kuśikaputreṇa rākṣasyai prākṣipacchilām || 57 || rākṣasī sā pradudrāva vāyavyāstreṇa yojitā || vāyavyāstraprayuktena dṛṣadānudrutā ca sā || 58 || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhestīraṃ dhāvati sma bhayārditā || dhāvantīmanudhāvantī sā śilāstraprayojitā || 59 || papātopari rākṣasyā majjaṃtyāḥ kapitīrthake || mṛtā sā rākṣasī tatra śilāpātātsvamūrddhani || || 3.1.39.60 || viśvāmitreṇa śaptā sā kapitīrthe nimajjanāt || śilārūpaṃ parityajya raṃbhārūpamupeyuṣī || 61 || devaiḥ kusumadhārābhirabhivṛṣṭā mano ramā || divyaṃ vimānamārūḍhā divyāṃbaravirājitā || 62 || hārakeyūrakaṭakanāsābharaṇabhūṣitā || urvaśyādyapsarobhiśca sakhibhiḥ parivāritā ||63|| kapitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ praśaṃsantī punaḥpunaḥ || niṣevya rāmanāthaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam || 64 || ākhaṇḍalapurīṃ ramyāṃ prayayāvamarāvatīm || rākṣasī sāpi śāpena kumbhajasya mahaujasaḥ || 65 || ghṛtācī devaveśyā hi rākṣasīrūpamāgatā || sāpyatra kapitīrthāpsu snānātsvaṃ rūpamāyayau || 66 || evaṃ raṃbhāghṛtācyau te kapitīrthe nimajjanāt || agastyaśiṣyaśvetasya prasādāddvijasattamāḥ || 67 || rākṣasītvaṃ śilātvaṃ ca hitvā svaṃ rūpamāgate || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snātavyaṃ kapitīrthake || 68 || yaḥ śṛṇotīmamadhyāyaṃ paṭhate vāpi mānavaḥ || prāpnoti kapitīrthasya snānajaṃ phalamuttamam || 69 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye kapitīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ raṃbhāghṛtācīśāpavimokṣa ṇavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39||
<3.1.40>
| śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi munayo lokapāvanam || gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā māhātmyaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām || 1 || śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva mahāpātakanāśanam || mahāpuṇyapradaṃ puṃsā narakakleśanāśanam || 2 || gāyatryāṃ ca sarasvatyāṃ ye snāṃti manujā mudā || na teṣāṃ garbhavāsaḥ syātkiṃ tu muktirbhaveddhruvam || 3 || sarasvatyāśca gāyatryā gandhamādanaparvate || brahmapatnyoḥ sannidhānāttannāmnā kathite ime || 4 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || gāyatryāśca sarasvatyā gandhamādanaparvate || kimarthaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ vai sūtābhūttadvadasva naḥ || 5 || || || sūta uvāca || || prajāpatiḥ purā viprāḥ svāṃ vai duhitaraṃ mudā || vāṅnāmnīṃ kāmuko bhūtvā spṛhayāmāsa mohanaḥ || 6 || atha prajāpateḥ putrī svasminvai tasya kāmitām|| vilokya lajjitā bhūtvā rohidrūpa dadhāra sā || 7 || brahmāpi hariṇo bhūtvā tayā rantumanāstadā || gacchatīmanuyātisma hariṇīrūpadhāriṇīm || 8 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarvāḥ putrīgamanasādaram || karotyakāryaṃ brahmāyaṃ putrīgamanalakṣaṇam || 9 || iti nindaṃti taṃ viprāḥ sraṣṭāraṃ jagatāṃ patim || niṣiddhakṛtyanirataṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā parameṣṭhinam|| 3.1.40.10 || haraḥ pinākamādāya vyādharūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ || ākarṇapūrṇa kṛṣṭena pinākadhanuṣā śaram || 11 || saṃyojya vedhasaṃ tena vivyādha niśitena saḥ || tripurāṃtaka bāṇena viddho'sau nyapatadbhuvi || 12 || tasya dehādathotthāya mahajjyotirmahāprabham || ākāśe mṛgaśīrṣākhyaṃ nakṣatramabhavattadā || 13 || ārdrānakṣatrarūpī sanharo'pyanujagāma tam || pīḍayanmṛgaśīrṣākhyaṃ nakṣatraṃ brahmarūpiṇam || 14 || adhunāpi mṛgavyādharūpeṇa tripurāṃtakaḥ || aṃbare dṛśyate spaṣṭaṃ mṛgaśīrṣāṃtike dvijāḥ || 15 || evaṃ vinihate tasmiñcchaṃbhunā parameṣṭhini || anaṃtaraṃ tu gāyatrīsarasvatyau śucārpite || 16 || bhartṛhīne muniśreṣṭhā bhartṛjīvanakāṃkṣayā || kiṃ kariṣyāvahe hyāvāmityanyoyaṃ vicārya tu || 17 || svapatiprāṇasiddhyarthaṃ gāyatrī ca sarasvatī || sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ śivasthānaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam || 18 || sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ puṃsāṃ tapaḥ kartuṃ samudyate || jagmaturniyamopetaṃ tapaḥ kartuṃ śivaṃ prati || 19 || snānārthamātmano viprā gāyatrī ca sarasvatī || tīrthadvayaṃ svanāmnā vai cakratuḥ pāpanāśanam || 3.1.40.20 || tatra triṣavaṇasnānaṃ pratyahaṃ cakraturmudā || bahukālamanāhāre kāmakrodhādivarjite || 21 || atyugraniyamo pete śivadhyānaparāyaṇe || paṃcākṣaramahāmantrajapaikaniyate śubhe || 22 || svapaterjīvanārthaṃ vai gāyatrī ca sarasvatī || mahādevaṃ samuddiśya tapa evaṃ pracakratuḥ || 23 || tayoratha tapastuṣṭo mahādevo maheśvaraḥ || sannidhatte mahāmūrtistapasāṃ phaladitsayā || 24 || tataḥ sannihitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ pārvatīramaṇaṃ śivam || gaṇeśakārttikeyābhyāṃ pārśvayoḥ parisevitama || 25 || dṛṣṭvā saṃtuṣṭacitte te gāyatrī ca sarasvatī || stotraistuṣṭuvatuḥ stutyaṃ mahādevaṃ ghṛṇā nidhim || 26 || || gāyatrīsarasvatyāvūcatuḥ || || namo durvārasaṃsāradhvāṃtadhvaṃsaikahetave || jvalajjvālāvalībhīmakālakūṭaviṣādine || 27 || jaganmohana paṃcāstradehanāthaikahetave || jagadaṃtakarakrūra yamāṃtaka namo'stu te || 28 || gaṃgātaraṃgasaṃpṛktajaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇe || namastestu virūpākṣa bāla śītāṃśudhāriṇe || 29 || pinākabhīmaṭaṃkāratrāsitatripuraukase || namaste vividhākārajagatsraṣṭṛśiraśchide || 3.1.40.30 || śāṃtāmalakṛpādṛṣṭisaṃrakṣitamṛ kaṇḍuja || namaste girijānātha rakṣāvāṃ śaraṇāgate || 31 || mahādeva jagannātha tripurāṃtaka śaṃkara || vāmadeva mahādeva rakṣāvāṃ śaraṇāgate || 32 ||| iti tābhyāṃ stutaḥ śambhurdevadevo maheśvaraḥ || abravītprītisaṃyukto gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm || 33 || || mahādeva uvāca || || bhoḥ sarasvati gāyatri prīto'smi yuvayoraham || varaṃ varayataṃ matto yadvā manasi vartate || 34 || ityukte te tu gāyatrīsarasvatyau hareṇa vai || abrūtāṃ pārvatīkāṃtaṃ mahādevaṃ ghṛṇānidhim || 35 || || gāyatrīsarasvatyāvūcatuḥ || || bhagannāvayordeva bharttāraṃ caturānanam || saprāṇaṃ kuru sarveśa kṛpayā karuṇākara || 36 || tvamāvayoḥ pitā deva tavāpyāvāṃ sute ubhe || rakṣāvāṃ patidānena tasmāttvaṃ tripurāṃtaka || 37 || sa evaṃ prārthitaḥ śambhustābhyāṃ brāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ || evamastviti saṃprocya gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm || 38 || tadeva vedhasaḥ kāyaṃ śirasā yoktumutsukaḥ || tatraiva vedhasaḥ kāyaṃ śirobhiḥ sahasuvratāḥ || 39 || bhūtairānāyayāmāsa naṃdibhṛṃgimukhaistadā || śirāṃsi tānyanekāni kāyena saha śaṃkaraḥ || 3.1.40.40 || kṣaṇātsaṃdhārayāmāsa vāṇīgāyatrisaṃnidhau || saṃdhito'tha hareṇāsau caturvaktro jagatpatiḥ || 41 || uttasthau tatkṣaṇādeva suptotthita iva dvijāḥ || tataḥ prajāpatirdṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam || tuṣṭāva vāgbhiragryābhirbhāryābhyāṃ ca samanvitaḥ || 42 || || brahmovāca || || namaste devadeveśa karuṇākara śaṃkara || 43 || pāhi māṃ karuṇāsiṃdho niṣiddhācaraṇātprabho || mama tvatkṛpayā śaṃbho niṣiddhācaraṇe kvacit || 44 || mā pravṛttirbhavedbhūyo rakṣa māṃ tvaṃ tathā sadā || tathaivāstviti saṃprāha brahmāṇaṃ girijāpatiḥ || 45 || itaḥ paraṃ pramādaṃ tvaṃ mā kuruṣva vidhe punaḥ || utpathaṃ pratipannānāṃ puṃsāṃ śāstāsmi sarvadā || 46 || evamuktvā caturvaktraṃ mahādevo dvijottamāḥ || sarasvatīṃ ca gāyatrīṃ provāca prīṇayangirā || 47 || || || mahādeva uvāca || || yuvayormatprasādena he gāyatri sarasvati || ayaṃ bhartā samāyātaḥ saprāṇaścaturānanaḥ || 48 || sahānena brahmalokaṃ yātaṃ mā bhūdvilaṃbatā || yuvayoḥ saṃnidhānena sadā kuṃḍadvaye'tra vai || 49 || bhaviṣyati nṛṇāṃ muktiḥ snānātsāyujyarūpiṇī || yuṣmannāmnā ca gāyatrīsara svatyāviti dvayam || 3.1.40.50 || idaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaloke khyātiṃ yāsyati śāśvatīm || sarveṣāmapi tīrthānāmidaṃ tīrthadvayaṃ sadā || 51 || śuddhipradaṃ tathā bhūyānmahāpātakanāśanam || mahāśāṃtikaraṃ puṃsāṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || 52 || mama prasādajananaṃ viṣṇuprītikaraṃ tathā || etattīrthadvayasamaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 53 || atra snānāddhi sarveṣāṃ sarvābhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati || idaṃ kuṃḍadvayaṃ loke bhavatībhyāṃ kṛtaṃ mahat || 54 || yuṣmannāmnā prasiddhaṃ ca bhaviṣyati vimuktidam || gāyatryupāstirahitā vedābhyāsavivarjitāḥ || 55 || aupāsanavihīnāśca paṃcayajñavivarjitāḥ || yuṣmatkuṃḍadvaye snānāttatta tphalamavāpnuyuḥ || 56 || anye ca ye pātakino nityānuṣṭhānavarjitāḥ || snātvā kuṃḍadvaye tatra śuddhāḥ syurdvijasattamāḥ || 57|| sarasvatīṃ ca gāya trīmevamuktvā maheśvaraḥ || kṣaṇādaṃtaradhāttatra sarveṣāmeva paśyatām || 58 || patiṃ labdhvā'tha gāyatrīsarasvatyau mudānvite || tena sākaṃ brahmalokaṃ jagma turdvijasattamāḥ || 59 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā gaṃdhamādanaparvate || saṃnidhānaṃ sarasvatyā gāyatryāśca sahetukam || 3.1.40.60 || yaḥ śṛṇotīmamadhyāyaṃ paṭhate vā sabhaktikam || etattīrthadvayasnānaphalamāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhi tāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye gāyatrīsarasvatītīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ gaṃdhamādane gāyatrīsarasvatīsannidhānakathanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || ||
<3.1.41>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm || lakṣyīkṛtya kathāmekāṃ pavitrāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1 || kaśyapākhyo dvijaḥ pūrvamasmiṃstīrthadvaye śubhe || snātvātimahataḥ pāpādvimukto narakapradāt || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || mune kaśyapanāmāsāvakarotkiṃ hi pātakam || snātvā tīrthadvayepyatra yasmānmukto'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 3 || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ brūhi sūta kṛpābalāt || tvadvaco'mṛtatṛptānāṃ na pipāsāpi vidyate || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || gāyatryāśca sarasvatyā māhātmyapratipādakam || itihāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam || 5 || abhimanyusuto rājā parīkṣinnāma nāmataḥ || adhyāste hāstinapuraṃ pālayandharmato mahīm || 6 || sa rājā jātu vipine cacāra mṛgayā rataḥ || ṣaṣṭivarṣavayā bhūpaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitaḥ ||7 || naṣṭamekaṃ sa vipine mārgayanmṛgamādarāt || dhyānārūḍhaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha taṃ cīravāsasam || 8 ||| mayā bāṇena vipine mṛgo viddho'dhunā mune || dṛṣṭaḥ sa kiṃ tvayā vidvanvidruto bhayakātaraḥ || 9 || samādhiniṣṭho maunitvānna kiṃ cidapi so'bravīt || tato dhanuraṭanyā'sau skaṃdhe tasya mahāmuneḥ| 3.1.41.10 || nidhāya mṛtasarpaṃ tu kupitaḥ svapuraṃ yayau|| munestasya sutaḥ kaścicchṛṃgīnāma babhūva vai || 11 || sakhā tasya kṛśākhyo'bhūcchṛṃgiṇo dvijasattamāḥ || sakhāyaṃ śṛṅgiṇaṃ prāha kṛśākhyaḥ sa sakhā tataḥ || 12 || pitā tava mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ skaṃdhena vahate'dhunā || mā bhūddarpastava sakhe mā kṛthāstvaṃ madaṃ vṛthā || 13 || so'vadatkupitaḥ śṛṃgī ditsuśśāpaṃ nṛpāya vai || mattāte śavasarpaṃ yo nyastavānmūḍhacetanaḥ || 14 || sa saptarātrānmriyatāṃ saṃdaṣṭastakṣakāhinā || śaśāpaivaṃ munisutaḥ saubhadreyaṃ parīkṣitam || 15 || śamīkākhyaḥ pitā tasya śrutvā śaptaṃ sutena tam || nṛpaṃ provāca tanayaṃ śṛṃgiṇaṃ munipuṃgavaḥ || 16 || rakṣakaṃ sarvalokānāṃ nṛpaṃ kiṃ śaptavānasi || arājake vayaṃ loke sthāsyāmaḥ kathamaṃjasā || 17 || krodhena pātakamabhūnna tvayā prāpyate sukham || yaḥ samutpāditaṃ kopaṃ kṣamayaiva nirasyati || 18 || iha loke paratrāsāvatyaṃtaṃ sukhamedhate || kṣamāyuktā hi puruṣā labhaṃte śreya uttamam || 19 || tataḥ śamīkaḥ svaṃ śiṣyaṃ prāha gauramukhābhidham || bho gau mukha gatvā tvaṃ vada bhūpaṃ parīkṣitam || 3.1.41.20 || imaṃ śāpaṃ matsutoktaṃ takṣakāhividaṃśanam || punarāyāhi śīghraṃ tvaṃ matsamīpe mahāmate || 21 || evamuktaḥ śamīkena yayau gauramukho nṛpam || sametya cābravīdbhūpaṃ saubhadreyaṃ parīkṣitam || 22 || dṛṣṭvā sarpaṃ pituḥ skandhe tvayā vinihitaṃ mṛtam || śamīkasya sutaḥ śṛṃgī śaśāpa tvāṃ ruṣānvitaḥ || 23 || etaddinātsaptame'hni takṣakeṇa mahāhinā || daṣṭo viṣāgninā dagdho bhūyādāśvabhimanyujaḥ || 24 || evaṃ śaśāpa tvāṃ rājañchṛṃgī tasya muneḥ sutaḥ || etadvaktuṃ pitā tasya prāhiṇonmāṃ tvadaṃtikam || 25 || itīrayitvā taṃ bhūpamāśu gauramukho yayau || gate gauramukhe paścādrājā śokaparāyaṇaḥ || 26 || abhraṃlihamathottuṃgamekastaṃbhaṃ suvistṛtam || madhyegaṃgaṃ vyatanuta maṃḍapaṃ nṛpapuṃgavaḥ || 27 || mahāgāruḍamaṃtrajñairauṣadhajñaiścikitsakaiḥ || takṣakasya viṣaṃ haṃtuṃ yatnaṃ kurvansamāhitaḥ || 28 || anekadevabrahmarṣirājarṣipravarānvitaḥ || āste tasminnṛpastuṃge maṃḍape viṣṇubhaktimān || 29 || tasminnavasare vipraḥ kāśyapo māṃtrikottamaḥ || rājānaṃ rakṣituṃ prāyāttakṣakasya mahāviṣāt || 3.1.41.30 || saptame'hani vipreṃdro daridro dhanakāmukaḥ || atrāṃtare takṣako'pi viprarūpī samāyayau || 31 || madhyemārgaṃ vilokyātha kaśyapaṃ pratyabhāṣata || brāhmaṇa tvaṃ kutra yāsi vada me'dya mahāmune || 32 || iti pṛṣṭastadāvādītkāśyapastakṣakaṃ dvijāḥ || parīkṣitaṃ mahārājaṃ takṣako'dya viṣāgninā || 33 || dakṣyate taṃ śamayituṃ tatsamīpamupaimyaham || ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ vipraṃ takṣakaḥ punarabravīt || 34 || takṣakohaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mayā daṣṭaścikitsitum || na śakyo 'bdaśatenāpi mahāmaṃtrāyutairapi || 35 || cikitsituṃ cenmaddaṣṭaṃ śaktirasti tavādhunā || anekayojanocchrāyamimaṃ vaṭataruṃ tvaham || 36 || daśāmyujjīvayainaṃ tvaṃ samartho'sti tato bhavān || itīrayitvā taṃ vṛkṣamadaśattakṣakastadā || 37 || abhavadbhasmasātso'pi vṛkṣo'tyaṃtaṃ samūrcchitaḥ || pūrvameva naraḥ kaścittaṃ vṛkṣamadhirūḍhavān || 38 || takṣakasya viṣolkābhiḥ so'pi dagdho'bhavattadā || taṃ naraṃ na vijijñāte tau ca kāśyapatakṣakau || || 39 || kāśyapaḥ pratijajñe'tha takṣakasyāpi śṛṇvataḥ || tanmaṃtraśaktiṃ paśyaṃtu sarve viprā hi no'dhunā || 3.1.41.40 || itīrayitvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ viṣāgninā || ajīvayanmantraśaktyā kāśyapo māṃtrikottamaḥ || 41 || naro'pi tena vṛkṣeṇa sākamujjīvito'bhavat || athābravīttakṣakastaṃ kāśyapaṃ maṃtrakovidam || 42 || yathā na munivāṅmithyā bhavedevaṃ kuru dvija || yatte rājā dhanaṃ dadyāttatopi dviguṇaṃ dhanam || || 43 || dadāmyahaṃ nivartasva śīghrameva dvijottama || ityuktvānarghyaratnāni tasmai dattvā sa takṣakaḥ || 44 || nyavartayatkāśyapaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ maṃtrako vidam || alpāyuṣaṃ nṛpaṃ matvā jñānadṛṣṭyā sa kāśyapaḥ || 45 || svāśramaṃ prayayau tūṣṇīṃ labdharatnaśca takṣakāt || so'bravīttakṣakaḥ sarvānsarpānāhūya tatkṣaṇe || 46 || yūyaṃ taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya munīnāṃ veṣadhāriṇaḥ || upahāraphalānyāśu prayacchata parīkṣite || 47 || tathetyuktvā sarvasarpā dadū rājñe phalānyamī || takṣakopi tadā tatra kasmiṃścidbadarīphale || 48 || kṛmiveṣadharo bhūtvā vyatiṣṭhaddaṃśituṃ nṛpam || atha rājā pradattāni sarpairbrāhmaṇarūpakaiḥ || 49 || parīkṣinmaṃtravṛddhebhyo dattvā sarvaphalānyapi || kautūhalena jagrāha sthūlamekaṃ phalaṃ kare || 3.1.41.50 || asminnavasare sūryo'pyastācalamagāhata || mithyā ṛṣivaco mā bhūditi tatratyamānavāḥ || 51 || anyoyamavadantsarve brāhmaṇāśca nṛpāstathā || evaṃ vadatsu sarveṣu phale tasminnadṛśyata || 52 || phale raktakṛmiḥ sarve rājñā cāpi parīkṣitā || ayaṃ kiṃ māṃ daśedadya kṛmirityuktavā nnṛpaḥ || 53 || nidadhe tatphalaṃ karṇe sakṛmi dvijasattamāḥ || takṣako'sminsthitaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛmirūpī phale tadā || 54 || nirgatya tatphalādāśu nṛpade hamaveṣṭayat || takṣakāveṣṭite bhūpe pārśvasthā dudruvurbhayāt || 55 || anaṃtaraṃ nṛpo viprāstakṣakasya viṣāgninā || dagdho'bhūdbhasmasādāśu saprāsādo balīyasā || 56 || kṛtvordhvadaihikaṃ tasya nṛpasya sapurohitāḥ || maṃtriṇastatsutaṃ rājye janamejayanāmakam || 57 || rājānamabhyaṣiṃcanvai gajadrakṣa ṇavāṃchayā || takṣakādrakṣituṃ bhūpamāyātaḥ kāśyapābhidhaḥ || 58 || yo brāhmaṇo muniśreṣṭhāḥ sa sarvairniṃdito janaiḥ || babhrāma sakalāndeśāñchiṣṭaiḥ sarvaiśca dūṣitaḥ || 59 || avasthānaṃ na lebhe'sau grāme vāpyāśrame'pi vā || yānyāndeśānasau yātastatratatramahājanaiḥ || 3.1.41.60 || tattaddeśānnirastaḥ sa śākalyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || praṇamya śākalyamuniṃ kāśyapo nindito janaiḥ || idaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa śākalyāya mahātmane || 61 || || kāśyapa uvāca || || bhagavansarvadharmajña śākalya harivallabha || 62 || munayo brāhmaṇāścānye māṃ niṃdaṃti suhṛjjanāḥ || nāsyāhaṃ kāraṇaṃ jāne kiṃ māṃ niṃdaṃti mānavāḥ || 63 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurustrīgamanaṃ tathā || steyaṃ saṃsargadoṣo vā mayā nācaritaḥ kvacit || 64 || anyānyapi hi pāpāni na kṛtāni mayā mune || tathāpi niṃdaṃti janā vṛthā māṃ bāṃdhavādayaḥ || 65 || jānāsi cettvaṃ śākalya mayā doṣaṃ kṛtaṃ vada || ukto'tha kāśyapenaivaṃ śākalyākhyo mahāmuniḥ || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā babhāṣe taṃ kāśyapaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 66 || || śākalya uvāca || || parīkṣitaṃ mahārājaṃ takṣakādrakṣituṃ bhavān || 67 || ayāsīdardhamārge tu takṣakeṇa nivāritaḥ || cikitsituṃ samartho'pi viṣarogādipīḍitam || 68 || yo na rakṣati lobhena tamāhurbrahmaghātakam || krodhātkāmādbhayāllobhānmātsaryānmohato'pi vā || 69 || yo na rakṣati vipreṃdra viṣarogāturaṃ naram || brahmahā sa surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || 3.1.41.70 || saṃsargadoṣaduṣṭaśca nāpi tasya hi niṣkṛtiḥ || kanyāvikrayiṇaścāpi hayavikrayiṇastathā || 71 || kṛtaghna syāpi śāstreṣu prāyaścittaṃ hi vidyate || viṣarogāturaṃ yastu samarthopi na rakṣati || 72 || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ proktā prāyaścittāyutairapi || na tena saha paṃktau ca bhuṃjīta sukṛtī janaḥ || 73 || na tena saha bhāṣeta na paśyettaṃ naraṃ kvacit || tatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa mahāpātakabhāgbhavet || 74 || parīkṣitsa mahārājaḥ puṇyaślokaśca dhārmikaḥ || viṣṇubhakto mahāyogī cāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā || 75 || vyāsaputrāddharikathāṃ śrutavānbhaktipūrvakam || arakṣitvā nṛpaṃ taṃ tvaṃ vacasā takṣakasya yat || 76 || nivṛttastena vipreṃdrairbāṃdhavairapi dūṣyase || sa parīkṣinmahārājo yadyapi kṣa ṇajīvitaḥ || 77 || tathāpi yāvanmaraṇaṃ budhaiḥ kāryaṃ cikitsanam || yāvatkaṇṭhagatāḥ prāṇā mumūrṣormānavasya hi || 78 || tāvaccikitsā kartavyā kālasya kuṭilā gatiḥ || iti prāhuḥ purā ślokaṃ bhiṣagvaidyābdhipāragāḥ || 79 || ataścikitsāśakto'pi yasmādakṛtabheṣajaḥ || ardhamārge nivṛttastvaṃ tena taṃ hatavānasi || śākalyenaivamuditaḥ kāśyapaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 3.1.41.80 || || kāśyapa uvāca || || mamaitaddoṣaśāṃtyarthamupāyaṃ vada suvrata || 81 || yena māṃ pratigṛhṇīyurbāṃdhavāḥ sasuhṛjjanāḥ || 82 || kṛpāṃ mayi kuruṣva tvaṃ śākalya harivallabha || kāśyapenaivamuktastu śākalyopi munīśvaraḥ || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā jagādaivaṃ kāśyapaṃ kṛpayā tadā || 83 || || śākalya uvāca || || asya pāpasya śātyarthamupāyaṃ pravadāmi te || 84 || tatkarttavyaṃ tvayā śīghraṃ vilaṃbaṃ mā kṛthā dvija || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhau setau gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 85 || asti tīrthadvayaṃ viprā gāyatrī ca sarasvatī || tatra tvaṃ snānamātreṇa śuddho bhūyāśca tatkṣaṇe || 86 || gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā jalavāta spṛśo naraḥ || vidhūya sarvapāpāni svargaṃ yāsyaṃti nirmalāḥ || 87 || tadyāhi śīghra vipra tvaṃ gāyatrīṃ ca sarasvatīm || ityuktaḥ kāśyapastena śākalyena dvijottamāḥ || 88 || natvā muniṃ ca śākalyaṃ tamāpṛcchya munīśvaram || tena caivābhyanujñātaḥ prayayau gandhamādanam || 89 || tatra gatvā ca gāyatrīsarasvatyau ca kāśyapaḥ || natvā tīrthadvayaṃ bhaktyā daṇḍapāṇiṃ ca bhairavam || 3.1.41.90 || saṃkalpapūrvaṃ tattīrthe sasnau niyamasaṃyutaḥ || tīrthadvaye snānamātrānmuktapāpo'tha kāśyapaḥ || 91 || tīrthadvayasya tīre'sau kiṃcitkālaṃ tu tasthivān || tasminkāle ca gāyatrīsarasvatyau munīśvarāḥ || || 92 || prādurbabhūvaturmūrte sarvābharaṇabhūṣite || devyau te sa namaskṛtya kāśyapo bhaktipūrvakam || 93 || ke yuvāṃ rūpasaṃpanne sarvālaṃkārasaṃyute || iti papraccha dṛṣṭvā te kāśyapo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || tena pṛṣṭe ca gāyatrīsarasvatyau tamūcatuḥ || 94 || || gāyatrīsarasvatyāvūcatuḥ || || kāśyapāvāṃ hi gāyatrīsarasvatyau vidhipriye || 95 || etattīrthasvarūpeṇa nityaṃ vartāvahe tvataḥ || atra tīrthadvaye snānādāvāṃ tuṣṭe tavādhunā || 96 || varaṃ matto vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ kāśyapa dvija || snāṃti tīrthadvaye ye'tra dāsyāvastadabhīpsitam || 97 || śrutvā vacastadgāyatrīsarasvatyoḥ sa kāśyapaḥ || tuṣṭāva vāgbhiragryābhiste devyau vedhasaḥ priye || 98 || || kāśyapa uvāca || || caturānanagehinyau jagaddhātryau namāmyaham || vidyāsvarūpe gāyatrī sarasvatyau śubhe ubhe || 99 || sṛṣṭisthityaṃtakāriṇyau jagato vedamātarau || havyakavyasvarūpe ca caṃdrādityavilocane || 3.1.41.100 || sarvadevādhipe vāṇī gāyatryau satataṃ bhaje || girijā kamalā cāpi yuvāmeva jagaddhite || 101 || yuṣmaddarśanamātreṇa jagatsṛṣṭyādikalpanam || yuṣmannimeṣātsatataṃ jagatāṃ pralayo bhavet || 102 || unmeṣātsṛṣṭirabhavadbhogāyatri sarasvati || yuvayordarśanādadya kṛtārtho'bhavamāśu vai || 103 || māmadya pātakānmuktaṃ snānāttīrtha dvaye'tra tu || svīkurvaṃtu muniśreṣṭhā brāhmaṇā bāṃdhavāstathā || 104 || itaḥ paraṃ pāpakṛtye mā me buddhiḥ pravartatām || dharme pravartatāṃ nityamayameva varo mama || 105 || dīyatāṃ bho mahādevyau nānyamicchāmyahaṃ varam || iti te prārthite tena kāśyapena dvijottamāḥ || 106 || sarasvatī ca gāyatrī dve devyau brahmaṇaḥ priye || kāśyapaṃ procatuḥ prīte jananyau jagatāṃ sadā || 107 || kāśyapaitadvaraṃ sarvaṃ prārthitaṃ yattvayā'dhunā || anugrahādāvayostadacireṇa tavāstu hi || 108 || ityuktvā taṃ tu gāyatrīsarasvatyau kṣaṇena vai || tirodhānaṃ gate viprāstasmiṃstīrthadvaye tadā || 109 || kāśyapo'pi kṛtārthaḥ sansva deśaṃ prati niryayau || bāṃdhavā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kāśyapaṃ gatakilbiṣam || 3.1.41.110 || pratyagṛhṇaṃśca gāyatrīsarasvatyornimajjanāt || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā kāśyapasya vimokṣaṇam|| 111 || pātakebhyo hi gāyatrīsarastyornimajanāt || paṭhate tvimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇute vā samāhitaḥ || 112 || yo gāyatryāṃ sarasvatyāṃ sa snātaphalamaśnute || 113 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye gāyatrīsarasvatītī rthapraśaṃsāyāṃ kāśyapapāpaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || cha ||
<3.1.42>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ vaibhavaṃ pravadāmyaham || setumadhyaniviṣṭānāmanuktānāṃ munīśvarāḥ || 1 || asti tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ nāmnā tu ṛṇamocanam || ṛṇāni trīṇi naśyaṃti narāṇāmatra majjanāt || || 2 || dvijasya jāyamānasya ṛṇāni trīṇi saṃti hi || ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 3|| brahmacaryānanuṣṭhānādṛṣīṇāmṛṇavānbhavet || yajñādīnāmakaraṇāddevānāṃ ca ṛṇī bhavet || 4 || putrānutpādanāccaiva pitṛṇāmṛṇavānbhavet || vināpi brahmacaryeṇa vinā yāgaṃ vinā sutam || 5 || ṛṇamokṣābhidhe tīrthe snānamātreṇa mānavāḥ || ṛṣidevapitṝṇāṃ tu ṛṇebhyo muktimāpnuyuḥ || 6 || brahmacaryeṇa yajñena tathā putrodbhavena ca || naiva tuṣyanti ṛṣayo devāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā || 7 || ṛṇamokṣe yathā snānādatulāṃ tuṣṭimāpnuyuḥ || kiṃ cātra majjanāttīrthe daridrā adhamarṇinaḥ || 8 || muktā ṛṇebhyaḥ sarvebhyo dhaninaḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ || yadatra majjanātpuṃsāmṛṇamuktiḥ prajāyate || 9 || tasmāduktamidaṃ tīrthamṛṇamocanasaṃjñayā || ato'tra ṛṇibhiḥ sarvaiḥ snātavyaṃ tadvimuktaye || 3.1.42.10 || etattīrthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || pāṃḍavaiḥ kṛtamapyatra tīrthamastyaparaṃ mahat || 11 || yatreṣṭaṃ dharmaputrādyaiḥ pāṃḍavaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ purā || tadetattīrthamuddiśya bhuktimukti phalapradam || 12 || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthānyanuttamāni hi || paṃcapāṃḍavatīrthesminsānnidhyaṃ kurvate sadā || 13 || āditpā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāśca samarudgaṇāḥ || pāṃḍavānāṃ mahātīrthe nityaṃ sannihitāstathā || 14 || atrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryātpitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet || sarvapāpavinirmukto brahma loke sa pūjyate || 15 || apyekaṃ bhojayedviprametattīrthataṭe'male || tenāsau karmaṇā tvatra paratrāpi ca modate || 16 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāpyanya eva vā || asmiṃstīrthavare snātvā viyoniṃ na prayāti vai || 17 || pāṃḍavānāṃ mahātīrthe puṇyayogeṣu yo naraḥ || snāyātsa manuja śreṣṭho narakaṃ naiva paśyati || 18 || pāṃḍavānāṃ mahātīrthaṃ sāyaṃ prātaśca yaḥ smaret|| sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ || 19 || iṃdrādidevatā bhiśca yatreṣṭaṃ daityaśāṃtaye || tadanyaddevatīrthākhyaṃ vidyate gaṃdhamādane || 3.1.42.20 || devatīrthe naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpavimocitaḥ || prāpnuyādakṣayām̐llokānsarva kāmasamanvitān || 21 || janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ striyā vā
