puruṣeṇa vā || kṛtaṃ taddevakuṃḍesminsnānātsadyo vinaśyati || 22 || yathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣā mādirvai madhusūdanaḥ || tathādiḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ devakuṃḍamanuttamam || 23 || yastu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇamagnihotramupāsate || yastveko devakuṃḍesminkadācitsnāna mācaret || 24 || samameva tayoḥ puṇyaṃ nātra saṃdehakāraṇam || durlabhaṃ devatīrthesmindānaṃ vāsaśca durlabhaḥ || 25 || devatīrthābhigamanaṃ snānaṃ cāpya tidurlabham|| devatīrthaṃ samāsādya devarṣipitṛsevitam || 26 || aśvamedhamavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || dvidinaṃ tridinaṃ cāpi paṃca vātha ṣaḍeva vā || 27 || uṣitvā devakuṃḍasthatīre narakanāśane || na mātṛyonimāpnoti siddhiṃ cāpnotyanuttamām || 28 || trirātrasnānato hyatra vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet || devatīrthasmṛteḥ sadyaḥ pāpebhyo mucyate naraḥ || 29 || arcayitvā pitṝndevānetattīrthataṭe naraḥ || sarvakāmasamṛddhiḥ syātsarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 3.1.42.30 || etattīrthasamaṃ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || tasmādavaśyaṃ snātavyaṃ devatīrthe mumukṣubhiḥ || 31 || aihikāmuṣmikaphalaprāptikāmaiśca mānavaiḥ || devatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ saṃkṣipya kathitaṃ dvijāḥ || 32 || vistareṇāsya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na pāryyate || sugrīvatīrthaṃ vakṣyāmi rāmasetau vimuktide || 33 || atra snātvā naro bhaktyā sūryalokaṃ samaśnute || sugrīvatīrthe snānena hayamedhaphalaṃ bhavet || 34 || brahmahatyādi pāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiścāpi jāyate || sugrīvatīrthagamanādgosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 35 || smaraṇāttasya vedānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || dinopavāsamātreṇa tasya tīrthasya tīrataḥ.|| 36 || mahāpāta kanāśaḥ syātprāyaścittaṃ vinā dvijāḥ || tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvāṇaḥ pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet || 37 || āptoryāmasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || sugrīvatīrthasnānena naramedhaphalaṃ labheta || 39 || sugrīvatīrthasnānena naro jātismaro bhavet || sugrīvatīrthaṃ bho viprāḥ prayātābhīṣṭasiddhaye || 39 || sugrīvatīrthamā hātmyamevaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ dvijāḥ ||| vaibhavaṃ nalatīrthasya tvidānīṃ prabravīmi vaḥ || 3.1.42.40 ||| nalatīrthe naraḥ snānātsvargalokaṃ samaśnute|| nalatīrthe sakṛtsanānātsarvapāpāvimocitaḥ||41|| agniṣṭomātirātrādiphalamāpnotyanuttamam|| trirātramuṣitastasmiṃstarpayanpitṛdevatāḥ||42|| sūryavadbhāsate viprā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || nīlatīrthaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāpātakanāśanam || 43 || agniputreṇa nīlena kṛtaṃ setau vimuktidam || nīlatīrthe naraḥ snānātsarvapāpavimocitaḥ || 44 || bahuvarṇyasya yāgasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet || nīlatīrthe naraḥ snātvā sarvā bhīṣṭapradāyini || 45 || agnilokamavāpnoti sarvakāmasamṛddhimān || gavākṣeṇa kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 46 || vidyate snānamātreṇa narakaṃ naiva yāti saḥ || agadena kṛtaṃ tīrthamasti setau vimuktide || 47 || atra snānena manujo deveṃdratvaṃ samaśnute ||| gajena gavayenātra śarabheṇa mahaujasā || 48 || kumudena hareṇāpi panasena balīyasā || kṛtāni yāni tīrthāni tathā'nyaiḥ sarvavānaraiḥ || 49 ||| rāmasetau mahāpuṇye gandhamādanaparvate || teṣu tīrtheṣu yaḥ snāti so'mṛtatvaṃ samaśnute || 3.1.42.50 || vibhīṣaṇakṛtaṃ tīrthamasti pāpavimocanam || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ mahāroganibarhaṇam || 51 || mahāpātakasaṃghānāmanalopamamuttamam || kuṃbhīpākādinarakakleśanāśanakāraṇam || 52 || duḥsvapra nāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ mahādāridryabādhanam|| tatra yo manujaḥ snāyāttasya nāstīha pātakam || 53 || sa vaikuṃṭhamavāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam || vibhīṣaṇasya sacivaiḥ kṛtaṃ tīrthacatuṣṭayam || 54 || tatra snānena manujaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sarayūśca nadī viprā gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 55 || rāmanāthaṃ mahādevaṃ sevituṃ vartate sadā || tatra snātvā narāḥ sarve sarvapātakavarjitāḥ || 56 || sarvayajñatapastīrthasevāphalamavāpnuyuḥ || daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthāni dvijasattamāḥ || 57 || vasaṃtyasminmahāpuṇye gandhamādanaparvate || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstathā vai saptasāgarāḥ || 58 || ṛṣyāśramāṇi puṇyāni tathā puṇyavanāni ca || anuttamāni kṣetrāṇi hīraśaṃkarayostathā || 59 || sānnidhyaṃ kurvate nityaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || upavītāṃtaraṃ tīrthaṃ proktavāṃścaturānanaḥ || 3.1.42.60 || trayastriṃśatkoṭyo'tra devāḥ pitṛgaṇaiḥ saha || sarvaiśca munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ yakṣaiḥ siddhaiśca kinnaraiḥ || vasaṃti setau devasya rāmaca ndrasya cājñayā || 61 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā tīrthānāṃ vaibhavaṃ mayā || 62 || idaṃ paṭhanvā śṛṇvanvā duḥkhasaṃghādvimucyate || kaivalyaṃ ca samāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam || 63 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye sakalatīrthapraśaṃsāyāmṛṇamocanāditīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||42||
<3.1.43>
śrīsūta uvāca|| athedānīṃ pravakṣyāmi rāmanāthasya vaibhavam|| yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavo bhuvi||1|| rāmapratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ yaḥ paśyati naraḥ sakṛt || sa naro muktimāpnoti śivasāyujyarūpiṇīm || 2 || daśavarṣaistu yatpuṇyaṃ kriyate tu kṛte yuge || tretāyāmekavarṣeṇa tatpuṇyaṃ sādhyate nṛbhiḥ || 3 || dvāpare tacca māsena taddinena kalau yuge || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ nimiṣe nimiṣe nṛṇām || 4 || niḥsaṃdehaṃ bhavedevaṃ rāmanāthavilokinām || rāmeśvara mahāliṃge tīrthāni sakalānyapi ||5|| vidyaṃte sarvadevāśca munayaḥ pitarastathā || ekakāladvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ sarvadaiva vā ||6|| ye smaraṃti mahādevaṃ rāmanāthaṃ vimuktidam || kīrtayaṃtyathavā viprāste vimuktāghapaṃjarāḥ||7|| saccidānaṃdamadvaitaṃ sāṃbaṃ rudraṃ prayāṃti vai || rāmeśvarākhyaṃ yalliṃgaṃ rāmacandreṇa pūji tam ||8|| yasya smaraṇamātreṇa yamapīḍāpi no bhavet || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ ye'rcayaṃti sakṛnnarāḥ ||9|| na mānuṣāste vijñeyāḥ kiṃ tu rudrā na saṃśayaḥ || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ nārcitaṃ yena bhaktitaḥ || 3.1.43.10 || cirakālaṃ sa saṃsāre saṃsaredduḥkhasaṃkule || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ ye paśyaṃti sakṛnnarāḥ || 11 ||| kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vrataisteṣāṃ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ yo na ciṃtayati kṣaṇam ||12|| ajñānī sa ca pāpī syātsa mūko badhirastathā || sa jaḍoṃ'dhaśca vijñeyaśchidraṃ tasya sadā bhavet || 13 || dhanakṣetrasutādīnāṃ tasya hānistathā bhavet || rāmeśvaramahāliṃge sakṛddṛṣṭe munīśvarāḥ || 14 || kiṃ kāśyā gayayā kiṃ vā prayāgeṇāpi kiṃ phalam || durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ mānavā yatra bhūtale || 15 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ namasyaṃtyarcayaṃti ca ||| janma teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ te kṛtārthāśca netare ||16|| rāmeśvaramahāliṃge pūjite vā smṛtepi vā || viṣṇunā brahmaṇā kiṃ vā śakreṇāpyakhilāmaraiḥ ||17|| rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ bhaktiyuktāśca ye narāḥ || teṣāṃ praṇāmasmaraṇapūjāyuktāstu ye narāḥ || 18 || na te paśyaṃti duḥkhāni naiva yāṃti yamālayam || brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi surāpānāyutāni ca ||19|| dṛṣṭe rāmeśvare deve vilayaṃ yāṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || ye vāṃchaṃti sadā bhogaṃ rājyaṃ ca tridaśālaye ||3.1.43.20|| rāme śvaramahāliṃgaṃ te namaṃtu sakṛnmudā || yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmakoṭikṛtānyapi || 21 || tāni rāmeśvare dṛṣṭe vilayaṃ yāṃti sarvadā || saṃparkātkautukāllobhādbhayādvāpi ca saṃsmaran || 22 || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ nehāmutra ca duḥkhabhāk || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ kīrtayannarcayannapi || 23 || avaśyaṃ rudrasārūpyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || yathaidhāṃsi samiddho'gnirbhasmasātkurute kṣaṇāt || 24 || tathā pāpāni sarvāṇi rāmeśvaravilokanāt || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgabhaktiraṣṭavidhā smṛtā || 25 || tadbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ tatpūjāparitoṣaṇam || svayaṃ tatpūjanaṃ bhaktyā tadarthe dehaceṣṭitam || 26 || tanmāhātmyakathānāṃ ca śravaṇeṣvādarastathā || svaranetraśarīreṣu vikārasphuraṇaṃ tathā || 27 || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgasmaraṇaṃ saṃtataṃ tathā || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgamāśrityaivopajīvanam || 28 || evamaṣṭavidhā bhaktiryasminmlecche'pividyate || sa eva muktikṣetrāṇāṃ dāyabhākparikīrtyate || 29 || bhaktyā tvananyayā muktirbrahmajñānena niścitā || vedāṃtaśāstraśravaṇādyatīnāmūrdhvaretasām || 3.1.43.30 || sā ca muktirvinā jñānadarśanaśravaṇodbhavam || yatrāśramaṃ vinā viprā viraktiṃ ca vinā tathā || 31 || sarveṣāṃ caiva varṇānāmakhilāśramiṇāmapi || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgadarśanādeva kevalāt || 32 || apunarbhavadā muktirbha viṣyatyavilaṃbitā || kṛmikīṭāśca devāśca munayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 33 || tulyā rāmeśvarakṣetre rāmanāthaprasādataḥ || pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ mayānekamiti mā kriyatāṃ bhayam || 34 || mā garvaḥ kriyatāṃ puṇyaṃ mayākārīti vā janaiḥ || rāmeśvaramahāliṃge sāṃbarudre vilokite || 35 || na nyūnā nādhikāśca syuḥ kiṃ tu sarve janāḥ samāḥ || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ yaḥ paśyati sabhaktikam || 36 || na tena tulyatāmeti caturvedyapi bhūtale || rāmeśvaramahāliṃge bhakto yaḥ śvapaco'pi san || 37 || tasmai dānāni deyāni nānyasmai ca trayīvide || yā gatiryogayuktānāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām || 38 || sā gatiḥ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ rāmeśvaravilokinām || rāmanāthaśivakṣetre ye vasaṃti narā dvijāḥ || 39 || te sarve pañcavaktrāḥ syuścaṃdrālaṃkṛtamastakāḥ || nāgābharaṇasaṃyuktāstathaiva vṛṣabhadhvajāḥ || 3.1.43.40 || trinetrā bhasmadigdhāṃgāḥ kapālākṛtiśekharāḥ || sākṣātsāṃbā mahādevā bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ ||41 || rāmanāthaśivakṣetraṃ ye vrajaṃti narā mudā || padepade'śvamedhānāṃ prāpnuyuḥ sukṛtāni te || 42 || rāmasetuṃ samāśritya rāmanāthasya tuṣṭaye|| dadāti grāmamekaṃ yo brāhmaṇāya sabhaktikam ||43|| tena bhūḥ sakalā dattā saśailavanakānanā || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ rāmanāthāya yo naraḥ || 44 || bhaktyā dadāti taṃ rakṣedrāmanātho hyaharniśam|| rāmanāthamahāliṃge sāṃbe kāruṇike śive || 45 || atyaṃtadurlabhā bhaktistatpūjāpyatidurlabhā || stotraṃ ca durlabhaṃ proktaṃ smaraṇaṃ cātidurlabham || 46 || rāmanātheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevaṃ trilocanam || śaraṇaṃ ye prapadyaṃte bhaktiyuktena cetasā || 47 || lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣā miha loke paratra ca || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaviṣayā yasya śemuṣī || 48 || divārātraṃ ca bhavati sa vai dhanyataro bhuvi || rāmanātheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yo na pūjayate śivam|| 49 || nāyaṃ bhukteśca mukteśca rājyānāmapi bhājanam || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ yaḥ pūjayati bhaktitaḥ || 3.1.43.50 || bhuktimuktyośca rājyānāmasau paramabhājanam || rāmanāthārcanasamaṃ nādhikaṃ puṇyamasti vai || 51 || rāmanātheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ dveṣṭi yo mohamāsthitaḥ || brahmahatyāyutaṃ tena kṛtaṃ narakakāraṇam || 52 || tatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa mānavo narakaṃ vrajet || rāmanāthaparā devā rāmanāthaparā makhāḥ || 53 || rāmanāthaparāḥ sarve tasmāda nyanna vidyate || ataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya rāmanāthaṃ samāśrayet || 54 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāti cennaraḥ || daurmatyaṃ tasya nāstyeva śivalokaṃ ca yāsyati || 55 || sarvayajñatapodānatīrthasnāneṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ rāmanāthasya sevayā||56|| rāmanātheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ ciṃtayanghaṭikā dvayam || kulaikavaṃśamuddhṛtya śivaloke mahīyate || 57 || dinamekaṃ tu yaḥ paśyedrāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || ihaiva dhanavānbhūtvā soṃ'te rudraśca jāyate || 58 || yaḥ smaretprātarutthāya rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || anenaiva śarīreṇa sa śivo vartate bhuvi || 59 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgadraṣṭurdarśanamātrataḥ || anyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 3.1.43.60 || rāmanātheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ madhyāhne yastu paśyati || surāpānasahasrāṇi tasya naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || || 61 || sāyaṃkāle paśyati yo rāmanāthaṃ sabhaktikam || gurustrīgamanotpannapātakaṃ tasya naśyati || 62 || sāyaṃkāle mahāstotraiḥ stauti rāmeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ || svarṇasteyasahasrāṇi tasya naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 63 || snānaṃ ca dhanuṣaḥ koṭau rāmanāthasya darśanam || iti labhyeta vai puṃsāṃ kiṃ gaṃgājalasevayā || 64 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgasevayā yanna labhyate || tadanyaddharmajālena naiva labhyeta karhicit || 65 || rāmanāthaṃ mahāligaṃ yaḥ kadāpi na paśyati || saṃkaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo na piturbījasaṃbhavaḥ || 66 || rāmanāthetiśabdaṃ yastriḥ paṭhetprātarutthitaḥ || tasya pūrvadinotpannapātakaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt || 67 || rāmanāthe mahāliṃge bhaktarakṣaṇadīkṣite || bhojane vidyamāne'pi yācanāḥ kiṃ prayāsyatha || 68 || rāmanāthamahāliṃge prasanne karuṇānidhau || naśyaṃti sakalāḥ kleśā yathā sūryodaye himam || 69 || prāṇotkramaṇavelāyāṃ rāmanāthaṃ smaredyadi || janmane'sau na kalpeta bhūyaḥ śaṃkaratāmiyāt || 3.1.43.70 || rāmanātha mahādeva māṃ rakṣa karuṇānidhe || iti yaḥ satataṃ brūyātkalināsau na bādhyate || 71 || rāmanātha jagannātha dhūrjaṭe nīlalohita || iti yaḥ satataṃ brūyādbādhyate'sau na māyayā || 72 || nīlakaṇṭha mahādeva rāmeśvarasadāśiva || iti bruvansadā jaṃturnaiva kāmena bādhyate || 73 || rāmeśvara yamārāte kālakūṭaviṣādana || itīrayañjano nityaṃ na krodhena prapīḍyate || 74 || rāmanāthālayaṃ yastu dārubhiḥ kurute naraḥ || sa pumānsvargamāpnoti trikoṭikulasaṃyutaḥ || 75 || iṣṭakābhistu yaḥ kuryātsa vaikuṇṭhamavāpnuyāt || śilābhiḥ kurute yastu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam || 76 || sphaṭikādiśilābhedaiḥ kurvannasyālayaṃ janaḥ || śivalokamavāpnoti vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 77 || rāmanāthālayaṃ tāmraiḥ kurvanbhaktipuraḥsaram || śivasāmīpyamāpnoti śivasyārddhāsanasthitaḥ || 78 || rāmeśvarālayaṃ rūpyaiḥ kurvanvai mānavo mudā || śivasārūpyamāpnoti śivavanmodate sadā || 79 || rāmanāthālayaṃ hemnā yaḥ karoti sabhaktikam || sa naro muktimāpnoti śivasāyujyarūpiṇīm || 3.1.43.80 || rāmanāthālayaṃ hemnā dhanāḍhyaḥ kurute naraḥ || mṛdā daridraḥ kurute tayoḥ puṇyaṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 81 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgasnānakāle dvijottamāḥ || trisaṃdhyaṃ geyanṛtte ca mukhavādyaiśca kāhalam || 82 || vādyānyanyāni kurute yaḥ pumānbhaktipūrvakam || sa mahāpātakairmukto rudraloke mahīyate || || 83 || yobhiṣekasya samaye rāmanāthasya śūlinaḥ || rudrādhyāyaṃ ca camakaṃ tathā puruṣasūktakam || 84 || trisuparṇaṃ paṃcaśāṃtiṃ pāvamānyādikaṃ tathā || japetprītiyuto viprā narakaṃ na samaśnute || 85 || gavāṃ kṣīreṇa dadhnā ca paṃcagavyairghṛtaistathā || rāmanāthamahāliṃgasnānaṃ narakanāśanam || || 86 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ ghṛtena snāpayecca yaḥ || kalpajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 87 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ gokṣīraiḥ snāpayannaraḥ || kulaikaviṃśamuttārya śivaloke mahīyate || 88 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ dadhnā saṃsnāpayannaraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 89 || abhyaṃgaṃ tilatailena rāmeśvaraśivasya yaḥ || karoti hi sakṛdbhaktyā sa kuberagṛhe vaset || 3.1.43.90 || rāmanāthamahāliṃge snānamikṣurasena yaḥ || sakṛdapyācaredbha ktyā candralokaṃ samaśnute || 91 || likucāmrarasotpannasāreṇa snāpayannaraḥ || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ pitṛlokaṃ samaśnute || 92 || nālikerajalaiḥ snānaṃ rāmanāthamaheśvare || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ parikīrtitam || 93 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ raṃbhāpakvairvimardayan || vināśya sakalaṃ pāpaṃ vāyuloke mahī yate| 94 || vastrapūtena toyena rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || snāpayanvāruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti dvijasattamāḥ || 95 || caṃdanodakadhārābhī rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || snāpayetpuruṣo viprā gāṃdharvaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 96 || puṣpavāsitatoyena hemasaṃpṛktavāriṇā || padmavāsitatoyena snānādrāmeśvarasya tu || 97 || maheṃdrāsanamāruhya tenaiva saha modate|| pāṭalotpalakalhārapunnāgakaravīrakaiḥ 98 || vāsitairvāribhirviprā rāmeśvaramaheśvaram || abhiṣicya mahadbhiśca pātakaiḥ sa vimucyate || 99 || yāni cānyāni puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi mahāṃti ca || tadgaṃdhavāsitaistoyairabhiṣicya dayānidhim || 3.1.43.100 || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || elākarpūralāmajjavāsitaiḥ śuddhavāribhiḥ || 101 || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgamabhiṣicya viśuddhadhīḥ || āgneyaṃ lokamāsādya sarvākāmā nsamaśnute || 102 || rāmanāthābhiṣekārthaṃ mṛddhaṭānyaḥ prayacchati || iha loke śatāyuḥ syātsarvakāma samṛddhimān || 103 || tāmrakuṃbhapradānena deveṃdratvamavā pnuyāt || raupyakuṃbhapradānena brahmalokaṃ samaśnute || 104 || hemakuṃbhapradānena śivaloke mahīyate || ratnakuṃbhapradānena śivasāmīpyamaśnute ||105|| rāmanāthābhiṣekārthaṃ naivedyārthamapi dvijāḥ || yo gāṃ payasvinīṃ dadyātso'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 106 || prāpnoti śivaveṣaṃ ca dehāṃte śivalokabhāk|| rāmasetau dhanuṣkoṭau rāmanāthetyudīrya yaḥ || 107 || yatra kvāpyācaretsnānaṃ setusnānaphalaṃ labhet|| sudhāpraliptaṃ yaḥ kuryādrāmanāthaśivālayam || 108 || tatpuṇyaṃ gadituṃ nāhaṃ śakto varṣaśatādapi || navīkaroti yo martyo rāmanāthaśivālayam || 109 || kartuḥ śataguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ dvijāḥ || chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ ca yaḥ samyagrāmanāthaśivālayam || 3.1.43.110 || karoti bhaktyā puruṣo brahmahatyāyutaṃ dahet || rāmanāthasya purato dīpānāropayanmudā || 111 || avidyāpaṭalaṃ bhittvā yāti brahma sanātanam || ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā mudgāñcharkarāstaṃḍulānguḍān || 112 || prayacchanrāmanāthāya deveṃdrapadamaśnute || rāmanāthamahāliṃgadarśanādarcanātsmṛteḥ || 113 || sparśanādapi pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti tatkṣaṇāt|| rāmanāthāya yo dadyānmahāghaṃṭāṃ ca darpaṇam ||114|| vimānaśatasaṃ bhogaiściraṃ śivapure vaset || bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭaha niḥsāṇamurajādikam || 115 || vaṃśakāṃsyādivāditraṃ tathā vādyāṃtarāṇi ca || prayacchanrāmanāthāya mahāde vāya sādaram || 116 || sa vimānairmahābhogairvādyaghoṣasamanvitaiḥ || anekayugaparyaṃtaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 117 || rāmanāthaṃ samuddiśya yaddattaṃ svalpa mādarāt || tadanaṃtaphalaṃ dātuḥ paratra bhavati dhruvam || 118 || rāmeśvare mahākṣetre rāmanāthasya sannidhau || vasanmuktimavāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitām || || 119 || āyuḥ prayāti tvaritaṃ tvaritaṃ yāti yauvanam || tvaritaṃ saṃpado yāṃti dāraputrādayastathā || 3.1.43.120 || rājādibhirdhanaṃ bādhyaṃ gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ tathā || sarvaṃ ca kṣaṇikaṃ viprā gṛhopakaraṇādikam || 121 || tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya saṃsārasyopalālanam || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgamāpannārtiharaṃ nṛṇām || || 122 || śrotavyaṃ kīrtitavyaṃ ca smartavyaṃ ca manīṣibhiḥ || rāmeśvarāya devāya yo vai grāmānprayacchati || 123 || sa hi prārabdhadehāṃte śiva eva prajā yate || pātrāṇāmuttamaṃ pātraṃ rāmanātho maheśvaraḥ || 124 || tasmai dattvā dvijāḥ satyamanaṃtaṃ sukhamaśnute || rāmanāthamahāliṃgadarśanāvadhi pātakam || || 125 || dattvā tasmai janaḥ kiṃcitsārvabhaumo bhaveddhruvam || tālavṛṃtaṃ dhvajaṃ chatraṃ caṃdanaṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 126 || tāmrakāṃsyādirajatahemaratnamayāndha ṭān || prayacchaṃtyabhiṣekārthaṃ rāmanāthasya ye narāḥ || 127 || bhūmaṃḍalādhipatayo jāyaṃte te bhavāṃtare || rāmanāthasya pūjārthaṃ puṣpāṇyutpādayaṃti ye || || 128 || aśvamedhādiyāgānāṃ phalānyaddhāpnuvaṃti te || rāmeśvare mahāliṃge pūjite namite smṛte || 129 || śrute dṛṣṭe ca vipreṃdrā durlabhaṃ nāsti kiṃcana|| rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ sevituṃ yaḥ pumānvrajet || 3.1.43.130 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayamāpnoti tasya pāpaugha āśu vai || rāmanātho mahādevo dṛṣṭo yadi bhavennṛbhiḥ || 131|| kiṃvedaiḥ kimu vā śāstraiḥ kiṃ vā tīrthaniṣevaṇaiḥ|| caṃdanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ koṣṭhaṃ kastūrīṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 132 || mṛganābhiṃ ca saralaṃ dadyādrāmeśvarāya yaḥ || sa bhūmāviha jāyeta dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ || 133 || muktābharaṇavastrāṇi mahārhāṇi dadāti yaḥ || rāmanāthāya devāya nāsau daurgatyamāpnuyāt || 134 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ gaṃgātoyaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ || yo'bhiṣiṃcatyasau pūjyaḥ śivasyāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 135 || yāvanna yāti maraṇaṃ yāvannākramate jarā || yāvanneṃdriyavaikalyaṃ tāvadeva dvijottamāḥ ||136|| tāvadeva mahādevo rāmanātho mumukṣubhiḥ || vandyaḥ pūjyaśca maṃtavyaḥ stutyaśca satataṃ śivaḥ || 137 || rāmeśvaramahāliṃgapūjātulyo na vidyate || dharmaḥ sarvapurāṇeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu vai tathā || 138 || rāmanātheśvaraṃ devaṃ mahākāruṇikaṃ prabhum || bhaktyā bhajaṃti ye nityaṃ te bhūloke sukhānvitāḥ || 139 || bhuktvā bhogānbahusukhānputradārayutā bhṛśam || etaccharīrapātāṃte muktiṃ yāsyaṃti śāśvatīm || 3.1.43.140 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā rāmanāthasya vai bhavam || yastvetacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhate ca sabhaktikam || 141 || sa rāmanāthasevāyāḥ phalamāpnotyanuttamam || dhanuṣkoṭimahātīrthasnānapuṇyaṃ ca yāsyati || 142 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmanāthapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || ||
<3.1.44>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sarvavedārthatattvajña purāṇārṇavapāraga || vyāsapādāṃbujadvaṃdvanamaskārahṛtāśubha || 1 || purāṇārthopadeśena sarvaprāṇyupakā raka || tvayā hyanugṛhītāḥ sma purāṇakathanādvayam || 2 || adhunā setumāhātmyakathanātsutarāṃ mune || vayaṃ kṛtārthāḥ saṃjātā vyāsaśiṣya mahāmate || || 3 || yathā prātiṣṭhipalliṃgaṃ rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || tacchrotuṃ vayamicchāmastvamidānīṃ vadasva naḥ || 4 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || yadarthaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || rāmacandreṇa vipreṃdra tadidānīṃ bravīmi vaḥ || 5 || hṛtabhāryo vanādrāmo rāvaṇena balīyasā || kapisenāyuto dhīraḥ sasaumi trirmahābalaḥ ||6|| maheṃdraṃ girimāsādya vyalokayata vāridhim || tasminnapāre jaladhau kṛtvā setuṃ raghūdvahaḥ ||7|| tena gatvā purīṃ laṃkāṃ rāvaṇenābhirakṣi tām || astaṃgate sahasrāṃśau paurṇamāsyāṃ niśāmukhe||8|| rāmaḥ sasainiko viprāḥ suvelagirimāruhat || tataḥ saudhasthitaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭvā laṃkeśvaraṃ balī| || || 9 || sūryaputro'sya mukuṭaṃ pātayāsa bhūtale || rākṣaso bhagnamukuṭaḥ praviveśa gṛhodaram || 3.1.44.10 || gṛhaṃ praviṣṭe laṃkeśe rāmaḥ sugrīvasaṃyutaḥ || sānujaḥ senayā sārddhamavaruhya girestaṭāt ||11|| senāṃ nyaveśayadvīro rāmo laṃkāsamīpataḥ || tato niveśamānāṃstānvānarānrāvaṇānugāḥ || 12|| abhijagmurmahākāyāḥ sāyudhāḥ sahasainikāḥ || parvaṇaḥ pūtano jṛṃbhaḥ kharaḥ krodhavaśo hariḥ ||13|| prārujaścārujaścaiva prahastaścetare tathā || tato'bhipatatāṃ teṣāmadṛśyānāṃ durātmanām || 14 || antardhānavadhaṃ tatra cakāra sma vibhīṣaṇaḥ || te dṛśyamānā balibhirharibhirdūrapātibhiḥ || 15 || nihatāḥ sarvataścaite nyapatanvai gatāsavaḥ || amṛṣyamāṇaḥ sabalo rāvaṇo niryayāvatha || 16 || vyūhya tānvānarānsarvānnyavārayata sāyakaiḥ || rāghavastvatha niryāya vyūḍhānīko daśānanam || 17 || pratyayudhyata vegena dvaṃdvayuddhamabhūttadā || yuyudhe lakṣmaṇenātha iṃdrajidrāvaṇātmajaḥ || 18 || virūpākṣeṇa sugrīvastāreyeṇāpi kharvaṭaḥ || pauṃḍreṇa ca nalastatra puṭeśaḥ panasena ca || 19 || anyepi kapayo vīrā rākṣasairdvaṃdvametya tu || cakruryuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavarddhanam || 3.1.44.20 || atha rakṣāṃsi bhinnāni vānarairbhīmavikramaiḥ || pradudruvū raṇādāśu laṃkāṃ rāvaṇapālitām || 21 || bhagneṣu sarvasainyeṣu rāvaṇapreritena vai || putreṇeṃdrajitā yuddhe nāgāstrairatidāruṇaiḥ || 22 || viddhau dāśarathī viprā ubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau || mocitau vainateyena garuḍena mahātmanā || 23 || tatra prahastastarasā samabhyetya vibhīṣaṇam || gadayā tāḍayāmāsa vinadya raṇakarkaśaḥ || 24 || sa tayābhihato dhīmāngadayā bhāmivegayā || nākaṃpata mahābāhurhimavāniva susthitaḥ || 25 || tataḥ pragṛhya vipulāmaṣṭaghaṃṭāṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ || abhimaṃtrya mahāśaktiṃ cikṣe pāsya śiraḥ prati||26|| pataṃtyā sa tayā vegādrākṣaso'śaninā yathā| hṛtottamāṃgo dadṛśe vātarugṇa iva drumaḥ||27|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ saṃkhye prahastaṃ kṣaṇadācaram|| abhidudrāva dhūmrākṣo vegena mahatā kapīn||28|| kapisainyaṃ samālokya vidrutaṃ pavanātmajaḥ|| dhūmrākṣamājaghānāśu śareṇa raṇamūrdhani||29|| dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ || sarvaṃ rājñe yathāvṛttaṃ rāvaṇāya nyavedayan ||3.1.44.30|| tataḥ śayānaṃ laṃkeśaḥ kumbhakarṇamabodhayat || prabuddhaṃ preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya sa ca rāvaṇaḥ || 31 || āgataṃ kumbhakarṇaṃ taṃ brahmāstreṇa tu lakṣmaṇaḥ || jaghāna samare kruddho gatāsurnyapatacca saḥ || 32 || dūṣaṇasyānujau tatra vatravegapramāthinau || hanumannīlanihatau rāvaṇapratimau raṇe || 33 || vajradaṃṣṭraṃ samavadhīdviśvakarmasuto nalaḥ || akaṃpanaṃ ca nyahanatkumudo vānararṣabhaḥ || 34 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parājito rājā prāviśacca purīṃ tataḥ || atikāyo lakṣmaṇena hataśca triśirāstathā || 35 || sugrīveṇa hatau yuddhe devāṃta kanarāṃtakau || hanūmatā hatau yuddhe kumbhakarṇasutāvubhau || 36 || vibhīṣaṇena nihato makarākṣaḥ kharātmajaḥ || tata indrajitaṃ putraṃ codayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ||37|| indrajinmohayitvā tau bhrātarau rāmalakṣamaṇau|| ghoraiḥ śarairaṃgadena hatavāho divi sthitaḥ||38|| kumudāṃgadasugrīvanalajāṃbavadādibhiḥ|| sahitā vānarāḥ sarve nyapataṃstena ghātitāḥ||39|| evaṃ nihatya samare sasainyau rāmalakṣmaṇau|| aṃtardadhe tadā vyomni meghanādo mahābalaḥ || 3.1.44.40 || tato vibhīṣaṇo rāmamikṣvākukulabhūṣaṇam || uvāca prāṃjalirvākyaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || 41 || ayamaṃbho gṛhītvā tu rājarājasya śāsanāt || guhyako'bhyāgato rāma tvatsakāśamariṃdama || 42 || idamaṃbhaḥ kuberaste mahārāja prayacchati || aṃtarhitānāṃ bhūtānāṃ darśanārthaṃ paraṃ tapa || 43 || anena spṛṣṭanayano bhūtānyaṃtarhitānyapi || bhavāndrakṣyati yasmai vā bhavānetatpradāsyati || 44 || so'pi drakṣyati bhūtāni viyattyaṃtarhitāni vai || tatheti rāmastadvāri pratigṛhyātha satkṛtam || 45 || cakāra netrayoḥ śaucaṃ lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ | sugrīvajāṃbavantau ca hanumānaṃgadastathā || 46 || maiṃdadvividanīlāśca ye cānye vānarāstathā || te sarve rāmadattena vāriṇā śuddhacakṣuṣaḥ || 47 || ākāśeṃtarhitaṃ vīramapaśyanrāvaṇā tmajam || tatastamabhidudrāva saumitrirdṛṣṭigocaram || 48 || tato jaghāna saṃkuddho lakṣmaṇaḥ kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ || kuverapreṣitajalaiḥ pavitrīkṛtalocanaḥ || || 49 || tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ lakṣmaṇeṃdrajitormahat || atīva citramāścaryaṃ śakraprahlādayoriva || 3.1.44.50 || tatastṛtīyadivase yatnena mahatā dvijāḥ || iṃdrajinnihato yuddhe lakṣmaṇena balīyasā || 51 || tato mūlabalaṃ sarvaṃ hataṃ rāmeṇa dhīmatā || atha kruddho daśagrīvaḥ priyaputre nipātite || 52 || niryayau rathamāsthāya nagarādbahusainikaḥ || rāvaṇo jānakīṃ hantumudyukto viṃdhyavāritaḥ || 53 || tato haryaśvayuktena rathenādityavarcasā || upatasthe raṇe rāmaṃ mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ || 54 || aindraṃ rathaṃ samāruhya rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || śirāṃsi rākṣasendrasya brahmāstreṇāvadhīdraṇe || 55 || tato hatadaśagrīvaṃ rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam || āśīrbhirjayayuktābhirdevāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ || 56 || tuṣṭuvuḥ parisaṃtuṣṭāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā || rāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ puṣpa varṣeravākiran || 57 || rāmastaiḥ surasaṃghātaiḥ sahitaḥ sainikairvṛtaḥ || sītāsaumitrisahitaḥ samāruhya ca puṣpakam || 58 || tathābhiṣicya rājānaṃ laṃkāyāṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam || kapisenāvṛto rāmo gandhamādanamanvagāt ||59|| pariśodhya ca vaidehīṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate || rāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ sthitavānara saṃvṛtam || 3.1.44.60 || hatalaṃkeśvaraṃ vīraṃ sānujaṃ savibhīṣaṇam || sabhāryaṃ devavṛṃdaiśca sevitaṃ munipuṃgavaiḥ || 61 || munayo'bhyāgatā draṣṭuṃ daṃḍakāraṇya vāsinaḥ || agastyaṃ te puraskṛtya tuṣṭuvurmaithilīpatim || 62 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || namaste rāmacaṃdrāya lokānugrahakāriṇe || arāvaṇaṃ jagatkartumavatīrṇāya bhūtale || 63 || tāṭikādehasaṃhartre gādhijādhvararakṣiṇe || namaste jitamārīca suvāhuprāṇahāriṇe || 64 || ahalyāmuktisaṃdāyipādapaṃkajareṇave || namaste harakodaṇḍalīlābhañjanakāriṇe || 65 || namaste maithilīpāṇigrahaṇotsavaśāline || namaste reṇukāputraparājayavidhāyine || 66 || sahalakṣmaṇasītābhyāṃ kaikeyyāstu varadvayāt || satyaṃ pitṛvacaḥ kartuṃ namo vanamupe yuṣe || 67 || bharataprārthanādattapādukāyugulāya te || namaste śarabhaṃgasya svargaprāptyaikahetave || 68 || namo virādhasaṃhartre gṛdharājasa khāya te || māyāmṛgamahākrūramārīcāṃgavidāriṇe || 69 || sītāpahārilokeśayuddhatyaktakalevaram || jaṭāyuṣaṃ tu saṃdahya tatkaivalyapradāyine || || 3.1.44.70 || namaḥ kabaṃdhasaṃhartre śavarīpūjitāṃghraye || prāptasugrīvasakhyāya kṛtavālivadhāya te || 71 || namaḥ kṛtavate setuṃ samudre varuṇālaye || sarvarākṣasasaṃhartre rāvaṇaprāṇahāriṇe || 72 || saṃsārāṃbudhisaṃtārapotapādāṃbujāya te || namo bhaktārtisaṃhartre saccidānaṃdarūpiṇe || 73 || namaste rāma bhadrāya jagatāmṛddhihetave || rāmādipuṇyanāmāni japatāṃ pāpahāriṇe || 74 || namaste sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthityaṃtakāriṇe || namaste karuṇāmūrte bhaktarakṣaṇadīkṣita || 785 || sasītāya namastubhyaṃ vibhīṣaṇasukhaprada || laṃkeśvaravadhādrāma pālitaṃ hi jagattvayā || 76 || rakṣarakṣa jagannātha pāhya smāñjānakīpate || stutvaivaṃ munayaḥ sarve tūṣṇīṃ tasthurdvijottamāḥ || 77 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || ya idaṃ rāmacandrasya stotraṃ munibhirīritam || trisaṃdhyaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca viṃdati || 78 || prayāṇakāle paṭhato n bhītirupajāyate || etatstotrasya paṭhanādbhūtavetālakādayaḥ || || 79 || naśyaṃti rogā naśyaṃti naśyate pāpasaṃcayaḥ || putrakāmo labhetputraṃ kanyā viṃdati satpatim || 3.1.44.80 || mokṣakāmo labhenmokṣaṃ dhanakāmo dhanaṃ labhet|| sarvānkāmānavāpnoti paṭhanbhaktyā tvimaṃ stavam || 81 || tato rāmo munīnprāha praṇamya ca kṛtāṃjaliḥ || ahaṃ viśuddhaye prāpyaḥ sakalairapi mānavaiḥ || 82 || maddṛṣṭigocaro janturnityamokṣasya bhājanam || tathāpi munayo nityaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā || 83 || svātmalābhena saṃtuṣṭānsādhūnbhūtasuhṛttamān || nirahaṃkāriṇaḥ śāṃtānnamasyāmyūrdhvaretasaḥ || 84 || yasmādbrahmaṇyadevo'hamato viprānbhaje sadā || yuṣmānpṛcchāmyahaṃ kiṃcittadvadadhvaṃ vicārya tu || 85 || rāvaṇasya vadhādviprā yatpāpaṃ mama vartate || tasya me niṣkṛtiṃ brūta paulastyavadhajasya hi || yatkṛtvā tena pāpe na mucye'haṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 86 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || satyavrata jagannātha jagadrakṣādhuraṃdhara || 87 || sarvalokopakārārthaṃ kuru rāma śivārcanam || gandhamādanaśṛṃge'sminmahāpuṇye vimuktide || 88 || śivaliṃgapratiṣṭhāṃ tvaṃ lokasaṃgrahakāmyayā || kuru rāma daśagrīvavadhadoṣāpanuttaye || ||89|| liṃgasthāpanajaṃ puṇyaṃ caturvaktro'pi bhāṣitum|| na śaknoti tato vaktuṃ kiṃ punarmanujeśvara||3.1.44.9||| yattvayā sthāpyate ligaṃ gandhamādanaparvate || asya saṃdarśanaṃ puṃsāṃ kāśīliṃgāvalokanāt || 91 || adhikaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ phalavatsyānna saṃśayaḥ || tava nāmnā tvidaṃ liṃgaṃ loke khyātiṃ samaśnutām || 92 || nāśakaṃ puṇyapāpākhyakāṣṭhānāṃ dahanopamam || idaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati || 93 || mā vilaṃbaṃ kuruṣvāto liṃgasthāpanakarmaṇi || rāmacaṃdra mahābhāga karuṇāpūrṇavigraha || 94 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti śrutvā vaco rāmo munīnāṃ taṃ munīśvarāḥ || puṇyakālaṃ vicāryātha dvimuhūrtaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 95 || kailāsaṃ preṣayāmāsa hanumantaṃ śivālayam || śivaliṃgaṃ samānetuṃ sthāpanārthaṃ raghūdvahaḥ || 96 || || rāma uvāca || || hanūmannaṃjanīsūno vāyuputra mahābala || kailāsaṃ tvarito gatvā liṃgamānaya mā ciram || 97 || ityājñaptassa rāmeṇa bhujāvāsphālya vīryavān || muhūrtadvitayaṃ jñātvā puṇyakālaṃ kapīśvaraḥ || 98 || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām || utpapāta mahāvegaścālayangaṃdhamādanam ||99|| laṃghayansa viyanmārgaṃ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ yayau || na dadarśa mahādevaṃ liṃgarūpadharaṃ kapiḥ||3.1.44.100|| kailāse parvate tasminpuṇye śaṃkarapālite || āṃjaneyastapastepe liṃgaprāptyarthamādarāt || 101 || prāgagreṣu samāsīnaḥ kuśeṣu munipuṃgavāḥ || ūrdhvabāhurnirālambo nirucchvāso jiteṃdriyaḥ || 102 || prasādayanmahādevaṃ liṃgaṃ lebhe sa mārutiḥ || etasminnaṃtare viprā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 103 || anāgataṃ hanūmaṃtaṃ kālaṃ svalpāvaśeṣitam || jñātvā prakathitaṃ tatra rāmaṃ prati mahāmatim || 104 || rāmarāma mahābāho kālo hyatyeti sāṃpratam || jānakyā yatkṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ saikataṃ līlayā vibho || 105 || talliṃgaṃ sthāpayasvādya mahāliṃgamanuttamam || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ rāmo jānakyā saha satvaram || 106 || munibhiḥ sahitaḥ prītyā kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ || jyeṣṭhe māse site pakṣe daśamyāṃ budhahastayoḥ || 107 || garānaṃde vyatīpāte kanyā candre vṛṣe ravau || daśayoge mahāpuṇye gandhamādanaparvate || 108 || setumadhye mahādevaṃ liṃgarūpadharaṃ haram || īśānaṃ kṛttivasanaṃ gaṃgācaṃdrakalādharam || 109 || rāmo vai sthāpayāmāsa śivaliṃgamanuttamam || liṃgasthaṃ pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ sāṃbamīśvaram || 3.1.44.110 || liṃgasthaḥ sa mahādevaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ || pratyakṣameva bhagavāndattavānvaramuttamam || 111 || sarvalokaśaraṇyāya rāghavāya mahātmane || tvayātra sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ ye paśyaṃti raghūdvaha || 112 || mahāpātakayuktāśca teṣāṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyati || sarvāṇyapi hi pāpāni dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || 113 || darśanādrāmaliṃgasya pātakāni mahāṃtyapi || vilayaṃ yāṃti rājeṃdra rāmacandra na saṃśayaḥ || 114 || prādādevaṃ hi rāmāya varaṃ devoṃ'bikāpatiḥ || tadagre naṃdikeśaṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || 115 || īśvarasyābhiṣekārthaṃ dhanuṣkoṭyātha rāghavaḥ || ekaṃ kūpaṃ dharāṃ bhittvā janayāmāsa vai dvijāḥ || 116 || tasmājjalamupādāya snāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram || koṭitīrthamiti proktaṃ tattīrthaṃ puṇyamuttamam || 117 || uktaṃ tadvaibhavaṃ pūrvamasmābhirmunipuṃgavāḥ || devāśca munayo nāgā gandharvāpsa rasāṃ gaṇāḥ || sarvepi vānarā liṃgamekaikaṃ cakrurādarāt || 118 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yathā rāmeṇa dhīmata ||119 |||| sthāpitaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ vai bhuktimuktipradāyakam || imāṃ liṃgapratiṣṭhāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhate'thavā || 3.1.44.120 || sa rāmeśvaraliṃgasya sevāphalamavāpnuyāt |||| sāyujyaṃ ca samāpnoti rāmanāthasya vaibhavāt || 121 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmanāthaliṃgapratiṣṭhāvidhivarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
<3.1.45>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ pratiṣṭhite liṃge rāmeṇākliṣṭakāriṇā || liṃgaṃ varaṃ samādāya mārutiḥ sahasā''yayau || 1 || rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ vīramabhivādya sa mārutiḥ || vaidehīlakṣmaṇau paścātsugrīvaṃ praṇanāma ca || 2 || sītā saikataliṃgaṃ tatpūjayaṃtaṃ raghūdvaham || dṛṣṭvātha munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ cukopa pavanātmajaḥ || 3 || atyaṃtaṃ khedakhinnaḥ sanvṛthākṛtapariśramaḥ || uvāca rāmaṃ dharmajñaṃ hanūmānaṃjanātmajaḥ || 4 || || hanūmānuvāca || || durjāto'haṃ vṛthā rāma loke kleśāya kevalam || khinno'smi bahuśo deva rākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ || 5 || mā sma sīmaṃtinī kācijjanayenmādṛśaṃ sutam || yato'nubhūyate duḥkhamanaṃtaṃ bhavasāgare || 6 || khinno'smi sevayā pūrvaṃ yuddhenāpi tatodhikam|| anantaṃ duḥkhamadhunā yato māmavamanyase || 7 || sugrīveṇa ca bhāryārthaṃ rājyārthaṃ rākṣasena ca || rāvaṇāvarajena tvaṃ sevito 'si raghūdvaha || 8 || mayā nirhetukaṃ rāma sevito'si mahāmate || vānarāṇāmanekeṣu tvayājñapto'hamadya vai || 9 || śivaliṃgaṃ samānetuṃ kailāsātparvato ttamāt || kailāsaṃ tvarito gatvā na cāpaśyaṃ pinākinam || 3.1.45.10 || tapasā prīṇayitvā taṃ sāṃbaṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam || prāptaliṃgo raghupate tvaritaḥ samu pāgataḥ || 11 || anyaliṃgaṃ tvamadhunā pratiṣṭhāpya tu saikatam || munibhirdevagandharvaiḥ sākaṃ pūjayase vibho || 12 || mayānītamidaṃ liṃgaṃ kailāsā tparvatādvṛthā || aho bhārāya me deho mandabhāgyasyajāyate || 13 || bhūtalasya mahārāja jānakīramaṇa prabho || idaṃ duḥkhamahaṃ soḍhuṃ na śaknomi raghūdvaha || 14 || kiṃ kariṣyāmi kutrāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi na me gatiḥ || ataḥ śarīraṃ tyakṣyāmi tvayāhamavamānitaḥ || 15 || || śrīsūta uvāca || evaṃ sa bahuśo viprāḥ kruśitvā pavanātmajaḥ || daṇḍavatpraṇato bhūmau krodhaśokākulo'bhavat || 16 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā raghunātho'pi prahasannidamabravīt || paśyatāṃ savadevānāṃ munīnāṃ kapirakṣasām || sāṃtvayanmārutiṃ tatra duḥkhaṃ cāsya pramārjayan || 17 || || śrīrāma uvāca || sarvaṃ jānāmyahaṃ kāryamātmano'pi parasya ca || 18 || jātasya jāyamānasya mṛtasyāpi sadā kape || jāyate mriyate jantureka eva svakarmaṇā 19 || prayāti narakaṃ cāpi paramātmā tu nirguṇaḥ || evaṃ tattvaṃ viniścitya śokaṃ mā kuru vānara || 3.1.45.20 || liṃgatrayavinirmuktaṃ jyotirekaṃ niraṃjanam || nirāśrayaṃ nirvikāramātmānaṃ paśya nityaśaḥ || 21 || kimarthaṃ kuruṣe śokaṃ tattvajñānasya bādhakam || tattvajñāne sadā niṣṭhāṃ kuru vānarasattama || 22 || svayaṃprakāśamātmānaṃ dhyāyasva satataṃ kape || dehādau mamatāṃ muṃca tattvajñānavirodhinīm || 23 || dharmaṃ bhajasva satataṃ prāṇihiṃsāṃ parityaja || sevasva sādhupuruṣāñjahi sarveṃdriyāṇi ca || 24 || parityajasva satatamanyeṣāṃ doṣakīrtanam || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāmarcāṃ kuru sadā kape || 25 || satyaṃ vadasva satataṃ parityaja śucaṃ kape || pratyagbrahmaikatājñānaṃ mohavastusamudgatam || 26 || śobhanāśobhanā bhrāṃtiḥ kalpi tāsminyathārthavat || adhyāste śobhanatvena padārthe mohavaibhavāt || 27 || rogo vijāyate nṛṇāṃ bhrāṃtānāṃ kapisattama || rāgadveṣabalādbaddhā dharmā dharmavaśaṃgatāḥ || 28 || devatiryaṅmanuṣyādyā nirayaṃ yāṃti mānavāḥ || caṃdanāgarukarpūrapramukhā atiśobhanāḥ || 29 || malaṃ bhavaṃti yatsparśāttaccharīraṃ kathaṃ sukham|| bhakṣyabhojyādayaḥ sarve padārthā atiśobhanāḥ ||3.1.45.30|| viṣṭhā bhavaṃti yatsaṃgāttaccharīraṃ kathaṃ sukham|| sugaṃdhi śītalaṃ toyaṃ mūtraṃ yatsaṃgamādbhavet ||31|| tatkathaṃ śobhanaṃ piṃḍaṃ bhavedbrūhi kape'dhunā || atīva dhavalāḥ śuddhāḥ paṭā yatsaṃgamenahi ||32|| bhavaṃti malināḥ svedāttatkathaṃ śobhanaṃ bhaveta || śrūyatāṃ paramārtho me hanūmanvāyunaṃdana || 33 || asminsaṃsāragarte tu kiṃcitsaukhyaṃ na vidyate || prathamaṃ jaṃturāpnoti janma bālyaṃ tataḥ param || ||34|| paścādyauvanamāpnoti tato vārdhakyamaśnute || paścānmṛtyumavāpnoti punarjanma tadaśnute ||35|| ajñānavaibhavādeva duḥkhamāpnoti mānavaḥ || tadajñāna nivṛttau tu prāpnoti sukhamuttamam ||36|| ajñānasya nivṛttistu jñānādeva na karmaṇā || jñānaṃ nāma paraṃ brahma jñānaṃ vedāṃtavākyajam ||37|| tajjñānaṃ ca viraktasya jāyate netarasya hi || mukhyādhikāriṇaḥ satyamācāryasya prasādataḥ ||39|| yadā sarve pramucyaṃte kāmā ye'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ || tadā martyo'mṛto'traiva paraṃ brahma samaśnute || 39 || jāgrataṃ ca svapaṃtaṃ ca bhuṃjaṃtaṃ ca sthitaṃ tathā || imaṃ janaṃ sadā krūraḥ kṛtāṃtaḥ parikarṣati || 3.1.45.40 || sarve kṣayāṃtā nicayāḥ patanāṃtāḥ samucchrayāḥ || saṃyogā viprayogāṃtā maraṇāṃtaṃ ca jīvitam || 41 || yathā phalānāṃ pakvānāṃ nānyatra patanādbhayam || yathā narāṇāṃ jātānāṃ nānyatra patanādbhayam || 42 || yathā gṛhaṃ dṛḍhastaṃbhaṃ jīrṇaṃ kāle vinaśyati || evaṃ vinaśyaṃti narā jarāmṛtyuvaśaṃgatāḥ || 43 || ahorātrasya gamanānnṛṇāmāyurvinaśyati || ātmānamanuśoca tvaṃ kimanyamanuśocasi || 44 || naśyatyāyuḥ sthitasyāpi dhāvato'pi kapīśvara || sahaiva mṛtyurvrajati saha mṛtyurniṣīdati || 45 || caritvā dūradeśaṃ ca saha mṛtyurnivartate || śarīre valayaḥ prāptāḥ śvetā jātāḥ śiroruhāḥ || 46 || jīryate jarayā dehaḥ śvāsakāsādinā tathā || yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau || 47 || sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ kālayogena vānara || evaṃ bhāryā ca putraśca vadhukṣetradhanāni ca || 48 || kvacitsaṃbhūya gacchaṃti punaranyatra vānara || yathā hi pāṃthaṃ gacchaṃtaṃ pathi kaścitpathi sthitaḥ|| 49 || ahamapyā gamiṣyāmi bhavadbhiḥ sākamityatha || kaṃcitkālaṃ sametau tau punaranyatra gacchataḥ || 3.1.45.50 || evaṃ bhāryāsutādīnāṃ saṃgamo naśvaraḥ kape || śarīrajanmanā sākaṃ mṛtyuḥ saṃjāyate dhruvam || 51 || avaśyaṃbhāvimaraṇe na hi jātu pratikriyā || etaccharīrapāte tu dehī karmagatiṃ gataḥ || 52 || prāpya piṃḍāṃtaraṃ vatsa pūrvapiṃḍaṃ tyajatyasau || prāṇināṃ na sadaikatra vāso bhavati vānara || 53 || svasvakarmavaśātsarve viyujyaṃte pṛthakpṛthak || yathā prāṇiśarīrāṇi naśyaṃti ca bhavaṃti ca || 54 || ātmano janmamaraṇe naiva staḥ kapisattama || atastvamaṃjanāsūno viśokaṃ jñānamadvayaṃ ||| || 55 || sadrūpamamalaṃ brahma ciṃtayasva divāniśam || tvatkṛtaṃ matkṛtaṃ karma matkṛtaṃ tvākṛtaṃ tathā || 56 || malliṃgasthāpanaṃ tasmāttvalliṃga sthāpanaṃ kape || muhūrtātikramālliṃgaṃ saikataṃ sītayā kṛtam || 57 || mayātra sthāpitaṃ tasmātkopaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca mā kuru || kailāsādāgataṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpayāsmicchubhe dine || 58 || tava nāmnā tvidaṃ liṃgaṃ yātu lokatraye prathām || hanūmadīśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā draṣṭavyo rāghaveśvaraḥ || 59 || brahmarākṣasayūthāni hatāni bhavatā kape || ataḥ svanāmnā liṃgasya sthāpanāttvaṃ pramokṣyase || 3.1.45.60 || svayaṃ hareṇa dattaṃ tu hanūmannāmakaṃ śivam || saṃpaśyanrāmanāthaṃ ca kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 61 || yojanānāṃ sahasre'pi smṛtvā liṃgaṃ hanūmataḥ || rāmanātheśvaraṃ cāpi smṛtvā sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 62 || teneṣṭaṃ sarvayajñaiśca tapaścākāri kṛtsnaśaḥ || yena dṛṣṭau mahādevau hanūmadrāghaveśvarau || 63 || hanūmatā kṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ yacca liṃgaṃ mayā kṛtam || jānakīyaṃ ca yalliṃgaṃ yalliṃgaṃ lakṣmaṇeśvaram || 64 || sugrīveṇa kṛtaṃ yacca setukartrā nalena ca || aṃgadena ca nīlena tathā jāṃbavatā kṛtam || 65 || vibhīṣaṇena yaccāpi ratnaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || indrādyaiśca kṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ yaccheṣādyaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || 66 || ityekādaśarūpo'yaṃ śivaḥ sākṣādvibhāsate || sadā hyeteṣu liṃgeṣu saṃnidhatte maheśvaraḥ || 67 || tatsvapāpaughaśuddhyarthaṃ sthāpayasva maheśvaram || atha cettvaṃ mahābhāga liṃgamutsādayiṣyasi || 68 || mayātra sthāpitaṃ vatsa sītayā saikataṃ kṛtam || sthāpayiṣyāmi ca tato liṃgametattvayā kṛtam || 69 || pātālaṃ sutalaṃ prāpya vitalaṃ ca rasātalam || talātalaṃ ca tadidaṃ bhedayitvā tu tiṣṭhati || 3.1.45.70 || pratiṣṭhitaṃ mayā liṃgaṃ bhettuṃ kasya balaṃ bhavet || uttiṣṭha liṃgamudvāsya mayaitatsthāpitaṃ kape || || 71 || tvayā samāhṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpayasvāśu mā śucaḥ || ityuktastaṃ praṇamyāthājñātasattvo'tha vānaraḥ || 72 || udvāsayāmi vegena saikataṃ liṃgamutta mam|| saṃsthāpayāmi kailāsādānītaṃ liṃgamādarāt || 73 || udvāsane saikatasya kiyānbhāro bhavenmama || cetasaivaṃ vicāryāyaṃ hanūmānmārutā tmajaḥ || 74 || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnāṃ kapirakṣasām || paśyato rāmacandrasya lakṣmaṇasyāpi paśyataḥ || 75 || paśyaṃtyā api vaidehyā liṃgaṃ tatsaikataṃ balāt || pāṇinā sarvayatnena jagrāha tarasā balī || 76 || yatnena mahatā cāyaṃ cālayannapi mārutiḥ || nālaṃ cālayituṃ hyāsītsaikataṃ liṃgamojasā || 77 || tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ kurvanvānarapuṃgavaḥ || pucchamudyamya pāṇibhyāṃ nirāsthattannijaujasā || 78 || ityanekaprakāreṇa cāla yannapi vānaraḥ || naiva cālayituṃ śakto babhūva pavanātmajaḥ || 79 || tadveṣṭayitvā pucchena pāṇibhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ spṛśan || utpapātātha tarasā vyomni vāyusutaḥ kapiḥ || 3.1.45.80 || kaṃpayansa dharāṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatam || liṃgasya krośamātre tu mūrcchito rudhiraṃ vaman || 81 || papāta hanumānviprāḥ kaṃpitāṃgo dharātale || patato vāyuputrasya vaktrācca nayanadvayāt || 82 || nāsāpuṭācchrotraraṃdhrādapānācca dvijottamāḥ || rudhiraughaḥ prasusrāva raktakuṇḍa mabhūcca tat|| 83 || tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || dhāvaṃtau kapibhiḥ sārddhamubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau || 84 || jānakīsahitau viprā hyāstāṃ śokākulau tadā || sītayā sahitau vīrau vānaraiśca mahābalau || 85 || rurucāte tadā viprā gandhamādanaparvate || yathā tārāgaṇayutau rajanyāṃ śaśi bhāskarau || 86 || dadarśaturhanūmaṃtaṃ cūrṇīkṛtakalevaram|| mūrcchitaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau vamantaṃ rudhiraṃ mukhāt|| 87 || vilokya kapayaḥ sarve hāhākṛtvā'patanbhuvi || karābhyāṃ sadayaṃ sītā hanūmaṃtaṃ marutsutam|| 88 || tātatāteti pasparśa patitaṃ dharaṇītale || rāmo'pi dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ hanūmaṃtaṃ kapīśvaram || | 89 || āropyāṃkaṃ svapāṇibhyāmāmamarśa kalevaram || vimuṃcannetrajaṃ vāri vāyujaṃ cāvravīddvijāḥ || 3.1.45.90 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmacandratattvajñānopadeśavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 || || cha || ||
<3.1.46>
|| śrīrāma uvāca|| paṃpāraṇye vayaṃ dīnāstvayā vānarapuṃgava|| āśvāsitāḥ kārayitvā sakhyamādityasūnunā||1|| tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ bandhūnkausalyāṃ jananīmapi || na smarāmo vayaṃ sarvānme tvayopakṛtaṃ bahu|| 2 || madarthaṃ sāgarastīrṇo bhavatā bahu yojanaḥ || talaprahārābhihato maināko'pi nagottamaḥ || 3 || nāgamātā ca surasā madarthaṃ bhavatā jitā || chāyāgrahāṃ mahākrūrāma vadhīdrākṣasīṃ bhavān || 4 || sāyaṃ suvelamāsādya laṃkāmāhatya pāṇinā || ayāsī rāvaṇagṛhaṃ madarthaṃ tvaṃ mahākape || 5 || sītāmanviṣya laṃkāyāṃ rātrau gatabhayo bhavān|| adṛṣṭvā jānakīṃ paścādaśokavanikāṃ yayau || 6 || namaskṛtya ca vaidehīmabhijñānaṃ pradāya ca || cūḍāmaṇiṃ samādāya madarthaṃ jānakīkarāt || 7 || aśokavanikāvṛkṣānabhāṃkṣīstvaṃ mahākape || tatastvaśītisāhasrānkiṃkarānnāma rākṣasān || 8 || rāvaṇapratimānyuddhe patyaśvebharathākulān || avadhīstvaṃ madarthe vai mahābalaparākramān || 9 || tataḥ prahastatanayaṃ jaṃbumālinamāgatam || avadhīnmaṃtritanayānsapta saptārcivarcasaḥ || 3.1.46.10 || paṃca senāpatīnpaścādanayastvaṃ yamālayam || kumāramakṣamavadhīstatastvaṃ raṇamūrdhani || 11 || tata indrajitā nīto rākṣaseṃdra sabhāṃ śubhām || tatra laṃkeśvaraṃ vācā tṛṇīkṛtyāvamanya ca || 12 || abhāṃkṣīstvaṃ purīṃ laṃkāṃ madarthaṃ vāyunaṃdana || punaḥ pratinivṛttastvamṛṣyamūkaṃ mahāgirim || 13 || evamādi mahāduḥkhaṃ madarthaṃ prāptavānasi || tvamatra bhūtale śeṣe mama śokamudīrayan || 14 || ahaṃ prāṇānparityakṣye mṛto'si yadi vāyuja || sītayā mama kiṃ kāryaṃ lakṣmaṇenānujena vā || 15 || bharatenāpi kiṃ kāryaṃ śatrughnena śriyāpi vā || rājyenāpi na me kāryaṃ paretastvaṃ kape yadi || 16 || uttiṣṭha hanumanvatsa kiṃ śeṣe'dya mahītale || śayyāṃ kuru mahābāho nidrārthaṃ mama vānara || 17 || kandamūlaphalāni tvamāhārārthaṃ mamāhara || snātumadya gamiṣyāmi śīghraṃ kalaśamānaya || 18 || ajināni ca vāsāṃsi darbhāṃśca samupāhara || brahmāstreṇāvabaddho'haṃ mocitaśca tvayā hare || 19 || lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā hyauṣadhānayanena vai || lakṣmaṇaprāṇadātā tvaṃ paulastyamadanāśanaḥ || 3.1.46.20 || sahāyena tvayā yuddhe rākṣasā nrāvaṇādikān || nihatyātibalānvīrānavāpaṃ maithilīmaham || 21 || hanūmannaṃjanāsūno sītāśokavināśana || kathamevaṃ parityajya lakṣmaṇaṃ māṃ ca jānakīm || 22 || aprāpayitvāyodhyāṃ tvaṃ kimarthaṃ gatavānasi || kva gatosi mahāvīra mahārākṣasakaṇṭaka || 23 || iti paśyanmukhaṃ tasya nirvākyaṃ raghunaṃdanaḥ || prarudannaśrujālena secayāmāsa vāyujam || 24 || vāyuputrastato mūrcchāmapahāya śanairdvijāḥ || paulastyabhayasaṃtrastalokarakṣārthamāgatam||25|| āśritya mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum|| jānakīlakṣmaṇayutaṃ kapibhiḥ parivāritam||26|| kālāṃbhodharasaṃkāśaṃ raṇadhūlisamukṣitam || jaṭāmaṇḍalaśobhāḍhyaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam || 27 || khinnaṃ ca bahuśo yuddhe dadarśa raghunaṃdanam || stūyamānamamitraghnaṃ devarṣipitṛkinnaraiḥ || 28 || dṛṣṭvā dāśarathiṃ rāmaṃ kṛpābahulacetasam || raghunāthakarasparśapūrṇagātraḥ sa vānaraḥ || 29 || patitvā daṇḍavadbhūmau kṛtāṃjalipuṭo dvijāḥ || astauṣījjānakīnāthaṃ stotraiḥ śrutimanoharaiḥ || 3.1.46.30 || || hanūmānuvāca || || namo rāmāya haraye viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave || ādidevāya devāya purāṇāya gadābhṛte || 31 || viṣṭare puṣpakaṃ nityaṃ niviṣṭāya mahātmane || prahṛṣṭavānarānīkajuṣṭapādāṃbujāya te || 32 || niṣpiṣṭa rākṣaseṃdrāya jagadiṣṭavidhāyine || namaḥ sahasraśirase sahasracaraṇāya ca || 33 || sahasrākṣāya śuddhāya rāghavāya ca viṣṇave || bhaktārtihāriṇe tubhyaṃ sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ || 34 || haraye nārasiṃhāya daityarājavidāriṇe || namastubhyaṃ varāhāya daṃṣṭroddhṛtavasundhara || 35 || trivikramāya bhavate baliyajña vibhedine || namo vāmanarūpāya namo maṃdaradhāriṇe || 36 || namaste matsyarūpāya trayīpālanakāriṇe || namaḥ paraśurāmāya kṣatriyāṃtakarāya te ||37|| namaste rākṣasaghnāya namo rāghavarūpiṇe || mahādeva mahābhīma mahākodaṇḍabhedine || 38 || kṣatriyāṃtakarakrūrabhārgavatrāsakāriṇe || namo'stvahilyā saṃtāpahāriṇe cāpahāriṇe || 39 || nāgāyutavalopetatāṭakādehahāriṇe || śilākaṭhinavistāravālivakṣovibhedine || 3.1.46.40 || namo māyā mṛgonmāthakāriṇe'jñānahāriṇe || daśasyaṃdanaduḥkhābdhiśoṣaṇāgastyarūpiṇe || 41 || anekormisamādhūtasamudramadahāriṇe || maithilīmānasāṃ bhojabhānave lokasākṣiṇe || 42 || rājeṃdrāya namastubhyaṃ jānakīpataye hare || tārakabrahmaṇe tubhyaṃ namo rājīvalocana || 43 || rāmāya rāmacandrāya vareṇyāya sukhātmane || viśvāmitrapriyāyedaṃ namaḥ kharavidāriṇe || 44 || prasīda devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada || rakṣa māṃ karu ṇāsiṃdho rāmacandra namo'stu te || 45 || rakṣa māṃ vedavacasāmapyagocara rāghava || pāhi māṃ kṛpayā rāma śaraṇaṃ tvāmupaimyaham || 46 || raghuvīra mahāmohamapākuru mamādhunā || snāne cācamane bhukto jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu || 47 || sarvāvasthāsu sarvatra pāhi māṃ raghunaṃdana || mahimānaṃ tava stotuṃ kaḥ samartho jagattraye || 48 || tvameva tvanmahattvaṃ vai jānāsi raghunaṃdana || iti stutvā vāyuputro rāmacaṃdraṃ ghṛṇānidhim || 49 || sītāmapyabhituṣṭāva bhaktiyuktena cetasā || jānaki tvāṃ namasyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm || 3.1.46.50 || dāridryaraṇasaṃhartrīṃ bhaktānāmiṣṭadāyinīm || videharājatanayāṃ rāghavānaṃdakāriṇīm || 51 || bhūmerduhitaraṃ vidyāṃ namāmi prakṛtiṃ śivām || paulastyaiśvaryasaṃhartrīṃ bhaktābhīṣṭāṃ sarasvatīm || 52 || pativratādhurīṇāṃ tvāṃ namāmi janakātmajām || anugrahaparāmṛddhimanaghāṃ harivallabhām || 53 || ātmavidyāṃ trayīrūpāmumārūpāṃ namāmya ham || prasādābhimukhīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣīrābdhitanayāṃ śubhām || 54 || namāmi candrabhaginīṃ sītāṃ sarvāṃgasuṃdarīm || namāmi dharmanilayāṃ karuṇāṃ vedamātaram || 55 || padmālayāṃ padmahastāṃ viṣṇuvakṣasthalālayām || namāmi candranilayāṃ sītāṃ candranibhānanām || 56 || āhlādarūpiṇīṃ siddhiṃ śivāṃ śivakarīṃ satīm || namāmi viśvajananīṃ rāmacandreṣṭavallabhām || sītāṃ sarvānavadyāṃgīṃ bhajāmi satataṃ hṛdā || 57 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || stutvaivaṃ hanumānsītārāmacandrau sabhaktikam || 58 || ānaṃdāśrupariklinnastūṣṇīmāste dvijottamāḥ || ya idaṃ vāyuputreṇa kathitaṃ pāpanāśanam || 59 || stotraṃ śrīrāmacaṃdrasya sītāyāḥ paṭhate'nvaham || sa naro mahadaiśvaryamaśnute vāṃchitaṃ sa dā || 3.1.46.60 || anekakṣetradhānyāni gāśca dogdhrīḥ payasvinīḥ || āyurvidyāśca putrāṃśca bhāryāmapi manoramām || 61 || etatstotraṃ sakṛ dviprāḥ paṭhannāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || etatstotrasya pāṭhena narakaṃ naiva yāsyati || 62 || brahmahatyādipāpāni naśyaṃti sumahāṃtyapi || sarvapāpavinirmukto dehāṃte muktimāpnuyāt || 63 || iti stuto jagannātho vāyuputreṇa rāghavaḥ || sītayā sahito viprā hanūmaṃtamathābravīt || 64 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || ajñānādvā naraśreṣṭha tvayedaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛtam || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā vāpi śakrāditridaśairapi || 65 || nedaṃ liṃgaṃ samuddhartuṃ śakyate sthāpitaṃ mayā || mahādevāparādhena patito'syadya mūrcchitaḥ || 66 || itaḥ paraṃ mā kriyatāṃ drohaḥ sāṃbasya śūlinaḥ || adyārabhya tvidaṃ kuṃḍaṃ tava nāmnā jagattraye || 67 || khyātiṃ prayātu yatra tvaṃ patito vānarottama || mahāpātakasaṃghānāṃ nāśaḥ syādatra majjanāt || 68 || mahādevajaṭājātā gautamī saritāṃ varā || aśvamedhasahasrasya phaladā snāyināṃ nṛṇām || 69 || tataḥ śataguṇā gaṃgā yamunā ca sarasvatī || etannadītrayaṃ yatra sthale pravahate kape || 3.1.46.70 || militvā tatra tu snānaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ smṛtam || nadīṣvetāsu yatsnānātphalaṃ puṃsāṃ bhavetkape || 71 || tatphalaṃ tava kuṃḍe'sminsnānātprāpnotyasaṃśayam || durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ hanūmatkuṃḍatīrataḥ || 72 || śrāddhaṃ na kurute yastu bhaktiyuktena cetasā || nirāśāstasya pitaraḥ prayāṃti kupitāḥ kape || 73 || kupyaṃti munayo'pyasmai devāḥ seṃdrāḥ sacāraṇāḥ || na dattaṃ na hutaṃ yena hanūmatkuṃḍatīrataḥ || 74 || vṛthājīvita evāsāvihāmutra ca duḥkhabhāk || hanūmatkuṃḍasavidhe yena dattaṃ tilodakam || modaṃte pitarastasya ghṛtakulyāḥ pibaṃti ca || 75 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ viprā rāmeṇoktaṃ sa vāyujaḥ || 76 || uttare rāmanāthasya liṃgaṃ svenāhṛtaṃ mudā || ājñayā rāmacandrasya sthāpayāmāsa vāyujaḥ || 77 || pratyakṣameva sarveṣāṃ kapilāṃgūlaveṣṭitam || haropi tatpucchajā taṃ bibharti ca valitrayam || taduttarāyāṃ kakubhi gaurīṃ saṃsthāpayanmudā || 78 || || śrīsūta uvāca || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yadarthaṃ rāghaveṇa tu ||| liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ setau bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām || 79 || yaḥ paṭhedimamadhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || sa vidhūyeha pāpāni śivaloke mahīyate || 3.1.46.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmanāthaliṃgapratiṣṭhākāraṇavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || || cha ||
<3.1.47>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || rākṣasasya vadhātsūta rāvaṇasya mahāmune || brahmahatyā kathamabhūdrāghavasya mahātmanaḥ || || 1 || brāhmaṇasya vadhātsūta brahmahatyābhijāyate || na brāhmaṇo daśagrīvaḥ kathaṃ tadvada no mune || 2 || brahmahatyā bhavetkrūrā rāmacaṃdasya dhīmataḥ || etannaḥ śraddadhānānāṃ vada kāruṇyato'dhunā || 3 || iti pṛṣṭastataḥ sūto naimiṣāraṇyavāsibhiḥ || vaktuṃ pracakrame teṣāṃ praśnasyottaramuttamam|| 4 || | śrīsūta uvāca || || brahmaputro mahātejāḥ pulastyonāma vai dvijāḥ || babhūva tasya putro'bhūdviśravā iti viśrutaḥ || 5 || tasya putraḥ pulastya sya viśravā munipuṃgavāḥ || cirakālaṃ tapastepe devairapi suduṣkaram || 6 || tapaḥ kurvati tasmiṃstu sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ || pātālalokādbhūlokaṃ sarvaṃ vai vicacāra ha || 7 || hemaniṣkāṃgadadharaḥ kālameghanibhacchaviḥ || samādāya sutāṃ kanyāṃ padmahīnāmiva śriyam || 8 || vicaransa mahīpṛṣṭhe kadācitpuṣpakasthitam || dṛṣṭvā viśravasaḥ putraṃ kuberaṃ vai dhaneśvaram || 9 || ciṃtayāmāsa vipreṃdrāḥ sumālī sa tu rākṣasaḥ || kuberasadṛśaḥ putro yadyasmākaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3.1.47.10 || vayaṃ varddhāmahe sarve rākṣasā hyakutobhayāḥ || vicāryaivaṃ nijasutāmabravīdrākṣaseśvaraḥ || 11 || sute pradānakālo'dya tava kaikasi śobhane || adya te yauvanaṃ prāptaṃ taddeyā tvaṃ varāya hi || 12 || apradānena putrīṇāṃ pitaro duḥkhamāpnuyuḥ || kiṃ ca sarvaguṇotkṛṣṭā lakṣmīriva sute śubhe || 13 || pratyākhyānabhayātpuṃbhirna ca tvaṃ prārthyase śubhe || kanyāpitṛtvaṃ duḥkhāya sarveṣāṃ mānakāṃkṣiṇām ||14 || na jāne'haṃ varaḥ ko vā varayediti kanyake || sā tvaṃ pulastyatanayaṃ muniṃ viśravasaṃ dvijam || 15 || pitāmahakulodbhūtaṃ varayasva svayaṃgatā || kuberatulyāstanayā bhaveyuste na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || kaikasī tadvacaḥ śrutvā sā kanyā pitṛgauravāt || aṃgīcakāra tadvākyaṃ tathāstviti śucismitā || 17 || parṇaśālāṃ muniśreṣṭhā gatvā viśravaso muneḥ || atiṣṭhadaṃtike tasya lajjamānā hyadhomukhī || 18 || tasminnavasare viprāḥ pulastyatanayaḥ sudhīḥ || agnihotramupāste sma jvalatpāvakasannibhaḥ || 19 || saṃdhyākālamatikrūramaviciṃtya tu kaikasī || abhyetya taṃ muniṃ subhrūḥ piturvacanagauravāt || 3.1.47.20 || tasthāvadhomukhī bhūmiṃ likhatyaṃguṣṭhakoṭinā || viśravāstāṃ vilokyātha kaikasīṃ tanumadhyamām || uvāca sasmito viprāḥ pūrṇacaṃdranibhānanām || 21 || || || viśravā uvāca || || śobhane kasya putrī tvaṃ kuto vā tvamihāgatā ||22|| kāryaṃ kiṃ vā tvamuddiśya vartase'tra śucismite || yathārthato vadasvādya mama sarvamaniṃdite || 23 || itīritā kaikasī sā kanyā baddhāṃjalirdvijāḥ || uvāca taṃ muniṃ prahvā vinayena samanvitā || 24 || tapaḥ prabhāvena mune madabhiprāyamadya tu || vettumarhasi samyaktvaṃ pulastyakuladīpana ||25|| ahaṃ tu kaikasī nāma sumāliduhitā mune || mattātasyājñayā brahmaṃstavāṃtikamupāgatā ||26|| śeṣa tvaṃ jñānadṛṣṭyādya jñātumarhasyasaṃśayaḥ|| kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā muniḥ prāha viśravāḥ sa tu kaikasīm ||27|| mayā te viditaṃ subhrūrmanogatamabhīpsitam|| putrābhilāṣiṇī sā tvaṃ māmagāḥ sāṃprataṃ śubhe ||28|| sāyaṃkāle'dhunā krūre yasmānmāṃ tvamupāgatā || putrābhilāṣiṇī bhūtvā tasmāttvāṃ prabravīmyaham||29|| śṛṇuṣvāvahitā rāme kaikasī tvamaniṃdite || dāruṇāndāruṇākārāndāruṇābhijanapriyān||3.1.47.30 || janayiṣyasi putrāṃstvaṃ rākṣasānkrūrakarmaṇaḥ || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ sā tu kaikasī praṇipatya tam || 31 || pulastyatanayaṃ prāha kṛtāṃjalipuṭā dvijāḥ || bhagavadīdṛśāḥ putrāstvattaḥ prāptuṃ na yujyate || 32 || ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ prāha kaikasīṃ tāṃ sumadhyamām || madvaṃśānuguṇaḥ putraḥ paścimaste bhaviṣyati || 33 || dhārmikaḥ śāstravicchāṃto na tu rākṣasaceṣṭitaḥ || ityuktā kaikasī viprāḥ kāle katipaye gate || 34 || suṣuve tanayaṃ krūraṃ rakṣorūpaṃ bhayaṃkaram || dvipaṃcaśīrṣaṃ kumatiṃ viṃśadbāhuṃ bhayānakam|| 35 || tāmroṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇavadanaṃ raktaśmaśru śiroruham || mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahākāyaṃ lokatrāsakaraṃ sadā || 36 || daśagrīvābhidhaḥ so'bhūttathā rāvaṇa nāmavān|| rāvaṇānaṃtaraṃ jātaḥ kumbhakarṇābhidhaḥ sutaḥ || 37 || tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāmnā krūrā jajñe ca rākṣasī || tato babhūva kaikasyā vibhīṣaṇa iti śrutaḥ || 38 || paścimastanayo dhīmāndhārmiko vedaśāstravit || ete viśravasaḥ putrā daśagrīvādayo dvijāḥ || 39 || ato daśagrīvavadhātkumbhakarṇavadhādapi || brahmahatyā samabhavadrāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || 3.1.47.40 || atastacchāṃtaye rāmo liṃgaṃ rāmeśvarābhidham || sthāpayāmāsa vidhinā vaidikena dvijottamāḥ || 41 || evaṃ rāvaṇaghātena brahmahatyāsamudbhavaḥ || samabhūdrāmacaṃdrasya lokakāṃtasya dhīmataḥ || 42 || tatsahaitukamākhyātaṃ bhavatāṃ brahmaghātajam|| pāpaṃ yacchāṃtaye rāmo liṃgaṃ prātiṣṭhipatsvayam || 43 || evaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya rāmacandro'tidhārmikaḥ || mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ sasītā varajo dvijāḥ || 44 || brahmahatyā gatā yatra rāmacaṃdrasya bhūpateḥ || tatra tīrthamabhūtkiṃcidbrahmahatyāvimocanam || 45 || tatra snānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam || dṛśyate rāvaṇo'dyāpi chāyārūpeṇa tatra vai || 46 || tadagre nāgalokasya bilamasti mahattaram || daśagrīvavadhotpannāṃ brahmahatyāṃ balīyasīm || 47 || tadbilaṃ prāpayāmāsa jānakīramaṇo dvijāḥ || tasyopari bilasyātha kṛtvā maṇḍapamuttamam || 48 || bhairavaṃ sthāpayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ tatra rāghavaḥ || bhairavājñāparitrastā brahmahatyā bhayaṃkarī || 49 || nāśaknottadbilādūrdhvaṃ nirgaṃtuṃ dvijasattamāḥ || tasminneva bile tasthau brahmahatyā nirudyamā || 3.1.47.50 || rāmanāthamahāliṃgaṃ dakṣiṇe girijā mudā || vartate paramānaṃdaśivasyārdhaśarīriṇī || 51 || ādityasomau vartete pārśvayostatra śūlinaḥ || devasya purato vahnī rāmanāthasya vartate || 52 || āste śatakratuḥ prācyāmāgneyāṃ ca tathā'nalaḥ || āste yamo dakṣiṇasyāṃ rāmanāthasya sevakaḥ || 53 || nairṛte nirṛtirviprā vartate śaṃkarasya tu || vāruṇyāṃ varuṇo bhaktyā sevate rāghaveśvaram || 54 || vāyavye tu diśo bhāge vāyurāste śivasya tu || uttarasyāṃ ca dhanado rāmanāthasya vartate || 55 || īśānye'sya ca digbhāge maheśo vartate dvijāḥ || vināyaka kumārau ca mahādevasutāvubhau || 56 || yathāpradeśaṃ vartete rāmanāthālaye'dhunā || vīrabhadrādayaḥ sarve maheśvaragaṇeśvarāḥ || 57 || yathāpradeśaṃ vartaṃte rāmanāthālaye sadā || munayaḥ pannagāḥ siddhā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 58 || saṃtuṣyamāṇahṛdayā yatheṣṭaṃ śivasannidhau || vartaṃte rāmanāthasya sevārthaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 59 || rāmanāthasya pūjārthaṃ śrotriyānbrāhmaṇānbahūn || rāmeśvare raghupatiḥ sthāpayāmāsa pūjakān || 3.1.47.60 || rāmapratiṣṭhitānviprānhavyakavyādinārcayet || tuṣṭāste toṣitāḥ sarvā pitṛbhiḥ sahadevatāḥ || 61 || tebhyo bahudhanāngrāmānpradadau jānakīpatiḥ || rāmanāthamahādeva naivedyārthamapi dvijāḥ || 62 || bahūngrāmānbahudhanaṃ pradadau lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ || hārakeyūrakaṭakaniṣkādyābharaṇāni ca || 63 || anekapaṭṭa vastrāṇi kṣaumāṇi vividhāni ca || rāmanāthāya devāya dadau daśarathātmajaḥ || 64 || gaṃgā ca yamunā puṇyā sarayūśca sarasvatī || setau rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ bhajaṃte svāghaśāṃtaye || 65 || etadadhyāyapaṭhanācchravaṇādapi mānavaḥ || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sāyujyaṃ labhate hareḥ || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmasya brahmahatyotpattihetunirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || || ||
<3.1.48>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || rāmanāthaṃ samuddiśya kathāṃ pāpavināśinīm || pravakṣyāmi muniśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 1 || pāṃḍyadeśādhipo rājā purāsīcchaṃkarābhidhaḥ || brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃdhaśca yāyajūkaśca dhārmikaḥ || 2 || vedavedāṃgatattvajñaḥ parasainyavidāraṇaḥ || caturo'pyāśramānvarṇāndharmataḥ paripālayan|| 3 || vaidikācāranirataḥ purāṇasmṛtipāragaḥ || śivaviṣṇvarcako nityamanyadaivatapūjakaḥ || 4 || mahādānaprado nityaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām || mṛgayārthaṃ yayau dhīmānsa kadācittapovanam || 5 || siṃhavyāghrebhamahiṣa krūrasatvabhayaṃkaram|| jhillikābhīṣaṇaravaṃ sarīsṛpasamākulam|| 6 || bhīmaśvāpadasaṃpūrṇaṃ dāvānalabhayaṃkaram || mahāraṇyaṃ praviśyātha śaṃkaro rājaśekharaḥ || || 7 || anekasainikopeta ākheṭikulasaṃkulaḥ || pādukāgūḍhacaraṇo raktoṣṇīṣo haricchadaḥ || 8 || baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇo dhṛtakodaṇḍasāyakaḥ || kakṣyābaddhamahākhaṅgaḥ śvetāśvavaramāsthitaḥ || 9 || suveṣadhārī sannaddhaḥ pattisaṃghasamāvṛtaḥ || kāṃtāreṣu ca sarveṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca || 3.1.48.10 || samuttīrṇa mahāsrotā yuvā siṃhaparākramaḥ || vicacāra balaiḥ sākaṃ darīṣu mṛgayanmṛgān || 11 || badhyatāṃ vadhyatāmeṣa yāti vegānmṛgo vane || evaṃ vadatsu sainyeṣu svayamutplutya śaṃkaraḥ || 12 || mṛgaṃ haṃti mahārājo vigāhya vipinasthalīm || siṃhānvarāhānmahiṣānkuñjarāccharabhāṃstathā || 13 || vinighnansa mṛgānanyānvanyāñchaṃkarabhūpatiḥ || kutracidvipinoddeśe darīmadhyanivāsinam || 14 || vyāghracarmadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ muniṃ niyatamānasam || vyāghrabuddhyā jaghānāśu śareṇānataparvaṇā || 15 || ativegena vipreṃdrāstatpatnīṃ ca sasāyakaḥ || nijaghāna patiprāṇāṃ niviṣṭāṃ patyuraṃtike ||16|| vilokya mātāpitarau tatputro nihatau vane || ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhārto vilalāpa ca kātaraḥ ||17|| bhostāta mātarmāṃ hitvā yuvāṃ yātau kva vādhunā || ahaṃ kutra gamiṣyāmi ko vā me śaraṇaṃ bhavet || 18 || ko māmadhyāpayedvedāñchāstraṃ vā pāṭhayetpitaḥ || aṃba me bhojanaṃ kā vā dāsyate sopadeśakam || 19 || ācārāñcchikṣayetko vā tāta tvayi mṛte'dhunā || aṃba bālaṃ prakupitaṃ kā vā māmupalāpayet || 3.1.48.20 || yuvāṃ nirāgasāvadya kena pāpena sāyakaiḥ || nihatau vai taponiṣṭhau matprāṇau madgurū vane || 21 || evaṃ tayoḥ suto viprā muktakaṇṭhaṃ ruroda vai || atha pralapitaṃ śrutvā śaṃkaro vipine caran || 22 || tacchabdābhimukhaḥ sadyaḥ prayayau sa darīmukham || tatratyā munayo'pyāśu samāgacchaṃstamāśramam || 23 || te dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve śareṇa nihataṃ munim|| tatpatnīṃ ca hatāṃ viprā rājānaṃ ca dhanurdharam || 24 || vilapaṃtaṃ sutaṃ cāpi vilokya bhṛśavihvalāḥ || putramāśvāsayāmāsurmā rodīriti kātaram || 25 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || āḍhye vāpi daridre vā mūrkhe vā paṃḍite'pi vā || pīne vātha kṛśe vāpi samavartī paretarāṭ || 26 || vane vā nagare grāme parvate vā sthalāṃtare || mṛtyorvaśe prayātavyaṃ sarvairapi hi jaṃtubhiḥ || 27 || vatsa nityaṃ ca garbhasthairjātairapi ca jaṃtubhiḥ || yuvabhiḥ sthaviraiḥ sarvairyātavyaṃ yamapattanam || 28 || varṇibhiśca gṛhasthaiśca vānaprasthaiśca bhikṣubhiḥ || kāle prāpte tvayaṃ dehastyaktavyo dvijaputraka || 29 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairapi ca saṃkaraiḥ || yātavyaṃ pretanilaye dvijaputra mahāmate || 3.1.48.30 || devāśca munayo yakṣā gaṃdharvoragarākṣasāḥ || anye ca jaṃtavaḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ || 31 || sarve yāsyaṃti vilayaṃ na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi || advayaṃ saccidānaṃdaṃ yadbrahmopaniṣadgatam || 32 || na tasya vilayo janma vardhanaṃ cāpi sattama || malabhāṃḍe navadvāre pūyāsṛkchoṇitālaye || 33 || dehe'sminbudbudākāre kṛmiyūthasamākule || kāmakrodhabhayadrohamohamātsaryakāriṇi || 34 || paradāraparakṣetraparadravyaikalolupe || hiṃsāsūyāśucivyāpte viṣṭhāmūtraikabhājane || 35 || yaḥ kuryācchobhanadhiyaṃ sa mūḍhaḥ sa ca durmatiḥ || bahucchidraghaṭākāre dehe'sminnaśucau sadā || 36 || vāyoravasthitiḥ kiṃ syātprāṇākhyasya ciraṃ dvija || ato mā kuru śokaṃ tvaṃ jananīṃ pitaraṃ prati || 37 || tau svakarmavaśādyātau gṛhaṃ tyaktvā tvidaṃ kvacit|| tava karmavaśāttvaṃ ca tiṣṭhasyasminmahītale || 38 || yadā karmakṣayaste syāttadā tvaṃ ca mariṣyasi || mariṣyamāṇapreto hi mṛtapretasya śocati || 39 || yasminkāle samutpannau tava mātā pitā tathā || na tasmiṃstvaṃ samutpannastato bhinnā gatirhi vaḥ || 3.1.48.40 || yadi tulyā gatiste syāttābhyāṃ saha mahāmate ||| tarhi tvayāpi yātavyaṃ mṛtau yatra hi tau gatau ||41|| mṛtānāṃ bāṃdhavā ye tu muṃcaṃtyaśrūṇi bhūtale || pibaṃtyaśrūṇi tānyaddhā mṛtāḥ pretāḥ paratra vai || 42|| ataḥ śokaṃ parityajya dhṛtiṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ || anayoḥ pretakāryāṇi kuru tvaṃ vaidikāni tu || 43 || śaraghātānmṛtāvetau yasmātte jananī pitā || atastaddoṣaśāṃtyarthamasthīnyādāya vai tayoḥ || 44 || rāmanāthaśivakṣetre rāmasetau vimuktide || sthāpayasva tathā śrāddhaṃ sapiṃḍīkaraṇādikam || 45 || tatraiva kuru śuddhyarthaṃ tayorbāhmaṇaputraka || tena durmṛtyudoṣasya śāṃtirbhavati nānyathā || 46 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamuktaḥ sa munibhiḥ śākalyasya suto dvijāḥ || jāṃgalākhyastayoḥ sarvaṃ pitṛmedhaṃ cakāra vai || 47 || anyedyurasthīnyādāya hālāsyaṃ prayayau ca saḥ || tasmādrāmeśvaraṃ sadyo gatvā'yaṃ jāṃgalo dvijaḥ||48|| muniproktaprakāreṇa tasminrāmeśvarasthale|| nidhāya pitrorasthīni śrāddhādīnyakarottathā||49|| prathamābdikaparyaṃtaṃ kāryaṃ tatrākarocca saḥ|| sthitvābdaṃ sa muneḥ putra eko jāṃgalasaṃjñakaḥ||3.1.48.50|| ābdikāṃte dine vipro rātrau svapne vilokya tu|| svamātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharau||51|| garuḍopari saṃviṣṭau padmamālāvibhūṣitau|| śobhitau tulasīdāmnā sphuranmakarakuṃḍalau||52|| kaustubhālaṃkṛtoraskau pītāṃbaravirājitau || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā munisuto jāṃgalaḥ suprasannadhīḥ || 53 || svāśramaṃ punarāgatya sukhena nyavasaddvijāḥ || svapnadṛṣṭaṃ ca vṛttāṃtaṃ mātāpitroḥ sa jāṃgalaḥ || 54 || tebhyo nyavedayatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo'tiharṣitaḥ || śrutvā te munayo vṛttamāsansaṃprītamānasāḥ || 55 || atha rājānamālokya sarve te'pi maharṣayaḥ || avadankupitā viprāḥ śapaṃtaḥ śaṃkaraṃ nṛpam || 56 || pāṃḍyabhūpa mahāmūrkha krauryādbrāhmaṇaghātaka || strīhatyā brahmahatyā ca kṛtā yasmāttvayādhunā || 57 || ataḥ śarīrasaṃtyāgaṃ kuru tvaṃ havyavāhane || nocettava na śuddhiḥ syātprāyaścittaśatairapi || 58 || tvatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyāyutaṃ bhavet || asmatsakāśādgaccha tvaṃ pāṃḍyānāṃ kulapāṃsana || 59 || ityukto munibhiḥ pāṃḍyaḥ śaṃkaro dvijapuṃgavāḥ || tathāstu dehasaṃtyāgaṃ kariṣye havyavāhane || 3.1.48.60 || brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ bhavatāṃ sannidhāvaham || anugrahaṃ me kurvaṃtu bhavaṃto munisattamāḥ || 61 || tathā śarīra saṃtyāgātpātakaṃ me layaṃ vrajet || evamuktvā munīnsarvāñcchaṃkaraḥ pāṃḍyabhūpatiḥ || 62 || svānmaṃtriṇaḥ samāhūya babhāṣe vacanaṃ tvidam || bho maṃtriṇo brahmahatyā mayā'kāryavicārataḥ || 63 || strīhatyā ca tathā krūrā mahānarakadāyinī || etatpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ munīnāṃ vacanādaham || 64 || pradīpte 'gnau mahājvāle parityakṣye kalevaram || kāṣṭhānyānayata kṣipraṃ tairagniśca samidhyatām || 65 || mama putraṃ ca suruciṃ rājye sthāpayatācirāt || mā śokaṃ kurutāmātyā daivataṃ duratikramam || 66 || itīritā nṛpatinā maṃtriṇo rurudustadā || pāṃḍyanātha mahārāja ripūṇāmapi vatsala || 67 || vayaṃ hi bhavatā nityaṃ putravatparipālitāḥ || tvāṃ vinā na pravekṣyāma purīṃ devapuropamām || 68 || havyavāhaṃ pravekṣyāmo mahā kāṣṭhasamedhitam || teṣāṃ pralapitaṃ śrutvā pāṃḍya śaṃkarabhūpatiḥ || provāca maṃtriṇaḥ sarvānvacanaṃ sāṃtvapūrvakam || 69 || || śaṃkara uvāca || kiṃ kariṣyatha bho'mātyā mahāpātakinā mayā || 3.1.48.70 || siṃhāsanaṃ samāruhya na kartuṃ yujyate bata || caturarṇavaparyaṃtadharāpālanamaṃjasā || 71 || matputraṃ suruciṃ śīghramataḥ sthāpayatāsane || kāṣṭhānyānayata kṣipraṃ praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhanam || 72 || mama maṃtrivarā yūyaṃ vilaṃbaṃ tyajatādhunā || ityuktā maṃtriṇaḥ kāṣṭhaṃ samāninyuḥ kṣaṇena te || 73 || agniṃ prajvalitaṃ kāṣṭhairdṛṣṭvā śaṃkarabhūpatiḥ || snātvācamya viśuddhātmā munīnāṃ saṃnidhau tadā || 74 || agniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tānmunīnapi satvaram|| agniṃ munīnnamaskṛtya dhyātvā devamumāpatim||75|| agnau patitumārebhe dhairyamālaṃbya bhūpatiḥ|| tasminnavasare viprā munīnāmapi śṛṇvatām||76|| aśarīrā samudabhūdvāṇī bhairavanādinī|| bhoḥ śaṃkara mahīpāla mānalaṃ praviśādhunā||77|| brahmahatyānimittaṃ te bhayaṃ mā bhūnmahāmate || tavopadeśaṃ vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ vedasaṃmitam || 78 || śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanmaduktaṃ kriyatāṃ tvayā || dakṣiṇāṃbunidhestīre gaṃdhamādanaparvate || 79 || rāmasetau mahāpuṇye mahāpātakanāśane || rāmapratiṣṭhitaṃ ligaṃ rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || 3.1.48.80 || sevasva varṣamekaṃ tvaṃ trikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || pradakṣiṇaprakramaṇaṃ namaskāraṃ ca vai kuru || 81 || mahābhiṣekaḥ kriyatāṃ rāmanāthasya vai tvayā || naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ rājankriyatāṃ ca dinedine || 82 || candanāgarukarpūrai rāmaliṃgaṃ prapūjaya || bhāradvayena gavyena hyājyena tvabhiṣecaya || 83 || pratyahaṃ ca gavāṃ kṣīrairdvibhāraparisaṃmitaiḥ || madhudroṇena talliṃgaṃ pratyahaṃ snāpaya prabhoḥ || 84 || pratyahaṃ pāyasānnena naivedyaṃ kuru bhūpate || pratyahaṃ tilatailena dīpārādhanamācara || 85 || etena tava rājeṃdra rāmanāthasya śūlinaḥ || strīhatyrā brahmahatyā ca tatkṣaṇādeva naśyataḥ || 86 || darśanādrāmanāthasya bhrūṇahatyāśatāni ca || ayutaṃ brahmahatyānāṃ surāpānāyutaṃ tathā || 87 || svarṇasteyāyutaṃ rājangurustrīgamanāyutam || etatsaṃsargadoṣāśca vinaśyaṃti kṣaṇādvibho||88|| mahāpātakatulyāni yāni pāpāni saṃti vai || tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti rāmanāthasya sevayā || 89 || mahatī rāmanāthasya sevā labhyeta cennṛṇām ||| kiṃ gaṃgayā ca gayayā prayāgeṇādhvareṇa vā || 3.1.48.90 || tadgaccha rāmasetuṃ tvaṃ rāmanāthaṃ bhajāniśam || vilaṃbaṃ mā kuru vibho gamane ca tvarāṃ kuru ||91||| ityuktvā virarāmātha sāpi vāgaśarīriṇī || tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve tvarayaṃti sma bhūpatim || 92 || gaccha śīghaṃ mahārāja rāmasetuṃ vimuktidam ||| rāmanāthasya māhātmyamajñātvāsmābhirīritam || 93 || dehatyāgaṃ kuruṣveti vahnau prajvalite'dhunā || anujñāto munivarairiti rājā sa śaṃkaraḥ |||| || 94 || caturaṃgabalaṃ puryāṃ prāpayitvā tvarānvitaḥ || namaskṛtya munīnsarvānprahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 95 || vṛtaḥ katipayaiḥ sainyaiḥ samādāya dhanaṃ bahu || rāmanāthasya sevārthamayāsīdgaṃdhamādanam || 96 || uvāsa varṣamekaṃ ca rāmasetau viśuddhide || ekabhukto jitakrodho vijiteṃdriyasaṃcayaḥ || || 97 || trisaṃdhyaṃ rāmanāthaṃ ca sevamānaḥ sabhaktikam || pradadau rāmanāthāya daśabhāraṃ dhanaṃ mudā || 98 || pratyahaṃ rāmanāthasya mahāpūjāmakārayat || akarocca dhanuṣkoṭau pratyahaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 99 || snānaṃ pratidinaṃ cānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhya dadau mudā || aśarīrāvacaḥproktamakhilaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 3.1.48.100 || evaṃ kṛtavatastasya varṣamekaṃ gataṃ dvijāḥ || varṣāṃte sa śucirbhūtvā śaṃkarastuṣṭamānasaḥ || tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ rāmanāthaṃ ghṛṇānidhim || 101 || ||śaṃkara uvāca || || namāmi rudramīśānaṃ rāmanāthamumāpatim || 102 || pāhi māṃ kṛpayā deva brahmahatyāṃ dahāśu me || tripuraghna mahādeva kālakūṭaviṣādana || 103 || rakṣa māṃ tvaṃ dayāsiṃdho strīhatyāṃ me vimocaya || gaṃgādhara virūpākṣa rāmanātha trilocana || 104 || māṃ pālaya kṛpādṛṣṭyā chindhi matpātakaṃ vibho || kāmāre kāmasaṃdāyinbhaktānāṃ rāghaveśvara || 105 || kaṭākṣaṃ pātaya mayi śuddhaṃ māṃ kuru dhūrjaṭe || mārkaṃḍeyabhayatrāṇa mṛtyuṃjaya śivāvyaya || 106 || namaste girijārdhāya niṣpāpaṃ kuru māṃ sadā || rudrākṣamālābharaṇa candraśekhara śaṃkara || 107 || vedoktasamyagācārayogyaṃ māṃ kuru te namaḥ || sūryadaṃtabhide tubhyaṃ bhāratīnāsikācchide || 108 || rāmeśvarāya devāya namo me śuddhido bhava || ānaṃdaṃ saccidānaṃdaṃ rāmanāthaṃ vṛṣadhvajam || 109 || bhūyobhūyo namasyāmi pātakaṃ me vinaśyatu || bhaktyaivaṃ stuvatastasya rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || 3.1.48.110 || nirjagāma mukhādrājño brahmahatyātibhīṣaṇā || nīlavastradharā krūrā mahāraktaśiroruhā || 111 || tāṃ brahmahatyāṃ bībhatsāṃ nṛpavaktrādvinirgatām || nijaghāna triśūlena bhairavo rudraśāsanāt || 112 || hatāyāṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ bhairaveṇa śivājñayā || rāmanātho nṛpaṃ prāha stutyā tasya prasannadhīḥ || 113 || || śrīrāmanātha uvāca || || pāṃḍyabhūpa mahārāja stotreṇānena te'nagha || prasanno'haṃ varaṃ dāsye tubhyaṃ varaya cepsitam || 114 || strīhatyābrahmahatyābhyāṃ yaste doṣaḥ sa nirgataḥ || śuddho vidhūtapāpo'si rājyaṃ pālaya pūrvavat || 115 || ye māmatra niṣevaṃte bhaktiyuktena cetasā || nāśayāmi nṛṇāṃ teṣāṃ brahmahatyāyutānyapi || 116 || surāpānāyutaṃ bhūpa gurustrīgamanāyutam || svarṇasteyāyutamapi tatsaṃsargāyutaṃ tathā || 117 || anyānyapi ca pāpāni nāśayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || matsevino narā rājanna bhūyaḥ saṃsaraṃti te || 118 || kiṃ tu sāyujyarūpāṃ me muktiṃ yāsyantyasaṃśayam || stuvaṃtyanena stotreṇa ye māṃ bhaktipuraḥsaram || 119 || nāśayāmyahameteṣāṃ mahāpātakasaṃcayam || prīto'haṃ tava bhaktyā ca stotreṇa manujeśvara || 3.1.48.120 || yatheṣṭaṃ prārthaya varaṃ mattastvaṃ varadānnṛpa || evamuktaḥ śivenātha śaṃkaro nṛpapuṃgavaḥ || rāmanāthaṃ babhāṣe taṃ śaṃkaraṃ karuṇānidhim || 121 || || nṛpa uvāca || || tava saṃdarśanenāhaṃ kṛtārtho'smi maheśvara || 122 || itaḥ paraṃ prārthanīyaṃ mama nāstyadhunādhikam || mṛkaṇḍusutasaṃtāpahāri pādayugaṃ tava || 123 || dṛṣṭaṃ mayā mahādeva nātaḥ prārthyaṃ vibhosti vai || tvatpādapadmayugule niścalā bhaktirastu me || 124 || na punarjanma me bhūyānmātṝṇāmudare'śucau || ye matkṛtamidaṃ stotraṃ kīrtayaṃti tava prabho || te narāḥ pāpanirmuktāstvatsevāphalamāpnuyuḥ ||125|| || śrīsūta uvāca || || tathāstvityanugṛhyainaṃ rāmanātho dvijottamāḥ || 126 || nīlakaṇṭho virūpākṣo liṃgarūpe tirohitaḥ || rājāpi rāmanāthena vihitānugrahastataḥ || 127 || rāmanāthaṃ namaskṛtya kṛtārthenāṃtarātmanā || sa senāsaṃvṛtaḥ prītaḥ prayayāvātmanaḥ purīm || 128 || vṛttāṃtametamavadanmunīnāṃ vanavāsinām || tebhyaṣiṃcannṛpaṃ rājye munayaḥ prītamānasāḥ || 129 || putradārayuto rājā prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam || maṃtribhiḥ sahito viprā rarakṣa pṛthivīṃ ciram || 3.1.48.130 || tatoṃtakāle saṃprāpte dhyāyanrāmeśvaraṃ śivam || dehāṃte rāmanāthasya sāyujyaṃ prayayau śubham || 131 || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā rāmanāthasya vaibhavam || caritaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ śaṃkarākhya nṛpasya ca || 132 || śṛṇvanpaṭhanvā manujastvimamadhyāyamādarāt || sarvapāpavinirmukto rāmanāthaṃ samaśnute || 133 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmanāthapraśaṃsāyāṃ śākalyadurmaraṇadoṣaśāṃtipūrvaka śaṃkarastrīhatyābrahmahatyādoṣaśāṃtivarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 || || cha || || ||
<3.1.49>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rāmanāthasya śūlinaḥ || stotrādhyāyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śṛṇuta śraddhayā dvijāḥ || || 1 || rāmaḥ pratiṣṭhite liṃge tuṣṭāva parameśvaram || lakṣmaṇo jānakī sītā sugrīvādyāḥ kapīśvarāḥ || 2 || brahmaprabhṛtayo devāḥ kumbhajādyā maharṣayaḥ || astuvanbhaktisaṃyuktāḥ pratyekaṃ rāghaveśvaram || 3 || tadvakṣyāmyānupūrvyeṇa śṛṇutādarapūrvakam || etacchravaṇamātreṇa muktaḥ syā nmānavo dvijāḥ || 4 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || namo mahātmane tubhyaṃ mahāmāyāya śūline || svapadāṃbujabhaktārtihāriṇe sarpa hāriṇe || 5 || namo devādhidevāya rāmanāthāya sākṣiṇe || namo vedāṃtavedyāya yogināṃ tattvadāyine || 6 || sarvadānaṃdapūrṇāya viśvanāthāya śaṃbhave || namo bhaktabhayacchedahetupādābjareṇave || 7 || namaste'khilanāthāya namaḥ sākṣātparātmane || namaste'dbhutavīryāya mahāpātakanāśine || || 8 || kālakālāya kālāya kālātītāya te namaḥ || namo'vidyānihaṃtre te namaḥ pāpaharāya ca || 9 || namaḥ saṃsārataptānāṃ tāpanāśaikahetave || namo madbrahmahatyāvināśine ca viṣāśine || 3.1.49.10 || namaste pārvatīnātha kailāsanilayāvyaya || gaṃgādhara virūpākṣa māṃ rakṣa sakalāpadaḥ || 11 || tubhyaṃ pinākahastāya namo madanahāriṇe || bhūyobhūyo namastubhyaṃ sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā || 12 || || lakṣmaṇa uvāca || || namaste rāmanāthāya tripuraghnāya śaṃbhave || pārvatījīviteśāya gaṇeśaskandasūnave || 13 || namaste sūryacadrāgnilocanāya kapardine || namaḥ śivāya somāya mārkaṃḍeya bhayacchide || 14 || namaḥ sarvaprapaṃcasya sṛṣṭisthityaṃtahetave || nama ugrāya bhīmāya mahādevāya sākṣiṇe || 15 || sarvajñāya vareṇyāya varadāya varāya te || śrīkaṇṭhāya namastubhyaṃ paṃcapātakabhedine || 16 || namaste'stu parānaṃdasatyavijñānarūpiṇe || namaste bhavarogaghna snāyūnāṃ pataye namaḥ || || 17 || pataye taskarāṇāṃ te vanānāṃ pataye namaḥ || gaṇānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ viśvarūpāyasākṣiṇe ||18 || karmaṇā preritaḥ śambho janiṣye yatrayatra tu || tatratatra padadvaṃdve bhavato bhaktirastu me || 19 || asanmārge ratirmā bhūdbhavataḥ kṛpayā mama || vaidikācāramārge ca ratiḥ syādbhavate namaḥ || 3.1.49.20 || || || sītovāca || || paramakāraṇa śaṃkara dhūrjaṭe girisutāstanakuṃkumaśobhita || mama patau paridehi matiṃ sadā na viṣamāṃ parapūruṣagocarām || || 21 || gaṃgādhara virūpākṣa nīlalohita śaṃkara || rāmanātha namastubhyaṃ rakṣa mā karuṇākara || 22 || namaste devadeveśa namaste karuṇālaya ||| namaste bhavabhītānāṃ bhavabhītivimardana || 23 || nātha tvadīyacaraṇāṃbujaciṃtanena nirddhūya bhāskarasutādbhayamāśu śambho || nityatvamāśu gatavānsa mṛkaṃḍuputraḥ kiṃ vā na sidhyati tavāśrayaṇātpareśa || 24 || pareśaparamānaṃda śaraṇāgatapālaka || pātivratyaṃ mama sadā dehi tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ || || 25 || || hanūmānuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha rāmanātha kṛpānidhe || tvatpādāṃbhoruhagatā niścalā bhaktirastu me || 26 || yaṃ vinā na jagatsattā tadbhānamapi no bhavet|| namaḥ sadbhānarūpāya rāmanāthāya śaṃbhave || 27 || aṃgada uvāca || || yasya bhāsā jagadbhānaṃ yatprakāśaṃ vinā jagat || na bhāsate namastasmai rāmanāthāya śaṃbhave || 28 || || jāṃbuvānuvāca || || sarvānaṃdo yadānaṃdo bhāsate paramārthataḥ || namo rāmeśvarāyāsmai paramānaṃdarūpiṇe || 29 || || nīla uvāca || || yaddeśakāladigbhedairabhinnaṃ sarvadā dvayam || tasmai rāmeśvarāyāsmai namo'bhinnasva rūpiṇe || 3.1.49.30 || || nala uvāca || || brahmaviṣṇumaheśānā yadavidyāvijṛṃbhitāḥ || namo'vidyāvihīnāya tasmai rāmeśvarāya te || 31 || || kumuda uvāca || || yastvarūpāparijñānātpradhānaṃ kāraṇatvataḥ || kalpitaṃ kāraṇāyāsmai rāmanāthāya śaṃbhave || 32 || || panasa uvāca || || jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādiyadavidyāvijṛṃbhitam || jāgradādivihīnāya namo'smai jñānarūpiṇe || 33 || || gaja uvāca || || yatsvarūpāparijñānātkāryāṇāṃ paramā ṇavaḥ || kalpitāḥ kāraṇatvena tārkikāpasadairvṛthā || 34 || tamahaṃ paramānaṃdaṃ rāmanāthaṃ maheśvaram || ātmarūpatayā nityamupāse sarvasākṣiṇam || || 35 || || gavākṣa uvāca || || ajñānapāśabaddhānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamocakam || rāmeśvaraṃ śivaṃ śāṃtamupaimi śaraṇaṃ sadā || 36 || || || gavaya uvāca || || sādhvastajagadādhāraṃ caṃdracūḍamumāpatim || rāmanāthaṃ śivaṃ vande saṃsārāmayabheṣajam || 37 || || śarabha uvāca || || aṃtaḥkaraṇamātmeti yadajñānādvimohitaiḥ || bhaṇyate ramanāthaṃ tamātmānaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 38 || || gandhamādana uvāca || || rāmanāthamumānāthaṃ gaṇanāthaṃ ca tryaṃbakam || sarvapātakaśuddhyarthamupāse jagadīśvaram ||39 || || sugrīva uvāca || || saṃsārāṃbhodhi madhye māṃ janmamṛtyujale bhaye || putradāradhanakṣetravīcimālāsamākule || 3.1.49.40 || majjadbrahmāṃḍakhaṃḍe ca patitaṃ nāptapārakam || krośaṃtamavaśaṃ dīnaṃ viṣayavyā lakātaram || 41 || vyādhinakrasamudvignaṃ tāpatrayajhaṣārtidam || māṃ rakṣa girijānātha rāmanātha namo'stu te || 42 || || vibhīṣaṇa uvāca || || saṃsāravanamadhye māṃ vinaṣṭanijamārgake || vyādhicaure krodhasiṃhe janmavyādhe layorage || 43 || bālyayauvanavārdhakyamahābhīmāṃdhakūpake || krodherṣyā lobhavahnau ca viṣayakrūraparvate || 44 || trāsabhūkaṃṭakāḍhye ca sīdaṃtamadhunāṃdhakam || śobhanāṃ padavīṃ śaṃbho naya rāmeśvarādhunā || 45 || || sarve vānarā ūcuḥ || || niṃdyāniṃdyeṣu sarvatra janitvā yoniṣu prabho || kuṃbhīpākādinarake patitvā ca punastathā || 46 || janitvā ca punaryonau karmaśeṣeṇa kutsite || saṃsāre patitānasmānrāmanātha dayānidhe || 47 || anāthānvivaśāndīnānkrośataḥ pāhi śaṃkara || namastestu dayāsiṃdho rāmanātha maheśvara || 48 || || brahmovāca || || namaste lokanāthāya rāmanāthāya śaṃbhave || prasīda mama sarveśa madavidyāṃ vināśaya || 49 || || || iṃdra uvāca || || yasya śaktirumā devī jaganmātā trayīmayī || tamahaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vaṃde rāmanāthamumāpatim || 3.1.49.50 || || yama uvāca || || putrau gaṇeśvaraskaṃdau vṛṣo yasya ca vāhanam || taṃ vai rāmeśvaraṃ seve sarvājñānanivṛttaye || 51 || || varuṇa uvāca || || yasya pūjāprabhāvena jita mṛtyurmṛkaṃḍujaḥ|| mṛtyuṃjayamupāse'haṃ rāmanāthaṃ hṛdā tu tam || 52 || || kubera uvāca || || īśvarāya lasatkarṇakuṃḍalābharaṇāya te || lākṣāruṇaśarīrāya namo rāmeśvarāya vai || 53 || || āditya uvāca || || namaste'stu mahādeva rāmanātha triyaṃbaka || dakṣādhvaravināśāya namaste pāhi māṃ śiva || 54 || || soma uvāca || || namaste bhasmadigdhāya śūline sarpamāline || rāmanātha dayāṃbhodhe smaśānanilayāya te || 55 || || agniruvāca || || indrādyakhiladikpālasaṃsevitapadāṃbuja || rāmanāthāya śuddhāya namo digvāsase sadā || 56 || || vāyuruvāca || || harāya harirūpāya vyāghracarmāṃbarāya ca || rāmanātha namastubhyaṃ mamābhīṣṭaprado bhava || 57 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || ahaṃtāsākṣiṇe nityaṃ pratyagadvayavastune || rāmanātha mamājñānamāśu nāśaya te namaḥ || 58 || || || śukra uvāca || || vaṃcakānāmalabhyāya mahāmaṃtrārtharūpiṇe || namo dvaitavihīnāya rāmanāthāya śaṃbhave || 59 || || aśvināvūcatuḥ || || ātmarūpatayā nityaṃ yogināṃ bhāsate hṛdi || ananya bhānavedyāya namaste rāghaveśvara || 3.1.49.60 || || agastya uvāca || || ādideva mahādeva viśveśvara śivāvyaya || rāmanāthāṃbikānātha prasīda vṛṣa bhadhvaja || 61 || aparādhasahasraṃ me kṣamasva vidhuśekhara || mamāhamiti putrādāvahaṃtāṃ mama mocaya || 62 || || sutīkṣṇa uvāca || || kṣetrāṇi ratnāni dhanāni dārā mitrāṇi vastrāṇi gavāśvaputrāḥ || naivopakārāya hi rāmanātha mahyaṃ prayaccha tvamato viraktim || 63 || || viśvāmitra uvāca || || śrutāni śāstrāṇyapi niṣphalāni trayyapyadhītā viphalaiva nūnam || tvayīśvare cenna bhaveddhi bhaktiḥ śrīrāmanāthe śiva mānuṣasya ||64|| || || gālava uvāca || || dānāni yajñā niyamāstapāṃsi gaṃgāditīrtheṣu nimajjanāni || rāmeśvaraṃ tvāṃ na namaṃti ye tu vyarthāni teṣāmiti niśca yo'tra || 65 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || kṛtvāpi pāpānyakhilāni lokastvāmetya rāmeśvara bhaktiyuktaḥ || nameta cettāni layaṃ vajeyuryathāṃdha kāro ravitejasā'ddhā || 66 || || atriruvāca || || dṛṣṭvā tu rāmeśvaramekadāpi spṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya bhavaṃtamīśam || punarna garbhaṃ sa naraḥ prayāyā tkiṃ tvadvayaṃ te labhataṃ svarūpam || 67 || aṃgirā uvāca || yo rāmanāthaṃ manujo bhavaṃtamupetya baṃdhūnpraṇamansmareta || saṃtārayettānapi sarvapāpātkima dbhutaṃ tasya kṛtārthatāyām|| 68 || || gautama uvāca || || śrīrāmanātheśvara gūḍhamettadrahasyabhūtaṃ paramaṃ viśokam || tvatpādamūlaṃ bhajatāṃ nṛṇāṃ ye sevāṃ prakurvaṃti hi te'pi dhanyāḥ || 69 || || śatānaṃda uvāca || || vedāṃtavijñānarahasyavidbhirvijñeyametaddhi mumukṣubhistu || śāstrāṇi sarvāṇi vihāya deva tvatsevanaṃ yadraghuvīranātha || 3.1.49.70 || || bhṛguruvāca || || rāmanātha tava pādapaṃkajaṃ dvaṃdvaciṃtanavidhūtakalmaṣaḥ || nirbhayaṃ vrajati satsukhā dvayaṃ suprabhaṃ tvatha amoghaciddhanam || 71 || || kutsa uvāca || || rāmanātha tava pādasevanaṃ bhogamokṣavaradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sadā || rauravādinara kapraṇāśanaṃ kaḥ pumānna bhajate rasagrahaḥ || 72 || || kāśyapa uvāca || || rāmanātha tava pādasevināṃ kiṃ vratairuta tapobhiradhvaraiḥ || vedaśāstra japacintayā ca kiṃ svargasindhupayasāpi kiṃ phalam || 73 || śrīrāmanātha tvamāgatya śīghraṃ mamotkrāṃtikāle bhavānyā ca sākam || māṃ prāpaya svātmapādāravindaṃ viśokaṃ vimohaṃ sukhaṃ citsvarūpam || 74 || || gandharvā ūcuḥ || || rāmanātha tvamasmākaṃ bhajatāṃ bhavasāgare || apāre duḥkhakallole na tvattonyā gatirhi naḥ || 75 || || kinnarā ūcuḥ || || rāmanātha bhavāraṇye vyādhivyāghrabhayānake || tvāmaṃtareṇa nāsmākaṃ padavīdarśako bhavet || 76 || || yakṣā ūcuḥ || || rāmanātheṃdriyārātibādhā no duḥsahā sadā || tānvijetuṃ sahāyastvamasmākaṃ bhava dhūrjaṭe || 77 || || nāgā ūcuḥ || || acintyamahimānaṃ tvā rāmanātha vayaṃ katham|| stotumalpadhiyaḥ śaktā bhaviṣyāmoṃ'bikāpate || || 78 || || kiṃpuruṣā ūcuḥ || || nānāyonau ca jananaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpyanekaśaḥ || vināśaya tathā'jñānaṃ rāmanātha namo'stu te || 79 || || vidyādharā ūcuḥ || || aṃbikāpataye tubhyamasaṃgāya mahātmane|| namaste rāmanāthāya prasīda vṛṣabhadhvaja || 3.1.49.80 || || vasava ūcuḥ || || rāmanāthagaṇeśāya gaṇavṛṃdārcitāṃghraye || gaṃgādharāya guhyāya namaste pāhi naḥ sadā || 81 || || viśvedevā ūcuḥ || || jñaptimātraikaniṣṭhānāṃ muktidāya suyoginām || rāmanāthāya sāṃbāya namo'smānrakṣa śaṃkara || 82 || || maruta ūcuḥ || || paratattvāya tattvānāṃ tattvabhūtāya vastutaḥ || namaste rāmanāthāya svayaṃbhānāya śaṃbhave || 83 || || sādhyā ūcuḥ || || svātiriktavihīnāya jagatsattāpradāyine || rāmeśvarāya devāya namo'vidyā vibhedine || 84 || || sarve devā ūcuḥ || || saccidānaṃdasaṃpūrṇaṃ dvaitavastuvivarjitam || brahmātmānaṃ svayaṃbhānamādimadhyāṃtavarjitam || 85 || avikriyamasaṃgaṃ ca pariśuddhaṃ sanātanam || ākāśādiprapaṃcānāṃ sākṣibhūtaṃ parāmṛtam||86|| pramātītaṃ pramāṇānāmapi bodhapradāyinam|| āvirbhāvatirobhāva saṃkocarahitaṃ sadā || 87 || svasminnadhyastarūpasya prapaṃcasyāsya sākṣiṇam || nirlepaṃ paramānaṃdaṃ nirastasakalakriyam|| 88 || bhūmānaṃdaṃ mahātmānaṃ cidrūpaṃ bhogavarjitam || rāmanāthaṃ vayaṃ sarve svapātakaviśuddhaye || 89 || cintayāmaḥ sadā citte svātmānaṃdabubhutsavaḥ ||
