rakṣāsmānkaruṇāsindho rāma nātha namo'stu te ||3.1.49.9||| rāmanāthāya rudrāya namaḥ saṃsārahāriṇe || brahmaviṣṇvādirūpeṇa vibhinnāya svamāyayā || 91 || vibhīṣaṇasacivā ūcuḥ || varadāya vareṇyāya trinetrāya triśūline || yogidhyeyāya nityāya rāmanāthāya te namaḥ || 92 || || sūta uvāca || || iti rāmādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ stuto rāmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ || prāha sarvānsamāhūya rāmādīndvijasattamāḥ || 93 || rāmarāma mahābhāga jānakīramaṇa prabho || saumitre jānaki śubhe he sugrīva mukhāstathā || 94 || anye brahmamukhā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāsthitāḥ || stotrādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ kṛtamādarāt || 95 || ye paṭhaṃti ca śṛṇvaṃti śrāvayaṃti ca mānavāḥ || || madarcanaphalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 96 || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭisnānapuṇyaṃ ca vai bhavet || varṣamekaṃ rāmasetau vāsapuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 97 || gandhamādanamadhyasthasarvartīrthābhimajjanāt || yatpuṇyaṃ tadbhavettena nātra saṃśayakāraṇam || 98 || uktvaivaṃ rāmanātho'pi svātmaliṃge tirodadhe || stotrādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ nityaṃ saṃkīrtayannaraḥ || 99 || jarāmaraṇanirmukto janmaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || rāmanāthasya sāyujyamuktiṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || 3.1.49.100 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye rāmādibhī rāmanāthastotrakathanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
<3.1.50>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi setumādhavavaibhavam|| śṛṇudhvaṃ munayo bhaktyā puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param|| 1 || purā puṇyanidhirnāma rājā somakulodbhavaḥ || madhurāṃ pālayāmāsa hālāsyeśvarabhūṣitām || 2 || kadācitsa mahīpālaścaturaṃgabalānvitaḥ || sāṃ'taḥpuraparīvāro madhurāyāṃ nijaṃ sutam || 3 || sthāpayitvā rāmasetuṃ prayayau snānakautukī || tatra gatvā dhanuṣkoṭau snātvā saṃkalpapūrvakam || 4 || anyeṣvapi ca tīrtheṣu tatratyeṣu nṛpottamaḥ || sasnau rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ siṣeve ca sabhaktikam || || 5 || evaṃ sa bahukālaṃ vai tatraiva nyavasatsukham || rāmasetau vasanpuṇye gandhamādanaparvate || 6 || viṣṇuprītikaraṃ yajñaṃ kadācidakaronnṛpaḥ || yajñāvasāne rājāsau mudāvabhṛthakautukī || 7 || sasnau rāmadhanuṣkoṭau sadāraḥ saparicchadaḥ || sevitvā rāmanāthaṃ ca sa veśma prayayau dvijāḥ || 8 || evaṃ nivasamāne'sminrājñi puṇyanidhau tadā || kadāciddhariṇā lakṣmīrvinodakalahākulā || 9 || hariṇā samayaṃ kṛtvā nṛpabhaktiṃ parīkṣitum || viṣṇunā preṣitā lakṣmīrvaikuṃṭhātkamalālayā || 3.1.50.10 || aṣṭavarṣavayorūpā prayayau gaṃdhamādane || tatrāgatya dhanuṣkoṭau tasthau sā kamalālayā || 11 || tasminnavasare rājā yayau guṇanidhirdvijāḥ || snātuṃ rāmadhanuṣkoṭau sadāraḥ sahasainikaḥ || 12 || tatra gatvā sa rājā'yaṃ snātvā niyamapūrvakam|| tulāpuruṣamukhyāni kṛtvā dānāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 13 || prayātukāmo bhavanaṃ kanyāṃ kāṃciddadarśa saḥ || atīvarūpasaṃpannāmaṣṭavarṣāṃ śucismitām|| || 14 || dṛṣṭvā nṛpastāṃ papraccha kanyāṃ cāruvilocanām || cārusmitāṃ cārudatīṃ biṃboṣṭhīṃ tanumadhyamām || 15 || || puṇyanidhiruvāca || || kā tvaṃ kanye sutā kasya kuto vā tvamihāgatā || atrāgamena kiṃ kāryaṃ tava vatse śucismite || 16 || evaṃ nṛpastāṃ papraccha kanyāmutpalaloca nām|| evaṃ pṛṣṭā tadā kanyā nṛpaṃ tamavadadvijāḥ || 17 || na me mātā pitā nāsti na ca me bāṃdhavāstathā || anāthāhaṃ mahārāja bhaviṣyāmi ca te sutā || 18 || tvadgṛhe'haṃ nivatsyāmi tāta tvāṃ paśyatīsadā || haṭhātkṛṣyati yo vā māṃ grahīṣyati kareṇa tam || 19 || yadi śāsiṣyase bhūpa tadāhaṃ tava maṃdire || vatsyāmi te sutā bhūtvā pitarguṇanidhe ciram || 3.1.50.20 || evamuktastadā prāha kanyāṃ guṇanidhirnṛpaḥ || ahaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi tvaduktaṃ kanyake śubhe || 21 || mamāpi duhitā nāsti putro'styekaḥ kulodvahaḥ || tava yasminrucirbhadre tvāṃ tasmai pradadāmyaham || 22 || āgaccha madgṛhaṃ kanye mama cāṃtaḥpure vasa || madbhāryāyāḥ sutā bhūtvā yathākāmamaniṃdite || 23 || ityuktā sā nṛpeṇātha kanyā kamalalocanā ||| tathā stviti nṛpaṃ procya tena sākaṃ yayau gṛham || 24 || rājā svabhāryāhaste tāṃ pradadau kanyakāṃ śubhām || abravīcca svakāṃ bhāryāṃ rājā vindhyāvaliṃ tadā || 25 || āvayoḥ kanyakā ceyaṃ rājñi viṃdhyāvale śubhe || rakṣemāṃ sarvathā tvaṃ vai puruṣāṃtarataḥ priye || 26 || itīritā nṛpeṇāsau bhāryā viṃdhyā valistadā || omityuktvātha tāṃ kanyāṃ putrīṃ jagrāha pāṇinā || 27 || poṣitā pālitā rājñā sutavatkanyakā ca sā || nyavātsītsusukhaṃ rājño bhavane lālitā sadā ||28|| atha viṣṇurjagannātho lakṣmīmanveṣṭumādarāt || ārūḍhavinatānando vaikuṃṭhānniryayau dvijāḥ ||29|| vinirgatya sa vaikuṃṭhā dvilaṃghitaviyatpathaḥ || babhrāma ca bahūndeśāllam̐kṣmīṃ tatra na dṛṣṭavān||3.1.50.30|| rāmasetumathāgacchadgaṃdhamādanaparvate || anviṣya sarvato rāmasetuṃ babhrāma ceṃdi rām|| 31 || etasminneva kāle sā puṣpāvacayakautukāt || sakhībhiḥ kanyakāyāsīdbhavanodyānapādapān || 32 || puṣpāṇyavacinoti sma sakhībhiḥ saha kānane || tatrāgatya tato viṣṇurviprarūpadharo dvijāḥ || 33 || gaṃgāṃbho vidadhatskaṃdhe vahañchatraṃ karaṃṇa ca || gaṃgāsnāyidvijasyeva racayanveṣamātmanaḥ || 34 || dhārayandakṣiṇe pāṇau kuśāgraṃthipavitrakam || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgastripuṇḍrāvaliśobhitaḥ || 35 || prajapañchivanāmāni dhṛtarudrākṣa mālikaḥ || sottarīyaḥ śucirviprāḥ samāyāto janārdanaḥ || 36 || tamāgataṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā stabdhā'tiṣṭhata kanyakā || apaśyadaṣṭavarṣāṃ tāṃ vallabhāṃ puṣpa hāriṇīm || 37 || dṛṣṭvā sa tvarayā vipraḥ kanyāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīm || haṭhātkṛtya kareṇāsau jagrāha garuḍadhvajaḥ || 38 || tadā cukrośa sā kanyā sakhībhiḥ saha kānane || tamākrośaṃ samākarṇya rājā sa tu samāgataḥ || 39 || prayayau bhavanodyānaṃ vṛtaḥ katipayairbhaṭaiḥ || gatvā papraccha tāṃ kanyāṃ tatsakhīrapi bhūpatiḥ || 3.1.50.40 || kimarthamadhunā kruṣṭaṃ sakhībhiḥ saha kanyake || tvayā tu bhavanodyāne tatra kāraṇamucyatām || 41 || kena tvaṃ paribhūtāsi haṭhātkṛṣya sute mama || iti pṛṣṭā tamācaṣṭa kanyā guṇanidhiṃ nṛpam || bāṣpapūrṇānanā khinnā ruṣitā bhṛśakātarā || 42 || || kanyovāca || || ayaṃ vipro haṭhātkṛtya jagṛhe pāṃḍyanātha mām || 43 || tātātra vṛkṣamūle'sau sa tiṣṭhatyakutobhayaḥ || tadākarṇya vacastasyā rājā guṇanidhiḥ sudhīḥ || 44 || jagrāha tarasā vipramavidvāṃstadbalaṃ haṭhāt || rāmanāthālayaṃ nītvā nigṛhya ca haṭhāttadā || 45 || baddhvā nigaḍapāśābhyā mānayanmaṃḍapaṃ ca tam || ātmaputrīṃ samāśvāsya śuddhāṃtamanayannṛpaḥ || 46 || svayaṃ ca prayayau ramyaṃ bhavanaṃ nṛpapuṃgavaḥ || tato rātrau svapanrājā svapne vipraṃ dadarśa tam || 47 || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam || kaustubhālaṃkṛtoraskaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ harim || 48 || kālameghacchaviṃ kāṃtaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitam || cārusmitaṃ cārudaṃtaṃ lasanmakarakuṇḍalam || 49 || viṣvaksenaprabhṛtibhiḥ kiṃkarairupasevitam || śeṣaparyaṃkaśayanaṃ nāradādi munistutam || 3.1.50.50 || dadarśa ca svakāṃ kanyāṃ vikāsikamalasthitām || dhṛtapaṃkajahastāṃ tāṃ nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām || 51 || viṣṇuvakṣasthalrāvāsāṃ samunnatapayodharām || diggajairabhiṣiktāṃgīṃ śyāmāṃ pītāṃbarāvṛtām || 52 || svarṇapaṃkajasaṃklṛptamālālaṃkṛtamūrdhajām || divyābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ cāruhā ravibhūṣitām || 53 || anargharatnasaṃklṛptanāsābharaṇaśobhitām || suvarṇaniṣkābharaṇāṃ kāṃcīnūpurarājitām || 54 || mahālakṣmīṃ dadarśāsau rājā rātrau svakāṃ sutām || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpaḥ svapne vipraṃ taṃ svasutāmapi || 55 || utthitaḥ sahasā talpātkanyāgṛhamavāpa ca || tathaiva dṛṣṭavānkanyāṃ yathā svapne dadarśa tām || 56 || athodite savitari kanyāmādāya bhūmipaḥ || rāmanāthālayaṃ prāpa brāhmaṇaṃ nyastavānyataḥ || 57 || sa maṃḍapavare vipraṃ dadarśa harirūpiṇam || yathā dadarśa svapne taṃ vanamālādicihnitam || viṣṇuṃ vijñāya tuṣṭāva nṛpatirharimīśvaram || 58 || || puṇyanidhiruvāca || || namaste kamalākāṃta prasīda garuḍadhvaja || 59 || śārṅgapāṇe namastubhyamaparādhaṃ kṣamasva me || namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa cakrapāṇe śriyaḥpate || 3.1.50.60 || kaustubhālaṃkṛtāṃkāya namaḥ śrīvatsalakṣmaṇe || namaste brahmaputrāya daityasaṃghavidāriṇe || 61 || aśeṣabhuvanāvāsanābhipaṃkajaśāline || madhukaiṭabhasaṃhartre rāvaṇāṃtakarāya te ||62|| prahrādarakṣiṇe tubhyaṃ dharitrīpataye namaḥ || nirguṇāyāprameyāya viṣṇave buddhisākṣiṇe ||63|| namaste śrīnivāsāya jaga ddhātre parātmane|| nārāyaṇāya devāya kṛṣṇāya madhuvidviṣe||64|| namaḥ paṃkajanābhāya namaḥ paṃkajacakṣuṣe|| namaḥ paṃkajahastāyāḥ pataye paṃkajāṃghraye ||65|| bhūyobhūyo jagannātha namaḥ paṃkajamāline || dayāmūrtte namastubhyamaparādhaṃ kṣamasva me || 66 || mayā nigaḍapāśābhyāṃ yaḥ kṛto madhusūdana || anayastvatsvarūpamaviditvā kṛtaḥ prabho || 67 || ato madaparādho'yaṃ kṣaṃtavyo madhusūdana || evaṃ stutvā mahāviṣṇuṃ rājā puṇyanidhirdvijāḥ || 68 || lakṣmīṃ tuṣṭāva jananīṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ mudā || namo devi jagaddhātri viṣṇuvakṣasthalālaye || 69 || namobdhisaṃbhave tubhyaṃ mahālakṣmi haripriye || siddhyai puṣṭyai svadhāyai ca svāhāyai satataṃ namaḥ || 3.1.50.70 || saṃdhyāyai ca prabhāyai ca dhātryai bhūtyai namonamaḥ || śraddhāyai caiva medhāyai sarasvatyai namonamaḥ || 71 || yajñavidye mahāvidye guhyavidyetiśobhane || ātmavidye ca deveśi muktide sarvadehinām || 72 || trayīrūpe jaganmātarjagadrakṣāvidhāyini || rakṣa māṃ tvaṃ kṛpādṛṣṭyā sṛṣṭisthityaṃtakāriṇi || 73 || bhūyobhūyo namastubhyaṃ brahmamātre maheśvari || iti stutvā mahālakṣmīṃ prārthayāmāsa mādhavam || 74|| yadajñānānmayā viṣṇo tvayi doṣaḥ kṛto'dhunā || pāde nigaḍabaṃdhena sa drohaḥ kṣamyatāṃ tvayā || 76 || lokāste śiśavaḥ sarve tvaṃ pitā jagatāṃ hare|| sutā'parādhaḥ pitṛbhiḥ kṣaṃtavyo madhusūdana || 76 || aparādhināṃ ca daityānāṃ svarūpamapi dattavān || bhavānviṣṇo mamāpīmamaparādhaṃ kṣamasva vai || || 77 || jighāṃsayāpi bhagavannāgatāṃ pūtanāṃ purā || anayastvatpadāṃbhojaṃ tanmāṃ rakṣa kṛpānidhe || lakṣmīkāṃta kṛpādṛṣṭiṃ mayi pātaya keśava || 78 || || || śrīsūta uvāca || || iti saṃprārthito viṣṇu rājñā tena dvijottamāḥ || prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā nṛpaṃ puṇyanidhiṃ tataḥ || 79 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || rājanna bhīstvayā kāryā madbaṃdhananimittajā || 3.1.50.80 || bhaktavaśyatvamadhunā tava pratihitaṃ mayā || mama prītikaraṃ yajñamakarodyadbhavāniha || || 91 || atastvaṃ mama bhaktosi rājanpuṇyanidhe'dhunā || tenāhaṃ tava vaśyo'smi bhaktipāśena yaṃtritaḥ || 82 || bhaktāparādhaṃ satataṃ kṣamāmyahamariṃ dama || tvadbhaktiṃ jñātukāmena mayā saṃpreritā tviyam || 83 || lakṣmīrmama priyā rājaṃstvayāsaṃrakṣitā'dhunā || tenāhaṃ tava tuṣṭo'smi matsvarūpā tviyaṃ sadā || 84 || asyāṃ yo bhaktimāṃlloke sa madbhakto'bhidhīyate || asyāṃ yo vimukho rājansa maddveṣī smṛtaḥ sadā || 85 || tvamimāṃ bhaktisaṃ yukto yasmātpūjitavānasi || matpūjāpi kṛtā tasmānmadabhinnā tviyaṃ yataḥ || 86 || atastvayā nāparādhaḥ kṛto mayi nareśvara || kiṃ tu pūjaiva vihitā tāṃ tvayārcayatā mama || 97 || tvayā madbhāryayā sākaṃ saṃketo'kāri yatpurā || tatsaṃketābhigutyarthaṃ māṃ yadbaṃdhitavānasi || 88 || tena prītosmi te rājam̐llakṣmīḥ saṃrakṣitā'dhunā || matsvarūpā ca sā lakṣmīrjaganmātā trayīmayī || 89 || tadrakṣāṃ kurvatā bhūpa tvayā yadbaṃdhanaṃ mama || tatpriyaṃ mama rājeṃdra mā bhayaṃ kriyatāṃ tvayā || 3.1.50.90 || iyaṃ lakṣmīstava sutā satyameva na saṃśayaḥ || itīrite'tha hariṇā lakṣmīḥ provāca bhūpatim || || 91 || || lakṣmīruvāca || || rājanprītāsmi te cāhaṃ rakṣitā yadgṛhe tvayā || tvadbhaktiśodhanārthaṃ vā ahaṃ viṣṇurubhāvapi || 92 || vinoda kalahavyājādāgatāviha bhūpate || tava yogena bhaktyā ca tuṣṭāvāvāṃ paraṃtapa || 93 || āvayoḥ kṛpayā rājansukhaṃ te bhavatātsadā || sarvabhūmaṃḍalaiśvaryaṃ sadā te bhavatu dhruvam || 94 || āvayoḥ pādayugale bhaktirbhavatu te dhruvā || dehāṃte mama sāyujyaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 95 || nityaṃ bhavatu te rājanmā bhūtte pāpadhīstathā || sadā dharme bhava dhīrviṣṇubhaktiyutā tava ||96|| evamuktvā nṛpaṃ lakṣmīrviṣṇorvakṣasthalaṃ yayau || atha viṣṇuruvācedaṃ rājānaṃ dvija puṃgavāḥ || 97 || yathā tvayātra baddhohaṃ nigaḍena nṛpotama || tadrūpeṇaiva vatsyāmi setumādhavasaṃjñitaḥ || 98 || mayaiva kāritaḥ setustadrakṣārthamahaṃ nṛpa || bhūtarākṣasasaṃghebhyo bhayānāmupaśāṃtaye ||99|| brahmāpi seturakṣārthaṃ vasatyatradivāniśam|| śaṃkaro rāmanāthākhyo nityaṃ setau vasatyatha||3.1.50.100|| iṃdrādilokapālāśca vasaṃtyatramudānvitāḥ || ato'hamatravatsyāmi setumādhavasaṃjñayā ||101|| setusaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ vai sarvopadravaśāṃtaye || sarveṣāmiṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ sarvapāpopaśāṃtaye || 102 || tvayā nigaḍabaddhaṃ māṃ sevate ye'tra mānavāḥ || te yāṃti mama sāyujyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaṃ tathā nṛpa || 103 || mama lakṣmyāstava tathā caritaṃ ye paṭhaṃti vai|| na te yāsyaṃti dāridryaṃ kiṃ tvaiśvaryaṃ vrajaṃti te ||104|| tvatkṛtaṃ yadidaṃ stotraṃ mama lakṣmyā viśāṃpate || ye paṭhaṃti ca śṛṇvaṃti likhaṃti ca mudānvitāḥ || 105 || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirmama lokātkadācana || ityuktvā sa haristatra nṛpaṃ puṇyanidhiṃ tadā || 106 || tatraiva pūrṇarūpeṇa saṃni dhatte sma sarvadā || nṛpaḥ puṇyanidhirviprāḥ setumādhavarūpiṇam|| 107 || viṣṇuṃ praṇamya bhaktyā tu mahāpūjāṃ vidhāya ca || sevitvā rāmanāthaṃ ca svameva bhavanaṃ yayau || 108 || yāvajjīvamasau tatra setau nyavasaduttame || madhurāyāṃ nijaṃ putraṃ sthāpayāmāsa pālakam || 109 || tatraiva nivasanrājā dehāṃte muktimāptavān || viṃdhyāvaliśca tatpatnī tamevānumamāra sā || pativratā patiprāṇā prayayau sāpi sadgatim||3.1.50.110||| || śrīsūta uvāca || || yetra bhaktiyutā nityaṃ sevaṃte setumādhavam || 111 || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kailāsājjātu jāyate || setumādhavasevā ye na kurvaṃtyatra mānavāḥ || || 112 || na teṣāṃ rāmanāthasya sevā phalavatī bhavet || gṛhītvā saikataṃ setorgaṃgāyāṃ nikṣipedyadi || 113 || vibhajya mādhavapure vaikuṃṭhe sa vasennaraḥ || gaṃgāṃ jigamiṣurviprāḥ setumādhavasannidhau || 114 || saṃkalpya gaṃgāṃ nirgacchetsā yātrā saphalā bhavet|| ānīya gaṃgāsalilaṃ rāmeśamabhi ṣicya ca || 115 || setau nikṣipya tadbhāraṃ brahma prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ || iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ setumādhavavaibhavam || 116 || etatpaṭhanvā śṛṇvanvā vaikuṃṭhe labhate gatim || 117 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīya brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye setumādhavapraśaṃsāyāṃ puṇya nidhicaritakathanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
<3.1.51>
|| sūta uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi setuyātrākramaṃ dvijāḥ || yaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate mānavaḥ kṣaṇāt || 1 || snātvācamya viśuddhātmā kṛtanityavidhiḥ sudhīḥ || rāmanāthasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ prītyarthaṃ rāghavasya ca || 2 || bhojayitvā yathāśakti brāhmaṇānvedapāragān || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgastripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ || 3 || gopīcandanalipto vā svabhāle'pyūrdhvapuṃḍrakaḥ || rudrākṣa mālābharaṇaḥ sapavitrakaraḥ śuciḥ || 4 || setuyātrāṃ kariṣye'hamiti saṃkalpya bhaktitaḥ || svagṛhātpravrajenmaunī japannaṣṭākṣaraṃ manum || 5 || paṃcākṣaraṃ nāmamaṃtraṃ japenniyatamānasaḥ || ekavāraṃ haviṣyāśī jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || 6 || pādukāchatrarahitastāṃbūlaparivarjitaḥ || tailābhyaṃgavihīnaśca strīsaṃgādivivarjitaḥ ||7|| śaucādyācārasaṃyuktaḥ sandhyopāstiparāyaṇaḥ || gāyatryupāsti kurvāṇastrisaṃdhyaṃ rāmaciṃtakaḥ || 8 || madhyemārgaṃ paṭhannityaṃ setumāhātmyamādarāt || paṭhanrāmāyaṇaṃ vāpi purāṇāṃtarameva vā || 9 || vyarthavākyāni saṃtyajya setuṃ gacchedviśuddhaye || pratigrahaṃ na gṛhṇīyānnācārāṃśca parityajet || 3.1.51.10 || kuryānmārge yathāśakti śivaviṣṇvādipūjanam || vaiśvadevādikarmāṇi yathāśakti samācaret || 11 || brahmayajñamukhāndharmā nprakuryāccāgnipūjanam || atithibhyo'nnapānādi saṃpradadyādyathābalam || 12 || dadyādbhikṣāṃ yatibhyo'pi vittaśāṭhyaṃ parityajan || śivaviṣṇvādi nāmāni stotrāṇi ca paṭhetpathi || 13 || dharmameva sadā kuryānniṣiddhāni parityajet || ityādiniyamopetaḥ setumūlaṃ tato vrajet || 14 || pāṣāṇaṃ prathamaṃ dadyāttatra gatvā samāhitaḥ || tatrāvāhya samudraṃ ca praṇamettadanaṃtaram || 15 || arghyaṃ dadyātsamudrāya prārthayettadanaṃtaram|| anujñāṃ ca tataḥ kuryāttataḥ snāyānmahodadhau || 16 || munīnāmatha devānāṃ kapīnāṃ pitṛṇāṃ tathā || prakuryāttarpaṇaṃ viprā manasā saṃsmaranharim || 17 || || pāṣāṇasaṃkhyā || || pāṣāṇasaptakaṃ dadyādekaṃ vā viprapuṃgavāḥ || pāṣāṇadānātsaphalaṃ snānaṃ bhavati nānyathā || 18 || || pāṣāṇadānamaṃtraḥ || || pippalādasamutpanne kṛtye lokabhayaṃkare || pāṣāṇaṃ te mayā dattamāhārārthaṃ prakalpyatām || 19 || || sānnidhyaprārthanāmantraḥ || || viśvārci tvaṃ ghṛtāci tvaṃ viśvayāne viśāṃpate || sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva sāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi || 3.1.51.20 || || namaskāramantraḥ || || namaste viśvaguptāya namo viṣṇo hyapāṃpate || namo hiraṇyaśṛṃgāya nadīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || sūmudrāya vayūnāya proccārya praṇamettathā || 21 || || arghyamantraḥ || || sarvaratnamaya śrīmansarvaratnākarākara || sarvaratnapradhānastvaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mahodadhe || 22 || || anujñāpanamaṃtraḥ || || aśeṣajagadādhāra śaṃkhacakragadā dhara || dehi deva mamānujñāṃ yuṣmattīrthaniṣevaṇe || 23 || || prārthanāmaṃtraḥ || || prācyāṃ diśi ca sugrīvaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ nalaṃ smaret || 24 || pratīcyāṃ maiṃdanāmānamudīcyāṃ dvividaṃ tathā || rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva sītāmapi yaśasvinīm || 25 || aṃgadaṃ vāyutanayaṃ smarenmadhye vibhīṣaṇam || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni prāviśaṃstvā mahodadhe || 26 || snānasya me phalaṃ dehi sarvasmāttrāhi māṃhasaḥ || hiraṇyaśṛṃgamityābhyāṃ nābhyāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret || 27 || dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ snānādiṣu ca karmasu || brahmalokamavāpnoti jāyate neha vai punaḥ || 28 || sarveṣāmapi pāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhavettataḥ || prahlādaṃ nāradaṃ vyāsamaṃbarīṣaṃ śukaṃ tathā || anyāṃśca bhagavadbhaktāṃściṃtayedekamānasaḥ || 29 || || snānamantraḥ || || vedādiryo vedavasiṣṭhayoniḥ saritpatiḥ sāgararatnayoniḥ || agniśca tejaśca ilāṃ ca tejo retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ || 3.1.51.30 || idaṃ te anyābhirasamānamadbhiryāḥ kāśca siṃdhuṃ praviśaṃtyāpaḥ || sarpo jīrṇāmiva tvacaṃ jahāmi pāpaṃ śarīrātsaśirasko'bhyupetya ||31|| samudrāya vayūnāya namaskuryātpunardvijāḥ || sarvatīrthamayaṃ śuddhaṃ nadīnāṃ patimaṃbudhim || 32|| dvau samudrāviti punaḥ proccārya snānamācaret || brahmāṃḍodaratīrthāni karaspṛṣṭāni te rave || 33 || tena satyena me setau tīrthaṃ dehi divākara || prācyāṃ diśi ca sugrīvamityādikramayogataḥ ||34|| smṛtvā bhūyo dvijāḥ setau tṛtīyaṃ snānamācaret || devīpattanamārabhya pravrajedyadi mānavaḥ || 35 || tadā tu navapāṣāṇamadhye setau vimuktide || snānamaṃbunidhau kuryātsvapāpaughāpanuttaye || 36 || darbhaśayyāpadavyā cedgacche tsetuṃ vimuktidam || tadā tatrodadhāveva snānaṃ kuryādvimuktaye || 37 || || tarpaṇavidhiḥ || || pippalādaṃ kaviṃ kaṇvaṃ kṛtāṃtaṃ jīviteśvaram || manyuṃ ca kālarātriṃ ca vidyāṃ cāhargaṇeśvaram || 38 || vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca parāśaramumāpatim || vālmikiṃ nāradaṃ caiva vālakhilyānmunīṃstathā || 39 || nalaṃ nīlaṃ gavākṣaṃ ca gavayaṃ gandhamādanam || maiṃdaṃ ca dvividaṃ caiva śarabhaṃ carṣabhaṃ tathā || 3.1.51.40 || sugrīvaṃ ca hanūmaṃtaṃ vegadarśanameva ca || rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ sītāṃ mahābhāgāṃ yaśasvinīm || 41 || triḥ kṛtvā tarpayedetānmaṃtrānuktvā yathākramam || vibhośca tattannāmāni caturthyaṃtāni vai dvijāḥ ||42|| devā nṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva vidhivacca tilodakaiḥ|| dvitīyāṃtāni nāmāni coktvā tarpayeddvijāḥ || 43|| tarpayetsapavitrastu jale sthitvā prasannadhīḥ || tarpaṇātsarvatīrtheṣu snānasya phalamāpnuyāt || 44 || evametāṃstarpayitvā namaskṛtyottarejjalāt || ārdravastraṃ parityajya śuṣkavāsaḥsamāvṛtaḥ || 45 || ācamya sapavitraśca vidhivacchrāddhamācaret || piṃḍānpitṛbhyo dadyācca tilataṇḍulakaistathā || 46 || etacchrāddhamaśaktasya mayā proktaṃ dvijottamāḥ || dhanāḍhyo'nnena vai śrāddhaṃ ṣaḍrasena samācaret || 47 || gobhūtilahiraṇyādidānaṃ kuryātsamṛddhimān || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭāvevameva samācaret || 48 || pāṣāṇadānapūrvāṇi tarpaṇāṃtāni vai dvijāḥ || setumūle yathaitāni vidhivadvyatanoddvijāḥ || 49 || cakratīrthaṃ tato gatvā tatrāpi snānamācaret || paśyecca setvadhipatiṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 3.1.51.50 || gacchanpaścimamārgeṇa tatratye cakratīrthake || snātvā darbhaśayaṃ devaṃ prapaśyedbhaktipūrvakam || 51 || kapitīrthaṃ tataḥ prāpya tatrāpi snānamācaret || sītākuṃḍaṃ tataḥ prāpya tatrāpi snānamācaret || 52 || ṛṇamocanatīrthaṃ tu tataḥ prāpya mahāphalam || snātvā praṇamya rāmaṃ ca jānakīramaṇaṃ prabhum || 53 || gacchellakṣmaṇatīrthaṃ tu kaṇṭhādupari vāpanam || kṛtvā snāyācca tatrāpi duṣkṛtānyapi cintayan || 54 || tataḥ snātvā rāmatīrthe tato devālayaṃ vrajet || snātvā pāpavināśane ca gaṃgāyamunayostathā || 55 || sāvitryāṃ ca sarasvatyāṃ gāyatryāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || snātvā ca hanumatkuṇḍe tataḥ snāyānmahāphale || brahmakuṇḍaṃ tataḥ prāpya snāyādvidhipuraḥsaram || 56 || nāgakuṇḍaṃ tataḥ prāpya sarvapāpavināśanam || snānaṃ kuryānnaro viprā narakakleśanāśanam || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstīrthāni sakalānyapi || 57 || sarvadā nāgakuṃḍe tu vasaṃti svāghaśāṃtaye || anaṃtādimahānāgairaṣṭābhiridamuttamam || 58 || kalpitaṃ muktidaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmasetau śivaṃkaram || agastyakuṇḍaṃ saṃprāpya tataḥ snāyādanuttamam || 59 || athāgnitīrthamāsādya sarvaduṣkarmanāśanam || snātvā saṃtarpya vidhivacchrāddhaṃ kuryātpitṝnsmaran || 3.1.51.60 || gobhūhiraṇya dhānyādi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svaśaktitaḥ || dattvāgnitīrthatīre tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 61 || athavā yāni tīrthāni cakratīrthamukhāni vai || anukrāṃtāni vipreṃdrāḥ sarvapāpaharāṇi tu || 62 || snāyāttadanupūrveṇa snāyādvāpi yathāruci || snātvaivaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu śrāddhādīni samācaret || 63 || paścādrāmeśvaraṃ prāpya niṣevya parameśvaram || setumādhavamāgatya tathā rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇam || 64 || sītāṃ prabhaṃjanasutaṃ tathānyānkapisattamān || tatratya sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā niyamapūrvakam || 65 || praṇamya rāmanāthaṃ ca rāmacaṃdraṃ tathāparān || namaskṛtya dhanuṣkoṭiṃ tataḥ snātuṃ vrajennaraḥ || 66 || tatra pāṣāṇa dānādipūrvoktaniyamaṃ caret || dhanuṣkoṭau ca dānāni dadyādvittānusārataḥ || 67 || kṣatraṃ gāśca tathānyāni vastrāṇyanyāni cādarāt || brāhmaṇebhyo vedavidbhyo dadyādvittānusārataḥ || 68 || koṭitīrthaṃ tataḥ prāpya snāyānniyamapūrvakam || tato rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ praṇamedvṛṣabhadhvajam || 69 || vibhave sati viprebhyo dadyātsauvarṇadakṣiṇām|| tilāndhānyaṃ ca gāṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāṇyanyāni taṃḍulān || 3.1.51.70 || dadyādvittānusāreṇa vittalobhavivarjitaḥ || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pūjopakaraṇānica || 71 || rāmeśvarāya devāya dadyādvittānusārataḥ || stutvā rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ praṇamya ca sabhaktikam || 72 || anujñāpya tato gacchatsetumādhavasaṃnidhim || tasmai dattvā ca dhūpādīnanujñāpya ca mādhavam || 73 || pūrvoktaniyamopetaḥ punarāyātsvakaṃ gṛham || brāhmaṇānbhojayedannaiḥ ṣaḍrasaiḥ paripūritaiḥ || 74 || tenaiva rāmanātho'smai prīto'bhīṣṭaṃ prayacchati || nārakaṃ cāsya nāstyeva dāridryaṃ ca vinaśyati || || 75 || saṃtatirvardhate tasya puruṣasya dvijottamāḥ || saṃsāramavadhūyāśu sāyujyamapi yāsyati || 76 || atrāgantumaśaktaścecchrutismṛtyāgameṣu yat || graṃthajātaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ setumāhātmyasūcakam || 77 || taṃ graṃthaṃ pāṭhayedviprā mahāpātakanāśanam || idaṃ vā setumāhātmyaṃ paṭhedbhaktipuraḥsaram || 78 || setusnānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ tenāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || aṃdhapaṃgvādiviṣayametatproktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 79 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathito viprāḥ setuyātrākramo dvijāḥ || etatpaṭhanvā śṛṇvanvā sarvaduḥkhādvimucyate || 3.1.51.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye yātrākramavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
<3.1.52>
|| śrīsūta uvāca || || bhūyo'pyahaṃ pravakṣyāmi setumuddiśya vaibhavam || yuṣmākamādareṇāhaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 1 || sthānānāmapi sarveṣāmetatsthānaṃ mahattaram || atra japtaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ dattaṃ cākṣaya mucyate || 2 || asminneva mahāsthāne dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt|| vārāṇasyāṃ daśasamāvāsapuṇyaphalaṃ bhavet || 3 || tasmiṃsthale dhanuṣkoṭau snātvā rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || dṛṣṭvā naro bhaktiyuktastridināni vaseddvijāḥ || 4 || puṇḍarīkapure tena daśavatsaravāsajam || puṇyaṃ bhavati vipreṃdrā mahāpātakanāśa nam ||5|| aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu maṃtramādyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || atra japtvā naro bhaktyā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 6 || madhyārjune kuṃbhakoṇe māyūre śvetakānane || hālāsye ca gajāraṇye vedāraṇye ca naimiṣe || 7 || śrīparvate ca śrīraṃge śrīmadvṛddhagirau tathā || cidaṃbare ca valmīke śeṣādrāvaruṇācale || 8 || śrīmaddakṣiṇakailāse veṃkaṭādrau haristhale || kāṃcīpure brahmapure vaidyeśvarapure tathā || 9 || anyatrāpi śivasthāne viṣṇusthāne ca sattamāḥ || varṣavāsabhavaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanuṣkoṭau naro mudā ||3.1.52.10||| māghamāse yadi snāyādāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ || imaṃ setuṃ samuddiśya dvau samudrāviti śrutiḥ ||11|| vidyate brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā mātṛbhūtā sanātanī || ado yaddārurityanyā yatrāsti munipuṃgavāḥ || 12 || viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyaṃtī setuvaibhavaśaṃsinī || śrutirasti tathānyāpi tadviṣṇoriti cāparā || 13 || itihāsapurāṇāni smṛtayaśca tapodhanāḥ || ekavākyatayā setumāhātmyaṃ prabuvaṃti hi || 14 || caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu kurva nsetvavagāhanam || avimukte daśābdaṃ tu gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇenaiva naśyati || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpnotya nuttamam ||16|| viṣuvāyanasaṃkrāṃtau śaśivāre ca parvaṇi || setudarśanamātreṇa saptajanmārjitāśubham ||17|| naśyate svargatiṃ caiva prayāṃti dvijapuṃgavāḥ || makarasthe ravau māghe kiṃcidabhyudite ravau || 18 || snātvā dinatrayaṃ martyo dhanuṣkoṭau vipātakaḥ || gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu snānapuṇyamavāpnuyāt || || 19 || dhanuṣkauṭau naraḥ kuryātsnānaṃ paṃcadineṣu yaḥ || aśvamedhādipuṇyaṃ ca prāpnuyādbrāhmaṇottamāḥ || 3.1.52.20 || cāṃdrāyaṇādikṛcchrāṇāmanuṣṭhānaphalaṃ labhet || caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pārāyaṇaphalaṃ tathā || 21 || māghamāse daśāhaḥsu dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || brahmahatyāyutaṃ naśyennātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 22 || māghamāse dhanuṣkoṭau daśapaṃcadināni yaḥ || snānaṃ karoti manujaḥ sa vaikuṃṭhamavāpnuyāt || 23 || māghamāse rāmasaitau snānaṃ viṃśaddi naṃ caran || śivasāmīpyamāpnoti śivena saha modate || 24 || paṃcaviṃśaddinaṃ snānaṃ kurvansārūpyamāpnuyāt || snānaṃ triṃśaddinaṃ kurvansāyujyaṃ labhate dhruvam || 25 || ato'vaśyaṃ rāmasetau māghamāse dvijottamāḥ || snānaṃ samācaredvidvānkiṃcidabhyudite ravau || 26 || caṃdrasūryoparāge ca tathaivārddhodaye dvijāḥ || mahodaye rāmasetau snānaṃ kurvandvijottamāḥ || 27 || anekakleśasaṃyuktaṃ garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati|| brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ ca prakīrtitam || || 28 || sarveṣāṃ narakāṇāṃ ca bādhakaṃ parikīrtitam || saṃpadāmapi sarvāsāṃ nidānaṃ parikīrtitam || 29 || indrādisarvalokānāṃ sālokyādipradaṃ tathā || caṃdrasūryoparāge ca tathaivārddhodaye dvijāḥ || 3.1.52.30 || mahodaye dhanuṣkoṭau majjanaṃ tvatiniścitam || rāvaṇasya vināśārthaṃ purā rāmeṇa nirmi tam || 31 || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvakinnaroragasevitam || brahmadevarṣirājarṣipitṛsaṃghaniṣevitam || 32 || brahmādidevatāvṛṃdaissevitaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || puṇyaṃ yo rāmasetuṃ vai saṃsmaranpuruṣo dvijāḥ || 33 || snāyācca yatra kutrāpi taṭākādau jalāśaye || na tasya duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidbhaviṣyati kadācana || 34 || setumadhyasthatīrtheṣu muṣṭimātrapradānataḥ || naśyaṃti sakalā rogā bhrūṇahatyādayastathā || 35 || rāmeṇa dhanuṣaḥ puṇyāṃ yo rekhāṃ paśyate kṛtām || na tasya punarāvṛttirvaikuṃṭhātsyātkadācana || 36 || dhanuṣkoṭiriti khyātā yā loke pāpanāśinī || vibhīṣaṇaprārthanayā kṛtā rāmeṇa dhīmatā || || 37 || dhanuṣkoṭirmahāpuṇyā tasyāṃ snātvā sabhaktikam || dadyāddānāni vittānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||38|| tilānāṃ taṃḍulānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ payasāṃ tathā || vastrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca māṣāṇāmodanasya ca||39|| dadhnāṃ ghṛtānāṃ vārīṇāṃ śākānāmapyudaśvitām || śuddhānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca sasyānāṃ madhunāṃ tathā || 3.1.52.40 || modakānāmapūpānāmanyeṣāṃ dānamevaca || rāmasetau dvijāḥ proktaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam || 41 || ato dadyādrāmasetau vittalobha vivarjitaḥ || dattaṃ hutaṃ ca taptaṃ ca japaśca niyamādikam || 42 || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭāvanaṃtaphaladaṃ bhavet || tena vedāśca tuṣyaṃti tuṣyaṃti pitarastathā || || 43 || tuṣyaṃti munayaḥ sarve brahmāviṣṇuḥ śivastathā || nāgāḥ kiṃpuruṣā yakṣāḥ sarve tuṣyaṃti niścitam ||44|| svayaṃ ca pūto bhavati dhanuṣkoṭyavalo kanāt|| svavaṃśajānnarānsarvānpāvayecca pitāmahān || 45 || tārayecca kulaṃ sarvaṃ dhanuṣkoṭyavalokanāt || rāmasya dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā kṛtarevāvagāhanāt || 46 || paṃcapātakakoṭīnāṃ nāśaḥ syāttatkṣaṇe dhruvam || śrīrāmadhanuṣaḥ koṭyā rekhāṃ yaḥ paśyate kṛtām || 47 || anekakleśasaṃpūrṇaṃ garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati || yatra sītā'nalaṃ prāptā tasminkuṃḍe nimajjanāt || 48 || bhrūṇahatyāśataṃ viprā naśyati kṣaṇamātrataḥ || yathā rāmastathā seturyathā gaṃgā tathā hariḥ || 49 || gaṃge hare rāmaseto tviti saṃkīrtayannaraḥ || yatra kvāpi bahiḥ snāyāttena yāti parāṃ gatim || 3.1.52.50 || setāvardhodaye snātvā gandhamādanaparvate || pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ piṃḍāndadyātsarṣapamātrakān || 51 || pitarastṛptimāyāṃti yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || śamīpatrapramāṇaṃ tu pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || 52 || dvijena piṇḍaṃ dattaṃ cetsarvapāpavimocitaḥ || svargastho muktimāyāti narakastho divaṃ vrajet || 53 || setau ca padmanābhe ca gokarṇe puruṣottame || udanvadaṃbhasi snānaṃ sārvakālikamīpsitam || 54 || śukrāṃgārakasaurīṇāṃ vāreṣu lavaṇāṃbhasi || saṃtānakāmī na snāyā tsetoranyatra karhicit || 55 || akṛtapretakāryo vā garbhiṇīpatireva vā || na snāyādudadhau vidvānsetoranyatra karhicit || 56 || na kālāpekṣaṇaṃ setornityasnānaṃ praśasyate || vāratithyṛkṣaniyamāḥ setoranyatra hi dvijāḥ || 57 || uddiśya jīvataḥ snāyānna tu snāyānmṛtānprati || kuśaiḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā snāpayettīrthavāribhiḥ || 58 || imaṃ maṃtraṃ samuccārya prasanneṃdriyamānasaḥ || kuśo'si tvaṃ pavitro'si viṣṇunā vidhṛtaḥ purā || 59 || tvayi snāte sa ca snāto yasyaitadgraṃdhivandhanam || sarvatra sāgaraḥ puṇyaḥ sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi || 3.1.52.60 || setau sindhvabdhisaṃyoge gaṃgāsāgara saṃgame || nityasnānaṃ hi nirdiṣṭaṃ gokarṇe puruṣottame || 61 || nāparvaṇi sarinnāthaṃ spṛśedanyatra karhicit || pitṝṇāṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnāmapi śṛṇvatām || 62 || pratijñāmakarodrāmaḥ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ || mayā hyatra kṛte setau snānaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || 63 || matprasādena te sarve yāsyaṃti punarbhavam || naśyaṃti sarvapāpāni matsetoravalokanāt || 64 || rāmanāthasya māhātmyaṃ matsetorapi vaibhavam || nāhaṃ varṇayituṃ śakto varṣakoṭiśatairapi || 65 || iti rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devamaharṣayaḥ || sādhusādhviti saṃtuṣṭāḥ praśaśaṃsuśca tadvacaḥ || 66 || setumadhye caturvaktraḥ sarvadevasamanvitaḥ || adhyāste tasya rakṣārthamīśvarasyājñayā sadā || 67 || rakṣārthaṃ rāmasetau hi setumādhavasaṃjñayā || mahāviṣṇuḥ samadhyāste nibaddho nigaḍena vai || 68 || maharṣayaśca pitaro dharmaśāstrapravartakāḥ || devāśca sahagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ || 69 || vidyādharāścāraṇāśca yakṣāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā || anyāni sarvabhūtāti vasaṃtyasminnaharniśam || 3.1.52.70 || so'haṃ dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vāpi smṛtaḥ spṛṣṭo'vagāhitaḥ || sarvasmādduritā tpāti rāmaseturdvijottamāḥ || 71 || setāvardhodaye snānamānaṃdaprāptikāraṇam || muktipradaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahānarakanāśanam || 72 || pauṣe māse viṣṇubhasthe dineśe bhānorvāre kiṃcidudyaddineśe || yuktā'mā cennāgahīnā tu pāte viṣṇorṛkṣe puṇyamardhodayaṃ syāt || 73 || tasminnardhodaye setau snānaṃ sāyujyakāraṇam|| vyatīpātasahasreṇa darśamekaṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 74 || darśāyutasamaṃ puṇyaṃ bhānuvāro bhavedyadi || śravaṇarkṣa yadi bhave dbhānuvāreṇa saṃyutam || 75 || puṇyameva tu vijñeyamanyonyasyaiva yogataḥ || ekaikamapyamṛtadaṃ snānadānajapārcanāt || 76 || paṃcasvapi ca yukteṣu kimu vaktavyamatra hi || śravaṇaṃ jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhamamā śreṣṭhā tithiṣvapi || 77 || vyatīpāta tu yogānāṃ vāraṃ vāreṣu vai raveḥ || caturṇāmapi yo yogo makarasthe ravau bhavet|| 78 || tasminkāle rāmasetau yadi snāyāttu mānavaḥ || garbhaṃ na māturāpnoti kintu sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 79 || ardhodayasamaḥ kālo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || evaṃ mahodayaḥ kālo dharmakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.1.52.80 || eteṣu puṇyakāleṣu setau dānaṃ prakīrtitam || ācāraśca tapo vedo vedāṃtaśravaṇaṃ tathā || 81 || śivaviṣṇvādipūjāpi purāṇārthapravaktṛtā || yasminvipre tu vidyaṃte dānapātraṃ taducyate || 82 || pātrāya tasmai dānāni setau dadyāddvijātaye || yadi pātraṃ na labhyeta setāvācārasaṃyutam || 83 || saṃkalpyoddiśya satpātraṃ pradadyādgrāmamāgataḥ || ato nādhamapātrāya dātavyaṃ phalakāṃkṣibhiḥ || uttamaṃ setumāhātmyaṃ vakturdeyaṃ na cānyataḥ || 84 || atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi vasiṣṭhoktamanuttamam || dilīpāya mahārājñe dānapātravi vitsave || 85 || || dilīpa uvāca || || dānāni kasmai deyāni brahmaputra purohita || etanme tattvato brūhi tvacchiṣyasya mahāmune || 86 || || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || pātrāṇāmuttamaṃ pātraṃ vedācāraparāyaṇam || tasmādapyadhikaṃ pātraṃ śūdrānnaṃ yasya nodare || 87 || vedāḥ purāṇamaṃtrāśca śivaviṣṇvādipūjanam || varṇāśramādyanuṣṭhānaṃ vartate yasya saṃtatam || 88 || daridraśca kuṭuṃbī ca tatpātraṃ śreṣṭhamucyate || tasminpātre pradattaṃ vai dharma kāmārthamokṣadam || 89 || puṇyasthale viśeṣeṇa dānaṃ satpātragarhitam || anyathā daśajanmāni kṛkalāso bhaviṣyati || 3.1.52.90 || janmatrayaṃ rāsabhaḥ syānmaṃḍūkaśca dvijanmani || ekajanmani cāṇḍālastataḥ śūdro bhaviṣyati || 91 || tataśca kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ kramādvipraśca jāyate || daridraśca bhavettatra bahurogasamanvitaḥ || 92 || evaṃ bahuvidhā doṣā duṣṭapātrapradānataḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena satpātreṣu pradāpayet || 93 || na labhyate cettatpātraṃ tadā saṃkalpapūrvakam || ekaṃ satpātramuddiśya prakṣipedudakaṃ bhuvi || 94 || uddiṣṭapātrasya mṛtau tatputrāya samarpayet || tasyāpi maraṇe prāpte mahādeve samarpa yet|| atonādhamapātrāya dadyāttīrthe viśeṣataḥ || 95 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evamukto vasiṣṭhena dilīpaḥ sa dvijottamāḥ || 96 || tadā prabhṛti satpātre prāyacchaddānamuttamam || ataḥ puṇyasthale setāvatrāpi munipuṃgavāḥ || 97 || yadi labhyeta satpātraṃ tadā dadyāddhanādikam || no cetsaṃkalpapūrvaṃ tu viśiṣṭaṃ pātramuttamam|| 98 || samuddiśya jalaṃ bhūmau prakṣipedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || svagrāmamāgataḥ paścāttasminpātre samarpayet || 99 || pūrvaṃsaṃkalpitaṃ vittaṃ dharmalopo'nyathā bhavet || na duḥkhaṃ punarāpnoti kiṃ tu sāyujyamāpnuyāt || 3.1.52.100 || ardhodayasamaḥ kālo na bhūto na bhavi ṣyati || kumbhakoṇaṃ setumūlaṃ gokarṇaṃ naimiṣe tathā || 101 || ayodhyā daṃḍakāraṇyaṃ virūpākṣaṃ ca veṃkaṭam || śāligrāmaṃ prayāgaṃ ca kāṃcī dvārāvatī tathā || 102 || madhurā padmanābhaṃ ca kāśī viśveśvarālayā || nadyaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca parvataṃ bhāskaraṃ smṛtam || 103 || muṃḍanaṃ copavāsaśca kṣetreṣveṣu prakīrtitam || lobhānmohādakṛtvā yaḥ svagṛhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 104 || sahaiva yāṃti tadgehe pātakāni ca tena vai || caturviṃśatitīrthāni parvate gandha mādane || 105 || tatra lakṣmaṇatīrthe tu vapanaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam || tīre lakṣmaṇatīrthasya lomavarjyaṃ śivājñayā || 106 || śiromātrasya vapanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām || snātvā lakṣmaṇatīrthe ca dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaśaṃkaram || 107 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śaṃkaraṃ yāti mānavaḥ || ardhodaye sadā snānaṃ setāvevaṃ samācaret || 108 || nāsti setusamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti setusamaṃ tapaḥ || nāsti setusamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti setusamā gatiḥ || 109 || uparāgasahasreṇa samamardhodadayaṃ smṛtam || ardhodayasamaḥ kālo nāsti saṃsāramocakaḥ || 3.1.52.110 || tasminnardhodaye rāmasetau snānaṃ tu yadbhavet || na tattulyaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu sarvadā || 111 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi bhāgīrathyavagāhanāt || yatpuṇyamṛṣinirdiṣṭaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 112 || ekavāraṃ rāmasetau snānātsidhyati niścitam || arddhodaye viśeṣeṇa tathaiva ca mahodaye || 113 || makarasthe ravau māghe prayāge pāpamocane || māghasnānasahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ || 114 || tasminnardhodaye viprā rāmasetau nimajjanāt || ekavāreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 115 || trailokyastheṣu tīrtheṣu snātānāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet || sakṛdarddhodaye setau snātvā tatpuṇyabhāgbhavet || 116 || brahmajñānavihīnānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ durā tmanām || pāpināmitareṣāṃ ca mahāpātakināṃ tathā || 117 || setāvarddhodaye snānādviśuddhiriti niścitā || sthalāṃtare kṛtaghnānāṃ niṣkṛtirnāsti karhicit || 118 || setāvardhodaye snānātteṣāmapi hi niṣkṛtiḥ || setāvarddhodaye snānaṃ ye na kurvaṃti mohataḥ || 119 || saṃsāreṣu nimajjaṃti te yathāṃdhāḥ pataṃtyadhaḥ || setāvardhodaye snātvā bhittvā bhāskaramaṇḍalam || 3.1.52.120 || brahmalokaṃ prayāsyaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || arddhodaye tu saṃprāpte snātvā setau vimuktide || 121 || snātvā samyagjagannāthaṃ rāghavaṃ sītayā saha || rāmeśvaraṃ mahādevaṃ sugrīvādimukhānkapīn || 122 || dhyātvā devānṛṣīṃścāpi tathā pitṛgaṇānapi || tarpayedapi tānsarvānsvadāridryavimuktaye || 123 || arddhodayākhyamamalaṃ jagannāthaṃ samarcayet || setāvarddhodaye kāle tena prīṇāti keśavaḥ || 124 || divākara namaste'stu tejorāśe jagatpate || atrigotrasamutpanna lakṣmī devyāḥ sahodara || 125 || arghaṃ gṛhāṇa bhagavansudhākumbha namostu te || vyatīpātamahāyoginmahāpātakanāśana || 126 || sahasrabāho sarvātma ngṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || tithinakṣatravārāṇāmadhīśa parameśvara || 127|| māsarūpa gṛhaṇārghyaṃ kālarūpa namo'stu te || iti dattvā pṛthaṅmaṃtrairarghyamarddhodaye naraḥ || 128 || upāyanāni viprebhyo dadyādvittānusārataḥ || caturdaśa dvādaśāṣṭau sapta ṣaṭ paṃca vā dvijān || 129 || yathāśaktyannapānādyaiḥ pṛthaṅmaṃtraiḥ samarcayet || kāṃsyapātraṃ samādāya nūtanaṃ dāravaṃ tu vā || 3.1.52.130 || viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sthāpya payasā paripūritam || saphalaṃ saguḍaṃ sājyaṃ satāṃbūlaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 131 || dadyādyajñopavītaṃ ca gāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīm || alaṃkṛtebhyo viprebhyo yathāśakti vadedidam || 132 || śravaṇarkṣe jaga nnātha janmarkṣe tava keśava || yanmayā dattamarthibhyastadakṣayamihāstu me || 133 || nakṣatrāṇāmadhipate devānāmamṛtaprada || trāhi māṃ rauhiṇīkāṃta kalā śeṣanamo'stu te || 134 || dīnanātha jagannātha kalānātha kṛpākara || tvatpādapadmayugalabhaktirastvacalā mama || 135 || vyatīpāta namaste'stu soma sūryognisaṃnibha || yaddānādikṛtaṃ kicittadakṣayamihāstu te || 136 || arthināṃ kalpavṛkṣo'si vāsudeva janārdana || māsartvayanakāleśa pāpaṃ śamaya me hare || 137 || ityarcayitvā vipreṃdrāstataḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaret || hiraṇyaśrāddhamāmaṃ vā pākaśrāddhamathāpi vā || 138 || pārvaṇaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādvitta śāṭhayaṃ na kārayet || ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścādvastrabhūṣaṇakuṇḍalaiḥ || 139 || pratimāmarpayettasmai gāṃ ca chatramupānaham || evamarddhodaye setau vrataṃ kuryāddvi jottamāḥ || 3.1.52.140 || tenaiva kṛtakṛtyaḥ syātkartavyaṃ nāsti kiṃcana || sthalāṃtare'pyevametadvratamardhodaye caret || 141 || setuḥ samudre rāmeṇa nirmito gandhamādane || setuḥ seturiti prājñāstasya nātra prakīrtanāt || 142 || snānakāle manuṣyāṇāṃ pātakānāṃ tu koṭayaḥ || tatkṣaṇādeva naśyaṃti yāsyaṃtyapyatyutaṃ padam || 143 || nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārddhaṃ vā setau tiṣṭhati yo naraḥ || taddṛṣṭigocaraṃ gaṃtuṃ na śaktā yamakiṃkarāḥ || 144 || rāmasetuṃ dhanu ṣkoṭiṃ rāmaṃ sītāṃ ca lakṣmaṇam || rāmanāthaṃ hanūmaṃtaṃ sugrīvādimukhānkapīn || 145 || vibhīṣaṇaṃ nāradaṃ ca viśvāmitraṃ ghaṭodbhavam || vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kāśyapam|| 146|| rāmabhaktāstathā cānyāṃściṃtayanmanasā tadā || sarvaduḥkhādvimucyeta prayāti paramaṃ padam || 147 || satya kṣetre harikṣetre kṛṣṇakṣetre ca naimiṣe || śālagrāme badaryyāṃ ca hastiśaile vṛṣācale || 148 || śeṣādrau citrakūṭe ca lakṣmīkṣetre kuraṃgake || kāṃcike kumbhakoṇe ca mohinīpura eva ca || 149 || aindre śvetācale puṇye padmanābhe mahāsthale || phullākhye ghaṭikādrau ca sārakṣetre hari sthale ||| 3.1.52.150 || śrīnivāse mahākṣetre bhaktanāthamahāsthale || aliṃdākhye mahākṣetre śukakṣetre ca vāruṇe || 151 || madhurāyāṃ harikṣetre śrīgoṣṭhyāṃ puruṣottame || śrīraṃge puṇḍarīkākṣe tathānyatra haristhale || 152 || snānena yāni pāpāni vinaśyanti dvijottamāḥ || tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti setusnānena niścitam || 153 || raghunāthakṛte setau mahāmuniniṣevite || na snāṃti ye narāsteṣāṃ na saṃsāranivartanam ||| || 154 || ye vā namaḥ śivāyeti mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ śubham || na vadanti na śṛṇvanti na smaranti munīśvarāḥ || 155 || namo nārāya ṇāyeti praṇavena samanvitam || maṃtramaṣṭākṣaraṃ vāpi na japaṃti smaraṃti vā || 156 || evaṃ śrīrāmacaṃdrasya ṣaḍakṣaramanu tathā || na japaṃti na śṛṇvaṃti na smaraṃti ca sattamāḥ || 157 || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti rāmasetau nimajjanāt || upoṣaṇaṃ na kurvaṃti ye vā haridine śubhe || 158 || na dhārayaṃti ye bhasma tripuṃḍroddhūlanādinā || jābālopaniṣanmaṃtraissaptabhirmastakādike || 159 || śivaṃ vā keśavaṃ vāpi tathānyānapi vai surān |1 na pūjayaṃti vedokta mārgeṇa dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 3.1.52.160 || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti rāmasetau nimjanāt || śivaviṣṇvādidevebhyo dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca caṃdanam || 161 || puṣpāṇi na pra yacchaṃti bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ śrīrudraiścamakaistathā || 162 || śrīmatpuruṣasūktena pāvamāyādi sūktakaiḥ || trimadhu trisuparṇaiśca paṃca śāṃtyādinā tathā || 163 || nābhiṣekaṃ prakurvaṃti ye narāḥ pāpacetasaḥ || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || 164 || śivaviṣṇvādi devānāṃ namaskārapradakṣiṇe || na prakurvaṃti bhaktyā ye pāpopahatabuddhayaḥ || 165 || dhanurmāse'pyuṣaḥkāle na pūjāṃ ca prakurvate || śivaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ mahānaivedyapūrvakam || 166 || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti rāmasetau nimajjanāt || kīrtayaṃti na ye viṣṇornāmāni tu harasya vā || 167 || śāligrāmaśilā cakraṃ śivanābhaṃ ca ye narāḥ || na pūjayaṃti mohena dvārakācakrameva vā || 168 || gaṃgāmṛdaṃ ca tulasīmṛttikāṃ gopicaṃdanam || na dhārayaṃti ye mūḍhā lalāṭe corasi dvijāḥ || 169 || dordvaṃdve ca gale samyaksarvapāpaughaśāṃtaye || rudrākṣaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ yo na dhārayate naraḥ ||3.1.52.170||| tasya pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || brāhme muhūrte saṃprāpte nidrāṃ tyaktvā prasannadhīḥ || 171 || hariśaṃkaranāmāni tatstotrāṇyatha vā dvijāḥ || yo hi ciṃtayate nityaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ maṃtrameva vā || 172 || tasya pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt|| prātarjalāśaye gatvā snātvā''camya viśuddhadhīḥ || 173 || prasannātmā muniśreṣṭhāḥ saṃdhyopāsanapūrvakam || nopāste ca naro yastu gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram || 174 || naupāsanaṃ vā kurvaṃti sāyaṃprātarataṃdritāḥ || mādhyāhnikaṃ na kurvaṃti ye vā pāpahatāśayāḥ || 175 || brahmayajñaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ madhyāhne'tithipūjanam || nācaraṃti ca sāyaṃ ye pūjāmatithisaṃmatām || 176 || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || bhikṣāṃ yatīnāṃ madhyāhne na prayacchaṃti ye narāḥ || 177 || ye'pyadhītāṃ trayīṃ viprā vismaraṃti kubuddhayaḥ || nādhīyate trayīṃ vāpi vedāṃgāni tathā punaḥ || 178 || pratyābdikaṃ mātṛpitroḥ śrāddhaṃ ye nācaraṃti vai || śrāddhaṃ mahālayaṃ nityamaṣṭakāśrāddha meva vā || 179 || anyannaimittikaṃ śrāddhaṃ ye na kurvaṃti lobhataḥ || ye caitre tu paurṇamāsyāṃ citraguptasya tuṣṭaye || 3.1.52.180 || pānakaṃ kadalīpakvaṃ pāyasānnaṃ saśarkaram || saguḍaṃ sāmraphalakaṃ panasādiphalairyutam || 181 || tāṃbūlaṃ pāduke chatraṃ vastrapuṣpāṇi caṃdanam || viprebhyo na prayacchaṃti lobhopahatabuddhayaḥ|| || 182 || teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti dhanuṣkoṭau nimajjanāt || durvṛtto vā suvṛtto vā yo dhanuṣkoṭisevakaḥ ||183 || tasya saṃsāravicchittiḥ puna rjanma vinā bhavet || saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ ya icchenmunipuṃgavāḥ || 184 || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭiṃ sa gacchedavilaṃbitam || satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi sāraṃ vacmi hitaṃ punaḥ || 185 || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭiṃ gacchadhvaṃ muktisiddhaye || rāmacandradhanuṣkoṭau kuryātsnānaṃ vimuktaye || 186 || nāstyupāyāṃtaraṃ viprā bhūyobhūyo vadāmyaham || rāmacaṃdradhanuṣkoṭau snānaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || 187 || teṣāmayatnataḥ sidhyetsaṃsārabhaya nāśanam || satyaṃ jñānamanaṃtaṃ yatpūrṇaṃ brahma sanātanam || 188 || tatprāptiḥ syāddhanuṣkoṭau majjanānnātra saṃśayaḥ || || śrīsūta uvāca || || evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ setumāhātmyamuttamam || 189 || mahāduḥkhapraśamanaṃ mahāroganibarhaṇam || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyamapamṛ tyunivāraṇam ]| 3.1.52.190 || mahāśāṃtikaraṃ puṃsāṃ paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāmapi || svargāpavargadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || 191 || kīrtayedya idaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu yādvā samāhitaḥ || so'gniṣṭomādiyajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti puṣkalam || 192 || caturṇāṃ sāṃgavedānāṃ śatāvṛtyā tu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti hyetanmāhātmyakīrtanāt || 193 || atraikādhyāyapaṭhanācchravaṇādvā munīśvarāḥ || aśvamedhasya yajñasya prāpnotyavikalaṃ phalam || 194 || adhyāyadvayapāṭhena śravaṇena tathaiva ca || gomedhākhyasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyanuttamam || 195 || daśādhyāyānpaṭhedyastu śṛṇuyādvā sabhaktikam || svargalokamavāpnoti śakreṇa saha modate || 196 || viṃśatyadhyāyapaṭhanācchravaṇācca munīśvarāḥ || brahmalokamavāpnoti brahmaṇā saha modate || 197 || triṃśadadhyāyapaṭhanācchravaṇācca munīśvarāḥ || viṣṇulokamavāpnoti viṣṇunā saha modate || 198 || catvāriṃśattamādhyāyānpaṭhedvā śṛṣuyādapi || rudralokamavāpnoti rudreṇa saha modate || 199 || yaḥ paṃcāśattamādhyāyānpaṭhate śṛṇute'pi vā || sa sāṃbaṃ haramāpnoti śivaṃ candrārdhaśekharam || 3.1.52.200 || yaḥ paṭhecchraṇuyāccedaṃ kṛtsnaṃ māhātmyamuttamam || sa sāṃbaśivasālokyamāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 201 || yaḥ paṭhecchraṇuyāccedaṃ dvivāraṃ munisatamāḥ || sa yāti śivasāmīpyaṃ vimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ || 202 || yastrivāraṃ paṭhedetacchṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ || śivasārūpyamāpnoti śivasya prītimāvahan ||203|| caturvāraṃ paṭhedyastu śṛṇuyādvedamuttamam || sa sāyujyamavāpnoti śivasya girijāpateḥ || 204 || dinedine paṭhenmartyaḥ ślokaṃ ślokārdhameva vā || pādaṃ vā pādamātraṃ vā akṣaraṃ varṇameva vā || 205 || tattaddinakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || kṛtsne'sminsetumāhātmye paṭhite'pi śrute'pi vā || || 206 || ślokeṣvatraiva vartaṃte varṇā yāvaṃta eva hi || tāvatyo brahmahatyāśca tāvanmadyaniṣevaṇam || 207 || tāvatsuvarṇasteyaṃ ca tāvāngurvaṃganāgamaḥ || tāvatsaṃsargadoṣāśca naśyaṃtyevaṃ hi tatkṣaṇāt || 208 || yāvato'sminmahāpuṇye vartaṃte varṇarāśayaḥ || tāvatkṛtvaścaturviṃśattīrtheṣu snānajaṃ phalam || 209 || tathānyeṣvapi tīrtheṣu setumadhyagateṣu vai || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pāṭhena śravaṇena vā || 3.1.52.210 || yenedaṃ likhitaṃ bhaktyā setumāhātmyamuttamam || vinaṣṭājñānasaṃtānaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 211 || yasyedaṃ vartate gehe māhātmyaṃ likhitaṃ śubham || bhūtavetālakādibhyo bhītistatra na vidyate || 212 || vyādhipīḍā na tatrāsti nāsti corabhayaṃtathā || śanyaṃgārakamukhyānāṃ grahāṇāṃ nāsti pīḍanam || 213 || yadgṛhe vartate puṇyamidaṃ māhā tmyamuttamam || rāmasetuṃ vijānīta tadgṛhaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 214 || caturviṃśati tīrthāni tatraiva nivasaṃti hi || tatraiva vartate puṇyo gandhamādanaparvataḥ || || 215 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca vartaṃte tatra sādaram || likhitvā setumāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtā tena dattā vasuṃdharā || 216 || || || setumāhātmyadānamantraḥ || || setumāhātmyadānasya kalā nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || dānānyanyāni sarvāṇi hyataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me || kiṃ punarbahu noktena vasatyatra jagattrayam || 217 || śrāvayecchrāddhakāle yo hyekamadhyāyamatra vai || naśyecchrāddhasya vaikalyaṃ pitaro'pyatiharṣitāḥ || 218 || yaḥ parvakāle saṃprāpte brāhmaṇāñchrāvayedidam || adhyāyamekaṃ ślokaṃ vā gāvosya nirupadravāḥ || bahukṣīrā savatsāśca mahiṣyo'sya bhavaṃti hi || 219 || paṭhanīyamidaṃ puṇyaṃ maṭhe devālaye'pi vā || nadītaṭākatīreṣu puṇye vāraṇyabhūtale || śrotriyāṇāṃ gṛhe vāpi naivānyatra tu karhicit || 3.1.52.220 || viṣuvāyana kāleṣu puṇye ca harivāsare || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paṭhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 221 || idaṃ hi pāṭhyaṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ māsi bhādrapade tathā || dhanurmāse ca pāṭhyaṃ syātpāṭhyaṃ caivottarāyaṇe || 222 || niyamenaiva māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyamidaṃ dvijāḥ || śrotāro niyamairyuktāḥ śṛṇuyuścedamuttamam || 223 || kīrtyaṃte puṇyatīrthāni māhātmye'sminbahūni vai || kīrtyaṃte puṇyaśīlāśca tathā rājarṣisattamāḥ || 224 || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāḥ kīrtyaṃte'sminnanuttame || dharmādharmau ca kīrtyete puṇyesmindvijapuṃgavāḥ || 225 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca kīrtyaṃte'tra trimūrtayaḥ || idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ śrutyarthairupabṛṃhi tam || 226 || saṃmataṃ smṛtikartṝṇāṃ dvaipāyanamunipriyam || śrotavyaṃ paṭhitavyaṃ ca ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā || 227 || śrāvakāya ca dātavyaṃ yatkiṃcitkāṃcanādikam || svasvaśaktyanurodhena vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || 228 || vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ dhānyaṃ vā bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca yathābalam || dattvā saṃbhāvanīyo'yaṃ śrāvakaḥ śrotṛbhirjanaiḥ || 229 || pūjite śrāvake tasminpūjitāḥ syustrimūrtayaḥ || jagattrayaṃ pūjitaṃ syātpūjitāsu trimūrtiṣu || 3.1.52.230 || avatīrṇo mahīṃ sākṣādrāmo dāśarathirhariḥ || sasītālakṣmaṇo nityaṃ śrotṛbhyaḥ śrāvakāya ca || 231 || dattveha loke bhogāṃśca muktiṃ cāṃte prayacchati || dvaipāyanamukhāṃbhojānniḥsṛtaṃ śubhadaṃ param || 232 || idaṃ vai setumāhātmyaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || bhīmasenādibhiḥ sarvairanujairapi saṃvṛtaḥ || 233 || niyamācārasaṃyuktaḥ sasainyaśca dinedine || śṛṇoti paṭhato dhaumyamaharṣeḥ svapurodhasaḥ || 234 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || bhobho stapodhanāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || matsakāśādidaṃ guhyaṃ māhātmyaṃ śrutisaṃmitam || 235 || śrutaṃ bhavadbhirniyatairnityaṃ paṭhata sādaram || pāṭhayadhvaṃ svaśiṣyebhyo niyatebhyo nirantaram || 236 || ityuktvā tānmunīnsūto romāṃcitakalevaraḥ || guruṃ hṛdā smaranvyāsaṃ nanartāśrūṇi vartayan || 237 || atrāṃtare mahāvidvānpārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ || āśu prādurabhūttatra śiṣyānugrahakāṃkṣayā || 238 || tamāgataṃ vilokyātha muniṃ satyavatīsutam || sūtaḥ sarvaiśca sahito naimiṣāraṇyavāsibhiḥ || 239 || vyāsasya caraṇāṃbhoje daṃḍavatpraṇipatya tu || jalamānaṃdajaṃ tatra netrābhyāṃparyavartayat || 3.1.52.240 || praṇataṃ priyaśiṣyaṃ taṃ dorbhyāmutthāpya vai muniḥ || āśīrbhirabhinaṃdyainamāliṃgya ca muhurmuhuḥ || 241 || naimiṣāraṇyamunibhirānīte paramāsane || dvaipāyano mahātejā niṣasāda tapodhanaḥ || 242 || muniṣvapyupaviṣṭeṣu sūte'pi ca nijājñayā || śaunakādīnmunīnsarvāñchakteḥ pautro'bhyabhāṣata || 243 || mayā jñātamidaṃ sarvaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || mama śiṣyeṇa sūtena setumāhātmyamuttamam || kathitaṃ bhavatāmadya mahāpātakanāśanam || 244 || śrutīnāṃ ca smṛtīnāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || śāstrāṇāṃ cetihāsānāmanyeṣāmapi kṛtsnaśaḥ || 245 || eṣa paryavasanno'rtho māhātmyaṃ yattvidaṃ mahat || sarveṣvapi purāṇeṣu idaṃ bahumataṃ mama || 246 || śṛṇoti dharmajo dhaumyādidaṃ nityaṃ mamājñayā || ato bhavaṃto'pi sadā setumāhātmyamuttamam || 247 || paṭhaṃtu śṛṇvaṃtu tathā śiṣyāṇāṃ pāṭhayaṃtu ca || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya te prāhurbāḍhamityapi || 248 || tato vyāso'pi sūtena śiṣyeṇa ca samanvitaḥ || anujñāpya munīntsarvānkailāsaṃ parvataṃ yayau || 249 || ṛṣayo naimiṣāraṇyanilayāstuṣṭimāgatāḥ || pratyahaṃ setumāhātmyaṃ śṛṇvaṃti ca paṭhaṃti ca || || 3.1.52.250 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe setumāhātmye dvipaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 || ||cha|| idaṃ skāṃdamahāpurāṇāntargatabrahmakhaṇḍāntargatasetumāhātmyaṃ samāptam ||
<3.2.1>
|| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ||||| tartuṃ saṃhṛtivāridhiṃ trijagatāṃ naurnāma yasya prabhoryenedaṃ sakalaṃ vibhāti satataṃ jātaṃ sthitaṃ saṃsṛtam|| yaścaitanyaghanapramāṇa vidhuro vedāṃtavedyo vibhustaṃ vande sahajaprakāśamamalaṃ śrīrāmacandraṃ param ( ||1|| ) dārāḥ putrā dhanaṃ vā parijanasahito baṃdhuvargaḥ priyo vā mātā bhrātā pitā vā śvaśurakulajanā bhṛtyaaiśvaryyavitte|| vidyā rūpaṃ vimalabhavanaṃ yauvanaṃ yauvataṃ vā sarve vyarthaṃ maraṇasamaye dharma ekaḥ sahāyaḥ (||2||) naimiṣe nimiṣakṣetre ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ|| satraṃ svargāya lokāya sahasrasamamāsata || 1 || ekadā sūtamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ śaunakādayaḥ || paraṃ harṣaṃ samāviṣṭāḥ papurnetraiḥ sucetasā|| citrāḥ śrotuṃ kathāstatra parivavrustapasvinaḥ || 2|| atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu tapasviṣu mahātmasu|| nirdiṣṭamāsanaṃ bheje vinayāllomaharṣaṇiḥ ||3|| sukhāsīnaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā vighnāṃtamupalakṣya ca || athāpṛcchaṃsta ṛṣayaḥ kāścitprāstāvikīḥ kathāḥ || 4 || purāṇamakhilaṃ tāta purā te'dhītavānpitā || kaccittvayāpi tatsarvamadhītaṃ lomaharṣaṇe|| 5|| kathayasva kathāṃ sūta puṇyāṃ pāpaniṣūdinīm|| śrutvā yāṃ yāti vilayaṃ pāpaṃ janmaśatodbhavam || 6 || || sūta uvāca || || śrībhāratyaṃghriyugalaṃ gaṇanāthapadadvayam || sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ namaskṛtya vadāmyaham || 7|| śaktīṃścaiva vasūṃścaiva grahānyajñādidevatāḥ || namaskṛtya śubhānviprānkavimukhyāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ||8|| abhīṣṭadevatāścaiva praṇamya gurusattamam || namaskṛtya śubhāndevānrāmādīṃśca viśeṣataḥ ||9||| yānsmṛtvā vividhaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || teṣāṃ prasādādvakṣye'haṃ tīrthānāṃ phalamuttamam || sarveṣāṃ ca niyaṃtāraṃ dharmātmānaṃ praṇamya ca || 3.2.1.10 || dharmmāraṇyapatistriviṣṭapapatirnityaṃ bhavānīpatiḥ pāpādvaḥ sthirabhogayogasulabho devaḥ sa dharmeśvaraḥ || sarveṣāṃ hṛdayāni jīvakalayā vyāpya sthitaḥ sarvadā dhyātvā yaṃ na punarviśaṃti manujāḥ saṃsārakārāgṛham|| 11 || || sūta uvāca || || ekadā tu sa dharmmo vai jagāma brahmasaṃsadi || tāṃ sabhāṃ sa samālokya jñānaniṣṭho'bhavattadā|| 12 || devairmunivaraiḥ krāṃtāṃ sabhāmālokya vismitaḥ || devairyakṣaistathā nāgaiḥ pannagaiśca tathā'suraiḥ| || 13|| ṛṣibhiḥ siddhagaṃdharvaiḥ samākrāṃtocitāsanā || sasukhā sā sabhā brahmanna śītā na ca gharmmadā || 14|| na kṣudhaṃ na pipāsāṃ ca na glāniṃ prāpnuvantyuta|| nānārūpairiva kṛtā maṇibhiḥ sā sabhā varaiḥ || 19 || staṃbhaiśca vidhṛtā sā tu śāśvatī na ca sakṣayā || divyairnānāvidhairbhāvairbhāsadbhiramitaprabhā || 16 || ati candraṃ ca sūryyaṃ ca śikhinaṃ ca svayaṃprabhā || dīpyate nākapṛṣṭhasthā bhartsayaṃtīva bhāskaram || 17 || tasyām̐ sa bhagavāñchāsti vividhāndevamānuṣān || svayameko'niśaṃ brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || 18 || upatiṣṭhaṃti cāpyenaṃ prajānāṃ patayaḥ prabhum|| dakṣaḥ pracetāḥ pulaho marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ || 19 || bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca gautamo'tha tathāṃgirāḥ || pulastyaśca kratuścaiva prahlādaḥ karddamastathā || 3.2.1.20 || atharvāṃgirasaścaiva vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ || manoṃ'tarikṣaṃ vidyāśva vāyustejo jalaṃ mahī || 21 || śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ raso gaṃdhastathaiva ca || prakṛtiśca vikāraśca sadasatkāraṇaṃ tathā || 22 || agastyaśca mahātejā mārkaṃḍeyaśca vīryavān || jamadagnirbharadvājaḥ saṃvartaścyavanastathā || 23 || durvāsāśca mahābhāga ṛṣyaśrṛṃgaśca dhārmikaḥ| sanatkumāro bhagavānyogācāryyo mahātapāḥ || 24|| asito devalaścaiva jaigīṣavyaśca tattvavit|| āyurvedastathāṣṭāṃgo gāndharvaścaiva tatra hi || 29 || caṃdramāḥ sah nakṣatrairādityaśca gabhastimān || vāyavastaṃtavaścaiva saṃkalpaḥ prāṇa eva ca || 26 || mūrtimaṃto mahātmāno mahāvrataparāyaṇāḥ || ete cānye ca bahavo brahmāṇaṃ samupāsire ||27|| artho dharmaśca kāmaśca harṣo dveṣastamo damaḥ || āyāṃti tasyāṃ sahitā gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 28|| śukrādyāśva grahāścaiva ye cānye tatsamīpagāḥ || maṃtrā rathaṃtaraṃ caiva harimānvasumānapi ||29|| mahito viśvakarmā ca vasavaścaiva sarvaśaḥ || tathā pitṛgaṇāḥ sarve sarvāṇi ca havīṃṣyatha || 3.2.1.30 || ṛgvedaḥ sāmavedaśca yajurvedastathaiva ca || atharvavedaśca tathā sarvaśāstrāṇi caiva ha || 31 || itihāsopavedāśca vedāṃgāni ca sarvaśaḥ|| medhā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiścaiva prajñā buddhiryaśaḥ samāḥ|| 32 || kālacakraṃ ca taddivyaṃ nityamakṣayamavyayam || yāvantyo devapatnyaśca sarvā eva manojavāḥ ||33|| gārhapatyā nākacarāḥ pitaro lokaviśrutāḥ || somapā ekaśṛṃgāśca tathā sarve tapasvinaḥ|| 31 | nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ paśavaḥ pitāmahamupāsate | sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi mahābhūtāstathā pare || 39|| puraṃdaraśca deveṃdro varuṇo dhanadastathā|| mahādevaḥ sahomo'tra sadā gacchati sarvadaḥ || 36|| gacchaṃti sarvadā devā nārāyaṇastatharṣayaḥ|| ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca yonijāyonijāstathā||| 37|| yatkiṃcitriṣu lokeṣu dṛśyate sthāṇu jaṃgamam || tasyāṃ sahopaviṣṭāyāṃ tatra jñātvā sa dharmavit || 38 || devairmunivaraiḥ krāṃtāṃ samālokyātivismitaḥ|| harṣeṇa mahatā yukto romāṃcitatanūruhaḥ || 39 || tatra dharmo mahātejāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || vācyamānāṃ tu śuśrāva vyāsenāmitatejasā || 3.2.1.40 || dharmāraṇyakathāṃ divyāṃ tathaiva sumanoharām || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladātrīṃ tathaiva ca || 41 | putrapautraprapautrādi phaladātrīṃ tathaiva ca || dhāraṇācchravaṇāccāpi paṭhanāccāvalokanāt ||42|| tāṃ niśamya suvistīrṇāṃ kathāṃ brahmāṃḍasaṃbhavām || pra modotphullanayano brahmāṇamanumatya ca || 43 || kṛtakāryopi dharmātmā gaṃtukāmastadābhavat || namaskṛtya tadā dharmo brahmāṇaṃ sa pitāmaham || 44 || anujñātastadā tena gato'sau yamaśāsanam || pitāmahaprasādācca śrutvā puṇyapradāyinīm || 45 || dharmāraṇyakathāṃ divyāṃ pavitrāṃ pāpanāśinīm || sa gato'nucaraiḥ sārddhaṃ tataḥ saṃyaminīṃ prati || 46|| amātyānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ praviṣṭaḥ svapuraṃ yamaḥ || tatrāṃtare mahātejā nārado munipuṃgavaḥ|| 47|| durnirīkṣyaḥ kṛpāyuktaḥ samadarśī taponidhiḥ || tapasā dagdhadehopi viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ|| 48|| sarvagaḥ sarvaviccaiva nāradaḥ sarvadā śuciḥ || vedādhyayanaśīlaśca tvāgata statra saṃsadi ||49|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā dharmo bhāryayā sevakaiḥ saha || saṃmukho harṣasaṃyukto gacchanneva sa satvaraḥ||3.2.1.50|| adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ kulam|| adya me saphalo dharmastvayyāyāte tapodhane ||51|| arghyapādyādividhinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || daṃḍavattaṃ praṇamyātha vidhinā copaveśitaḥ ||52|| āsane sve mahādivye ratnakāṃcanabhūṣite || citrārpitā sabhā sarvā dīpā nirvātagā iva ||53|| vidhāya kuśalapraśnaṃ svāgatenābhinaṃdya tam || praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe dharmāraṇyakathāṃ smaran || 54 || nāradaṃ pūjayitvā tu prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || harṣitaṃ tu yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā nārado vismitānanaḥ || 55 || ciṃtayāmāsa manasā kimidaṃ harṣito hariḥ || atiharṣaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā yamarājasvarūpiṇam || āścaryamanasaṃ caiva nāradaḥ pṛṣṭavāṃstadā || 56 || || || nārada uvāca || || kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatāścaryyaṃ kiṃ vā labdhaṃ mahatpadam|| duṣṭastvaṃ duṣṭakarmā ca duṣṭātmā krodharūpadhṛk || 57|| pāpināṃ yamanaṃ caivametadrūpaṃ mahattaram|| saumyarūpaṃ kathaṃ jātametanme saṃśayaḥ prabho || 58|| adya tvaṃ harṣasaṃyukto dṛśyase kena hetunā || kathayasva mahākāya harṣasyaiva hi kāraṇam|| 59|| || dharmarāja uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ brahmaputraitatkathayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || purāhaṃ brahmasadanaṃ gatavānabhivaṃditum|| 3.2.1.60 || tatrāsīnaḥ sabhāmadhye sarvalokaikapūjite||| nānākathāḥ śrutāstatra dharmmavargasamanvitāḥ || 61|| kathāḥ puṇyā dharmayutā ramyā vyāsamukhācchrutāḥ || dharmakāmārthasaṃyuktāḥ sarvāghaughavināśinīḥ || 62 || yāḥ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte brahmahatyayā | tārayaṃti pitṛgaṇāñchatamekottaraṃ mune || 63 || || || nārada uvāca || || kīdṛśī tatkathā me tāṃ praśaṃsa bhavatā śrutām|| kathāṃ yama mahābāho śrotukāmosmyahaṃ ca tām || 64 || || || yama uvāca || || ekadā brahmaloke'haṃ namaskartuṃ pitāmaham || gatavānasmi taṃ deśaṃ kāryākāryavicāraṇe || 65|| mayā tatrādbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca munisattama || dharmmāraṇyakathāṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyaneritām|| 66|| śrutvā kathāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ brahmanbrahmāṃḍagāṃ śubhām || guṇapūrṇāṃ satyayuktāṃ tena harṣeṇa harṣitaḥ || 67|| anyaccaiva muniśreṣṭha tavāgamanakāraṇam|| śubhāya ca sukhāyaiva kṣemāya ca jayāya hi || 68|| ādyāsmi kṛtakṛtyo'hamadyāhaṃ sukṛtī mune| dharmonāmādya jāto'haṃ tava padyugmadarśanāt || 69 | pūjyo'haṃ ca kṛtārthohaṃ dhanyohaṃ cādya nārada|| yuṣmatpādaprasādācca pūjyo'haṃ bhuvanatraye || 3.2.1.70 || || sūta uvāca || || evaṃvidhairvacobhiśca toṣito munisattamaḥ| papraccha parayā bhaktyā dharmāraṇyakathāṃ śubhām || 71 || || || nārada uvāca || || śrutā vyāsamukhāddharmma dharmāraṇyakathā śubhā|| tatsarvaṃ hi kathaya me vistīrṇaṃ ca yathātatham || 72 || || yama uvāca||| || vyagro'haṃ satataṃ brahmanprāṇināṃ sukhaduḥkhinām || tattatkarmānusāreṇa gatiṃ dātuṃ sukhetarām || 73|| tathāpi sādhusaṃgo hi dharmāyaiva prajāyate || iha loke paratrāpi kṣemāya ca sukhāya ca || 74 || brahmaṇaḥ sannidhau yañca śrutaṃ vyāsamukheritam|| tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi mānuṣāṇāṃ hitāya vai|| 79|| || sūta uvāca || || yamena kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yacchrutaṃ brahmasaṃsadi || ādimadhyāvasānaṃ ca sarvaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 76 || kalidvāparayormadhye dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram || gato'sau nārado martye rājyaṃ dharmasutasya vai || 77|| āgataḥ śrīhareraṃśo nāradaḥ pratyadṛśyata || jvalitāgnipratīkāśo bālārkasadṛśekṣaṇaḥ || 78 || savyāpavṛttaṃ vipulaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍalamudvahan || caṃdrāṃśuśukle vasane vasāno rukmabhūṣaṇaḥ || 79 || vīṇāṃ gṛhītvā mahatīṃ kakṣāsaktāṃ sakhīmiva || kṛṣṇājinottarāsaṃgo hemayajñopavītavān|| 3.2.1.80|| daṇḍī kamaṃḍalukaraḥ sākṣādvahnirivāparaḥ || bhettā jagati guhyānāṃ vigrahāṇāṃ guhopamaḥ || 81 || maharṣigaṇasaṃsiddho vidvāngāṃdharvavedavit|| vairakelikalo vipro brāhmaḥ kalirivāparaḥ ||82|| devagaṃdharvalokānāmādivaktā sunigrahaḥ|| gātā caturṇāṃ vedānāmudgātā harisadguṇān || 83 || sa nārado'tha viprarṣirbrahmalokacaro'vyayaḥ|| āgato'tha purīṃ harṣāddharmarājena pālitām || 84 ||| atha tatropaviṣṭeṣu rājanyeṣu mahātmasu || mahatsu copaviṣṭeṣu gaṃdharveṣu ca tatra vai || 89|| lokānanucaransarvānāgataḥ sa maharṣirāṭ || nāradaḥ sumahātejā ṛṣibhiḥ sahitastadā ||86|| tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ sarvadharmavit || siṃhāsanātsamutthāya prayayau sanmukhastadā||87|| abhyavādayataṃ prītyā vinayāva natastadā || tadarhamāsanaṃ tasmai saṃpradāya yathāvidhi ||88|| gāṃ caivaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca saṃpradāyārdhameva ca || arcayāmāsa ratnaiśca sarvakāmaiśca dharmavit||89|| tutoṣa ca yathāvañca pūjāṃ prāpya ca dharmavit || kuśalī tvaṃ mahābhāga tapasaḥ kuśalaṃ tava || 3.2.1.90 || na kaścidbādhate duṣṭo daityo hi svargabhūpatim || mune kalyāṇarūpastvaṃ namaskṛtaḥ surāsuraiḥ || sarvvagaḥ sarvavettā ca brahmaputra kṛpānidhe || 91 || || nārada uvāca || || sarvataḥ kuśalaṃ medya prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ sadā || kuśalī tvaṃ mahābhāga dharmaputra yudhiṣṭhira || 92 || bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājeṃdra dharmeṣu ramate manaḥ || dāraiḥ putraiśca bhṛtyaiśca kuśalairgajavājibhiḥ || 93 || aurasāniva putrāṃśca prajā dharmeṇa dharmaja || pālayasi kimāścaryaṃ tvayā dhanyā hi sā prajā || 94 || pālanātpoṣaṇānnṝṇāṃ dharmo bhavati vai dhruvam|| tattaddharmasya bhoktā tvamityevaṃ manurabravīt || 99 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kuśalaṃ mama rāṣṭraṃ ca bhavatāmaṃghrisparśanāt|| darśanena mahābhāga jāto'haṃ gatakilbiṣaḥ||96|| dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ sabhāgyo'haṃ dharātale|| adyāhaṃ sukṛtī jāto hmaputre gṛhāgate || 97 | kuta āgamanaṃ brahmannadya te munisattama || anugrahārthaṃ sādhūnāṃ kiṃ vā kāryeṇa kena ca || 98 || || nārada uvāca || āgato'haṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sakāśācchamanasya ca || vyāsenoktāṃ brahmaṇogre kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām || 99 || dharmāraṇyāśritāṃ divyāṃ sarvasaṃtāpahāriṇīm|| yāṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate brahmahatyayā || 3.2.1.100 || hatyāyutapraśamanīṃ tāpatrayavināśinīm || yāṃ vai śrutvātibhaktyā ca kaṭhino mṛdutāṃ bhajet || 101 | dharmarājena tāṃ śrutvā mamāgre ca niveditām | tamapṛcchdameyātmā kathāṃ dharmavinodinīm|| 102|| || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || dharmāraṇyāśritāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ me dvijasattama || kathayasva prasādena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 103 || || nārad uvāca || || snānakāloyamasmākaṃ na kathāvasaro mama || paraṃtu śrūyatāṃ rājannupadeśaṃ dadāmyaham || 104 || māsānāmuttamo māghaḥ snānadānādike tathā || tasminmāghe ca yaḥ snāti sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate||105|| snānārthaṃ yāhi śīghraṃ tvaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ nṛpate'dhunā|| vyāsasyāgamanaṃ cādya bhaviṣyati nṛpottama || 106 || taṃ pṛcchasva mahābhāga śrāvayiṣyati te śubham || tīrthānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ puṇyaṃ yadadbhutam || 107|| bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || vācayiṣyati tatsarvamitihāsasamudbhavam || 108 || dharmāraṇyasya sakalaṃ vṛttaṃ yadyatpurātanam || vyāsaḥ satyavatīputro vadiṣyati ca te'khilam || 109 || || sūta uvāca || || evamuktvā vidheḥ putrastatraivāṃtaradhīyata | tasmingate sa nṛpatiḥ krīḍate sacivaiḥ saha|| 3.2.1.110|| etasminnaṃtare tatra prāptaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ || vijñāpayāmāsa tadā viduraḥ pāṃḍavasya hi || 111 || || sūta uvāca || || āgataṃ tu muniṃ śrutvā sarve harṣasamākulāḥ || samuttasthurhi bhīmādyāḥ sah dharmeṇa sarvaśaḥ || 112 || tadā hi sanmukho bhūtvā mumude natakandharaḥ || daṃḍavattaṃ praṇamyātha bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitastadā || 113 || madhuparkeṇa vidhinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām|| siṃhāsane samāveśya papracchānāmayaṃ tadā ||111|| tataḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ śrāvayāmāsa dharmavit|| kathāṃte muniśārdūlaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 115 || || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || tvatprasādānmayā brahmañchrutāstu pravarāḥ kathāḥ || āpaddharmmā rājadharmā mokṣadharmmā hyanekaśaḥ|| 116|| purāṇānāṃ ca dharmāśca vratāni bahuśastathā || tīrthānyanekarūpāṇi sarvāṇyāyatanāni ca || 117 || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi dharmāraṇyakathāṃ śubhām || śrutvā yāṃ hi vinaśyeta pāpaṃ brahmavadhādikam|| 118 || dharmmāraṇyasthatīrthānāṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || kasyedaṃ sthāpitaṃ sthānaṃ kasmādetadvinirmitam || 119 || rakṣitaṃ pālitaṃ kena kasminkāle'tha nirmitam || kiṃkiṃ tvatrābhavatpūrvaṃ śaṃśaitatpṛcchato mama || 3.2.1.120|| bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyañca tasminsthāne ca yadbhavet|| tatsarvaṃ kathayasvādya tīrthānāṃ ca yathā sthitiḥ|| 121|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrva bhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye yudhiṣṭhirapraśnavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<3.2.2>
|| vyāsa uvāca||| || pṛthvīpuraṃdhyāstilakaṃ lalāṭe lakṣmīlatāyāḥ sphuṭamālavālam|| vāgdevatāyā jalakeliramyaṃ noherakaṃ saṃprati varṇayāmi || 1 || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājanvārāṇasyadhikādhikam|| dharmāraṇyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha śrṛṇuṣvāvahito bhṛśam|| 2|| sarvatīrthāni tatraiva ūṣaraṃ tena kathyate || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairiṃdrādyaiḥ parisevitam || 3 || lokapālaiśca dikpālairmātṛbhiḥ śivaśaktibhiḥ || gaṃdharvaiśvāpsarobhiśca sevitaṃ yajñakarmabhiḥ || 4|| bhūtavetālaśākinīgrahadevādhidevataiḥ|| ṛtubhirmāsapakṣaiśca sevyamānaṃ surāsureḥ | || 9 | tadādyaṃ ca nṛpasthānaṃ sarvasaukhyapraduṃ tathā || yajñaiśca bahubhiścaiva sevitaṃ munisattamaiḥ || 6|| siṃhavyāghrairdvipaiścaiva pakṣibhirvividhaistathā || gomahi ṣyādibhiścaiva sārasairmṛgaśūkaraiḥ || 7|| sevitaṃ nṛpaśārdūla śvāpadaivairvividhairapi | tatra ye nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭakādayaḥ || 8 || paśavaḥ śvāpadāścaiva jalasthalacarāśca ye || khecarā bhūcarāścaiva ḍākinyo rākṣasāstathā || 9 || ekottaraśataiḥ sārddhaṃ muktisteṣāṃ hi śāśvatī || te sarve viṣṇulokāṃśca prayāṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 3.2.2.10|| saṃtārayati pūrvajñāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān | yavavrīhitilaiḥ sarpirbilvapatraiśca dūrvayā || 11 || guḍaiścaivodakairnātha tatra piṃḍaṃ karoti yaḥ || uddharetsapta gotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatam|| 12 || vṛkṣairanekadhā yuṃkte latāgulmaiḥ suśobhitam || sadā puṇyapradaṃ tacca sadā phalasamanvitam|| 13|| nirvairaṃ nirbhayaṃ caiva dharmāraṇyaṃ ca bhūpate || govyāghraiḥ krīḍyate tatra tathā mārjāramūṣakaiḥ || 11 || bheko'hinā krīḍate ca mānuṣā rākṣasaiḥ saha || nirbhayaṃ vasate tatra dharmmāraṇyaṃ ca bhūtale || 19 || mahānaṃdamayaṃ divyaṃ pāvanātpāvanaṃ param || kalakaṃṭhaḥ kalotkaṃṭhamanuguṃjati kuṃjagaḥ || 16 | dhyānasthaḥ śroṣyati tadā pārāvatyeti vāryyate || kekaḥ kokīṃ parityajya maunaṃ tiṣṭhati tadbhayāt || 17 || cakoraścaṃdrikābhoktā naktavratamivāsthitaḥ|| paṭhaṃti sārikāḥ sāraṃ śukaṃ saṃbodhayatyaho || 18|| apāravārasaṃsārasiṃdhupārapradaḥ śivaḥ || ālasyenāpi yo yāyādgṛhāddharmavanaṃ prati|| 19 || aśvamedhādhiko dharmastasya syācca padepade || śāpānugrahasaṃyuktā brāhmaṇāstatra saṃti vai || 3.2.2.20 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi puṇyakāryeṣu nirmitāḥ || ṣaṭtriṃśattu sahasrāṇi bhṛtyāste vaṇijo bhuvi || 21 || dvijabhaktisamāyuktā brahmaṇyāste tvayonijāḥ || purāṇajñāḥ sadācārā dhārmikāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ || svarge devāḥ praśaṃsaṃti dharmmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 22|| || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || dharmāraṇyeti tridaśaiḥ kadā nāma pratiṣṭhitam || pāvanaṃ bhūtale jātaṃ kasmāttena vinirmitam || 23 || tīrthabhūtaṃ hi kasmācca kāraṇāttadvadasva me || brāhmaṇāḥ katisaṃ khyākāḥ kena vai sthāpitāḥ purā || 24 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi kimarthaṃ sthāpitāni vai || kasminnaṃśe samutpannā brāhmaṇā brahma sattamāḥ || 25 || sarvavidyāsu niṣṇātā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || ṛgvedeṣu ca niṣṇātā yajurvedakṛtaśramāḥ || 26 || sāmavedāṃgapārajñāstraividyā dharma vittamāḥ || taponiṣṭhā śubhācārāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ || 27 || māsopavāsaiḥ kṛśitāstathā cāṃdrāyaṇādibhiḥ || sadācārāśca brahmaṇyāḥ kena nityo pajīvinaḥ || tatsarvamāditaḥ kṛtsnaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara || 28 || dānavāstatra daiteyā bhūtavetālasaṃbhavāḥ || rākṣasāśca piśācāśca udvejaṃte kathaṃ na tān || 29 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvārdhe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye yudhiṣṭhirapraśnarṇanaṃnāma dvitī yo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || || cha ||
<3.2.3>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām || yāṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 || ekadā dharmarājo vai tapastepe suduṣkaram || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairjalavarṣāṃtapādiṣāṭ || 2 || ādau tretāyuge rājanvarṣāṇāmayutatrayam || madhyevanaṃ tapasyaṃtamaśokatarumūlagam || 3 || śuṣkasnāyupinaddhāsthisaṃcayaṃ niścalākṛtim || valmīkakīṭikākoṭiśoṣitāśeṣaśoṇitam || 4 || nirmāṃsakīkasacayaṃ sphaṭikopalaniścalam || śaṃkhakudeṃdutahinamahāśaṃkhalasacchriyam || 5 || sattvāvalaṃbitaprāṇamāyuḥśeṣeṇa rakṣitam || niśvāsocchvāsa pavanavṛttisūcitajīvitam || 6 || nimeṣonmeṣasaṃcārapaśunīkṛtajantukam || piśaṃgitasphuradraśminetradīpitadiṅmukham || 7 || tattapogniśikhādāva cuṃbitamlānakānanam || tacchāṃtyudasudhāvarṣasaṃsiktākhilabhūruhama || 8 || sākṣāttapasyaṃtamiva tapo dhṛtvā narākṛtim || nirākṛtiṃ nirākāśaṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ ca kāṃcanam || 9 || kuraṃgaśāvairgaṇaśo bhramadbhiḥ parivāritam || ninādabhīṣaṇāsyaiśca vanajaiḥ parirakṣitam || 3.2.3.10 || etādṛśaṃ mahābhīmaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ || dhyāyaṃtaṃ ca mahādevaṃ sarveṣāṃ cābhayapradam || 11 || brahmādyā daivatā sarve kailāsaṃ prati jagmire || pārijātatarucchāyāmāsīnaṃ ca sahomayā || 12 || nadirbhṛṃgirmahākālastathānye ca mahāgaṇāḥ || skandasvāmī ca bhagavāngaṇapaśca tathaiva ca || tatra devāḥ sabrahmādyāḥ svasvasthāneṣu tasthire || 13 || || brahmovāca || || namostvanaṃtarūpāya nīlaśca namo'stu te || avijñātasvarūpāya kaivalyāyāmṛtāya ca || 14 || nāṃtaṃ devā vijānaṃti yasya tasmai namonamaḥ || yaṃ na vācaḥ praśaṃsaṃti namastasmai cidātmane || 15 || yogino yaṃ hṛdaḥ kośe praṇidhānena niścalāḥ || jyotīrūpaṃ prapaśyati tasmai śrībrahmaṇe namaḥ || 16 || kālātparāya kālāya svecchayā puruṣāya ca || guṇatrayasvarūpāya namaḥ prakṛtirūpiṇe ||17|| viṣṇave sattvarūpāya rajorūpāya vedhase || tamorūpāya rudrāya sthitisargāṃtakāriṇe || 18 || namo buddhisvarūpāya tridhāhaṃkārarūpiṇe || paṃcatanmātrarūpāya namaḥ prakṛtirūpiṇe || 19 || namo namaḥ svarūpāya paṃcabuddhīṃdriyātmane || kṣityādipaṃcarūpāya namaste viṣayātmane || 3.2.3.20 || namo brahmāṃḍarūpāya tadaṃtarvartine namaḥ || arvācīnaparācīnaviśvarūpāya te namaḥ ||21|| anityanityarūpāya sadasatpataye namaḥ || namaste bhaktakṛpayā svecchāvi ṣkṛtavigraha || 22 || tava niśvasitaṃ vedāstava vedo'khilaṃ jagat || viśvābhūtāni te pādaḥ śiro dyauḥ samavartata || 23 || nābhyā āsīdaṃtarikṣaṃ lomāni ca vanaspatiḥ || caṃdramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryastava prabho || 24 || tvameva sarvaṃ tvayi deva sarvaṃ sarvastuti stavya iha tvameva || īśa tvayā vāsyamidaṃ hi sarvaṃ namo'stu bhūyo'pi namo namaste || 25 || iti stutvā mahādevaṃ nipeturdaṃḍavatkṣitau || pratyuvāca tadā śaṃbhurvarado'smi kimicchati || 26 || || mahādeva uvāca || || kathaṃ vyagrāḥ surāḥ sarve bṛhaspa tipurogamāḥ || tatsamācakṣva māṃ brahmanbhavatāṃ duḥkhakāraṇam || 27 || || brahmovāca || || nīlakaṃṭha mahādeva duḥkhanāśābhayaprada || śṛṇu tvaṃ duḥkhamasmākaṃ bhavato yadvadāmyaham || 28 || dharmarājo'pi dharmātmā tapastepe suduḥsaham || na jāne'sau kimicchati devānāṃ padamuttamam || 29 || tena trastāstattapasā sarva iṃdrapurogamāḥ || bhavatoṃghrau cireṇaiva manastena samarpitam || tamutthāpaya deveśa kimicchati sa dharmarāṭ || 3.2.3.30 || || īśvara uvāca || || bhavatāṃ nāsti nu bhayaṃ dharmātsatyaṃ bravīmyaham || 31 || tata utthāya te sarve devāḥ saha divaukasaḥ || rudraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtvā punaḥpunaḥ || 32 || indreṇa sahitāḥ sarve kailātpunarāgatāḥ || svasvasthāne tadā śīghraṃ gatāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ || 33 || indro'pi vai sudharmāyāṃ gatavānprabhurīśvaraḥ || na nidrāṃ labdhavāṃstatra na sukhaṃ na ca nirvṛtim || 34 || manasā ciṃtayāmāsa vighnaṃ me samupasthitam || avāpa mahatīṃ citāṃ tadā devaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 35 || mama sthānaṃ parāhartuṃ stapastepe suduścaram || sarvāndevānsamāhūya idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 36 || || || indra uvāca || || śṛṇvaṃtu devatāḥ sarvā mama duḥkhasya kāraṇam || duḥkhena mama yallabdhaṃ tatkiṃ vā prārthayedyamaḥ || bṛhaspatiḥ samālokya sarvānde vānathābravīt || 37 || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || tapase nāsti sāmarthyaṃ vighnaṃ kartuṃ divaukasaḥ || urvaśyādyā samāhūya saṃpreṣyaṃtāṃ ca tatra vai ||38|| tāsāmākāraṇārthāya pratidvāraṃ pratasthivān|| sa gatvā tāḥ samādāya sabhāyāṃ śīghramāyayau||39|| āgatāstā hariḥ prāha mahatkāryamupasthitam || gachantu tvaritāḥ sarvā dharmāraṇyaṃ prati drutam || 3.2.3.40 || yatra vai dharmarājosau tapaścakre suduṣkaram || hāsyabhāvakaṭākṣaiśca gatinṛtyādi bhistathā || 41 || taṃ lobhayadhvaṃ yaminaṃ tapaḥsthānāccyutirbhavet || devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā apsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 42 || mithaḥ saṃrebhire kartuṃ vicārya ca parasparam|| dharmāraṇyaṃ pratasthesāvurvaśī svarvarāṃganā || 43 || tuṣṭuvuḥ puṣpavarṣāśca sasṛjustacchirasyamī || tatastu devairvipraiśca stūyamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 44 || niryayau paramaprītyā vanaṃ paramapāvanam || bilvārkakhadirākīrṇaṃ kapitthadhavasaṃkulam || 45 || na sūryo bhāti tatraiva mahāṃdhakāra saṃyutam|| nirjanaṃ nirmanuṣyaṃ ca bahuyojanamāyatam || 46 || mṛgaiḥ siṃhairvṛtaṃ ghoreranyaiścāpi vanecaraiḥ || puṣpitaiḥ pādapaiḥ kīrṇaṃ sumanoharaśādvalam || || 47 || vipulaṃ madhurānādairnāditaṃ vihagaistathā || puṃskokilaninādāḍhyaṃ jhillīkagaṇanāditam || 48 || pravṛddhavikaṭairvṛkṣaiḥ sukhacchāyaiḥ samāvṛtam || | vṛkṣairācchāditatalaṃ lakṣmyā paramayā yutam ||49|| nāpuṣpaḥ pādapaḥ kaścinnāphalo nāpi kaṃṭakī || ṣaṭpadairapyanākīrṇaṃ nāsminvai kānanebhavet ||3.2.3.50|| vihaṃgairnāditaṃ puṣpairalaṃkṛtamatīva hi || sarvartukusamairvṛkṣaiḥ sukhacchāyaiḥ samāvṛtam || 51 || mārutākalitāstatra drumāḥ kusumaśākhinaḥ || puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vicitrāṃ tu visṛjaṃti ca pādapāḥ || 52 || divaspṛśo'tha saṃpuṣṭāḥ pakṣibhirmadhurasvanaiḥ || virejuḥ pādapāstatra sugandhakusumairvṛtāḥ || 53 || tiṣṭhaṃti ca pravāleṣu puṣpabhārāvanādiṣu || ruvaṃti madhurālāpāḥ ṣaṭpadā madhulipsavaḥ || 54 || tatra pradeśāṃśca bahūnāmodāṃkuramaṃḍitān || latāgṛha parikṣiptānmanasaḥ prītivarddhanān || 55 || saṃpaśyaṃtī mahātejā babhūva muditā tadā || parasparāśliṣṭaśākhaiḥ pādapaiḥ kusamācitaiḥ || 56 || aśobhata vanaṃ tattu maheṃdradhvajasannibhaiḥ || sukhaśītasugandhī ca puṣāreṇuvaho'nilaḥ || 57 || evaṃguṇasamāyuktaṃ dadarśa sā vanaṃ tadā || tadā sūryodbhavāṃ tatra pavitrāṃ pariśobhitām || 58 || āśramapravaraṃ tatra dadarśa ca manoramam || patibhirvālakhilyaiśca vṛtaṃ munigaṇā vṛtam || 59 || agnyagāraiśca bahubhirvṛkṣaśākhāvalaṃbitaiḥ || dhūgamrapānakaṇaistatra digvāsoyatibhistathā || 3.2.3.60 || pālyā vanyā mṛgāstatra saumyā bhūyo babhūvire || mārjārā mūṣakaistatra sarpaiśca nakulāstathā || 61 || mṛgaśāvaistathā siṃhāḥ sattvarūpā babhūvire || parasparaṃ cikrīḍuste yathā caiva sahodarāḥ || dūrāddadarśa ca vanaṃ tatra devo'bravīttadā || 62 || || indra uvāca || || ayaṃ ca khalu dharmarāḍ tapastugrevatiṣṭhate || mama rājyābhikāṃkṣo'sāvatorthe yatyatāmiha || 63 || tapovighnaṃ prakurvaṃtu mamājñā tatra gamyatām|| indrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā urvaśī ca tilottamā || 64 || sukeśī maṃjughoṣā ca ghṛtācī menakā tathā || viśvācī caiva raṃbhā ca pramlocā cārubhāṣiṇī || pūrvacittiḥ surūpā ca anumlocā yaśasvinī || etāścānyāśca bahuśastatra saṃsthā vyaciṃtayan || 66 || parasparaṃ vilokyaiva śaṃkamānā bhayena hi || yamaścaiva tathā śakra ubhau vāyatanaṃ hi vaḥ |||| || 67 || evaṃ vicārya bahudhā varddhanī nāma bhārata || sarvāsāmapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 68 || uvācaivorvaśī tatra kiṃ khidyasi śubhānane|| devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ māyārūpabalena ca || varṇadharmo yathā bhūyātkariṣye pākaśāsana || 69 || || indra uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahābhāge varddhanī nāma suvratā || śīghraṃ gaccha svayaṃ bhadre kuru kāryaṃ kṛśodari || 3.2.3.70 || dhīrāṇāmavane śaktā nānyā subhru tvayā vinā || varddhanī ca tathetyuktvā gatā yatra sa dharmarāṭ || 71 || mahatā bhūṣaṇenaiva rūpaṃ kṛtvā manoramam || kuṃkumaiḥ kajjalairvastrairbhūṣaṇaiścaiva bhūṣitā || 72 || kusumaṃ ca tathā vastraṃ kiṃkiṇīkaṭirājitā || jhaṇatkāraistathā kaṣṭairbhūṣitā ca padadvaye || 73 || nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā nānācaṃdanacarcitā || nānākusuma mālāḍhyā dukūlenāvṛtā śubhā || 74 || pragṛhya vīṇāṃ saṃśuddhāṃ kare sarvāṃgasundarī || nartanaṃ trividhaṃ tatra cakre lokamanoramam || 75 || tārasvareṇa madhurairvaṃśanādena miśritam || 76 || mūrcchanātālasaṃyuktaṃ taṃtrīlayasamanvitam || kṣaṇena sahasā devo dharmarājo jitātmavān || vimanāḥ sa tadā jāto dharmarājo nṛpātmajaḥ || 77 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ brahmañjātaṃ me brahmasattama || kathaṃ brahmopapannasya tapaśchedo babhūva ha || 78 || dharme dharā ca nākaśca dharme pātālameva ca || dharme caṃdrārkamāpaśca dharme ca pavano'nalaḥ || 79 || dharme caivākhilaṃ viśvaṃ sa dharmo vyagratāṃ katham || gataḥ svāmiṃstadvaiyagryaṃ tathyaṃ kathaya suvrata || 3.2.3.80 || || vyāsa uvāca || || patanaṃ sāhasānāṃ ca narakasyaiva kāraṇam || yonikuṇḍamidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ kuṃbhīpākasamaṃ bhuvi || 81 || netrarajjvā dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā dharṣayaṃti manasvinaḥ|| kucarūpairmahādaṃḍaistāḍyamānamacetasam || 82 || kṛtvā vai pātayaṃtyāśu narakaṃ nṛpasattama || mohanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ nārī caivaṃ vinirmitā ||83|| tāvaddhaṃta manaḥsthairyaṃ śrutaṃ satyamanākulam || yāvanmattāṃganāgre na vāgureva sucetasām |||4||| tāvattapobhivṛddhistu tāvaddānaṃ dayā damaḥ|| tāvatsvādhyāyavṛttaṃ ca tāvacchaucaṃ dhṛtaṃ vratam ||85|| yāvattrastamṛgīdṛṣṭiṃ capalāṃ na vilokayet|| tāvanmātā pitā tāvaddhātā tāvatsasuhṛjjanaḥ || 86 || tāvallajjā bhayaṃ tāvatsvācārastāvadeva hi || jñānamaudāryamaiśvaryaṃ tāvadeva hi bhāsate || yāvanma ttāṃganāpāśaiḥ pātito naiva bandhanaiḥ || 87 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye indrabha yakathanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || cha ||
<3.2.4>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmarājasya ceṣṭitam || yacchrutvā yamadūtānāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||1|| dharmarājena sā dṛṣṭā varddhanī ca varāpsarā || mahatyaraṇye kā hyeṣā sundarāṃgyatisundarī ||2|| nirmānuṣavanaṃ cedaṃ siṃhavyāghrabhayānakam || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā dharmarājo'bravīdidam || 3 || || dharmarāja uvāca || || kasmāttvaṃ mānini hyekā vane carasi nirjane || kasmātsthānātsamāyātā kasya patnī suśobhane || 4 || sutā tvaṃ kasya vāmoru atirūpavatī śubhā || mānuṣī vātha gaṃdharvī amarī vātha kiṃnarī || 5 || apsarā pakṣiṇī vātha athavā vanadevatā || rākṣasī vā khecarī vā kasya bhāryā ca tadvada || 6 || satyaṃ ca vada me subhrūrityāhārkasutastadā || kimicchasi tvayā bhadre kiṃ kāryaṃ vā vadātra vai || 7 || yadicchasi tvaṃ vāmoru dadāmi tava vāṃchitam || 8 || || varddhanyuvāca || || dharme tiṣṭhati sarvaṃ vai sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vibho || sa dharmo duṣkaraṃ karma kasmāttvaṃ kuruṣe'nagha || 9 || || yama uvāca || || īśānasya ca yadrūpaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi bhāmini || tenāhaṃ tapasā yuktaḥ śivayā saha śaṃkaram || 3.2.4.10 || yaśaḥ prāpsye sukhaṃ prāpsye karomi ca suduṣkaram || yugeyuge mama khyātirbhavediti matirmama || 11 || kalpe kalpe mahākalpe bhūyaḥ khyātirbhavediti || etasmātkāraṇātsubhrūstapyate paramaṃ tapaḥ || 12 || kasmāttvamāgatā bhadre kathayasva yathātathā || kiṃ kāryaṃ kasya hetuśca satyamākhyātumarhasi || 13 || || varddhanyuvāca || || tapasaiva tvayā dharma bhayabhīto divaspatiḥ || tenāhaṃ noditā cātra tapovi ghnasya kāṃkṣayā || 14 || indrāsanabhayādbhītā hariṇā harisannidhau || preṣitāhaṃ mahābhāga satyaṃ hi pravadāmyaham || 15 || || sūta uvāca || || satyavākyena ca tadā toṣito ravinaṃdanaḥ || uvācaināṃ mahābhāgyo varadohaṃ prayaccha me || 16 || yamo'haṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ karmakāriṇām || dharma rūpo hi sarveṣāṃ manujānāṃ jitātmanām || 17 || sa dharmo'haṃ varārohe dadāmi tava durlabham || tatsarvaṃ prārthaya tvaṃ me śīghraṃ cāpsarasāṃ vare || 18 || || || varddhanyuvāca || || indrasthāne sadā ramye susthiratvaṃ prayaccha me || svāmindharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha lokānāṃ ca hitāya vai || 19 || || yama uvāca || || evamastviti tāṃ prāha cānyaṃ varaya satvaram || dadāmi varamutkṛṣṭaṃ gānena toṣitosmyaham || 3.2.4.20 || || varddhanyuvāca || || asminsthāne mahākṣetre mama tīrthaṃ mahāmate || bhūyācca sarvapāpaghnaṃ mannāmneti ca viśrutam || 21 || tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ paṭhitaṃ vā'kṣayaṃ bhavet || pañcarātraṃ niṣeveta varddhamānaṃ sarovaram ||22 || pūrvajāstasya tuṣyeraṃstarpyamāṇā dinedine || tathetyuktvā tu tāṃ dharmo maunamācaṣṭa saṃsthitaḥ|| triḥparikramya taṃ dharmaṃ namaskṛtya divaṃ yayau || 23 || || varddhanyuvāca || || mā bhayaṃ kuru deveśa yamasyārkasutasya ca || ayaṃ svārthaparo dharma yaśase ca samācaret || 24 || || vyāsa uvāca || || varddhanī pūjitā tena śakreṇa ca śubhānanā || sādhusādhu mahābhāge devakārya kṛtaṃ tvayā ||25|| nirbhayatvaṃ varāgehe sukhavāsaśca te sadā || yaśaḥ saukhyaṃ śriyaṃ ramyāṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ śubhānane || 26 || tatheti devāstāmūcurnirbhayānaṃdacetasā || namaskṛtya ca śakraṃ sā gatā sthānaṃ svakaṃ śubham || 27 || || sūta uvāca || || gatepsarasi rājendra dharmastasthau yathāvidhi || tapastepe mahāghoraṃ viśvasyodvegadāyakam || 28 || paṃcāgnisā dhanaṃ śukre māsi sūryeṇa tāpite || cakre suduḥsahaṃ rājandevairapi durāsadam || 29 || tato varṣaśate pūrṇe antako maunamāsthitaḥ|| kāṣṭhabhūta ibhavātasthau valmīkaśatasaṃvṛtaḥ || 3.2.4.30 || nānāpakṣigaṇaistatra kṛtanīḍaiḥ sa dharmarāṭ || upaviṣṭe vrataṃ rājandṛśyate naiva kutracit || 31 || saṃsmaraṃto'tha deveśa mumāpatimaniṃditam || tato devāḥ sagandharvā yakṣāścodvignamānasāḥ || kailāsaśikharaṃ bhūya ājagmuḥ śivasannidhau || 32 || || devā ūcuḥ || trāhitrāhi mahādeva śrīkaṇṭha jagataḥ pate || trāhi no bhūtabhavyeśa trāhi no vṛṣabhadhvaja || dayālustvaṃ kṛpānātha nirvighnaṃ kuru śaṃkara || 33 || || īśvara uvāca || || kenāparādhitā devāḥ kena vā mānamardditāḥ || martye svarge'thavā nāge śīghraṃ kathaya tāciram || 34 || anenaiva triśūlena khaṭvāṃgenāthavā punaḥ || atha pāśupatenaiva nihaniṣyāmi taṃ raṇe || śīghraṃ vai vadatāsmāka matrāgamanakāraṇam || 35 || || devā ūcuḥ || || kṛpāsindho hi deveśa jagadānandakāraka || na bhayaṃ mānuṣādadya na nā gāddevadānavāt || 36 || martyaloke mahādeva pretanātho mahākṛtiḥ || ātmakāryaṃ mahāghoraṃ kleśayediti niścayaḥ || 37 || ugreṇa tapasā kṛtvā kliśyadātmānamātmanā || tenātra vayamudvignā devāḥ sarve sadāśiva || śaraṇaṃ tvāmanuprāptā yadicchasi kuruṣva tat || 38 || || sūta uvāca || || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā vṛṣārūḍho vṛṣadhvajaḥ || āyudhānparisaṃgṛhya kavacaṃ sumanoharam || gatavānatha taṃ deśaṃ yatra dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || || 39 || || īśvara uvāca || || anena tapasā dharma saṃtuṣṭaṃ mama mānasam || varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 3.2.4.40 || icchase tvaṃ yathā kāmā nyathā te manasi sthitān || yaṃyaṃ prārthayase bhadra dadāmi tava sāṃpratam || 41 || || sūta uvāca || || evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || valmīkādutthito rājangṛhītvā karasaṃpuṭam || tuṣṭāva vacanaiḥ śuddhairlokanāthamariṃdam || 42 || || dharma uvāca || || īśvarāya namastubhyaṃ namaste yogarūpiṇe || namaste tejorūpāya nīlakaṃṭha namo'stu te || 43 || dhyātṝṇāmanurūpāya bhaktigamyāya te namaḥ ||
