namaste brahmarūpāya viṣṇurūpa namo' stu te || 44 || namaḥ sthūlāya sūkṣmāya aṇurūpāya vai namaḥ || namaste kāmarūpāya sṛṣṭisthityaṃtakāriṇe || 45 || namo nityāya saumyāya mṛḍāya haraye namaḥ || ātapāya namastubhyaṃ namaḥ śītakarāya ca || 46 || sṛṣṭirūpa namastubhyaṃ lokapāla namo'stu te || nama ugrāya bhīmāya śāṃta rūpāya te namaḥ || 47 || namaścānaṃtarūpāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ || namo bhasmāṃgaliptāya namaste caṃdraśekhara || namo'stu paṃcavaktrāya trinetrāya namo'stu te || 48 || namaste vyālabhūṣāya kakṣāpaṭadharāya ca || namoṃ'dhakavināśāya dakṣapāpāpahāriṇe || kāmanirddāhine tubhyaṃ tripurāre namo'stu te || || 49 || catvāriṃśacca nāmāni mayoktāni ca yaḥ paṭhet || śucirbhūtvā trikālaṃ tu paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādapi || 3.2.4.50 || goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca surāpo guruta lpagaḥ || brahmahā hemahārī ca hyathavā vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 51 || strībālaghātakaścaiva pāpī cānṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ || anācārī tathā steyī paradārābhigastathā || akāryakārī kṛtyaghno brahmadviḍvāḍavādhamaḥ|| 53|| ||sūta uvāca|| ityevaṃ bahubhirvākyairdharmarājena vai muhuḥ|| īḍito'pi mahadbhaktyā praṇamya śirasā svayam||54|| tuṣṭaḥ śaṃbhustadā tasmā uvācedaṃ vacaḥ śubham || varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yatte manasi varttate || 55 || || yama uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari|| taṃ kuruṣva mahābhāga trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 56 || mannāmnā sthānametaddhi khyātaṃ loke bhavediti || acchedyaṃ cāpyabhedyaṃ ca puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || || 57 || sthānaṃ kuru mahādeva yadi tuṣṭo'si me bhava || śivena sthānakaṃ dattaṃ kāśītulyaṃ tadā nṛpa || taddattvā ca punaḥ prāha anyaṃ varaya sattama || 58 || || dharma uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || taṃ kuruṣva mahābhāga trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || vareṇaivaṃ yathā khyātiṃ gamiṣyāmi yugeyuge || 59 || || īśvara uvāca || || brūhi kīnāśa tatsarvaṃ prakaromi tavepsitam || tapasā toṣito'haṃ vai dadāmi varamīpsitam || || 3.2.4.60 || || yama uvāca || || yadi me vāṃchitaṃ deva dadāsi tarhi śaṃkara || asminsthāne mahākṣetre mannāmā bhava sarvadā || 61 || dharmāraṇyamiti khyātistrailokye sacarācare || yathā saṃjāyate deva tathā kuru maheśvara || 62 || || īśvara uvāca || || dharmāraṇyamidaṃ khyātaṃ sadā bhūyādyugeyuge || tvannāmnā sthāpitaṃ deva khyātimetadgamiṣyati || athānyadapi yatkiṃcitkaromyeṣa vadasva tata || || 63 || || yama uvāca || || yojanadvayavistīrṇaṃ mannāmnā tīrthamuttamam || mukteśca śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ pāvanaṃ sarvadehinām || || 64 || makṣikāḥ kīṭakāścaiva paśupakṣimṛgādayaḥ || pataṃgā bhūtavetālā piśācoragarākṣasāḥ || 65 || nārī vātha naro vātha matkṣetre dharmasaṃjñake || tyajate yaḥ priyānprāṇānmuktirbhavatu śāśvatī || 66 || evamastviti sarvopi devā brahmādayastathā || puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ prakurvāṇāḥ paraṃ harṣamavāpnuyuḥ||67|| devaduṃdubhayo nedurgaṃdharvapatayo jaguḥ|| vavuḥ puṇyāstathā vātā nanṛtuścāpsaro gaṇāḥ||68|| ||sūta uvāca|||| yamena tapasā bhaktyā toṣito hi sadāśivaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ devaṃ ramyaṃ sādhumanoramam|| 69 || anujñāṃ dehi me tāta yathā gacchāmi satvaram || kailāsaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 3.2.4.70 || || yama uvāca || || na me sthānaṃ parityaktuṃ tvayā yuktaṃ maheśvara || kailāsādadhikaṃ deva jāyate vacanādidam || 71 || || śiva uvāca || || sādhu proktaṃ tvayā yuktamekāṃśenātra me sthitiḥ || na mayā tyajitaṃ sādhu sthānaṃ tava sunirmalam || || 72 || viśveśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ mannāmnātra bhaviṣyati || evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 73 || śivasya vacanāttatra tadā liṃgaṃ tadadbhutam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca suraistatra yathānāmānukīrttanam || 74 || svaṃsvaṃ liṃgaṃ tadā sṛṣṭaṃ dharmāraṇye surottamaiḥ || yasya devasya yalliṃgaṃ tannāmnā parikīrtitam || || 75 || || sūta uvāca || || dharmeṇa sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ dharmeśvaramupasthitam || smaraṇātpūjanāttasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 76 || yadbrahma yogināṃ gamyaṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye sthitam || tiṣṭhate yasya liṃgaṃ tu svayaṃbhuvamiti sthitam || 77 || bhūtanāthaṃ ca saṃpūjya vyādhibhirmucyate janaḥ || dharmavāpīṃ tataścaiva cakre tatra manoramām || 78 || āhatya koṭitīrthānāṃ jalaṃ vāpyāṃ mumoca ha || yamatīrthasvarūpaṃ ca snānaṃ kṛtvā manoramam || 79 || snānārthaṃ devatānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 3.2.4.80 || dharmavāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā dharmeśvaraṃ śivam || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo na māturgarbhamāviśet || 81 || tatra snātvā naro yastu karoti yamatarpaṇam || vyādhidoṣavināśārthaṃ kleśadoṣopa śāṃtaye || yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāṃtakāya ca || vaivasvatāya kālāya dadhnāya parameṣṭhine ||82|| vṛkodarāya vṛkāya dakṣiṇeśāya te namaḥ || nīlāya citraguptāya citra vaicitra te namaḥ || 83 || yamārthaṃ tarpaṇaṃ yo vai dharmavāpyāṃ kariṣyati || sākṣatairnāmabhiścaitaistasya nopadravo bhavet|| 84 || ekāṃtarastṛtīyastu jvaraścāturthikastathā || velāyāṃ jāyate yastu jvaraḥ śītajvarastathā || 85 || pīḍayanti na caitasya yasyaivo matirīdṛśī || revatyādigrahā doṣā ḍākinī śākinī tathā || 66 || dhanadhānyasamṛddhiḥ syātsaṃtatirvardhate sadā || bhūteśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya susnāto vijiteṃdriyaḥ || 87 || sāṃgaṃ rudrajapaṃ kṛtvā vyādhidoṣātpramucyate|| amāvāsyāṃ somadine vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau|| saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe caiva tatra śrāddhaṃ smṛtaṃ nṛṇām||88|| śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāḥ sahasraṃ nirasya caitatpitarastvadaṃti|| pānīyamevāpi tilairvimiśritaṃ dadāti yo vai prathito manuṣyaḥ||89|| ekaviṃśativāraistu gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānataḥ || dharmeśvare sakṛddattaṃ pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 3.2.4.90 || dharmeśātpaścime bhāge viśveśvarāṃtarepi vā || dharmavāpīti vikhyātā svargasopānadāyinī || 91 || dharmeṇa nirmitā pūrvaṃ śivārthaṃ dharmabuddhinā || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca tarpitāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ || 92 || śamīpatrapramāṇaṃ tu piṃḍaṃ dadyācca yo naraḥ || dharmavāpyāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ garbhavāsaṃ na cāpnuyāt || 93 || kumbhīpākānmahāraudrādrauravānnarakātpunaḥ || aṃdhatāmisrakādrājanmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 94 || || sūta uvāca || || ekavarṣaṃ tarpaṇīyaṃ dharmavāpyāṃ narottamaḥ || ṛtau māse ca pakṣe ca viparītaṃ ca jāyate || 95 || barhiṣado'gniṣvāttāśca ājyapāḥ somapāstathā || tṛptiṃ prayāṃti paramāṃ vāpyāṃ vai tarpaṇena tu || 96 || kurukṣetrādi kṣetrāṇi ayodhyādipurastathā || puṣkarādyāni sarvāṇi muktināmāni saṃti vai || 97 || tāni sarvāṇi tulyāni dharmakūpo'dhiko bhavet || mantro vedāstathā yajñā dānāni ca vratāni ca || 98 || akṣayāṇi prajāyaṃte dattvā japtvā nareśvara || abhicārāśca ye cānye susiddhātharvavedajāḥ || 99 || te sarve siddhimāyāṃti tasminsthāne kṛtā api || āditīrthaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha kājeśairupasevitam || 3.2.4.100 || siddhisthānaṃ susaumyaṃ ca brahmādyairapi sevi tam || kṛte tu yugaparyaṃtaṃ tretāyāṃ lakṣapañcakam || 101 || dvāpare lakṣamekaṃ tu dinaikena phalaṃ kalau || etaduktaṃ mayā brahmandharmāraṇyasya varṇanam || phalaṃ caivātra sarvaṃ hi uktaṃ dvaipāyanena tu || 102 || || sūta uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmavākyaṃ manoramam || devānāṃ hitakāmāya ājñāpya ca yaduktavān || 103 || || dharma uvāca || || asminkṣetre prakurvaṃti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ || pāradāryaṃ mahāduṣṭaṃ svarṇasteyādikaṃ tathā || 104 || anyacca vikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kurvāṇo narakaṃ vrajet || anyakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dharmāraṇye vinaśyati || 105 || dharmāraṇye kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepo bhaviṣyati || yathā puṇyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ yatkiṃcicca śubhāśubham || 106 || tatsarvaṃ varddhate nityaṃ varṣāṇi śatamityuta || kāmināṃ kāmadaṃ puṇya yogināṃ muktidāyakam || 107 || siddhānāṃ siddhidaṃ proktaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ tu sarvadā || aputro labhate putrānnirdhano dhanavānbhavet || 108 || etadākhyānakaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmeṇa kathitaṃ purā || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā nārī vā śrāvayettu yaḥ || gosahasraphalaṃ tasya aṃte haripuraṃ brajet || 109 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye kṣetrasthāpanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<3.2.5>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmāraṇyanivāsinā || yatkāryaṃ puruṣeṇeha gārhasthyamanutiṣṭhatā || 1 || dharmāraṇyeṣu ye jātā brāhmaṇāḥ śuddhavaṃśajā || aṣṭādaśasahasrāśca kājeśaiśca vinirmitāḥ || 2 || sadācārāḥ pavitrāśca brāhmaṇā brahmavittamāḥ || teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa mahāpāpairvimucyate || 3 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || pārāśarya samākhyāhi sadācāraṃ ca me prabho || ācārāddharmamāpnoti ācārāllabhate phalam|| ācārācchriyamāpnoti tadācāraṃ vadasva me || 4 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sthāvarāḥ kṛmayo'bjāśca pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo narāḥ || krameṇa dhārmikāstveta etebhyo dhārmikāḥ surāḥ || 5 || sahasrabhāgātprathame dvitīyānukramāstathā || sarva ete mahābhāgāḥ pāpānmuktisamāśrayāḥ || 6 || caturṇāmapi bhūtānāṃ prāṇinotīva cottamāḥ || prāṇikebhyopi muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarve buddhyupajīvinaḥ || 7 || matimadbhyo narāḥ śreṣṭhāstebhya śreṣṭhāstu vāḍavāḥ || viprebhyo'pi ca vidvāṃso vidvadbhyaḥ kṛtabuddhayaḥ || 8 || kṛtadhībhyo'pi kartāraḥ kartṛbhyo brahmatatparāḥ || na tebhyo'bhyadhikaḥ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu bhārata || 9 || anyonyapūjakāste vai tapo vidyāviśeṣataḥ || brāhmaṇo brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteśvaro yataḥ || 3.2.5.10 || ato jagatsthitaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇo'rhati nāparaḥ || sadācāro hi sarvārho nācārādvicyutaḥ punaḥ || 11 || tasmādvipreṇa satataṃ bhāvyamācāraśīlinā || vidveṣarāgarahitā anutiṣṭhanti yaṃ mune || 12 || saddhi yastaṃ sadācāraṃ dharmamūlaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || lakṣaṇaiḥ parihīno'pi samyagācāratatparaḥ || 13 || śradāluranasūyuśca naro jīvetsamāḥ śatam ||| śrutismṛtibhyāmuditaṃ sveṣusveṣu ca karmasu || 14 || sadācāraṃ niṣeveta dharmamūlamatandritaḥ || durācārarato loke garhaṇīyaḥ pumā nbhavet || 15 || vyādhibhiścābhibhūyeta sadālpāyuḥ suduḥkhabhāk || tyājyaṃ karma parādhīnaṃ kāryamātmavaśaṃ sadā || 16 || duḥkhī yataḥ parādhīnaḥ sadaivātmavaśaḥ sukhī || yasminkarmaṇyaṃtarātmā kriyamāṇe prasīdati || 17 || tadeva karma karttavyaṃ viparītaṃ na ca kvacit || prathamaṃ dharmmasarvasvaṃ proktaṃ yanniyamā yamāḥ || 16 || atasteṣveva vai yatnaḥ kartavyo dharmamicchatā || satyaṃ kṣamārtavaṃ dhyānamānṛśaṃsyamahiṃsanam || 19 || damaḥ prasādo mādhuryaṃ mṛduteti yamā daśa || śaucaṃ snānaṃ tapo dānaṃ maunejyādhyayanaṃ vratam || 3.2.5.20 || upoṣaṇopasthadaṃḍo daśaite niyamāḥ smṛtāḥ || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ damaṃ mohaṃ mā tsaryaṃ lobhameva ca || 21 || amūnṣaḍvairiṇo jitvā sarvatra vijayī bhavet || śanaiḥ saṃcinuyāddharmaṃ valmīkaṃ śṛṃgavānyathā || 22 || parapīḍāmakurvāṇaḥ para lokasahāyinam || dharma eva sahāyī syādamutra parirakṣitaḥ || 23 || pitṛmātṛsutabhrātṛyoṣidbaṃdhujanādhikaḥ || jāyate caikalaḥ prāṇī mriyate ca tathai kalaḥ || 24 || ekalaḥ sukṛtaṃ bhuṃkte bhuṃkte duṣkṛtamekalaḥ || dehe paṃcatvamāpanne tyaktvaikaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭavat || 25 || bāṃdhavā vimukhā yāṃti dharmo yāṃtamanu vrajet || ataḥ saṃcinuyāddharmmamatrā'mutra sahāyinam || 26 || dharmaṃ sahāyinaṃ labdhvā saṃtareddustaraṃ tamaḥ || saṃbaṃdhānācārennityamuttamairuttamaiḥ sudhīḥ || ||27|| adhamānadhamāṃstyaktvā kulamutkarṣatāṃ nayet || uttamānuttamāneva gaccheddhīnāṃśca varjayet || brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhatāmeti pratyavāyena śūdratām || 28 || anadhyayanaśīlaṃ ca sadācāravilaṃghinam || sālasaṃ ca durannādaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bādhateṃ'takaḥ || 29 || ato'bhyasyetprayatnena sadācāraṃ sadā dvijaḥ || tīrthānyapyabhilaṣyaṃti sadācārisamāgamam || 3.2.5.30 || rajanīprāṃtayāmārddhaṃ brāhmaḥ samaya ucyate || svahitaṃ ciṃtayetprājñastasmiṃścotthāya sarvadā || || 31 || gajāsyaṃ saṃsmaredādau tata īśaṃ sahāṃbayā || śrīraṃgaṃ śrīsametaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam|| 32|| iṃdrādīnsakalāndevānvasiṣṭhādīnmunīnapi || gaṃgāyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ śrīśailāyakhilāngirīn|| 33 || kṣīrodādīnsamudrāṃśca mānasādisarāṃsi ca || vanāni naṃdanādīni dhenūḥ kāmadughādayaḥ || || 34 || kalpavṛkṣādivṛkṣāṃśca dhātūnkāṃcanamukhyataḥ || divyastrīrurvaśīmukhyāḥ prahrādāvadyānhareḥ priyān || 35 || jananīcaraṇau smṛtvā sarvatīrthoktta mottamau || pitaraṃ ca gurūṃścāpi hadi dhyātvā prasannadhīḥ || 36 || tataścāvaśyakaṃ karttuṃ nairṛtīṃ diśamāvrajet || grāmāddhanuḥśataṃ gacchennagarācca caturguṇam || 37 || tṛṇairācchādya vasudhāṃ śiraḥ prāvṛtya vāsasā || karṇopavīta udagvaktro divase saṃdhyayorapi || 38 || viṇmūtre visṛjenmaunī niśāyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || na tiṣṭhannāśu no vipra govanhyanilasaṃmukhaḥ || 39 || na phālakṛṣṭe bhūbhāge na rathyāsevyabhūtale || nālokayeddiśo bhāgañjyo tiścakraṃ nabho malam || 3.2.5.40 || vāmena pāṇinā śiśnaṃ dhṛtvottiṣṭhetprayatnavān || atho mṛdaṃ samādadyājjaṃtukarkkaravarjitām || 41 || vihāya mūṣako tkhātāṃ cocchiṣṭāṃ keśasaṃkulām || guhye dadyānmṛdaṃ caikāṃ prakṣālya cāṃbunā tataḥ || 42 || punarvāmakareṇeti paṃcadhā kṣālayedgudam || ekaika pādayordadyāttisraḥ pāṇyormṛdastathā || 43 || itthaṃ śaucaṃ gṛhī kuryādgaṃdhalepakṣayāvadhi || kramādvaiguṇyataḥ kuryādbrahmacaryādiṣu triṣu || 44 || divāvihitaśaucācca rātrāvarddhaṃ samācaret || paragrāme tadardhaṃ ca pathi tasyārdhameva ca || 45 || tadardhaṃ rogiṇāṃ cāpi susthe nyūnaṃ na kāra yet || api sarvanadītoyairmṛtkūṭaiścāpyagopamaiḥ || 46 || āpātamācarecchaucaṃ bhāvaduṣṭo na śuddhibhāk || ārdradhātrīphalonmānā mṛdaḥ śauce prakīrtitāḥ || 47 || sarvāścāhutayo'pyevaṃ grāsāścāṃdrāyaṇepi ca || prāgāsya udagāsyo vā sūpaviṣṭaḥ śucau bhuvi || 48 || upaspṛśedvihīnābhistuṣāṃgārāsthibhasmabhiḥ || atisvacchābhiradbhiśca yāvaddhṛdgābhiratvaraḥ || 49 || brāhmaṇo brahmatīrthena dṛṣṭipūtābhirācamet || kaṇṭhagābhirnṛpaḥ śudhyettālugābhistathorujaḥ || 3.2.5.50 || strīśūdrāvātha saṃsparśamātreṇāpi viśudhyataḥ || śiraḥ śabdaṃ sakaṃṭhaṃ vā jale muktaśikho'pi vā || 51 || akṣālitapadadvadva ācāṃto'pyaśucirmmataḥ || triḥ pītvāṃbu viśuddhyarthaṃ tataḥ khāni viśodhayet || 52 || aṃguṣṭhamūladeśena hyadharoṣṭhau pari mṛjet || spṛṣṭvā jalena hṛdayaṃ samastābhiḥ śiraḥ spṛśet || 53 || aṃgulyagraistathā skandhau sāṃbu sarvvatra saṃspṛśet || ācāṃtaḥ punarācāmetkṛtvā rathyopasarpaṇam|| 54 || snātvā bhuktvā payaḥ pītvā prāraṃbhe śubhakarmaṇām || suptvā vāsaḥ parīdhāya dṛṣṭvā tathāpyamaṃgalam || 55 || pramādādaśuci smṛtvā dvirācāṃtaḥ śucirbhavet || daṃtadhāvanaṃ prakurvīta yathokta dharmaśāstrataḥ || ācāṃto'pyaśuciryasmādakṛtvā daṃtadhāvanam || 56 || pratipaddarśaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyāṃ ravivāsare || daṃtānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃyogo dahedāsaptamaṃ kulam || 57 || alābhe daṃtakāṣṭhānāṃ niṣiddhe vātha vāsare || gaṃḍūṣā dvādaśa grāhyā mukhasya pariśuddhaye || 58 || kaniṣṭhāgraparīmāṇaṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇārujam || dvādaśāṃgulamānaṃ ca sārdraṃ syāddaṃtadhāvanam || 59 || ekekāṃgulamānaṃ taccarvayeddaṃtadhāvanam || prātaḥ snānaṃ caritvā ca śuddhyai tīrthe viśeṣataḥ || 3.2.5.60 || prātaḥ snānādyataḥ śuddhyetkāyo'yaṃ malinaḥ sadā|| yanmalaṃ navabhiśchidraiḥ sravatyeva divāniśam || 61 || utsāhamedhāsaubhāgyarūpasaṃpatpravarddhakam || prājāpatyasamaṃ prāhustanmahāghavināśakṛt || 62 || prātaḥ snānaṃ haretpāpamalakṣmīṃ glānimeva ca || aśucitvaṃ ca duḥsvapnaṃ tuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ prayacchati || 63 || nopasarpaṃti vai duṣṭāḥ prātasnāyijanaṃ kvacit || dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ yasmātprātaḥsnānaṃ samācaret || 64 || prasaṃgataḥ snānavidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi nṛpottamāḥ || vidhisnānaṃ yataḥ prāhuḥ snānā cchataguṇottaram || 65 || viśuddhāṃ mṛdamādāya barhiṣastilagomayam || śucau deśe paristhāpya hyācamya snānamācaret || 66 || upagrahī baddha śikho jalamadhye samāviśet || svaśākhoktavidhānena snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || 67 || snātvetthaṃ vastramāpīḍya gṛhṇīyāddhautavāsasī || ācamya ca tataḥ kuryātprātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ kuśānvitaḥ || 68 || prāṇāyāmāṃścaranvipro niyamya mānasaṃ dṛḍham || ahorātrakṛtaiḥ pāpairmukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || || 69 || daśa dvādaśasaṃkhyā vā prāṇāyāmāḥ kṛtā yadi || niyamya mānasaṃ tena tadā taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || 3.2.5.70 || savyāhṛtipraṇavakāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa || api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsātpunaṃtyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ || 71 || yathā pārthivadhātūnāṃ dahyate dhamanānmalāḥ || tatheṃdriyaiḥ kṛtā doṣā jvālyaṃte prāṇasaṃyamāt|| 72 || ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ || gāyatryāstu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ ca nṛpottama || 73 || karmaṇā manasā vācā yadrātrau kurute tvagham|| uttiṣṭhanpūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ prāṇāyāmairviśodhayet || 74 || yadahnā kurute pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || āsīnaḥ paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ prāṇāyāmairvyapohati || paścimāṃ tu samāsīno malaṃ haṃti divākṛtam || 75 || nopatiṣṭhettu yaḥ pūrvvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām || sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryaḥ sarvasmāddvijakarmaṇaḥ || 76 || apāṃ samīpamāsādya nityakarma samācaret || tata ācamanaṃ kuryādyathāvidhyanu pūrvaśaḥ || 77 || āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhirmārjanaṃ tu tataścaret || bhūmau śirasi cākāśa ākāśe bhuvi mastake || 78 || mastake ca tathākāśaṃ bhūmau ca navadhā kṣipet || bhūmiśabdena caraṇāvākāśaṃ hṛdayaṃ smṛtam || śirasyeva śiraḥśabdo mārjanaṃ tairudāhṛtam || 79 || vāruṇādapi cāgneyādvāyavyādapi ceṃdrataḥ || maṃtrasthānādapi paraṃ brāhmaṃ snānamidaṃ param || brāhmasnānena yaḥ snātaḥ sa bāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ śuciḥ || 3.2.5.80 || sarvatra cārhatāmeti devapūjādikarmaṇi || naktaṃdinaṃ nimajjyāpsu kaivartāḥ kimu pāvanāḥ || 81 || śataśo'pi tathā snātā na śuddhā bhāvadūṣitāḥ || aṃtaḥkaraṇaśuddhāṃśca tānvibhūtiḥ pavitrayet || 82 || kiṃ pāvanāḥ prakīrtyaṃte rāsabhā bhasmadhūsarāḥ || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu malaiḥ sarvairvivarjitaḥ ||83|| tena kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ ceto yasyeha nirmalam || tadeva nirmalaṃ ceto yathā syāttanmune śṛṇu || 84 || viśveśaścetprasannaḥ syāttadā syānnānyathā kvacit || tasmācceto viśuddhyarthaṃ kāśīnāthaṃ samāśrayet||85|| idaṃ śarīramutsṛjya paraṃ brahmādhigacchati|| drupadāṃtaṃ tato japtvā jalamādāya pāṇinā|| || 86 || kuyādṛtaṃ ca maṃtreṇa vidhijñastvaghamarṣaṇam || nimajjyāpsu ca yo vidvāñjapettriraghamarṣaṇam || 87 || jale vāpi sthale vāpi yaḥ kuryādaghamarṣa ṇam || tasyāghaugho vinaśyeta yathā sūryodaye tamaḥ || 88 || gāyatrīṃ śirasā hīnāṃ mahāvyāhṛtipūrvvikām || praṇavādyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhankṣipedaṃbhoṃjali trayam|| 89 || tena vajrodakenāśu maṃdehā nāma rākṣasāḥ || sūryatejaḥ pralopaṃte śailā iva vivasvataḥ || 3.2.5.90 || sahāyārthaṃ ca sūryasya yo dvijo nāṃjali trayam|| kṣipenmaṃdehanāśāya sopi maṃdehatāṃ vrajet ||91|| prātastāvajjapaṃstiṣṭhedyāvatsūryasya darśanam || upaviṣṭo japetsāyamṛkṣāṇāmāvilokanāt || || 92 || kālalopo na karttavyo dvijena svahitepsunā|| arddhodayāstasamaye tasmādvajrodakaṃ kṣipet || 93 || vidhināpi kṛtā saṃdhyā kālātītā 'phalā bhavet || ayameva hi dṛṣṭāṃto vaṃdhyāstrīmaithunaṃ yathā ||94|| jale vāmakaraṃ kṛtvā yā saṃdhyā''caritā dvijaiḥ || vṛṣalī sā parijñeyā rakṣogaṇamudā vahā || 95 || upasthānaṃ tataḥ kuryācchākhoktavidhinā tataḥ || sahasrakṛtvo gāyatryāḥ śatakṛtvothavā punaḥ || 96 || daśakṛtvo'tha devyai ca kuryātsau rīmupasthitim || sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām || 97 || gāyatrīṃ yo japedvipro na sa pāpaiḥ pralipyate || raktacaṃdanamiśrābhiradbhiśca kusumaiḥ kuśaiḥ || 98 || vedoktairāgamoktairvā maṃtrairarghaṃ pradāpayet || arcitaḥ savitā yena tena trailokyamarccitam || 99 || arcitaḥ savitā datte sutānpaśuva sūni ca || vyādhīnhareddadātyāyuḥ pūrayedvāṃchitānyapi || 3.2.5.100 || ayaṃ hi rudra ādityo harireṣa divākaraḥ || ravirhiraṇyarūpo'sau trayīrūpo'yama ryamā || 101 || tatastu tarpaṇaṃ kuryātsvaśākhoktavidhānataḥ || brahmādīnakhilāndevānmarīcyādīṃstathā munīn || 102 || caṃdanāgurukarppūragaṃdhava tkusamairapi || tarpayecchucibhistoyaistṛpyaṃtviti samuccaret || 103 || sanakādīnmanuṣyāṃśca nivītī tarpayedyavaiḥ || aṃguṣṭhadvayamadhye tu kṛtvā darbhānṛjūndvijaḥ || 104 || kavyavāḍanalādīṃśca pitṝndivyānpratarppayet || prācīnāvītiko darbhairdviguṇaistilamiśritaiḥ || 105 || ravau śukle trayodaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ niśi saṃdhyayoḥ || śreyorthī brāhmaṇo jātu na kuryāttilatarppaṇam || 106 || yadi kuryāttataḥ kuryācchuklaireva tilaiḥ kṛtī || caturdaśa yamānpaścāttarpayennāma uccaran ||107|| tataḥ svagotramuccārya tarpayetsvānpitṝnmudā || savyajānunipātena pitṛtīrthena vāgyataḥ ||108|| ekaikamaṃjaliṃ devā dvaudvau tu sanakādikāḥ || pitarastrīnpravāṃchaṃti striya ekaikamaṃjalim || 109 || aṃgulyagreṇa vai daivamārṣamaṃgulimūlagam || brāhmamaṃguṣṭhamūle tu pāṇimadhye prajāpateḥ || 3.2.5.110 || madhyeṃguṣṭhapradeśinyoḥ pitryaṃ tīrthaṃ pracakṣate || ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ || 111 || tṛpyaṃtu sarvve pitaro mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ || anye ca maṃtrāḥ proktā ye vedoktāḥ purāṇasaṃbhavāḥ || 112 || sāṃgaṃ ca tarppaṇaṃ kuryātpitṝṇāṃ ca sukhapradam || agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vedābhyāsaṃ tataścaret || 113 || śrutyabhyāsaḥ paṃcadhā syātsvīkāro'rthavicāraṇam || abhyāsaśca tapaścāpi śiṣyebhyaḥ pratipādanam || 114 || labdhasya pratipālārthamalabdhasya ca labdhaye || prātaḥkṛtyamidaṃ proktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ nṛpottama || 115 || athavā prātarutthāya kṛtvāvaśyakameva ca || śaucācamanamādāya bhakṣayeddantadhāvanam || || 116 || viśodhya sarvagātrāṇi prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ samācaret || vedārthānadhigacchedvai śāstrāṇi vividhānyapi || 117 || adhyāpayecchucīñchiṣyānhitānme dhāsamanvitān || upeyādīśvaraṃ cāpi yogakṣemādisiddhaye || 118 || tato madhyāhnasiddhyarthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ snānamācaret || snātvā mādhyāhnikīṃ saṃdhyā mupāsīta vicakṣaṇaḥ || 119 || devatāṃ paripūjyātha naimittikaṃ vidhiṃ caret || pavanāgniṃ samujjvālya vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret || 3.2.5.120 || niṣpāvānko dravānmāṣānkalāpāṃścaṇakāṃstyajet || tailapakvamapakvānnaṃ sarvaṃ lavaṇayuktyajet || 121 || āḍhakyannaṃ masūrānnaṃ vartuladhānyasaṃbhavam || bhuktaśeṣaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vaiśvadeve vivarjayet au| 122 || darbhapāṇiḥ samācamya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca || pṛṣodivīti maṃtreṇa paryyukṣaṇamathācaret || 123 || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca paryukṣya dviḥ paristīrya vai kuśān || rāporddha(?)devamantreṇa kuryādvahniṃ svasaṃmukhe || 124 || vaiśvānaraṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣataistathā || svaśākhoktaprakāreṇa homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 125 || adhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttiśca vidyārthī gurupoṣakaḥ || yatiśca brahmacārī ca ṣaḍete dharmabhikṣakāḥ || 126 || atithiḥ pāṃthiko jñeyo'nūcānaḥ śrutipāragaḥ || mānyāvetau gṛhasthānāṃ brahmalokamabhīpsatām || 127 || api śvapāke śuni vā naivānnaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || atrārthini samāyāte pātrāpātraṃ na ciṃtayet || 128 || śunāṃ ca patitānāṃ ca śvapacāṃ pāparogiṇām || kākānāṃ ca kṛmīṇāṃ ca bahirannaṃ kiredbhuvi || 129 || aindravāruṇavāyavyāḥ saumyā vai nairṛtāśca ye || pratigṛhṇaṃtvimaṃ piṃḍaṃ kākā bhūmau mayārpitam || 3.2.5.130 || itthaṃ bhūta baliṃ kṛtvā kālaṃ godohamātrakam || pratīkṣyātithimāyātaṃ viśadbhojyagṛhaṃ tataḥ || 131 || adattvā vāyasabaliṃ nityaśrāddhaṃ samācaret || nityaśrāddhe svasāmarthyāttrīndvāvekamathāpi vā || 132 || bhojayetpitṛyajñārthaṃ dadyāduddhatya vāri ca || nityaśrāddhaṃ daivahīnaṃ niyamādivivarjitam || 133 || dakṣiṇārahitaṃ tvetaddātṛbhoktṛsutṛptikṛt || pitṛyajñaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ svasthabuddhiranāturaḥ || 134 || aduṣṭāsanamadhyāsya bhuṃjīta śiśubhiḥ saha || sugandhiḥ sumanāḥ sragvī śucivāsodvayānvitaḥ || 135 || prāgāsya udagāsyo vā bhuṃjīta pitṛsevitam || vidhāyānnamanagnaṃ tadupariṣṭādadhastathā || 136 || āpośānavidhānena kṛtvāśnīyātsudhīrdvijaḥ || bhūmau balitrayaṃ kuryādapo dadyāttadopari || 137 || sakṛccāpa upaspṛśya prāṇādyāhutipaṃcakam || dadyājaṭharakuṃḍāgnau darbhapāṇiḥ prasannadhīḥ || 138 || darbhapāṇistu yo bhuṃkte tasya doṣo na vidyate || keśakīṭādisaṃbhūtastadaśnīyātsadarbhakaḥ || 139 || tato maunena bhuñjīta na kuryāddaṃtagharṣaṇam || prakṣālitavyahastasya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhamūlataḥ || 3.2.5.140 || raurave'puṇyani laye adholokanivāsinām || ucchiṣṭodakamicchūnāmakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām || 141 || punarācamya medhāvī śucirbhūtvā prayatnataḥ || mukhaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā purāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ || 142 || ativāhya divāśeṣaṃ tataḥ saṃdhyāṃ samācaret || gṛheṣu prākṛtā saṃdhyā goṣṭe daśaguṇā smṛtā || 143 || nadyāmayutasaṃkhyā syādanaṃtā śivasannidhau || anṛtaṃ madyagandhaṃ ca divāmaithunameva ca || punāti vṛṣalasthānaṃ saṃdhyā bahirupāsitā || 144 || uddeśataḥ samākhyāta eṣa nityatano vidhiḥ || itthaṃ samācaranvipro nāvasīdati karhicit||145 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharuyā saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye sadācāravarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha || ||
<3.2.6>
vyāsa uvāca || || upakārāya sādhūnāṃ gṛhasthāśramavāsinām || yathā ca kriyate dharmo yathāvatkathayāmi te || 1 || vatsa gārhasthyamāsthāya naraḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat || puṣṇāti tena lokāṃśca sa jayatyabhivāṃchitān || 2 || pitaro munayo devā bhūtāni manujāstathā || krimikīṭapataṃgāśca vayāṃsi pitaro'surāḥ || 3 || gṛhasthamupajīvaṃti tatastṛptiṃ prayāṃti ca || mukhaṃ vāsya nirīkṣaṃte apo no dāsyatīti ca || 4 || sarvasyādhārabhūtā ye vatsa dhenustrayīmayī || asyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvahetuśca yā matā || 5 || ṛkpṛṣṭhāsau yajuḥsaṃdhyā sāmakukṣipayodharā || iṣṭāpūrtaviṣāṇā ca sādhusūktatanūruhā || 6 || śāṃti puṣṭiśakṛnmūtrā varṇapādapratiṣṭhitā || upajīvyamānā jagatāṃ padakramajaṭāghanaiḥ || 7 || svāhākārasvadhākārau vaṣaṭkāraśca putraka || hantakārastathai vānyastasyāḥ stanacatuṣṭayam || 8 || svāhākārastanaṃ devāḥ pitaraśca svadhāmayam || munayaśca vaṣaṭkāraṃ devabhūtasureśvarāḥ || 9 || hantakāraṃ manuṣyāśca pibaṃti satataṃ stanam || evamadhyāpayedeva vedānāṃ pratyahaṃ trayīm || 3.2.6.10 || teṣāmucchedakarttā yaḥ puruṣo'naṃtapāpakṛt || sa tamasyaṃdhatāmisre narake hi nimajjati || 11 || yastvenāṃ mānavo dhenuṃ svarvatsairamarādibhiḥ || pūjayatyucite kāle sa svargāyopapadyate || 12 || tasmātputra manuṣyeṇa devarṣi pitṛmānavāḥ || bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanuryathā || 13 || tasmātsnātaḥ śucirbhūtvā devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam || yajñasyāṃte tathaivādbhiḥ kāle kuryātsamāhitaḥ || 14 || sumanogandhapuṣpaiśca devānabhyarcya mānavaḥ || tatognestarpaṇaṃ kuryāddyāccāpi balīṃstathā || 15 || naktaṃcarebhyo bhūtebhyo balimākāśato haret || pitṝṇāṃ nirvapettadvaddakṣiṇābhimukhastataḥ || 16 || gṛhasthastatparo bhūtvā samāhitamānasaḥ || tatastoyamupādāya teṣvevārpaṇa satkriyām || 17 || sthāneṣu nikṣipetprājño nāmnā tūdiśya devatāḥ || evaṃ baliṃ gṛhe dattvā gṛhe gṛhapatiḥ śuciḥ || 18 || ācamya ca tataḥ kuryātprājño dvārāvalokanam || muhūrtasyāṣṭamaṃ bhāgamudīkṣetātithiṃ tataḥ || 19 || atithiṃ tatra saṃprāptamarghyapādyodakena ca || bubhukṣumāgataṃ śrāṃtaṃ yācamānamakiṃcanam || 3.2.6.20 || brāhmaṇaṃ prāhuratithiṃ saṃpūjya śaktito budhaiḥ || na pṛchettatrācaraṇaṃ svādhyāyaṃ cāpi paṃḍitaḥ ||21|| śobhanāśobhanākāraṃ taṃ manyeta prajāpatim || anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāttasmādatithirucyate || 22 || tasmai dattvā tu yo bhuṃkte sa tu bhuṃkte'mṛtaṃ naraḥ || atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātprati nivartate ||23|| sa dattvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati || api vā śākadānena yadvā toyapradānataḥ || pūjayettaṃ naraḥ bhaktyā tenaivāto vimucyate ||24|| || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || vivāhā brāhmadaivārṣāḥ prājāpatyāsurau tathā || gāṃdharvo rākṣasaścāpi paiśācoṣṭama ucyate ||25|| eteṣāṃ ca vidhiṃ brūhi tathā kāryaṃ ca tattvataḥ || gṛhasthānāṃ tathā dharmānbrūhi me tvaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 26 || || parāśara uvāca || || sa brāhmo varamāhūya yatra kanyā svalaṃkṛtā || dīyate tatsutaḥ pūyātpuruṣānekaviṃśatim || 27 || yajñasthāyartvije daivastajjaḥ pāti caturdaśa || varādādāya godvandvamārṣastajjaḥ punāti ṣaṭ || 28 || sahobhau caratāṃ dharmaṃ prājāpatyaḥ sa īritaḥ || varavadhvoḥ svecchayrā ca gāṃdharvo'nyonyamaitrataḥ || prasahya kanyāharaṇādrākṣaso ninditaḥ satām || 29 || chalena kanyāharaṇātpaiśāco garhito'ṣṭamaḥ || prāyaḥ kṣatraviśoruktā gāṃdharvāsurarākṣasāḥ || 3.2.6.30 || aṣṭamastveṣa pāpiṣṭhaḥ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ || savarṇayā karo grāhyo dhāryaḥ kṣatriyayā śaraḥ || 31 || pratodo vaiśyayā dhāryo vāsoṃtaḥ śūdrayā tathā || asavarṇā sveṣa vidhiḥ smṛtau dṛṣṭaśca vedane || 32 || savarṇābhistu sarvābhiḥ pāṇirgrāhyastvayaṃ vidhiḥ || dharmye vivāhe jāyaṃte dharmyāḥ putrāḥ śatāyuṣaḥ || 33 || adharmyāddharmmarahitā maṃdabhāgyadhanāyuṣaḥ || kṛtakālābhigamane dharmoyaṃ gṛhiṇaḥ paraḥ ||34|| strīṇāṃ varamanusmṛtya yathākāmyathavā bhavet || divābhigamanaṃ puṃsāmanāyuṣyaṃ paraṃ matam|| 35 || śrāddhārhaḥ sarvaparvāṇi na gaṃtavyāni dhīmatā || tatra gachanstriyaṃ mohārddharmātpracyavate parāt || 36 || ṛtukālābhigāmī yaḥ svadāranirataśca yaḥ || sa sadā brahmacārī hi vijñeyaḥ sa gṛhāśramī || 37 || ārṣe vivāhe godvaṃdvaṃ yaduktaṃ tatra śasyate || śulkamaṇvapi kanyāyāḥ kanyāvikrayapāpakṛt || 38 || apatyavikrayātkalpaṃ vasedviṭkṛmibhojane || ato nāṇvapi kanyāyā upajīvyaṃ narairdhanam || 39 || tatra tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīrnivaseddānavāriṇā || vāṇijyaṃ nīcasevā ca vedānadhyayanaṃ tathā || 3.2.6.40 || kuvivāhaḥ kriyālopaḥ kule patanahetavaḥ || kuryādvaivāhike cāgnau gṛhyakarmmānvahaṃ gṛhī || 41 || pañcayajñakriyāṃ cāpi paktiṃ dainaṃdinīmapi || gṛhasthāśramiṇaḥ pañcasūnākarma dinedine || 42 || kuṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī hyudakumbhī tu mārjanī || tāsāṃ ca paṃcasūnānāṃ nirākaraṇahetavaḥ || kratavaḥ paṃca nirddiṣṭā gṛhiśreyobhivarddhanāḥ || 43 || paṭhanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ syāttarpaṇaṃ ca pitṛkratuḥ || homo daivo balirbhauta ātithyaṃ nṛkratuḥ kramāt || 44 || vaiśvadevāṃtare prāptaḥ sūryoḍho vātithiḥ smṛtaḥ || atitherāditopyete bhojyā nātra vicāraṇā || 45 || pitṛdevamanuṣyebhyo dattvāśnātyamṛtaṃ gṛhī || adattvānnaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte kevalaṃ svodaraṃbhariḥ || 46 || vaiśvadevena ye hīnā ātithyena vivarjitāḥ || sarve te vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedā api dvijāḥ ||47|| akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu bhuñjate ye dvijādhamāḥ || iha lokennahīnāḥ syuḥ kākayoniṃ vrajaṃtyatho || 48|| vedoktaṃ viditaṃ karmma nityaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ || yadi kuryādyathāśakti prāpnuyātsadgatiṃ parām || 49 || ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyorvasetpāpaṃ taile māṃse sadaiva hi || caturdaśyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ tathaiva ca kṣure bhage || 3.2.6.50 || udayantaṃ na vīkṣeta nāstaṃ yaṃtaṃ na mastake || na rāhuṇopaspṛṣṭaṃ ca nāṃḍasthaṃ vīkṣayedravim ||51|| na vīkṣetātmano rūpamapsu dhāvenna kardame || na nagnāṃ striyamīkṣeta na nagno jalamāviśet ||52|| devatāyatanaṃ vipraṃ dhenuṃ madhu mṛdaṃ tathā|| jātivṛddhaṃ vayovṛddhaṃ vidyāvṛddhaṃ tathaiva ca ||53|| aśvatthaṃ caityavṛkṣaṃ ca guruṃ jalabhṛtaṃ ghaṭam|| siddhānnaṃ dadhisiddhārthaṃ gacchankuryātpradakṣiṇam || 54 || rajasvalāṃ na seveta nāśnīyātsaha bhāryayā || ekavāsā na bhuñjīta na bhuñjītotkaṭāsane || 55 || nāśuciṃ striyamīkṣeta teja skāmo dvijottamaḥ || asaṃtarpya pitṝndevānnādyādannaṃ ca kutracit ||56|| pakvānnaṃ cāpi no māṃsaṃ dīrghakālaṃ jijīviṣuḥ || na mūtraṇaṃ vraje kuryānna valmī ke na bhasmani || 57 || na gatteṃṣu sasattveṣu na tiṣṭhanna vrajannapi || brāhmaṇaṃ sūryamagniṃ ca caṃdraṛkṣagurūnapi || 58 || abhipaśyanna kurvīta malamūtravisarja nam|| mukhenopadhamennāgniṃ nagnāṃ nekṣeta yoṣitam || 59 || nāṃghrī pratāpayedagnau na vastu aśuci kṣipet || prāṇihiṃsāṃ na kurvīta nāśnīyātsaṃdhya yordvayoḥ || 3.2.6.60 || na saṃviśecca saṃdhyāyāṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ kvacidbudhaḥ || nācakṣīta dhayaṃtīṃ gāṃ neṃdracāpaṃ pradarśayet || 61 || naikaḥ supyātkvacicchūnye na śayānaṃ prabodhayet || paṃthānaṃ naikalo yāyānna vāryyaṃjalinā pibet || 62 || na divoddhṛtasāraṃ ca bhakṣayeddadhi no niśi || strīdharmiṇī nābhivadennādyādātṛpti rātriṣu || 63 || tauryatrikapriyo na syātkāṃsye pādau na dhāvayet || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā paraśrāddhe yo'śnīyājjñānavarjitaḥ || 64 || dātuḥ śrāddhaphalaṃ nāsti bhoktā kilbiṣabhugbhavet || na dhārayedanyabhuktaṃ vāsaścopānahāvapi || 65 || na bhinnabhājane'śnīyānnāsītāgnyādidūṣite || ārohaṇaṃ gavāṃ pṛṣṭhe pretadhūmaṃ sarittaṭam|| 66 || bālātapaṃ divāsvāpaṃ tyajeddīrghaṃ jijīviṣuḥ || snātvā na mārjayedgātraṃ visṛjenna śikhāṃ pathi || || 67 || hastau śiro na dhunuyānnākarṣedāsanaṃ padā || kareṇa no mṛjedgātraṃ snānavastreṇa vā punaḥ || 68 || śunocchiṣṭaṃ bhavedgātraṃ punaḥ snānena śudhyati || notpāṭayellomanakhaṃ daśanena kadācana||69|| karajaiḥ karajacchedaṃ vivarjayecchubhāya tu|| yadāyatyāṃ tyajettanna kuryātkarma prayatnataḥ|| 3.2.6.70|| advāreṇa na gantavyaṃ svaveśmāpi kadācana|| krīḍennājñaiḥ sahāsīta na dharmmaghnairna rogibhiḥ||71|| na śayīta kvacinnagnaḥ pāṇau bhuṃjīta naiva ca || ārdrapādakarāsyo'śnandīrghakālaṃ na jīvati || 72 || saṃviśennārdracaraṇo nocchiṣṭaḥ kvacidāvrajet || śayanastho na cāśnīyānna pibecca jalaṃ dvijaḥ || 73 || sopānatko nopaviśenna jalaṃ cotthitaḥ pibet || sarvvamamlamayaṃ nādyādārogyasyābhilāṣukaḥ || 74 || na nirīkṣeta viṇmūtre nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśecchiraḥ || nādhitiṣṭhettuṣāṃgāra bhasmakeśakapālikāḥ || 75 || patitaiḥ saha saṃvāsaḥ patanāyaiva jāyate || dadyādāsanaṃ maṃcaṃ na śūdrāya kadācana || 76 || brāhmaṇyāddhīyate vipraḥ śūdro dharmācca hīyate || dharmopadeśaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ svaśreyaḥ pratighātayet || 77 || dvijaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharmmaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ hi paro mataḥ || kaṇḍūyanaṃ hi śirasaḥ pāṇibhyāṃ na śubhaṃ matam || 78 || ādiśedvaidikaṃ maṃtraṃ na śūdrāya kadācana || brāhmaṇyā dīyate vipraḥ śūdro dharmmācca hīyate || |79 || ātāḍanaṃ karābhyāṃ ca krośanaṃ keśaluṃcanam || aśāstravartanaṃ bhūyo lubdhātkṛtvā pratigraham || 3.2.6.80 || brāhmaṇaḥ sa ca vai yāti narakānekaviṃśatim || akālameghastanite varṣartau pāṃsuvarṣaṇe || 81 || mahābāladhvanau rātrāvanadhyāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || ulkāpāte ca bhūkaṃpe digdāhe madhyarātriṣu || 82 || madhyayorvṛṣalopānte rājyahāre ca sūtake || daśāṣṭakāsu bhūtāyāṃ śrāddhāhe pratipadyapi ||83|| pūrṇimāyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ viḍvare rāṣṭraviplave || upākarmaṇi cotsarge kalpādiṣu yugādiṣu ||84|| āraṇyakamadhītyāpi bāṇasāmnorapi dhvanau || anadhyāyeṣu caiteṣu cādhīyīta na vai kvacit ||85|| bhūtāṣṭamyoḥ pañcadaśyorbrahmacārī sadā bhavet || anāyuṣyakaraṃ ceha paradāropasarpaṇam || tasmāttaddūratastyājya vairiṇāṃ copasevanam || 86 || pūrvarddhibhiḥ parityaktamātmānaṃ nāvamānayet || sadodyamavatāṃ yasmācchriyo vidyā na durlabhāḥ || || 87 || satyaṃ brūyātpriyaṃ būyānna brūyātsatyamapriyam || priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmo vidhīyate || 88 || vācovegaṃ manāvegaṃ jihvāvegaṃ ca varja yet || guhyajānyapi lomāni tatsparśādaśucirbhaveta || 89 || pādadhautodakaṃ mūtramucchiṣṭānyudakāni ca || niṣṭhīvanaṃ ca śleṣmāṇaṃ dūrāddūraṃ viniḥ kṣipeta || 3.2.6.90 || aharnniśaṃ śruterjāpyācchaucācāraniṣevaṇāta || adrohavatyā buddhyā ca pūrvajanma mmareddvijaḥ || 91 || vṛddhānprayatnādvaṃdeta dadyātteṣāṃ svamāsanama || vinamrakandharo bhūyādanuyāyāttataśca tān || 92 || śrutibhūdevadevānāṃ nṛpasādhutapasvinām || pativratānāṃ nārīṇāṃ nindāṃ kuryānna karhi cita || 93 || uddhṛtya pañcamṛtpiṃḍānsnāyātparajalāśaye || śraddhayā pātramāsādya yatkiṃciddīyate vasu || 94 || deśe kāle ca vidhinā tadānaṃtyāya kalpate || bhūprado maṇḍalādhīśaḥ sarvatra sukhito'nnadaḥ || 95 || toyadātā surūpaḥ syātpuṣṭaścānnaprado bhaveta || pradīpado nirmalākṣo godātāryamaloka bhāk ||96|| svarṇadātā ca dīrghāyustiladaḥ syācca suprajaḥ || veśmado'tyuccasaudheśo vastradaścandralokabhāk ||97|| hayaprado divyadeho lakṣmīvānvṛṣabha pradaḥ|| subhāryaḥ śibikādātā suparyaṃkaprado'pi ca ||98|| śraddhayā pratigṛhṇāti śraddhayā yaḥ prayacchati || svargiṇau tāvubhau syātāṃ patato'śradrayā tvadhaḥ |||99|| anṛtena kṣaredyajñastapo vismayataḥ kṣaret || kṣaretkīrtirvinādānamāyurviprāpamānataḥ ||3.2.6.100|| gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ kuśā gāvaḥ śākaṃ māṃsaṃ payo dadhi || maṇimatsyagahaṃ dhānyaṃ grāhyametadupasthitam ||101|| madhūdakaṃ phalaṃ mūlamedhāṃsyabhayadakṣiṇā || abhyudyatāni grāhyāṇi tvetānyapi nikṛṣṭataḥ||102|| dāsanāpitagopālakulamitrārddhasīriṇaḥ || bhojyānnāḥ śūdravargemī tathātmavinivedakaḥ ||103|| itthamācāradharmoyaṃ dharmāraṇyanivāsinām || śrutismṛtyuktadharmo'yaṃ yudhiṣṭhira niveditaḥ || 104 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye sadācāralakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha ||
<3.2.7>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || saṃprāpya dharmavāpyāṃ ca yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam || tṛptiṃ prayāṃti pitaro yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || 1 || pitaraścātra pūjyāśca svargatā ye ca pūrvajāḥ || piṃḍāṃśca nirvapetteṣāṃ prāpyemāṃ muktidāyikām || 2 || tretāyāṃ paṃca divasairdvāpare tridinena tu || ekacittena yo viprāḥ piṃḍaṃ dadyātkalau yuge || 3 || lolupā mānavā loke saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge || paradāraratā lokāḥ striyo'ticapalāḥ punaḥ||4|| paradroharatāḥ sarve naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ|| paranindāparā nityaṃ paracchidropadarśakāḥ||5|| parodvegakarā nūnaṃ kalahā mitrabhedinaḥ|| sarve te śuddhatāṃ yāṃti kājeśāḥ svayamabruvan ||6|| etaduktaṃ mahābhāga dharmāraṇyasya varṇanam || phalaṃ caivātra sarvaṃ hi yaduktaṃ śūlapāṇinā || 7 || vāṅmanaḥ kāyaśuddhāśca paradāraparāṅmukhāḥ || adrohāśca samāḥ kruddhā mātāpitṛparāyaṇāḥ || 8 || alaulyā lobharahitā dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || āstikāścaiva dharmajñāḥ svāmibhaktiratāśca ye || 9 || pativratā tu yā nārī patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā || ahiṃsakā ātitheyāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sadā|| 3.2.7.10 || || śaunaka uvāca || || śṛṇu sūta mahābhāga sarvadharmavidāṃvara || gṛhasthānāṃ sadācāraḥ śrutaśca tvanmukhānmayā || 11 || ekaṃ manepsitaṃ medya tatkathayasva sūtaja || pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vada || 12 || || sūta uvāca || || pativratā gṛhe yasya saphalaṃ tasya jīvanam || yasyāṃgacchāyayā tulyā yatkathā puṇyakāriṇī || 13 || pativratāstvaruṃdhatyā sāvitryāpyanasūyayā || śāṃḍilyā caiva satyā ca lakṣmyā ca śatarūpayā || || 14 || menayā ca sunītyā ca saṃjñayā svāhayā samāḥ || pativratānāṃ dharmā hi muninā ca prakīrtitāḥ || 15 || bhuṃkte bhukte svāmini ca tiṣṭha ti tvanutiṣṭhati || vinidrite yā nidrāti prathamaṃ paribudhyati || 16 || analaṃkṛtamātmānaṃ deśāṃte bhartari sthite || kāryārthaṃ proṣite kvāpi sarvvamaṃḍa navarjitā || 17 || bharturnāma na gṛhṇāti hyāyuṣo'sya hi vṛddhaye || puruṣāṃtaranāmāpi na gṛhṇati kadācana || 18 || ākṛṣṭāpi ca nākrośettāḍitāpi prasīdati || idaṃ kuru kṛtaṃ svāminmanyatāmiti vakti ca || 19 || āhūtā gṛhakāryāṇi tyaktvā gacchati satvaram || kimarthaṃ vyāhṛtā nātha sa prasādo vidhīyatām || 3.2.7.20 || na ciraṃ tiṣṭhati dvāri na dvāramupasevate || adātavyaṃ svayaṃ kiṃcitkarhicinna dadātyapi|| 21 || pūjopakaraṇaṃ sarvama nuktā sādhayetsvayam || niyamodakabarhīṃṣi yatra puṣpākṣatādikam || 22 || pratīkṣamāṇā ca varaṃ yathākālocitaṃ hi yat || tadupasthāpayetsarvamanudvi gnātihṛṣṭavat ||23|| sevate bhartturucchiṣṭamiṣṭamannaṃ phalādikam || dūrato varjjayedeṣā samājotsavadarśanam || 24 || na gacchettīrthayātrādivivāhaprekṣaṇā diṣu || sukhasuptaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ ramamāṇaṃ yadṛcchayā || 25 || aṃtarāye'pi kāryeṣu patiṃ notthāpayetkvacit || strīdharmiṇī trirātraṃ tu svamukhaṃ naiva darśayet || 26 || svavākyaṃ śrāvayennāpi yāvatsnātvā na śudhyati || susnātā bhartṛvadanamīkṣetānyasya na kvacit || athavā manasi dhyātvā patiṃ bhānuṃ vilokayet ||27|| haridrāṃ kukumaṃ caiva siṃdūraṃ kajjalaṃ tathā || kūrpāsakaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ māṃgalyābharaṇaṃ śubham || 28 || keśasaṃskārakaṃ caiva karakarṇādibhūṣaṇam || bharturāyuṣyamicchaṃtī dūrayenna pativratā || 29 || bhartṛvidveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ naiṣā saṃbhāṣate kvacit || naikākinī kvacidbhūyānna nagnā snāti ca kvacit ||3.2.7.30|| nolūkhale na muśale na varddhanyāṃ dṛṣadyapi || na yaṃtrake na dehalyāṃ satī copaviśetkvacit || 31 || vinā vyavāyasamayātprāgalbhyaṃ na kvaciccareta || yatrayatra rucirbhartustatra premavatī sadā || 32 || idameva vrataṃ strīṇāmayameva paro vṛṣaḥ || iyameva ca pūjā ca bharturvākyaṃ na laṃghayet || || 33 || klībaṃ vā duravasthaṃ vā vyādhitaṃ vṛddhameva vā || susthiraṃ duḥsthiraṃ vāpi patimekaṃ na laṃghayet || 34 || sarpirlava(?)ṇahiṃgvādikṣaye'pi va pati vratā || patiṃ nāstīti na brūyādāyasīṣu na bhojayet || 35 || tīrthasnānārthinī caiva patipādodakaṃ pibet || śaṃkarādapi vā viṣṇoḥ patirevādhi kaḥ striyaḥ || 36 || vratopavāmaniyamaṃ patimullaṃghya yā caret || āyuṣyaṃ harate bharturmṛtā nirayamṛcchati || 37 || uktā pratyuttaraṃ dadyānnārī yā krodhata tparā || saramā jāyate grāme śṛgālī nirjane vane || 38 || strīṇāṃ hi paramaścaiko niyamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || abhyarcya caraṇau bhaturbho ktavyaṃ kṛtaniścayā || 39 || uccāsanaṃ na seveta na vrajetparaveśmasu || tatra pāruṣyavākyāni brūyānnaiva kadācana ||3.2.7.40|| gurūṇāṃ sannidhau vāpi noccairbru yānnavāhayet || 41 || yā bhartāraṃ parityajya rahaścarati durmatiḥ || ulūkī jāyate krūrā vṛkṣakoṭaraśāyinī || 42 || tāḍitā tāḍayeccettaṃ sā vyāghrī vṛṣadaṃśikā || kaṭākṣayati yā'nyaṃ vai kekarākṣī tu sā bhavet || 43 || yā bhartāraṃ parityajya miṣṭamaśnāti kevalam || grāme sā sūkarī bhūyādvalgulī vātha viṅbhujā || 44 || huntvaṃkṛtyāpriyaṃ brūte mūkā sā jāyate khalu || yā sapatnīṃ sadairṣyeta durbhagā sā punaḥpunaḥ || dṛṣṭiṃ vilupya bharturyā kaṃcidanyaṃ samīkṣate || 45 || kāṇā ca vimukhā vāpi kurūpāpi ca jāyate || bāhyādāyāṃtamālokya tvaritā ca jalāsanaiḥ || tāṃbūlairvyajanaiścaiva pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ || 46 || tathaiva cāruvacanaiḥ svedasaṃnodanaiḥ paraiḥ || yā priyaṃ prīṇayetprītā trilokī prīṇitā tayā || mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrātā sutaṃ sutaḥ || 47 || amitasya hi dātāraṃ bhartāraṃ kā na pūjayet || bhartā devo gururbhartā dharmatīrthavratāni ca || tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya patimekaṃ samarcayet || 48 || jīvahīno yathā dehī kṣaṇādaśucitāṃ vrajet || bhartṛhīnā tathā yoṣitsusnātāpya śuciḥ sadā || 49 || amaṃgalebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vidhavā syādamaṃgalā || vidhavādarśanātsiddhiḥ kvāpi jātu na jāyate || 3.2.7.50 || vihāya mātaraṃ caikāṃ sarvā maṃgalavarjitāḥ || tadāśiṣamapi prājñastyajedāśīviṣopamām || 51 || kanyāvivāhasamaye vācayeyuriti dvijāḥ || bhartuḥ sahacarī bhūyājjīvato 'jīvatopi vā || 52 || anuvrajantī bhartāraṃ gṛhātpitṛvanaṃ mudā || padepadeśvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 53 || vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ balāduddharate bilāt || evamutkramya dūtebhyaḥ patiṃ svargaṃ vrajetsatī || 54 || yamadūtāḥ palāyaṃte tāmālokya pativratām || tapanastapyate nūnaṃ dahanopi ca dahyate || 55 || kaṃpaṃte sarvatejāṃsi dṛṣṭvā pātivrataṃ mahaḥ || yāvatsvalomasaṃkhyāsti tāvatkoṭyayutāni ca || 56 || bhartrā svargasukhaṃ bhuṃkte ramamāṇā pativratā || dhanyā sā jananī loke dhanyo'sau janakaḥ punaḥ || 57 || dhanyaḥ sa ca patiḥ śrīmānyeṣāṃ gehe pativratā || pitṛvaṃśyā mātṛvaṃśyāḥ pativaṃśyāstrayastrayaḥ || pativratāyāḥ puṇyena svargasaukhyāni bhuṃjate || 58 || śīlabhaṃgena durvṛttāḥ pātayaṃti kulatrayam || piturmātustathā patyurihāramutra ca duḥkhitāḥ || 59 || pativratāyāścaraṇo yatrayatra spṛśedbhuvam || sā tīrthabhūmirmmānyeti nātra bhāro'sti pāvanaḥ || 3.2.7.60 || bibhyatpativratāsparśaṃ kurute bhānumānapi || somo gandharva evāpi svapāvitryāya nānyathā || 61 || āpaḥ pativratāsparśamabhilaṣyaṃti sarvadā || gāyatryāghavināśo no pātivratyena sā'ghanut || 62 || gṛhegṛhe na kiṃ nāryyo rūpalāvaṇyagarvitāḥ || paraṃ viśveśabhaktyaiva labhyate strī pati vratā || 63 || bhāryā mūlaṃ gṛhasthasya bhāryā mūlaṃ sukhasya ca || bhāryā dharmaphalāyaiva bhāryā saṃtānavṛddhaye || 64 || paralokastvayaṃ loko jīyate bhāryayā dvayam || devapitratithīnāṃ ca tṛptiḥ syādbhāryayā gṛhe || gṛhasthaḥ sa tu vijñeyo gṛhe yasya pativratā || 65 || yathā gaṃgāvagāhena śarīraṃ pāvanaṃ bhavet || tathā pativratāṃ dṛṣṭvā sadanaṃ pāvanaṃ bhavet || 66 || paryaṃkaśāyinī nārī vidhavā pātayetpatim|| tasmādbhūśayanaṃ kāryyaṃ patisaukhyasamīhayā || 67 || naivāṃgodvarttanaṃ kāryyaṃ striyā vidhavayā kvacit || gandhadravyasya saṃbhogo naiva kāryyastayā kvacit || 68 || tarppaṇaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryaṃ bhartuḥ kuśatilodakaiḥ|| tatpitustatpituścāpi nāmagotrādipūrvakam || 69 || viṣṇoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ patibuddhyā na cānyathā || || patimeva sadā dhyāyedviṣṇurūpadharaṃ harim || 3.2.7.70 || yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yadyatpatyuḥ samīhitam || tattadguṇavate deyaṃ patiprīṇanakāmyayā || 71 || vaiśākhe kārttike māse viśeṣaniyamāṃścaret || snānaṃ dānaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ muhuḥ || 72 || vaiśākhe jalakumbhāśca kārttike ghṛtadīpikāḥ || māghe dhānyatilotsargaḥ svargaloke viśiṣyate || 73 || prapā kāryā ca vaiśākhe deve deyā galaṃtikā || uśīraṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ sūkṣmavāsāṃsi caṃdanam || ||74|| sakarpūraṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ puṣpadānaṃ tathaiva ca || jalapātrāṇyanekāni tathā puṣpagṛhāṇi ca || 75 || pānāni ca vicitrāṇi drākṣāraṃbhāphalāni ca || deyāni dvijamukhyebhyaḥ patirme prīyatāmiti ||76|| ūrjje yavānnamaśnīyādekānnamathavā punaḥ|| vṛntākaṃ sūraṇaṃ caiva śūkaśiṃbīṃ ca varjayet||77|| kārttike varjayettailaṃ kāṃsyaṃ cāpi vivarjayet || kārttike maunaniyame cārughaṇṭāṃ pradāpayet || 78 || patrabhojī kāṃsyapātraṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ prayacchati || bhūmiśayyāvrate deyā śayyā ślakṣṇā satūlikā ||79| phalatyāge phalaṃ deyaṃ rasatyāge ca tadrasaḥ || dhānyatyāge ca taddhānyamathavā śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ || dhenuṃ dadyātprayatne na sālaṃkārā sakāṃcanām |||3.2.7.8 0|| ekataḥ sarvadānāni dīpadānaṃ tathaikataḥ || kārttike dīpadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ||51|| ityādividhavānāṃ ca niyamāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ || teṣāṃ phalamidaṃ rājannānyeṣāṃ ca kadācana || 82 || dharmavāpīṃ samāsādya dānaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || koṭidhā varddhate nityaṃ brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā || 83 || tiladhenuṃ ca yo dayāddharmeśvarapuraḥ sthitaḥ || tilasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi svarge loke mahīyate || 64 || dharmakṣetre tu saṃprāpya śrāddhaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ || tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛptāḥ syuḥ pitaro dhuvam || 85 || ye cānye pūrvajāḥ svarge ye cānye narakaukasaḥ || ye ca tiryaktvamāpannā ye ca bhūtādisaṃsthitāḥ || 86 || tānsarvāndharmakūpe vai śrāddhaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || atra prakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi || tena te tṛptimāyāṃti ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ || 87 || yeṣāṃ tu snānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati putraka || tena ye tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate || 88 || yā vai yavānāṃ kaṇikāḥ pataṃti dharaṇītale || tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye tu devatvamāgatāḥ || 89 || uddhṛteṣyatha piṃḍeṣu yāvānnakaṇikā bhuvi || tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye ca pātālamāgatāḥ || 3.2.7.90 || ye vā varṇāśramācārakriyālopā hyasaṃskṛtāḥ || vipannāste bhavaṃtyatra saṃmārjanajalāśinaḥ || 91 || bhuktvā vācamanaṃ yacca jalaṃ patati bhūtale || brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaivānye tena tṛptiṃ prayāṃti vai || 92 || evaṃ yo yajamānaśca yacca teṣāṃ dvijanmanām || kvacijjalānnavikṣepaḥ śuciraspṛṣṭa eva ca || 93 || ye cānye narake jātāstatra yonyaṃtaraṃ gatāḥ || prayāṃtyāpyāyanaṃ vatsa samyakchrāddhakriyāvatām || || 94 || anyāyopārjitairdravyaiḥ śrāddhaṃ yatkriyate naraiḥ || tṛpyaṃti tena caṇḍālapulkasādiṣu yoniṣu || 95 || evamāpyāyitā vatsa tena cānekabāṃdhavāḥ || śrāddhaṃ kartumaśaktiścecchākairapi hi jāyate || 96 || tasmācchrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā śākairapi yathāvidhi || kurute kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ kulaṃ kvacinna sīdati || 97 || pāpaṃ yadi kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ ca varddhate dhruvam || kurvāṇo narake ghore pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 98 || yathā puṇyaṃ tathā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham || tatsarvaṃ varddhate nūnaṃ dharmāraṇye nṛpottama || 99 || kāmikaṃ kāmadaṃ devaṃ yogināṃ muktidāyakam || siddhānāṃ siddhidaṃ proktaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ tu sarvadā || 3.2.7.100 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāṇyakṣetramāhātmye dharmācāravarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<3.2.8>
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || dharmāraṇyakathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā tṛptirna me vibho || yadāyadā kathayasi tadā protsahate manaḥ || ataḥ paraṃ kimabhavatparaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu pārtha mahāpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ skaṃdapurāṇajām || sthāṇunoktāṃ ca skaṃdāya dharmāraṇyodbhavāṃ śubhām || 2 || sarvatīrthasya phaladāṃ sarvopadravanāśinīm || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum || paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam || 3 || kapālakhaṭavāṃgakaraṃ nāgayajñopavītinam || gaṇaiḥ parivṛtaṃ tatra surāsuranamaskṛtam || 4 || nānārūpaguṇairgītaṃ nāradapramukhairyutam || gaṃdharvaiścāpsarobhiśca sevitaṃ tamumāpatim|| tatrasthaṃ ca mahādevaṃ praṇipatyābravītsutaḥ || 5 || || skaṃda uvāca || || svāminniṃdrādayo devā brahmādyāścaiva sarvaśaḥ || tava dvāre samāyātāntvaddarśanaikalālasāḥ || kimājñāpayase deva karavāṇi tavāgrataḥ || 6 || || vyāsa uvāca || skaṃdasya vacanaṃ śrutvā āsanādutthito haraḥ || vṛṣabhaṃ na samārūḍho gaṃtukāmo'bhavattadā || 7 || gatukāmaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā skaṃdo vākyamathābravīt || || 8 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kiṃ kāryaṃ deva devānāṃ yattvamāhūyase tvaram || vṛṣaṃ tyaktvā kṛpāsiṃdho kṛpāsti yadi me vada || 9 || devadānava yuddhaṃ vā kiṃ kāryaṃ vā mahattaram || 3.2.8.10 || || śiva uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvaikāgramanasā yenāhaṃ vyagracetasaḥ || asti sthānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ dharmmāraṇyaṃ ca bhūtale || 11 || tatrāpi gaṃtukāmo'haṃ devaiḥ saha ṣaḍānanaḥ || 12 || || skaṃda uvāca || || tatra gatvā mahādeva kiṃ kariṣyasi sāṃpratam || tanme brūhi jagannātha kṛtyaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ || 13 || || śiva uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ putra manasolhādakāraṇam || āditaḥ sarvvavṛttānāṃ sṛṣṭi sthitikaraṃ mahat || 14 || paraṃtu pralaye jāte sarvatastamasā vṛtam|| āsīdekaṃ tadā brahma nirguṇaṃ bījamavyayam || 15 || nirmitaṃ vai guṇairādau maha ddravyaṃ pracakṣyate || 16 || mahākalpe ca saṃprāpte carācare kṣayaṃ gate || jalarūpī jagannātho ramamāṇastu līlayā || 17 || cirakāle gate sopi pṛthivyādisutattvakaiḥ || vṛkṣamutpādayāmāsāyutaśākhāmanoramam || 18 || phalairviśālairākīrṇaṃ skaṃdhakāṃḍādiśobhitam || phalaughāḍhyo jaṭāyukto nyagro dho viṭapo mahān || 19 || bālabhāvaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vāsudevo janārddanaḥ || śete'sau vaṭapatreṣu viśvaṃ nirmātumutsukaḥ || 3.2.8.20 || sanābhikamale viṣṇo rjāto brahmā hi lokakṛt || sarvaṃ jalamayaṃ paśyannānākāramarūpakam|| 21 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasodvegādbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || idamāha tadā putra kiṃ karo mīti niścitam|| 22 || khe jajāna tato vāṇī devātsā cāśarīriṇī || tapastapa vidhe dhātaryathā me darśanaṃ bhavet || 23 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tatra brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || prātapyata tapo ghoraṃ paramaṃ duṣkaraṃ mahat || 24 || prahasansa tadā bālarūpeṇa kamalāpatiḥ || uvāca madhurāṃ vācaṃ kṛpālurbāla līlayā || 25 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || putra tvaṃ vidhinā cādya kuru brahmāṃḍagolake || pātālaṃ bhūtalaṃ caiva siṃdhusāgarakānanam || 26 || vṛkṣāśca girayo dvipadāḥ paśavastathā || pakṣiṇaścaiva gaṃdharvāḥ siddhā yakṣāśca rākṣasāḥ || 27 || śvāpadādyāśca ye jīvāścaturāśītiyonayaḥ || udbhijjāḥ svedajāścaiva jarāyujāstathāṃḍajāḥ ||28|| ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi ekaikasya ca yonayaḥ || kuru tvaṃ sakalaṃ cāśu ityuktvāṃtaradhīyata || brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ ca yathoditam || 29 || yasminpitāmaho jajñe prabhurekaḥ prajāpatiḥ || sthāṇuḥ suragururbhānuḥ pracetāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 3.2.8.30 || yathā dakṣo dakṣaputrā stathā saptarṣayaśca ye || tataḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ prābhavannekaviṃśatiḥ || 31 || puruṣaścāprameyaśca evaṃ vaṃśyarṣayo viduḥ || viśvedevāstathādityā vasava ścāśvināvapi || 32 || yakṣāḥ piśācāḥ sādhyāśca pitaro guhyakāstathā || tataḥ prasūtā vidvāṃso hyaṣṭau brahmarṣayo'malāḥ || 33 || rājarṣayaśca bahavaḥ sarve samuditā guṇaiḥ || dyaurāpaḥ pṛthivī vāyuraṃtarikṣaṃ diśastathā || 34 || saṃvatsarārtavo māsāḥ pakṣāhorātrayaḥ kramāt || kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtādi nime ṣādi lavāstathā || 35|| grahacakraṃ sanakṣatraṃ yugā manvantarādayaḥ || yaccānyadapi tatsarvaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ lokasākṣikam || 36 || yadidaṃ dṛśyate cakraṃ kiṃci tsthāvarajaṃgamam|| punaḥ saṃkṣipyate putra jagatprāpte yugakṣaye || 37 || yathartāvṛtuliṃgāni nāmarūpāṇi paryaye || dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā vatsa yugādikam|| 38 || || śiva uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām || brahmaṇaśca tathā putra vaṃśasyaivānukīrtanam || 39 || brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrā viditāḥ ṣaṇmaharṣayaḥ || marīciratryaṃgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || 3.2.8.40 || marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ kaśyapāccaramāḥ prajāḥ || prajajñire mahābhāgā dakṣakanyāstrayodaśa || 41 || aditirditirdanuḥ kālā danāyuḥ siṃhikā tathā || krodhā provā vasiṣṭhā ca vinatā kapilā tathā || 42 || kaṇḍūścaiva sunetrā ca kaśyapāya dadau tadā || adityāṃ dvādaśādityāḥ saṃjātā hi śubhānanāḥ || 43 || sūryādvai dharmarāḍ jajñe te nedaṃ nirmitaṃ purā || dharmeṇa nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmāraṇyamanuttamam || dharmāraṇyamiti proktaṃ yanmayā skanda puṇyadam || 44 || || skanda uvāca || ||| dharmāraṇyasya cākhyānaṃ paramaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā || śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ kathayasva maheśvara || 45 || || īśvara uvāca || || indrādyāḥ sakalā devā anvayurbrahmaṇā saha || ahaṃ vai tatra yāsyāmi kṣetraṃ pāpaniṣūdanam || 46 || || skanda uvāca || || ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi taṃ draṣṭuṃ śaśiśe khara || 47 || || sūta uvāca || || tataḥ skandastathā rudraḥ sūryaścaivānilo'nalaḥ || siddhāścaiva sagandharvāstathaivāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ || 48 || piśācā guhyakāḥ sarva indro varuṇa eva ca || nāgāḥ sarvāḥ samājagmuḥ śukro vācaspatistathā || 49 || grahāḥ sarve sanakṣatrā vasavo'ṣṭau dhruvā dayaḥ || aṃtarikṣacarāḥ sarve ye cānye nagavāsinaḥ || 3.2.8.50 || brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhaṃ parayā mudā || mantraṇārthaṃ tadā brahmā viṣṇave'mitate jase || 51 || gatvā tasmiṃśca vaikuṇṭhe brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || dhyātvā muhūrtamācaṣṭa viṣṇuṃ prati suharṣitaḥ || 52 || || brahmovāca || || kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho kṛpālo parameśvara || sraṣṭā tvaṃ caiva hartā tvaṃ tvameva jagataḥ pitā || 53 || namaste viṣṇave saumya namaste garuḍadhvaja || namaste kama lākāṃta namastebrahmarūpiṇe || 54 || namaste matsyarūpāya viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ || namaste daityanāśāya bhaktānāmabhayāya ca || 55 || kaṃsaghnāya namastestu baladaityajite namaḥ || brahmaṇaivaṃ stutaścāsītpratyakṣo'sau janārddanaḥ || 56 || pītāṃbaro ghanaśyāmo nāgārikṛtavāhanaḥ || caturbhujo mahā tejāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 57 || stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sa devo'mitavikramaḥ || vidyādharaistathā nāgaiḥ stūyamānaśca sarvaśaḥ || 58 || uttasthau sa tadā devo bhāskarāmitadīptimān || koṭiratnaprabhābhāsvanmukuṭādivibhūṣitaḥ || 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye viṣṇusamāgamonāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
<3.2.9>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ rājaśārdūla puṇyamākhyānamuttamam || stūyamāno jagannātha idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 1 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve brahmādyāḥ surasattamāḥ|| pṛthivyāṃ kuśalaṃ kaccitkuto vo bhayamāgatam ||2|| tataḥ provāca vai hṛṣṭo brahmā taṃ keśavaṃ vacaḥ || na bhayaṃ vidyate'smākaṃ trailokye sacarācare ||3|| ekavijñāpanārthāya āgato'haṃ tavāṃtike|| tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadetacchṛṇu me vacaḥ||4|| paraṃ tu pūrvaṃ dharmeṇa sthāpitaṃ tīrthamuttamam|| taddraṣṭukāmo'haṃ deva tvatprasādājjanārdana || 5 || tatra tvaṃ devadeveśa gamane kuru mānasam || yathā sattīrthatāṃ yāti dharmāraṇyamanuttamam || 6 || viṣṇuruvāca || sādhusādhu mahābhāga tvaryatāṃ tatra mā ciram || mamāpi cittaṃ tatraiva taddarśanesti lālasam || 7 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tārkṣyamāruhya goviṃda statrāgācchīghrameva hi || tato dharmeṇa te devāḥ seṃdrāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā || 8 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā dṛṣṭā dūrānmumoda ca || dharmarājopi tāndṛṣṭvā devā nviṣṇupurogamān || 9 || āgataḥ svāśramāttatra pūjāṃ pragṛhya tatpuraḥ || āsanādutthitaḥ śīghraṃ saparyādyaṃ pragṛhya ca || ekaikasya cakārātha pūjāṃ caiva pṛthakpṛthak || 3.2.9.10 || cakāra pūjāṃ vidhivatteṣāṃ tatrārkanaṃdanaḥ || āsaneṣūpaveśyātha pūjāṃ kṛtvā garīyasīm || 11 || || yama uvāca || || tīrtharūpamidaṃ kṣetraṃ prasādāddevakīsuta || tvattoṣavidhinā cādya kṛpayā ca śivasya ca || 12 || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || adya me saphalaṃ sthānaṃ kājeśānāṃ samāgamāt || 13 || || vyāsa uvāca || || evaṃ stutastadā viṣṇuḥ provāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ || tuṣṭo'smi dharma rājeṃdra ahaṃ stotreṇa te vibho || 14 || kiṃcitprārthaya matto'haṃ karomi tava vāṃchitam || yatte'styabhīpsitaṃ tubhyaṃ taddadāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || yama uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa vāṃchitaṃ kuruṣe yadi || dharmāraṇye mahāpuṇye ṛṣīṇāmāśramānkuru || 16 || vasaṃti vāḍavā yatra yajaṃti caiva yājñikāḥ || vedanirghoṣasaṃyuktaṃ bhāti tattīrthamuttamam || 17 || abrāhmaṇamidaṃ tīrthaṃ pīḍayiṣyaṃti jantavaḥ || tasmāttvaṃ vāḍavāñchaure samānaya ṛṣī nbahūn || dharmāraṇyaṃ yathā bhāti trailokye sacarācare || 18 || tato viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasraśīrṣaḥ sahasrapāt || sahasraśastadā rūpaṃ kṛtavāndharmavatsalaḥ || yasminsthāne ca ye viprāḥ sadācārāḥ śubhavratāḥ || 19 || aśeṣadharmakuśalāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || tapojñāne mahākhyātā brahmayajñaparāyaṇāḥ || sthāpitā ṛṣayaḥ sarve sahasrāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva tu || 3.2.9.20 || nānādeśātsamānīya sthāpitāstatra taiḥ suraiḥ || āśramāṃśca bahūṃstatra kājeśairapi nirmitān || 21 || dharmopadeśātkṛṣṇena brahmaṇā ca śivena ca || svesve sthāne yathāyogye sthāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 22 || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kasminvaṃśe samutpannā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || sthāpitāḥ saparīvārāḥ putrapautrasamāvṛtāḥ || śiṣyaiśca bahubhiryuktā agnihotraparāyaṇāḥ || teṣāṃ sthānāni nāmāni yathāvacca vadasva me || 23 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla dharmmāraṇyanivāsinām || 24 || mahātmanāṃ brāhmaṇānāmṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || teṣāṃ vai putrapautrāṇāṃ nāmāni ca vadāmyaham || 25 || caturviśatigotrāṇi dvijānāṃ pāṃḍavarṣabha || teṣāṃ śākhāḥ praśākhāśca putrapautrādayastathā || 26 || jajñire bahavaḥ putrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || caturviśatimukhyānāṃ nāmāni pravadāmi te || dvijānāmṛṣayaḥ proktāḥ pravarāṇi tathā śṛṇu || 27 || bhāradvājastathā vatsaḥ kauśikaḥ kuśa eva ca || śāṃḍilyaḥ kāśyapaścaiva gautamaśchāṃdhanastathā || 28 || jātūkarṇyastathā vatso vasiṣṭho dhāraṇastathā || ātreyo bhāṃḍilaścaiva laukikāśca itaḥ param || 29 || kṛṣṇāyanopamanyuśca gārgyamudgalamauṣakāḥ || puṇyāsanaḥ parāśaraḥ kauṃḍinyaśca tataḥ param || || 3.2.9.30 || tathā gānyāsanaścaiva pravarāṇi caturviṃśatiḥ || jāmadagnyasya gotrasya pravarāḥ paṃca eva hi || 31 || bhārgavaścyavanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ || paṃcaite pravarā rājanvikhyātā lokaviśrutāḥ ||32 || evaṃ gotrasamutpannā vāḍavā vedapāragāḥ || dvijapūjākriyāyuktā nānākratukriyāparāḥ || 33 || guṇena saṃhitā āsan ṣaṭkarmaniratāśca ye || evaṃvidhā mahābhāgā nānādeśabhavā dvijāḥ || 34 || bhāmevasaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca pravarāḥ paṃca eva hi || bhārgavacyāvanāpnuvānaurvajāmadagnyasaṃyutāḥ || ātreyo'rcanānasaśca śyāvāsyeti tṛtīyakaḥ || 35 || asmingotre bhavā viprā duṣṭāḥ kuṭilagāminaḥ || dhanino dharmaniṣṭhāśca vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ ||36|| dānabhogaratāḥ sarve śrautasmārteṣu saṃmatāḥ || māṃḍavyagotre vijñeyāḥ pravaraiḥ paṃcabhiryutāḥ ||37|| bhārgavaścyāvano 'triścāpnuvānaurvastathaiva ca || asmingotre bhavā viprāḥ śrutismṛtiparāyaṇāḥ || 38 || rogiṇo lobhino duṣṭā yajane yājane ratāḥ || brahmakriyā parāḥ sarve māṃḍavyāḥ kurusattama || 39 || gārgyasya gotre ye jātāsteṣāṃ tu pravarāstrayaḥ || aṃgirāścāṃbarīṣaśca yauvanāśvastṛtīyakaḥ || 3.2.9.40 || asmingotre samutpannāḥ sadvṛttāḥ satyabhāṣiṇaḥ || śāṃtāśca bhinnavarṇāśca nirddhanāśca kucailinaḥ || 41 || saṃgavātsalyayuktāśca vedaśāstreṣu niścalāḥ || vatsagotre dvijā bhūpa pravarāḥ paṃca eva hi || 42 || bhārgavaścyavanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ || ebhistu paṃca vikhyātā dvijā brahmasvarūpiṇaḥ || 43 || śāṃtā dāṃtāḥ suśīlāśca dharmaputraiḥ susaṃyutā || vedādhyayanahīnāśca kuśalāḥ sarvakarmasu || 44 || surūpāśca sadācārāḥ sarvadharmeṣu niṣṭhitāḥ|| dānadharma ratāḥ sarve annadā jaladā dvijāḥ || 45 || dayālavaḥ suśīlāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || kāśyapā brāhmaṇā rājanpravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || 46 || kāśyapaścāpavatsāro naidhruvaśca tṛtīyakaḥ || vedajñā gauravarṇāśca naiṣṭhikā yajñakārakāḥ || 47 || priyavāsā mahādakṣā gurubhaktiratāḥ sadā || pratiṣṭhāmānava ntaśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ || 48 || yajaṃte ca mahāyajñānkāśyapeyā dvijātayaḥ|| dhārīṇasagotrajāśca pravaraistribhiranvitāḥ || 49 || agastidarviśvetāśva dadhyavāhanasaṃjñakāḥ || asmingotre ca ye jātā dharmakarmasamāśritāḥ || 3.2.9.50 || karmakrūrāśca te sarve tathaivodariṇastu te || laṃbakarṇā mahādaṃṣṭrā dvijā dhanaparāyaṇāḥ || 51 || krodhino dveṣiṇaścaiva sarvasattvabhayaṃkarāḥ || laugākṣasodbhavā ye vai vāḍavāḥ satyasaṃśritāḥ || 52 || pravarāśca trayasteṣāṃ tattvajñānasvarūpakāḥ || kaśyapaścaiva vatsaśca vasiṣṭhaśca tṛtīyakaḥ || 53 || sadācārāstu vikhyātā vaiṣṇavā bahuvṛ ttayaḥ || romabhirbahubhirvyāptāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāstu vāḍavāḥ || 54 || śāṃtā dātāḥ suśīlāśca svadāraniratāḥ sadā || kuśikasagotre ye jātāḥ pravaraistribhiranvitāḥ || 55 || viśvāmitro devarāta audalaśca trayaśca ye || asmingotre tu ye jātā durbalā dīnamānasāḥ || 56 || asatyabhāṣiṇo viprāḥ surūpā nṛpasattamāḥ || sarvvavidyākuśalino brāhmaṇā brahmasattamāḥ || 57 || upamanyusagotreyāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || vasiṣṭhaśca bharadvājastviṃdrapramada eva vā || 58 || asmingotre tu ye viprāḥ krūrāḥ kuṭilagāminaḥ || dūṣaṇā dveṣiṇastucchāḥ sarvasaṃgrahatatparāḥ || 59 || kalahotpādane dakṣā dhanino māninastathā || sarvadaiva praduṣṭāśca duṣṭasaṃgaratāstathā || 3.2.9.60 || rogiṇo durbalāścaiva vṛttyupakalpavarjitāḥ || vātsyagotre bhavā viprāḥ pravaraiḥ paṃcabhiryutāḥ || 61 || bhārgavacyāvanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ || asmingotre bhavā viprāḥ sthūlāśca bahubuddhayaḥ||62|| sarvakarmaratā ścaiva sarvadharmeṣu niścalāḥ || vedaśāstrārthanipuṇā yajane yājane ratāḥ || 63 || sadācārāḥ surūpāśca buddhito dīrghadarśinaḥ || vātsyāyanasagotreyāḥ pravaraiḥ paṃcabhiryutāḥ || 64 || bhārgavacyāvanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ || pūrvoktāḥ pravarāścāsya kathitāstava bhārata || 65 || asmingotre tu ye jātā pākayajñaratāḥ sadā || lobhinaḥ krodhinaścaiva prajāyante bahuprajāḥ || 66 || snānadānādiniratāḥ sarvadāśca jiteṃdriyāḥ || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ kartāraśca sahasraśaḥ || vrataśīlā guṇajñāśca mūrkhā vedavivarjitāḥ || 67 || kauśikavaṃśe ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || viśvāmitro'gharmaṣī ca kauśikaśca tṛtīyakaḥ || 68 || asmingotre ca ye jātā brāhmaṇā brahmavedinaḥ|| śāṃtā dāṃtāḥ suśīlāśca sarvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 69 || aputriṇa stathā rūkṣāstejohīnā dvijottamāḥ || bhāradvājasagotreyāḥ pravaraiḥ paṃcabhiryutāḥ || 3.2.9.70 || aṃgiraso bārhaspatyo bhāradvājastu sainyasaḥ || gārgyaścai veti vijñeyāḥ pravarāḥ paṃca eva ca || 71 || asmingotre ca ye jātā vāḍavā dhaninaḥ śubhāḥ || vastrālaṃkaraṇopetā dvijabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 72 || brahmabhojyaparāḥ sarve sarvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || kāśyapagotre yai jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || 73 || kāśyapaścāpavatsāro raibhyeti viśrutāstrayaḥ || asmingotre bhavā viprā raktākṣāḥ krūradṛṣṭayaḥ || 74 || jihvālaulyaratāḥ sarve sarve te pāramārthinaḥ || nirdhanā rogiṇaścaite taskarānṛtabhāṣiṇaḥ || 75 || śāstrārthāvedinaḥ sarve vedasmṛtivivarjitāḥ || śunakeṣu ca ye jātā viprā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 76 || tapasvino yoginaśca vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || sādhavaśca sadācārā viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 77 || hrasvakāyā bhinnavarṇā bahurāmā dvijottamāḥ || dayālāḥ saralāḥ śāṃtā brahmabhojyaparāyaṇāḥ || || 78 || śaunakaseṣu ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || bhārgavaśaunahotreti gārtsyapramada iti trayaḥ || 79 || asmindeśe samutpannā vāḍavā duḥsahā nṛpa || mahotkaṭā mahākāyāḥ pralaṃbāśca madoddhatāḥ || 3.2.9.80 || kleśarūpāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || bahubhujo mānino dakṣā rāga dveṣopavarjitāḥ || 81 || suvastrabhūṣārūpā vai brāhmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ || vasiṣṭhagotre ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || 82 || vasiṣṭho bhāradvājaśca indrapramada eva ca || asmingotre bhavā viprā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || 83 || yājñikā yajñaśīlāśca susvarāḥ sukhinastathā || dveṣiṇo dhanavaṃtaśca putriṇo guṇinastathā || 84 || viśālahṛdayā rājañchūrāḥ śatrunibarhaṇāḥ || gautamasagotre ye jātāḥ pravarāḥ paṃca eva hi || 85 || kautsagārgyomavāhāśca asito devalastathā || asmingotre ca ye jātā viprāḥ paramapāvanāḥ || 86 || paropakāriṇaḥ sarve śrutismṛti parāyaṇāḥ || bakāsanāśca kuṭilāśchadmavṛttiparāstathā || 87 || nānāśāstrārthanipuṇā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || vṛkṣādikarmakuśalā dīrgharoṣāśca rogiṇaḥ || 88 || āṃgirasagotre ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || āṃgirasoṃbarīṣaśca yauvanāśvastṛtīyakaḥ || 89 || asmingotre ca ye jātāḥ satya saṃbhāṣiṇastathā || jiteṃdriyāḥ surūpāśca alpāhārāḥ śubhānanāḥ || 3.2.9.90 || mahāvratāḥ purāṇajñā mahādānaparāyaṇāḥ || nirdveṣiṇo lobhayutā vedādhya yanatatparāḥ || 91 || dīrghadarśimahātejo mahāmāyāvimohitāḥ || śāṃḍilasagotreye pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ || 92 || asito devalaścaiva śāṃḍilastu tṛtīyakaḥ || asmingotre mahābhāgāḥ kubjāśca dvijasattamāḥ || 93 || netrarogī mahāduṣṭā mahātyāgā anāyuṣaḥ || kalahotpādane dakṣāḥ sarvasaṃgraha tatparāḥ ||94|| malinā māninaścaiva jyotiḥśāstraviśāradāḥ || ātreyasagotre ye jātāḥ paṃcapravarasaṃyutāḥ || 95 || ātreyo'rcanānasaśyāvāśvoṃgira so'triśca || asminvaṃśe ca ye jātā dvijāste sūryavarcasaḥ || 96 || caṃdravacchītalāḥ sarve dharmāraṇye vyavasthitāḥ || sadācārā mahādakṣāḥ śrutiśāstra parāyaṇāḥ || 97 || yājñikāśca śubhācārāḥ satyaśaucaparāyaṇāḥ || dharmajñā dānaśīlāśca nirmalāśca mahotsukāḥ || 98 || tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā nyāyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 99 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kathayasva mahābāho dharmāraṇyakathāmṛtam || yacchrutvā mucyate pāpādghorādbrahmavadhādapi || || 3.2.9.100 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ sudurlabhām || 101 || yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādyā udvejayaṃti vāḍavān || jṛṃbhakonāma yakṣo'bhūddharmmāraṇyasamīpataḥ || 102 || udvejayati nityaṃ sa dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || tatastaiśca dvijāgryaistu devebhyo viniveditam || 103 || yakṣarakṣādinā caiva paribhūtā vayaṃ surāḥ || tyakṣyāmo'dya varaṃ sthānaṃ tadbhayānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 104 || tato devaiḥ saṃgadharvaiḥ sthāpitāstatra bhūmiṣu || siddhāśca varayoginyaḥ śrīmātṛprabhṛtayastathā || 105 || rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || gotrānprati tathaikaikā sthāpitā yoginī tadā || 106 || yasya gotrasya yā śaktī rakṣaṇe pālane kṣamā || sā tasya kuladevīti sākṣāttatra babhūva ha || 107 || śrīmātā tāraṇī devī āśāpūrī ca gotrapā || icchā''rtināśinī caiva pippalī vikāravaśā ||108|| jaganmātā mahāmātā siddhā bhaṭṭārikā tathā || kadaṃbā vikarā mīṭhā suparṇā vasujā tathā ||109|| mātaṃgī ca mahādevī vāṇī ca mukuṭeśvarī || bhadrī caiva mahāśaktiḥ saṃhārī ca mahābalā||3.2.9.110|| cāmuṃḍā ca mahādevī ityetā gotramātaraḥ || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ sthāpitāstatra rakṣaṇe ||111|| tāḥ pūjayaṃti vipreṃdrāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sadā || tataḥ prabhṛti yoginyaḥ svesve kāle surakṣitāḥ ||112|| vāḍavāḥ svasthatāṃ jagmuḥ putrapautraiḥ samāvṛtāḥ || tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvā harṣanirbharamānasāḥ || vimānavaramārūḍhā jagmurnāke'mṛtāśanāḥ || 113 || gate varṣaśate rājanbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || smṛtvā tu dharmāraṇyasya prekṣaṇārthaṃ kutūhalāt ||114|| samājagmustadā rājanprabhāte udite ravau || vimānavaramāruhya apsarogaṇasevitāḥ ||115|| gaṃdharvair gīyamānāste stūyamānāḥ prabodhakaiḥ || tatra sthāne dvijā rājansamitpuṣpakuśānbahūn ||116|| āśramāṃstānparityajya gatāḥ sarve diśo daśa || tamāśramapadaṃ dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ caiva maheśvaraḥ||117|| uvāca vākyaṃ dharmajño vāḍavānkliśate vibho || śuśūṣārthaṃ hi śuśrūṣankalpayediti me matiḥ ||118|| śrutvā tu vacanaṃ śaṃbhordevadevo janārdanaḥ || satyaṃsatyamiti procya brahmāṇamidamabravīt || 119 || bhobho brahmandvijātīnāṃ śuśrūṣārthaṃ prakalpaya || sṛṣṭirhi śāśvatīvādya dvijoghopi sukhī bhavet || viṣṇorvākyamabhiśrutya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ||3.2.9.120|| saṃsmarankāmadhenuṃ vai smaraṇenaiva tatkṣaṇe|| āgatā tatra sā dhenurdharmāraṇye pavitrake || 121 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvārdhe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye gotrapravaragotradevīkathanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9|| |||cha|| ||
<3.2.10>
vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttaṃ dharmmāraṇye śubhaṃ matam || yadidaṃ kathayiṣyāmi aśeṣāghaughanāśanam |||1 || ajeśena tadā rājanpreritena svayaṃbhuvā || kāmadhenuḥ samāhūtā kathayāmāsa tāṃ prati || 2 || viprebhyo'nucarāndehi ekaikasmai dvijātaye || dvau dvau śuddhātmakau caivaṃ dehi mātaḥ prasīda me || 3 || tathetyuktvā mahādhenuḥ kṣīreṇollekhayaddharām || huṃkārāttasya niṣkrāṃtāḥ śikhāsūtradharā narāḥ || 4 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi vaṇijaśca mahābalāḥ || sopavītā mahādakṣāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 5 || dvijabhaktisamāyuktā brahmaṇyāste taponvitāḥ || purāṇajñāḥ sadācārā dhārmikā bahmabhojakāḥ || 6 || svarge devāḥ praśaṃsaṃti dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || tapo'dhyayanadāneṣu sarvakālepyatīṃdriyāḥ || 7 || ekaikasmai dvijāyaiva dattaṃ jātu caradvayam || vāḍavasya ca yadgotraṃ purā proktaṃ mahīpate || 8 || parasparaṃ ca tadgotraṃ tasya cānucarasya ca || iti kṛtvā vyavasthāṃ ca nyavasaṃstatra bhūmiṣu ||9|| tataśca śiṣyatā devairdattā cānucarānbhuvi || brahmaṇā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ teṣāmanuhitāya vai ||3.2.10.10|| kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ caiṣāṃ dadadhvaṃ ca yadicchitam || samitpuṣpakuśādīni ānayadhvaṃ dinedine || 11 || anujñayaiṣāṃ vartadhvaṃ māvajñāṃ kuruta kvacit || jātakaṃ nāmakaraṇaṃ tathānnaprāśanaṃ śubham || 12 || kṣauraṃ caivopanayanaṃ mahānāmnyādikaṃ tathā || kriyākarmādikaṃ yacca vrataṃ dānopavāsakam || 13 || anujñayaiṣāṃ kartavyaṃ kājeśā idamabuvan || anujñayā vinaiṣāṃ yaḥ kāryamārabhate yadi || 14 || darśaṃ vā śrāddhakāryaṃ vā śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || dāridryaṃ putraśokaṃ ca kīrtināśaṃ tathaiva ca || 15 || rogairnipīḍyate nityaṃ na kvacitsukhamāpnuyuḥ || tatheti ca tato devāḥ śakrādyāḥ surasattamāḥ || 16 || stutiṃ kurvaṃti te sarve kāma dhenoḥ puraḥ sthitāḥ || kṛtakṛtyāstadā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 17 || tvaṃ mātā sarvadevānāṃ tvaṃ ca yajñasya kāraṇam || tvaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ nama ste'stu sadānaghe || 18 || śaśisūryāruṇā yasyā lalāṭe vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || sarasvatī ca huṃkāre sarve nāgāśca kaṃbale || 19 || kṣurapṛṣṭhe ca gandharvā vedāścatvāra eva ca || mukhāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 3.2.10.20 || evaṃvidhaiśca bahuśo vacanaistoṣitā ca sā || suprasannā tadā dhenuḥ kiṃ karomīti cābravīt || 21 || || devā ūcuḥ || || sṛṣṭāḥ sarve tvayā mātardevyaite'nucarāḥ śubhāḥ || tvatprasādānmahābhāge brāhmaṇāḥ sukhino' bhavan || 22 || tato'sau surabhī rājangatā nākaṃ yaśasvinī || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstatraivāṃtaradhustataḥ || 23 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || abhāryāste mahātejā gojā anucarāstathā || udvāhitā kathaṃ brahmantsutāsteṣāṃ kadā'bhavan || 24 || || vyāsa uvāca || || parigrahārthaṃ ve teṣāṃ rudreṇa ca yamena ca || gandharvakanyā āhṛtya dārāstatropakalpitāḥ || 25 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || ko vā gandharvarājāsau kiṃnāmā kutra vā sthitaḥ || kiyanmātrāstasya kanyāḥ kimācārā bravīhi me || 26 || || vyāsa uvāca || || viśvāvasuriti khyāto gandharvādhipatirnṛpa || ṣaṣṭikanyāsahasrāṇi āsate tasya veśmani || 27 || aṃtarikṣe gṛhaṃ tasya gadharvanagaraṃ śubham || yauvanasthāḥ surūpāśca kanyā gandharvajāḥ śubhāḥ || 28 || rudrasyānucarau rājannaṃdī bhṛṃgī śubhānanau || pūrvadṛṣṭāśca tāḥ kanyāḥ kathayāmāsatuḥ śivam|| 29 || dṛṣṭāḥ purā mahādeva gandharvanagare vibho || viśvāvasugṛhe kanyā asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 3.2.10.30 || tā ānīya valādeva gobhujebhyaḥ prayaccha bho || evaṃ śrutvā tato devastripuraghnaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 31 || preṣayāmāsa dūtaṃ tu vijayaṃ nāma bhārata || sa tatra gatvā yatrāste viśvāvasurariṃdamaḥ || 32 || uvāca vacanaṃ caiva pathyaṃ caiva śiveritam || dharmāraṇye mahābhāga kājeśena vinirmitāḥ || 33 || sthāpitā vāḍavāstatra vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || teṣāṃ vai paricaryārthaṃ kāmadhenuśca prārthitā || 34 || tayā kṛtāḥ śubhācārā vaṇijaste tvayonijā || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi kumārāste mahābalāḥ || 35 || śivena preṣito'haṃ vai tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ || kanyārthaṃ hi mahābhāga dehidehītyuvāca ha || 36 || || gandharva uvāca || || devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mahāmate || parityajya kathaṃ loke mānuṣāṇāṃ dadāmi vai || 37 || śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya nivṛtto vijayastadā || kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ gandharva caritaṃ mahat ||38 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo bhagavām̐llokaśaṃkaraḥ || vṛṣabhe ca samārūḍhaḥ śūlahastaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 39 || bhūtapretapiśācādyaiḥ sahasrairāvṛtaḥ prabhuḥ || tato devāstathā nāgā bhūtavetālakhecarāḥ || 3.2.10.40 || krodhena mahatāviṣṭāḥ samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || hāhākāro mahānāsīttasminsainye visarpati || 41 || prakaṃpitā dharādevī diśāpālā bhayāturāḥ || ghorā vātāstadā'śāṃtāḥ śabdaṃ kurvaṃti diggajāḥ || || 42 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tadāgataṃ mahāsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayavilolitam || gandharvanagarātsarve vineśuste diśo daśa || 43 || gandharvarājo nagaraṃ tyaktvā meruṃ gato nṛpa || tāḥ kanyā yauvanopetā rūpaudāryasamanvitāḥ || 44 || gṛhītvā pradadau sarvā vaṇigbhyaśca tadā nṛpa || vedoktena vidhānena tathā vai devasannidhau || 45 || ājyabhāgaṃ tadā dattvā gandharvāya gavātmajāḥ || devānāṃ pūrvajānāṃ ca sūryācaṃdramasostathā || 46 || yamāya mṛtyave caiva ājyabhāgaṃ tadā daduḥ || dattvājyabhāgānvidhivadvavrire te śubhavratāḥ || 47 || tataḥ prabhṛti gāndharvavivāhe samupasthite || ājyabhāgaṃ pragṛhṇanti adyāpi sarvato bhṛśam || 48 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi kumārā yannyavedayan || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || ata eva hi tāḥ sarvā dāsatve hi vinirmitāḥ ||3 kṣatriyāśca mahāvīrā kiṃkaratve hi nirmitāḥ || 3.2.10.50 || tato devā'stadā rājañjagmuḥ sarve yathātathā|| gate deve dvijāḥ sarve sthāne'sminnivasaṃti te||51|| putrapautrayutā rājannivasaṃtyakutobhayāḥ|| paṭhaṃti vedānvedajñāḥ kvacicchāstrārthamudgiran||52|| kecidviṣṇuṃ japaṃtīha śivaṃ kecijjapaṃti hi|| brahmāṇaṃ ca japaṃtyeke yamasūktaṃ hi kecana|| yajaṃti yājakāścaiva agnihotramupāsate || svāhākārasvadhākāravaṣaṭkāraiśca suvrata || 54 || śabdairāpūyate sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || vaṇijaśca mahādakṣā dvijaśuśrūṇotsukāḥ || 55 || dharmāraṇye śubhe divye te vasaṃti suniṣṭhitāḥ || annapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ samitkuśaphalādikam || 56 || āpūrayandvijātīnāṃ vaṇijaste gavātmajāḥ || 57 || puṣpopahāranicayaṃ snānavastrādidhāvanam || upalādikanirmāṇaṃ mārjanādiśubhakriyāḥ || 58 || vaṇikstriyaḥ prakurvaṃti kaṃḍanaṃ peṣaṇādikam || śuśrūṣaṃti ca tānviprānkājeśavacanena hi || 59 || svasthā jātāstadā sarve dvijā harṣaparāyaṇāḥ || kājeśādīnupāsaṃte divārātrau hi saṃdhyayoḥ || 3.2.10.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāra ṇyamāhātmye vaṇikparigrahavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<3.2.11>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ kimabhavadbravītu dvijasattama || tvadvacanāmṛtaṃ pītvā tṛptirnāsti mama prabho || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || atha kiṃcidgate kāle yugāṃtasamaye sati || tretādau lolajihvākṣa abhavadrākṣaseśvaraḥ || 2 || tena vidrāvitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || jitvā sa sakalām̐llokāndharmāraṇye samāgataḥ || 3 || taddṛṣṭvā sakalaṃ puṇyaṃ ramyaṃ dvijaniṣe vitam || brahmadveṣācca tenaiva dāhitaṃ ca puraṃ śubham || 4 || dahyamānaṃ puraṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇaṣṭā dvijasattamāḥ || yathāgataṃ prajagmuste dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || ||5 || śrīmātādyāstadā devyaḥ kopitā rākṣasena vai || ghātayaṃtyeva śabdena tarjayitvā ca rākṣasam || 6 || samucchritāstadā devyaḥ śataśo'tha saha sraśaḥ || triśūlavaradhāriṇyaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharāḥ ||7|| kamaṃḍaludharāḥ kāścitkaśākhaṅgadharāḥ parāḥ || pāśāṃkuśadharā kācitkhaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī || 8 || kācitparaśuhastā ca divyāyudhadharā parā || nānābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā nānāratnābhiśobhitā || 9 || rākṣasānāṃ vināśāya brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca || ājagmustatra yatrāste lolajihvo hi rākṣasaḥ ||3.2.11.10|| mahādaṃṣṭro mahākāyo vidyujjihvo bhayaṃkaraḥ || dṛṣṭvā tā rākṣaso ghoraṃ siṃhanādamathākarot ||11|| tena nādena mahatā trāsitaṃ bhuvanatrayam || āpūritā diśaḥ sarvāḥ kṣubhitānekasāgarāḥ || 12 || kolāhalo mahānāsīddharmāraṇye tadā nṛpa || tacchrutvā vāsavenātha preṣito nalakūbaraḥ || 13 || kimidaṃ paśya gatvā tvaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahyaṃ nivedaya || tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gato vai nalakūbaraḥ || 14 || dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāyuddhaṃ śrīmātālolajihvayoḥ || yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathājātaṃ śakrāgre sa nyavedayat || 15 || udvejayati lokāṃstrīndharmāraṇyamito gataḥ || tacchrutvā vāsavo viṣṇuṃ nivedya kṣitimāgamat|| 16 || dāhitaṃ tatpuraṃ ramyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham || na dṛṣṭā vāḍavāstatra gatāḥ sarve diśo daśa || 17 || śrīmātā yoginī tatra kurute yuddhamuttamam || hāhābhūtā prajā sarvā itaścetaśca dhāvati || 18 || tacchrutvā vāsudevo hi gṛhītvā ca sudarśanam || satyalokāttadā rājansamāgacchanmahītale || 19 || dharmāraṇyaṃ tato gatvā taccakraṃ pramumoca ha || lolajihvastadā rakṣo mūrcchito nipapāta ha || 3.2.11.20 || triśūlena tato bhinnaḥ śaktibhiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || hanyamānastadā rakṣaḥ prāṇāṃstyaktvā divaṃ gataḥ || 21 || tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvā harṣanirbharamānasāḥ || tuṣṭuvustaṃ jagannāthaṃ satyalokātsamāgatāḥ || 22 || udvasaṃ tatsamālokya viṣṇurvacanamabravīt || kva ca te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve ṛṣīṇāmāśrame punaḥ || 23 || tato devāḥ sagaṃ dharvā itastataḥ palāyitān|| saṃśodhya tarasā rājanbrāhmaṇānidamabruvan || 24 || śrūyatāṃ no vaco viprā nihato rākṣasādhamaḥ || vāsudevena devena cakreṇa nirakṛṃtata || 25 || tacchrutvā vāḍavāḥ sarve praharṣotphullalocanāḥ || samājagmustadā rājansvasvasthāne samāviśan || 26 || śrīkāṃtāya tadā rājanvākyamuktaṃ manoramam || yasmāttvaṃ satyalokācca āgato'si jagatprabhuḥ || sthāpitaṃ ca puraṃ cedaṃ hitāya ca dvijātmanām || 27 || satyamaṃdiramiti khyātaṃ tadā loke bhaviṣyati || kṛte yuge dharmāraṇyaṃ tretāyāṃ satyamaṃdiram || 28 || tacchrutvā vāsudevena tatheti pratipadya ca || tataste vāḍavāḥ sarve putrapautrasamanvitāḥ || 29 || sapatnīkāḥ sānucarā yathāpūrvaṃ nyavātsiṣuḥ || tapoyajñakriyādyeṣu vartaṃte'dhyayanādiṣu || 3.2.11.30 || evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ dharma vai satyamaṃdire || 31 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye lolajihvāsuravadhapūrvakaṃ satyamaṃdirasaṃsthāpanavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<3.2.12>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || tato devairnṛpaśreṣṭha rakṣārthaṃ satyamaṃdiram || sthāpitaṃ tattadādyaiva satyābhikhyā hi sā purī || 1 || pūrvaṃ dharmeśvaro devo dakṣiṇena gaṇādhipaḥ || paścime sthāpito bhānuruttare ca svayaṃbhuvaḥ || 2 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || gaṇeśaḥ sthāpitaḥ kena kasmātsthāpitavānasau || kiṃ nāmāsau mahābhāga tanme kathaya mā ciram || 3 || || vyāsa uvāca || || adhunāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi gaṇeśotpattikāraṇam || 4 || samaye militāḥ sarve devatā mātarastathā || dharmāraṇye mahārāja sthāpitaścaṃḍikāsutaḥ || 5 || ādau devairnṛpaśreṣṭha bhūmau vai satyayoṣitām || prākāraścābhavattatra patākādhvajaśobhitaḥ || 6 || brāhmaṇāyatane tatra prākāramaṇḍalāntare || tanmadhye racitaṃ pīṭhamiṣṭakābhiḥ suśobhitam || 7 || pratolyaśca catasro vai śuddhā eva satoraṇāḥ || pūrve dharmeśvaro devo dakṣiṇe gaṇanāyakaḥ || 8 || paścime sthāpito bhānuruttare ca svayaṃbhuvaḥ || dharmeśvarotpattivṛttamākhyātaṃ tattavāgrataḥ || 9 || adhunāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi gaṇeśotpattihetukam || kadācitpārvatī gātrodvarttanaṃ kṛtavatyabhūt || 3.2.12.10 || malaṃ tajjanitaṃ dṛṣṭvā haste dhṛtvā svagātrajam || pratimāṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā surūpaṃ ca dadarśa ha || 11 || jīvaṃ tasyāṃ ca saṃcārya udatiṣṭhattadagrataḥ || mātaraṃ sa tadovāca ki karomi tavājñayā || 12 || || pārvatyuvāca || || yāvatsnānaṃ kariṣyāmi tāvattvaṃ dvāri tiṣṭha me || āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi paraśvādīni yāni tu || 13 || tvayi tiṣṭhati maddvāre ko'pi vighnaṃ karotu na || evamukto mahādevyā dvāre'tiṣṭhatsa sāyudhaḥ || 14 || etasminnaṃtare devo mahādevo jagāma ha || ābhyaṃtare praveṣṭuṃ ca matiṃ dadhre maheśvaraḥ || 19 || dvārasthena gaṇeśena praveśodāyi tasya na || tataḥ kruddho mahādevaḥ parasparamayudhyata || 16 || yuddhaṃ kṛtvā tataścobhau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau || paraśuṃ jaghnivāndeva lalāṭe parame śubham || 17 || tato devo mahādevaḥ śūlamudyamya cāhanat || śiraściccheda śūlena tadbhūmau nipapāta ha || 18 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ putraṃ pārvatī praruroda ha || hāhākāro mahānāsīttadā tatra nipātite || 19 || pārvatīṃ vikalāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || ciṃtayāmāsa devo'pi kiṃ kṛtaṃ vā mudhā mayā || 3.2.12.20 || etasminnaṃtare tatra gajāsuramapaśyata || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mahādaityaṃ sarvalokaikapūjitaḥ || 21 || jaghnivāṃstacchiro gṛhya pārvatyā kṛtamarbhakam || uttasthau sagaṇastatra mahādevasya sannidhau|| 22 || tato nāma cakārāsya gajānana iti sphuṭam || surāḥ sarve ca saṃpṛktā harṣitā munayastathā || 23 || stuvaṃti stutibhiḥ śaśvatkuṭumbakuśalaṃkaram || vikrīṇāti kuṭumbaṃ yo modakārthaṃ samarcake || 24 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ pratolyāṃ tamekadaṃtaṃ ca pīvaram || ārcayacca mahādevaṃ svayaṃbhūḥ surapūjitam || 25 || jaṭilaṃ vāmanaṃ caiva nāgayajñopavītakam || tryakṣaṃ caiva mahākāyaṃ karadhvajakuṭhārakam || 26 || dadhānaṃ kamalaṃ haste sarvavipravināśanam || rakṣaṇāya ca lokānāṃ nagarāddakṣiṇāśritam||27|| suprasannaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ siddhibuddhinamaskṛtam || siṃdūrābhaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ tīvrāṃkuśadharaṃ śubham || 28 || śatapuṣpaiḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpairarcitaṃ hyamarādhipaḥ || praṇamya ca mahābhaktyā tuṣṭuvu staṃ surāstataḥ || 29 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namastestu sureśāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ || gajānana namastubhyaṃ mahādevādhidaivata || 3.2.12.30 || bhaktipriyāya devāya gaṇādhyakṣa namostu te || ityetaiśca śubhaiḥ stotraiḥ stūyamāno gaṇādhipaḥ || suprītaśca gaṇādhyakṣaḥ tadā'sau vākyamabravīt || || 31 || || gaṇādhyakṣa uvāca || tuṣṭo'haṃ vo surā brūta vāṃchitaṃ ca dadāmi vaḥ || 32 || || devā ūcuḥ || || tvamatrastho mahābhāga kuru kāryaṃ ca naḥ prabho || dharmāraṇye ca viprāṇāṃ vaṇigjananivāsinām || 33 || brahmacaryādiyuktānāṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ gaṇeśvara || varṇāśrametarāṇāṃ ca rakṣitā bhava sarvadā ||| 34 || tvatprasādānmahābhāga dhanasaukhyayutā dvijāḥ || bhavaṃtu sarve satataṃ vaṇijaśca mahābalāḥ ||35|| rakṣitavyāstvayā deva yāvaccaṃdrārkamedinī || evamastviti sovādīdgaṇanātho maheśvaraḥ || 36 || devāśca harṣamāpannāḥ pūjayaṃti gaṇādhipam || tato devā mudā yuktāḥ puṣpadhūpāditarpaṇaiḥ || 37 || ye cānye manujā loke nirvighnārthaṃ ca pūjayan || 38 || vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pūrvamārādhito bhavet || dharmāraṇyodbhavānāṃ ca prasanno bhava sarvadā || || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge gaṇeśaprasthāpanāvarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || ||
<3.2.13>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || śaṃbhośca paścime bhāge sthāpitaḥ kaśyapātmajaḥ || tatrāsti tanmahābhāga ravikṣetraṃ taducyate || 1 || tatrotpannau mahādivyau rūpayauvanasaṃyutau || nāsatyāvaśvinau devau vikhyātau gadanāśanau || 2 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || pitāmaha mahābhāga kathayasva prasādataḥ || utpattiraśvinoścaiva mṛtyuloke ca tatkatham || 3 || ravilokātkathaṃ sūryo dharāyāmavatāritaḥ || etatsarvaṃ prayatnena kathayasva prasādataḥ || 4 || yacchrutvā hi mahābhāga sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 5 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhūpa ūrdhvalokakathānakam || yacchrutvā naraśārdūla sarvarogātpramucyate || viśvakarmmasutā saṃjñā aṃśumadraviṇā vṛtā || 6 || sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadā saṃjñā svākṣisaṃyamanaṃ vyadhāt || yatastataḥ saroṣo'rkaḥ saṃjñāṃ vacanamabravīt || 97 || || sūrya uvāca || || mayi dṛṣṭe sadā yasmātkuruṣe svākṣisaṃyamam || tasmājjaniṣyate mūḍhe prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ || || 8 || tataḥ sā capalaṃ devī dadarśa ca bhayākulam || vilolitadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarāha ca tāṃ raviḥ || 9 || yasmādvilolitā dṛṣṭirmayi dṛṣṭe tvayā dhunā || tasmādvilolitāṃ saṃjñe tanayāṃ prasaviṣyasi || 3.2.13.10 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tatastasyāstu saṃjajñe bhartṛśāpena tena vai || yamaśca yamunā yeyaṃ vikhyātā sumahānadī || 11 || sā ca saṃjñā ravestejo mahadduḥkhena bhāminī || asahaṃtīva sā citte ciṃtayāmāsa vai tadā || 12 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva gatāyāśca nirvṛtiḥ || bhavenmama kathaṃ bhartuḥ kopamarkasya naśyati ||13|| iti saṃciṃtya bahudhā prajāpatisutā tadā || sādhu mene mahābhāgā pitṛsaṃśrayamāpasā ||14|| tataḥ pitṛgṛhaṃ gaṃtuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī || chāyāmāhūyātmanastu sā devī dayitā raveḥ ||15|| tāṃ covāca tvayā stheyamatra bhānoryathā mayā || tathā samyagapatyeṣu vartitavyaṃ tathā ravau ||16|| duṣṭamapi na vācyaṃ te yathā bahumataṃ mama || saivāsmi saṃjñāhamiti
