vācyamevaṃ tvayānaghe || 17 || || chāyāsaṃjñovāca || || ākeśagrahaṇāccāhamāśāpācca vacastathā || kariṣye kathayiṣyāmi yāvatkeśāpakarṣaṇāt || 18 || ityuktā sā tadā devī jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ || dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasā dhūtakilbiṣam || 19 || bahumānācca tenāpi pūjitā viśva karmmaṇā || tatsthau pitṛgṛhe sā tu kiṃcitkālamaniṃditā || 3.2.13.20 || tataḥ prāha sa dharmajñaḥ pitā nāticiroṣitām || viśvakarmā sutāṃ premṇā bahumā napurassaram || 21 || tvāṃ tu me paśyato vatse dināni subahūnyapi || muhūrtena samāni syuḥ kiṃtu dharmo vilupyate || 22 || bāṃdhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso na nārīṇāṃ yaśaskaraḥ || manoratho bāṃdhavānāṃ bhāryā pitṛgṛhe sthitā || 23 || sa tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃgatā || piturgṛhe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike || 24 || ato bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo'haṃ pūjitā ca me || punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śubhekṣaṇe ||25 || || vyāsa uvāca || || ityuktā sā tadā kṣipraṃ tathetyuktā ca vai mune || pūjayitvā tu pitaraṃ sā jagāmottarānkurūn || 26 || sūryatāpamanicchatī tejasastasya bibhyatī || tapaścacāra tatrāpi vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī || 27 || saṃjñāmityeva manvāno dvitīyāyāṃ divaspatiḥ || janayāmāsa tanayau kanyāṃ caikāṃ manoramām || 28 || chāyā svatanayeṣveva yathā preṣṇādhyavartata || tathā na saṃjñākanyāyāṃ putrayoścāpyavartata || lālanāsu ca bhojyeṣu viśeṣamanuvāsaram || 29 || manustatkṣāṃtavānasyā yamastasyā na cākṣamat || tāḍanāya tataḥ kopātpādastena samudyataḥ || tasyāḥ punaḥ kṣāṃtamanā na tu dehe nyapātayat || 3.2.13.30 || tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ kopācchāyāsaṃjñā yamaṃ nṛpa || kiṃcitprasphuramāṇoṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā || 31 || patnyāṃ piturmayi yadi pādamudyacchase balāt || bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva bhaviṣyati || 32 || ityākarṇya yamaḥ śāpaṃ mātaryativiśaṃkitaḥ || abhyetya pitaraṃ prāha praṇipātapurassaram|| 33 || tātaitanmahadāścaryamadṛṣṭamiti ca kvacit || mātā vātsalyarūpeṇa śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ||34|| yathā mātā mamācaṣṭa neyaṃ mātā tathā mama || nirguṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirguṇā bhavet || 35 || yamasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavāṃstimirāpahaḥ || chāyāsaṃjñāmathāhūya papraccha kvagateti ca ||36|| sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso || patnī tava tvayāpatyānyetāni janitāni me || 37 || itthaṃ vivasvatastāṃ tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato yadā || nācacakṣe tadā kruddho bhāsvāṃstāṃ śaptumudyataḥ || 38 || tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ vivasvate || viditārthaśca bhagavāñjagāma tvaṣṭu rālayam || 39 || tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa tvaṣṭā trailokyapūjitam || bhāsvankiṃ rahitā śaktyā nijagehamupāgataḥ || 3.2.13.40 || saṃjñāṃ papraccha taṃ tasmai kathayāmāsa tattvavit || āgatā seha me veśma bhavataḥ preṣitā rave || 41 || divākaraḥ samādhistho vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm || tapaścaraṃtīṃ dadṛśe uttareṣu kuruṣvatha || 42 || asahyamānā sūryasya tejastenātipīḍitā || vahnyābhanijarūpaṃ tu cchāyārūpaṃ vimucya ca|| 43 || dharmāraṇye samāgatya tapa stepe suduṣkaram|| chāyāputraṃ śaniṃ dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ cānyaṃ ca bhūpate || 44 || tadaiva vismitaḥ sūryo duṣṭaputrau samīkṣya ca || jñātuṃ dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā viditvā tacca kāraṇam || 45 || ghṛṇyauṣṇyāddagdhadehā sā tapastepe pativratā || yena māṃ tejasā sahyaṃ draṣṭuṃ naiva śaśāka ha || 46 || pañcāśaddhāyanetīte gatvā kau tapa ācarat || pradyotano vicāryaivaṃ gatvā śīghraṃ manojavaḥ || 47 || dharmāraṇye vare puṇye yatra saṃjñāsthitā tapaḥ || āgataṃ taṃ raviṃ dṛṣṭvā vaḍavā samajāyata || 48 || sūryapatnī sadā saṃjñā sūryaścāśvastato'bhavat || tābhyāṃ sahābhūtsaṃyogo trāṇe liṃgaṃ niveśya ca || 49 || tadā tau ca samutpannau yugalāvaśvinau bhuvi || prādurbhūtaṃ jalaṃ tatra dakṣiṇena khureṇa ca || 3.2.13.50 || vidalite bhūmibhāge tatra kuṃḍaṃ samudbabhau || dvitīyaṃ tu punaḥ kuṃḍaṃ paścārdhacaraṇodbhavam || 51 || uttaravāhinyāḥ kāśyā kurukṣetrādi vai tathā || gaṃgāpurīsamaphalaṃ kuṇḍe'tra muninoditam || 52 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti taptakuṇḍe na saṃśayaḥ || snānaṃ vidhāya tatraiva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 53 || na punarjāyate dehaḥ kuṣṭhādivyādhipīḍitaḥ || etatte kathitaṃ bhūpa dasrāṃśotpattikāraṇam || 54 || tadā brahmādayo devā āgatāstatra bhūpate || dattvā saṃjñāvaraṃ śubhraṃ ciṃtitādadhikaṃ hi taiḥ || 55 || sthāpayitvā raviṃ tatra bakulākhyavanādhipam || ānarcuste tadā saṃjñāṃ pūrvarūpā'bhavattadā || 56 || sthāpitā tatra rājñī ca kumārau yugalau tadā || etattīrthaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu rājanmahāmate || 57 || ādisthānaṃ kuruśreṣṭha devairapi sudurlabham || ravikuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā śraddhāyukto jiteṃdriyaḥ || 58 || tārayetsa pitṝnsarvānmahānarakagānapi || śraddhayā yaḥ pibettoyaṃ saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || 59 || svalpaṃ vāpi bahuvāpi sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa grahaṇaṃ caṃdrasūryayoḥ || 3.2.13.60 || ravikuṇḍe ca ye snātāḥ na te vai garbhagāminaḥ || sakrāṃtau ca vyatīpāte vaidhṛteṣu ca parvasu || 61 || pūrṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ caturddaśyāṃ sitāsite || ravikuṃḍe ca yaḥ snātaḥ kratukoṭiphalaṃ labhet || 62 || pūjayedbakulārkaṃ ca ekacittena mānavaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma sa yāvattapate raviḥ || 63 || tasya lakṣmīḥ sthirā nūnaṃ labhate saṃtatiṃ sukham || arivargaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti prasādācca divaspateḥ || 64 || nāgnerbhayaṃ hi tasya syānna vyāghrānna ca daṃtinaḥ || na ca sarppabhayaṃ kvāpi bhūtapretādibhīrnahi || 65 || bālagrahāśca sarve'pi revatī vṛddharevatī || te sarve nāśamāyāṃti bakulārka namostu te || 66 || gāvastasya vivarddhaṃte dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathaiva ca || avicchedo bhavedvaṃśo bakulārke namaskṛte || 67 || kākavandhyā ca yā nārī anapatyā mṛtaprajā || vandhyā virūpitā caiva viṣakanyāśca yāḥ striyaḥ || 68 || evaṃ doṣaiḥ pramucyaṃte snātvā kuṇḍe ca bhūpate || saubhāgyastrīsutāṃścaiva rūpaṃ cāpnoti sarvaśaḥ || ||69|| vyādhigrastopi yo martyaḥ ṣaṇmāsāccaiva mānavaḥ || ravikuṇḍe ca susnātaḥ sarvarogātpramucyate || 3.2.13.70 || nīlotsargavidhiṃ yastu ravikṣetre karoti vai || pitarastṛptimāyāṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 71 || kanyādānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādasminkṣetre ca putraka || udvāhaparipūtātmā brahmaloke mahīyate || 72 || dhenudānaṃ ca śayyāṃ ca vidrumaṃ ca hayaṃ tathā || dāsīmahiṣīghaṇṭāśca tilaṃ kāṃcanasaṃyutam || 73 || dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyādasmi nkṣetre ca bhārata || upānahau ca chatraṃ ca śītatrāṇādikaṃ tathā || 74 || lakṣahomaṃ tathā rudraṃ rudrātirudrameva ca || tasminsthāne ca yatkiṃciddadāti śraddhayānvitaḥ || 75 || ekaikasya phalaṃ tāta vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ || dānena labhate bhogāniha loke paratra ca || 76 || rājyaṃ ca labhate martyaḥ kṛtvodvāhaṃ tu mānuṣāḥ || jāyāto dharmakāmārthāḥ prāpyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 77 || pūjāyā labhate saukhyaṃ bhavejjanmanijanmani || saptamyāṃ raviyuktāyāṃ bakulārkaṃ smarettu yaḥ || 78 || jvarādeḥ śatrutaścaiva vyādhestasya bhayaṃ nahi ||79|| || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || bakulārketi vai nāma kathaṃ jātaṃ ravermune || etanme vadatāṃ śreṣṭha tattvamākhyātumarhasi ||3.2.13.80|| || vyāsa uvāca || || yadā saṃjñā ca rājeṃdra sūryārthaṃṃ caikacetasā || tepe bakulavṛkṣādhaḥ patyustejaḥ praśāṃ taye ||81|| prādurbhāvaṃ raverdṛṣṭvā vaḍavā samajāyata || atyaṃtaṃ gopatiḥ śāṃto bakulasya samīpataḥ ||82|| suṣuve ca tadā rājñī sutau divyau manoharau || tenāsya prathitaṃ nāma bakulārketi vai raveḥ ||83|| yastatra kurute snānaṃ vyādhistasya na pīḍayet || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||84|| ṣaṇmāsātsiddhimāpnoti mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥ || etaduktaṃ mahārāja bakulārkasya vaibhavam || 85|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyopākhyāne bakulārkamāhātmyakathanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || ||
<3.2.14>
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kṛpāsiṃdho mahābhāga sarvavyāpinsureśvara || kadā hyatra tapastaptaṃ viṣṇunāmitatejasā || 1 || skaṃdāya kathitaṃ caiva śarveṇa ca mahātmanā || ānupūrvyeṇa sarvaṃ hi kathayasva tvameva hi || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi dharmmāraṇye nṛpottama || ekadātra tapastaptaṃ viṣṇunā'mitatejasā || || 3 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kathaṃ devasaronāma paṃpā caṃpā gayā tathā || vārāṇasyadhikā caiva kathamaśvamukho hariḥ || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || atra nārāyaṇo devastapastepe suduṣkaram || divyavarṣaśataṃ trīṇi jātaḥ suṣṭhvānanaśca saḥ || 5 || tapastepe mahāviṣṇuḥ surūpārthaṃ ca putraka || vājimukho haristatra siddhasthāne mahādyute || 6 || || skaṃda uvāca || || kāraṇaṃ brūhi nodya tvamaśvānanaḥ kathaṃ hariḥ || mahāripośca haṃtā ca devadevo jagatpatiḥ || || 7 || yasya nāmnā mahābhāga pātakāni bahūnyapi || vilīyaṃte tu vegena tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 8 || śrūyaṃte yasya karmāṇi adbhutānyadbhutāni vai || sarveṣāmeva jīvānāṃ kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 9 || prāṇarūpeṇa yo devo hayarūpaḥ kadhaṃ bhavet || sarveṣāmapi taṃtrāṇāmekarūpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.2.14.10 || bhaktigamyo dharmabhājāṃ sukharūpaḥ sadā śuciḥ || guṇātīto'pi nityo'sau sarvago nirguṇastathā || 11 || sraṣṭāsau pālako haṃtā avyaktaḥ sarvadehinām || anukūlo mahātejāḥ kasmādaśvamukho'bhavat || 12 || yasya romodbhavā devā vṛkṣādyāḥ pannagā nagāḥ || kalpekalpe jagatsarvaṃ jāyate yasya dehataḥ || || 13 || sa eva viśvaprabhavaḥ sa evātyaṃtakāraṇam || yenānītāḥ punarvidyā yajñāśca pralayaṃ gatāḥ ||14|| ghātito duṣṭadaityo'sau vedārthaṃ kṛta udyamaḥ || evamāsīnmahāviṣṇuḥ kathamaśvamukho'bhavat || 15 || ratnagarbhā dhṛtā yena pṛṣṭhadeśe ca līlayā || kṛtyā vyavasthitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || || 16 || sa devo viśvarūpo vai kathaṃ vājimukho'bhavat || hiraṇyākṣasya haṃtā yo rūpaṃ kṛtvā varāhajam || 17 || supavitraṃ mahātejāḥ praviśya jalasā gare || uddhṛtā ca mahī sarvā sasāgaramahīdharā || 18 || uddhṛtā ca mahī nūnaṃ daṃṣṭrāgre yena līlayā || kṛtvā rūpaṃ varāhaṃ ca kapilaṃ śokanāśanam || || 19 || sa devaḥ kathamīśāno hayagrīvatvamāgataḥ || prahlādārthe sa ceśāno rūpaṃ kṛtvā bhayāvaham || 3.2.14.20 || nārasiṃhaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvaduṣṭanivāraṇam || parvatāgnisamudrasthaṃ rarakṣa bhaktasattamam || 21 || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ duṣṭaṃ jaghāna rajanīmukhe || iṃdrāsane ca saṃsthāpya prahlādasya sukhapradam || 22 || prahlādārthe ca vai nūnaṃ nṛsiṃhatvamupāgataḥ || virocanasutasyāgre yācako'sau bhavettadā || 23 || yajñe caivāśvamedhe vai balinā yaḥ samarcitaḥ || hṛtā vasumatī tasya tripadīkṛtarodasī || 24 || viśvarūpeṇa vai yena pātāle kṣapito baliḥ || triḥsaptavāraṃ yenaiva kṣatriyānavanītale || 25 || hatvā'dadācca viprebhyo mahīmatimahaujasā || ghātito haihayo rājā yenaiva jananī hatā || 26 || yena vai śiśunorvyāṃ hi ghātitā duṣṭacāriṇī || rākṣasī tāḍakā nāmnī kauśikasya prasādataḥ || 27 || viśvāmitrasya yajñe tu yena līlānṛdehinā || caturdaśasahasrāṇi ghātitā rākṣasā valāt || 28 || hatā śūrpaṇakhā yena triśirāśca nipātitaḥ || sugrīvaṃ vālinaṃ hatvā sugrīveṇa sahāyavān || 29 || kṛtvā setuṃ samudrasya raṇe hatvā daśānanam || dharmmāraṇyaṃ samāsādya brāhmaṇānanvapūjayat || 3.2.14.30 || śāsanaṃ dvijavaryebhyo dattvā grāmānbahūṃstathā || snātvā caiva dharmmavāpyāṃ sudānānyadadādgavām || 31 || sādhūnāṃ pālanaṃ kṛtvā nigrahāya durātmanām || evamanyāni karmmāṇi śrutāni ca dharātale ||32|| sa devo līlayā kṛtvā kathaṃ cāśvamukho'bhavat || yo jāto yādave vaṃśe pūtanāśakaṭādikam || 33 || ariṣṭadaityaḥ keśī ca vṛkāsurabakāsurau || śakaṭāsuro mahāsura stṛṇāvartaśca dhenukaḥ || 34 || mallaścaiva tathā kaṃso jarāsaṃdhastathaiva ca || kālayavanasya haṃtā ca kathaṃ vai sa hayānanaḥ || tārakāsuraṃ raṇe jitvā ayutaṣaṭpuraṃ tathā || 35 || kanyāścodvāhitā yena sahasrāṇi ca ṣaḍ daśa || amānuṣāṇi kṛtvetthaṃ kathaṃ so'śvamukho'bhavat || 36 || trātā yaḥ sarvabhaktānāṃ haṃtā sarvadurātmanām || dharmasthāpanakṛtso'pi kalkirviṣṇupade sthitaḥ || 37 || etadvai mahadāścaryyaṃ bhavatā yatprakāśitam || etadācakṣva me sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tripurāṃtaka || 38 || || śrīrudra uvāca || || sādhupṛṣṭaṃ mahābāho kāraṇaṃ tasya vacmyaham || hayagrīvasya kṛṣṇasya śṛṇuṣve kāgramānasaḥ || 39 || || vyāsa uvāca || || purā devaiḥ samārabdho yajño nūnaṃ dharātale || vedamaṃtrairāhvayituṃ sarve rudrapurogamāḥ ||3.2.14.40|| vaikuṇṭhe ca gatāḥ sarve kṣīrābdhau ca nijālaye || pātāle'pi punargatvā na viduḥ kṛṣṇadarśanam || 41 || mohāviṣṭāstataḥ sarve itaścetaśca dhāvitāḥ || naiva dṛṣṭastadā taistu brahmarūpo janārdanaḥ || 42 || vicārayaṃti te sarve devā indrapurogamāḥ || kva gato'sau mahāviṣṇuḥ kenopāyena dṛśyate || 43 || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ vāgīśaṃ procurādarāt || devadeva mahāviṣṇuṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ || 44 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || na jāne kena kāryeṇa yogārūḍho mahātmavān || yogarūpo'bhavadviṣṇuryogīśo hariracyutaḥ || 45 || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā svamātmānaṃ dhiṣaṇena khyāpito hariḥ || tatra sarve gatā devā yatra devo jagatpatiḥ || 46 || tadā dṛṣṭo mahāviṣṇurdhyānastho'sau janārdanaḥ || dhyātvā kṛtyasamākāraṃ saśaraṃ daityasūdanam || 47 || samāsthānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā bodhopāyaṃ pracakrame || āha tāṃśca tadā vamryo dhanurguṇaṃ prayatnataḥ || chetsyaṃti cettacchabdena prabudhyeta hariḥ svayam || 48 || || devā ūcuḥ || || guṇabhakṣaṃ kurudhvaṃ vai yenāsau budhyate hariḥ || kratvarthino vayaṃ vamryaḥ prabhuṃ vijñāpayāmahe || 49 || || vamryaḥ ūcuḥ || || nidrābhaṃgaṃ kathācchedaṃ dampatyormaitrabhedanam || śiśumātṛvibhedaṃ vā kurvāṇo narakaṃ vrajet || 3.2.14.50 || yogārūḍho jagannāthaḥ samādhistho mahābalaḥ || tasya śrījagadīśasya vighnaṃ naiva tu kurmahe || 51 || || brahmovāca || || bhavatāṃ sarvabhakṣatvaṃ devakāryaṃ kriyeta cet || karttavyaṃ ca tato vamryo yajñasiddhiryathā bhavet || vamrīśā sā tadā vatsa punarevamuvāca ha || 52 || || vamryuvāca || || duḥkhasādhyo jagannātho malayānilasaṃnibhaḥ || kathaṃ vā bodhyatāṃ bahmannasmābhiḥ surapūjitaḥ || 53 || naiva yajñena me kāryaṃ suraiścaiva tathaiva ca || sarveṣu yajñakāryeṣu bhāgaṃ dadatu me surāḥ || 54 || || || devā ūcuḥ || || pradāsyāmo vayaṃ vamryai bhāgaṃ yajñeṣu sarvadā || yajñāya dattamasmābhiḥ kuruṣvaivaṃ vaco hi naḥ || 55 || tatheti vidhināpyuktaṃ vamrī codyamamāśritā || guṇabhakṣādikaṃ karma tayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ nṛpa || 56 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || asya vā bodhane devā guṇabhaṃge samādhiṣu || etadāścaryaṃ viprarṣe satyaṃ satyavatīsuta || 57 || || vyāsa uvāca || || vyagracittāḥ surāḥ sarve ākṛṣṭaṃ harikārmu kam || na jāne kena kāryeṇa viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ || 58 || muditāstāḥ pramuñcaṃti valmīkaṃ cāgrato hareḥ || koṭipārśve tato nītaṃ valmīkaṃ parvatopamam || 59 || guṇe ca bhakṣite tasmiṃstakṣaṇādeva dūṣite || jyāghātakoṭibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śīrṣaṃ chittvā divaṃ gatam || 3.2.14.60 || gate śīrṣe ca te devā bhṛśamu dvignamānasāḥ || dhāvaṃti sarvataḥ sarve śiraālokanāya te || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrva bhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye viṣṇuśironāśonāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<3.2.15>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || na paśyaṃti tadā śīrṣaṃ brahmā dyāstu surāstadā || kiṃ kurma iti hetyuktvā jñāninaste vyacintayan || 1 || uvāca viśvakarmāṇaṃ tadā brahmā surānvitaḥ ||2|| || brahmovāca || || viśvakarmastvamevāsi kāryakartā sadā vibho || śīghrameva kuru tvaṃ vai vaktraṃ sāṃdraṃ ca dhanvinaḥ || 3 || namaskṛtya tadā tasmai stuto'sau devavarddhakiḥ || uvāca parayā bhaktyā brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam || 3 || yajñakāryaṃ nivṛtyāśu vadaṃti vividhāḥ surāḥ || 4 || yajñabhāgavihīnaṃ māṃ kiṃ punarvacmi te 'grataḥ || yajñabhāgamahaṃ deva labheyaivaṃ suraiḥ saha || 5 || || brahmovāca || || dāsyāmi sarvayajñeṣu vibhāgaṃ suravarddhake || some tvaṃ prathamaṃ vīra pūjyase śrutikovidaiḥ || 6 || tadviṣṇośca śirastāvatsaṃdhatsvāmaravarddhaka || viśvakarmābravīddevānānayadhvaṃ śirastviti || 7 || tannāstīti surāḥ sarve vadaṃti nṛpasattama || madhyāhne tu samudbhūte rathastho divi cāṃśumān || 8 || dṛṣṭaṃ tadā suraiḥ sarvai rathādaśvamathānayan || chittvā śīrṣaṃ mahīpāla kabaṃdhādvājino hareḥ || 9 || kabaṃdhe yojayāmāsa viśvakarmāticāturaḥ || dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ surāḥ stutimakurvata || 3.2.15.10 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaste'stu jagadbīja namaste kamalāpate || namaste'stu sureśāna namaste kamalekṣaṇa || 11 || tvaṃ sthitiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ satām || tvaṃ haṃtā sarvaduṣṭānāṃ hayagrīva namo'stu te || 12 || tvamoṃkāro vaṣaṭkāraḥ svāhā svadhā caturvidhā || ādyastvaṃ ca sureśāna tvameva śaraṇaṃ sadā || 13 || yajño yajñapatiryajvā dravyaṃ hotā hutastathā || tvadarthaṃ hūyate deva tvameva śaraṇaṃ sakhā || 14 || kālaḥ karālarūpastvaṃ tvaṃ vārkkaḥ śītadīdhitiḥ || tvamagnirvaruṇaścaiva tvaṃ ca kālakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 15 || guṇatrayaṃ tvameveha guṇahīnastvameva hi || guṇānāmālayastvaṃ ca goptā sarveṣu jaṃtuṣu || 16 || strīpuṃsośca dvidhā tvaṃ ca paśupakṣyādimānavaiḥ || caturvidhaṃ kulaṃ tvaṃ hi caturāśītilakṣaṇaḥ || 17 || dināṃtaścaiva pakṣāṃto māsāṃto hāyanaṃ yugam || kalpāṃtaśca mahāṃtaśca kālāṃtastvaṃ ca vai hare || 18 || evaṃvidhairmahādivyaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surairnṛpa || saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāha sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purataḥ prabhuḥ || 19 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || kimarthamiha saṃprāptāḥ sarve devagaṇā bhuvi || kimetatkāraṇaṃ devāḥ ki nu daityaprapīḍitāḥ || 3.2.15.20 || || devā ūcuḥ || || na daityasya bhayaṃ jātaṃ yajña karmotsukā vayam || tvaddarśanaparāḥ sarve paśyāmo vai diśo daśa || 21 || tvanmāyāmohitāḥ sarve vyagracittā bhayāturāḥ || yogārūḍhasvarūpaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ te'smābhiruttamam|| 22 || vamrī ca noditāsmābhirjāgarāya taveśvara || tataścāpūrvamabhavacchiraśchinnaṃ babhūva te || 23 || sūryāśvaśīrṣamānīya viśva karmāticāturaḥ || samadhatta śiro viṣṇo hayagrīvo'syataḥ prabho || 24 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || tuṣṭo'haṃ nākinaḥ sarve dadāmri varamīpsitam || hayagrīvo'smyahaṃ jāto devadevo jagatpatiḥ || 25 || na raudraṃ na virūpaṃ ca surairapi ca sevitam || jāto'haṃ varado devā hayānaneti toṣitaḥ || 26 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || kṛte satre tato vedhā dhīmānsantuṣṭacetasā || yajñabhāgaṃ tato dattvā vamrībhyo viśvakarmaṇe || 27 || yajñāṃte ca suraśreṣṭhaṃ namaskṛtya divaṃ yayau || etacca kāraṇaṃ viddhi hayānano yato hariḥ || 28 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || yenākrāṃtā mahī sarvā krameṇaikena tattvataḥ || vivare vivare romṇāṃ vartaṃte ca pṛthakpṛthak ||29|| brahmāṃḍāni sahasrāṇi dṛśyaṃte ca mahādyute || na vetti vedo yatpāraṃ śīrṣaghāto hi vai katham || 3.2.15.30 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām || īśvarasya caritraṃ hi naiva vetti carācare ||31|| ekadā brahmasabhāyāṃ gatā devāḥ savāsavāḥ|| bhūrlokādyāśca sarve hi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca||32|| devā brahmarṣayaḥ sarve namaskartuṃ pitāmaham || viṣṇurapyāgatastatra sabhāyāṃ maṃtrakāraṇāt ||33|| brahmā cāpi vigarviṣṭha uvācedaṃ vacastadā || bhobho devāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ kastrayāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ mahat ||34|| satyaṃ bruvaṃtu vai devā brahmeśaviṣṇumadhyataḥ || tāṃ vācaṃ ca samākarṇya devā vismayamāgatāḥ||35|| ūcuścaiva tato devā na jānīmo vayaṃ surāḥ || brahmapatnī tadovāca viṣṇuṃ prati sureśvaram || trayāṇāmapi devānāṃ mahāṃtaṃ ca vadasva me || 36 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || viṣṇumāyābalenaiva mohitaṃ bhuvanatrayam || tato brahmovāca cedaṃ na tvaṃ jānāsi bho vibhoḥ || 37 || naiva muhyati te māyābalena naivameva ca || garvahiṃsāparo devo jagadbhartā jagatprabhuḥ ||38|| jyeṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ na viduḥ sarve viṣṇumāyāvṛtāḥ khilāḥ || tato brahmā sa roṣeṇa kruddhaḥ prasphuritānanaḥ || 39 || uvāca vacanaṃ kopāddhe viṣṇo śṛṇu me vacaḥ || yena vaktreṇa sabhāyāṃ vacanaṃ samudīritam || 3.2.15.40 || tacchīrṣaṃ patatādāśu cālpakālena vai punaḥ || tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ seṃdrāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ || 41 || brahmāṇaṃ kṣamayāmāsurviṣṇuṃ prati surottamāḥ || viṣṇuśca tadvacaḥ śrutvā satyaṃsatyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 42 || tato viṣṇurmahātejāstīrthasyotpādanena ca || tapastepe tu vai tatra dharmāraṇye sureśvaraḥ || aśvaśīrṣa mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā hayagrīvo janārddanaḥ || 43 || tapastepe mahābhāga vidhinā saha bhārata || na śakyaṃ kenacitkarttumātmanātmaiva tuṣṭavān || 44 || brahmāpi tapasā yuktastepe varṣaśatatrayam || tiṣṭhanneva puro viṣṇorviṣṇumāyāvimohitaḥ || 45 || yajñārthamavadattuṣṭo devadevo jagatpatiḥ || brahmaṃste muktatādyāsti mama māyāpyaduḥsahā || 46 || tato labdhavaro brahmā hṛṣṭacitto janārddanaḥ || uvāca madhurāṃ vācaṃ sarveṣāṃ hitakāraṇāt || 47 || atrābhavanmahākṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || vidhiviṣṇumayaṃ caitadbhavatvetanna saṃśayaḥ || 48 || tīrthasya mahimā rājanhayaśīrṣastadā hariḥ || śubhānano hi saṃjātaḥ pūrveṇaivā nanena tu || 49 || kaṃdarpakoṭilāvaṇyo jātaḥ kṛṣṇastadā nṛpa || brahmāpi tapasā yukto divyaṃ varṣaśatatrayam || 3.2.15.50 || sāvitryā ca kṛtaṃ yatra viṣṇumāyā na bādhate || māyayā tu kṛtaṃ śīrṣaṃ paṃcamaṃ śārdulasya vā || 51 || dharmāraṇye kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ hareṇa ccheditaṃ purā || tasmai dattvā varaṃ viṣṇurjagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ || 52 || sthāpayitvā vidhistatra tīrthaṃ caiva trilocanam || mukteśaṃ nāma devasya mokṣatīrthamariṃdama || 53 || gataḥ so'pi suraśreṣṭhaḥ svasthānaṃ surasevitam || tatra pretā divaṃ yāṃti tarpaṇena pratarpitāḥ || 54 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ snāne pāne godānajaṃ phalam || puṣkarādyāni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || 55 || snānārthamatrāgacchaṃti devatāḥ pitarastathā || kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge mukteśaṃ pūjayettu yaḥ || 56 || snātvā devasare ramye natvā devaṃ janārddanam || yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 57 || bhuktvā bhogā nyathākāmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || aputrā kākavaṃdhyā ca mṛtavatsā mṛtaprajā || 58 || ekāṃbareṇa susnātau patipatnyau yathāvidhi || taddoṣaṃ nāśayennūnaṃ prajāptipratibandhakam || 59 || mokṣeśvaraprasādena putrapautrādi varddhayet || dadyādvaikena cittena phalāni satyasaṃyutā || || 3.2.15.60 || nidhāya vaṃśapātre'pi nārī doṣātpramucyate || prāpnuvaṃti ca devāśca agniṣṭomaphalaṃ nṛpa || 61 || vedhā harirharaścaiva tapyaṃte paramaṃ tapaḥ || dharmāraṇye trisaṃdhyaṃ ca snātvā devasarasyatha || 62 || tatra mokṣeśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ sthāpito vai tataḥ suraiḥ || tatra sāṃgaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || 63 || evaṃ kṣetraṃ mahārāja prasiddhaṃ bhuvanatraye || yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || 64 || uddharetsapta gotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatam || devasaro mahāramyaṃ nānāpuṣpaiḥ samanvitam || śyāmaṃ sakalakalhārairvividhairjalajaṃtubhiḥ || 65 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ sevitaṃ suramānuṣaiḥ || siddhairyakṣaiśca munibhiḥ sevitaṃ sarvataḥ śubham || 66 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kīdṛśaṃ tatsaraḥ khyātaṃ tasmi nsthāne dvijottama || tasya rūpaṃ prakāraṃ ca kathayasva yathātatham || 67 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahāprājña dharmaputra yudhiṣṭhira || yasya saṃkīrtanānnūnaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 68 || atisvachataraṃ śītaṃ gaṃgodakasamaprabham || pavitraṃ madhuraṃ svādu jalaṃ tasya nṛpottama || 69 || mahāviśālaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ devakhātaṃ manoramam || laharyādibhirgaṃbhīraḥ phenāvartasamākulam|| 3.2.15.70 || jhaṣamaṃḍūkakamaṭhairmakaraiśca samākulam || śaṃkhaśuktyādi bhiryuktaṃ rājahaṃsaiḥ suśobhitam || 71 || vaṭaplakṣaiḥ samāyuktamaśvatthāmraiśca veṣṭitam || cakravākasamopataṃ bakasārasaṭiṭṭibhaiḥ || 72 || kamanīya pragandhācchacchatrapatraiḥ suśobhitam || sevyamānaṃ dvijaiḥ sarvaiḥ sārasādyaiḥ suśobhitam || 73 || sadevairmunibhiścaiva viprairmatyaiśca bhūmipa || sevitaṃ duḥkhahaṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 74 || anādinidhanodaṃtaṃ sevitaṃ siddhamaṃḍalaiḥ || snānādibhiḥ sarvadaiva tatsaro nṛpasattama || 75 || vidhinā kurute yastu nīlotsargaṃ ca tattaṭe || pretā naiva kule tasya yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa || 76 || kanyādānaṃ ca ye kuryurvidhinā tatra bhūpate || te tiṣṭhanti brahmaloke yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 77 || mahiṣīṃ gṛhadāsīṃ ca surabhīṃ sutasaṃyutām || hema vidyāṃ tathā bhūmiṃ rathāṃśca gajavāsasī || 78 || dadāti śraddhayā tatra so'kṣayaṃ svargamaśnute || devakhātasya māhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau || dīrghamāyustathā saukhyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 79 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā nārī vā tvidamadbhutam || kule tasya bhavecchreyaḥ kalpāṃte'pi yudhiṣṭhira || 3.2.15.80 || etatsarvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ hayagrīvasya kāraṇam || prabhāstasya tīrthasya sarvapāpāyanuttaye || 81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇya māhātmye hayagrīvasyākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<3.2.16>
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || rakṣasāṃ caiva daityānāṃ yakṣaṇāmatha pakṣiṇām || bhayanāśāya kājeśairdharmāraṇyanivāsinām || 1 || śaktīḥ saṃsthāpitā nṛnaṃ nānārūpā hyanekaśaḥ || tāsāṃ sthānāni nāmā ni yathārūpāṇi me vada || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu pārtha mahābāho dharmamūrte nṛpottama || sthāne vai sthāpitā śaktiḥ kājeśaiścaiva gotrapā || 3 || śrīmātā madārikāyāṃ śāṃtā naṃdāpure vare || rakṣārthaṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ caturdikṣu sthitāśca tāḥ || || 4 || yuktāścaiva suraiḥ sarvaiḥ svasvasthāne nṛpottama || vanamadhye sthitāḥ sarvā dvijānāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai || 5 || sā babhūva mahārāja sāvitrīti prathā śivā || asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāya jñānajā sthāpitā suraiḥ || 6 || gātrāyī(?) pakṣiṇī devī chatrajā dvāravāsinī || śīhorī cūṭasaṃjñā yā pippalāśāpurī tathā || anyāśca bahavaścaiva sthāpitā bhayarakṣaṇe || 7 || pratīcyodīcyāṃ yāmyāṃ vai vibudhaiḥ sthāpitā hi sā || nānāyudhadharā sā ca nānābharaṇabhūṣitā || 8 || nānāvāhanamārūḍhā nānārūpadharā ca sā || nānākopasamāyuktā nānābhayavinā śinī || 9 || sthāpyā mātaryathāsthāne yathāyogyā diśodiśa || garuḍena samārūḍhā triśūlavaradhāriṇī || 3.2.16.10 || siṃhārūḍhā śuddharūpā vāruṇī pānadarpitā || khaḍgakheṭakabāṇāḍhyaiḥ karairbhāti śubhānanā || 11 || raktavastrāvṛtā caiva pīnonnatapayodharā || udyadādityabiṃbābhā madāghūrṇitalocanā || || 12 || evameṣā mahādivyā kājeśaiḥ sthāpitā tadā || rakṣārthaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ satyamaṃdiravāsinām || 13 || sā devī nṛpaśārdūla stutā saṃpūjitā saha || dadāti sakalānkāmānvāṃchitānnṛpamattama || 14 || dharmāraṇyātpaścimataḥ sthāpitā chatrajā śubhā || tatrasthā rakṣate viprānkiyacchaktisama nvitā || 15 || bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya rākṣasānāṃ vadhāya ca || dhārayaṃtyāyudhānītthaṃ viprāṇāmabhayāya ca || 16 || saraścakāra tasyāgre uttamaṃ jala pūritam || sarasyasminmahābhāga kṛtvā snānāditarpaṇam || 17 || piṃḍadānādikaṃ sarvamakṣayaṃ caiva jāyate || bhūmau kṣiptāṃjalīndivyāndhūpadīpādikaṃ sadā || 18 || tasya no bādhate vyādhiḥ śatrūṇāṃ nāśa eva ca || balidānādikaṃ tatra kuryādbhūyaḥ svaśaktitaḥ || 19 || śatravo nāśamāyāṃti dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vivardhate || ānaṃdā sthāpitā rājañchaktyaṃśā ca manoramā || 3.2.16.20 || rakṣaṇārthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate || śuklāṃbaradharā divyā hemabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā || 21 || siṃhārūḍhā caturhastā śaśāṃkakṛtaśekharā || muktāhāralatopetā pītonnatapayodharā || 22 || akṣamālāsihastā ca guṇa tomaradhāriṇī || divyagaṃdhavarādhārā divyamālāvibhūṣitā || 23 || sāttvikī śaktirānaṃdā sthitā tasminpure purā || pūjayettāṃ ca vai rājankarpūrārakta caṃdanaiḥ || 24 || bhojayetpāyasaiḥ śubhrairmadhvājyasitayā saha || bhavānyāḥ prītaye rājankumāryāḥ pūjanaṃ tathā || 25 || tatra japtaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ dhyātaṃ ca nṛpasattama || tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ tatra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26 || triguṇe triguṇā vṛddhistasminsthāne nṛpottama || sādhakasya bhavennūnaṃ dhanadārādisaṃ padaḥ || 27 || na hānirna ca rogaśca na śatrurna ca duṣkṛtam || gāvastasya vivarddhaṃte dhanadhānyādisaṃkulam || 28 || na śākinyā bhayaṃ tasya na ca rājñaśca vairiṇaḥ || na ca vyādhibhayaṃ caiva sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 29 || vidyāścaturddaśāsyaiva bhāsaṃte paṭhitā iva || sūryavaddyotate bhūmāvānaṃdamā śrito naraḥ || 3.2.16.30 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvārdhe dharmāraṇyamāhātmya ānaṃdāsthāpanavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<3.2.17>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || dakṣiṇe sthāpitā rājañchām̐tā devī mahābalā || sā vividhāmbaradharā vanamālāvibhūṣitā || 1 || tāmasī sā mahārāja madhukaiṭabhanāśinī || viṣṇunā tatra vai nyastā śivapatnī nṛpottama || 2 || sā caivāṣṭabhujā ramyā meghaśyāmā manoramā || kṛṣṇāṃbaradharā devī vyāghravāhanasaṃsthitā || 3 || dvīpicarmaparīdhānā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā || ghaṃṭātriśūlākṣamālākamaṃḍaludharā śubhā|| 4|| alaṃkṛtabhujā devī sarvadevanamaskṛtā || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutānbhogānsvabhaktebhyaḥ prayacchati || 5 || pūjayetkamalai rdivyaiḥ karpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ || taduddeśena tatraiva pūjayeddvijasattamān || 6 || kumārīrbhojayedannairvividhairbhaktibhāvataḥ || dhūpairdīpaiḥ phalaiḥ ramyaiḥ pūjayecca surādibhiḥ || 7 || māṃsaistu vividhairdivyairathavā dhānyapiṣṭajaiḥ || anyaiśca vividhairdhānyaiḥ pāyasairvaṭakaistathā || 8 || odanaiḥ kṛśarāpūpaiḥ pūjayetsusamāhitaḥ || stutipāṭhena tatraiva śaktistotrairmanoharaiḥ || 9 || ripavastasya naśyaṃti sarvatra vijayī bhavet || raṇe rājakule dyūte labhate jayamaṃgalam || 3.2.17.10 || saumyā śāṃtā mahārāja sthāpitā kulamātṛkā || śrīmātā sā prasiddhā ca māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate || 11 || kulamātā mahāśaktistatrāste nṛpasattama || kumārī brahmaputrī sā rakṣārthaṃ vidhinā kṛtā || 12 || sthānamātā ca sā devī śrīmātā sābhidhānataḥ || trirūpā sā dvijātīnāṃ nirmitā rakṣaṇāya ca || 13 || kamaṇḍaludharā devī ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitā || akṣamālāyutā rājañchubhā sā śubharūpiṇī || 14 || kumārī cādimātā ca sthānatrāṇakarāpi ca || daityaghnī kāmadā caiva mahāmohavināśinī || 15 || bhaktigamyā ca sā devī kumārī brahmaṇaḥ sutā || raktāṃbaradharā sādhuraktacaṃdanacarcitā || 16 || raktamālyā daśabhujā paṃcavaktrā sureśvarī || caṃdrāvataṃsikā mātā surā suranamaskṛtā || 17 || sākṣātsarasvatīrūpā rakṣārthaṃ vidhinā kṛtā || oṃkārā sā mahāpuṇyā kājeśena vinirmitā || 18 || ṛṣibhiḥ siddhayakṣā disurapannagamānavaiḥ || praṇamyāṃghriyugā tebhyo dadāti manasepsitam || 19 || pālayantī ca saṃsthānaṃ dvijātīnāṃ hitāya vai || yathaurasānsutānmātā pālayantīha sadguṇaiḥ || 3.2.17.20 || atha pālayatī devī śrīmātā kuladevatā || upadravāṇi sarvāṇi nāśayetsatataṃ stutā || 21 || sarvavighnopaśamanī śrīmātā smaraṇena hi || vivāhe copavīte ca sīmaṃte śubhakarmaṇi || 22 || sarveṣu bhaktakāryeṣu śrīmātā pūjyate sadā || yathā laṃbodaraṃ devaṃ pūja yitvā samārabhet || 23 || kāryaṃ śubhaṃ sarvamapi śrīmātaraṃ tathā nṛpa || yatkiṃcidbhojanaṃ tvatra brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati || 24 || athavā vinivedyaṃ ca kriyate yatparasparam || anivedya ca tāṃ rājankurvāṇo vighnameṣyati || 25 || tasmāttasyai nivedyātha tataḥ karma samārabhet || tadvareṇākhilaṃ karma avighnena hi siddhati || hemaṃte śiśire prāpte pūjayeddharmaputrikām || 26 || hemapatre samālikhya rājate vātha kārayet || pādukāṃ cottamāṃ rājañchrīmātāyai nivedayet || 27 || snātvā caiva śucirbhūtvā tilāmalakamiśritaiḥ|| vāsobhiḥ sumanobhiśca dukūlaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ || 28 || lepayeccaṃdanaiḥ śubhraiḥ kukumaiḥ siṃdurāsakaiḥ || karpūrāgurukastūrīmiśritaiḥ karddamaistathā || 29 || karṇikāraiśca kahlāraiḥ karavīraiḥ sitāruṇaiḥ || caṃpakaiḥ ketakībhiśca japā kusumakaistathā || 3.2.17.30 || yakṣakarddamakaiścaiva vilvapatrairakhaṃḍitaiḥ || pālāśajātipuṣpaiśca vaṭakairmāṣasaṃbhavaiḥ || pūpabhaktādidālībhistoṣayecchākasaṃcayaiḥ || || 31 || dhūpadīpādipūrvaṃ tu pūjayejjagadaṃbikām || taddhiyaiva kumārīrvai viprānapi ca bhojayet || pāyasairghṛtayuktaiśca śarkarāmiśritairnṛpa || 32 || pakvānnairmodakādyaiśca tarpayedbhaktibhāvataḥ || tarpyamāṇe dvijaikasminsahasraphalamaśnute ||33|| daityānāṃ ghātakaṃ stotraṃ vācayecca punaḥ punaḥ || ekāgramānaso bhūtvā śrīmātaraṃ stuvīya yaḥ ||34|| tasya tuṣṭā varaṃ dadyātsnāpitā pūjitā stutā || aniṣṭāni ca sarvāṇi nāśayeddharmaputrikā ||35|| aputro labhate putrānni rdhano dhanavānbhavet|| rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ vidyārthī labhate ca tām||36|| śriyorthī labhate lakṣmīṃ bhāryārthī labhate ca tām || prasādācca sarasvatyā labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 37 || ante ca paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham || prāpnoti puruṣo nityaṃ sarasvatyāḥ prasādataḥ || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye śrīmātāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || ||
<3.2.18>
|| rudra uvāca || || śṛṇu skanda mahāprājña hyadbhutaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mayā || dharmāraṇye mahāduṣṭo daityaḥ karṇāṭakābhidhaḥ || 1 || nibhṛtaṃ hi samāgatya daṃpatyorvighnamācarat || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbhayāllokaḥ pradudrāva nirantaram || 2 || tyaktvā sthānaṃ gatāḥ sarve vaṇijo vāḍavādayaḥ || mātaṃgīrūpamāsthāya śrīmātrā tvanayā suta || 3 || hataḥ karṇāṭako nāma rākṣaso dvijaghātakaḥ || tadā sarve'pi vai viprā hṛṣṭāste tena karmaṇā || 4 || stuvaṃti pūjayaṃti sma vaṇijo bhaktitatparāḥ || varṣevarṣe prakurvaṃti śrīmātāpūjanaṃ śubham || 5 || śubhakāryeṣu sarveṣu prathamaṃ pūjayettu tām || na sa vighnaṃ prapaśyeta tadāprabhṛti putraka || 6 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || ko'sau duṣṭo mahādaityaḥ kasminvaṃśe samudbhavaḥ || kiṃ kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ tāta sarvaṃṃ kathaya suvrata || 7 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi karṇāṭakaviceṣṭitam || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ yo duḥsaho vīryadarpitaḥ || 8 || duṣṭakarmā durācāro mahārāṣṭro mahābhujaḥ || jitvā ca sakalām̐llokāṃstrailokye ca gatāgataḥ || 9 || yatra devāśca ṛṣayastatra gatvā mahāsuraḥ || chadmanā vā balenaiva vighnaṃ prakurute nṛpa ||3.2.18.1 0|| na vedādhyayanaṃ loke bhavettasya bhayena ca || kurvate vāḍavā devā na ca saṃdhyādyupāsanam || 11 || na kraturvartate tatra na caiva surapūjanam || deśedeśe ca sarvatra grāmegrāme purepure || 12 || tīrthetīrthe ca sarvatra vighnaṃ prakurute'suraḥ || paraṃtu śakyate naiva dharmāraṇye praveśitum || 13 || bhayācchaktyāśca śrīmāturdānavo viklavastadā || kenopāyena tatraiva gamyate tviti ciṃtayan || 14 || vighnaṃ kariṣye hi kathaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām || vedādhyayanakartṝṇāṃ yajñe karmādhitiṣṭhatām || 15 || vedādhyayanajaṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā dūrātsa dānavaḥ || vivyathe sa yathā rājanvajrāhata iva dvipaḥ || 16 || niḥśvāsānmumuce roṣāddaṃtairdaṃtāṃśca gharṣayan || daśamāno nijāvoṣṭhau peṣayaṃśca karāvubhau || 17 || unmattavadvicarata itaścetaśca māriṣa || sannipātasya doṣeṇa yathā bhavati mānavaḥ || 18 || tathaiva dānavo ghoro dharmāraṇyasamīpagaḥ || bhramate dahate caiva dūrādeva bhayānvitaḥ || 19 || vivāhakāle viprāṇāṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā dvijanmanaḥ || tatrāgatya durādharṣo nītvā dāṃpatyamuttamam || 3.2.18.20 || utpapāta mahīpṛṣṭhādgagane so'surādhamaḥ || svayaṃ ca ramate pāpo dveṣājjātisvabhāvataḥ || 21 || evaṃ ca bahuśaḥ so'tha dharmāraṇyācca daṃpatī || gṛhītvā kurute pāpaṃ devānāmapi duḥsaham || 22 || vighnaṃ karoti duṣṭo'sau daṃpatyoḥ satataṃ bhuvi || mahāghorataraṃ karma kurvaṃstasminpure vare || 23 || tatrodvignā dvijāḥ sarve palāyaṃte diśo daśa || gatāḥ sarve bhūmidevā styaktvā sthānaṃ manoramam || 24 || yatrayatra mahattīrthaṃ tatratatra gatā dvijāḥ || udvasaṃ tatpuraṃ jātaṃ tasminkāle nṛpottama || 25 || na vedādhyayanaṃ tatra na ca yajñaḥ pravartate || manujāstatra tiṣṭhaṃti na karṇāṭabhayārditāḥ || 26 || dvijāḥ sarve tato rājanvaṇijaśca mahāyaśāḥ || ekatra militāḥ sarve vaktuṃ maṃtraṃ yathocitam || 27|| karṇāṭasya vadhopāyaṃ maṃtrayaṃti dvijarṣabhāḥ || vicāryamāṇe tairdaivādvāgjātā cāśarīriṇī || 28 || ārādhayata śrīmātāṃ sarvaduḥkhāpahāriṇīm || sarvadaityakṣayakarīṃ sarvopadravanāśanīm || 29 || tacchrutvā vāḍavāḥ sarve harṣavyākulalocanāḥ || śrīmātāṃ tu samāgatya gṛhītvā balimuttamam || 3.2.18.30 || madhu kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ śarkarā pañcadhārayā || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā caiva caṃdanaṃ kusumāni ca || 31 || phalāni vividhānyeva gṛhītvā vāḍavā nṛpa || dhānyaṃ tu vividhaṃ rājanbhaktāpūpā ghṛtācitāḥ || 32 || kulmāṣā vaṭakāścaiva pāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśritam || sohālikā dīpikāśca sārdrāśca vaṭakāstathā || 33 || rājikābhiśca saṃliptā navacchidrasamanvitāḥ || caṃdrabiṃbapratīkāśā maṇḍakāstatra kalpitāḥ || 34 || pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā gandhodakena ca || dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaistoṣayāmāsurīśvarīm || 35 || nīrājanaiḥ sakapūraiḥ puṣpairdīpaiḥ sucaṃdanaiḥ || śrīmātā toṣitā rājansarvopadravanāśanī || 36 || śrīmātā ca jaganmātā brāhmī saumyā varapradā || rūpatrayaṃ samāsthāya pālayetsā jagattrayam || 37 || trayīrūpeṇa dharmātmanrakṣate satyamaṃdiram|| jitedriyā jitātmāno militāste dvijottamāḥ || 38 || taiḥ sarverarcitā mātā caṃdanādyena toṣitā || stutimārebhire tatra vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ || ekacittena bhāvena brahmaputryāḥ puraḥ sthitāḥ || 39 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || namaste brahmaputryāstu namaste brahmacāriṇi || namaste jagatāṃ mātarnamaste sarvage sadā || 3.2.18.40 || kṣunnidrā tvaṃ tṛṣā tvaṃ ca krodhataṃdrādayastathā || tvaṃ śāṃtistvaṃ ratiścaiva tvaṃ jayā vijayā tathā || 41 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaistvaṃ prapannā sureśvari || sāvitrī śrīrumā caiva tvaṃ ca mātā vyavasthitā || 42 || brahmaviṣṇu sureśānāstvadādhāre vyavasthitāḥ || namastubhyaṃ jaganmātardhṛtipuṣṭisvarūpiṇi || 43 || ratiḥ krodhā mahāmāyā chāyā jyotiḥsvarūpiṇi || sṛṣṭi sthityaṃtakṛddevi kāryakāraṇadā sadā ||44|| dharā tejastathā vāyuḥ salilākāśameva ca || namaste'stu mahāvidye mahājñānamaye'naghe || 45 || hrīṃkārī devarūpā tvaṃ klīṃkārī tvaṃ mahādyute || ādimadhyāvasānā tvaṃ trāhi cāsmānmahābhayāt || 46 || mahāpāpo hi duṣṭātmā daityo'yaṃ bādhate'dhunā || trāṇarūpā tvamekā ca asmākaṃ kuladevatā || 47|| trāhitrāhi mahādevi rakṣarakṣa maheśvari || hanahana dānavaṃ duṣṭaṃ dvijātīnāṃ vighnakārakam ||48|| evaṃ stutā tadā devī mahāmāyā dvijanmabhiḥ || karṇāṭasya vadhārthāya dvijātīnāṃ hitāya ca || pratyakṣā sā'bhavattatra varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 49 || || || śrīmātovāca || || kena vai trāsitā viprāḥ kena vodvejitāḥ punaḥ || tasyāhaṃ kupitā viprā nayiṣye yamasādanam ||3.2.18.50|| kṣīṇāyuṣaṃ naraṃ vitta yena yūyaṃ nipīḍitāḥ || dadāmi vo dvijātibhyo yatheṣṭaṃ vaktumarhatha ||51|| bhaktyā hi bhavatāṃ viprāḥ kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ ||52|| || dvijā ūcuḥ|| || karṇāṭākhyo mahāraudro dānavo madagarvitaḥ || vighnaṃ prakurute nityaṃ satyamaṃdiravāsinām ||53|| brāhmaṇānsatyaśīlāṃśca vedādhyayanatatparān || dveṣāddveṣṭi dveṣaṇastānnityameva mahāmate || vedavidveṣaṇo duṣṭo ghātayainaṃ mahādyute || 54 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tathetyuktvā tu sā devī prahasya kuladevatā || vadhopāyaṃ viciṃtyāsya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai || 55 || tataḥ kopaparā jātā śrīmātā nṛpasattama || kopena bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā raktanetrāṃtalocanām || 56 || kopena mahatā''viṣṭā vasaṃtī pāvakaṃ yathā || mahājvālā mukhānnetrānnāsākarṇācca bhārata||57|| tattejasā samudbhūtā mātaṃgī kāmarūpiṇī || kālī karā lavadanā durdarśavadanojjvalā ||58|| raktamālyāṃbaradharā madāghūrṇitalocanā || nyagrodhasya samīpe sā śrīmātā saṃśritā tadā ||59|| aṣṭādaśabhujā sā tu śubhā mātā suśobhanā || dhanurbāṇadharā devī khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī || 3.2.18.60 || kuṭhāraṃ kṣurikāṃ bibhrattriśūlaṃ pānapātrakam || gadāṃ sarpaṃ ca parighaṃ pinākaṃ caiva pāśakam || 61 || akṣamālādharā rājanmadyakuṃbhānudhāriṇī || śaktiṃ ca muśalaṃ cograṃ kartarīṃ kharparaṃ tathā || 62 || kaṃṭakāḍhyāṃ ca badarīṃ bibhratī tu mahānanā || tatrābhavanmahāyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || 63 || mātaṃgyāḥ saha karṇāṭadānavena nṛpottama || 64 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kathaṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavatkathaṃ caivāpavartata || jitaṃ kenaiva dharmajña tanmamācakṣva māriṣa || 65 || || vyāsa uvāca || || ekadā śṛṇu rājeṃdra yajjātaṃ daityasaṃgare || tatsarvaṃ kathayāmyāśu yathāvṛttaṃ hi tatpurā || 66 || praṇaṣṭayoṣā ye viprā vaṇijaścaiva bhārata || caitramāse tu saṃprāpte dharmāraṇye nṛpottama || 67 || gaurīmudvāhayāmāsurviprāste saṃśitavratāḥ || svasthānaṃ suśubhaṃ jñātvā tīrtharājaṃ tathottamam || 68 || vivāhaṃ tatra kurvaṃto militāste dvijottamāḥ || koṭikanyākulaṃ tatra ekatrāsīnmahotsave || dharmāraṇye mahāprājña satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 69 || caturthyāmapararātre'bhyaṃtarato'gnimādadhuḥ || āsanaṃ brahmaṇe dattvā agniṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam || 3.2.18.70 || sthālīpākaṃ ca kṛtvātha kṛtvā vedīḥ śubhāstadā || caturhastāḥ sakalaśā nāgapāśa samanvitāḥ || 71 || vedamaṃtreṇa śubhreṇa maṃtrayaṃte tato dvijāḥ || caratāṃ daṃpatīnāṃ hi pariveśya yathocitam || 72 || brahmaṇā sahitāstatra vāḍavā ste suharṣitāḥ || kurvate vedanirghoṣaṃ tārasvaranināditam || 73 || tena śabdena mahatā kṛtsnamāpūritaṃ nabhaḥ || taṃ śrutvā dānavo ghoro vedadhvaniṃ dvije ritam || 74 || utpapātāsanāttūrṇaṃ sasainyo gatacetanaḥ || dhāvataḥ sarvabhṛtyāstaṃ ye cānye tānuvāca saḥ || 75 || śrūyatāṃ kutra śabdo'yaṃ vāḍavānāṃ samutthitaḥ || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daiteyāḥ satvaraṃ yayuḥ || 76 || vibhrāṃtacetasaḥ sarve itaścetaśca dhāvitāḥ || dharmāraṇye gatāḥ kecittatra dṛṣṭā dvijā tayaḥ || 77 || udgiraṃto hi nigamānvivāhasamaye nṛpa || sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsuḥ karṇāṭāya durātmane || 78 || tacchrutvā raktatāmrākṣo dvijadviṭ kopapū ritaḥ || abhyadhāvanmahābhāga yatra te daṃpatī nṛpa || 79 || khamāśritya tadā daityamāyāṃ kurvansa rākṣasaḥ || aharaddaṃpatī rājansarvālaṃkārasaṃyutān || || 3.2.18.80 || tataste vāḍavāḥ sarve saṃgatā bhuvaneśvarīm || buṃbāravaṃ prakurvāṇāstrāhitrāhīti cocire || 81 || tacchrutvā viśvajananī mātaṃgī bhuvaneśvarī || siṃhanādaṃ prakurvāṇā triśūlavaradhāriṇī || 82 || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ devīkarṇāṭayostathā || ṛṣīṇāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra vaṇijāṃ ca dvijanmanām || 83 || paśyatāmabhavayuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || astraiściccheda mātagī madavihvalitaṃ ripum || 84 || so'pi daityastatastasyā bāṇenaikena vakṣasi || asāvapi triśūlena ghātitaḥ kaśmalaṃ gataḥ || 85 || muṣṭibhiścaiva tāṃ devīṃ so'pi tāḍayate'suraḥ || so'pi devyā tataḥ śīghraṃ nāgapāśena yaṃtritaḥ || 86 || tatastenaiva daityena garuḍāstraṃ samādadhe || tayā nārāyaṇāstraṃ tu saṃdadhe śarapātanam||87 || evamanyonyamākṛṣya yudhyamānau jayecchayā || tataḥ parighamādāya āyasaṃ daityapuṃgavaḥ || 88 || mātaṃgīṃ prati saṃkuddho jaghāna paravīrahā || devī kruddhā muṣṭipātaiścūrṇayāmāsa dānavam || 89 || tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa mūrcchito nipapāta ha || tatastu sahasotthāya śaktiṃ dhṛtvā kare mudā || 3.2.18.90 || śataghnīṃ pātayāmāsa tasyā upari dānavaḥ || śaktiṃ ciccheda sā devī mātaṃgī ca śubhānanā || 91 || jahāsoccaistu sā subhraḥ śataghnīṃ vajrasannibhā || eva manyonyaśastraughairardayaṃtau parasparam || 92 || tatastriśūlena hato hṛdaye nipapāta ha || mūrchāṃ vihāya daityo'sau māyāṃ kṛtvā ca rākṣasīm || 93 || paśyatāṃ tatra teṣāṃ tu adṛśyo'bhūnmahāsuraḥ || papau pānaṃ tato devī jahāsāruṇalocanā || 94 || sarvatragaṃ taṃ sā devī trailokye sacarācare || 95 || kva pāsyastīti brūte sā brūhi tvaṃ sāṃprataṃ hi me || karṇāṭaka mahāduṣṭa ehi śīghraṃ hi yudhyatām || 96 || tato'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca bhayānakam || papau devī tu maireyaṃ vadhārthaṃ sumahābalā || 97 || mātaṃgī ca tataḥ kruddhā vaktre cikṣepa dānavam || tato'pi dānavo raudro nāsāraṃdhreṇa nirgataḥ ||98|| yudhyate sa punardaityaḥ karṇāṭo madapūritaḥ || tato devī prakupitā mātaṃgī madapūritā || 99 || daśanairmathayitvā ca carvayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || śavāsthi me dasā yuktaṃ majjāmāṃsādipūritam || 3.2.18.100 || nakharomābhisaṃyuktaṃ prakṣipya codare'suram || karekeṇa mukhaṃ ruddhaṃ kareṇaikena nāsikām || 101 || tato mahābalo daityaḥ karṇaraṃdhreṇa nirgataḥ || tatastayā mahādevyā nāma cakre tadā bhuvi || 102 || karṇaraṃdhraprasūto'yaṃ karṇāṭeti vidurbudhāḥ || punaryuddhārthamāyāto daityo hi baladarpitaḥ || 103 || garjamānosurastatra sāyudho yudhi saṃsthitaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥsahaṃ daityaṃ vimṛśya ca punaḥ punaḥ || 104 || vadhopāyaṃ hi mātaṃgī ciṃtayāmāsa bhārata || yadā ciṃtayate devī mātaṃgī madapūritā || 105 || māyārūpaṃ samāsthāya karṇāṭaḥ kusumāyudhaḥ || gauraścāṃbujapatrākṣaṃ stathā ṣoḍaśavārṣikam || 106 || abhyetya devīṃ brūte sma māṃ tvaṃ varaya śobhane || 107 || || śrīmātovāca || || sādhu cedaṃ tvayā proktaṃ daityarāja suniścitam|| rūpeṇa sadṛśo nānyo vidyate bhuvanatraye || 108 || pratijñā me kṛtā pūrvaṃ śrutā kimasurottamaṃ || mamānujā śubhā śyāmā vivāhe vipra kāṃkṣiṇī || 109 || pitrā me sthāpitā daitya rakṣārthaṃ hi dvijanmanām || kevalaṃ śyāmalāṃgī sā sarvalokahitāvahā || 3.2.18.110 || na kaścidvarayetka nyāmityuktvā sthāpitā tu sā || kathayāśu tava śubhaṃ śrutvopāyaṃ kathaṃ śubham || 111 || bhaginī me'sti daityeṃdra śyāmalāhyaparigrahā || tavārthaṃ rakṣitā śūra tāṃ ca pūrveṇa codvaha ||112|| sa pitā tāṃ mahāvīra dāsyate vai śubhāmimām|| gaccha tvaṃ vriyatāṃ hyeva śyāmalā kopasaṃyutā || 113 || tataḥ karṇāṭakaḥ kruddho gṛhītvā śaktimūrjitām || abhyadhāvata duṣṭātmā śyāmalānidhanecchayā ||114|| āgataṃ cāsuraṃ dṛṣṭvā śyāmalā sumahāmanāḥ|| vivāhārthaṃ paraṃ jñātvā'bhiprāyaṃ duṣṭacetasaḥ || 115 || mahāyuddhamabhūttatra śyāmalā'suravaryayoḥ || māsatrayaṃ tato rājaṃścābhavattumulaṃ kṣitau || 116 || māghe kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ dharmāraṇye mahāraṇe || madhyāhnasamaye bhūpa karṇāṭākhyo nipātitaḥ || 117 || kārṇāṭiḥ patitastatra yatra devyā nipātitaḥ || tacchaila śṛṃgapratimaṃ papāta śira uttamam || 118 || cacāla sakalā pṛthvī sābdhidvīpā saparvatā || tato viprāḥ prahṛṣṭāste jaya mātarudairayan || 119 || jagurgandharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || tatotsavaṃ prakurvanto gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ śubhapradam || 3.2.18.120 || pāyasairvaṭakaiścaiva naivedyairmodakaistathā || tuṣṭavuḥ śubhavāṇyā te sthāne moṭerake vare || 121 || śrīmatī pūjitā sā ca sutasaukhyadhanapradā || mahotsave ca saṃprāpte mātaṃgīpūjanaṃ hitam || 122 || ye 'rcayaṃti sthāpayitvā dhanaputrārthasiddhaye || sukhaṃ kīrtiṃ tathāyuṣyaṃ yaśaḥ puṇyaṃ samāpnuyuḥ || 123 || vyādhayo nāśamāyāṃti cādityādyā grahāḥ śubhāḥ || bhūtavetālaśākinyo jaṃbhādyāḥ pīḍayanti na || 124 || na jāyate tathā kvāpi pretādīnāṃ prapīḍanam || tato viprāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca stutiṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ || 125 || śrīmātā caiva śaktīśca mātaṃgīmastuvaṃstadā || śyāmalāṃ ca mahādevīṃ harṣeṇa mahatāyutā || 126 || || || viprā ūcuḥ || || mātastvamevamasmākaṃ rakṣikā sthānake bhava || daṃpatīnāṃ hitārthāya yathā nodvijate dvijāḥ || 127 || || mātaṃgyuvāca || || tuṣṭāhaṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ stavenānena vo dvijāḥ || varayadhvaṃ varaṃ yadvo manasā samabhīpsitam || 128 || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || dāsyāmahe baliṃ devi yaste manasi vartate || asmākaṃ caiva dampatyo rakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ sthirā bhava || 129 || || devyuvāca || || svasthāḥ saṃtu dvijāḥ sarve na ca pīḍā bhaviṣyati || mayi sthitāyāṃ durdharṣā daityā ye'nye ca rākṣasāḥ ||3.2.18.130|| śākinībhūtapretāśca jaṃbhādyāśca grahāstathā || śākinyādigrahāścaiva sarpā vyāghrādayastathā || 131 || pīḍayiṣyaṃti na kvāpi sthitāyāṃ mayi śāsane || mahotsavaṃ yaḥ kurute vivāhe samupasthite || 132 || daṃpatyośca hitārthaṃ hi pūjayenmāṃ sadā naraḥ || tasyāhaṃ sakalā bādhāṃ nāśayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 133 || nādhayo vyādhayaścaiva na kleśo na ca saṃbhramaḥ || prāpyate paramaṃ saukhyaṃ yaśaḥ puṇyaṃ dhanaṃ sadā || nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya vātapittādikaṃ nahi || 134 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || kena vā vidhinā pūjā naivedyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet || dhūpaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ mātaḥ kathaṃ pūjāṃ prakalpayet || 135 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || śrūyatāṃ me vaco viprā patre caiva hiraṇmaye || likhitvā pūjayedyastu cirāyurdaṃpatī bhavet || 136 || athavā rājate patre kāṃsapatre'thavā punaḥ || aṣṭādaśabhujā devīcaṃdanena vicarcitā || 137 || śūrpaṃ śaraiḥ kare śvānaṃ padmaṃ tu paramaṃ punaḥ || karttarīṃ kārayedekāṃ tūṇīraṃ ca dhanūṃṣi ca || 138 || carma pāśaṃ mudgaraṃ ca kāṃsālaṃ tomaraṃ tathā || śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śubhrāṃ muśalaṃ parighaṃ śubham || 139 || khaṭvāṃgaṃ badarīṃ caiva aṃkuśaṃ ca manoramam || aṣṭādaśāyudhairebhiḥ saṃyutā bhuvaneśvarī || 3.2.18.140 || likhetsakuṃḍalāṃ devīṃ bāhunūpurabhūṣitām || keyūramuktāpadmaiśca muṃḍamālābhiranvitām || 141 || mātṛkākṣaraparivṛtāmaṃgulīya kasaṃyutām || nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ likhitvā bhuvaneśvarīm || 142 || mātaṃgīmiti vikhyātāṃ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ || candanena ca hṛdyena puṣpaiścaiva prapūjayet || 143 || yakṣakardamamānīya mātaṃgīṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ || ghṛtena bodhayeddīpaṃ saptavartiyutaṃ śubham || 144 || dhūpayedguggulenātha sājyenāti sugaṃdhinā || nālikereṇa śubhreṇa dadyādarghaṃ ca daṃpatī || 145 || pradakṣiṇāḥ prakurvīta caturaḥ sumanoramam || vastrāṃśukaṃ guṃṭhayitvā agre kṛtvā ca daṃpatī || 146 || prokṣiṇīkṛtya mātaṃgyāḥ prāśya mādhvīkamuttamam || gītavāditranirghoṣairmātaṃgīṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ || 147 || suvāsinīstu tadrūpā mātaṃgīsaṃbhavā iti || nṛtyaṃtī dampatī cāgre sarvopadravaśāṃtaye || 148 || naivedyaṃ vividhānnena aṣṭādaśavidhaṃ śubham || vaṭakāpūpikāḥ śubhrāḥ kṣīraṃ śarkarayā yutam || 149 || ballākaraṃ varaṃ yūpā kṣiptakulmāṣakaṃ tathā || sohālikā bhinnavaṭā lāpsikā padmacūrṇakam || 3.2.18.150 || śaiveyā vimalāstatra parpaṭāḥ śālakādayaḥ || pūraṇaṃ tasya māsasya kuryācchubhraṃ manoramam || 151 || rājamāṣāḥ sūpacitāḥ kalpayettatra daṃpatī || pheṇikā ropikāstatra kuryāccaiva manoramāḥ || 152 || etānyaṣṭādaśānyāni pakvānnāni prakalpayet || ājyaśarkarāyuktāni yuktāni śākasaṃcayaiḥ || 153 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ suvāsinīṃ ca pūjayet || mukhāvalokanaṃ cājye kurvīyātāṃ ca dampatī || 154 || parasparaṃ hi kurvīta utpātapariśāṃtaye || evaṃ vidhaṃ mayākhyātaṃ mātaṃgīpūjanaṃ śubham || 155 || na pūjayati yo mūḍhastasya vipraṃ karoti sā || daṃpatyormaraṇaṃ cātha dhananāśaṃ mahābhayam || 156 || kleśaṃ rogaṃ tathā vahneḥ prādurbhāvaṃ prapaśyati || etasmātkāraṇādviprā mātaṃgīṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ || 157 || daṃpatīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dvijātīnāṃ ca śāsane || vaṇijāṃ ca mahādevī nirvighnaṃ kurute sadā || 158 || tatheti caiva tairukte punarvacanamabravīt || śrūyatāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vivāhādimahotsavam || 159 || madīyavacanaṃ śrutvā tathā kuruta vai vidhim || vivāhakāle saṃprāpte daṃpatyoḥ saukhyahetave ||3.2.18.160|| nirvighnārthaṃ tu kartavyaṃ nijaiśca saha sevakaiḥ || aṃjanaṃ nayane kuryātsaṃ baṃdhināṃ va sarvaśaḥ || 161 || bhrūmadhyāttu prakarttavyamarddhacaṃdrasamākṛti || biṃduṃ tu kārayedviprāstasyopari manoharam || 162 || evaṃ kṛte tadā viprāḥ śāṃtirbhavati nānyathā || putravṛddhikaraṃ caitattilakaṃ cārddhabiṃbakam || sarvavighnaharaṃ sarvadauḥsthyavyādhivināśanam || 163 || || vyāsa uvāca || || tataḥ śāṃtāḥ prajāḥ sarvā dharmāraṇye narādhipa || prasādāccaiva mātaṅgyā devyā vai satyamaṃdire ||164|| tato hṛṣṭahṛdā viprāḥ pupūjuste vidheḥ sutām || mātaṃgyāśca prakarttavyaṃ varṣevarṣe ca pūjanam || 165 || māghāsite tṛtīyāyāṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhistathā || karṇāṭasya tathotpattiḥ punarjātā tu bhūtale || 166 || bhayāccaiva hi tatsthānaṃ tyaktvā yāmyamagāttataḥ || gacchamānastadā daityo yakṣmarūpo hyabhāṣata ||167|| śrūyatāṃ bho dvijāḥ sarve dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || vaṇijaśca mahaccedaṃ madvākyaṃ paripālyatām || 168 || māghamāse hi matprītyā nirvighnārthaṃ sadā bhuvi || tridalena ca dhānyena mūlakena viśeṣataḥ || 169 || tila tailena vā kuryātpuruṣo niyatavrataḥ || ekāśanaṃ hi kurute yakṣmaprītyai niraṃtaram || 3.2.18.170 || ābālayauvanenaiva vṛddhenāpīha sarvadā || varṣevarṣe prakarttavyaṃ yakṣmaṇo vratamuttamam || 171 || yasmingṛhe hi yāvacca puruṣākārarūpiṇaḥ || tasyāhvayaṃ prakuryusta ekabhaktaratāḥ sadā || 172 || bālasyārthe tu jananī kurute vratamuttamam || pitā vāpyathavā bhrātā yannimittaṃ vrataṃ caret || 173 || na ca tasya bhayaṃ kvāpi na vyādhirna ca baṃdhanam || bharturnimitte strī kuryādaśakte tvitareṇa ca || 174 || evaṃ samādiśandaityaḥ satyamaṃdiramutsṛjan || gato'sau yāmyadigbhāga udadhestīra uttame || 175 || vipulaṃ deha māsādya karṇāṭaḥ sa narādhipa || svanāmnā caiva taṃ deśaṃ sthāpayāmāsa cottamam ||176|| yasmiṃśca sarvavastūni dhanadhānyāni bhūriśaḥ || karṇāṭadeśaṃ taṃ rājanparivārya ciraṃ sthitaḥ ||177|| dharmāraṇyakathāṃ puṇyāṃ kathitāṃ narasattama || śrīmātuścaiva māhātmyaṃ śṛṇvaṃti śrāvayaṃti ye || 178 || teṣāṃ kule kadā cittu ariṣṭaṃ naiva jāyate || aputro labhate putrāndhanahīnastu saṃpadaḥ || āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ śrīmātuśca prasādataḥ || 179 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye mātaṃgīkarṇāṭakopākhyānavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || cha || || ||
<3.2.19>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || indrasare naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ceṃdreśvaraṃ śivam || saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kena cādau nirmitaṃ tattīrthaṃ sarvottamottamam || yathāvadvarṇaya tvaṃ me bhagavandvijasattama || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || indreṇaiva mahārāja tapastaptaṃ suduṣkaram|| grāmāduttaradigbhāge śatavarṣāṇi tatra vai || 3 || śivoddeśaṃ mahāghoramekāṃguṣṭhena bhārata || urddhvabāhurmahātejāḥ sūryasyābhimukho'bhavat || || 4 || vṛtrasya vadhato jñātaṃ yatpāpaṃ tasya nuttaye || ekāgraḥ prayato bhūtvā śivasyārādhane rataḥ || 5 || tapasā ca tadā śaṃbhustoṣitaḥ śaśiśe kharaḥ || tatrājagāma jaṭilo bhasmāṃgo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 6 || khaṭvāṃgī paṃcavaktraśca daśabāhustrilocanaḥ || gaṃgādharo vṛṣārūḍho bhūtapretādiveṣṭitaḥ || 7 || suprasannaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpālurvaradāyakaḥ || tadā hṛṣṭamanā devo devendramidamūcivān || 8 || || hara uvāca || || yattvaṃ yācayase deva tadahaṃ prada dāmi te || 9 || || indra uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa kṛpāsiṃdho maheśvara || brahmahatyā hi māṃ deva udvejayati nityaśaḥ || 3.2.19.10 || vṛtrāsurasya hanane jātaṃ pāpaṃ surottama || tatpāpaṃ nāśaya vibho mama duḥkhapradaṃ sadā || 11 || || hara uvāca || || dharmāraṇye surapate brahmahatyā na pīḍayet || hatyā gavāṃ dvijātīnāṃ bālasya yoṣitāmapi || 12 || vacanānmama deveṃdra brahmaṇaḥ keśavasya ca || yamasya vacanājjiṣṇo hatyā naivātra tiṣṭhati || praviśya tvaṃ mahārāja atotra snānamācara || 13 || || indra uvāca || || yadi tvaṃ mama tuṣṭo'si kṛpāsiṃdho maheśvara || mannāmnā ca mahādeva sthāpito bhava śaṃkara || 14 || tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ suprasanno harastadā || darśayāmāsa tatraiva liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 15 || kūrmapṛṣṭhātsamutpādya ātmayogena śaṃbhunā || sthitastatraiva śrīkaṇṭhaḥ kālatrayavido viduḥ || 16 || vṛtrahatyāsamuttrastadevarājasya sannidhau || indreśvarastadā tatra dharmā raṇye sthito nṛpa || 17 || sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || indreśvaraṃ tu rājeṃdra puṣpadhūpādikaiḥ sadā || 18 || pūjayecca naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ māghamāse viśeṣataḥ || 19 || sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || nīlotsargaṃ tu yo martyaḥ karoti ca tadagrataḥ || 3.2.19.20 || uddharetsapta gotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatam || sāṃgarudrajapaṃ yastu caturddaśyāṃ karoti vai || 21 || sarvapāviśuddhātmā labhate paramaṃ padam || 22 || sauvarṇanayanaṃ kṛtvā madhye ratnasamanvitam || yo dadāti dvijātibhya indratīrthe tathottame || 23 || andhatā na bhave ttasya janmāni ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyayā || nirmalatvaṃ sadā teṣāṃ nayaneṣu prajāyate || mahārogāstathā cānye snātvā yāṃti tadagrataḥ || 24 || pūjite caikacitte na sarvarogātpramucyate || snātvā kuṇḍe naro yastu saṃtarpayati yaḥ pitṝn || 25 || tasya tṛptāḥ sadā bhūpa pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ || ye vai grastā mahārogaiḥ kuṣṭhādyaiścaiva dehinaḥ || 26 || snānamātreṇa saṃśuddhā divyadehā bhavaṃti te || jvarādikaṣṭamāpannā narāḥ svātmahitāya vai || 27|| snāna mātreṇa saṃśuddhā divyadehā bhavaṃti te || snātvā ca pūjayeddevaṃ mucyate jvarabandhanāt || 28 || ekāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ ca cāturthaṃ vā tṛtīyakam || viṣamajvarapīḍā ca māsapakṣādikaṃ jvaram || 29 || indreśvaraprasādācca naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || vijvaro jāyate nūnaṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ ca bhūpate || 3.2.19.30 || vandhyā ca durbhagā nārī kākavandhyā mṛtaprajā || mṛtavatsā mahāduṣṭā snātvā kuṇḍe śivāgrataḥ || pūjayedekacittena snānamātreṇa śuddhyati || 31 || evaṃvidhāśca bahuśo varāndattvā pinākadhṛk || gato'sau svapuraṃ pārtha sevyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 32 || tataḥ śakro mahātejā gato vai svapuraṃ prati || jayaṃtenāpi tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 33 || jayaṃtasya harastuṣṭastasmilliṃge stutaḥ sadā || trikālaṃ putrasaṃyuktaḥ pūjanārthaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 34 || āyāti ca mahābāho tyaktvā sthānaṃ svakaṃ hi vai || etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam || 35 || indreśvaraṃ tu yatpuṇyaṃ jayaṃteśasya pūja nāt || tadevāpnoti rājendra satyaṃsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || snātvā kuṇḍe mahārāja saṃpūjyaikāgramānasaḥ || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā indraloke mahīyate || 37 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti jayaṃteśapramādataḥ || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye indreśvarajayaṃteśvaramahimavarṇanonāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha ||
<3.2.20>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śivatīrthamanuttamam || yatrāsau śaṃkaro devaḥ punarjanmadharo'bhavat || 1 || kīlito devadeveśaḥ śaṃkaraśca trilocanaḥ || girijayā mahābhāga pātito bhūmimaṃḍale || 2 || chalito muhyamānastu divārātriṃ na vetti ca || puṃstrīnapuṃsakāścaiva jaḍībhūtastrilocanaḥ || 3 || kalpāṃtamiva saṃjātaṃ tadā tasmiṃśca kīlite || pārvatyā sahasā tasya kṛta kīlanakaṃ tadā || 4 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || etadāścaryamatulaṃ vacanaṃ yattvayoditam || yo guruḥ sarvadevānāṃ yogināṃ caiva sarvadā || 5 || pārvatyā kīlitaḥ kasmā nnaṣṭavṛttiḥ śivaḥ katham || kāraṇaṃ kathyatāṃ tatra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 6 || || vyāsa uvāca || || mantraughā vividhā rājañchaṃkareṇa prakāśitāḥ || pārvatyagre mahārāja atharvaṇopavedajāḥ || 7 || śākinī ḍākinī caiva kākinī hākinī tathā || ekinī lākinī hyetāḥ ṣaṭbhedāstatra kīrti tāḥ || 7 || bījānyuddhṛtya vai tābhyo mālā caikavṛtā kṛtā || śaṃbhunā kathitā caiva pārvatyagre nṛpottama || 9 || taiścaiva aṣṭā bhavati maṃtroddhāraḥ kṛtastu sā || sādhayetsā mahāduṣṭā śākinī pramadānaghe || 3.2.20.10 || || śrīpārvatyuvāca || || prakāśitāstvayā nātha bhedā hyete ṣaḍeva hi || ṣaḍvidhāḥ śaktayo nātha agamyāyogamālinīḥ || ṣaḍvidhoktaṃ tvayaikena kūṭātkṛtaṃ vadasva mām || 11 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || aprakāśo mahādevi devāsuraistu mānavaiḥ || 12 || || pārvatyuvāca || || namaste sarvarūpāya namaste vṛṣabhadhvaja || jaṭileśa namastubhyaṃ nīlakaṇṭha namostute || || 13 || kṛpāsiṃdho namastubhyaṃ namaste kālarūpiṇe || etaiśca bahubhirvākyaiḥ komalaiḥ karuṇānidhim || 14 || toṣayitvādritanayā daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca || jagrāha pādayugalaṃ tāṃ provāca dayāparaḥ || 15 || kimarthaṃ stūyase bhadre yācyatāṃ manasīpsitam || 16 || || pārvatyuvāca || || samāhāraṃ ca sadhyānaṃ kathayasva savistaram || asaṃdehamaśeṣaṃ ca yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava || 17 || || śrīrudra uvāca || || na prakāśyaṃ tvayā devisamāhārodbhavaṃ phalam || sarvaṃ tattvamahaṃ vakṣye maṃtrakūṭādyameva hi || 17 || māyābījaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ kūṭānāṃ hi varānane || sarveṣāṃ madhyamo varṇo biṃdunā dādiśobhitaḥ || 19 || vahnibījaṃ savātaṃ ca kūrmabījasamanvitam || ādityaprabhavaṃ bījaṃ śaktibījodbhavaṃ sadā || 3.2.20.20 || etatkūṭaṃ cādyabījaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca vibhormatam || tṛtīyaṃ cāgnibījaṃ tu saṃyuktaṃ biṃduneṃdunā || 21 || caturthaṃ yuktaṃ śeṣeṇa brahmabījamṛṣistathā || paṃcamaṃ kālabījaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ pārthiva bījakam || 22 || saptame cāṣṭame bāhyaṃ nṛsiṃhena samanvitam || navame dvitīyamekaṃ ca daśame cāṣṭakūṭakam || 23 || viparītaṃ tayorbījaṃ rudrākṣe vara cāriṇi || caturdaśe caturthyarthaṃ pṛthvībījena saṃyutam || 24 || kūṭāḥ śeṣākṣarāḥ kecidrakṣitā menakātmaje || sā papāta yadorvyāṃ hi śivapatnī tadā nṛpa || 25 || rāmeṇāśvāsitā tatra prahasaṃstripurāṃtakaḥ || bhadre yasmāttvayā pannaṃ jaṃvaśaktirbhaviṣyati || 26 || māraṇe mohane vaśye ākarṣaṇe ca kṣobhaṇe || yaṃyaṃ kāmayate nūnaṃ tatatsiddhirbhaviṣyati || 27 || iti śrutvā tadā devī duṣṭacittā śucismitā || kūṭaśeṣāstato vīrāḥ proktāstasyai tu śaṃbhu nā ||28|| uvāca ca kṛpāsiṃdhuḥ sādhayasva yathāvidhi|| kailāsāttu harastatra dharmāraṇyaṃ gato bhṛśam ||29|| jñātvā devī yayau tatra yatrāsau vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tatkṣaṇātpatito bhūmau dharmāraṇye nṛpottama ||3.2.20.30|| jaṭā caṃdroragāḥ śūlaṃ vṛṣabhādyāyudhāni3 || muṃḍamālā ca kaupīnaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇastu vai ||31|| gatā gaṇāśca sarvatra bhūtapretā diśo daśa || visaṃjñaṃ ca svamātmānaṃ jñātvā devo maheśvaraḥ || 32 || svedajāstu samutpannā gaṇāḥ kūṭādayastathā || paṃcakūṭānsamutpādya tasmāttadādhamūline || 33 || sādhakāste mahārāja japahomaparāyaṇāḥ || pretāsanāstu te sarve kālakūṭopari sthitāḥ || 34 || kathayaṃti svamātmānaṃ yena mokṣaḥ pinākinaḥ || tataḥ kaṣṭasamāviṣṭā gaurī vahnibhayāturā || 35|| sabhājitaḥ śivastaiśca gaurī hrīṇā tvadhomukhī || tapastepe ca tatrasthā śaṃkarādeśakāriṇī || 36 || paṃcāgnisevanaṃ kṛtvā dhūmrapānamadhomukhī || kūṭākṣaraiḥ stutastaistu toṣito vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 37 || dharākṣetramidaṃ rājanpāpaghnaṃ sarvakāmadam || devamajjanakaṃ śubhraṃ sthānake'sminvirājate || 38 || āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyā dine nṛpa || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 39 || pūjayitvā ca deveśamupoṣya ca vidhānataḥ || śākinī ḍākinī caiva vetālāḥ pitaro grahāḥ || 3.2.20.40 || grahā dhiṣṇyā na pīḍyaṃte satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane || sāṃgaṃ rudrajapaṃ tatra kṛtvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 41 || naśyaṃti trividhā rogāḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ ca bhūpate || etatsarvaṃ mayā khyātaṃ devamajjanakaṃ śṛṇu || 42 || aśvamedhasahasraistu kṛtaistu bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śrotā śrāvayitā naraḥ|| 43 || aputro labhate putrānnirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt || āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 44 || manovākkāyajanitaṃ pātakaṃ trividhaṃ ca yat || tatsarvaṃnāśamāyāti smaraṇātkīrtanānnṛpa || 45 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sukhasaṃtānadāyakam || māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyādvatsa sarvasaukhyānvito bhavet ||46|| sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam|| sarvayajñaiśca yatpuṇyaṃ jāyate śravaṇānnṛpa || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍa pūrvabhāge dharmāṇyamāhātmye dharākṣetravarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||

<3.2.22>
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || sthānavāsinyo yoginyaḥ kājeśena vinirmitāḥ || kasminsthāne hi kā devyaḥ kīdṛśyastā vadasva me || 1 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sarvajñosi kulīnosi sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayānagha || kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvamakhilena yudhiṣṭhira || 2 || nānābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā nānāratnopaśobhitāḥ || nānāvasanasaṃvītā nānāyuvasamanvitāḥ || 3 || nānāvāhanasaṃyuktā nānāsvaraninādinīḥ || bhayanāśāya viprāṇāṃ kājeśena vinirmitāḥ || 4 || prācyāṃ yāmyā mudīcyāṃ ca pratīcyāṃ sthāpitā hi tāḥ || āgneyā nairṛte deśe vāyavyeśānayostathā || 5 || āśāpurī ca gātrāī chatrāī jñānajā tathā || pippalāṃbā tathā śāṃtā siddhā bhaṭṭārikā tathā || 6 || kadaṃbā vikaṭā mīṭhā suparṇā vasujā tathā || mātaṃgī ca mahādevī vārāhī mukuṭeśvarī || 7 || bhadrā caiva mahāśaktiḥ siṃhārā ca mahābalā || etāścānyāśca bahavaḥ kathituṃ naiva śakyate || 8 || nānārūpadharā devyo nānāveṣasamāśritāḥ || sthānāduttaradigbhāge āśāpūrṇāsamīpataḥ || 9 || pūrve tu vidyate devī ānaṃdānaṃdadāyinī || vasaṃtī cottare devyo nānārūpadharā mudā || 3.2.22.10 || iṣṭānkāmāndadātyetā jaladānena tarpitāḥ || sthāne nairṛtidigbhāge śāṃtā śāṃtipradāyinī || 11 || siṃhopari samāsīnā caturhastā varapradā || bhaṭṭārī ca mahāśaktiḥ punastatraiva tiṣṭhati || 12 || saṃstutā pūjitā bhaktyā bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśinī || sthānāttu saptame krośe kṣemalābhā vyava sthitā || 13 || sā vilepamayī pūjyā ciṃtitā siddhidāyinī || pūrvasyāṃ diśi lokaistu balidānena tarpitā || parivāreṇa saṃyuktā bhuktimukti pradāyinī || 14 || aciṃtyarūpacaritā sarvaśatruvināśanī || saṃdhyāyāstriṣu kāleṣu pratyakṣaiva hi dṛśyate || 15 || sthānāttu saptame krośe dakṣiṇā vindhyavāsinī || sāyudhā rūpasaṃpannā bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇī || 16 || paścime niṃbajā devī tāvadbhūmisamāśritā || mahābalā sā dṛṣṭāpi nayanānanda dāyinī || 17 || sthānāduttaradigbhāge tāvadbhūmisamāśritā || śaktirbahusuvarṇākṣā pūjitā sāsuvarṇadā || 18 || sthānādvāyavyakoṇe ca krośamātra mite śritā || kṣetradharā mahādevī samaye cchāgadhāriṇī || 19 || purāduttaradigbhāge krośamātre tu karṇikā || sarvopakāraniratā sthānopadravanāśanī || 3.2.22.20 || sthānānnirṛtidigbhāge brahmāṇīpramukhāstathā || nānārūpadharā devyo vidyaṃte jalamātaraḥ || 21 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye devatāsthāpanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || || cha ||
<3.2.23>
|| vyāsa uvāca|| || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ purā || tatsarvaṃ kathayāmyadya śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 1 || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca vairādyuddhaṃ babhūva ha || tasminyuddhe mahāduṣṭe devāḥ saṃkliṣṭamānasāḥ || 2 || babhūvustatra sodvegā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 3 || || devā ūcuḥ || || brahmankena prakāreṇa daityānāṃ vadhameva ca || karomyadya upāyaṃ hi kathyatāṃ śīghrameva me ||4|| || brahmovāca || || mayā hi śaṃkareṇaiva viṣṇunā hi tathā purā || yamasya tapasā tuṣṭairdharmāraṇyaṃ vinirmitam || 5 || tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ yajñaṃ vā tapa uttamam || tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ bhavediti na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || pāpaṃ vā yadi vā puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ koṭi guṇaṃ bhavet || tasmāddaityairna dharṣitaṃ kadācidapi bhoḥ surāḥ || 7 || śrutvā tu brahmaṇo vākyaṃ devāḥ sarve savismayāḥ || brahmāṇaṃ tvagrataḥ kṛtvā dharmāra ṇyamupāyayuḥ || 8 || satraṃ tatra samārabhya sahasrābdamanuttamam || vṛtvā''cāryaṃ cāṃgirasaṃ mārkaṃṇḍeyaṃ tathaiva ca || 9 || atriṃ ca kaśyapaṃ caiva hotā kṛtvā mahāmatiḥ || jamadagniṃ gautamaṃ ca adhvaryutvaṃ nyavedayan || 3.2.23.10 || bharadvājaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ tu pratyadhvaryutvamādiśan || nāradaṃ caiva vālmīkiṃ nodanā yākarottadā || 11 || brahmāsane ca brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsurādarāt || krośacatuṣkamātrāṃ ca vediṃ kṛtvā suraistataḥ || 12 || dvijāḥ sarve samāhūtā yajñasyārthe hi jāpakāḥ || ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvānvai vedānudgirayaṃti ye || 13 || gaṇanāthaṃ śaṃbhusutaṃ kārttikeyaṃ tathaiva ca || indraṃ vajradharaṃ caiva jayaṃtaṃ candrasūnukam || 14 || catvāro dvārapālāśca devāḥ śūrā vinirmitāḥ || tato rākṣoghnamaṃtreṇa hūyate havyavāhanaḥ || 15 || tilāṃśca yavamiśrāṃśca madhvājyena ca miśritān || juhuvuste tadā devā vedamaṃtrairnareśvara || 16 || āghārāvājyabhāgau ca hutvā caiva tataḥ param || drākṣekṣupūganāriṃga jaṃbīraṃ bījapūrakam || 17 || uttarato nālikeraṃ dāḍimaṃ ca yathākramam || madhvājyaṃ payasā yuktaṃ kṛśaraśarkarāyutam || 18 || taṃḍulaiḥ śatapatraiśca yajñe vācaṃ niyamya ca || viciṃtya ca mahābhāgāḥ kṛtvā yajñaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 19 || uttamaṃ ca śubhaṃ stomaṃ kṛtvā harṣamupāyayuḥ || avāritānnamadadandīnāṃdhakṛpaṇeṣvapi || 3.2.23.20 || brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣeṇa dattamannaṃ yathepsitam || pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ sājyaśākasamanvitam || 21 || maṃḍakā vaṭakāḥ pūpāstathā vai veṣṭikāḥ śubhāḥ || sahasramodakāścāpi pheṇikā ghurghurādayaḥ || 22 || odanaśca tathā dālī āḍhakīsaṃbhavā śubhā || tathā vai mudgadālī ca parpaṭā vaṭikā tathā || 23 || pralehyāni vicitrāṇi yuktāstryūṣaṇasaṃcayaiḥ || kulmāṣā vellakāścaiva komalā vālakāḥ śubhāḥ || 24 || karkaṭikāścārdrayutā maricena samanvitāḥ || evaṃvidhāni cānnāni śākāni vividhāni ca || 25 || bhojayitvā dvijānsarvāndharmāraṇya nivāsinaḥ || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi saputrāṃśca tadā nṛpa || 26 || pratidinaṃ tadā devā bhojayaṃti sma vāḍavān || evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai kṛtvā yajñaṃtadāmarāḥ || 27 || kṛtvā daityavadhaṃ rājannirbhayatvamavāpnuyuḥ || svargaṃ jagmuste sahasā devāḥ sarve marudgaṇāḥ || 28 || tathaivāpsarasaḥ sarvā brahmavi ṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || kailāsaśikharaṃ ramyaṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ viṣṇuvallabham || 29 || brahmalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ prāpya sarve divaukasaḥ || paraṃ harṣamupājagmuḥ prāpya naṃdanamuttam || 3.2.23.30 || svesve sthāne sthirībhūtvā tasthuḥ sarve hi nirbhayāḥ || 31 || tataḥ kālena mahatā kṛtākhyayugaparyaye || lohāsuro madonmatto brahmaveṣadharaḥ sadā || 32 || āgatya sarvānviprāṃśca dharṣayeddharmavittamān || śūdrāṃśca vaṇijaścaiva daṃḍaghātena tāḍayet || 33 || vidhvaṃsayecca yajñādīnhomadravyāṇi bhakṣayet || vedikā dīrghikā dṛṣṭvā kaśmalena pradūṣayet || 34 || mūtrotsargapurīṣeṇa dūṣayetpuṇyabhūmikāḥ || gahanena tathā rājanstriyo dūṣayate hi saḥ || 35 || tataste vāḍavāḥ sarve lohāsurabhayāturāḥ || pranaṣṭāḥ saparīvārā gatāste vai diśo daśa || 36 || vaṇijaste bhayodvignā viprānanuyayurnṛpa || mahābhayena saṃbhītā dūraṃ gatvā vimṛśya ca||37|| saha śūdraidvijaiḥ sarva ekībhūtvā gatāstadā || muktāraṇyaṃ puṇyatamaṃ nirjanaṃ hi yayuśca te || 38 || nivāsaṃ kārayāmāsurnātidūre nareśvara || vajiṅnāmnā hi tadgrāmaṃ vāsayāmāsureva te || 39 || lohāsurabhayādrājanvipra nāmnā vinirmitam || śaṃbhunā vaṇijā yasmāttasmāttannāmadhāraṇam || 3.2.23.40 || śaṃbhugrāmamiti khyātaṃ loke vikhyātimāgatam || atha kecidbhayānnaṣṭā vaṇijaḥ prathamaṃ tadā || 41 || te nātidūre gatvā vai maṃḍalaṃ cakruruttamam || viprāgamanakāṃkṣāste tatra vāsamakalpayan || 42 || maṃḍaleti ca nāmnā vai grāmaṃ kṛtvā nyavīvasan || viprasārthaparibhraṣṭāḥ kecittu vaṇijastadā || 43 || anyamārge gatā ye vai lohāsurabhayārditāḥ || dharmāraṇyānnāti dūre gatvā ciṃtāmupāyayuḥ || 44 || kasminmārge vayaṃ prāptāḥ kasminprāptā dvijātayaḥ || iti ciṃtāṃ paraṃ prāptā vāsaṃ tatra tvakārayan || 45 || anyamārge gatā yasmāttasmāttannāmasaṃbhavam || grāmaṃ nivāsayāmāsuraḍālaṃjamiti kṣitau || 46 || yasmingrāme nivāsī yo yatsaṃjñaśca vaṇigbhavet || tasya grāmasya tannāma hyabhavatpṛthivīpate || 47 || vaṇijaśca tathā viprā mohaṃ prāptā bhayārditāḥ || tasmānmohetisaṃjñāste rājansarve nirabruvan || || 48 || evaṃ pranaṣaṇaṃ naṣṭāste gatāśca diśo diśa || dharmāraṇye na tiṣṭhaṃti vāḍavā vaṇijo'pi vā || 49 || udvasaṃ hi tadā jātaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ ca durlabham || bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṛtaṃ lohāsureṇa tat || 3.2.23.50 || naṣṭadvijaṃ naṣṭatīrthaṃ sthānaṃ kṛtvā hi dānavaḥ || parāṃ mudamavāpyaiva jagāma svālayaṃ tataḥ || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye jñātibhedavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<3.2.24>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || etattīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mayā proktaṃ tavāgrataḥ || anekapūrvajanmotthapātakaghnaṃ mahīpate ||1|| sthānānāmuttamaṃ sthānaṃ paraṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat || skaṃdasyāgre purā proktaṃ mahārudreṇa dhīmatā || 2 || tvaṃ pārtha tatra snātvā hi mokṣyase sarvapāta kāt || tacchrutvā vyāsavākyaṃ hi dharmmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 3 || dharmātmajastadā tāta dharmāraṇyaṃ samāviśat || mahāpātakanāśāya sādhupālanata tparaḥ || 4 || vigāhya tatra tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca || iṣṭāpūrtādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yathepsitam || 5 || tataḥ pāpavinirmuktaḥ punargatvā svakaṃ puram || idraprasthaṃ mahāsena śaśāsa vasudhātalam || 6 || idaṃ hi sthānamāsādya ye śṛṇvaṃti narottamāḥ|| teṣāṃ bhuktiśca muktiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| || 7 || bhuktvā bhogānpārthivāṃśca paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyuḥ || śrāddhakāle ca saṃprāpte ye paṭhaṃti dvijātayaḥ || 8 || uddhṛtāḥ pitarastaistu yāvaccaṃdrārkkamedini|| dvāpare ca yuge bhūtvā vyāsenoktaṃ mahātmanā || 9 || vārimātre dharmavāpyāṃ gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet || atrāgatasya martyasya pāpaṃ yamapade sthitam || || 3.2.24.10 || kathitaṃ dharmaputreṇa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || vinā annairvinā darbhairvinā cāsanameva vā || 11 || toyena nāśamāyāti koṭijanmakṛtaṃ tva gham || sahasramuruśṛṃgīṇāṃ dhenūnāṃ kurujāṃgale || dattvā sūryagrahe puṇyaṃ dharmavāpyāṃ ca tarpaṇām || 12 || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmāraṇyasya ceṣṭitam || yacchrutvā brahmahā goghno mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 13 || ekaviṃśativāraistu gayāyāṃ piṃḍapātane || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sakṛdasmiñchrute sati || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyatīrthamāhātmyaprabhāvakathanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 24 || || cha ||
<3.2.25>
|| sūta uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || dharmāraṇye yathā''nītā satyalokātsarasvatī || 1 || mārkaṃḍeyaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ mahāmuniniṣevitam || taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam || 2 || sarvatīrthamayaṃ divyamṛṣīṇāṃ pravaraṃ dvijam || āsanasthaṃ samāyuktaṃ dhanyaṃ pūjyaṃ dṛḍhavratam || 3 || yogātmānaṃ paraṃ śāṃtaṃ kamaḍaludharaṃ vibhum || akṣasūtradharaṃ śāṃtaṃ tathā kalpāṃ tavāsinam || 4 || akṣobhyaṃ jñāninaṃ svasthaṃ pitāmahasamudyutim || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā samādhisthaṃ praharṣotphullalocanam || 5 || praṇamya stutibhiryuktyā mārkkaṃḍaṃ munayo'bruvan || bhagavannaimiṣāraṇye satre dvādaśavārṣike || 6 || tvayāvatāritā brahmannadī yā brahmaṇaḥ sutā|| tathā kṛtaṃ ca tatraiva gaṃgā vataraṇaṃ kṣitau || 7 || gīyamāne kulapateḥ śaunakasya muneḥ puraḥ || sūtena muninā khyātamanyeṣāmapi śṛṇvatām || 8 || tacchrutvā mahadākhyānama smākaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam || pāpaghnī puṇyajananī prāṇināṃ darśanādapi || 9 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || dharmāraṇye mayā viprāḥ satyalokātsarasvatī || samānītā surekhādrau śaraṇyā śaraṇārthinām ||3.2.25.10|| bhādrapade site pakṣe dvādaśī puṇyasaṃyutā || tatra dvārāvatītīrthe munigaṃdharvasevite || || 11 || tasmindine ca tattīrthe piṃḍadānādi kārayet || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || 12 || mahadākhyānamakhilaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ ca yat || pavitraṃ yatpavitrāṇāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 13 || sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ jalam || ūrdhvaṃ kiṃ divi yatpuṇyaṃ prabhāsāṃte vyavasthitam || 14 || sārasvatajalaṃ nṝṇāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || sarasvatyāṃ narāḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || paścātpiṃḍapradātāro na bhavaṃti stanaṃdhayāḥ || 15 || yathā kāmadughā gāvo bhavantīṣṭaphalapradāḥ || tathā svargāpavargaikahaitubhūtā sarasvatī || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye sarasvatīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || || || cha ||
<3.2.26>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || mārkaṃḍeyoddhāṭitaṃ vai svargadvāramapāvṛtam || tatra ye dehasaṃtyāgaṃ kurvaṃti phalakāṃkṣayā || 1 || labhaṃte tatphalaṃ hyaṃte viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāpnuyuḥ || ataḥ kiṃ bahunoktena dvāravatyāṃ sadā naraiḥ || 2 || dehatyāgaḥ prakartavyo viṣṇorlokajigīṣayā || anāśake jale vāgnau ye ca saṃti narottamāḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktā yāṃti viṣṇoḥ purīṃ sadā || 3 || anyopi vyādhirahito gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ || sarvapāpa vinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ purīṃ naraḥ || 4 || śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ vasedaṃte divi dvijaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ bhuvi || 5 || upavāsai stathā tulyaṃ tapaḥ karmma na vidyate || nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guru || 6 || na dharmātparamastīha tapo nānaśanātparam || snātvā yaḥ kurute 'trāpi śrāddhaṃ piṃḍodakakriyām || 7 || tṛpyaṃti pitarastasya yāvadbrahmadivāniśam || tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā keśavaṃ yastu pūjayet ||8 || sa muktapātakaiḥ sarverviṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra saṃnihito hariḥ || 9 || harate sakalaṃ pāpaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe sthitasya saḥ || muktidaṃ mokṣakāmānāṃ dhanadaṃ ca dhanārthinām || āyurdaṃ sukhada caiva sarvakāmaphalapradam ||3.2.26.10|| kimanyenātra tīrthena yatra devo janārddanaḥ || svayaṃ vasati nityaṃ hi sarveṣāmanukampayā || 11 || tatra yaddīyate kiciddānaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam || akṣayaṃ tadbhavetsarvamiha loke paratra ca || 12 || yajñairdānaistapo bhiśca yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ || tadatra snānamātreṇa śūdrairapi susevakaiḥ || 13 || tatra śrāddhaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || sa pitṝnuddhare tsarvānnarakebhyo na saṃśayaḥ || 14 || akṣayyāṃ tṛptimāpnoti paramātmā janārddanaḥ || dīyate'tra yaduddiśya tadakṣayyamudāhṛtam || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye dvārikāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 |||cha||| ||
<3.2.27>
|| || sūta uvāca || || tatra tasya samīpasthaṃ mārkaṃḍenopalakṣitam || tīrthaṃ govatsasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvatra bhuvi saṃśrutam || 1 || tatrāvatīrya govatsasvarūpeṇāṃbikāpatiḥ || svayaṃbhūliṃgarūpeṇa saṃsthito jagatāṃ patiḥ || 2 || āsīdbalāhakonāma rudrabhakto mahābalaḥ || ākheṭakasamāyukto nṛpaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || 3 || mṛgayūthe sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā govatsaṃ tatpadātinā || ukto rājā mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kautukaṃ nṛpasattama || 4 || govatso mṛgayūthasya dṛṣṭo madhyasthito mayā || teṣāmevānurakto'sau jananyā rahitastathā || 5 || draṣṭuṃ tu kautukaṃ rājā taṃ padātiṃ puraḥ sthitam || uvāca darśayasveti govatsaṃ ca samāviśat || 6 || gatvāṭavīṃ tadā rājño darśitaḥ sa padātinā || padātibhirmṛgānīkaṃ dudrāva trāsitaṃ yadā || 7 || pīlugulmaṃ prati gataṃ govatsaḥ prasthitastadā || rājā taddharaṇākāṃkṣo prāviśadgulmamādarāt || 8 || tatra sthitaṃ sa govatsamapaśyannṛpatiḥ svayam || yāvadgṛhṇāti taṃ tāvalliṃgaṃ jātaṃ samujvalam || 9 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito rājā kimetadityaciṃtayat || yāvacciṃtayate hyevaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā divaṃ gataḥ || 3.2.27.10 || atrāṃtare gaganatale samaṃtataḥ śrūyate surajayakāragarjitam || papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiraṃbarādrājā gataḥ śivabhuvanaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt || 11 || tāvatpaśyati tannābhyaṃ govatsaṃ bālakaṃ sthitam || nūnameṣa mahādevo vatsarūpī maheśvaraḥ || 12 || tamānetuṃ samudyukto rājā tamujjahāra ca || tadā taddeva liṃgaṃ tu nottiṣṭhati kathaṃcana || tadā devāḥ sahānena prārthayāmāsurīśvaram || 13 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavansarvadeveśa sthātavyaṃ bhavatā vibho|| śuklena liṃgarūpeṇa sarvalokahitaiṣiṇā || 14 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || sthāsyāmyahaṃ sadaivātra liṃgarūpeṇa devatāḥ || yasmādbhādrapade māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe kuhū dine || 15 || tathā taddivase tatra snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || liṃgaṃ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti na teṣāṃ vidyate bhayam || 16 || ṛte ca piṃḍadānena pūrvajāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || raurave narake ghore kuṃbhīpāke ca ye gatāḥ || 17 || anekanarakasthāśca tiryagyonigatāśca ye || sakṛtpiṃḍapradānena syātte ṣāmakṣayā gatiḥ || 18 || tato balāhako rājā sarvadevasamanvitaḥ || sthāpayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ sarvadevasamīpataḥ || 19 || cakāra bahudānāni lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || yāvadarcayate hyevaṃ rudro'pi svayamāgataḥ || 3.2.27.20 || || rudra uvāca || || asyāṃ rātrau tu manujāḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitāḥ || yercayiṣyaṃti deveśaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyamanaṃtakam || 21 || jāgaraṃ ye kariṣyaṃti gītaśāstrapuraḥsaram || uddhariṣyaṃti te martyāḥ kulamekottaraṃ śatam || 22|| tāvadgarjjaṃti tīrthāni naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayā || prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca dvārakā mathurā'rbudaḥ || 23 || yāvanna dṛśyate liṃgaṃ govatsaṃ paramādbhutam|| yadā hi kurute bhāvaṃ govatsagamanaṃ prati || 24 || svavaṃśajāstadā sarve nṛtyaṃti harṣitā dhruvam || 25 || || sūta uvāca || || yaccānyadadbhutaṃ tatra vṛttāṃtaṃ śṛṇu ta dvijā || yena vai śrutamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 26 || yadā vai sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvadevaiḥ purātanam || viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhānaguṇātsarveṣāṃ ca divauka sām || 27 || aṇumātrapramāṇena pratyahaṃ samavarddhata || tataste manujā devā bhītāstaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 28 || || devā ūcuḥ || || vṛddhiṃ saṃhara deveśa lokā nāṃ svasti tadbhavet|| evamukte tato liṃgādvāguvācāśarīriṇī||29|| || śivavāṇyuvāca || || he lokā mā bhayaṃ vo'stu upāyaḥ śrūyatāmayam || kaściccaṃḍālamānīya matpuraḥ sthāpyatāṃ dhuvam ||3.2.27.30|| caṃḍālāṃśca samānīya dadhurdevasya te puraḥ|| tathāpi tasya vṛddhistu naiva nirvartate punaḥ ||31|| vāguvāca || karmmaṇā yastu caṃḍālaḥ so'gre me sthāpyatāṃ janāḥ || tacchrutvā mahadāścaryaṃ matiṃ cakurvilocane || 32 || mārgamāṇāstadā te tu grāmāṇi ca purāṇi ca || kañcitkarmarataṃ pāpaṃ dadṛśurbrāhmaṇabruvam ||33|| vṛṣabhānbhārasaṃyuktānmadhyāhnevāhayattu saḥ || kṣuttṛṭśramaparītāṃśca durbalānkrūramānasaḥ ||34|| asnātvāpi paryuṣitaṃ bhakṣayaṃtīha vai dvijāḥ || taṃ samādāya deveśaṃ jagmuryatra jagadguruḥ || 35 || devālayāgrabhūmau taṃ sthāpayāsurādṛtāḥ || bhasmī babhūva sahasā govatsāgre nirūpitaḥ || 36 || caṃḍālasthala ityeṣa prasiddhosau'bhavatkṣitau || tatra sthitairna cādyāpi prāsādo daśyate hi saḥ || || 37 || tadāprabhṛti talliṃgaṃ sāmyabhāvamupāgatam || dhautapāpmā gatastīrthaṃ dvijo liṃganirīkṣiṇāt || 38 || pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa govatsaṃ gata kilbiṣaḥ || viśeṣātkṛṣṇapakṣasya caturddaśyāṃ samāgataḥ || 39 || etattadadbhutaṃ tasya devasya ca triśūlinaḥ || śṛṇuyādyo naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 3.2.27.40 || || bhūta uvāca || || govatsamiti vikhyātaṃ narāṇāṃ puṇyadaṃ param || anekajanmapāpaghnaṃ mārkaṃḍeyena bhāṣitam || 41 || tatra tīrthe sakṛtsnānaṃ rudralokapradaṃ nṛṇām || pāpadehaviśuddhayarthaṃ pāpenopahatātmanām || 42 || kūpe tarpaṇataścaiva śrāddhataścaiva tṛptatā || bhādrapade viśe ṣeṇa pakṣasyāṃte bhavetkalau || 43 || ekaviṃśativārāṃstu gayāyāṃ tarpaṇe kṛte || pitṝṇāṃ paramā tṛptiḥ sakṛdvai gaṃgakūpake || 44 || tasmingovatsasāmīpye tiṣṭhate gaṃgakūpakaḥ || tasmiṃstilodakenāpi sadgatiṃ yāṃti tarpitāḥ || 45 || pitaro narakādvāpi supuṇyena sumedhasā || gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tasmiṃstīrthe munīśvarāḥ || 46 || viprāya svarṇadānaṃ tu rudraloke nayennaram || sarasvatīśivakṣetre gaṃgā ca gaṃgakūpake || 47 || ekasthametattritayaṃ svargāpavargakāraṇam || sevitaṃ carṣibhiḥ siddhaistīrthaṃ sarvatra viśrutam || 48 || pīluyugmaṃ sthitaṃ tatra tattīrthaṃ munisevitam || snānātsvargapradaṃ caiva pānātpāpaviśuddhidam || 49 || kīrttanātpuṇyajananaṃ sevanānmuktidaṃ param || tadvai paśyaṃti ye bhaktyā brahmahā yadi mātṛhā || || 3.2.27.50 || bālaghātī ca goghnaśca ye ca strīśūdraghātakāḥ || garadāścāgnidāścaiva gurudroharatāśca ye || 51 || tapasvinindakāścaiva kūṭasākṣyaṃ karoti yaḥ || vaktā ca paradoṣasya parasya guṇalopakaḥ || 52 || sarvapāpamayo'pyatra mucyate liṃgadarśanāt || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pātālakhaṇḍe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye balāhakopākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
<3.2.28>
|| vyāsa uvāca || govatsānnairṛte bhāge dṛśyate lohayaṣṭikā || svayaṃbhuliṃgarūpeṇa rudrastatra sthitaḥ svayam || || śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || mokṣatīrthe sarasvatyā nabhasye caṃdrasaṃkṣaye || viprānsaṃpūjya vidhivattebhyo dattvā ca dakṣiṇām || 1 || ekaviṃśativārāṃstu bhaktyā piṃḍasya yatphalam || gayāyāṃ prāpyate puṃsāṃ dhruvaṃ tadiha tarppaṇāt || 2 || lohayaṣṭyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe nabhasye caṃdrasaṃkṣaye || pretayonivinirmuktāḥ krīḍaṃti pitaro divi || 3 || api naḥ saṃkule bhūyādyo vai dadyāttilodakam || piṃḍaṃ vāpyudakaṃ vāpi pretapakṣe vidhūdaye || 3 || lohayaṣṭyāmamāvasyāṃ kāryaṃ bhādrapade janaiḥ || śrāddhaṃ vai munayaḥ prāhuḥ pitaro yadi vallabhāḥ || 5 || kṣīreṇa tu tilaiḥ śvetaiḥ snātvā sārasvate jale || pitṝṃstarpayate yastu tṛptāstatpitaro dhruvam || 6 || tatra śrāddhāni kurvīta saktubhiḥ payasā saha || amāvāsyādinaṃ prāpya pitṝṇāṃ mokṣamicchakaiḥ || 7 || rudratīrthe tato dhenuṃ dadyādvastrādibhūṣitām || viṣṇutīrthe hiraṇyaṃ ca pradadyānmokṣamicchukaḥ || 8 || gayāyāṃ pitṛrūpeṇa svayameva janārdanaḥ || taṃ dhyātvā puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ mucyate ca ṛṇatrayāt || 9 || prārthayettatra gatvā taṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam || āgato'smi gayāṃ deva pitṛbhyaḥ piṃḍaditsayā || eṣa piṃḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana || 3.2.28.10 || paralokagatebhyaśca tvaṃ hi dātā bhaviṣyasi || anenaiva ca maṃtreṇa tatra dadyāddhareḥ kare || 11 || caṃdre kṣīṇe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye piṃḍamāharet || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 12 || ekaviṃśativārāṃśca gayāyāṃ piṃḍapātanaiḥ || bhaktyā tṛptimavāpnoti lohayaṣṭyāṃ pitṛtarppaṇe || 13 || vāridastṛptimāpnoti sukhamakṣayyamatra hi || phalapradaḥ sutānbhaktānārogyamabhayapradaḥ||14|| vittaṃ nyāyārjitaṃ dattaṃ svalpaṃ tatra mahāphalam || snānenāpi hi tattīrthe rudrasyānucaro bhavet ||15|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekākāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye saṃkṣepata stīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || ||
<3.2.29>
sūta uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ hi lohāsuraviceṣṭitam || baleḥ putraśatasyāpi kathayiṣyāmi viśrutam || 1 || yathā tau bhrātarau vṛddhau prāpatuḥ sthānamuttamam|| tadā prabhṛti vairāgyaṃ daityo lohāsure dadhau || 2 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi tapase sthānamuttamam || yasya pāraṃ na jānaṃti devatā munayo narāḥ || 3 || ko mayā''rādhyatāṃ devo hṛdi ciṃtayate bhṛśam || iti ciṃtayatastasya matirjātā mahātmanaḥ || 4 || dadhau gaṃgāṃ svaśīrṣeṇa puṣpavaṃtau ca netrayoḥ || hṛdā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kaṭimaṃḍale || 5 || iṃdrādyā devatāḥ sarve yaddehe pratibiṃbitāḥ || prapaśyaṃti
