tadātmānaṃ bhāskaraḥ salile yathā || 6 || tamevārādhayiṣyāmi niraṃjanamakalmaṣaḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā matiṃ daitya stapastepe suduṣkaram || bhīto janmabhayādghorādduṣkaraṃ yanmahātmabhiḥ || 7 || aṃbubhakṣo vāyubhakṣaḥ śīrṇaparṇāśanastathā || divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ yadā tepe mahattapaḥ || tatastutoṣa bhagavāṃstriśūlavaradhārakaḥ || 8 || || īśvara uvāca || || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te manasā yadabhīpsitam || lohāsura mayā deyaṃ tava nāsti tapobalāt || 9 || ityukto dānavastatra śaṃkarāgre vaco'bravīt || 3.2.29.10 || || lohāsura uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa varamekaṃ vṛṇomyaham || śarīrasyājaratvaṃ ca mā mṛtyorapi me bhayam || 11 || janmanyasminprabho bhūyātsthātavyaṃ hṛdaye mama || evamastu śivaḥ prāha tatra taṃ dānaveśvaram || 12 || śarvalabdhavaro daivātpunastepe mahattapaḥ || ramye sarasvatītīre taraṇāya bhavārṇavāt || 13 || vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca || śaṃkate bhagavāniṃdro bhītastasya tapobalāt || 14 || mā me padacyutirbhūyāddaityallohāsurātkvacit || maghavānguptarūpeṇa sametyāśramakānanam || 15 || tapobhaṃgaṃ prakurute kaṃpayitvā mahāsuram || tāḍayaṃti śarīre taṃ muṣṭibhistīkṣṇakarkaśaiḥ || 16 || atha tena ca daityena dhyānamutsṛjya vīkṣitam || iṃdreṇa tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tapobalavināśanam || 17 || tasya tairabhavadyuddhamiṃdrādyairatha karkkaśaiḥ || ekasya bahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ devāste tena saṃyuge || 18 || rudhirāklinnadehā vai prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ || keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā trāhi trāhīti bhāṣiṇaḥ || 19 || || || sūta uvāca || || devānāṃ vākyamākarṇya vāsudevo janārdanaḥ || yuyudhe keśavastena yuddhe varṣaśataṃ kila || 3.2.29.20 || tato nārāyaṇaṃ tatra jigāya sa varorjitaḥ || atha nārāyaṇo devo jito lohāsureṇa tu || 21 || maṃtrayāmāsa rudreṇa brahmaṇā ca punaḥpunaḥ || mīmāṃsitvā trayo devāḥ punaryuddhasamudyamam || 22 || lohāsurasya daityasya vapurdṛṣṭvā punarnavam || mahadāsītpunaryuddhaṃ daityakeśavayostataḥ || 23 || na mamāra yadā daityo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || tarasā taṃ keśavo'pi pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 24 || uttānaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pinākī parameśvaraḥ || dadhāra hṛdaye tasya svarūpaṃ rūpavarjitaḥ || 25 || kaṇṭhe tasthau tato brahmā tasya lohāsurasya ca || caraṇau pīḍayāmāsa svasthityā puruṣottamaḥ || 26 || atha daityaḥ samuttasthau bhṛśaṃ baddhopi bhūtale || dṛṣṭvotthitaṃ tato daityaṃ pātayaṃtaṃ surottamān || 27 || uvāca divyayā vācā viraṃciḥ kamalāsanaḥ || 28 || || || brahmovāca || || lohāsura sadā rakṣa vācodharmamabhīkṣṇaśaḥ || tvayā yatprārthitaṃ rudrāttadeva samupasthitam || 29 || ahaṃ viṣṇuśca rudraśca trayo'mī surasattamāḥ || tvaddehamupavekṣyāmo yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 3.2.29.30 || dānaveśa śivaprāptirbhāvabhaktyaiva jāyate || śivaṃ cālayituṃ buddhiḥ kathaṃ tava bhaviṣyati || 31 || acalāṃścālayedyastu prāsādānbrāhmaṇānpurān || acireṇaiva kālena pātakenaiva lipyate || 32 || śmaśānavatparityājyaḥ satyadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || satyavāgasi bhadraṃ te mā vicālaya devatāḥ || 33 || yena yātāstu pitaro yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ || tena mārgeṇa gaṃtavyaṃ na collaṃghyā satāṃ gatiḥ || 34 || dānaveśa pitā te hi dadau lokatrayaṃ hareḥ || vākpāśabaddhaḥ pātāle rājyaṃ cakre mahīpatiḥ || 35 || tathā tvamasi vākpāśācchivabhaktisamanvitaḥ || bhūtale tiṣṭha daityeṃdra mā vāgvaikalpyamāpnuhi || 36 || varāṃste ca pradāsyāmo mā vicālyā hi devatāḥ || 37 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ saṃtuṣṭo dānaveśvaraḥ || prāha prasannayā vācā brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ haram || 38 || || lohāsura uvāca || || vākpāśabaddhastiṣṭhāmi na punarbhavatāṃ bale || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trayo'mī surasattamāḥ || 39 || sthāsyaṃti ceccharīre me kiṃ na labdhaṃ mayā tataḥ || idaṃ kalevaraṃ me hi samārūḍhaṃ tribhiḥ suraiḥ || 3.2.29.40 || bhūmyāṃ bhavatu vikhyātaṃ matprabhāvātsurottamāḥ || 41 || lohāsurasya vākyena harṣitā stridaśāstrayaḥ || daduḥ pratyuttaraṃ tasmai brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 42 || satyavākpāśato daityo na satyāccalito yataḥ || tena satyena saṃtuṣṭā dāsyā maste manīpsitam || 43 || || brahmovāca || || yathā snānaṃ brahmajñānaṃ dehatyāgo gayātale || dharmāraṇye tathā daitya dharmmeśvarapuraḥ sthite || 44 || kūpe tarppaṇakaṃ śrāddhaṃ śaṃsaṃti pitaro divi || saṃtuṣṭā piṃḍadānena gayāyāṃ pitaro yathā || 45 || vāṃchaṃti tarppaṇaṃ kūpe dharmāraṇye viśuddhaye || dānavendra śarīraṃ tu tīrthaṃ tava bhaviṣyati || 46 || ekaviṃśativārāṃstu gayāyāṃ tarppaṇe kṛte || pitṝṇāṃ yā parā tṛptirjāyate dānavādhipa || 47 || dharmeśvara purastātsā tvekadā pitṛtarpaṇāt || syādvai daśaguṇā tṛptiḥ satyameva na saṃśayaḥ || 48 || pitṝṇāṃ piṃḍadānena akṣayyā tṛptirastviha || śivarūpāṃtarāle vai dharmāraṇye dharātale ||49|| śraddhayaiva hi karttavyāḥ śrāddhapiṃḍodakakriyāḥ || tathāṃtarāle cāsmākaṃ śrāddhapiṃḍau viśeṣataḥ || 3.2.29.50 || tathā śarīre kvāpi stāṃciṃtā satyo'si suvrata|| triṣu lokeṣu duṣprāpaṃ satyaṃ te divi saṃsthitam ||51|| asmadvākyena satyena tattathā'surasattama || gayāsamadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tava jātaṃ dharātale||52|| asmākaṃ sthitiravyagrā tava dehe na saṃśayaḥ || satyapāśena baddhāḥ sma dṛḍhameva tvayā'nagha||53|| || viṣṇuruvāca || || gayāprayāga kasyā'pi phalaṃ samadhikaṃ smṛtam || caturddaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ lohayaṣṭyāṃ piṃḍadānataḥ || 54 || baliputrasya satyena mahatī tṛptiratra hi || mā kuruṣvātra saṃdehaṃ tava dehe sthitā svayam || 55 || sarasvatī puṇyatoyā brahmalokātprayātyuta || plāvayiṣyaṃti dehāṃgaṃ mayā saha susaṃgatā ||56|| yatho vai dvārakā vāso devastatra maheśvaraḥ || viraṃciryatra tīrthāni trīṇyetāni dharātale || 57 || bhaviṣyati ca pātāle svargaloke yamakṣaye || vikhyātānyasuraśreṣṭha pi tṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave ||58|| athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi gāthāṃ pitṛkṛtāṃ parām || ājñārūpāṃ hi putrāṇāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva mamānagha ||59|| pitara ūcuḥ|| śaṃkarasyāgrataḥ sthānaṃ rudralokapradaṃ nṛṇām || pāpadehaviśuddhyarthaṃ pāpenopahatātmanām ||3.2.29.60|| tasmiṃstilodakenāpi sadgatiṃ yāṃti tarpitāḥ || pitaro narakādvā pi suputreṇa sumedhasā || 61 || gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tattatra pitṛmuktaye || pitrādikānsamuddiśya dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ ca keśavam ||62|| tilapiṇyākapiṃḍena tṛptiṃ yāsyāmahe parām || caturddaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ tathā ca pitṛtarpaṇam || 63 || ajñātagotrajanmānastebhyaḥ piṃḍāṃstu nirvapet || te'pi yāṃti divaṃ sarve ye datta iti śrutiḥ || 64 || sarvakāryāṇi saṃtyajya mānavaiḥ puṇyamīpsubhiḥ || prāpte bhādrapade māse gaṃtavyā lohayiṣṭakā || ajñātagotranāmnā tu piṃḍa maṃtramimaṃ śṛṇu || 65 || pitṛvaṃśe mṛtā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca || atītagotrajāstebhyaḥ piṃḍo'yamupatiṣṭhatu || 66 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa mamāgre surasattama || kṣīṇe caṃdre caturddaśyāṃ nabhasye piṃḍamāharet || 67 || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || tilapiṇyākapiṃḍena pitaro mokṣamāpnuyuḥ || 68 || kṣaṇatrayavinirmuktā mānavā jagatītale || bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃdeho lohayaṣṭyā tilatarpaṇe || 69 || snātvā yaḥ kurute cātra pitṛpiṃḍodakakriyāḥ || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadbrahmadivāniśam || 3.2.29.70 || amāvāsyādinaṃ prāpya māsi bhādrapade saraḥ || brahmaṇo yaṣṭikāyāṃ tu yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam || 71 || pitarastasya tṛptāḥ syuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || teṣāṃ prasanno bhagavānādidevo maheśvaraḥ || 72 || asya tīrthasya yātrāyāṃ matiryeṣāṃ bhaviṣyati || gokṣīreṇa tilaiḥ śvetaiḥ snātvā sārasvate jale || 73 || tarpayedakṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tasya jāyate || śrāddhaṃ caiva praku rvīta saktubhiḥ payasā saha || 74 || amāvāsyādinaṃ prāpya pitṝṇāṃ modamicchukaḥ || rudratīrthe tato dhenuṃ dayādvastrāṇi yamatīrthake || 75 || viṣṇutīrthe hiraṇyaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ mokṣamicchukaḥ || vinākṣatairvinā darbhairvinā cāsanameva ca || vārimātrāllohayaṣṭyāṃ gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet || 76 || || sūta uvāca || || etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprā lohāsuraviceṣṭitam || yacchrutvā brahmahā goghno mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 77 || ekaviṃśativārantu gayāyāṃ piṃḍa pātane || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sakṛdasmiñchrute sati || 78 || catuḥṣkoṭi dvilakṣaṃ ca sahasraṃ śatameva ca || dhenavastena dattāḥ syurmāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu yāttu yaḥ || 79 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye lohāsuramāhātmyasaṃpūrtirnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || cha || ||
<3.2.30>
vyāsa uvāca || || purā tretāyuge prāpte vaiṣṇavāṃśo raghūdvahaḥ || sūryavaṃśe samutpanno rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || 1 || sa rāmo lakṣmaṇaścaiva kākapakṣadharāvubhau || tātasya vacanāttau tu viśvāmitramanuvratau || 2 || yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya rājñā dattau kumārakau || dhanuḥśaradharau vīrau piturvacanapālakau || 3 || pathi pravrajato yāvattāḍakānāma rākṣasī || tāvadāgamya puratastasthau vai vighnakāraṇāt || || 4 || ṛṣeranujñayā rāmastāḍakāṃ samaghātayat|| prādiśacca dhanurvedavidyāṃ rāmāya gādhijaḥ ||5|| tasya pādatalasparśācchilā vāsavayogataḥ || ahalyā gautamavadhūḥ punarjātā svarūpiṇī || 6 || viśvāmitrasya yajñe tu saṃpravṛtte raghūttamaḥ || mārīcaṃ ca subāhuṃ ca jaghāna parameṣubhiḥ ||7|| īśvarasya dhanurbhagnaṃ janakasya gṛhe sthitam || rāmaḥ paṃcadaśe varṣe ṣaḍvarṣāṃ caiva maithilīm || 8 || upayeme tadā rājanramyāṃ sītāmayonijām || kṛtakṛtyastadā jātaḥ sītāṃ saṃprāpya rāghavaḥ || 9 || ayodhyāmagamanmārge jāmadagnyamavekṣya ca || saṃgrāmo'bhūttadā rājandevānāmapi duḥsahaḥ || 3.2.30.10 || tato rāmaṃ parājitya sītayā gṛhamāgataḥ || tato dvādaśavarṣāṇi reme rāmastayā saha || 11 || ekaviṃśatime varṣe yauvarājyapradāyakam || rājānamatha kaikeyī varadvayamayāca ta || 12 || tayorekena rāmastu sasītaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ || jaṭādharaḥ pravrajatāṃ varṣāṇīha caturdaśa || 13 || bharatastu dvitīyena yauvarājyādhipostu me || maṃtharāvacanānmūḍhā varametamayācata || 14 || jānakīlakṣmaṇasakhaṃ rāmaṃ prāvrājayannṛpaḥ || trirātramudakāhāraścaturthehni phalāśanaḥ || 15 || pañcame citrakūṭe tu rāmo vāsamakalpayat || tadā daśarathaḥ svargaṃ gato rāma iti bruvan || 16 || brahmaśāpaṃ tu saphalaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ jagāma kim || tato bharata śatrughnau citrakūṭe samāgatau || 17 || svargataṃ pitaraṃ rājanrāmāya vinivedya ca || sāṃtvanaṃ bharatasyāsya kṛtvā nivartanaṃ prati || 18 || tato bharata śatrughnau naṃdigrāmaṃ samāgatau || pādukāpūjanaratau tatra rājyadharāvubhau || 19 || atriṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamāgamata || rakṣogaṇavadhārambhe virādhe vinipātite || 3.2.30.20 || arddhatrayodaśe varṣe paṃcavaṭyāmuvāsa ha || tato virūpayāmāsa śūrpaṇakhāṃ niśācarīm || vane vicarataratasya jānakīsahitasya ca || 21 || āgato rākṣaso ghoraḥ sītāpaharaṇāya saḥ || tato māghāsitāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vṛndasaṃjñake || 22 || rāghavābhyāṃ vinā sītāṃ jahāra daśa kandharaḥ || mārīcasyāśramaṃ gatvā mṛgarūpeṇa tena ca || 23 || nītvā dūraṃ rāghavaṃ ca lakṣmaṇena samanvitam || tato rāmo jaghānāśu mārīcaṃ mṛgarū piṇam || 24 || punaḥ prāpyāśramaṃ rāmo vinā sītāṃ dadarśa ha || tatraiva hriyamāṇā sā cakraṃda kurarī yathā || 25 || rāmarāmeti māṃ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ rakṣasā hṛtām|| yathā śyenaḥ kṣudhāyuktaḥ krandaṃtīṃ vartikāṃ nayet || 26 || tathā kāmavaśaṃ prāpto rākṣaso janakātmajām || nayatyeṣa janakajāṃ tacchrutvā pakṣirāṭ tadā || 27 || yuyudhe rākṣaseṃdreṇa rāvaṇena hato'patat || māghāsitanavamyāṃ tu vasaṃtīṃ rāvaṇālaye || 28 || mārgamāṇau tadā tau tu bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau || 29 || jaṭāyuṣaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva jñātvā rākṣasasaṃhṛtām || sītāṃ jñātvā tataḥ pakṣī saṃskṛtastena bhaktitaḥ || 3.2.30.30 || agrataḥ prayayau rāmo lakṣmaṇastatpadānugaḥ || paṃpābhyāśamanuprāpya śabarīmanugṛhya ca ||31|| tajjalaṃ samupaspṛśya hanumaddarśanaṃ kṛtam || tato rāmo hanumatā saha sakhyaṃ cakāra ha || 32 || tataḥ sugrīvamabhyetya ahanadvālivānaram || preṣitā rāmadevena hanumatpramukhāḥ priyām || 33 || aṃgulīyakamādāya vāyusūnustadāgataḥ || saṃpātirdaśame māsi ācakhyau vānarāya tām ||34|| tatastadvacanādabdhiṃ pupluve śatayojanam || hanumānniśi tasyāṃ tu laṃkāyāṃ parito'cinot||35|| tadrātriśeṣe sītāyā darśanaṃ tu hanūmataḥ || dvādaśyāṃ śiṃśapāvṛkṣe hanumānparyavasthitaḥ || 36 || tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ jānakyā viśvāsāyāha saṃkathām || akṣādibhistrayodaśyāṃ tato yuddhamavarttata || 37 || brahmāstreṇa trayodaśyāṃ baddhaḥ śakrajitā kapiḥ || dāruṇāni ca rūkṣāṇi vākyāni rākṣasādhipam || || 38 || abravīdvāyusūnustaṃ baddho brahmāstrasaṃyutaḥ || vahninā pucchayuktena laṃkāyā dahanaṃ kṛtam || 39 || pūrṇimāyāṃ maheṃdrādrau punarāgamanaṃ kapeḥ || mārgaśīrṣapratipadaḥ paṃcabhiḥ pathi vāsaraiḥ || 3.2.30.40 || punarāgatya varṣehni dhvastaṃ madhuvanaṃ kila || saptamyāṃ pratyabhijñānadānaṃ sarvanivedanam || 41 || maṇipradānaṃ sītāyāḥ sarvaṃ rāmāya śaṃsayat || aṣṭamyuttaraphālgunyāṃ muhūrte vijayābhidhe || 42 || madhyaṃ prāpte sahasrāṃśau prasthānaṃ rāghavasya ca || rāmaḥ kṛtvā pratijñāṃ hi prayātuṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam|| 43 || tīrtvāhaṃ sāgaramapi haniṣye rākṣaseśvaram || dakṣiṇāśāṃ prayātasya sugrīvo'thābhava tsakhā || 44 || vāsaraiḥ saptabhiḥ siṃdhostīre sainyaniveśanam || pauṣaśuklapratipadastṛtīyāṃ yāvadaṃbudhau || upasthānaṃ sasainyasya rāghavasya babhūva ha||45|| vibhīṣaṇaścaturthyāṃ tu rāmeṇa saha saṃgataḥ || samudrataraṇārthāya paṃcamyāṃ maṃtra udyateḥ || 46 || prāyopaveśanaṃ cakre rāmo dinacatuṣṭayam || samudrādvaralābhaśca sahopāyapradarśanaḥ || 47 || setordaśamyāmāraṃbhastrayodaśyāṃ samāpanam || caturdaśyāṃ suvelādrau rāmaḥ senāṃ nyave śayat || 48 || pūrṇimāsyā dvitīyāyāṃ tridinaiḥ sainyatāraṇam || tīrtvā toyanidhiṃ rāmaḥ śūravānarasainyavān || 49 || rurodha ca purīṃ laṃkāṃ sītārthaṃ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ || tṛtīyādidaśamyaṃtaṃ niveśaśca dināṣṭakaḥ || 3.2.30.50 || śukasāraṇayostatra prāptirekādaśīdine || pauṣāsite ca dvādaśyāṃ sainyasaṃkhyānameva ca || 51 || śārdūlena kapīṃdrāṇāṃ sārāsāropavarṇanam || trayodaśyādyamāṃte ca laṃkāyāṃ divasaistribhiḥ || 52 || rāvaṇaḥ sainyasaṃ khyānaṃ raṇotsāhaṃ tadā'karot || prayayāvaṃgado dautye māghaśuklādyavāsare || 53 || sītāyāśca tadā bharturmāyāmūrdhādidarśanam || māghaśukladvitīyā yāṃ dinaiḥ saptabhiraṣṭamīm || 54 || rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca yuddhamāsīcca saṃkulam || māghaśuklanavamyāṃ tu rātrāviṃdrajitā raṇe || 55 || rāmalakṣmaṇayornā gapāśabaṃdhaḥ kṛtaḥ kila || ākuleṣu kapīśeṣu hatāśeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ || 56 || vāyūpadeśādgaruḍaṃ sasmāra rāghavastadā || nāgapāśavimokṣārthaṃ daśamyāṃ garu ḍo'bhyagāt || 57 || avahāro māghaśuklaisyaikādaśyāṃ dinadvayam || dvādaśyāmāṃjaneyena dhūmrākṣasya vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 58 || trayodaśyāṃ tu tenaiva nihato'kaṃpano raṇe || māyāsītāṃ darśayitvā rāmāya daśakaṃdharaḥ || 59 || trāsayāmāsa ca tadā sarvānsainyagatānapi || māghaśuklacaturddaśyāṃ yāvatkṛṣṇādivāsaram || 3.2.30.60 || tridinena prahastasya nīlena vihito vadhaḥ || māghakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāścaturthyaṃtaṃ tribhirdinaiḥ || 61 || rāmeṇa tumule yuddhe rāvaṇo drāvito raṇāt || pañcamyā aṣṭamī yāvadrāvaṇena prabodhitaḥ || 62 || kuṃbhakarṇastadā cakre'bhyavahāraṃ caturdinam || kumbhakarṇokarodyuddhaṃ navamyādicaturdinaiḥ || 63 || rāmeṇa nihato yuddhe bahuvānarabhakṣakaḥ || amāvāsyādine śokā'bhyavahāro babhūva ha || 64 || phālgunapratipadādau caturthyaṃtaiścaturdinaiḥ || narāṃtakaprabhṛtayo nihatāḥ pañca rākṣasāḥ || 65 || paṃcamyāḥ saptamīṃ yāvadatikāyavadhastryahāt || aṣṭamyā dvādaśīṃ yāvannihato dinapaṃcakāt || 66 || nikumbhakumbhau dvāvetau makarākṣaścaturdinaiḥ || phālgunāsitadvitīyāyā dine vai śakrajijjitaḥ || 67 || tṛtīyādau saptamyaṃtadinapañcakameva ca || oṣadhyānayavaiyagryādavahāro babhūva ha || 68 || aṣṭamyāṃ rāvaṇo māyāmaithilīṃ hatavānkudhīḥ|| śokāvegāttadā rāmaścakre sainyāvadhāraṇam || 69 || tatastrayodaśīṃ yāvaddinaiḥ paṃcabhiriṃdrajit || lakṣmaṇena hato yuddhe vikhyātabalapauruṣaḥ || 3.2.30.70 || caturddaśyāṃ daśagrīvo dīkṣāmāpāvahārataḥ || amāvāsyādine prāgādyuddhāya daśakaṃdharaḥ || 71 || caitraśuklapratipadaḥ paṃcamīdinapaṃcake || rāvaṇo yudhyamāno 'bhūtpracuro rakṣasāṃ vadhaḥ || 72 || caitraśuklāṣṭamīṃ yāvatsyaṃdanāśvādisūdanam || caitraśuklanavamyāṃ tu saumitreḥ śaktibhedane || 73 || kopāviṣṭena rāmeṇa drāvito daśakaṃdharaḥ || vibhīṣaṇopadeśena hanumadyuddhameva ca || 74 || droṇādreroṣadhīṃ netuṃ lakṣmaṇārthamupāgataḥ || viśalyāṃ tu samādāya lakṣmaṇaṃ tāmapāyayat || 75 || daśamyāmavahāro'bhūdrātrau yuddhaṃ tu rakṣasām || ekādaśyāṃ tu rāmāya ratho mātalisārathiḥ || 76 || prāpto yuddhāya dvādaśyāṃ yāvatkṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīm || aṣṭādaśadine rāmo rāvaṇaṃ dvairathe'vadhīt || 77 || saṃskārā rāvaṇādīnāmamāvā syādine'bhavan || saṃgrāme tumule jāte rāmo jayamavāptavān || 78 || māghaśukladvitīyādicaitrakṛṣṇacaturddaśīm || saptāśītidinānyevaṃ madhye paṃvadaśā hakam || 79 || yuddhāvahāraḥ saṃgrāmo dvāsaptatidinānyabhūt || vaiśākhādi tithau rāma uvāsa raṇabhūmiṣu || abhiṣikto dvitīyāyāṃ laṃkārājye vibhī ṣaṇaḥ || 3.2.30.80 || sītāśuddhistṛtīyāyāṃ devebhyo varalaṃbhanam || daśarathasyāgamanaṃ tatra caivānumodanam || 81 || hatvā tvareṇa laṃkeśaṃ lakṣmaṇasyāgrajo vibhuḥ||| gṛhītvā jānakīṃ puṇyāṃ duḥkhitāṃ rākṣasena tu || 82 || ādāya parayā prītyā jānakīṃ sa nyavartata || vaiśākhasya caturthyāṃ tu rāmaḥ puṣpakamā śritaḥ || 83 || vihāyasā nivṛttastu bhūyo'yodhyāṃ purīṃ prati || pūrṇe caturdaśe varṣe paṃcamyāṃ mādhavasya ca || 84 || bhāradvājāśrame rāmaḥ sagaṇaḥ samu pāviśat || naṃdigrāme tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sa puṣpakeṇa samāgataḥ || 85 || saptamyāmabhiṣikto'sau bhūyo'yodhyāyāṃ raghūdvahaḥ || daśāhādhikamāsāṃśca caturdaśa hi maithilī || 85 || uvāsa rāmarahitā rāvaṇasya niveśane || dvācatvāriṃśake varṣe rāmo rājyamakārayat || 87 || sītāyāstu trayastriṃśadvarṣāṇi tu tadā bhavan || sa caturdaśavarṣāṃte praviṣṭaḥ svāṃ purīṃ prabhuḥ || 88 || ayodhyāṃ nāma mudito rāmo rāvaṇadarpahā || bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitastatra rāmo rājyamakāra yat || 89 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca || rāmo rājyaṃ pālayitvā jagāma tridivālayam || 3.2.30.90 || rāmarājye tadā lokā harṣanirbharamā nasāḥ || babhūvurdhanadhānyāḍhyāḥ putrapautrayutā narāḥ || 91 || kāmavarṣī ca parjanyaḥ sasyāni guṇavaṃti ca || gāvastu ghaṭadohinyaḥ pādapāśca sadā phalāḥ || 92 || nādhayo vyādhayaścaiva rāmarājye narādhipa || nāryaḥ pativratāścāsanpitṛbhaktiparā narāḥ || 93 || dvijā vedaparā nityaṃ kṣatriyā dvija sevinaḥ || kurvate vaiśyavarṇāśca bhaktiṃ dvijagavāṃ sadā || 94 || na yonisaṃkaraścāsīttatra nācārasaṃkaraḥ || na vaṃdhyā durbhagā nārī kākavaṃdhyā mṛta prajā || 95 || vidhavā naiva kāpyāsītsabhartṛkā na lapyate || nāvajñāṃ kurvate kepi mātāpitrorgurostathā || 96 || na ca vākyaṃ hi vṛddhānāmullaṃ ghayati puṇyakṛt || na bhūmiharaṇaṃ tatra paranārīparāṅmukhāḥ || 97 || nāpavādaparo loko na daridro na rogabhāk || na steyo dyūtakārī ca maireyī pāpino nahi || 98 || na hemahārī brahmaghno na caiva gurutalpagaḥ || na strīghno na ca bālaghno na caivānṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ || 99 || na vṛttilopakaścāsītkūṭa sākṣī na caiva hi || na śaṭho na kṛtaghnaśca malino naiva dṛśyate || 3.2.30.100 || sadā sarvatra pūjyaṃte brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || nāvaiṣṇavo'vratī rājanrāma rājye'tiviśrute || 101 || rājyaṃ prakurvatastasya purodhā vadatāṃ varaḥ || vasiṣṭho munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛtvā tīrthānyanekaśaḥ || 102 || ājagāma brahmaputro mahābhāgastaponidhiḥ || rāmastaṃ pūjayāmāsa munibhiḥ sahitaṃ gurum || 103 || abhyutthānārghapādyaiśca madhuparkādipūjayā || prapaccha kuśalaṃ rāmaṃ vasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ || 104 || rājye cāśve gaje kośe deśe sadbhrātṛbhṛtyayoḥ || kuśalaṃ varttate rāma iti pṛṣṭe munestadā || 105 || || rāma uvāca || || sarvatra kuśalaṃ me'dya prasādādbhavataḥ sadā || papraccha kuśalaṃ rāmo vasiṣṭhaṃ munipuṃgavam || 106 || sarvataḥ kuśalī tvaṃ hi bhāryāputrasamanvitaḥ || sa sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa yathā tīrthānyaśeṣataḥ || 107 || sevitāni dharāpṛṣṭhe kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca || rāmāya kathayāmāsa sarvatra kuśalaṃ tadā || 108 || tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || papraccha tīrthamāhātmyaṃ yattīrtheṣūttamottamam || 109 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye rāmacaritravarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || || cha || ||
<3.2.31>
śrīrāma uvāca || || bhagavanyāni tīrthāni sevitāni tvayā vibho || eteṣāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tanmamācakṣva mānada || 1 || mayā tu sītāharaṇe nihatā brahmarākṣasāḥ || tatpāpasya viśudayarthaṃ vada tīrthottamottamam || 2 || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || gaṃgā ca narmadā tāpī yamunā ca sarasvatī || gaṃḍakī gomatī pūrṇā etā nadyaḥ supāvanāḥ || 3 || etāsāṃ narmadā śreṣṭhā gaṃgā tripathagāminī || dahate kilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ darśanādeva rāghava || 4 || dṛṣṭvā janmaśataṃ pāpaṃ gatvā janmaśatatrayam || snātvā janmasahasraṃ ca haṃti revā kalau yuge || 5 || narmadātīramāśritya śākamūlaphalairapi || ekasminbhojite vipre koṭi bhojaphalaṃ labheta || 6 || gaṃgā gaṃgeti yo brūyādyojanānāṃ śatairapi || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 7 || phālgunāṃte kuhūṃ prāpya tathā prauṣṭhapade'site || pakṣe gaṃgāmadhi prāpya snānaṃ ca pitṛtarpaṇam || 8 || kurute piṃḍadānāni so'kṣayaṃ phalamaśnute || śucau māse ca saṃprāpte snānaṃ vāpyāṃ karoti yaḥ || 9 || caturaśītinarakānna paśyati naro nṛpa || tapatyāḥ smaraṇe rāma mahāpātakināmapi || 3.2.31.10 || uddharetsaptagotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatam || yamunāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 11 || mahāpātakayukto'pi sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge sarasvatyāṃ nimajjayet || 12 || gacchetsa garuḍārūḍhaḥ stūyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ || snātvā yaḥ kārtike māsi yatra prācī sarasvatī || 13 || prācīṃ mādhavamāstūya sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || gaṃḍakīpuṇyatīrthe hi snānaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ || 14 || śālagrāmaśilāmarcya na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || gomatījalakallolairmajjayetkṛṣṇasannidhau || 15 || caturbhujo naro bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhe modate ciram || carmaṇvatīṃ namaskṛtya apaḥ spṛśati yo naraḥ || 16 || sa tārayati pūrvajāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān || dvayośca saṃgamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vā sāgaradhvanim || 17 || brahmahatyāyuto vāpi pūto gacchetparāṃ gatim || māghamāse prayāge tu majjanaṃ kurute naraḥ || 18 || iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā ante viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet || prabhāse ye narā rāma trirātraṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ || 19 || yamalokaṃ na paśyeyuḥ kuṃbhīpākādikaṃ tathā || naimiṣāraṇyavāsī yo naro devatvamāpnuyāt || 3.2.31.20 || devānāmālayaṃ yasmāttadeva bhuvi durlabham || kurukṣetre naro rāma grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ || 21 || hemadānācca rājeṃdra na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet || śrīsthale darśanaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ pāpātpramucyate || 22 || sarvaduḥkhavināśe ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate || kāśyapīṃ sparśayedyo gāṃ mānavo bhuvi rāghava || || 23 || sarvakāmadughāvāsamṛṣilokaṃ sa gacchati || ujjayinyāṃ tu vaiśākhe śiprāyāṃ snānamācaret || 24 || mocayedrauravādghorātpūrvajāṃśca sahasraśaḥ || siṃdhusnānaṃ naro rāma prakaroti dinatrayam || 25 || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā kailāse modate naraḥ || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ śivam || 26 || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairlipyate na ca sa kvacit || ajñānāmapi jaṃtūnāṃ mahā'medhye tu gacchatām || || 27 || pādodbhūtaṃ payaḥ pītvā sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati || vedavatyāṃ naro yastu snāti sūryodaye śubhe || 28 || sarvarogātpramucyeta paraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt || tīrthāni rāma sarvatra snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ || 29 || nāśayaṃti manuṣyāṇāṃ sarvapāpāni līlayā || tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ pracakṣate || 3.2.31.30 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādyairyadādau saṃsthāpitaṃ purā || araṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 31 || dharmāraṇyātparaṃ nāsti bhuktimuktipradāyakam || svarge devāḥ praśaṃsaṃti dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 32 || te puṇyāste puṇyakṛto ye vasaṃti kalau narāḥ || dharmāraṇye rāmadeva sarvakilbiṣanāśane || 33 || brahmahatyādipāpāni sarvasteyakṛtāni ca || paradāraprasaṃgādi abhakṣyabhakṣaṇādi vai || 34 || agamyāgamanā yāni asparśasparśanādi ca || bhasmībhavaṃti lokānāṃ dharmāraṇyāvagāhanāt || 35 || brahmaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca bālaghno'nṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ || strīgoghnaścaiva grāmaghro dharmāraṇye vimucyate || 36 || nātaḥ paraṃ pāvanaṃ hi pāpināṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi || svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ vāṃchitārthapradaṃ śubham || 37 || kāmināṃ kāmadaṃ kṣetraṃ yatīnāṃ muktidāyakam || siddhānāṃ siddhidaṃ proktaṃ dharmāraṇyaṃ yugeyuge || 38 || || brahmovāca || || vasiṣṭhavacanaṃ śrutvā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || paraṃ harṣamanuprāpya hṛdayānaṃdakārakam || 39 || protphullahṛdayo rāmo romāciṃtatanūruhaḥ || gamanāya matiṃ cakre dharmāraṇye śubhavrataḥ || || 3.2.31.40 || yasminkīṭapataṃgādimānuṣāḥ paśavastathā || trirātrasevanenaiva mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ || 41 || kuśasthalī yathā kāśī śūlapāṇiśca bhairavaḥ || yathā vai muktido rāma dharmāraṇyaṃ tathottamam || 42 || tato rāmo maheṣvāso mudā paramayā yutaḥ || prasthitastīrthayātrāyāṃ sītayā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 43 || anujagmustadā rāmaṃ hanumāṃśca kapīśvaraḥ || kauśalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca mudānvitā || 44 || lakṣmaṇo lakṣaṇopeto bharataśca mahāmatiḥ || śatrughnaḥ sainyasahitopyayodhyāvāsinastathā || 45 || prakṛtayo naravyāghra dharmāraṇye viniryayuḥ || anujagmustadā rāmaṃ mudā paramayā yutāḥ || 46 || tīrthayātrāvidhiṃ kartuṃ gṛhātpracalito nṛpaḥ || vasiṣṭhaṃ svakulācāryamidamāha mahīpate || 47 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || etadāścaryamatulaṃ kimādi dvārakābhavat || kiyatkālasamutpannā vasiṣṭhedaṃ vadasva me || 48 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || na jānāmi mahārāja kiyatkālādabhūdidam || lomaśo jāṃbavāṃścaiva jānātīti ca kāraṇam || 49 || śarīre yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nānājanmāṃtareṣvapi || prāyaścitaṃ hi sarveṣāmetatkṣetra paraṃ smṛtam || 3.2.31.50 || śrutveti vacanaṃ tasya rāmaṃ jñānavatāṃ varaḥ || gantuṃ kṛtamatistīrthaṃ yātrāvidhimathācarat || 51 || vasiṣṭhaṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā mahāmāṃḍalikairnṛpaiḥ || punaścaravidhiṃ kṛtvā prasthitaścottarāṃ diśam || 52 || vasiṣṭhaṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā pratasthe paścimāṃ diśam || grāmādgrāmamatikramya deśāddeśaṃ vanādvanam ||53|| vimucya niryayau rāmaḥ sasainyaḥ saparicchadaḥ || gajavājisahasraughai rathairyānaiśca koṭibhiḥ|| || 54 || śibikābhiścāsaṃkhyābhiḥ prayayau rāghavastadā || gajārūḍhaḥ prapaśyaṃśca deśānvividhasauhṛdān || 55 || śvetātapatraṃ vidhṛtya cāmareṇa śubhena ca || vījitaśca janaughena rāmastatra samabhyagāt || 56 || vāditrāṇāṃ svanaighorairnṛtyagītapuraḥsaraiḥ || stūyamānopi sūtaiśca yayau rāmo mudānvitaḥ || 57 || daśame'hani saṃprāptaṃ dharmāraṇyamanuttamam || adūre hi tato rāmo dṛṣṭvā māṃḍalikaṃ puram || 58 || tatra sthitvā sasainyastu uvāsa niśi tāṃ purīm || śrutvā tu nirjanaṃ kṣetramudvasaṃ ca bhayānakam || 59 || vyāghrasiṃhākulaṃ tatra yakṣarākṣasasevitam || śrutvā janamukhādrāmo dharmāraṇyamaraṇyakam || tacchrutvā rāmadevastu na ciṃtā kriyatāmiti || 3.2.31.60 || tatrasthānvaṇijaḥ śūrāndakṣānsvavyavasāyake || 61 || samarthānhi mahākāyānmahābalaparākramān || samāhūya tadā kāle vākyametadathābravīt || 62 || śibikāṃ susuvaṇāṃ me śīghraṃ vāhayatāciram || yathā kṣaṇena caikena dharmaraṇyaṃ vrajāmyaham || 63 || tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca sarvapāpātpramucyate || evaṃ te vaṇijaḥ sarvai rāmeṇa preritāstadā || 64 || tathetyuktvā ca te sarve ūhustacchibikāṃ tadā || kṣetramadhye yadā rāmaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sahasainikaḥ || || 65 || tadyānasya gatirmaṃdā saṃjātā kila bhārata || maṃdaśabdāni vādyāni mātaṃgā maṃdagāminaḥ || 66 || hayāśca tādṛśā jātā rāmo vismaya māgataḥ || guruṃ papraccha vinayādvaśiṣṭhaṃ munipuṃgavam || 67 || kimetanmaṃdagatayaścitraṃ hṛdi munīśvara || trikālajño muniḥ prāha dharmakṣetramupāgatam || || 68 || tīrthe purātane rāma pādacāreṇa gamyate || evaṃ kṛte tataḥ paścātsainyasaukhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 69 || pādacārī tatau rāmaḥ sainyena saha saṃyutaḥ || madhuvāsanake grāme prāptaḥ paramabhāvanaḥ || 3.2.31.70 || guruṇā coktamārgeṇa mātṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtam || nānopahārairvividhaiḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhipūrvakam || 73 || tato rāmo harikṣetraṃ suvarṇādakṣiṇe taṭe || nirīkṣya yajñayogyāśca bhūmīrvai bahuśastathā || 72 || kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ mene rāmo raghūdvahaḥ || dharmasthānaṃ nirīkṣyātha suvarṇākṣottare taṭe || 73 || sainyasaṃghaṃ samuttīryya babhrāma kṣetramadhyataḥ || tatra tīrtheṣu sarveṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ||74|| yathoktāni ca karmāṇi rāmaścakre vidhānataḥ || śrāddhāni vidhivaccakre śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 75 || sthāpayāmāsa rāmeśaṃ tathā kāmeśvaraṃ punaḥ || sthānādvāyupradeśe tu suvarṇo bhayatastaṭe || 76 || kṛtvaivaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhūdrāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || kṛtvā sarvavidhiṃ caiva sabhāyāṃ samupāviśat || 77 || tāṃ niśāṃ sa nadītīre suṣvāpa raghunaṃdanaḥ || tato'rddharātre saṃjāte rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || 78 || jāgṛtastu tadā kāla ekākī dharmavatsalaḥ || aśrauṣīcca kṣaṇe tasminrāmo nārīvirodanam || 79 || niśāyāṃ karuṇairvākyai rudaṃtīṃ kurarīmiva || cārairvilokayāmāsa rāmastāmatisaṃbhramāt || 3.2.31.80 || dṛṣṭvātivihvalāṃ nārīṃ kraṃdantīṃ karuṇaiḥ svaraiḥ || pṛṣṭā sā duḥkhitā nārī rāmadūtaistadānagha || 81 || || dūtā ūcuḥ || || kāsi tvaṃ subhage nāri devī vā dānavī nu kim || kena vā trāsitāsi tvaṃ muṣṭaṃ kena dhanaṃ tava ||82|| vikalā dāruṇāñchabdānudgiraṃtī muhurmuhuḥ || kathayasva yathātathyaṃ rāmo rājābhipṛcchati|| || 83 || tayoktaṃ svāminaṃ dūtāḥ preṣayadhvaṃ mamāṃtikam || yathāhaṃ mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ śāṃtyai tasmai nivedaye || 84 || tathetyuktvā tato dūtā rāmamāgatya cābruvan || 85 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye dūtāgamanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || cha ||
<3.2.32>
|| vyāsa uvāca || || tataśca rāmadūtāste natvā rāmamathābruvan || rāmarāma mahābāho varanārī śubhānanā || 1 || suvastrabhūṣābharaṇāṃ mṛduvākyaparāyaṇām || ekākinīṃ kradamānāma dṛṣṭvā tāṃ vismitā vayam || 2 || samīpavartino bhūtvā pṛṣṭā sā surasundarī || kā tvaṃ devi varārohe devī vā dānavī nu kim || 3 || rāmaḥ pṛcchati devi tvāṃ brūhi sarvaṃ yathātatham || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rāmā sovāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ || 4 || rāmaṃ preṣayata bhadraṃ vo mama duḥkhāpahaṃ param || 5 || tadākarṇya tato rāmaḥ saṃbhramāttvarito yayau || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ svayaṃ duḥkhamavāpa saḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ rāmaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭastadā || 6 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā kenāvadhūtā vijane nirastā || muṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ kena ca tāvakīnamācakṣva mātaḥ sakalaṃ mamāgre || 7 || ityuktvā cātiduḥkhārto rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ || praṇāmaṃ daṃḍavaccakre cakrapāṇirivāparaḥ ||8|| tayābhivaṃdito rāmaḥ pragamya ca punaḥpunaḥ || tuṣṭayā parayā prītyā stuto madhurayā girā || 9 || paramātmanpareśāna duḥkhahārinsanātana || yadarthamavatāraste tacca kāryaṃ tvayā kṛtam || 3.2.32.10 || rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca śakrajitpramukhāstathā || kharadūṣaṇatriśiromārīcākṣakumārakāḥ || 11 || asaṃkhyā nirjitā raudrā rākṣasāḥ samarāṃgaṇe || 12 || kiṃ vacmi lokeśa sukīrttimadya te vedhāstvadīyāṃgajapadmasaṃbhavaḥ || viśvaṃ niviṣṭaṃ ca tato dadarśa vaṭasya patre hi yatho vaṭo mataḥ || 13 || dhanyo daśaratho loke kauśalyā jananī tava || yayorjātosi goviṃda jagadīśa paraḥ pumān || 14 || dhanyaṃ ca tatkulaṃ rāma yatra tvamāgataḥ svayam || dhanyā'yodhyāpurī rāma dhanyo lokastvadāśrayaḥ || 15 || dhanyaḥ so'pi hi vālmīkiryena rāmāyaṇaṃ kṛtam || kavinā vipramukhyebhya ātmabuddhyā hyanāgatam || 16 || tvatto'bhavatkulaṃ cedaṃ tvayā deva supāvitam ||17|| narapatiriti lokaiḥ smaryate vaiṣṇavāṃśaḥ svayamasi ramaṇīyaistvaṃ guṇairviṣṇureva || kimapi bhuvanakāryaṃ yadviciṃtyāvatīrya tadiha ghaṭayataste vatsa nirvighnamastu ||18|| stutvā vācātha rāmaṃ hi tvayi nāthe nu sāṃpratam || śūnyā varte ciraṃ kālaṃ yathā doṣastathaiva hi || 19 || dharmāraṇyasya kṣetrasya viddhi māmadhidevatām || varṣāṇi dvādaśehaiva jātāni duḥkhi tāsmyaham || 3.2.32.20 || nirjanatvaṃ mamādya tvamuddharasva mahāmate || lohāsurabhayādrāma viprāḥ sarve diśo daśa || 21 || gatāśca vaṇijaḥ sarve yathāsthānaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ || sa daityo ghātito rāma devaiḥ surabhayaṃkaraḥ || 22 || ākramyātra mahāmāyo durādharṣo duratyayaḥ || na te janāḥ samāyāṃti tadbhayādati śaṃkitāḥ || 23 || adya vai dvādaśa samāḥ śūnyāgāramanāthavat || yasmācca dīrghikāyāṃ me snānadānodyato janaḥ || 24 || rāma tasyāṃ dīrghikāyāṃ nipataṃti ca śūkarāḥ || yatrāṃganā bhartṛyutā jalakrīḍāparāyaṇāḥ || 25 || cikrīḍustatra mahiṣā nipataṃti jalāśaye || yatra sthāne supuṣpāṇāṃ prakaraḥ pracuro'bhavat || 26 || tadruddhaṃ kaṃṭakairvṛkṣaiḥ siṃhavyāghrasamākulaiḥ || saṃcikrīḍuḥ kumārāśca yasyāṃ bhūmau niraṃtaram ||27|| kumāryaścitrakāṇāṃ ca tatra krīḍaṃ ti harṣitāḥ || akurvanvāḍavā yatra vedagānaṃ tiraṃtaram ||28|| śivānāṃ tatra phetkārāḥ śrūyaṃte'tibhayaṃkarāḥ || yatra dhūmo'gnihotrāṇāṃ dṛśyate vai gṛhegṛhe || 29 || tatra dāvāḥ sadhūmāśca dṛśyaṃte'tyulbaṇā bhṛśam || nṛtyaṃte narttakā yatra harṣitā hi dvijāgrataḥ || 3.2.32.30 || tatraiva bhūtavetālā pretāḥ nṛtyaṃti mohitāḥ || nṛpā yatra sabhāyāṃ tu nyaṣīdanmaṃtratatparāḥ || 31 || tasminsthāne niṣīdaṃti gavayā ṛkṣaśallakāḥ || āvāsā yatra dṛśyante dvijānāṃ vaṇijāṃ tathā ||32|| kuṭṭimapratimā rāma dṛśyaṃtetra bilāni vai || koṭarāṇīha vṛkṣāṇāṃ gavākṣāṇīha sarvataḥ || 33 || catuṣkā yajñavedirhi socchrāyā hyabhavatpurā || te'tra valmīkanicayairdṛśyaṃte pariveṣṭitāḥ || 34 || evaṃvidhaṃ nivāsaṃ me viddhi rāma nṛpottama || śūnyaṃ tu sarvato yasmānnivāsāya dvijā gatāḥ || 35 || tena me sumahadduḥkhaṃ tasmāttrāhi nareśvara || etacchrutvā vaco rāma uvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ || 36 || || śrīrāma uvāca || || na jāne tāvakānviprāṃścaturdikṣu samāśritān || na teṣāṃ vedmyahaṃ saṃkhyāṃ nāmagotre dvijanmanām || 37 || yathā jñātiryathā gotraṃ yāthātathyaṃ nivedaya || tata ānīya tānsarvānsvasthāne vāsayāmyaham || 38 || || śrīmātovāca || || brahmaviṣṇumaheśaiśca sthāpitā ye nareśvara || aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || 39 || trayīvidyāsu vikhyātā loke'sminnamitadyute || catuṣṣaṣṭikagotrāṇāṃ vāḍavā ye pratiṣṭhitāḥ || || 3.2.32.40 || śrīmātādāttrayīvidyāṃ loke sarve dvijottamāḥ || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi vaiśyā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 41 || āryavṛttāstu vijñeyā dvijaśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ || bahulārko nṛpo yatra saṃjñayā saha rājate || 42 || kumārāvaśvinau devau dhanado vyayapūrakaḥ || adhiṣṭhātrī tvahaṃ rāma nāmnā bhaṭṭārikā smṛtā || 43 || || śrīsūta uvāca || || sthānācārāśca ye kecitkulācārāstathaiva ca || śrīmātrā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rāmasyāgre purātanam || 44 || tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā rāmo mudamavāpa ha || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ hi bhāṣitaṃ tvayā || 45 || yasmātsatyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ tannāmnā nagaraṃ śubham || vāsayāmi jaganmātaḥ satyamaṃdirameva ca || 46 || trailokye khyātimāpnotu satyamaṃdiramu ttamam || 47 || etaduktvā tato rāmaḥ sahasraśatasaṃkhyayā || svabhṛtyānpreṣayāmāsa viprānayanahetave || 48 || yasmindeśe pradeśe vā vane vā sari tastaṭe || paryaṃte vā yathāsthāne grāme vā tatratatra ca || 49 || dharmāraṇyanivāsāśca yātā yatra dvijottamāḥ || arghapādyaiḥ pūjayitvā śīghramānayatātra tān || 3.2.32.50 || ahamatra tadā bhokṣye yadā drakṣye dvijottamān || 51 || vimānya ca dvijānetānāgamiṣyati yo naraḥ || sa me vadhyaśca daṃḍyaśca nirvāsyo viṣayādbahiḥ || 52 || tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ duḥsahaṃ duḥpradharṣaṇam || rāmājñākāriṇo dūtā gatāḥ sarve diśo daśa || 53 || śodhitā vāḍavāḥ sarve labdhāḥ sarve suharṣitāḥ || yathoktena vidhānena arghapādyairapūjayan || 54 || stutiṃ cakruśca vidhivadvinayācārapūrvakam || āmaṃtrya ca dvijānsarvānrāmavākyaṃ prakāśayan || 55 || tataste vāḍavāḥ sarve dvijāḥ sevakasaṃyutāḥ || gamanāyodyatāḥ sarve vedaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ || 56 || āgatā rāmapārśvaṃ ca bahumānapuraḥsarāḥ || samāgatāndvijāndṛṣṭvā romāṃcitatanūruhaḥ || 57 || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene dāśarathirnṛpaḥ || sa saṃbhramātsamutthāya padātiḥ prayayau puraḥ || 58 || karasaṃpuṭakaṃ kṛtvā harṣāśru pratimuñcayan || jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 59 || vipraprasādātkamalāvaro'haṃ vipraprasādāddharaṇīdharo'ham || vipraprasādājjagatīpatiśca vipraprasādānmama rāmanāma || 3.2.32.60 || ityevamuktā rāmeṇa vāḍa vāste praharṣitāḥ || jayāśīrbhiḥ prapūjyātha dīrghāyuriti cābruvan || 61 || āvarjitāste rāmeṇa pādyārghyaviṣṭarādibhiḥ || stutiṃ cakāra viprāṇāṃ daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca || 62 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitvā cakre pādābhivaṃdanam || āsanāni vicitrāṇi haimānyābharaṇāni ca || 63 || samarpayāmāsa tato rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi upavītāni karṇakān || 64 || pradadau vipramukhyebhyo nānāvarṇāśca dhenavaḥ || ekaikaśata saṃkhyākā ghaṭodhnīśca savatsakāḥ || 65 || savastrā baddhaghaṃṭāśca hemaśṛṃgavibhūṣitāḥ || rūpyakhurāstāmrapṛṣṭhīḥ kāṃsyapātrasamanvitāḥ || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ| saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye brahmanāradasaṃvāde satyamaṃdirasthāpana varṇanonāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || cha ||
<3.2.33>
|| rāma uvāca || || jīrṇoddhāraṃ kariṣyāmi śrīmāturvacanādaham || ājñā pradīyatāṃ mahyaṃ yathādānaṃ dadāmi vaḥ || 1 || pātre dānaṃ pradātavyaṃ kṛtvā yajñavaraṃ dvijāḥ || nāpātre dīyate kiṃciddattaṃ na tu sukhāvaham || 2 || supātraṃ nauriva sadā tārayedubhayorapi || lohapiṃḍopamaṃ jñeyaṃ kupātraṃ bhañjanātmakam || 3 || jātimātreṇa vipratvaṃ jāyate na hi bho dvijāḥ || kriyā balavatī loke kriyāhīne kutaḥ phalam || 4 || pūjyāstasmātpūjyatamā brāhmaṇāḥ satyavādinaḥ || yajñakārye samutpanne kṛpāṃ kurvaṃtu sarvadā || 5 || || brahmovāca || || tatastu militāḥ sarve vimṛśya ca parasparam || kecidūcustadā rāmaṃ vayaṃ śiloṃchajīvikāḥ || 6 || saṃtoṣaṃ paramāsthāya sthitā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || pratigrahaprayogeṇa na cāsmākaṃ prayojanam || 7 || daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajaḥ || daśadhvajasamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ || 8 || rājapratigraho ghoro rāma satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || tasmādvayaṃ na cecchāmaḥ pratigrahaṃ bhayā vaham || 9 || ekāhikā dvijāḥ kecitkecitsvāmṛtavṛttayaḥ || kumbhīdhānyā dvijāḥ kecitkecitṣaṭkarmatatparāḥ || 3.2.33.10 || trimūrtisthāpitāḥ sarve pṛthagbhāvāḥ pṛthagguṇāḥ || kecidevaṃ vadaṃti sma trimūrtyājñāṃ vinā vayam || 11 || pratigrahasya svīkāraṃ kathaṃ kuryāma ha dvijāḥ || na tāṃbūlaṃ strīkṛtaṃ no hyadmo dānena bhaṣitam || 12 || vimṛśya sa tadā rāmo vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sasmāra guruṇā saha || smṛtamātrāstato devāstaṃ deśaṃ samupāgaman|| sūryakoṭipratīkāśīvamānāvalisaṃvṛtāḥ || 14 || rāmeṇa te yathānyāyaṃ pūjitāḥ parayā mudā || 13 || niveditaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ rāmeṇātisubuddhinā || 15 || adhidevyā vacanato jīrṇoddhāraṃ karomyaham || dharmāraṇye harikṣetre dharmakūpasamīpataḥ || 16 || tataste vāḍavāḥ sarve trimūrttīḥ praṇipatya ca || mahatā harṣavṛṃdena pūrṇāḥ prāptamanorathāḥ || 17 || arghyapādyādividhinā śraddhayā tānapūjayan || kṣaṇaṃ viśramya te devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 18 || ūcū rāmaṃ mahāśaktiṃ vinayātkṛtasaṃpuṭam || 19 || || devā ūcuḥ || || devadruhastvayā rāma ye hatā rāvaṇādayaḥ || tena tuṣṭā vayaṃ sarve bhānuvaṃśavibhūṣaṇa || 3.2.33.20 || uddharasva mahāsthānaṃ mahatīṃ kīrtimāpnuhi || 21 || labdhvā sa teṣāmājñāṃ tu prīto daśarathātmajaḥ || jīrṇoddhāre'naṃtaguṇaṃ phalamicchannilāpatiḥ || 22 || devānāṃ saṃnidhau teṣāṃ kāryāraṃbhamathākarot || sthaṃḍilaṃ pūrvataḥ kṛtvā mahāgiri samaṃ śubham||23|| tasyopari bahiḥśālā gṛhaśālā hyanekaśaḥ || brahmaśālāśca bahuśo nirmame śobhanākṛtīḥ ||24|| nidhānaiśca samāyuktā gṛhopakaraṇai rvṛtāḥ || suvarṇakoṭisaṃpūrṇā rasavastrādipūritāḥ || 25 || dhanadhānyasamṛddhāśca sarvadhātuyutāstathā || etatsarvaṃ kārayitvā brāhmaṇebhyastadā dadau ||26|| ekaikaśo daśadaśa dadau dhenūḥ payasvinīḥ || catvāriṃśacchataṃ prādādgrāmāṇāṃ caturādhikam || 27 || traividyadvijaviprebhyo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || kājeśena trayeṇaiva sthāpitā dvijasattamāḥ || 28 || tasmāttrayīvidya iti khyātirloke babhūva ha || evaṃvidhaṃ dvijebhyaḥ sa dattvā dānaṃ mahādbhutam || || 29 || ātmānaṃ cāpi mene sa kṛtakṛtyaṃ nareśvaraḥ || brahmaṇā sthāpitāḥ pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ye || 3.2.33.30 || te pūjitā rāghaveṇa jīrṇoddhāre kṛte sati || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi gobhujā ye vaṇigvarāḥ || 31 || śuśrūṣārthaṃ pradattā vai devairhariharādibhiḥ|| saṃtuṣṭena tu śarveṇa tebhyo dattaṃ tu ceta nam|| 32 || śvetāśvacāmarau dattau khaṅgaṃ dattaṃ sunirmalam || tadā prabodhitāste ca dvijaśuśrūṣaṇāya vai || 33 || vivāhādau sadā bhāvyaṃ cāmarai maṃgalaṃ varam || khaṅgaṃ śubhaṃ tadā dhāryyaṃ mama cihnaṃ kare sthitam || 34 || gurupūjā sadā kāryā kuladevyāḥ punaḥpunaḥ || vṛddhyāgameṣu prāpteṣu vṛddhi dāyakadakṣiṇā || 35 || ekādaśyāṃ śanervāre dānaṃ deyaṃ dvijanmane || pradeyaṃ bālavṛddhebhyo mama rāmasya śāsanāt || 36 || maṃḍaleṣu ca ye śuddhā vaṇigvṛttiratāḥ parāḥ || sapādalakṣāste dattā rāmaśāsanapālakāḥ || 37 || māṃḍalīkāstu te jñeyā rājāno maṃḍaleśvarāḥ || dvija śuśrūṣaṇe dattā rāmeṇa vaṇijāṃ varāḥ || 38 || cāmaradvitayaṃ rāmo dattavānkhaḍgameva ca || kulasya svāminaṃ sūryaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhipūrvakam || || 39 || brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa caturvedasamanvitam || śrīmātaraṃ mahāśaktiṃ śūnyasvāmihariṃ tathā || 3.2.33.40 || vighnāpadhvaṃsanārthāya dakṣiṇadvārasaṃsthitam || gaṇaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa tathānyāścaiva devatāḥ || 41 || kāritāstena vīreṇa prāsādāḥ saptabhūmikāḥ || yatkiṃ citkurute kāryaṃ śubhaṃ māṃgalyarūpakam || 42 || putre jāte jātake vānnāśane muṃḍane'pi vā || lakṣahome koṭihome tathā yajñakriyāsu ca || 43 || vāstupūjāgrahaśāṃtyoḥ prāpte caiva mahotsave || yatkiṃcitkurute dānaṃ dravyaṃ vā dhānyamuttamam || 44 || vastraṃ vā dhenavo nātha hema rūpyaṃ tathaiva ca || viprāṇāmatha śūdrāṇāṃ dīnānāthāṃdhakeṣu ca || 45 || prathamaṃ bakulārkasya śrīmātuścaiva mānavaḥ || bhāgaṃ dadyācca nirvighnakāryasiddhyai nirantaram || 46 || vacanaṃ me samullaṃghya kurute yo'nyathā naraḥ || tasya tatkarmaṇo vighnaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || evamuktvā tato rāmaḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || devānāmatha vāpīśca prākārāṃstu suśobhanān || 48 || durgopakaraṇairyuktānpratolīśca suvistṛtāḥ || nirmame caiva kuṃḍāni sarāṃsi sarasīstathā || 49 || dharmavāpīśca kūpāṃśca tathānyāndevanirmitān || etatsarvaṃ ca vistārya dharmāraṇye manorame || 3.2.33.50 || dadau traividyamukhyebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā punaḥ || tāmrapaṭṭasthitaṃ rāmaśāsanaṃ lopayettu yaḥ ||51|| pūrvajāstasya narake pataṃtyagre na saṃtatiḥ || vāyuputraṃ samāhūya tato rāmo'bravīdvacaḥ || || 52 || vāyuputra mahāvīra tava pūjā bhaviṣyati || asya kṣetrasya rakṣāyai tvamatra sthitimācara || 53 || āṃjaneyastu tadvākyaṃ praṇamya śirasādadhau || jīrṇoddhāraṃ tadā kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha || 54 || śrīmātaraṃ tadābhyarcya prasannenāṃtarātmanā || śrīmātaraṃ namaskṛtya tīrthānyanyāni rāghavaḥ ||55|| te'pi devāḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ yayurbahmapurogamāḥ ||56|| dattvāśiṣaṃ tu rāmāya vāṃchitaṃ te bhaviṣyati || ramyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā rāma viprāṇāṃ sthāpanādikam || || 57 || asmākamapi vātsalyaṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyavatā tvayā || iti stuvaṃtaste devāḥ svāni sthānāni bhejire || 58 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvārdhe dharmāraṇyamāhātmye śrīrāmacandrasya purapratyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || cha ||
<3.2.34>
|| || vyāsa uvāca || || evaṃ rāmeṇa dharmajña jīrṇoddhāraḥ purā kṛtaḥ || dvijānāṃ ca hitārthāya śrīmāturvacanena ca || 1 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kīdṛśaṃ śāsanaṃ brahmanrāmeṇa likhitaṃ purā || kathayasva prasādena tretāyāṃ satyamaṃdire || 2 || || vyāsa uvāca || || dharmāraṇye vare divye bakulārke svadhiṣṭhite || śūnyasvāmini vipreṃdra sthite nārāyaṇe prabhau || 3 || rakṣaṇādhipatau deve sarvajñe guṇanāyake || bhavasāgara magnānāṃ tāriṇī yatra yoginī || 4 || śāsanaṃ tatra rāmasya rāghavasya ca nāmataḥ || śṛṇu tāmrāśrayaṃ tatra likhitaṃ dharmaśāstrataḥ || 5 || mahāścaryakaraṃ tacca hyanekayugasaṃsthitam|| sarvo dhātuḥ kṣayaṃ yāti suvarṇaṃ kṣayameti ca || 6 || pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate putra dvijaśāsanamakṣayam || avināśo hi tāmrasya kāraṇaṃ tatra vidyate || 7 || vedoktaṃ sakalaṃ yasmādviṣṇureva hi kathyate || purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu dharmaśāstreṣu bhārata || 8 || sarvatra gīyate viṣṇurnānā bhāvasamāśrayaḥ || nānādeśeṣu dharmeṣu nānādharmaniṣevibhiḥ || 9 || nānābhedaistu sarvatra viṣṇureveti ciṃtyate || avatīrṇaḥ sa vai sākṣātpurāṇapuruṣo ttamaḥ || 3.2.34.10 || devavairivināśāya dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca || tenedaṃ śāsanaṃ dattamavināśātmakaṃ suta || 11 || yasya pratāpādṛṣada(ya)stāritā jalamadhyataḥ || vānarairveṣṭitā laṃkā helayā rākṣasā hatāḥ || 12 || muniputraṃ mṛtaṃ rāmo yamalokādupānayat || duṃdubhirnihato yena kabaṃdho'bhihatastathā || 13 || nihatā tāḍakā caiva saptatālā vibheditāḥ || kharaśca dūṣaṇaścaiva triśirāśca mahāsuraḥ || 14 || caturdaśasahasrāṇi javena nihatā raṇe || tenedaṃ śāsanaṃ dattamakṣayaṃ na kathaṃ bhavet || 15 || svavaṃśavarṇanaṃ tatra likhitvā svayameva tu || deśakālādikaṃ sarvaṃ lilekha vidhipūrvakam || 16 || svamudrācihnitaṃ tatra traividyebhyastathā dadau|| catuścatvāriṃśavarṣo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || 17 || tasminkāle mahāścaryaṃ saṃdattaṃ kila bhārata|| tatra svarṇopamaṃ cāpi raupyopamama thāpi ca || 18 || uvāha salilaṃ tīrthe devarṣipitṛtṛptidam || svavaṃśanāyakasyāgre sūryeṇa kṛtameva tat || 19 || taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rāmo viṣṇuṃ prapūjya ca || rāmalekhavicitraistu likhitaṃ dharmaśāsanam || 3.2.34.20 || yaddṛṣṭvātha dvijāḥ sarve saṃsārabhayabaṃdhanam || kurvate naiva yasmācca tasmānnikhilarakṣakam || || 21 || ye pāpiṣṭhā durācārā mitradroharatāśca ye || teṣāṃ prabodhanārthāya prasiddhimakarotpurā || 22 || rāmalekhavicitraistu vicitre tāmrapaṭṭake || vākyānīmāni śrūyaṃte śāsane kila nārada || 23 || āsphoṭayaṃti pitaraḥ kathayaṃti pitāmahāḥ || bhūmido'smatkule jātaḥ so'smānsaṃtārayiṣyati || 24 || bahubhirbahudhā bhuktā rājabhiḥ pṛthivī tviyam || yasyayasya yadā bhūmistasyatasya tadā phalam || 25 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ || ācchettā cānumaṃtā ca tānyeva narakaṃ vrajet || 26 || saṃdaṃśaistudyamānastu mudgarairvinihatya ca || pāśaiḥ subadhyamānastu roravīti mahāsvaram || 27 || tāḍyamānaḥ śire daṃḍaiḥ samāliṃgya vibhāvasum || kṣurikayā chidyamāno roravīti mahāsvanam || 28 || yamadūtairmahāghorairbrahmavṛttivilopakaḥ || evaṃvidhairmahāduṣṭaiḥ pīḍyaṃte te mahāgaṇaiḥ || 29 || tatastiryaktvamāpnoti yoniṃ vā rākṣasīṃ śunīm || vyālīṃ śṛgālīṃ paiśācīṃ mahābhūtabhayaṃkarīm || 3.2.34.30 || bhūmeraṃgulahartā hi sa kathaṃ pāpamācaret || bhūmeraṃguladātā ca sa kathaṃ puṇyamācaret || 31 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ rājasūyaśatasya ca || kanyāśatapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti bhūmidaḥ || 32 || āyuryaśaḥ sukhaṃ prajñā dharmo dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ jayaḥ || saṃtānaṃ varddhate nityaṃ bhūmidaḥ sukhamaśmute || 33 || bhūmeraṃgulamekaṃ tu ye haraṃti khalā narāḥ || vaṃdhyāṭavīṣvatoyāsu śuṣkakoṭaravāsinaḥ || kṛṣṇasarpāḥ prajāyaṃte dattadāyāpahārakāḥ || 34 || taḍāgānāṃ sahasreṇa aśvamedhaśatena vā || gavāṃ koṭipradānena bhūmiharttā viśudhyati || 35 || yānīha dattāni punardhanāni dānāni dharmārthayaśaskarāṇi || audāryato vipraniveditāni ko nāma sādhuḥ punarādadīta || 36 || caladaladalalīlācaṃcale jīvaloke tṛṇalavalaghusāre sarvasaṃsārasaukhye || apaharati durāśaḥ śāsanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ narakagahanagarttāvartapātotsuko yaḥ ||37 || ye pāsyaṃti mahībhujaḥ kṣitimimāṃ yāsyaṃti bhuktvākhilāṃ no yātā na tu yāti yāsyati na vā kenāpi sārddhaṃ dharā|| yatkiṃcidbhuvi tadvināśi sakalaṃ kīrtiḥ paraṃ sthāyinī tvevaṃ vai vasudhāpi yairupakṛtā lopyā na satkīrtayaḥ || 38 || ekaiva bhaginī loke sarveṣāmeva bhūbhujām || na bhojyā na karagrāhyā vipradattā vasuṃdharā || 39 || dattvā bhūmiṃ bhāvinaḥ pārthiveśānbhūyobhūyo yācate rāmacandraḥ || sāmānyo'yaṃ dharmaseturnṛpāṇāṃ sve sve kāle pālanīyo bhavadbhiḥ ||3.2.34.40|| asminvaṃśe kṣitau kopi rājā yadi bhaviṣyati || tasyāhaṃ karalagnosmi maddattaṃ yadi pālyate||41|| likhitvā śāsanaṃ rāmaścāturvedyadvijottamān|| saṃpūjya pradadau dhīmānvasiṣṭhasya ca sannidhau||42|| te vāḍavā gṛhītvā taṃ paṭṭaṃ rāmājñayā śubham|| tāmraṃ haimākṣarayutaṃ dharmyaṃ dharmavibhūṣaṇam||43|| pūjārthaṃ bhaktikāmārthāstadrakṣaṇamakurvata|| caṃdanena ca divyena puṣpeṇa ca sugandhinā||44|| tathā suvarṇapuṣpeṇa rūpyapuṣpeṇa vā punaḥ|| ahanyahani pūjāṃ te kurvate vāḍavāḥ śubhām||45|| tadagre dīpakaṃ caiva ghṛtena vimalena hi|| saptavartiyutaṃ rājannarghyaṃ prakurvate dvijāḥ||46|| naivedyaṃ kurvate nityaṃ bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ|| rāmarāmeti rāmeti mantramapyuccaraṃti hi||47|| aśane śayane pāne gamane copaveśane || sukhe vāpyathavā duḥkhe rāmamantraṃ samuccaret || 48 || na tasya duḥkhadaurbhāgyaṃ nādhivyādhibhayaṃ bhavet || āyuḥ śriyaṃ balaṃ tasya varddhayaṃti dine dine || 49 || rāmeti nāmnā mucyeta pāpādvai dāruṇādapi || narakaṃ nahi gaccheta gatiṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm || 3.2.34.50 || || || vyāsa uvāca || || iti kṛtvā tato rāmaḥ kṛtakṛtyamamanyata || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadā praṇamya ca dvijānbahūn || 51 || dattvā dānaṃ bhūritaraṃ gavāśvamahiṣīratham || tataḥ sarvānnijāṃstāṃśca vākyametaduvāca ha || 52 || atraiva sthīyatāṃ sarvairyāvaccaṃdradivākarau || yāvanmerurmahīpṛṣṭhe sāgarāḥ sapta eva ca || 53 || tāvadatraiva sthātavyaṃ bhavadbhirhi na saṃśayaḥ || yadā hi śāsanaṃ viprā na manyaṃte nṛpā bhuvi || 54 || athavā vaṇijaḥ śūrā madamāyāvimohitāḥ || madājñāṃ na prakurvaṃti manyaṃte vā na te janāḥ || 55 || tadā vai vāyuputrasya smaraṇaṃ kriyatāṃ dvijāḥ || smṛtamātro hanūmānvai samāgatya kariṣyati || 56 || sahasā bhasma tānsatyaṃ vacanānme na saṃśayaḥ || ya idaṃ śāsanaṃ ramyaṃ pālayiṣyati bhūpatiḥ || || 57 || vāyuputraḥ sadā tasya saukhyamṛddhiṃ pradāsyati || dadāti putrānpautrāṃśca sādhvīṃ patnīṃ yaśo jayam || 58 || ityevaṃ kathayitvā ca hanumaṃtaṃ prabodhya ca || nivartito rāmadevaḥ sasainyaḥ saparicchadaḥ || 59 || vāditrāṇāṃ svanairviṣvaksūcyamānaśubhāgamaḥ || śvetātapatrayukto'sau cāmarairvī jito naraiḥ || ayodhyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya ciraṃ rājyaṃ cakāra ha || 3.2.34.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye brahmanāradasaṃvāde śrīrāmeṇa brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śāsanapaṭṭapradānavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || || cha | || ||
<3.2.35>
|| nārada uvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraka || guṇātīto guṇairyukto muktīnāṃ sādhanaṃ param || 1 || saṃsthāpya vedabhavanaṃ vidhivaddvija sattamān || kiṃ cakre raghunāthastu bhūyo'yodhyāṃ gatastadā || 2 || svasthāne brāhmaṇāstatra kāni karmāṇi cakrire || || brahmovāca || || iṣṭāpūrtaratāḥ śāṃtāḥ pratigrahaparāṅmukhāḥ || 3 || rājyaṃ cakrurvanasyāsya purodhā dvijasattamaḥ || uvāca rāmapuratastīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || 4 || prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ triveṇīphalamuttamam || prayāgatīrthamahimā śuklatīrthasya caiva hi || 5 || siddhakṣetrasya kāśyāśca gaṃgāyā mahimā tathā || vasiṣṭhaḥ kathayā māsa tīrthānyanyāni nārada || 6 || dharmāraṇyasuvarṇāyā harikṣetrasya tasya ca || snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vārāṇasyā yavādhikam || 7 || etacchrutvā rāmadevaḥ sa camatkṛtamānasaḥ || dharmāraṇye punaryātrāṃ karttukāmaḥ samabhyagāt || 8 || sītayā saha dharmajño gurusainyapuraḥsaraḥ || lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā bharatena sahāyavān || 9 || śatrughnena parivṛto gato moherake pure || tatra gatvā vasiṣṭhaṃ tu pṛcchate'sau mahāmanāḥ || 3.2.35.10 || || rāma uvāca || || dharmāraṇye mahākṣetre kiṃ karttavyaṃ dvijottama || dānaṃ vā niyamo vātha snānaṃ vā tapa uttamam || 11 || dhyānaṃ vātha kratuṃ vātha homaṃ vā japamuttamam || dānaṃ vā niyamaṃ vātha snānaṃ vā tapa uttamam|| 12 || yena vai kriyamāṇena tīrthe'smindvijasattama || brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate tadbravīhi me || 13 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yajñaṃ kuru mahābhāga dharmāraṇye tvamuttamam || dinedine koṭiguṇaṃ yāvadvarṣaśataṃ bhavet || 14 || tacchrutvā caiva guruto yajñāraṃbhaṃ cakāra saḥ || tasminnavasare sītā rāmaṃ vyajñāpayanmudā || 15 || svāminpūrvaṃ tvayā viprā vṛtā ye vedapāragāḥ || brahmaviṣṇumaheśena nirmitā ye purā dvijāḥ || 16 || kṛte tretāyuge caiva dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || viprāṃstānvai vṛṇuṣva tvaṃ taireva sādhako'dhvaraḥ || 17 || tacchrutvā rāmadevena āhūtā brāhmaṇāstadā || sthāpitāśca yathāpūrvamasminmohe rake pure || 18 || taistvaṣṭādaśasaṃkhyākaistraividyairmehivāḍavaiḥ || yajñaṃ cakāra vidhivattairevāyatabuddhibhiḥ || 19 || kuśikaḥ kauśiko vatsa upamanyuśca kāśyapaḥ|| kṛṣṇātreyo bharadvājo dhāriṇaḥ śaunako varaḥ||3.2.35.20|| māṃḍavyo bhārgavaḥ paiṃgyo vātsyo laugākṣa eva ca|| gāṃgāyanotha gāṃgeyaḥ śunakaḥ śaunakastathā|| 21|| ||brahmovāca|| ebhirvipraiḥ kratuṃ rāmaḥ samāpya vidhivannṛpaḥ|| cakārāvabhṛthaṃ rāmo viprānsaṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ||22|| yajñāṃte sītayā rāmo vijñaptaḥ suvinītayā|| asyādhvarasya saṃpattī dakṣiṇāṃ dehi suvrata||23|| mannāmnā ca puraṃ tatra sthāpyatāṃ śīghrameva ca || sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā cakre nṛpottamaḥ || 24 || teṣāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sthānamekaṃ sunirbhayam || dattaṃ rāmeṇa sītāyāḥ saṃtoṣāya mahībhṛtā || 25 || sītāpuramiti khyātaṃ nāma cakre tadā kila || tasyādhidevyau varttete śāṃtā caiva sumaṃgalā || 26 || moherakasya purato grāmadvādaśakaṃ puraḥ || dadau viprāya viduṣe samutthāya praharṣitaḥ || 27 || tīrthāṃtaraṃ jagāmāśu kāśyapīsaritastaṭe || vāḍavāḥ ke'pi nītāste rāmeṇa saha dharmavit || 28 || dharmālaye gataḥ sadyo yatra mālā kamaṃḍaluḥ || purā dharmeṇa sumahatkṛtaṃ yatra tapo mune || 29 || tadārabhya suvikhyātaṃ dharmālayamiti śrutam || dadau dāśarathistatra mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa | 3.2.35.30 || paṃcāśattadā grāmāḥ sītāpurasamanvitāḥ || satyamaṃdiraparyaṃtā raghunā thena vai tadā || 31 || sītāyā vacanāttatra guruvākyena caiva hi || ātmano vaṃśavṛddhyarthaṃ dvijebhyo'dādraghūttamaḥ || 32 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇāṃ dvijānāmabhavatkulam || vātsyāyana upamanyurjātūkarṇyo'tha piṃgalaḥ || 33 || bhāradvājastathā vatsaḥ kauśikaḥ kuśa eva ca || śāṃḍilyaḥ kaśyapaścaiva gautamaśchāṃdhanastathā || 34 || kṛṣṇātreyastathā vatso vasiṣṭho dhāraṇastathā || bhāṃḍilaścaiva vijñeyo yauvanāśvastataḥ param || 35 || kṛṣṇāyanopamanyū ca gārgyamudgalamaukhakāḥ || puśiḥ parāśaraścaiva kauṃḍinyaśca tataḥ param || 36 || paṃcapaṃcāśadgrāmāṇāṃ nāmānyevaṃ yathākramam || sītāpuraṃ śrīkṣetraṃ ca muśalī mudgalī tathā || 37 || jyeṣṭhalā śreyasthānaṃ ca daṃtālī vaṭapatrakā || rājñaḥ puraṃ kṛṣṇavāṭaṃ dehaṃ lohaṃ canasthanam || 38 || kohecaṃ caṃdanakṣetraṃ thalaṃ ca hastināpuram || karpaṭaṃ kaṃnajahnavī vanoḍaphanaphāvalī || 39 || mohodhaṃ śamohoralī goviṃdaṇaṃ thalatyajam || cāraṇasiddhaṃ sodgītrābhājyajaṃ vaṭamālikā ||3.2.35.40|| godharaṃ māraṇajaṃ caiva mātramadhyaṃ ca mātaram || balavatī gaṃdhavatī īāmlī ca rājyajam ||41|| rūpāvalī bahudhanaṃ chatrīṭaṃ vaṃśaṃjaṃ tathā || jāyāsaṃraṇaṃ gotikī ca citralekhaṃ tathaiva ca || 42 || dugdhāvalī haṃsāvalī ca vaiholaṃ caillajaṃ tathā || nālāvalī āsāvalī suhālī kāmataḥ param ||43|| rāmeṇa paṃcapaṃcāśadgrāmāṇi vasanāya ca || svayaṃ nirmāya dattāni dvijebhyastebhya eva ca || 44 || teṣāṃ śuśrūṣaṇārthāya vaiśyānrāmo nyave dayat || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi śūdrāstebhyaścaturguṇān ||45|| tebhyo dattāni dānāni gavāśvavasanāni ca || hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ śraddhayā parayā mudā || 46 || nārada uvāca || aṣṭādaśasahasrāste brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || kathaṃ te vyabhajangrāmāndrāmotpannaṃ tathā vasu || vastrādyaṃ bhūṣaṇādyaṃ ca tanme kathaya suvra tam ||47| || brahmovāca || || yajñāṃte dakṣiṇā yāvatsartvigbhiḥ svīkṛtā suta || mahādānādikaṃ sarvaṃ tebhya eva samarpitam ||48|| grāmāḥ sādhāraṇā dattā mahāsthānāni vai tadā || ye vasaṃti ca yatraiva tāni teṣāṃ bhavaṃtviti || 49 || vaśiṣṭhavacanāttatra grāmāste viprasātkṛtāḥ || raghūdvahena dhīreṇa nodva saṃti yathā dvijāḥ ||3.2.35.50|| dhānyaṃ teṣāṃ pradattaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ cāmitaṃ vasu || kṛtāṃjalistato rāmo brāhmaṇānidamabravīt ||51|| yathā kṛtayuge viprāstretāyāṃ ca yathā purā || tathā cādyaiva varttavyaṃ mama rājye na saṃśayaḥ || 52 || yatkiṃciddhanadhānyaṃ vā yānaṃ vā vasanāni vā || maṇayaḥ kāṃcanādīṃśca hemādīṃśca tathā vasu || 53 || tāmrādyaṃ rajatādīṃśca prārthayadhvaṃ mamādhunā || adhunā vā bhaviṣye vābhyarthanīyaṃ yathocitam || 54 || preṣaṇīyaṃ vācikaṃ me sarvadā dvijasattamāḥ || yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ prārthayadhvaṃ taṃ taṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vibho || 55|| tato rāmaḥ sevakādīnādarātpratyabhāṣata || viprājñā nollaṃghanīyā seva nīyā prayatnataḥ || 56 || yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ prārthayaṃte kārayadhvaṃ tatastataḥ || evaṃ natvā ca viprāṇāṃ sevanaṃ kurute tu yaḥ || 57 || sa śūdraḥ svargamāpnoti dhanavānputravānbhavet || anyathā nirdhanatvaṃ hi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 58 || yavano mlecchajātīyo daityo vā rākṣasopi vā|| yotra vighnaṃ karotyeva bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 59 || || brahmovāca || || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dvijānrāmo'tiharṣitaḥ || prasthānābhimukho viprairāśīrbhirabhinaṃditaḥ || 3.2.35.60 || āsīmāṃtamanuvrajya snehavyākulalocanāḥ || dvijāḥ sarve vinirvṛttā dharmāraṇye vimohitāḥ || 61 || evaṃ kṛtvā tato rāmaḥ pratasthe svāṃ purīṃ prati || kāśyapāścaiva gargāśca kṛtakṛtyā dṛḍhavratāḥ || 62 || gurvāsanasamāviṣṭāḥ sabhāryā sasuhṛtsutāḥ || rājadhānīṃ tadā prāpa rāmo'yodhyāṃ guṇānvitām || 63 || dṛṣṭvā pramuditāḥ sarve lokāḥ śrīraghunandanam || tato rāmaḥ sa dharmātmā prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 64 || sītayā saha dharmātmā rājyaṃ kurvaṃstadā sudhīḥ || jānakyā garbhamādhatta ravivaṃśodbhavāya ca || 65 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe pūrvabhāge dharmāraṇyamāhātmye śrīrāmarudrakṛtadharmāraṇyatīrthakṣetrajīrṇoddhāravarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
<3.2.36>
|| nārada uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ kimabhavattanme kathaya suvrata || pūrvaṃ ca tadaśeṣeṇa śaṃsa me vadatāmbara || 1 || sthirībhūtaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ kiyatkālaṃ vadasva me || kena vai rakṣyamāṇaṃ ca kasyājñā vartate prabho || 2 || || brahmovāca || || tretāto dvāparāṃtaṃ ca yāvatkalisamāgamaḥ || tāvatsaṃrakṣaṇe caiko hanūmānpavanātmajaḥ || 3 || samartho nānyathā kopi vinā hanumatā suta || laṃkā vidhvaṃsitā yena rākṣasāḥ prabalā hatāḥ ||4|| sa eva rakṣate tatra rāmādeśena putraka || dvijasyājñā pravarteta śrīmātāyāstathaiva ca || 5 || dinedine praharṣobhūjjanānāṃ tatra vāsināḥ || paṭhaṃti sma dvijāstatra ṛgyujuḥsāmalakṣaṇān || 6 || atharvaṇamapi tatra paṭhaṃti sma divāniśam || vedanirghoṣajaḥ śabdastrailokye sacarācare || 7 || utsavāstatra jāyaṃte grāmegrāme purepure || nānā yajñāḥ pravartaṃte nānādharmasamāśritāḥ || 8 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kadāpi tasya sthānasya bhaṃgo jātotha vā na vā || daityairjitaṃ kadā sthānamathavā duṣṭarākṣasaiḥ || 9 || || vyāsa uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājandharmajñastvaṃ sadā śuciḥ || ādau kaliyuge prāpte yaddattaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva bhoḥ || 3.2.36.10 || lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kāmāya ca sukhāya ca || yajñaṃ ca kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate ||11|| idānīṃ ca kalau prāpta āmo nāmā vabhūva ha || kānyakubjādhipaḥ śrīmāndharmajño nītitatparaḥ || 12 || śāṃto dāṃtaḥ suśīlaśca satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || dvāparāṃte nṛpaśreṣṭha anāgame kalau yuge || 13 || bhayātkaliviśeṣeṇa adharmasya bhayādibhiḥ || sarve devāḥ kṣitiṃ tyaktvā naimiṣāraṇyamāśritāḥ || 14 || rāmopi setubaṃdhaṃ hi sasahāyo gato nṛpa || 15 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kīdṛśaṃ hi kalau prāpte bhayaṃ loke sudustaram || yasminsuraiḥ parityaktā ratnagarbhā vasundharā || 16 || || vyāsa uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva kalidharmāstvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti yathā nṛpa || asatyavādino lokāḥ sādhunindāparāyaṇāḥ || 17 || dasyukarmaratāḥ sarve pitṛbhaktivivarjitāḥ || svagotradārābhiratā laulyadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 18 || brahmavidveṣiṇaḥ sarve parasparavirodhinaḥ || śaraṇāgatahaṃtāro bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge || 19 || vaiśyācāraratā viprā vedabhraṣṭāśca māninaḥ || bhaviṣyaṃti kalau prāpte saṃdhyālopakarā dvijāḥ || 3.2.36.20 || śāṃtau śūrā bhaye dīnāḥ śrāddhatarpaṇavarjitāḥ || asurācāraniratā viṣṇubhaktivivarjitāḥ || 21 || paravittābhilāṣāśca utkoca grahaṇe ratāḥ || asnātabhojino viprāḥ kṣatriyā raṇavarjitāḥ || 22 || bhaviṣyaṃti kalau prāpte malinā duṣṭavṛttayaḥ || madyapānaratāḥ sarvepyayā jyānāṃ hi yājakāḥ || 23 || bhartṛdveṣakarā rāmāḥ pitṛdveṣakarāḥ sutāḥ || bhrātṛdveṣakarāḥ kṣudrā bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge || 24 || gavyavikrayiṇaste vai brāhmaṇā vittatatparāḥ || gāvo dugdhaṃ na duhyaṃte saṃprāpte hi kalau yuge || 25 || phalaṃte naiva vṛkṣāśca kadācidapi bhārata || kanyāvikraya karttāro gojāvikrayakārakāḥ || 26 || viṣavikrayakarttāro rasavikrayakārakāḥ || vedavikrayakarttāro bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge || 27 || nārī garbhaṃ samādhatte hāyanaikādaśena hi || ekādaśyupavāsasya viratāḥ sarvato janāḥ || 28 || na tīrthasevanaratā bhaviṣyaṃti ca vāḍavāḥ || bahvāhārā bhaviṣyaṃti bahunidrāsamākulāḥ || 29 || jihmavṛttiparāḥ sarve vedaniṃdāparāyaṇāḥ || yatiniṃdāparāścaiva cchadmakārāḥ parasparam || 3.2.36.30 || sparśadoṣabhayaṃ naiva bhaviṣyati kalau yuge || kṣatriyā rājyahīnāśca mleccho rājā bhaviṣyati || 31 || viśvāsaghātinaḥ sarve gurudroharatāstathā || mitradroharatā rājañchiśnodaraparāyaṇāḥ || 32 || ekavarṇā bhaviṣyaṃti varṇāścatvāra eva ca || kalau prāpte mahārāja nānyathā vacanaṃ mama || 33 || etacchrutvā guroreva kānyakubjādhipo balī || rājyaṃ prakurute tatra āmo nāmnā hi bhūtale || 34 || sārvabhaumatvamāpannaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ || prajānāṃ kalinā tatra pāpe buddhirajāyata || 35 || vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmamutsajya vauddhadharmamupāgatāḥ || prajāstamanuvartinyaḥ kṣapaṇaiḥ pratibodhitāḥ||36|| tasya rājño mahādevī māmānāmnyativiśrutā || garbhaṃ dadhāra sā rājño sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 37 || saṃpūrṇe daśame māsi jātā tasyāḥ surūpiṇī || duhitā samaye rājñyāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanā || 38 || ratnagaṃgeti nāmnā sā maṇimāṇikyabhūṣitā || ekadā daivayogena deśāṃtarādupāgataḥ || 39 || nāmnā caiveṃdrasūrirvai deśesminkānyakubjake || ṣoḍaśābdā ca sā kanyā nopanītā nṛpātmajā ||3.2.36.40|| dāsyāṃtareṇa militā indrasūriśca jīvikaḥ || śābarīṃ maṃtravidyāṃ ca kathayāmāsa bhārata ||41|| ekacittābhavatsā tu śūlikarmavimohitā || tataḥ sā mohamāpannā tattadvākyaparāyaṇā||42|| kṣapaṇairbodhitā vatsa jainadharmaparāyaṇā || brahmāvartādhipataye kuṃbhīpālāya dhīmate ||43|| ratnagaṃgāṃ mahādevīṃ dadau tāmiti vikramī|| moherekaṃ dadau tasmai vivāhe daivamohitaḥ || 44 || dharmāraṇyaṃ samāgatya rājadhānī kṛtā tadā || devāṃśca sthāpayāmāsa jainadharmapraṇītakān || 45 || sarve varṇāstathābhūtā jaina dharmasamāśritāḥ || brāhmaṇā naiva pūjyaṃte na ca śāṃtikapauṣṭikam || 46 || na dadāti kadā dānamevaṃ kālaḥ pravartate || labdhaśāsanakā viprā luptasvāmyā aharniśam || 47 || samākulitacittāste nṛpamāmaṃ samāyayuḥ || kānyakubjasthitaṃ śūraṃ pākhaṇḍaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || 48 || kānyakubjapuraṃ prāpya katibhirvāsarairnṛpa || gaṃgopakaṇṭhe nyavasañchrāṃtāste moḍhavāḍavāḥ || 49 || cāraiśca kathitāste ca nṛpasyāgre samāgatāḥ || prātarākāritā viprā āgatā nṛpasaṃsadi || 3.2.36.50 || pratyutthānābhivādādīnna cakre sādaraṃ nṛpaḥ || tiṣṭhato brāhmaṇānsarvānparyapṛcchadasau tataḥ || 51 || kimarthamāgatā viprāḥ kiṃsvitkāryaṃ bruvaṃtu tat || 52 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || dharmāraṇyādihāyātāstvatsamīpaṃ narādhipa || rājaṃstava sutāyāstu bhartā kumārapālakaḥ || 53 || tena praluptaṃ viprāṇāṃ śāsanaṃ mahadadbhutam || vartatā jainadharmeṇa preriteneṃdrasūriṇā || 54 || || rājovāca || || kena vai sthāpitā yūyamasminmoherake pure || etaddhi vāḍavāḥ sarvaṃ brūta vṛttaṃ yathātatham || 55 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || kājeśaiḥ sthāpitāḥ pūrvaṃ dharmarājena dhīmatā || kṛtā cātra śubhe sthāne rāmeṇa ca tataḥ purī || 56 || śāsanaṃ rāmacaṃdrasya dṛṣṭvā'nyaiścaiva rājabhiḥ || pālitaṃ dharmato hyatra śāsanaṃ nṛpasattama || 57 || idānīṃ tava jāmātā viprānpālayate na hi || tacchrutvā vipravākyaṃ tu rājā viprānathābravīt || 58 || yāṃtu śīghraṃ hi bho viprāḥ kathayaṃtu mamājñayā || rājñe kumārapālāya dehi tvaṃ brāhmaṇālayam || 59 || śrutvā vākyaṃ tato viprāḥ paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ || jagmustato'timuditā vākyaṃ tatra niveditam || 3.2.36.60 || śvaśurasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā vacanamabravīt || || kumārapāla uvāca || || rāmasya śāsanaṃ viprāḥ pālayiṣyāmyahaṃ nahi || 61 || tyajāmi brāhmaṇānyajñe paśuhiṃsāparāyaṇān || tasmāddhi hiṃsakānāṃ tu na me bhaktirbhaveddvijāḥ || 62 || || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ pākhaṃḍadharmeṇa luptaśāsanako bhavān || pālayasva nṛpaśreṣṭha mā sma pāpe manaḥ kṛthāḥ || 63 || || rājovāca || || ahiṃsā paramo dharmo ahiṃsā ca paraṃ tapaḥ || ahiṃsā paramaṃ jñānamahiṃsā paramaṃ phalam || 64 || tṛṇeṣu caiva vṛkṣeṣu pataṃgeṣu nareṣu ca || kīṭeṣu matkuṇādyeṣu ajāśveṣu gajeṣu ca || 65|| lūtāsu caiva sarpeṣu mahiṣyādiṣu vai tathā || jaṃtavaḥ sadṛśā viprāḥ sūkṣmeṣu ca mahatsu ca || 66 || kathaṃ yūyaṃ pravartadhve viprā hiṃsāparāyaṇāḥ || tacchrutvā vajratulyaṃ hi vacanaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 67 || pratyūcurvāḍavāḥ sarve krodharaktekṣaṇā dṛśā || 68 || || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ satyametattvayoditam || paraṃ tathāpi dharmo'sti śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 69 || yā vedavihitā hiṃsā sā na hiṃseti nirṇayaḥ || śastreṇāhanyate yacca pīḍā jaṃtuṣu jāyate || 3.2.36.70 || sa evādharma evāsti loke dharmavidāṃ vara || vedamaṃtraivihanyaṃte vinā śastreṇa jaṃtavaḥ || 71 || jaṃtupīḍākarā naiva sā hiṃsā sukhadāyinī || paropakāraḥ puṇyāya pāpāya parapīḍanam || 72 || vedoditāṃ vidhāyāpi hiṃsāṃ pāpairna lipyate || viprāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā punarvacanamabravīt || 73 || || rājovāca || || brahmādīnāṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ dharmāraṇyamanuttamam || brahmaviṣṇu maheśādyā nedānīmatra saṃti te || 74 || na dharmo vidyate vātra ukto rāmaḥ sa mānuṣaḥ || kva vāpi laṃbapucho'sau yo mukto rakṣaṇāya vaḥ || 75 || śāsanaṃ cenna dṛṣṭaṃ vo naiva tatpālayāmyaham || dvijāḥ kopasamāviṣṭā daduḥ pratyuttaraṃ tadā || 76 || || dvijā ūcuḥ || || re mūḍha tvaṃ kathaṃ vettha bhāṣase madalolupaḥ || sa daityānāṃ vināśāya dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca || 77 || rāmaścaturbhujaḥ sākṣānmānuṣatvaṃ gato bhuvi || agatīnāṃ ca gatidaḥ sa vai dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || dayāluśca kṛpāluśca jaṃtūnāṃ paripālakaḥ || 78 || || rājovāca || || kuto'dya varttate rāmaḥ kuto vai vāyunaṃdanaḥ || bhraṣṭābhramiva te sarve kva rāmo hanumāniti || 79 || paraṃtu rāmo hanumānyadi vartteta sarvataḥ || idānīṃ viprasāhāyya āgamiṣyati me matiḥ || 3.2.36.80 || darśayadhvaṃ hanūmaṃtaṃ rāmaṃ vā lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā || yadyasti pratyayaḥ kaścitsa no viprāḥ pradarśyatām ||81|| uktaṃ tai rāmadevena dūtaṃ kṛtvāṃjanīsutam || catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaṃ dattaṃ grāmaśataṃ nṛpa || 62 || punarāgatya sthāne'smindattā grāmāstrayodaśa || kāśyapyāṃ caiva gaṃgāyāṃ mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || 83 || dattāni vipramukhyebhyo dattā grāmāḥ suśobhanāḥ || punaḥ saṃkalpitā vīra ṣaṭpaṃcāśakasaṃkhyayā || 84 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi gobhujā jajñire varāḥ || sapādalakṣā vaṇijo dattā māṃḍalikābhidhāḥ || 85 || tenoktaṃ vāḍavāḥ sarve darśayadhvaṃ hi mārutim || yasyābhijñānamātreṇa sthitiṃ pūrvāṃ dadāmyaham || 86 || vipravākyaṃ kariṣyāmi pratyayo darśyate yadi || tataḥ sarve bhaviṣyaṃti vedadharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 87 || anyathā jainadharmeṇa varttayadhvaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ || nṛpavākyaṃ tu te śrutvā svesve sthāne samāgatāḥ || 88 || vāḍavaḥ khinnamanasaḥ krodhenāṃdhīkṛtā bhuvi || niśvāsānmuṃcamānāste hāheti pravadaṃti ca ||89|| daṃtānprāgharṣayansarvānnyapīḍaṃśca karaiḥ karān || parasparaṃ bhāṣamāṇāḥ kathaṃ kurmo vayaṃ tvitaḥ ||3.2.36.90|| militvā vāḍavāḥ sarve cakruste maṃtramuttamam || rāmavākyaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā dhyātvā caivāṃjanīsutam||91|| dvijamelāpakaṃ cakrurbālā vṛddhatamā api || teṣāṃ vṛddhatamo vipro vākyamūce śubhaṃ tadā || 92 || catuḥṣaṣṭiśca gotrāṇāmasmākaṃ ye dvisaptatiḥ || svasvagotrasyāvaṭaṃkā ekagrāmābhibhāṣiṇaḥ || 93 || prayātu svasvavargasya eko hyeko dvijaḥ sudhīḥ || rāmeśvaraṃ setu baṃdhaṃ hanūmāṃstatra vidyate || 94 || sarve prayāṃtu tatraiva rāmapārśve nirāmayāḥ || nirāhārā jitakrodhā māyayā varjitāḥ punaḥ || 95 || ekāgramānasāḥ sarve stutvā dhyātvā japaṃtu tam || tato dāśarathī rāmo dayāṃ kṛtvā dvijanmasu ||96|| śāsanaṃ ca pradāsyati acalaṃ ca yugeyuge || mahatā tapasā tuṣṭaḥ pradāsyati samīhitam || 97 || yasya vargasya yo vipro na prayāsyati tatra vai || sa ca vargātparityājyaḥ sthānadharmānna saṃśayaḥ ||98|| vaṇigvṛtte na saṃbaṃdhe na vivāhe kadācana || grāmavṛtte na saṃbaṃdhaḥ sarvasthāne bahiṣkṛtāḥ || 99 || sabhāvākyaṃ ca tacchrutvā tanmadhye vāḍavaḥ śuciḥ || vāgmī dakṣaḥ suśabdaśca triravaiḥ śrāvayandvijān || 3.2.36.100 || prativākyaṃ dattatālaṃ tiṣṭhannetadvaco'bravīt || asatyavādināṃ yacca pātakaṃ pariniṃdake || paradārābhigamane paradroharate nare || 101 || madyapeṣu ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ hemahāriṣu || tatpāpaṃ ca bhavettasya gamane yaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ || atha kiṃ bahunoktena yāṃtu satyaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 102 || tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ gamanāya mano dadhe || gacchatastāndvijāñchrutvā rājā kumārapālakaḥ || 103 || samāhūya kṛṣeḥ karma bhikṣāṭanamathāpi vā || nānāgotrebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prāpayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ || 104 || tacchrutvā vyathitāḥ sarve kiṃ bhaviṣyatyataḥ param || tathā trīṇi sahasrāṇi prabaṃdhaṃ cakrire tadā || 105 || gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve rāmaṃ prati na saṃśayaḥ || hastākṣarapradānaṃ vai anyonyaṃ tu kṛtaṃ dvijaiḥ || 106 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭā viprā vākyametadathābruvan || naśyate'tra trayī vidyā trayīmūrtiḥ prakupyati || 107 || tasmāttatraiva gaṃtavyamaṣṭādaśasahasrakaiḥ || tataḥ sa vaṇijaḥ sarvānsamāhūya ca gobhujān || 108 || vākyamūce nṛpaśreṣṭho vārayadhvaṃ dvijāniti || 109 || || vyāsa uvāca || na jainadharme ye liptā gobhujā vaṇiguttamāḥ || vṛttibhaṃgabhayāttatra maunameva samācaran || 3.2.36.110 || vārayāma kathaṃ viprānvahnirūpāndahaṃti te || śāpāgninā narapate dvijā mṛtyuparāyaṇāḥ || 111 || aḍālayeṣu ye jātāḥ śūdrā āhūya tānnṛpaḥ || nivāryaṃtāmiti prāha vāḍavā gamanodyatāḥ || || 112 || teṣāṃ madhye katipayā jainadharmasamāśritāḥ || gatā vāḍavapuṃjeṣu rājādeśānnivāraṇe || 113 || || kecicchrūdrā ūcuḥ || || kva rāmo lakṣmaṇopetaḥ kva ca vāyusuto balī || vartamānena kālena vaktavyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 114 || vyāghrasiṃhākule durge vane vanagajāśrite || parityajya priyānprāṇānputrāndārānniketanān|| 115 || kimarthaṃ gamyate viprā rājye vai duṣṭaśāsane || tacchrutvā vāḍavāḥ kecidvākyena manasā'smaran || 116 || paṃcadaśasahasrāste vāḍavā nṛpasattamāt || bhayāllobhācca dānācca tatsarvaṃ bhavatāmiti || 117 || vṛttopakalpanenaiva kariṣyāmaḥ kadācana || kṛṣi karma kariṣyāmo bhikṣāṭanamathāpi vā || 118 || tataśca te paṃcadaśasahasrā dvijasattamāḥ || dāruṇaṃ vākyamūcustānyāṃtu cānye yathocitam || 119 || śāsanaṃ bhavatāmastu rāmadattaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || trayīvidyāstu vikhyātāḥ sarve vāḍavapuṃgavāḥ || 3.2.36.120 || sahasrāṇi ca trīṇyeva traividyā abhavandhruvam|||| 121 || || rājovāca || || caturdhāṃśena rājyaṃ ca kiṃciddattā vasundharā || tasmāccaturvidhetyevaṃ jñātibandhamataḥ param || 122 || cyavano dāsyate kanyāṃ yūyaṃ kanyāmavāpnuta || na vṛttirna ca saṃbaṃdho bhavatāṃ syātkadāpi vā || 123 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā trayīvidyāśca vāḍavāḥ || svesve sthāne gatāḥ sarve saṃketādanivṛttya ca || 124 || paṃcadaśa sahasrāṇi tatastu dvijapuṃgavāḥ || yathāgataṃ gatāḥ sarve cāturvidyā dvijottamāḥ || 125 || taddine ativāhyātha ciṃtāviṣṭena cetasā || vāryamāṇāḥ svaputraiste dāraiśca vinayānvitaiḥ || 126 || ekāgramānasā sarve na nidrāmupalebhire || brāhme muhūrte cotthāya māyāṃ tyaktā hi laukikīm || 127 || parityajya priyānputrāndārānsanilayānapi || grāmopāṃteṣu militāḥ sarve vāḍavapuṃgavāḥ || 128 || sahasrāṇi tadā trīṇi kṛtanityāhnikakriyāḥ || viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā saṃpūjya kulamātaram || 129 || viprasaṃghavināśāya dakṣiṇadvārasaṃsthitaḥ || siṃdūrapuṣpamālābhiḥ pūjito gaṇanāyakaḥ||3.2.36.130|| pūjito bakulasvāmī sūryasarvārthasādhakaḥ|| ādarācca mahāśaktiḥ śrīmātā pūjitā tathā||131|| śāṃtāṃ caiva namaskṛtya jñānajāṃ gotramātaram|| gamanenodyamānāste paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ||132|| cāturvidyā dvijāścaiva punarāmaṃtrya tānprati|| papracchuśca muhuḥ sarvaṃ samāgamanakāraṇam || 133 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || na gaṃtavyaṃ bhavadbhirvai gatvā vā''yāṃtu satvarāḥ || 134 || yathā rāmapradattaṃ hi upakalpayase'cirāt || śrutvā punarathocuste cāturvidyā dvijottamāḥ || 135 || na sthānena dvijairvāpi na ca vṛttyāṃ kathaṃcana || vayaṃ naivāgamiṣyāmaḥ kathanīyaṃ na vai punaḥ || 136 || raghūdvahena dattā vai vṛttirvo dvijasattamāḥ || tāṃ vṛttiṃ prati yāsyāmo japahomārcanādibhiḥ || 137 || te paṃcadaśasāhasrāḥ punastānūcurādarāt || asmābhiratra sthātavyamagnisevārthatatparaiḥ || 138 || yuṣmābhistatra gaṃtavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ kāryasiddhaye || anyonyaṃ sarvasāhāyā vṛttiṃ yāma na saṃśayaḥ || 139 || tyaktasvakīyavacanā vṛttihīnā bhaviṣyatha || tatastanmadhyataḥ kaściccāturvidya uvāca ha||3.2.36.140|| cāturvidya uvāca|| pūrvaṃ hi vṛttimasmākaṃ rāmo vai dattavāndvijāḥ|| cāturvidyā mahāsattvāḥ svadharmapratipālakāḥ || 141 || yājanādhyayanāyuktāḥ kājeśena vinirmitāḥ || dānaṃ dattvā tu rāmeṇa uktaṃ hi bhavatāṃ punaḥ || 142 || sthānaṃ tyaktvā na gaṃtavyamitthaṃ hi niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ || āpatkāle tu smartavyo vāyuputro mahābalaḥ || 143 || iti rāmeṇa pūrvaṃ hi sve sthāne sthāpitāstadā || rāma vākyamanyathā tatkṛtvā gacchetkathaṃ punaḥ || 144 || tasmādyuṣmānvayaṃ brūmo gacchata kāryasiddhaye || bhavatāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ vayaṃ homārcanādibhiḥ || 145 || jhaṭiti kāryasiddhiḥ syātsatyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || iti vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā te dvijā gamanaṃ prati || 146 || prasthānaṃ ca vidhāyādau gamanāya mano dadhuḥ || trisāhasrāstadā tasmātprasthitā dvijasattamāḥ || 147 || deśāddeśāṃtaraṃ gatvā vanāccaiva vanāṃtaram || tīrthetīrthe kṛtaśrāddhāḥ susaṃta satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ || te gatā dūramadhvānaṃ hanumaddarśanārthinaḥ||3.2.36.150|| saṃdhyāmupāsate nityaṃ trikālaṃ caikamānasāḥ|| evaṃ tu gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ śakunā abhavacchubhāḥ || 151 || evaṃ tu gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ pātheyaṃ truṭitaṃ tadā || śrāṃtā glāniṃ gatāḥ sarve padaṃ paramamāsthitāḥ || 152 || kramitvā kiyatī bhūmiṃ padaṃ gaṃtuṃ na tu kṣamāḥ || manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā dṛḍhīkṛtya svamānasam || 153 || hanatmaṃtamadṛṣṭvaiva na yāsyāmo vayaṃ gṛhān || trai vidyāstu gatāstatra yatra rāmeśvaro hariḥ || 154 || dṛḍhavratāḥ satyaparāḥ kandamūlaphalāśanāḥ || dhyāyaṃto rāmarāmeti hanūmaṃteti vai punaḥ || 155 || gṛhītvā niyamaṃ te'pi tyaktvā cānnaṃ tathodakam || tṛṣārtāśca kṣudhārtāśca yayurvrataparāyaṇāḥ || 156 || evaṃ tu kliśyamānānāṃ dvijānāṃ bhaktibhājanaḥ || udvignamānaso rāmo hanūmaṃtamathābravīt || 157 || śīghraṃ gaccha dvijārthe tvaṃ pavanātmaja dharmavit || kliśyaṃte vāḍavāḥ sarve dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ || 158 || dahyate mānasaṃ me'dya nānyathā śāntirasti me || viprāṇāṃ duḥkhakarttā ca śāstavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 159 || yena vai duḥkhitā viprāstenāhaṃ duḥkhitaḥ kape ||3.2.36.160|| rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā namaskṛtya ca rāghavam|| kṛpayā parayāviṣṭaḥ prādurāsīddharīśvaraḥ|| 161|| vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa parīkṣārthaṃ dvijanmanām|| uvāca parayā bhaktyā brāhmaṇāñchramadurbalān||162|| kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā karānmuktvā kamaṃḍalum || sarvānpratyabhivādyātha vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 163 || kutaḥ sthānādiha prāptā gaṃtukāmāśca vai kutaḥ || kimarthaṃ vai bhavadbhiśca gamyate dāruṇaṃ vanam || 164|| || viprā ūcuḥ || || dharmāraṇyātsamāyātā nijaduḥkhaṃ niveditum || rāmasya darśanārthaṃ hi gaṃtukāmā vayaṃ dvijāḥ || 165 || setubaṃdhaṃ mahātīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam|| niyamasthāḥ kṣīṇadehā rāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ || 166 || yatra rāmeśvaro devaḥ sākṣādvāyusutaḥ kapiḥ || tacchrutvā sa dvijaḥ prāha kva rāmaḥ kva ca vāyujaḥ || 167 || kva setubaṃdharāmeśo dūrāddūrataro dvijāḥ || vyāghrasiṃhākulaṃ cograṃ vanaṃ ghorataraṃ mahat|| gatvā yasmānna vartaṃte tadugramanujīvinaḥ || nivartadhvaṃ mahābhāgā yadi kāryaṃ hi madvacaḥ || 169 || athavā gamyatāṃ viprāściraṃ jīva sukhī bhava || vṛddhasya vākyaṃ tacchrutvā vāḍavāścaikamānasāḥ ||3.2.36.170|| vipra gacchāmahe sarve rāmapārśvamasaṃśayaḥ || mriyeta yadi mārge'sminrāmaloka mavāpnuyrāt || 171 || jīvanvṛttimavāpnoti rāmadeva na saṃśayaḥ || anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti asmākaṃ rāghavaṃ vinā || 172 || ityuktvā nirgatāḥ sarve rāmadarśanatatparāḥ || dināṃtamativāhyātha prabhāte vimale punaḥ || 173 || hanumānbrahmarūpī sa vṛddhaḥ pūrvaguṇānvitaḥ || kamaṃḍaludharo dhīmānabhivādanata tparaḥ || 174 || kutrasthānādiha prāptāḥ sarve yūyaṃ hi vāḍavāḥ || kutrāsti vā mahālābho vivāhotsava eva vā || 175 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāḍavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || praṇāmapūrvāṃ vijñaptiṃ kathayāmāsurādṛtāḥ || 176 || asmākaṃ tu purā vṛttaṃ mahadāścaryakārakam || bhūmideva śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ dayālurdṛśyase yataḥ || 177 || ādau sṛṣṭisamāraṃbhe sthāpitā keśavena ca || śivena brahmaṇā caiva trimūrtisthāpitā vayam || 178 || śrī rāmeṇa tataḥ paścājjīrṇoddhāreṇa sthāpitāḥ || grāmāṇāṃ vetanaṃ dattaṃ harirājena cādarāt||179|| catuścatvāriṃśadadhikacatuḥśatamitātmanām || grāmāstrayodaśārcārthaṃ sītāpurasamanvitāḥ||| ||3.2.36.180|| ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi vaṇijo dvijapālane || gobhūjasaṃjñāste śūdrāstebhyaḥ sapādalakṣakāḥ || 181 || te ca jātāstridhā tāta gobhūjāḍālajā stathā || māṃḍalīyāstathā caite trividhāśca manoramāḥ ||182|| vṛttyarthaṃ tena dattā vai hyanarghyā ratnakoṭayaḥ || tadā te moḍha 18000 gobhūjā 18000 | māṃḍalīyā 125000 aḍālajāḥ 18000 ||183|| adhunā vāḍavaśreṣṭha āmonāma mahīpatiḥ || śāsanaṃ rāmacaṃdrasya na mānayati durmatiḥ ||184||| jāmātā tasya duṣṭo vai nāmnā kumārapālakaḥ || pāṣaṃḍairveṃṣṭito nityaṃ kalidharmeṇa saṃmataḥ || 185 || indrasūtreṇa jainena prerito bauddhadharmiṇā || śāsanaṃ tena luptaṃ hi rāmadattaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 186 || vāṇijastādṛśāḥ ke'pi tanmanaskā babhūvire || niṣedhayaṃti rāmaṃ te hanumaṃtaṃ mahāmatim ||187|| pratyayaṃ tu vinā viprā na dāsyāmīti niścitam || taṃ jñātvā tu ime viprā rāmaṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ ||188|| hanumaṃtaṃ mahāvīraṃ rāmaśāsanapālakam || tasmādgacchāmahe sarve rāmaṃ prati mahāmate || 189 || āṃjaneyo yadāsmākaṃ na dāsyati samīhitam || anāhāravratenaiva prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmahe vayam || 3.2.36.190 || asmābhiste viśeṣeṇa kathitaṃ paripṛcchate || snehabhāvaṃ viciṃtyāśu nijavṛttiṃ prakāśaya ||191|| hanumānuvāca || prāpte kaliyuge viprāḥ kva devadarśanaṃ bhavet || nivarttadhvaṃ hi viprendrā yadīcchatha sukhaṃ mahat || 192 || vyāghrasiṃhākule śūnye vane vanagajāśrite || bahudāvasamāviṣṭe praveṣṭuṃ naiva śakyate || 193 || || viprā ūcuḥ || | atīte divase vipra ekaṃ kathitavānidam || adyaiva tvaṃ samāgamya evameva prabhāṣase || 194 || kastvaṃ vāḍavarūpeṇa rāmo vāpyatha vāyujaḥ || satyaṃ kathaya naḥ svāsmindayāṃ kṛtvā mahādvija || 195 || hanumānkathayāmāsa gopitaṃ yaddvijāgrataḥ || hanumānityahaṃ viprā budhyadhvaṃ niścitā hi mām || 196 || svarūpaṃ prakaṭīkṛtya lāṃgūlaṃ darśayanmahat || 197 || || hanumānuvāca || || ayamaṃbhonidhiḥ sākṣātsetubaṃdho manoramaḥ || ayaṃ rāmeśvaro devo garbhavāsavināśakṛt || 198 || iyaṃ tu nagarī śreṣṭhā laṃkānāmeti viśrutā || yatra sītā mayā prāptā rāmaśokāpahāriṇī || 199 || tarjanyagre dvijaśreṣṭhā agamyā māṃ vinā paraiḥ || sā suvarṇamayī bhāti yasyāṃ rājye vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 3.2.36.200 || sthāpito rāmadevena seyaṃ laṃkā mahāpurī || niyamasthaiḥ sādhuvṛṃdaistīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ || 201 || ānīya gaṃgāsalilaṃ rāmeśamabhiṣicya ca || kṣiptā ete mahābhārā dṛśyaṃte sāgarāṃtare ||202||| niṣpāpāstena saṃjātāḥ sādhavaste dṛḍhavratāḥ || nūnaṃ puṇyodaye vṛddhiḥ pāpe hāniśca jāyate || 203 || sthānabhraṣṭāḥ kṛtāḥ pūrvaṃ cāturvidyā dvijātayaḥ || jīrṇoddhāreṇa rāmeṇa sthāpitāḥ punareva hi || pūrvajanmani bho viprā haripūjā kṛtā mayā || 204 || sāṃprataṃ niścalā bhaktirbhavatsevā hi dṛśyate || tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa tuṣṭo dāsyāmi vo varam || 205 || dhanyohaṃ kṛtakṛtyohaṃ subhāgyohaṃ dharātale || adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 206 || yadahaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca prāptavāṃścaraṇāṃtikam || 207 || || vyāsa uvāca || || dṛṣṭvaiva hanumantaṃ te pulakāṃkitavigrahāḥ || sagadgadaṃ yathocuste vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradāḥ || 208 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe dharmāraṇya māhātmye hanumatsamāgamo nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||36||
<3.2.37>
||vyāsa uvāca|| tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pratyūcuḥ pavanātmajam|| adhunā saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 1 || adya no moḍhalokānāṃ dhanyo dharmaśca vai gṛhāḥ|| dhanyā ca sakalā pṛthvī yajñadharmā hyanekaśaḥ || 2 || namaḥ śrīrāma bhaktāya akṣavidhvaṃsanāya ca || namo rakṣaḥpurīdāhakāriṇe vajradhāriṇe || 3 || jānakīhṛdayatrāṇakāriṇe karuṇātmane || sītāviraha taptasya śrīrāmasya priyāya ca || 4 || namo'stu te mahāvīra rakṣāsmānmajjataḥ kṣitau || namo brāhmaṇadevāya vāyuputrāya te namaḥ || 5 || namo'stu rāma bhaktāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca || namostu rudrarūpāya kṛṣṇavaktrāya te tamaḥ || 6 || aṃjanīsūnave nityaṃ sarvavyādhiharāya ca || nāgayajñopavītāya prabalāya namo'stu te || 7 || svayaṃ samudratīrṇāya setubaṃdhanakāriṇe || 8 || || vyāsa uvāca || || stotreṇaivāmunā tuṣṭo vāyuputro'bravīdvacaḥ || śṛṇudhvaṃ hi varaṃ viprā yadvo manasi rocate || 9 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa rāmājñāpālaka prabho || svarūpaṃ darśayasvādya laṃkāyāṃ yatkṛtaṃ hare || 3.2.37.10 || tathā vidhvaṃsavādya tvaṃ rājānaṃ pāpakāriṇam || duṣṭaṃ kumārapālaṃ hi āmaṃ caiva na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || vṛttilopaphalaṃ sadyaḥ prāpnuyāttvaṃ tathā kuru || pratītyarthaṃ mahābāho kiṃ vilaṃbaṃ vadasva naḥ ||12|| tvayi cittena dattena sa rājā puṇyabhāgbhavet || pratyaye darśite vīra śāsanaṃ pālayiṣyati || 13 || trayīdharmmaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu vistāraṃ prāpayiṣyati || dharmadhīra mahāvīra svarūpaṃ darśayasva naḥ || 14 || || hanumānuvāca || || matsvarūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ na cakṣurviṣayaṃ kalau || tejorāśimayaṃ divyamiti jānaṃtu vāḍavāḥ || 15 || tathāpi parayā bhaktyā prasanno'haṃ stavādibhiḥ || vasanāṃtaritaṃ rūpaṃ darśayiṣyāmi paśyata || 16 || evamuktāstadā viprāḥ sarvakāryasamutsukāḥ || mahārūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahāpucchasamākulam || 17 || dṛṣṭvā divyasvarūpaṃ taṃ hanumaṃtaṃ jaharṣire || kathaṃciddhairyamālaṃbya viprāḥ procuḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 18 || yathoktaṃ tu purāṇeṣu tattathaiva hi dṛśyate || uvāca sa hi tānsarvāṃścakṣuḥ pracchādya saṃsthitān || 19 || phalānīmāni gṛhṇīdhvaṃ bhakṣaṇārthamṛṣīśvarāḥ || ebhistu bhakṣitairviprā hyatitṛptirbhaviṣyati || 3.2.37.20 || dharmāraṇyaṃ vinā vādya kṣudhā vaḥ śāmyati dhuvam || 21 || || vyāsa uvāca || || kṣudhākrāṃtaistadā vipraiḥ kṛtaṃ vai phalabhakṣaṇam || amṛtaprāśanamiva tṛptisteṣāmajāyata || 22 || na tṛṣā naiva kṣuccaiva viprāḥ saṃkliṣṭamānasāḥ || abhavansahasā rājanvismayāviṣṭacetasaḥ ||23|| tataḥ prāhāṃjanīputraḥ saṃprāpte hi kalau dvijāḥ || nāgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tatra muktvā rāmeśvaraṃ śivam || 24 || abhijñānaṃ mayā dattaṃ gṛhītvā tatra gacchata || tathyametatpratīyeta tasya rājño na saṃśayaḥ || 25 || ityuktvā bāhumuddhṛtya bhujayorubhayorapi || pṛthagromāṇi saṃgṛhya cakāra puṭikādvayam || 26 || bhūrjapatreṇa saṃveṣṭya te adādviprakakṣayoḥ || vāme tu vāmakakṣotthāṃ dakṣiṇotthāṃ tu dakṣiṇe || 27 || kāmadāṃ rāmabhaktasya anyeṣāṃ kṣayakāriṇīm || uvāca ca yadā rājā brūte cihnaṃ pradīyatām || 28 || tadā pradīyatāṃ śīghraṃ vāmakakṣodbhavā puṭī || athavā tasya rājñastu dvāre tu puṭikāṃ kṣipa || 29 || jvālayati ca tatsainyaṃ gṛhaṃ kośaṃ tathaiva ca || mahiṣyaḥ putrakāḥ sarvaṃ jvalamānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3.2.37.30 || yadā tu vṛttiṃ grāmāṃśca vaṇijānāṃ baliṃ tathā || pūrvaṃ sthitaṃ tu yatkiṃcittattaddāsyati vāḍavāḥ || 31 || likhitvā niścayaṃ kṛtvāpyatha dadyātsa pūrvavat || karasaṃpuṭakaṃ kṛtvā praṇamecca yadā nṛpaḥ || 32 || saṃprāpya ca purā vṛttiṃ rāmadattāṃ dvijottamāḥ || tato dakṣiṇakakṣāsthakeśānāṃ puṭikā tviyam || 33 || prakṣipyatāṃ tadā sainyaṃ purāvacca bhaviṣyati ||| gṛhāṇi ca tathā kośaḥ putrapautrādayastathā || 34 || vahninā mucyamānāste dṛśyaṃte tatkṣaṇāditi || śrutvā'mṛtamayaṃ vākyaṃ hanumaṃtoditaṃ param ||35|| alabhanta mudaṃ viprā nanṛtuḥ prajagurbhṛśam || jayaṃ codairayanke'pi prahasanti parasparam || 36 || pulakāṃkitasarvāṅgāḥ stuvanti ca muhurmuhuḥ || pucchaṃ tasya ca saṃgṛhya cucuṃbuḥ kecidutsukāḥ || 37 || brūte'nyo mama yatnena kāryaṃ niyatameva hi || anyo brūte mahābhāga mayedaṃ kṛtamityuta |||68||| tataḥ provāca hanumāṃstrirātraṃ sthīyatāmiha || rāmatīrthasya
