vinaṣṭadaṃtāmavyaktāṃ viluṭhaṃtīṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 6 || caṃḍārkakiraṇaspṛṣṭakharoṣṇarajasāplutām|| viṇmūtrapūyadigdhāṃgīmasṛggaṃdhadurāsadām || 7 || kapharogabahuśvāsaślathannāḍībahuvyathām || vidhvastakeśāvayavāmapaśyaṃ maraṇonmukhīm || 8 || tādṛgvyathāṃ ca tāṃ vīkṣya kṛpayāhaṃ pariplutaḥ || pratīkṣanmaraṇaṃ tasyāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 9 || athāṃtarikṣapadavīṃ siṃcaṃtamiva raśmibhiḥ || divyaṃ vimānamānītamadrākṣaṃ śivakiṃkaraiḥ || 3.3.3.10 || tasminravīṃduvahnīnāṃ tejasāmiva paṃjare || vimāne sūryasaṃkāśānapaśyaṃ śivakiṃkarān || 11 || te vai triśūlakhaṭvāṃgaṭaṃkacarmāsipāṇayaḥ || caṃdrārdhabhūṣaṇāḥ sāṃdracaṃdrakuṃdoruvarcasaḥ || 12 || kirīṭakuṃḍalabhrājanmahāhivalayojjvalāḥ || śivānugā mayā dṛṣṭā ścatvāraḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ || 13 || tānāpatata ālokya vimānasthānsuvismitaḥ || upasṛtyāṃtike vegādapṛcchaṃ gagane sthitān || 14 || namonamo vastridaśottamebhyastrilocanaśrīcaraṇānugebhyaḥ || trilokarakṣāvidhimāvahadbhyastriśūlacarmāsigadādharebhyaḥ || 15 || viditā hi mayā yūyaṃ maheśvarapadā nugāḥ || iyaṃ vo lokarakṣārthā gatirāho vinodajā || |6 || uta sarvajanāghaughavijayāya kṛtodyamāḥ || brūta kāruṇyato mahyaṃ yasmādyūyamihāgatāḥ || 17 || || śivadūtā ūcuḥ || || eṣāgre dṛśyate vṛddhā cāṃḍālī maraṇonmukhī || etāmānetumāyātāḥ saṃdiṣṭā prabhuṇā vayam || 18 || ityukte śivadūtaistairapṛcchaṃ punarapyaham || vismayāviṣṭacittastānkṛtāṃjaliravasthitaḥ || 19 || aho pāpīyasī ghorā cāṃḍālī kathamarhati || divyaṃ vimānamāroḍhuṃ śunīvādhvaramaṃḍalam || 3.3.3.20 || ājanmato'śuciprāyā pāpāṃ pāpā nugāminīm || kathamenāṃ durācārāṃ śivalokaṃ ninīṣatha || 21 || asyā nāsti śivajñānaṃ nāsti ghorataraṃ tapaḥ || satyaṃ nāsti dayā nāsti kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 22 || paśumāṃsakṛtāhārā vāruṇīpūritodarām || jīvahiṃsāratāṃ nityaṃ kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 23 || na ca paṃcākṣarī japtā na kṛtaṃ śivapūjanam|| na dhyāto bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 24 || nopoṣitā śivatithirna kṛtaṃ śivapūjanam || bhūtasauhṛdaṃ na jānāti na ca bilvaśivārpaṇam|| neṣṭāpūrtādikaṃ vāpi kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 25 || na ca snātāni tīrthāni na dānāni kṛtāni ca || na ca vratāni cīrṇāni kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 26 || īkṣaṇe pariharttavyā kimu saṃbhāṣaṇādiṣu || satsaṃgarahitāṃ caṃḍāṃ kathamenāṃ ninīṣatha || 27 || janmāṃtarārjitaṃ kiṃcidasyāḥ sukṛtamasti vā || tatkathaṃ kuṣṭharogaṇa kṛmibhiḥ paribhūyate || 28 || aho īśvaracaryeyaṃ durvibhāvyā śarīriṇām || pāpātmāno'pi nīyaṃte kāruṇyātparamaṃ padam || 29 || ityuktāste mayā dūtā devadevasya śūlinaḥ || pratyūcurmāmatha prītyā sarvasaṃśayabhedinaḥ || 3.3.3.30 || || śivadūtā ūcuḥ || || brahmansumahadāścaryaṃ śṛṇu kautūhalaṃ yadi || imāmuddiśya cāṃḍālīṃ yaduktaṃ bhavatādhunā || 31 || āsīdiyaṃ pūrvabhave kāci dbrāhmaṇakanyakā || sumitrānāma saṃpūrṇasomabimbasamānanā || 32 || utphullamallikādāmasukumārāṃgalakṣaṇā || kaikeyadvijamukhyasya kasyacittanayā satī || 33 || tāṃ sarvalakṣaṇopetāṃ ratermūrtimivāparām|| varddhamānāṃ piturgehe vīkṣyāsanvismitā janāḥ || 34 || dinedine vardhamānā baṃdhubhirlālitā bhṛśam || sā śanairyauvanaṃ bheje smarasyeva mahādhanuḥ || 35 || atha sā baṃdhuvargaiśca sametena kumārikā || pitrā pradattā kasmaicidvidhinā dvija sūnave|| 36 || sā bharttāramanuprāpya navayauvanaśālinī || kaṃcitkālaṃ śubhācārā reme baṃdhubhirāvṛtā || 37 || atha kālavaśāttasyāḥ patistīvra rujārditaḥ || rūpayauvanakāṃtopi paṃcatvamagamanmune || 38 || mṛte bharttari duḥkhena vidagdhahadayā satī || uvāsa katicinmāsānsuśīlā vijiteṃ driyā || 39 || atha yauvanabhāreṇa jṛṃbhamāṇena nityaśaḥ || babhūva hṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ kaṃdaparparikaṃpitam || 3.3.3.40 || sā guptā bandhuvargeṇa śāsitāpi maho ttamaiḥ || na śaśāka mano roddhaṃ madanākṛṣṭamaṃganā || 41 || sā tīvramanmathāviṣṭā rūpayauvanaśālinī || vidhavāpi viśeṣeṇa jāramārgaratābhavat || 42 || na jñātā kenacidapi jāriṇīti vicakṣaṇā || jugūhātmadurācāraṃ kaṃcitkālamasattamā || 43 || tāṃ dohadasamākrāṃtāṃ ghananīlamukhastanīm || kālena baṃdhuvargopi bubodha viṭadūṣitām || 44 || iti bhīto mahākleśācciṃtā lebhe duratyayām || striyaḥ kāmena naśyaṃti brāhmaṇā hīnasevayā|||45|| rājāno brahmadaṃḍena yatayo bhogasaṃgrahāt|| līḍhaṃ śunā tathaivānnaṃ surayā vārpitaṃ payaḥ||46|| rūpaṃ kuṣṭharujāviṣṭaṃ kulaṃ naśyati kustriyā|| iti sarve samālocya sametāḥ patisodarāḥ || 47|| tatyajurgotrato dūraṃ gṛhītvā sakacagraham || saghaṭotsargamutsṛṣṭā sā nārī sarvabandhubhiḥ|| 48 vicaraṃtī ca śūdreṇa ramamāṇā ratipriyā || sā yayau strī bahiryāmādṛṣṭā śūdreṇa kenacit || 49 || sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā varārohām̐ pīnonnatapayodharām || gṛhaṃ nināya sāmnā ca vidhavāṃ śūdranāyakaḥ || sā nārī tasya mahiṣī bhūtvā tena divāniśam || 3.3.3.50|| ramamāṇā kvaciddeśe nyavasadgṛhavallabhā || tatra sā piśitāhārā nityamāpītavāruṇī||51|| lebhe sutaṃ ca śūdreṇa ramamāṇā ratipriyā || kadācidbharttari kvāpi yāte pītasurā tu sā||52|| iyeṣa piśitāhāraṃ madirāmadavihvalā || atha meṣeṣu baddheṣu gobhiḥ saha bahirvraje || 53 || yayau kṛpāṇamādāya sā tamīṃdhe niśāmukhe || avimṛśya madāveśānmeṣabuddhyāmiṣapriyā || 54 || ekaṃ jaghānaṃ govatsaṃ krośaṃtaṃ niśi durbhagā || nihataṃ gṛhamānīya jñātvā govatsamaṃganā || 55 || bhītā śivaśivetyāha kenacitpuṇyakarmaṇā || sā muhūrtamiti dhyātvā piśitāsavalālasā || 56 || chittvā tameva govatsaṃ cakārāhāramīpsitam || govatsārdhaśarīreṇa kṛtāhārātha sā punaḥ || 57 || tadardhadehaṃ nikṣipya bahiścukrośa kaitavāt || aho vyāghreṇa bhagno'yaṃ jagdho govatsako vraje || 58|| iti tasyāḥ samākraṃdaḥ sarvageheṣu śuśruve | atha sarve śūdrajanāḥ samāgamyāṃtike sthitāḥ || 59|| hataṃ govatsamālokya vyāghreṇeti śucaṃ yayuḥ || gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu vyuṣṭāyāṃ ca tato niśi || 3.3.3.60 || tadbhartā gṛhamāgatya dṛṣṭavāngṛhaviḍvaram | evaṃ bahutithe kāle gate sā śūdvavallabhā || 61 | kālasya vaśamāpannā jagāma yamamaṃdiram | yamopi dharmamālokya tasyāḥ karma ca paurvikam || 62 || nirvatrya nirayāvāsāñcakre caṃḍālajātikām || sāpi bhraṣṭā yamapurāccāṃḍālīgarbhamāśritā || 63 || tato babhūva jātyaṃdhā praśāṃtāṃgāramecakā || tatpitā kopi cāṃḍālo deśe kutracidāsthitaḥ || 64 || tāṃ tādṛśīmapi sutāṃ kṛpayā paryapoṣayat || abhojyena kadannena śunā līḍhena pūtinā || 65 || apeyaiśca rasairmātrā poṣitā sā dinedine || jātyaṃdhā sāpi kālena bālye kuṣṭharujārditā || 66 || ūḍhā na kenacidvāpi cāṃḍālenātidurbhagā || atītabālye sā kāle vidhvastapitṛmātṛkā || 67 || durbhageti parityaktā baṃdhubhiśca sahodaraiḥ || tataḥ kṣudhārditā dīnā śocantī vigatekṣaṇā || 68 || gṛhītayaṣṭiḥ kṛcchreṇa saṃcacāla saloṣṭikā || pattaneṣvapi sarveṣu yācamānā dinedine || 69 || cāṃḍālocchiṣṭapiṃḍena jaṭharāgnimatarpayat|| evaṃ kṛcchreṇa mahatā nītvā subahulaṃ vayaḥ || 3.3.3.70 || jarayā grastasarvāṃgī duḥkhamāpa duratyayam || nirannapānavasanā sā kadācinmahājanān|| 71 || āyāsyaṃtyāṃ śivatithau gacchato bubudhe'dhvagān|| tasyāṃ tu devayātrāyāṃ deśadeśāṃtayāyinām || 72 || viprāṇāṃ sāgnihotrāṇāṃ sastrīkāṇāṃ mahātmanām|| rājñāṃ ca sāvarodhānāṃ sahastirathavājinām || 73 || saparīvāraghoṣāṇāṃ yānacchatrādiśobhinām || tathānyeṣāṃ ca viṭśūdrasaṃkīrṇānāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 74 || hasatāṃ gāyatāṃ kvāpi nṛtyatāmatha dhāvatām || jighratāṃ pibatāṃ kāmādgacchatāṃ pratigarjatām || 75 ||| saṃprayāṇe manuṣyāṇāṃ saṃbhramaḥ sumahānabhūt || iti sarveṣu gacchatsu gokarṇaṃ śivamaṃdiram || 76 || paśyaṃti divijāḥ sarve vimānasthāḥ sakautukāḥ || atheyamapi cāṃḍālī vasanāśanatṛṣṇayā || 77 || mahājanānyācayituṃ cacāla ca śanaiḥśanaiḥ || karāvalaṃbenānyasyāḥ prāgjanmārjitakarmaṇā || dinaiḥ katipayairyātī gokarṇaṃ kṣetramāyayau || 78 || tato vidūre mārgasya niṣaṇṇā vivṛtāṃjaliḥ || yācamānā muhuḥ pāṃthānbabhāṣe kṛpaṇaṃ vacaḥ || 79 || prāgjanmārjitapāpaughaiḥ pīḍitāyāściraṃ mama || āhāramātradānena dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ || 3.3.3.80 || trātāraḥ paramārtānāṃ dātāraḥ paramāśiṣām || kartāro bahupuṇyānāṃ dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ || 81 || vasanāśanahīnāyāṃ svapitāyāṃ mahītale || mahāpāṃsunimagnāyāṃ dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ || 82 || mahāśītātapārttāyāṃ pīḍitāyāṃ mahārujā || andhāyāṃ mayi vṛddhāyāṃ dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ || 83 || ciropavāsadīptāyāṃ jaṭharāgnivivardhanaiḥ || saṃdahyamānasarvāṃgyāṃ dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ || 84 || anupārjitapuṇyāyāṃ janmāṃtaraśateṣvapi || pāpāyāṃ maṃdabhāgyāyāṃ dayāṃ kuruta bho janāḥ ||85|| evamabhyarthayaṃtyāstu cāṃḍālyāḥ prasṛteṃ'jalau || ekaḥ puṇyatamaḥ pāṃthaḥ prākṣipadbilvamaṃjarīm || 86 || tāmaṃcalau nipatitāṃ sā vimṛśya punaḥ punaḥ || abhakṣyetyeva matvātha dūre prākṣipadāturā || 87 || tasyāḥ kareṇa nirmuktā rātrau sā bilvamaṃjarī || papāta kasyaciddiṣṭyā śivaliṃgasya mastake || 88 || saivaṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ rātrau pāṃthajanānmuhuḥ || yācamānāpi yatkiṃcinna lebhe daivayogataḥ || 89 || tatroṣitānayā rātrirbhadrakā lyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ || kiṃciduttarataḥ sthānaṃ tadardhenātidūrataḥ || 3.3.3.90 || tataḥ prabhāte bhraṣṭāśā śokena mahatāplutā || śanairnivavṛte dīnā svadeśāyaiva kevalā || 91 || śrāṃtā ciropavāsena nipatantī padepade || kraṃdaṃtī vahurogārtā vepamānā bhṛśāturā || 92 || dahyamānārkatāpena nagnadehā saya ṣṭikā|| atītyaitāvatīṃ bhūmiṃ nipapāta vicetanā||93|| atha viśveśvaraḥ śaṃbhuḥ karuṇāmṛtavāridhiḥ|| enāmānayatettyasmānyuyuje savimānakān||94|| eṣā pravṛttiścāṃḍālyāstaveha parikīrttitā|| tathā saṃdarśitā śaṃbhoḥ kṛpaṇeṣu kṛpālutā|| karmaṇaḥ paripākotthāṃ gatiṃ paśya mahāmate || adhamāpi paraṃ sthānamārohati nirāmayam || 96 || yadetayā pūrvabhave nānnadānādikaṃ kṛtam || kṣutpipāsādibhiḥ kleśaistasmādiha nipī ḍyate || 97 || yadeṣā madavegāṃdhā cakre pāpaṃ maholbaṇam|| karmaṇā tena jātyaṃdhā babhūvātraiva janmani || 98 || api vijñāya govatsaṃ yadeṣā'bhakṣaya tpurā || karmaṇā tena cāṃḍālī babhūveha vigarhitā || 99 || yadeṣāryapathaṃ hitvā jāramārgaratā purā || tena pāpena kenāpi durvṛttā durbhagāpi vā || || 3.3.3.100 || yadāśliṣya madāviṣṭā jāreṇa vidhavā purā || tena pāpena mahatā bahukuṣṭhavraṇānvitā || 101 || kāmārttā yadiyaṃ svairaṃ śūdreṇa ramitā purā || mahāsṛkpūyakṛmibhiḥ pīḍyate tena pāpmanā || 102 || suvratāni na cīrṇāni neṣṭāpūtārdikaṃ kṛtam || sarvabhogavihīneyaṃ dūyate tena pāpmanā || || 103 || yadetayā pūrvabhave surā pītā vimūḍhayā || mahāyakṣmārtihṛcchūlaiḥ pīḍyate tena pāpmanā || 104 || atraiva sarvamartyeṣu pāpacihnāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || lakṣyate muniśārdūla savivekairmahātmabhiḥ || 105 || atra ye bahurogārttā ye putradhanavarjitāḥ || 106 || ye ca durlakṣaṇakliṣṭā yācakā vigatahriyaḥ || vāsonnapānaśayanabhūṣaṇābhyaṃjanādibhiḥ || 107 || hīnā virūpā nirvidyā vikalāṃgāḥ kubhojanāḥ || ye durbhāgyā niṃditāśca ye cānye parasevakāḥ || 108 || ete pūrvabhave sarve sumahatpāpakāriṇaḥ || evaṃ vimṛśya yatnena dṛṣṭvā lokajanasthitim || 109 || budho na kurute pāpaṃ yadi kuryātsa ātmahā || deho'yaṃ mānuṣo jaṃtorbahukarmaikabhājanam || 3.3.3.110 || sadā satkarma seveta duṣkarma satataṃ tyajet || puṇyaṃ sukhārthī kurvīta duḥkhārthī pāpamācaret || || 111 || dvayorekatare loke gṛhīte kuśalo janaḥ || imaṃ mānuṣamāśritya dehaṃ paramadurlabham || 112 || ya ātmahitavānkaściddevamekaṃ samāśrayet || atha pāpāni sarvāṇi kurvannapi sadā naraḥ || 113 || śivamekamatirdhyāyetsa saṃtarati pātakam || mṛtā pūrvabhave tveṣā yadā prāptā yamālaye || 114 || tadā vitarkaḥ sumahānāsīdyamasabhāsadām || yadyapi brāhmaṇī tveṣā satkulācāradūṣitā || 115 || ato'smābhirihānītā nirayaṃ yātu vā na vā || anayā sādhito bālye puṇyaleśo'sti vā na vā || 116 || athāpi suvimṛśyaivaṃ dhāryo daṃḍo'tra nānyathā || bahujanmasahasreṣu kṛtapuṇyavipākataḥ|| || 117 || nṛṇāṃ brahmakule janma labhyate hi kathaṃcana || atosyāḥ pūrvapūrveṣu kṛtāghaṃ nāsti janmasu||118|| anyathā satkule janma kathameṣā prapadyate|| atraiva janmanyanayā kṛtamaṃho duratyayam || 119 || athāpi narakāvāsaṃ prāyaśo neyamarhati || kiṃtu govatsakaṃ hatvā vimṛśyāgatasādhvasā || 3.3.3.120 || eṣā śivaśivetyāha prāgjanmārjitakarmaṇā || yadeṣā pāpavicchittyai sakṛdapyurumaṃgalam || 121 || śivanāma vadedbhaktyā tarhi gacchetparaṃ padam || ekajanmakṛtasyāsya dāruṇasyāpi yatphalam || 122 || krameṇānubhavatveṣā bhūtvā cāṃḍālajātikā || asmādanyatamaḥ ko vā narako'sti nṛṇā miha || 123 || anekakleśasaṃghātairyanmuhuḥ paripīḍanam || duṣkule janma dāridryaṃ mahāvyādhirvimūḍhatā || 124 || ekaika eva narakaḥ sarve vā cātha kiṃ punaḥ || prāgjanmapuṇyabhāreṇa yannāma vivaśā'bravīt || 125 || tenaiṣānyabhave bhūri puṇyamaṃte kariṣyati || tena puṇyena mahatā nistīryāghaughayā tanāḥ || 126 || nītā tatpuruṣairaṃte prayāsyati paraṃ padam || etādṛśānāṃ martyānāṃ śāstāro na vayaṃ kvacit || vicārya svayameveśo yadyuktaṃ tatkarotu saḥ || 127 || evaṃ vaivasvatapure sarvairyamapurogamaiḥ || vimṛśya citraguptādyairiyaṃ muktā'patadbhuvi || 128 || ādau yadeṣā śivanāma nārī pramādato vāpya satī jagāda || teneha bhūyaḥ sukṛtena śaṃbhorbilvāṃkurārādhanapuṇyamāpa || 129 || śrīgokarṇe śivatithāvupoṣya śivamastake || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ hyeṣā cakre bilvārpaṇaṃ niśi || 3.3.3.130 || akāmataḥ kṛtasyāsya puṇyasyaiva ca yatphalam || adyaiva bhokṣyate seyaṃ paśyatastava no mṛṣā || 131 || || || gautama uvāca || || ityuktvā śivadūtāste tasyāścāṃḍālayonitaḥ || jīvaleśaṃ samākṛṣya yuyujurdivyatejasā || 132 || tāṃ divyadehasaṃkrāṃtāṃ tejorāśisamujjvalām|| vimāne sthāpayāmāsuḥ prītāste śivakiṃkarāḥ || 133 || atha sā paramodārarūpalāvaṇyaśālinī || divyabhūṣaṇadīptāṃgī divyāṃbaravidhāriṇī || 134 || dehena divyagaṃdhena divyatejovikāśinā || divyamālyāvataṃsena virarāja vimānagā || 135 || ratnacchatrapatākādyairgī tavāditranisvanaiḥ || madhye sā śivadūtānāṃ modamānā varānanā || 136 || anubhūtāni janmāni smṛtvāsmṛtvā punaḥpunaḥ || bhītā trastā dṛḍhā ścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā svapnamivotthitā || 137 || kāhaṃ ke'mī mahāsiddhāḥ koyaṃ loko manoramaḥ || kva gataṃ me vapuḥ kaṣṭaṃ caṃḍacāṃḍālagotrajam || 138 || aho sumahadāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ māyāvilāsajam || yanme bhavasahasreṣu bhrātaṃbhrāṃtaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 139 || aho īśvarapūjāyā māhātmyaṃ vismayāvaham || patramātreṇa saṃtuṣṭo yo dadāti nijaṃ padam || 3.3.3.140 || iti tāṃ jātanirvedāṃ smarantīṃ bhagavatpadam || divyaṃ vimānamāropya te maheśvarakiṃkarāḥ || || 141 || ālokayatsu sarveṣu lokeśeṣu savismayam || āmaṃtrya tāmathāninyuḥ parameśvarasannidhim || 142 || rājansumahadāścaryamākhyātaṃ girijā pateḥ || māhātmyaṃ bhaktileśasya sarvāghaughavināśanam || 143 || || rājovāca || || bhagavanparameśasya kīdṛśo loka uttamaḥ || tasya me lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi yadyasti mayi te dayā || 144 || || gautama uvāca || || brahmādisuranāthānāṃ lokeṣvapi sudurlabhaḥ || ya ānaṃdaḥ sadā yatra sa lokaḥ pārameśvaraḥ || 145 || sarvātigamanaṃ yatra jyotiryatra pratiṣṭhitam || kvāpi nāsti tamoyogaḥ sa lokaḥ pārameśvaraḥ || 146 || guṇavṛtti vinistīrya saṃprāptā yatra yoginaḥ || na pateyuḥ punaḥ sarve sa lokaḥ pārameśvaraḥ || 147 || yatra vāsaṃ na kurvaṃti krodhalobhamadādayaḥ || yatrāvasthā na janmādyāḥ sa lokaḥ pārameśvaraḥ || 148 || sarveṣāṃ nigamānāṃ ca yadekaṃ kṣetramucyate || yasmānnāsti paraṃ vittaṃ tatpadaṃ pārameśvaram || 149 || pratyāhārāsana dhyānaprāṇasaṃyamanādibhiḥ || yatra yogapathaiḥ prāptuṃ yatate yoginaḥ sadā || 3.3.3.150 || yatra devaḥ sadānaṃdanirmalajñānarūpayā || asti devyā saha krīḍañsa lokaḥ pārameśvaraḥ || 151 || janmānekasahasreṣu saṃbhṛtaiḥ puṇyarāśibhiḥ || ārūḍhāḥ puruṣā nāryaḥ krīḍante yatra saṃgatāḥ || 152 || tejo rāśau samālīnā durvibhāvye manorame || ahorātrādisaṃsthānaṃ na viṃdaṃti kadācana || 153 || sa lokaḥ parameśasya durlabho hi kuyoginaḥ || etadbhakti supūrṇā ye taireva pratipadyate || 154 || ye tatkathāśravaṇakīrtanajātaharṣā ye sarvabhūtasuhṛdaḥ praśamaikaniṣṭhāḥ || saṃsāracakramativāhya nirastamohāste śāṃkaraṃ padamavāpya sukhaṃ ramante || 155 || tathā tvamapi rājeṃdra gokarṇaṃ giriśālayam || gatvā praśamitāghaughaḥ kṛtakṛtyatvamāpnuhi || 156 || tatra sarveṣu kāleṣu snātvābhyarcya mahābalam || kṛtvā śivacaturdaśyāmupavāsaṃ samāhitaḥ || 157 || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau bilvairabhyarcya śaṃkaram || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokamavāpsyasi || 158 || eṣa te vimalo rājannupadeśo mayā kṛtaḥ || svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi mithilādhipateḥ purīm || 159 || ityāmantrya muniḥ prītyā gautamo mithilāṃ yayau || so'pi hṛṣṭamanā rājā gokarṇaṃ pratyapadyata || 3.3.3.160 || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ snātvābhyarcya mahābalam || nirdhūtāśeṣapāpaugho lebhe śambhoḥ paraṃ padam || 161 || ya imāṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kathāṃ śaivīṃ manoharām || śrāvayedvā jano bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 162 || śraddadhānaḥ sakṛdvāpi ya imāṃ śṛṇuyātkathām || triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 163 || iti kathitamaśeṣaṃ śreyasāmādibījaṃ bhavaśataduritaghnaṃ dhvastamohāṃdhakāram || caritamamarageyaṃ manmathārerudāraṃ satatamapi niṣevyaṃ svastimadbhiśca lokaiḥ || ||164|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe śivacaturdaśīgokarṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || || 3 || || cha || || cha ||
<3.3.4>
|| sūta uvāca || || bhūyopi śivamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi paramādbhutam || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ bhavapāśavimocanam || || 1 || dustare duritāṃbhodhau majjatāṃ viṣayātmanām || śivapūjāṃ vinā kaścitplavo nāsti nirūpitaḥ || 2 || śivapūjāṃ sadā kuryādbuddhimāniha mānavaḥ || aśaktaścetkṛtā pūjāṃ paśyedbhaktivinamradhīḥ || 3 || aśraddhayāpi yaḥ kuryācchivapūjāṃ vimuktidām || paśyedvā sopi kālena prayāti paramaṃ padam || 4 || āsītkirātadeśeṣu nāmnā rājā vimardanaḥ || śūraḥ paramadurddharṣo jitaśatruḥ pratāpavān || 5 || sarvadā mṛgayāsaktaḥ kṛpaṇo nirghṛṇo balī || sarvamāṃsāśanaḥ krūraḥ sarvavarṇāṃganāvṛtaḥ || 6 || tathāpi kurute śaṃbhoḥ pūjāṃ nityamataṃdritaḥ || caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ || || 7 || mahāvibhavasaṃpannāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā sa modate || harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo nṛtyati stauti gāyati || 8 || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya nṛpateḥ sarvabhakṣiṇaḥ || durācārasya mahiṣī ceṣṭitenānvatapyata || 9 || sā vai kumudvatīnāma rājñī śīlaguṇānvitā || ekadā patimāsādya rahasye tadapṛcchata || 3.3.4.10 || etatte caritaṃ rājanmahadāścaryakāraṇam || kva te mahādurācāraḥ kva bhaktiḥ parameśvare || 11 || sarvadā sarvabhakṣastvaṃ sarvastrījanalālasaḥ || sarvahiṃsāparaḥ krūraḥ kathaṃ bhaktistaveśvare || 12 || iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa bhūpālo vimṛśya suciraṃ tataḥ || trikālajñaḥ prahasyaināṃ provāca sukutūhalaḥ || 13 || || || rājovāca || || ahaṃ pūrvabhave kaścitsārameyo varānane || paṃpānagaramāśritya paryaṭāmi samaṃtataḥ || 14 || evaṃ kāleṣu gacchatsu tatraiva nagarottame || kadācidāgataḥ sohaṃ manojñaṃ śivamaṃdiram || 15 || pūjāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ mahātithau || apaśyamutsavaṃ dūrādbahirdvāraṃ samāśritaḥ || 16 || athāhaṃ paramakruddhairdaṃḍahastaiḥ pradhāvitaḥ || tasmāddeśādapakrāṃtaḥ prāṇarakṣāparāyaṇaḥ || 17 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya manojñaṃ śivamaṃdiram || dvāradeśaṃ punaḥ prāpya punaścaiva nivāritaḥ || 18 || punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadeva śivamandiram || balipiṃḍādilobhena punardvāramupāgataḥ || 19 || evaṃ punaḥpunastatra kṛtvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || dvāradeśe samāsīnaṃ nijaghnurniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 3.3.4.20 || sa viddhagātraḥ sahasā śivadvāri gatāsukaḥ || jāto'smyahaṃ kule rājñāṃ prabhāvācchivasannidheḥ || 21 || dṛṣṭvā caturdaśīpūjāṃ dīpamālā vilokitāḥ || tena puṇyena mahatā trikālajño'smi bhāmini || 22 || prāgjanmavāsanābhiśca sarvabhakṣo'smi nirghṛṇaḥ || viduṣāmapi durlaṃghyā prakṛtirvāsanāmayī || 23 || ato'hamarcayāmīśaṃ caturdaśyāṃ jagadgurum || tvamapi śraddhayā bhadre bhaja devaṃ pinākinam || 24 || || rājñyuvāca || || trikālajño'si rājendra prasādādgirijāpateḥ || matpūrvajanmacaritaṃ vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ || 25 || || rājovāca || || tvaṃ tu pūrvabhave kācitkapotī vyomacāriṇī || kvāpi labdhavatī kiṃcinmāṃ sapiṃḍaṃ yadṛcchayā || 26|| tvadgṛhītamathālokya gṛdhraḥ kopyāmiṣaṃ balī | nirāmiṣaḥ svayaṃ vegābhidudrāva bhīṣaṇaḥ || 27|| tatastaṃ vīkṣya vitrastā vidrutāsi varānane || tenānuyātā ghoreṇa māṃsapiṃḍajighṛkṣayā || 28 || diṣṭyā śrīgirimāsādya śrāṃtā tatra śivālayam || pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya dhvajāgre samupasthitā || 29|| athānusṛtya sahasā tīkṣṇatuṃḍo vihaṃgamaḥ || tvāṃ nihatya nipātyādho māṃsamādāya jagmivān || 3.3.4.30 || pradakṣiṇaprakramaṇāddevadevasya śūlinaḥ|| tasyāgre maraṇāccaiva jātāsīha nṛpāṃganā || 31 || || rājñyuvāca || || śrutaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa prāgjanmacareitaṃ mayā || jātaṃ ca mahadāścaryaṃ bhaktiśca mama cetasi || athānyacchrotumicchāmi trikālajña mahāmate || idaṃ śarīramutsṛjya yāsyāvaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ punaḥ | ||| 32 || || rājovāca || || ato bhave janiṣye'haṃ dvitīye saiṃdhavo nṛpaḥ || 33 || sṛṃjayeśasutā tvaṃ hi māmeva pratipatsyase || tṛtīye tu bhave rājā saurāṣṭre bhavitā'smyaham || 34 || kaliṃgarājatanayā tvaṃ me patnī bhaviṣyasi || caturthe tu bhaviṣyāmi bhave gāṃdhārabhūmipaḥ || 35 || māgadhī rājatanayā tatra tvaṃ mama gehinī || paṃcame'vaṃtinātho'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi bhavāṃtare || 36 || dāśārharājatanayā tvameva mama vallabhā|| asmāj janmani ṣaṣṭhe'hamānarte bhavitā nṛpaḥ || 37|| yayātivaṃśajā kanyā bhūtvā māmeva yāsyasi || pāṃḍyarājakumāro'ham̐ saptame bhavitā bhave || 38 || tatra matsadṛśo nānyo rūpaudāryaguṇādibhiḥ || sarvaśāstrārthatattvajño balavāndṛḍhavikramaḥ || 39 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvalokamanoramaḥ || padmavarṇa iti khyātaḥ padmamitrasamadyutiḥ || 3.3.4.40|| bhavitā tvaṃ ca vaidarbhī rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi || nāmnā vasumatī khyātā rūpāvayavaśobhinī || 41 || sarva rājakumārāṇāṃ manonayananaṃdinī || sā tvaṃ svayaṃvare sarvānvihāya nṛpanaṃdanān || 42 || varaṃ prāpsyasi māmeva damayaṃtīva naiṣadham || so'haṃ jitvā nṛpānsarvānprāpya tvāṃ varavarṇinīm ||43|| svarāṣṭrastho'khilānbhogānbhokṣye varṣagaṇānbahūn || iṣṭvā ca vividhairyajñairvājimedhādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 44 || saṃtarpya pitṛdevarṣīndānaiśca dvijasattamān || saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram || 45 || putre rājyadhuraṃ nyasya gaṃtāsmi tapase vanam || tatrāgastyānmunivarādbrahmajñānamavāpya ca || 46 || tvayā saha gamiṣyāmi śivasya paramaṃ padam | caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmevaṃ saṃpūjya śaṃkaram || 47 || saptajanmasu rājastvaṃ bhaviṣyati varānane || ityetatsukṛtaṃ labdhaṃ pūjaādarśanamātrataḥ || kva sārameyo duṣṭātmā kvedṛśī bata saṅgatiḥ|| 48 | || sūta uvāca|| ityukto nijanāthena sā rājñī śubhalakṣaṇā || 49 || paraṃ vismayamāpannā pūjayāmāsa taṃ mudā || so'pi rājā tayā sārddhaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān || 3.3.4.50 || jagāma saptajanmāṃte śaṃbhostatparamaṃ padam || ya etacchivapūjāyā māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutam || śṛṇuyātkīrtayedvāpi sa gacchetparamaṃ padam|| 51 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe caturdaśīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<3.3.5>
|| sūta uvāca || || śivo guruḥ śivo devaḥ śivo baṃdhuḥ śarīriṇām || śiva ātmā śivo jīvaḥśivādanyanna kiñcana ||1||| śivamuddiśya yatkiṃciddattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ kṛtam || tadanaṃtaphalaṃ proktaṃ sarvāgamaviniścitam || 2 || bhaktyā niveditaṃ śaṃbhoḥ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam || alpādalpataraṃ vāpi tadānaṃtyāya kalpate || 3 || vihāya sakalāndharmānsakalāgamaniścitān || śivamekaṃ bhajedyastu mucyate sarvabandhanāt || 4 || yā prītirātmanaḥ putre yā kalatre dhanepi sā || kṛtā cecchivapūjāyāṃ trāyatīti kimadbhutam || 5 || tasmātkecinmahātmānaḥ sakalānviṣayāsavān || tyajaṃti śivapūjārthe svadehamapi dustyajam || 6 || sā jihvā yā śivaṃ stauti tanmano dhyāyate śivam || tau karṇau tatkathālolau tau hastau tasya pūjakau || 7 || te netre paśyataḥ pūjāṃ tacchiraḥ praṇataṃ śive || tau pādau yau śivakṣetraṃ bhaktyā paryaṭataḥ sadā || 8 || yasyendriyāṇi sarvāṇi vartaṃte śivakarmasu || sa nistarati saṃsāraṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca viṃdati || 9 || śivabhaktiyuto martyaścāṃḍālaḥ pulkasopi ca || nārī naro vā ṣaṃḍho vā sadyo mucyeta saṃsṛteḥ || 3.3.5.10 || kiṃ kulena kimācāraiḥ kiṃśīlena guṇena vā || bhaktileśayutaḥ śaṃbhoḥ sa vaṃdyaḥ sarvadehinām || 11 || ujjayinyāmabhūdrājā candrasenasamāhvayaḥ || jāto mānavarūpeṇa dvitīya iva vāsavaḥ || 12 || tasminpure mahākālaṃ vasaṃtaṃ parameśvaram || saṃpūjayatyasau bhaktyā candraseno nṛpottamaḥ || 13 || tasyābhavatsakhā rājñaḥ śivapāriṣadāgraṇīḥ || maṇibhadro jitābhadraḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 14 || tasyai kadā mahībhartuḥ prasannaḥ śaṃkarānugaḥ || cintāmaṇiṃ dadau divyaṃ maṇibhadro mahāmatiḥ || 15 || sa maṇiḥ kaustubha iva dyotamānorkasannibhaḥ || dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā dhyāto vā nṛṇāṃ yacchati ciṃtitam || 16 || tasya kāṃtilavaspṛṣṭaṃ kāṃsyaṃ tāmramayastrapu || pāṣāṇādikamanyadvā sadyo bhavati kāṃcanam || || 17 || sa taṃ cintāmaṇiṃ kaṃṭhe bibhradrājāsanaṃ gataḥ || rarāja rājā devānāṃ madhye bhānuriva svayam || 18 || sadā cintāmaṇigrīvaṃ taṃ śrutvā rājasattamam || pravṛddhatarṣā rājānaḥ sarve kṣubdhahṛdo'bhavan || 19 || snehātkecidayācaṃta dhārṣṭyātkecana durmadāḥ || daivalabdhamajānaṃto maṇiṃ matsariṇo nṛpāḥ|3.3.5.20|| sarveṣāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ yāñcā yadā vyarthīkṛtāmunā|| rājānaḥ sarvadeśānāṃ saṃraṃbhaṃ cakrire tadā||21|| saurāṣṭrāḥ kaikayāḥ śālvāḥ kaliṃgaśakamadrakāḥ || pāṃcālāvaṃtisauvīrā māgadhā matsyasṛṃjayāḥ || 22 || ete cānye ca rājānaḥ sahāśvarathakumajarāḥ || candrasenaṃ mṛdhe jetumudyamaṃ cakrurojasā || 23 || te tu sarve susaṃrabdhāḥ kaṃpayaṃto vasundharām || ujjayinyāścaturdvāraṃ rurudhurbahusainikāḥ || 24 || saṃrudhyamāno svapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājabhiruddhataiḥ || caṃdraseno mahākālaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ yayau || 25 || nirvikalpo nirāhāraḥ sa rājā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ || arcayāmāsa gaurīśaṃ divā nakta mananyadhīḥ || 26 || etasminnaṃtare gopī kācittatpuravāsinī || ekaputrā bhartṛhīnā tatraivāsīcciraṃtanā || 27 || sā paṃcahāyanaṃ bālaṃ vahaṃtī gata bhartṛkā || rājñā kṛtāṃ mahāpūjāṃ dadarśa girijāpateḥ || 28 || sā dṛṣṭvā sarvamāścaryaṃ śivapūjāmahodayam || praṇipatya svaśibiraṃ punarevābhyapadyata || || 29 || etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa sa dṛṣṭvā ballavīsutaḥ || kutūhalena vidadhe śivapūjāṃ viraktidām|| 3.3.5.30 || ānīya hṛdyaṃ pāṣāṇaṃ śūnye tu śibirottame || nātidūre svaśibirācchivaliṃgamakalpayat || 31 || yāni kāni ca puṣpāṇi hastalabhyāni cātmanaḥ || ānīya snāpya talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 32 || gaṃdhālaṃkāravāsāṃsi dhūpadīpākṣatādikam || vidhāya kṛtrimairdivyairnaivedyaṃ cāpyakalpayat || 33 || bhūyobhūyaḥ samabhyarcya patraiḥ puṣpairmanoramaiḥ || nṛtyaṃ ca vividhaṃ kṛtvā praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ ||34|| evaṃ pūjāṃ prakurvāṇaṃ śivasyānanyamānasam || sā putraṃ praṇayādgopī bhojanāya samā hvayat||35|| mātrāhūtopi bahuśaḥ sa pūjāsaktamānasaḥ || bālopi bhojanaṃ nacchattadā mātā svayaṃ yayau|| 36|| taṃ vilokya śivasyāgre niṣaṇṇaṃ mī litekṣaṇam|| cakarṣa pāṇiṃ saṃgṛhya kopena samatāḍayat|| 37 || ākṛṣṭastāḍito vāpi nāgacchatsvasuto yadā || tāṃ pūjāṃ nāśayāmāsa kṣiptvā liṃgaṃ vidūrataḥ || 38 || hāheti rudamānaṃ taṃ nirbhartsya svasutaṃ tadā || punarviveśa svagṛhaṃ gopī roṣasamanvitā || 39 || mātrā vināśitāṃ pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā devasya śūlinaḥ || devadeveti cukrośa nipapāta sa bālakaḥ || 3.3.5.40 || pranaṣṭasaṃjñaḥ sahasā bāṣpapūrapariplutaḥ || labdhasaṃjño muhūrtena cakṣuṣī udamīlayat|| || 41 || tato maṇistaṃbhavirājamānaṃ hiraṇmayadvārakapāṭatoraṇam || mahārhanīlāmalavajravedikaṃ tadeva jātaṃ śibiraṃ śivālayam || 42 || saṃtaptahema kalaśairbahubhirvicitraiḥ prodbhāsitasphaṭikasaudhatalābhirāmam || ramyaṃ ca tacchivapuraṃ varapīṭhamadhye liṃgaṃ ca ratnasahitaṃ sa dadarśa bālaḥ || 43 || sa dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya bhītavismitamānasaḥ || nimagna iva saṃtoṣātparamānaṃdasāgare || 44 || vijñāya śivapūjāyā māhātmyaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ || nanāma daṃḍavadbhūmau svamāturaghaśāṃtaye || 45 || deva kṣamasva duritaṃ mama māturumāpate || mūḍhāyāstvāmajānaṃtyāḥ prasanno bhava śaṃkara || 46 || yadyasti mayi yatkiṃcitpuṇyaṃ tvadbhaktisaṃbhavam || tenāpi śiva me mātā tava kāruṇyamāpnuyāt || 47 || iti prasādya giriśaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ praṇamya ca || sūrye cāstaṃ gate bālo nirjagāma śivālayāt || 48 || athāpaśyatsvaśibiraṃ puraṃdarapuropamam || sadyo hiraṇmayībhūtaṃ vicitravibhavojjvalam || 49 || soṃtaḥ praviśya bhavanaṃ modamāno niśāmukhe || mahāmaṇigaṇākīrṇaṃ hemarāśisamujjvalam || 3.3.5.50 || tatrāpaśyatsvajananīṃ smaraṃtīmakutobhayām || mahārharatna paryaṃke sitaśayyāmadhiśritām || 51 || ratnālaṃkāradīptāṃgīṃ divyāṃbaravirājinīm || divyalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ sākṣātsuravadhūmiva || 52 || javenotthāpayāmāsa saṃbhramotphullalocanaḥ || aṃba jāgṛhi bhadraṃ te paśyedaṃ mahadadbhutam|| 53 || iti prabodhitā gopī svaputreṇa mahātmanā || tato'paśyatsvajananī smayantī mukuṭojjvalā || 54 || sasaṃbhramaṃ samutthāya tatsarvaṃ pratyavekṣata || apūrvamiva cātmānamapūrvamiva bālakam || 55 || apūrvaṃ ca svasadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sītsukhavihvalā || śrutvā putramukhātsarvaṃ prasādaṃ girijāpateḥ || 56 || rājñe vijñāpayāmāsa yo bhajatyaniśaṃ śivam || sa rājā sahasāgatya samāpta niyamo niśi || 57 || dadarśa gopikāsūnoḥ prabhāvaṃ śivatoṣajam || hiraṇmayaṃ śivasthānaṃ liṃgaṃ maṇimayaṃ tathā || 58 || gopavadhvāśca sadanaṃ māṇi kyavarakojjvalam|| dṛṣṭvā mahīpatiḥ sarvaṃ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ||59 || muhūrtaṃ vismitadhṛtiḥ paramānaṃdanirbharaḥ || premṇā vāṣpajalaṃ muṃcanparirebhe tama rbhakam || 3.3.5.60 || evamatyadbhutākārācchivamāhātmyakīrttanāt || paurāṇāṃ saṃbhramāccaiva sā rātriḥ kṣaṇatāmagāt || 61 || atha prabhāte yuddhāya puraṃ saṃrudhya saṃsthitāḥ || rājānaścāravaktrebhyaḥ śuśruvuḥ paramādbhutam || 62 || te tyaktavairāḥ sahasā rājānaścakitā bhṛśam || nyastaśastrā niviviśuścaṃdrasenānumoditāḥ || 63 || tāṃ praviśya purīṃ ramyāṃ mahākālaṃ praṇamya ca || tadgopavanitāgehamājagmuḥ sarvabhūbhṛtaḥ || 64 || te tatra caṃdrasenena pratyudgamyābhi pūjitāḥ || mahārhaviṣṭaragatāḥ prītyānaṃdansuvismitāḥ || 65 || gopasūnoḥ prasādāya prādurbhūtaṃ śivālayam || liṃgaṃ ca vīkṣya sumahacchive cakruḥ parāṃ matim || 66 || tasmai gopakumārāya prītāste sarvabhūbhujaḥ || vāsohiraṇyaratnāni gomahiṣyādikaṃ dhanam || 67 || gajānaśvānrathānraukmāñchatra yānaparicchadān || dāsāndāsīranekāśca daduḥ śivakṛpārthinaḥ || 68 || yeye sarveṣu deśeṣu gopāstiṣṭhaṃti bhūriśaḥ || teṣāṃ tameva rājānaṃ cakrire sarva pārthivāḥ ||69|| athāsminnaṃtare sarvaistridaśairabhipūjitaḥ || prādurbabhūva tejasvī hanūmānvānareśvaraḥ ||3.3.5.70|| tasyābhigamanādeva rājāno jātasaṃbhramāḥ || pratyutthāya namaścakrurbhaktinamrātmamūrttayaḥ || 71 || teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ pūjitaḥ plavageśvaraḥ || gopātmajaṃ samāśliṣya rājño vīkṣyedamavavīt || || 72 || sarve śṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo rājāno ye ca dehinaḥ || śivapūjāmṛte nānyā gatirasti śarīriṇāma || 73 || eṣa gopasuto diṣṭyā pradoṣe maṃdavā sare || amaṃtreṇāpi saṃpūjya śivaṃ śivamavāptavān || 74 || maṃdavāre pradoṣo'yaṃ durlabhaḥ sarvadehinām || tatrāpi durlabhataraḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāgate || || 75 || eṣa puṇyatamo loke gopānāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ || asya vaṃśe'ṣṭamo bhāvī naṃdonāma mahāyaśāḥ || prāpsyate tasya putratvaṃ kṛṣṇo nārā yaṇaḥ svayam || 76 || adyaprabhṛti lokesminneṣa gopālanaṃdanaḥ || nāmnā śrīkara ityuccairloke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 77 || || sūta uvāca || evamuktvāṃjanīsūnustasmai gopakasūnave || upadiśya śivācāraṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 78 || te ca sarve mahīpālāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pratipūjitāḥ || candrasenaṃ samāmaṃtrya pratijagmuryathāgatam || 79 || śrīkaro'pi mahātejā upadiṣṭo hanūmatā || brāhmaṇaiḥ saha dharmajñaiścakre śambhoḥ samarhaṇam || 3.3.5.80 || kālena śrīkaraḥ so'pi caṃdrasenaśca bhūpatiḥ || samārādhya śivaṃ bhaktyā prāpatuḥ paramaṃ padam || 81 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ yaśaskaraṃ puṇyamaharddhivardhanam || ākhyānamākhyātamaghaughanāśanaṃ gaurīśapādāṃbujabhaktivardhanam || 82 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottara khaṇḍe gopakumāracaritavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<3.3.6>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yaduktaṃ bhavatā sūta mahadākhyānamadbhutam || śambhormāhātmyakathanamaśeṣāghaharaṃ param || 1 || bhūyopi śrotumicchāmastadeva susamāhitāḥ || pradoṣe bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ pūjitastu mahātmabhiḥ || 2 || saṃprayacchati kāṃ siddhimetanno brūhi suvrata || śrutamapyasakṛtsūta bhūyastṛṣṇā pravardhate || 3 || || sūta uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahāprājñā bhavadbhirlokaviśrutaiḥ || ato'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śivapūjāphalaṃ mahat || 4 || trayodaśyāṃ tithau sāyaṃ pradoṣaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || tatra pūjyo mahādevo nānyo devaḥ phalārthibhiḥ || 5 || pradoṣapūjāmāhātmyaṃ ko nu varṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ || yatra sarve'pi vibudhāstiṣṭhaṃti giriśāṃtike || 6 || pradoṣasamaye devaḥ kailāse rajatālaye || karoti nṛtyaṃ vibudhairabhiṣṭutaguṇodayaḥ || 7 || ataḥ pūjā japo homastatkathāstadguṇastavaḥ || karttavyo niyataṃ martyaiścaturvargaphalā rthibhiḥ || 8 || dāridyatimirāṃdhānāṃ martyānāṃ bhavabhīruṇām || bhavasāgaramagnānāṃ plavo'yaṃ pāradarśanaḥ || 9 || duḥkhaśokabhayārttānāṃ kleśanirvāṇamicchatām || pradoṣe pārvatīśasya pūjanaṃ maṃgalāyanam || 3.3.6.10 || durbuddhirapi nīcopi mandabhāgyaḥ śaṭho'pi vā || pradoṣe pūjya deveśaṃ vipadbhyaḥ sa pramucyate || 11 || śatrubhirhanyamāno'pi daśyamānopi pannagaiḥ || śailairākramyamāṇo'pi patito'pi mahāṃbudhau || 12 || āviddhakāladaṇḍo'pi nānārogahato'pi vā || na vinaśyati martyo'sau pradoṣe giriśārcanāt || 13 || dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkhamṛṇabhāraṃ nagopamam || sadyo vidhūya saṃpadbhiḥ pūjyate śivapūjanāt || 14 || atra vakṣye mahāpuṇyamitihāsaṃ purātanam || yaṃ śrutvā manujāḥ sarve prayāṃti kṛtakṛtyatām || 15 || āsīdvidarbhaviṣaye nāmnā satyaratho nṛpaḥ || sarvadharmarato dhīraḥ suśīlaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ || 16 || tasya pālayato bhūmiṃ dharmeṇa munipuṃgavāḥ || vyatīyāya mahānkālaḥ sukhenaiva mahāmateḥ || 17 || atha tasya mahībharturbabhūvuḥ śālvabhūbhujaḥ || śatravaścoddhatabalā durmarṣaṇapurogamāḥ || 18 || kadācidatha te śālvāḥ saṃnaddhabahusainikāḥ || vidarbhanagarīṃ prāpya rurudhurvijigīṣavaḥ || 19 || dṛṣṭvā niruddhyamānāṃ tāṃ vidarbhādhipatiḥ purīm || yoddhumabhyāyayau tūrṇaṃ balena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 3.3.6.20 || tasya tairabhavayuddhaṃ śālvairapi baloddhataiḥ || pātāle pannagendrasya gandharvairiva durmadaiḥ || 21 || vidarbhanṛpatiḥ so'tha kṛtvā yuddhaṃ sudāruṇam || pranaṣṭorubalaiḥ śālvairnihato raṇamūrdhani || 22 || tasminmahārathe vīre nihate maṃtribhiḥ saha || dudruvuḥ samare bhagnā hataśeṣāśca sainikāḥ || 23 || atha yuddhebhivirate nadatsu ripumaṃtriṣu || nagaryāṃ yuddhyamānāyāṃ jāte kolāhale rave || 24 || tasya satyarathasyaikā vidarbhādhipateḥ satī || bhūriśokasamāviṣṭā kvacidyatnādviniryayau || 25 || sā niśāsamaye yatnādaṃtarvatnī nṛpāṃganā || nirgatā śoka saṃtaptā pratīcīṃ prayayau diśam || 26 || atha prabhāte mārgeṇa gacchantī śanakaiḥ satī || atītya dūramadhvānaṃ dadarśa vimalaṃ saraḥ || 27 || tatrāgatya varārohā taptā tāpena bhūyasā || vilasaṃtaṃ sarastīre chāyāvṛkṣaṃ samāśrayat || 28 || tatra daivavaśādrājñī vijane tarukuṭṭime || asūta tanayaṃ sādhvī mūhūrte sadguṇānvite || 29 || atha sā rājamahiṣī pipāsābhihatā bhṛśam || saro'vatīrṇā cārvaṃgī grastā grāheṇa bhūyasā || 3.3.6.30 || jātamātraḥ kumāro'pi vinaṣṭapitṛmātṛkaḥ || rurodoccaiḥ sarastīre kṣutpipāsārdito'balaḥ || 31 || tasminnevaṃ krandamāne jātamātre kumārake || kācidabhyāyayau śīghraṃ diṣṭyā vipravarāṃganā || 32 || sāpyekahāyanaṃ bālamudvahantī nijātmajam || adhanā bhartṛrahitā yācamānā gṛhegṛhe || 33 || ekātmajā baṃdhuhīnā yāñcāmārgavaśaṃgatā|| umānāma dvijasatīdadarśa nṛpanaṃdanam|| 34 || sā dṛṣṭvā rājatanayaṃ sūryabiṃvamiva cyutam|| anāthamenaṃ kraṃdaṃtaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa bhūriśaḥ || 35|| aho sumahadāścaryamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayādhunā || acchinnanābhisūtro'yaṃ śiśurmātā kva vā gatā || 36 || pitā nāsti na cānyosti nāsti baṃdhujano'pi vā || anāthaḥ kṛpaṇo bālaḥ śete kevala bhūtale || 37 || eṣa cāṃḍālajo vāpi śūdrajo vaiśyajopi vā || viprātmajo vā nṛpajo jñāyate kathamarbhakaḥ || 38|| śiśumenaṃ samuddhṛtya puṣṇāmyaurasavaddhruvam || kiṃ tvavijñātakulajaṃ notsahe spraṣṭumuttamam || 39 || iti mīmāṃsamānāyāṃ tasyāṃ vipravarastriyām || 3.3.6.40 || kaścitsamāyayau bhikṣuḥ sākṣāddevaḥ śivaḥ svayam || tāmāha bhikṣuvaryotha viprabhāmini mā khidaḥ || 11 || rakṣainaṃ bālakaṃ subhrurvisṛjya hṛdi saṃśayam|| anena paramaṃ śreyaḥ prāpsyase hyacirādeiha || 42 || etāvaduktvā tvarito bhikṣuḥ kāruṇiko yayau || atha tasmingate bhikṣau viśrabdhā viprabhāminī || 43 || tamarbhakaṃ samādāya nijameva gṛhaṃ yayau || bhikṣuvākyena viśrabdhā sā rāja tanayaṃ satī || 44 || ātmaputreṇa sadṛśaṃ kṛpayā paryapoṣayat|| ekacakrāhvaye ramye grāme kṛtaniketanā || 49 || svaputraṃ rājaputraṃ ca bhikṣānnena vyavardhayat || brāhmaṇītanayaścaiva sa rājatanayastathā || 16 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtasaṃskārau vavṛdhāte supūjitau||| kṛtopanayanau kāle bālakau niyame sthitau || || 47 || bhikṣārthaṃ ceratustatra mātrā saha dinedine || tābhyāṃ kadācidbālābhyāṃ sā vipravanitā saha || 48 || bhaikṣyaṃ caraṃtī daivena praviṣṭā devatālayam|| tatra vṛddhaiḥ samākīrṇe munibhirdevatālaye || 19 || tau dṛṣṭvā bālakau dhīmāñchāṃḍilyo munirabravīt || aho daivabalaṃ citramaho karma duratyayam || 3.3.6.50 || eṣa bālo'nyajananīṃ śrito bhaikṣyeṇa jīvati || imāmeva dvijavadhūṃ prāpya mātaramuttamām || 51 || sahaiva dvijaputreṇa dvijabhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ || iti śrutvā munervākyaṃ śāṃḍilyasya dvijāṃganā || 52|| sā praṇamya sabhāmadhye paryapṛcchatsavismayā || brahmanneṣorbhako nīto mayā bhikṣorgirā gṛham || 53 || avijñātakulodyāpi sutavatparipoṣyate || kasminkule prasūto'yaṃ kā mātā janakosya kaḥ || 54 || sarvaṃ vijñātumicchāmi bhavato jñānacakṣuṣaḥ ||.55 ||| iti pṛṣṭo muniḥ sotha jñānadṛṣṭirdvijastriyāṃ || ācakhyau tasya bālasya janma karma ca paurvikam || 56 || vidarbharājaputrastu tatpituḥ samare mṛtim|| tanmāturnakraharaṇaṃ sākalyena nyavedayat || 57 || atha sā vismitā nārī punaḥ prapaccha taṃ munim || sa rājā sakalānbhogānhitvā yuddhe kathaṃ mṛtaḥ || 58 || dāridryamasya bālasya kathaṃ prāptaṃ mahāmune || dāridryaṃ punaruddhūya kathaṃ rājyamavāpsyati || || 59 || asyāpi mama putrasya bhikṣānnenaiva jīvataḥ | dāridryaśamanopāyamupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi ||3.3.6.60|| || śāṃḍilya uvāca |||| amuṣya bālasya pitā sa vidarbhamahīpatiḥ || pūrvajanmani pāṃḍyeśo babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ || 61 || sa rājā sarvadharmajñaḥ pālayansakalāṃ mahīm || pradoṣasamaye śaṃbhuṃ kadā citpratyapūjayat || 62 || tasya pūjayato bhaktyā devaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || āsītkalakalārāvaḥ sarvatra nagare mahān || 63 || śrutvā tamutkaṭaṃ śabdaṃ rājā tyaktaśivārcanaḥ || niryayau rājabhavanānnagarakṣobhaśaṃkayā || 64 || etasminneva samaye tasyāmātyo mahābalaḥ || śatruṃ gṛhītvā sāmaṃtaṃ rājāṃtikamupāgamat || 65 || amātyena samānītaṃ śatruṃ sāmaṃtamuddhatam || dṛṣṭvā krodhena nṛpatiḥ śiracchedamakārayat || 66 || sa tathaiva mahīpālo visṛjya śivapūjanam || asamāptātmaniyamaścakāra niśi bhojanam || 67 || tatputropi tathā cakre pradoṣasamaye śivam || anarcayitvā mūḍhātmā bhuktvā suṣvāpa durmadaḥ || 68 || janmāṃtare sa nṛpatirvidarbhakṣitipo'bhavat || śivārcanāṃtarāyeṇa parairbhogāṃtare hataḥ || 69 || tatputro yaḥ pūrvabhave sosmiñjanmani tatsutaḥ || bhūtvā dāridryamāpannaḥ śivapūjāvyatikramāt || 3.3.6.70 || asya mātā pūrvabhave sapatnīṃ chadmanāhanat || tena pāpena mahatā grāheṇāsminbhave hatā || 71 || eṣā pravṛttireteṣāṃ bhavatyai samudāhṛtā || anarcitaśivā martyāḥ prāpnuvaṃti daridratām || || 72 || satyaṃ bravīmi paralokahitaṃ bravīmi sāraṃ bravīmyupaniṣaddhṛdayaṃ bravīmi || saṃsāramulbaṇamasāramavāpya jaṃtoḥ sāro yamīśvarapadāṃburuhasya sevā || 73 || ye nārcayaṃti giriśaṃ samaye pradoṣe ye nārcitaṃ śivamapi praṇamaṃti cānye || etatkathāṃ śrutipuṭairna pibaṃti mūḍhāste janmajanmasu bhavaṃti narā daridrāḥ || 74 || ye vai pradoṣasamaye parameśvarasya kurvaṃtyananyamanasoṃ'ghrisarojapūjām || nityaṃ pravṛddhadhana dhānyakalatraputrasaubhāgyasaṃpadadhikāsta ihaiva loke || 75 || kailāsaśailabhavane trijagajanitrīṃ gaurīṃ niveśya kanakāṃcitaratnapīṭhe || nṛtyaṃ vidhātu mabhivāñchati śūlapāṇau devāḥ pradoṣasamaye'nubhajaṃti sarve || 76 || vāgdevī dhṛtavallakī śatamakho veṇuṃ dadhatpadmajastālonnidrakaro ramā bhagavatī geyaprayogānvitā || viṣṇuḥ sāṃdramṛdaṃgavādanapaṭurdevāḥ samaṃtātsthitāḥ sevaṃte tamanu pradoṣasamaye devaṃ mṛḍānīpatim || 77 || gaṃdharvayakṣapatagoragasiddha sādhyā vidyādharāmaravarāpsarasāṃ gaṇāśca || ye'nye trilokanilayāḥ saha bhūtavargāḥ prāpte pradoṣasamaye harapārthasaṃsthāḥ || 78 || ataḥ pradoṣe śiva eka eva pūjyo'tha nānye haripadmajādyāḥ || tasminmaheśe vidhinejyamāne sarve prasīdaṃti surādhināthāḥ || 79 || eṣa te tanayaḥ pūrvajanmani brāhmaṇottamaḥ || pratigrahairvayo ninye na yajñādyaiḥ sukarmabhiḥ||3.3.6.80|| ato dāridryamāpannaḥ putraste dvijabhāmini|| taddoṣa parihārārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātu śaṃkaram || 81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe pradoṣamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha ||
<3.3.7>
|| sūta uvāca || || ityuktā muninā sādhvī sā vipravanitā punaḥ || taṃ praṇamyātha papraccha śivapūjāvidheḥ kramam || 1 || || śāṃḍilya uvāca || || pakṣadvaye trayodaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhavedyadā || ghaṭītrayādastamayātpūrvaṃ snānaṃ samācaret || 2 || śuklāṃbaradharo dhīro vāgyato niyamānvitaḥ|| kṛtasaṃdhyājapavidhiḥ śivapūjāṃ samārabhet || 3 || devasya purataḥ samyagupalipya navāṃbhasā || vidhāya maṃḍalaṃ ramyaṃ dhautavastrādibhirbudhaḥ || 4|| vitānādyairalaṃkṛtya phalapuṣpanavāṃkuraiḥ || vicitrapadmamuddhṛtya varṇapaṃcakasaṃyutam || 5 || tatropaviśya suśubhe bhaktiyuktaḥ sthirāsane || samyaksaṃpāditāśeṣa pūjopakaraṇaḥ śuciḥ || 6 || āgamoktena maṃtreṇa pīṭhamāmaṃtrayetsudhīḥ || tataḥ kṛtvātmaśuddhiṃ ca bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ kramāt || 7 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bījavarṇaiḥ sabiṃdukaiḥ || mātṛkā nyasya vidhivaddhyātvā tāṃ devatāṃ parām || 8 || samāpya mātṛkā bhūyo dhyātvā caiva paraṃ śivam || vāmabhāge guruṃ natvā dakṣiṇe gaṇapaṃ namet || 9 || aṃsoruyugme dharmādīnnyasya nābhau ca pārśvayoḥ || adharmādīnanaṃtādīnhṛdi pīṭhe manuṃ nyaset || || 3.3.7.10 || ādhāraśaktimārabhya jñānātmānamanukramāt || uktakrameṇa vinyasya hṛtpadme sādhubhāvite || 11 || navaśaktimaye ramye dhyāyeddevamumāpatim|| candrakoṭipratīkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam || 12 || āpiṃgalajaṭājūṭaṃ ratnamaulivirājitam || nīlagrīvamudārāṃgaṃ nāgahāropaśobhitam || 13 || varadābhayahastaṃ ca dhāriṇaṃ ca paraśvadham || dadhānaṃ nāgavalayakeyūrāṃgadamudrikam || 14 || vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane sthitam || dhyātvā tadvāma bhāge ca ciṃtayedgirikanyakām || 15 || bhāsvajjapāprasūnābhāmudayārkasamaprabhām || vidyutpuṃjanibhāṃ tanvīṃ manonayananaṃdinīm || 16 || bāleṃdu śekharāṃ snigdhāṃ nīlakuṃcitakuntalām || bhṛṃgasaṃghātarucirāṃ nīlālakavirājitām || 17 || maṇikuṃḍalavidyotanmukhamaṃḍalavibhramām || navakumkumapaṃkāṃka kapoladaladarpaṇām ||18|| madhurasmitavibhrājadaruṇādharapallavām || kaṃbukaṃṭhīṃ śivāmudyatkucapaṃkajakuḍmalām || 19 || pāśāṃkuśābhayābhīṣṭavila satsu caturbhujām || anekaratnavilasatkaṃkaṇāṃkitamudrikām || 3.3.7.20 || valitrayeṇa vilasaddhemakāṃcīguṇānvitām || raktamālyāṃbaradharāṃ divyacaṃdanaca rcitām || 21 || dikpālavanitāmaulisannatāṃghrisaroruhām || ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhāṃ sarparājaparicchadām || 21 || evaṃ dhyātvā mahādevaṃ devīṃ ca giri kanyakām || nyāsakrameṇa saṃpūjya devaṃ gaṃdhādibhiḥ kramāt || 23 || paṃcabhirbrahmabhiḥ kuryātproktasthāneṣu vā hṛdi || pṛthakpuṣpāṃjaliṃ dehe mūlena ca hadi tridhā || 24 || punaḥ svayaṃ śivo bhūtvā mūlamaṃtreṇa sādhakaḥ || tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ bāhyapīṭhe punaḥ kramāt || 25 || saṃkalpaṃ pravadettatra pūjāraṃbhe samāhitaḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā ciṃtayeddhṛdi śaṃkaram || 26 || ṛṇapātakadaurbhāgyadāridryavinivṛttaye || aśeṣāghavināśāya prasīda mama śaṃkara || 27 || duḥkhaśokāgnisaṃtaptaṃ saṃsārabhayapīḍitam || bahurogākulaṃ dīnaṃ trāhi māṃ vṛṣavāhana || 28 || āgaccha devadeveśa mahādevābhayaṃkara || gṛhāṇa saha pārvatyā tava pūjāṃ mayā kṛtām || 29|| iti saṃkalpya vidhivadbrāhmapūjāṃ samācaret || guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ caiva yajetsavyāpasavyayoḥ || 3.3.7.30 || kṣetreśamīśakoṇe tu yajedvāstoṣpatiṃ kramāt || vāgdevīṃ ca yajettatra tataḥ kātyāyanīṃ yajet || 31 || dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca namoṃ'takaiḥ || svarairīśādikoṇeṣu pīṭhapādānanukramāt || ābhyāṃ biṃduvisargābhyāmadharmādīnprapūjayet || 32 || sattvarūpaiścaturdikṣu madhye'naṃtaṃ satārakam || sattvādīṃstriguṇāṃstaṃ tu rūpānpīṭheṣu vinyaset || 33 || ata ūrdhvacchade māyāṃ saha lakṣmyā śivena ca || 34 || tadaṃte cāṃbujaṃ bhūyaḥ sakalaṃ maṃḍalatrayam || patrakesarakiṃjalkavyāptaṃ tārākṣaraiḥ kramāt || 35 || padmatrayaṃ tathābhyarcya madhye maṃḍalamādarāt || vāmāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ ca raudrīṃ ca bhāgādyairdikṣu pūjayet || || 36 || vāmādyā nava śaktīśca navasvarayutā yajet || hṛdi bījatrayādyena pīṭhamaṃtreṇa cārcayet ||37|| āvṛttaiḥ prathamāṃgaiśca paṃcabhirmūrttiśaktibhiḥ || triśaktimūrttibhiścānyairnidhidvayasamanvitaiḥ || 38 || anaṃtādyaiḥ parītāśca mātṛbhiśca vṛṣādibhiḥ || siddhibhiścāṇimādyābhiriṃdrādyaiśca sahāyudhaiḥ || || 39 || vṛṣabhakṣetracaṃḍeśadurgāśca skaṃdanaṃdinau || gaṇeśaḥ sainyapaścaiva svasvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ || 3.3.7.40 || aṇimā mahimā caiva garimā laghimā tathā || īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca prāptiḥ prākāmyameva ca || 41 || aṣṭaiśvaryāṇi coktāni tejorūpāṇi kevalam || paṃcabhirbrahmabhiḥ pūrvaṃ hṛllekhādyādibhiḥ kramāta || 42 || aṃgairumādyairiṃdrādyaiḥ pūjoktā munibhistu taiḥ || umācaṃḍeśvarādīṃśca pūjayeduttarāditaḥ || 43 || evamāvaraṇairyuktaṃ tejorūpaṃ sadāśivam || umayā sahitaṃ devamupacāraiḥ prapūjayet || 44 || supratiṣṭhitaśaṃkhasya tīrthaiḥ paṃcāmṛtairapi || abhiṣicya mahādevaṃ rudrasūktaiḥ samāhitaḥ || 45 || kalpayedvividhairmaṃtrairāsanādyupacārakān|| āsanaṃ kalpayeddhaimaṃ divyavastrasamanvitam || 46 || arghyamaṣṭaguṇopetaṃ pādyaśuddhodakena ca || tenaivācamanaṃ dadyānmadhuparkaṃ madhūttaram || 47 || punarācamanaṃ dattvā snānaṃ maṃtrai prakalpayet || upavītaṃ tathā vāso bhūṣaṇāni nivedayet || gaṃdhamaṣṭāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ supūtaṃ vinivedayet || || 48 || tataśca bilvamaṃdārakahlārasarasīruham || dhattūrakaṃ karṇikāraṃ śaṇapuṣpaṃ ca mallikām || 49 || kuśāpāmārgatulasīmādhavīcaṃpakādikam || bṛhatīkaravīrāṇi yathālabdhāni sādhakaḥ || 3.3.7.50 || nivedayetsugaṃdhīni mālyāni vividhāni ca || dhūpaṃ kālāgarūtpannaṃ dīpaṃ ca vimalaṃ śubham || ||51|| viśeṣakam || atha pāyasanaivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ sopadaṃśakam || modakāpūpasaṃyuktaṃ śarkarāguḍasaṃyutam || 52 || madhunāktaṃ dadhiyutaṃ jalapānasamanvitam || tenaiva haviṣā vahnau juhuyānmaṃtrabhāvite || 53 || āgamoktena vidhinā guruvākyaniyaṃtritaḥ || naivedyaṃ śaṃbhave bhūyo dattvā tāṃbūlamuttamam || 54 ||| dhūpaṃ nīrājanaṃ ramyaṃ chatraṃ darpaṇamuttamam || samarpayitvā vidhivanmaṃtrairvedikatāṃtrikaiḥ || 55 || yadyaśaktaḥ svayaṃ niḥsvo yathāvibhavamarcayet || bhakttyā dattena gaurīśaḥ puṣpamātreṇa tuṣyati || 56 || athāṃgabhūtānsakalāngaṇeśādīnprapūjayet || stavairnānāvidhaiḥ stutvā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamedbudhaḥ || 57 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vṛṣacaṃḍeśvarādikān || pūjāṃ samarpya vidhivatprārthayedgirijāpatim || 58 || jaya deva jagannātha jaya śaṃkara śāśvata || jaya sarva surādhyakṣa jaya sarvasurārcita || 59 || jaya sarvaguṇātīta jaya sarvavaraprada || jaya nitya nirādhāra jaya viśvaṃbharāvyaya || 3.3.7.60 || jaya viśvaikavedyeśa jaya nāgeṃdrabhūṣaṇa || jaya gaurīpate śaṃbho jaya caṃdrārdhaśekhara || 61 || jaya koṭyarkasaṃkāśa jayānaṃtaguṇāśraya || 62 || jaya rudra virūpākṣa jayāciṃtya niraṃjana || jaya nātha kṛpāsiṃdho jaya bhaktārtibhañjana || jaya dustarasaṃsārasāgarottāraṇa prabho || 63 || prasīda me mahādeva saṃsārārttasya khidyataḥ || sarvapāpabhayaṃ hṛtvā rakṣa māṃ parameśvara || 64 || mahādāridryamagnasya mahāpāpahatasya ca || mahāśokavinaṣṭasya mahārogāturasya ca || 65 || ṛṇabhāraparītasya dahyamānasya karmabhiḥ || grahaiḥ prapīḍyamānasya prasīda mama śaṃkara || 66 || daridraḥ prārthayedevaṃ pūjāṃte girijāpatim || arthāḍhyo vāpi rājā vā prārthayeddevamīśvaram || 67 || dīrghamāyuḥ sadārogyaṃ kośavṛddhirbalonnatiḥ || mamāstu nityamānandaḥ prasādāttava śaṃkara || 68 || śatravaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yāṃtu prasīdantu mama grahāḥ || naśyantu dasyavo rāṣṭre janāḥ saṃtu nirāpadaḥ || 69 || durbhikṣamārīsaṃtāpāḥ śamaṃ yāṃtu mahītale || sarvasasyasamṛddhiśca bhūyātsukhamayā diśaḥ || 3.3.7.70 || evamārādhayeddevaṃ pradoṣe girijāpatim || brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścāddakṣiṇābhiśca toṣayet || 71 || sarvapāpakṣayakarī sarvadāridryanāśinī || śivapūjā mayā khyātā sarvābhīṣṭavarapradā || 72 || mahāpātakasaṃghātamadhikaṃ copapātakam || śivadravyāpaharaṇādanyatsarvaṃ nivārayet || 73 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi || prāyaścittāni dṛṣṭāni na śivadravyahāriṇām || 74 || bahunātra kimuktena ślokārdhena bravīmyaham || brahmahatyāśataṃ vāpi śivapūjā vināśayet || 75 || mayā kathitametatte pradoṣe śivapūjanam || rahasyaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāmatra nāstyeva saṃśayaḥ || 76 || etābhyāmapi bālābhyāmevaṃ pūjā vidhīyatām || ataḥ saṃvatsarādeva parāṃ siddhimavāpsyatha || 77 || iti śāṃḍilyavacanamākarṇya dvijabhāminī || tābhyāṃ tu saha bālābhyāṃ praṇanāma muneḥ padam || 78 || || || viprastryuvāca || || ahamadya kṛtārthāsmi tava darśanamātrataḥ || etau kumārau bhagavaṃstvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatau || 79 || eṣa me tanayo brahmañchucivrata itīritaḥ || eṣa rājasuto nāmnā dharmaguptaḥ kṛto mayā || 3.3.7.80 || etāvahaṃ ca bhagavanbhavaccaraṇakiṃkarāḥ || samuddharāsminpatitānghore dāridryasāgare || 81 || iti prapannāṃ śaraṇaṃ dvijāṃganāmāśvāsya vākyairamṛtopamānaiḥ || upādideśātha tayoḥ kumārayormuniḥ śivārādhanamaṃtra vidyām || 82 || athopadiṣṭau muninā kumārau brāhmaṇī ca sā || taṃ praṇamya samāmaṃtrya jagmuste śivamaṃdirāt || 83 || tataḥ prabhṛti tau bālau munivaryopadeśataḥ || pradoṣe pārvatīśasya pūjāṃ cakraturaṃjasā || 84 || evaṃ pūjayatordevaṃ dvijarājakumārayoḥ || sukhenaiva vyatīyāya tayormāsacatuṣṭayam || 85 || kadācidrājaputreṇa vināsau dvijanaṃdanaḥ || snātuṃ gato nadītīre cacāra bahulīlayā || 86 || tatra nirjharanirghātanirbhinne vapra kuṭṭime || nidhānakalaśaṃ sthūlaṃ prasphuraṃtaṃ dadarśa ha || 87 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāgatya harṣakautukavihvalaḥ || daivopapannaṃ manvāno gṛhītvā śirasā yayau || || 88 || sasaṃbhramaṃ samānīya nidhāya kalaśaṃ balāt || nidhāya bhavanasyāṃte mātaraṃ samabhāṣata || 89 || mātarmātarimaṃ paśya prasādaṃ girijāpateḥ || nidhānaṃ kumbharūpeṇa darśitaṃ karuṇātmanā || 3.3.7.90 || atha sā vismitā sādhvī samāhūya nṛpātmajam || svaputraṃ pratinaṃdyāha mānayantī śivārcanam || || 91 || śṛṇutāṃ me vacaḥ putrau nidhānakalaśīmimām || samaṃ vibhajya gṛhṇītaṃ mama śāsanagauravāt || 92 || iti māturvacaḥ śrutvā tutoṣa dvija naṃdanaḥ || pratyāha rājaputrastāṃ visrabdhaḥ śaṃkarārcane || 93 || mātastava sutasyaiva sukṛtena samāgatam || nāhaṃ grahītumicchāmi vibhaktaṃ dhanasaṃca yam || 94 || ātmanaḥ sukṛtāllabdhaṃ svayameva bhunaktvasau || sa eva bhagavānīśaḥ kariṣyati kṛpāṃ mayi || 95 || evamarcayatoḥ śaṃbhuṃ bhūyopi parayā mudā || saṃvatsaro vyatīyāya tasminneva gṛhe tayoḥ || 96 || athaikadā rājasūnuḥ saha tena dvijanmanā || vasaṃtasamaye prāpte vijahāra vanāṃ tare || 97 || atha dūraṃ gatau kvāpi vane dvijanṛpātmajau || gandharvakanyāḥ krīḍaṃtī śataśastāvapaśyatām || 98 || tāḥ sarvāścārusarvāṃgyo viharaṃtyo manoharam || dṛṣṭvā dvijātmajo dūrāduvāca nṛpanaṃdanam || 99 || itaḥ puro na gaṃtavyaṃ viharaṃtyagrataḥ striyaḥ|| strīsaṃnnidhānaṃ vibudhāstyajaṃti vimalāśayāḥ|| 3.3.7.100 || etāḥ kaitavakāriṇyo dhanayauvanadurmadāḥ | mohayantyo janaṃ dṛṣṭvā vācānunayakovidāḥ || 101 || ataḥ parityajettstrīṇāṃ sannidhiṃ sahabhāṣaṇam | nijadharmarato vidvanbrahmacārī viśeṣataḥ || 102|| atohaṃ notsahe gantuṃ krīḍāsthānaṃ mṛgīdṛśām || ityuktvā dvijaputrastu nivṛtto dūrataḥ sthitaḥ || 103 || athāsau rājaputrastu kautukāviṣṭamānasaḥ || tāsāṃ vihārapadavīmeka evābhayo yayau || 104 || tatra gaṃdharvakanyānāṃ madhye tvekā varānanā || dṛṣṭvā''yāṃtaṃ rājaputraṃ ciṃtayāmāsa cetasā || 105 || aho koyamudārāṃgo yuvā sarvāṃgasundaraḥ || mattamātaṃga gamano lāvaṇyāmṛtavāridhiḥ || 106|| līlālolaviśālākṣī madhurasmitapeśalaḥ || madanopamarūpaśrīḥ sukumārāṃgalakṣaṇaḥ || 107|| ityāścaryayutā bālā dūrāddṛṣṭvā nṛpātmajam || sarvāḥ sakhīḥ samālokya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 108 || ito vidūre he sakhyo vanamastyekamuttamam || vicitracaṃpakāśokapunnāgabakulairyutam || 109|| tatra gatvā vanaṃ sarvāḥ saṃcīya kusumotkaram || bhavatyaḥ punarāyāṃtu tāvattiṣṭhāmyahaṃ tviha || 3.3.7.110 || ityādiṣṭaḥ sakhīvargo jagāma vipināṃtaram || sāpi gaṃdharvajā tasthau nyastadṛṣṭirnṛpātmaje || 111 || tāṃ samālokya tanvaṃgīṃ navayauvanaśālinīm || bālāṃ svarūpasaṃpattyā paraiibhūtatilottamām || 112 || rājaputraḥ samāgamya kautukotphullalocanaḥ || avāpa daivayogena madanasya śaravyathām || 113 || gandharvatanayā sāpi prāptāya nṛpasūnave || utthāya tarasā tasmai pradadau pallavāsanam ||114 || kṛtopacāramāsīnaṃ tamāsādya sumadhyamā || papraccha tadrūpaguṇairdhvastadhairyākuleṃdriyā || 119 | kastvaṃ kamalapatrākṣa kasmāddeśādihāgataḥ || kasya putra iti premṇā pṛṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat || 116 || vidarbha rājatanayaṃ vidhvastapitṛmātṛkam || śatrubhiśca hṛtasthānamātmānaṃ pararāṣṭragam || 117 || sarvamāvedya bhūyastāṃ papraccha nṛpanaṃdanaḥ || kā tvaṃ vāmoru kiṃ cātra kāryaṃ te kasya cātmajā || 118 || kimavadhyāyasi hṛdā kiṃ vā vaktumihecchasi || ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājeṃdrasattama || 119 || astyeko dravikonāma gaṃdharvāṇāṃ kulāgraṇīḥ || tasyāhamasmi tanayā nāmnā cāṃśumatī smṛtā || 3.3.7.120 || tvāmāyāṃtaṃ vilokyāhaṃ tvatsaṃbhāṣaṇa lālasā || tyaktvā sakhījanaṃ sarvamekaivāsmi mahāmate || 121 || sarvasaṃgītavidyāsu na matto'nyāsti kācana || mama yogena tuṣyaṃti sarvā api surastriyaḥ || 122 || sāhaṃ sarvakalābhijñā jñātasarvajaneṃgitā || tavāhamīpsitaṃ vedmi mayi te saṃgataṃ manaḥ || 123 || tathā mamāpi cautsukyaṃ daivena pratipāditam|| āvayoḥ snehabhedo'tra nābhibhūyāditaḥ param || 124 || iti saṃbhāṣya tenāśu premṇā gandharvanaṃdinī || muktāhāraṃ dadau tasmai svakucāṃtarabhūṣaṇam|| 125 || tamādāyādbhutaṃ hāraṃ sa tasyāḥ praṇayākulaḥ || gāḍhaharṣabharotsiktāmidamāha nṛpātmajaḥ || 126 || satyamuktaṃ tvayā bhīru tathāpyekaṃ vadāmyaham || tyaktarājyasya niḥsvasya kathaṃ me bhavasi priyā || 127 || sā tvaṃ pitṛmatī bālā vilaṃghya pitṛśāsanam || svacchaṃdā caraṇaṃ kartuṃ mūḍheva kathamarhasi || 128 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā taṃ pratyāha śucismitā || astu nāma tathaivāhaṃ kariṣye paśya kautukam || 129 || gaccha svabhavanaṃ kāṃta paraśvaḥ prātareva tu || āgaccha punaratraiva kāryamasti ca no mṛṣā || 3.3.7.130 || ityuktvā taṃ nṛpasutaṃ sā saṃgatasakhījanā || apākrāmata cārvaṃgī sa cāpi nṛpanandanaḥ || 131 || sa samabhyetya harṣeṇa dvijaputrasya sannidhim || sarvamākhyāya tenaiva sārdhaṃ svabhavanaṃ yayau || || 132 || tāṃ ca viprasatīṃ bhūyo harṣayitvā nṛpātmajaḥ || paraśvo dvijaputreṇa sārdhaṃ tena vanaṃ yayau ||133 || sa tayā pūrvanirdiṣṭaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya nṛpātmajaḥ || gandharvarājamadrākṣītsvaduhitrā samanvitam || 134 || sa gaṃdharvapatiḥ prāptāvabhinaṃdya kumārakau || upaveśyāsane ramye rājaputramabhāṣata || || 135 || || gaṃdharva uvāca || || rājeṃdraputra pūrvedyuḥ kailāsaṃ gatavānaham || tatrāpaśyaṃ mahādevaṃ pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum || 136 || āhūya māṃ sa deveśaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām || sannidhāvāha bhagavānkaruṇāmṛtavāridhiḥ || 137 || dharmaguptāhvayaḥ kaścidrājaputro'sti bhūtale || akiñcano bhraṣṭarājyo hṛtadeśaśca śatrubhiḥ || 138 || sa bālo guruvākyena madarccāyāṃ rataḥ sadā || adya tatpitaraḥ sarve māṃ prāptāstatprabhāvataḥ || 139 || tasya tvamapi sāhāyyaṃ kuru gandharvasattama || athāsau nijarājyastho hataśatrurbhaviṣyati || 3.3.7.140 || ityājñapto maheśena saṃprāpto nijamadiram || anayā madduhitrā ca bahuśo'bhyarthitastathā || 141 || jñātvemaṃ sakalaṃ śaṃbhorniyogaṃ karuṇātmanaḥ || ādāyemāṃ duhitaraṃ prāpto'smīdaṃ vanāṃtaram ||142|| ata enāṃ prayacchāmi kanyāmaṃśumatīṃ tava || hatvā śatrūnsvarāṣṭe tvāṃ sthāpayāmi śivājñayā || 143 || tasminpure tvamanayā bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān|| daśavarṣasahasrānte gantāsi giriśālayam || tatrāpi mama kanyeyaṃ tvāmeva pratipatsyate || anenaiva svadehena divyena śivasannidhau || 145 || iti gandharvarājastamābhāṣya nṛpanandanam || tasminvane svaduhituḥ pāṇigrahamakārayat || 146 || pāribarhamadāttasmai ratnabhārānmahojjvalān || cūḍāmaṇiṃ candranibhaṃ muktāhārāṃśca bhāsurān||147|| divyālaṃkāravāsāṃsi kārttasvaraparicchadān || gajānāmayutaṃ bhūyo niyutaṃ nīlavājinām||148|| syandanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sauvarṇāni mahāṃti ca || punarekaṃ rathaṃ divyaṃ dhanuścendrāyudhopamam || 149 || astrāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi tūṇī cākṣayyasāyakau || abhedyaṃ varma sauvarṇaṃ śaktiṃ ca ripumardinīm || 3.3.7.150 || duhituḥ paricaryārthaṃ dāsīpañcasahasrakam || dadau prītamanāstasmai dhanāni vividhāni ca || || 151 || gaṃdharvasainyamatyugraṃ caturaṃgasamamanvitam || punaśca tatsahāyārthe gandharvādhipatirdadau || 152 || itthaṃ rājendratanayaḥ saṃprāptaḥ śriyamuttamām || abhīṣṭajāyāsahito mumude nijasaṃpadā || 153 || kārayitvā svaduhiturvivāhaṃ samayocitam || yayau vimānamāruhya gaṃdharvādhipatirdivam || 154 || dharmaguptaḥ kṛtodvāhaḥ saha gaṃdharvasenayā || punaḥ svanagaraṃ prāpya jaghāna ripuvāhinīm || 155 || durdharṣaṇaṃ raṇe hatvā śaktyā gaṃdharvasenayā || niḥ śeṣitārātibalaḥ praviveśa nijaṃ puram || 156 || tatobhiṣiktaḥ sacivairbrāhmaṇaiśca mahottamaiḥ || ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaścakre rājyamakaṇṭakam || 157 || yā vipravanitā pūrvaṃ tamapuṣṇātsvaputravat || saiva mātābhavattasya sa bhrātā dvijanandanaḥ || 158 || gaṃdharvatanayā jāyā vidarbhanagareśvaraḥ || ārādhya devaṃ giriśaṃ dharmagupto nṛpo'bhavat || 159 || evamanye samārādhya pradoṣe girijāpatim || labhaṃtebhīpsitānkāmāndehāṃte tu parāṃ gatim || 3.3.7.160 || || sūta uvāca || || etanmahāvrataṃ puṇyaṃ pradoṣe śaṃkarārcanam || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yadetatsādhanaṃ param || 161 || ya etacchṛṇuyātpuṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutam || pradoṣe śivapūjāṃte kathayedvā samāhitaḥ || 162 || bhavenna tasya dāridryaṃ janmāntaraśateṣvapi || jñānaiśvaryasamāyuktaḥ sonte śivapuraṃ vrajet || 163 || ye prāpya durlabhataraṃ manujāḥ śarīraṃ kurvaṃti haṃta parameśvarapādapūjām || dhanyāsta eva nijapuṇyajitatrilokāsteṣāṃ padāṃbujarajo bhuvanaṃ punāti || 164 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe pradoṣamahimāvarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<3.3.8>
|| sūta uvāca || || nityānaṃdamayaṃ śāṃtaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirāmayam || śivatattvamanādyaṃtaṃ ye viduste paraṃ gatāḥ || 1 || viraktāḥ kāmabhogebhyo ye prakurvaṃtyahaitukīm || bhaktiṃ parāṃ śive dhīrāsteṣāṃ muktirna saṃsṛtiḥ ||2|| viṣayānabhisaṃdhāya ye kurvaṃti śive ratim || viṣayairnābhibhūyaṃte bhuṃjānāstatphalānyapi || 3 || yena kenāpi bhāvena śivabhaktiyuto naraḥ || na vinaśyati kālena sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 4 || ārurukṣuḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ || pūjayetkarmaṇā śaṃbhuṃ bhogāṃte śivamāpnuyāt || 5 || aśaktaḥ kaścidutsraṣṭuṃ prāyo viṣayavāsanām || ataḥ karmamayī pūjā kāmadhenuḥ śarīriṇām ||6|| māyāmayepi saṃsāre ye vihṛtya ciraṃ sukham || muktimicchanti dehāṃte teṣāṃ dharmoyamīritaḥ || 7|| śivapūjā sadā loke hetuḥ svargāpavargayoḥ || somavāre viśeṣeṇa pradoṣādiguṇānvite || 8 || kevalenāpi ye kuryuḥ somavāre śivārcanam || na teṣāṃ vidyate kiṃcidihāmutra ca durlabham || 9 || upoṣitaḥ śucirbhūtvā somavāre jiteṃdriyaḥ || vaidikairlaukikairvāpi vidhivatpūjayecchivam ||3.3.8.10|| brahmacārī gṛhastho vā kanyā vāpi sabharttṛkā|| vibhartṛkā vā saṃpūjya labhate varamīpsitam||11|| atrāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāṃ śrotṛmanoharām|| śrutvā muktiṃ prayāṃtyeva bhartirbhavati śāṃbhavī||12|| āryāvarte nṛpaḥ kaścidāsīddharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ|| citravarmeti vikhyāto dharmarājo durātmanām|| || 13 || sa goptā dharmasetūnāṃ śāstā duṣpathagāminām || yaṣṭā samastayajñānāṃ trātā śaraṇamicchatām||14|| karttā sakalapuṇyānāṃ dātā sakalasaṃpadām || jetā sapatnavṛṃdānāṃ bhaktaḥ śivamukundayoḥ || 15 || sonukūlāsu patnīṣu labdhvā putrānmahaujasaḥ || cireṇa prārthitāṃ lebhe kanyāmekāṃ varānanām || 16 || sa labdhvā tanayāṃ diṣṭyā himavāniva pārvatīm || ātmānaṃ devasadṛśaṃ mene pūrṇamanoratham || 17 || sa ekadā jātakalakṣaṇajñānāhūya sādhūndvijamukhyavṛṃdān || kutūhalenābhiniviṣṭacetāḥ papraccha kanyājanane phalāni || 18 || atha tatrābravīdeko bahujño dvijasattamaḥ || eṣā sīmaṃtinī nāmnā kanyā tava mahīpate || 19 || umeva māṃgalyavatī damayaṃtīva rūpiṇī || bhāratīva kalābhijñā lakṣmīriva mahāguṇā || || 3.3.8.20 || suprajā devamāteva jānakīva dhṛtavratā || raviprabheva satkāṃtiścaṃdrikeva manoramā || 21 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi saha bhartrā pramodate || prasūya tanayānaṣṭau paraṃ sukhamavāpsyati|| 22 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatirdhanaiḥ saṃpūjya taṃ dvijam || avāpa paramāṃ prītiṃ tadvāgamṛtasevayā || 23 || athānyo'pi dvijaḥ prāha dhairyavānamitadyutiḥ || eṣā caturdaśe varṣe vaidhavyaṃ pratipatsyati || 24 || ityākarṇya vacastasya vajranirghātaniṣṭhuram || muhūrtamabhavadrājā ciṃtāvyākulamānasaḥ || 25 || atha sarvānsamutsṛjya brāhmaṇānbrahmavatsalaḥ || sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ mattvā niściṃtaḥ pārthivo'bhavat || 26 || sāpi sīmaṃtinī bālā krameṇa gataśaiśavā || vaidhavyamātmano bhāvi śuśrāvātmasakhīmukhāt || 27 || paraṃ nirvedamāpannā ciṃtayāmāsa bālikā || yājñavalkyamuneḥ patnīṃ maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata||28|| mātastvaccaraṇāṃbhojaṃ prapannāsmi bhayākulā|| saubhāgyavardhanaṃ karma mama śaṃsitumarhasi||29|| iti prapannāṃ nṛpateḥ kanyāṃ prāha muneḥ satī|| śaraṇaṃ vraja tanvaṃgi pārvatīṃ śivasaṃyutām||3.3.8.30|| somavāre śivaṃ gaurīṃ pūjayasva samāhitā|| upoṣitā vā susnātā virajāmbaradhāriṇī || 31 || yatavāṅniścalamanāḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathocitām || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvātha śivaṃ samyakprasādayat ||32|| pāpakṣayo'bhiṣekeṇa sāmrājyaṃ pīṭhapūjanāt || saubhāgyamakhilaṃ saukhyaṃ gaṃdhamālyākṣatārpaṇāt || 33 || dhūpadānena saugaṃdhyaṃ kāṃtirdīpapradānataḥ || naivedyaiśca mahābhogo lakṣmīstāṃbūladānataḥ || 34 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca namaskārapradānataḥ || aṣṭaiśvaryādisiddhīnāṃ japa eva hi kāraṇam || 35 || homena sarvakāmānāṃ samṛddhirupajāyate || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tuṣṭirbrāhmaṇabhojanāt || 36 || itthamārādhaya śivaṃ somavāre śivāmapi || atyāpadamapi prāptā nistīrṇābhibhavā bhaveḥ || 37 || ghorādghoraṃ prapannāpi mahākleśaṃ bhayānakam || śivapūjāprabhāveṇa tariṣyasi mahadbhayam || 38 || itthaṃ sīmaṃtinīṃ samyaganuśāsya punaḥ satī || yayau sāpi varārohā rājaputrī tathā'karot || 39 || damayaṃtyāṃ nalasyāsīdiṃdrasenābhidhaḥ sutaḥ || tasya caṃdrāṃgado nāma putrobhū ccaṃdrasannibhaḥ || 3.3.8.40 || citravarmā nṛpaśreṣṭhastamāhūya nṛpātmajam || kanyāṃ sīmaṃtinīṃ tasmai prāyacchadgurvanujñayā || 41 || so'bhūnmahotsavastatra tasyā udvāhakarmaṇi || yatra sarvamahīpānāṃ samavāyo mahānabhūt || 42 || tasyāḥ pāṇigrahaṃ kāle kṛtvā caṃdrāṃgadaḥ kṛtī || uvāsa katicinmāsāṃstatraiva śvaśurālaye || 43 || ekadā yamunāṃ tartuṃ sa rājatanayo balī || āruroha tarīṃ kaiścidvayasyaiḥ saha līlayā || 44 || tasmiṃstarati kāliṃdīṃ rājaputre vidhervaśāt || mamajja saha kaivatairāvarttābhihatā tarī || 45 || hā heti śabdaḥ sumahānāsīttasyāstaṭadvaye || paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ pralāpo divama spṛśat || 46 || majjaṃto mamrire kecitkecidgrāhodaraṃ gatāḥ || rājaputrādayaḥ kecinnādṛśyaṃta mahājale || 47 || tadupaśrutya rājāpi citravarmātivi hvalaḥ || yamunāyāstaṭaṃ prāpya viceṣṭaḥ samajāyata ||48|| śrutvātha rājapatnyaśca vabhūburgatacetanāḥ || sā ca sīmaṃtinī śrutvā papāpa ḍūvi mūrcchitā || 49 || tathānye maṃtrimukhyāśca nāyakāḥ sapurohitāḥ|| vihvalāḥ śokasaṃtaptā vilepurmuktamūrdhajāḥ ||3.3.8.50|| iṃdrasenopi rājedraḥ putravārttāṃ suduḥkhitaḥ|| ākarṇya saha patnībhirnaṣṭasaṃjñaḥ papāta ha || 51 || tanmaṃtriṇaśca tatpaurāstathā taddeśavāsinaḥ || ābālavṛddhavanitāścukruśuḥ śokavihvalāḥ || 52 || śokātkeciduro jaghnuḥ śiro jaghnuśca kecana || hā rājaputra hā tāta kvāsi kvāsīti babhramuḥ ||53|| evaṃ śokākulaṃ dīnamiṃdrasenamahīpateḥ || nagaraṃ sahasā kṣubdhaṃ citravarmapuraṃ tathā || 54 || atha vṛddhaiḥ samāśvastaścitravarmā mahīpatiḥ || śanairnagaramāgatya sāntvayāmāsa cātmajām || 55 || sa rājāṃbhasimagnasya jāmātustasya bāṃdhavaiḥ || āgataiḥ kārayāmāsa sākalyādaurdhvadaihikam ||56|| sā ca sīmaṃtinī sādhvī bhartṛlokamatiḥ satī || pitrā niṣiddhā snehena vaidhavyaṃ pratyapadyata || 57 || muneḥ patnyo'padiṣṭaṃ yatsomavāravrataṃ śubham || na tatyāja śubhācārā vaidhavyaṃ prāptavatyapi || 58 || evaṃ caturdaśe varṣe duḥkhaṃ prāpya sudāruṇam || dhyāyantī śivapādābjaṃ vatsaratrayamatyagāt || 59 || putraśokādivonmattamiṃdrasenaṃ mahīpatim || prasahya tasya dāyādāḥ saptāṃgaṃ jahrurojasā || 3.3.8.60 || hṛtasiṃhāsanaḥ śūrairdāyādaiḥ so'prajo nṛpaḥ || nigṛhya kārābhavane sapatnīko niveśitaḥ || || 61 || caṃdrāgado'pi tatputro nimagno yamunājale || adhodhomajjamāno'sau dadarśoragakāminīḥ || 62 || jalakrīḍāsu saktāstā dṛṣṭvā rājakumāra kam || vismitāstamatho ninyuḥ pātālaṃ pannagālayam || 63 || sa nīyamānastarasā pannagībhirnṛpātmajaḥ || takṣakasya puraṃ ramyaṃ viveśa paramādbhutam || || 64 || so'paśyadrājatanayo maheṃdrabhavanopamam || mahāratnaparibhrājanmayūkhaparidīpitam || 65|| vajravaiḍūryapācādiprāsādaśatasaṃkulam || māṇikya gopuradvāraṃ muktādāmabhirujjvalam || 66 || caṃdrakāṃtasthalaṃ ramyaṃ hemadvārakapāṭakam || anekaśatasāhasramaṇidīpavirājitam || 67 || tatrāpaśyatsabhā madhye niṣaṇṇaṃ ratnaviṣṭare || takṣakaṃ pannagādhīśaṃ phaṇānekaśatojjvalam || 68 || divyāṃbaradharaṃ dīptaṃ ratnakuṇḍalarājitam || nānāratnaparikṣiptamukuṭa dyutiraṃjitam || 69 || phaṇāmaṇimayūkhāḍhyairasaṃkhyaiḥ pannagottamaiḥ || upāsitaṃ prāṃjalibhiścitraratnavibhūṣitaiḥ || 3.3.8.70 || rūpayauvanamādhuryavilāsagati śobhinā || nāgakanyāsahasreṇa samaṃtātparivāritam || 71 || divyābharaṇadīptāṃgaṃ divyacaṃdanacarcitam || kālāgnimiva durdharṣaṃ tejasādityasannibham || || 72 || dṛṣṭvā rājasuto dhīraḥ praṇipatya sabhāsthale || utthitaḥ prāṃjalistasya tejasākṣiptalocanaḥ || 73 || nāgarājopi taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaputraṃ manoramam || ko'yaṃ kasmādihāyāta iti papraccha pannagīḥ || 74 || tā ūcuryamunātoye dṛṣṭo'smābhiryadṛcchayā || ajñātakulanāmāyamānītastava sannidhim || 75 || atha pṛṣṭo rājaputrastakṣakeṇa mahātmanā || kasyāsi tanayaḥ kastvaṃ ko deśaḥ kathamāgataḥ || 76 || rājaputro vacaḥ śrutvā takṣakaṃ vākyamabravīt || 77 || || rājaputra uvāca || || asti bhūmaṃḍale kaściddeśo niṣadhasaṃjñakaḥ || tasyādhipo'bhavadrājā nalo nāma mahā yaśāḥ || sa puṇyakīrtiḥ kṣitipo damayantīpatiḥ śubhaḥ || 78 || tasmādapīṃdrasenākhyastasya putro mahābalaḥ || caṃdrāṃgadosmi nāmnāhaṃ navoḍhaḥ śvaśurālaye || viharanyamunātoye nimagno devacoditaḥ || 79 || etābhiḥ pannagastrībhirānītosmi tavāṃtikam || dṛṣṭvāhaṃ tava pādābjaṃ puṇyairjanmāṃtarārjitaiḥ || 3.3.8.80 || adya dhanyo'smi dhanyo'smi kṛtārtho pitarau mama || yatprekṣito'haṃ kāruṇyāttvayā saṃbhāṣitopi ca || 81 || || sūta uvāca || || ityudāramasaṃbhrāṃtaṃ vacaḥ śrutvātipeśalam || takṣakaḥ punarautsukyādbabhāṣe rājanaṃdanam || 82 || || takṣaka uvāca || || bhobho nareṃdradāyāda mā bhaiṣīrdhīratāṃ vraja || sarvadeveṣu ko devo yuṣmābhiḥ pūjyate sadā || 83 || || rājaputra uvāca || || yo devaḥ sarvedeveṣu mahādevaṃ iti smṛtaḥ || pūjyate sa hi viśvātmā śivo'smābhirumāpatiḥ || 84 || yasya tejoṃśaleśena rajasā ca prajāpatiḥ || kṛtarūpo'sṛjadviśvaṃ sa naḥ pūjyo maheśvaraḥ || 85 || yasyāṃśātsāttvikaṃ divyaṃ bibhradviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || viśvaṃ bibhartti bhūtātmā śivo'smābhiḥ sa pūjyate || || 86 || yasyāṃśāttāmasājjāto rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ || viśvametaddharatyaṃte sa pūjyo'smābhirīśvaraḥ || 87 || yo vidhātā vidhātuśca kāraṇasyāpi kāraṇam || tejasāṃ paramaṃ tejaḥ sa śivo naḥ parā gatiḥ || 88 || yoṃtikastho'pi dūrasthaḥ pāpopahṛtacetasām || aparicchedya dhāmāsau śivo naḥ paramā gatiḥ || 89 || yo'gnau tiṣṭhati yo bhūmau yo vāyau salile ca yaḥ || ya ākāśe ca viśvātmā sa pūjyo naḥ sadāśivaḥ|| 3.3.8.90 | yaḥ sākṣī sarvabhūtānāṃ ya ātmastho niraṃjanaḥ || yasyecchāvaśago lokaḥ so'smābhiḥ pūjyate śivaḥ || 91 || yamekamādyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ vadaṃti bhinnaṃ guṇavaikṛtena || kṣetrajñameketha turīyamanye kūṭasthamanye sa śivo gatirnaḥ || 92 || yaṃ nāspṛśaṃścaityamaciṃtyatattvaṃ duraṃtadhāmānamatatsvarūpam || manovacovṛttaya ātmabhājāṃ sa eṣa pūjyaḥ paramaḥ śivo naḥ || 93|| yasya prasādaṃ pratilabhya saṃto vāṃchaṃti naiṃdraṃ padamujjvalaṃ vā || nistīrṇakarmārgalakālacakrāścaraṃtyabhītāḥ sa śivo gatirnaḥ || 94|| yasya smṛtiḥ sakalapāparujāṃ vighātaṃ sadyaḥ karotyapi cu pulkasajanma bhājām || yasya svarūpamakhilaṃ śrutibhirvimṛgyaṃ tasmai śivāya satataṃ karavāma pūjām || 95 || yanmūrdhni labdhanilayā suralokasiṃdhuryasyāṃgagām̐ bhagavatī jagadaṃbikā ca || yatkuṃḍale tvahaha takṣakavāsukī dvau so'smākameva gatirardhaśaśāṃkamauliḥ || 96 || jayati nigamacūḍāgreṣu yasyāṃghripadmaṃ jayati ca hṛdi nityaṃ yogināṃ yasya mūrtiḥ || jayati sakalatattvodbhāsanaṃ yasya mūrtiḥ sa vijitaguṇasargaḥ pūjyate'smābhirīśaḥ || 97 || || sūta uvāca || || ityākarṇya vacastasya takṣakaḥ prītamānasaḥ || jātabhaktirmahādeve rājaputramabhāṣata || 98 || || takṣaka uvāca || || parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ stāttava rājedranaṃdana || bālopi yatparaṃ tattvaṃ vetsi śaivaṃ parātparam || 99 || eṣa ratnamayo loka etāścārudṛśo'balāḥ || ete kalpadrumāḥ sarve vāpyomṛtarasāṃbhasaḥ || 3.3.8.100 || nātra mṛtyubhayaṃ ghoraṃ na jarārogapīḍanam || yatheṣṭaṃ viharātraiva bhuṃkṣva bhogānyathocitān || 101 || ityukto nāgarājena sa rājeṃdrakumārakaḥ || pratyuvāca paraṃ prītyā kṛtāṃjalirudāradhīḥ || 102 || kṛtadāro'smyahaṃ kāle suvratā gṛhiṇī mama || śiva pūjāparā nityaṃ pitarāvekaputrakau || 103 || te tvadya māṃ mṛtaṃ mattvā śokena mahatāvṛtāḥ || prāyaḥ prāṇairviyujyaṃte daivātprāṇānvahaṃti vā || 104 || ato mayā bahutithaṃ nātra stheyaṃ kathaṃcana || tameva lokaṃ kṛpayā māṃ prāpayitumarhasi || 105 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ naradevaputraṃ divyairvarānnaiḥ surapādapotthaiḥ || āpyāyayitvā varagaṃdhavāsaḥ sragratnadivyābharaṇairvicitraiḥ || 106 || saṃtoṣayitvā vividhaiśca bhogaiḥ punarbabhāṣe bhujagādhirājaḥ || yadāyadā tvaṃ smarasi tvadagre tadā tadāviṣkriyate mayeti || 107 || punaśca rājaputrāya takṣakośvaṃ ca kāmagam || nānādvīpasamudreṣu lokeṣu ca nirargalam || 108 || dattavānratnābharaṇa divyābharaṇavāsasām || vāhanāya dadāvekaṃ rākṣasaṃ pannageśvaraḥ || 109 || tatsahāyārthamekaṃ ca pannageṃdrakumārakam || niyujya takṣakaḥ prītyā gaccheti visasarja tam || 3.3.8.110 || iti caṃdrāṃgadaḥ so'tha saṃgṛhya vividhaṃ dhanam || aśvaṃ kāmagamāruhya tābhyāṃ saha viniryayau ||111|| sa mūhūrtādivonmajjya tasmā deva sarijjalāt || vijahāra taṭe ramye divyamāruhya vājinam || 112 || athāsminsamaye tanvī sā ca sīmaṃtinī satī || snātuṃ samāyayau tatra sakhī bhiḥ parivāritā || 113 || sā dadarśa nadītīre viharaṃtaṃ nṛpātmajam || rakṣasā nararūpeṇa nāgaputreṇa cānvitam || 114 || divyaratnasamākīrṇaṃ divya mālyāvataṃsakam || dehena divyagaṃdhena vyākṣiptadaśayojanam || 115 || tamapūrvākṛtiṃ vīkṣya divyāśvamadhisaṃsthitam || jaḍonmatteva bhīteva tasthau tannyastalocanā || 116 || tāṃ ca rājeṃdraputro'sau dṛṣṭapūrvāmiti smaran || nirmuktakaṃṭhābharaṇāṃ kaṃṭhasūtravivarjitām || 117 || asaṃyojitadhammillāmaṃgarāgavivarjitām || tyaktanīlāṃjanāpāṃgīṃ kṛśāṃgīṃ śokadūṣitām || 118 || dṛṣṭvā'vatīrya turagādupaviṣṭaḥ sarittaṭe || tāmāhūya varārohāmupaveśyedama bravīt || 119 || kā tvaṃ kasya kalatraṃ vā kasyāsi tanayā satī || kimidaṃ teṃgane bālye duḥsahaṃ śokalakṣaṇam || 3.3.8.120 || iti snehena saṃpṛṣṭā sā vadhūraśrulocanā || lajjitā svayamākhyātuṃ tatsakhī sarvamabravīt || 121 || iyaṃ sīmaṃtinī nāmnā snuṣā niṣadhabhūpateḥ || caṃdrāṃgadasya mahiṣī tanayā citravarmaṇaḥ || 122 || asyāḥ patirdaivayogānnimagno'sminmahājale || teneyaṃ prāptavaidhavyā bālā duḥkhena śoṣitā || 123 || evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ nītaṃ śokenātibalīyasā || adyeṃduvāre saṃprāpte snātumatra samāgatā || 124 || śvaśuro'syāśca rājeṃdro hṛtarājyaśca śatru bhiḥ || balādgṛhīto baddhaśca sabhāryastadvaśe sthitaḥ || 125 || tathāpyeṣā śubhācārā somavāre maheśvaram || sāṃbikaṃ parayā bhaktyā pūjayatyamalāśayā || 126 || || sūta uvāca || || itthaṃ sakhīmukhenaiva sarvamāvedya suvratā || tataḥ sīmaṃtinī prāha svayameva nṛpātmajam || 127 || kastvaṃ kaṃdarpasaṃkāśaḥ kāvimau tava pārśvagau || devo nareṃdraḥ siddho vā gaṃdharvo vātha kinnaraḥ || 128 || kimarthaṃ mama vṛttāṃtaṃ snehavāniva pṛcchasi || kiṃ māṃ vetsi mahābāho dṛṣṭavānkimu kutracit || 129 || dṛṣṭapūrva ivābhāsi mayā ca svajano yathā || sarvaṃ kathaya tattvena satyasārā hi sādhavaḥ || 3.3.8.130 || || sūta uvāca || etāvaduktvā naradevaputrī sabāṣpakaṃṭhaṃ suciraṃ ruroda || mumoha bhūmau patitā sakhībhirvṛtā na kiṃcitkathituṃ śaśāka || 131 || śrutvā caṃdrāṃgadaḥ sarvaṃ priyāyāḥ śokakāraṇam || muhūrttamabhavatūṣṇīṃ svayaṃ śokasamākulaḥ || 132 || athāśvāsya priyāṃ tanvīṃ vividhairvākyanaipuṇaiḥ || siddhā nāma vayaṃ devāḥ kāmagā iti so'bravīt || 133 || tato balādivākṛṣya pāṇigrahaṇaśaṃkitām || pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgīṃ tāṃ karṇe tvidamabravīt || 134 || kvāpi loke mayā dṛṣṭastava bharttā varānane || tvadvratācaraṇātprītaḥ sadya evāgamiṣyati || || 135 || apaneṣyati te śokaṃ dvitraireva dinairdhruvam || etacchaṃsitumāyātastava bharttuḥ sakhā'smyaham || 136 || atra kāryo na saṃdehaḥ śapāmi śivapādayoḥ || tāvattvaddhṛdaye stheyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ ca kutracit || 137 || sā tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sudhādhārāśatādhikam || saṃbhramodbhrāṃtanayanā tameva muhuraikṣata || || 138 || premabaṃdhānuguṇitaṃ vākyaṃ cāha rasāyanam || vibhramodārasahitaṃ madhurāpāṃgavīkṣaṇam || 139 || svapāṇisparśanodbhinnapulakāṃcitavigraham|| pūrva dṛṣṭāni cāṃgeṣu lakṣaṇāni svarādiṣu || vayaḥpramāṇaṃ varṇaṃ ca parīkṣyainamatarkayat || 3.3.8.140 || eṣa eva patirme syāddhruvaṃ nānyo bhaviṣyati || asminneva prasaktaṃ me hṛdayaṃ premakātaram || 141 || paralokādihāyātaḥ kathamevaṃ svarūpadhṛk || durbhāgyāyāḥ kathaṃ me syādbharturnaṣṭasya darśanam || 142 || svapnoyaṃ kimu na svapno bhramo'yaṃ kiṃ tu na bhramaḥ || eṣa dhūrto'thavā kaścidyakṣo gaṃdharva eva vā || 143 || munipalyā yaduktaṃ me paramāpadgatāpi ca || vratametatkuruṣveti tasya vā phalameva vā||144|| yo varṣāyuta saubhāgyaṃ mametyāha dvijottamaḥ|| nūnaṃ tasya vacaḥ satyaṃ ko vidyādīśvaraṃ vinā||145|| nimittāni ca dṛśyaṃte maṃgalāni dinedine|| prasanne pārvatīnāthe kimasādhyaṃ śarīriṇām|| 146|| itthaṃ vimṛśya bahudhā tāṃ punarmuktasaṃśayām|| lajjānamramukhīṃ karṇe śaśaṃsātmaprayojanam || 147 || imaṃ vṛttāṃtamākhyātuṃ tatpitroḥ śokataptayoḥ || gacchāmaḥ svasti te bhadre sadyaḥ patimavāpsyasi || 148 || ityuktvāśvaṃ samāruhya jagāma nṛpanaṃdanaḥ || tābhyāṃ saha nijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pratyapadyata tatkṣaṇāt || 149 || sa puropavanābhyāśe sthitvā taṃ phaṇi putrakam || visasarjātmadāyādānnṛpāsanagatānprati ||3.3.8.150|| sa gatvovāca tāñchīghramiṃdraseno vimucyatām || caṃdrāṃgadastasya sutaḥ prāpto'yaṃ pannagāla yāt || 151 || nṛpāsanaṃ vimuṃcaṃtu bhavaṃto na vicāryatām || no ceccaṃdrāgadasyāśu bāṇāḥ prāṇānharaṃti vaḥ || 152 || sa magno yamunātoye gatvā takṣakamaṃdiram || labdhvā ca tasya sāhāyyaṃ punarlokādihāgataḥ || 153 || ityākhyātamaśeṣeṇa tadvṛttāṃtaṃ niśamya te || sādhusādhviti saṃbhrāṃtāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ paripaṃthinaḥ || 154 || atheṃdrasenāya nivedya satvaraṃ naṣṭasya putrasya punaḥ samāgamam || prasādya taṃ prāptanareśvarāsanaṃ dāyādamukhyāstu bhayaṃ prapedire || 155 || atha paurajanāḥ sarve purodyāne nṛpātmajam || dṛṣṭvā rājñe drutaṃ procurlebhire ca mahādhanam || 156 || ākarṇya putramāyāṃtaṃ rājānaṃdajalāplutaḥ || na vyajānādimaṃ lokaṃ rājñī ca parayā mudā || 157 || atha nāgarikāḥ sarve maṃtrivṛddhāḥ purodhasaḥ || pratyudgamya pariṣvajya tamāninyurnṛpāṃti kam || 158 || athotsavena mahatā praviśya nijamaṃdiram || rājaputraḥ svapitarau vavaṃde bāṣpamutsṛjan || 159 || taṃ pādamūle patitaṃ svaputraṃ viveda nāsau pṛthivīpatiḥ kṣaṇam || prabodhito'mātyajanaiḥ kathaṃcidutthāya klinnena hṛdāliliṃga || 3.3.8.160 || krameṇa mātṝrabhivaṃdya tābhiḥ pravardhitāśīḥ praṇayāku lābhiḥ || āliṃgitaḥ paurajanānaśeṣānsaṃbhāvayāmāsa sa rājasūnuḥ ||161|| teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ svavṛttāṃtamaśeṣataḥ || pitre nivedayāmāsa takṣakasya ca mitratām||162|| dattaṃ bhujaṃgarājena ratnādidhanasaṃcayam || divyaṃ tadrākṣasānītaṃ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat ||163|| rājaputrasya caritaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca vihvalaḥ || | mene snuṣāyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ maheśārādhanārjitam ||164|| saumāṃgalyamayīṃ vārtāmimāṃ niṣadhabhūpatiḥ|| cārairnivedayāmāsa citravarmamahīpateḥ ||165|| śrutvā'mṛtamayīṃ vārttāṃ sa samutthāya saṃbhramāt || tebhyo dattvā dhanaṃ bhūri nanartānaṃdavihvalaḥ||166|| athāhūya svatanayāṃ pariṣvajyāśrulocanaḥ || bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayāmāsa tyaktavaidhavyalakṣaṇām || 167 || athotsavo mahānāsīdrāṣṭragrāmapurādiṣu || sīmaṃtinyāḥ śubhācāraṃ śaśaṃsuḥ sarvato janāḥ || 168 || citravarmātha nṛpatiḥ samāhūyeṃdrasenajam || punarvivāhavidhinā sutāṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 169 || candrāṃgado'pi ratnādyairānītaistakṣakālayāt || svāṃ patnīṃ bhūṣayāṃ cakre martyānāmatidurlabhaiḥ || 3.3.8.170 || aṃgarāgeṇa divyena taptakāṃcanaśobhinā || śuśubhe sā sugaṃdhena daśayojanagāminā || 171 || amlānamālayā śaśvatpadmakiṃjalkavarṇayā || kalpadrumotthayā bālā bhūṣitā śuśubhe satī || 172 || evaṃ caṃdrāṃgadaḥ patnīmavāpya samaye śubhe || yayau svanagarīṃ bhūyaḥ śvaśureṇānumoditaḥ || 173 || indraseno'pi rājeṃdro rājye sthāpya nijātmajam || tapasā śivamārādhya lebhe saṃyamināṃ gatim || 174 || daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi sīmaṃtinyā svabhāryayā || sārdhaṃ candrāṃgado rājā bubhuje viṣayānbahūn || 175 || prāsūta tanayānaṣṭau kanyāmekāṃ varānanām || reme sīmaṃtinī bhartrā pūjayatī maheśvaram || dinedine ca saubhāgyaṃ prāptaṃ caivenduvāsarāt || 176 || || sūta uvāca || || vicitramidamākhyānaṃ mayā samanuvarṇitam || bhūyo'pi vakṣye māhātmyaṃ somavāravratoditam || 177 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brahmottarakhaṇḍe somavāravratavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || cha ||
<3.3.9>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sādhusādhu mahābhāga tvayā kathitamuttamam || ākhyānaṃ punaranyatra vicitraṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 || || sūta uvāca || || vidarbhaviṣaye pūrvamāsīdeko dvijottamaḥ || vedamitra iti khyāto veda śāstrārthavitsudhīḥ || 2 || tasyāsīdaparo vipraḥ sakhā sārasvatāhvayaḥ || tāvubhau paramasnigdhāvekadeśanivāsinau || 3 || vedamitrasya putro'bhūtsumedhā nāma suvrataḥ || sārasvatasya tanayaḥ somavāniti viśrutaḥ || 4 || ubhau savayasau bālau samaveṣau samasthitī || samaṃ ca kṛtasaṃskārau sama vidyau babhūvatuḥ || 5 || sāṃgānadhītya tau vedāṃstarkavyākaraṇāni ca || itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ || 6 || sarvavidyākuśalinau bālya eva manīṣiṇau || praharṣamatulaṃ pitrordadatuḥ sakalairguṇaiḥ || 7 || tāvekadā svatanayau tāvubhau brāhmaṇottamau || āhūyāvocatāṃ prītyā ṣoḍa śābdau śubhākṛtī || 8 || he putrakau yuvāṃ bālye kṛtavidyau suvarcasau || vaivāhikoyaṃ samayo vartate yuvayoḥ samam || 9 || imaṃ prasādya rājānaṃ vidarbheśaṃ svavidyayā || tataḥ prāpya dhanaṃ bhūri kṛtodvāhau bhaviṣyathaḥ || 3.3.9.10 || evamuktau sutau tābhyāṃ tāvubhau dvijanaṃdanau || vidarbharājamāsādya samatoṣayatāṃ guṇaiḥ || 11 || vidyayā parituṣṭāya tasmai dvijakumārakau || vivāhārthaṃ kṛtodyogau dhanahīnāvaśaṃsatām || 12 || tayorapi mataṃ jñātvā sa vidarbhamahīpatiḥ || prahasya kiṃcitprovāca lokatattvavivitsayā || 13 || āste niṣadharājasya rājñī sīmaṃtinī satī || somavāre mahādevaṃ pūjayatyaṃbikāyutam||14|| tasmindine sapatnīkāndvijāgryānvedavittamān|| saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā dhanaṃ bhūri dadāti ca||15|| ato'tra yuvayoraiko nārīvibhramaveṣadhṛk|| ekastasyā patirbhūtvā jāyetāṃ vipradaṃpatī||16|| yuvāṃ vadhūvarau bhūtvā prāpya sīmaṃtinīgṛham|| bhuktvā bhūri dhanaṃ labdhvā punaryātaṃ mamāṃmatikam || 17 || iti rājñā samādiṣṭau bhītau dvijakumārakau || pratyūcaturidaṃ karma kartuṃ nau jāyate bhayam || 18 || devatāsu gurau pitrostathā rājakuleṣu ca || kauṭilyamācaranmohātsadyo naśyati sānvayaḥ || 19 || kathamaṃtargṛhaṃ rājñāṃ chadmanā praviśetpumān || gopyamānamapicchadma kadācitkhyātimeṣyati || 3.3.9.20 || ye guṇāḥ sādhitāḥ pūrvaṃ śīlācāraśrutādibhiḥ || sadyaste nāśamāyāṃti kauṭilya pathagāminaḥ || 21 || pāpaṃ niṃdā bhayaṃ vairaṃ catvāryetāni dehinām || chadmamārgaprapannānāṃ tiṣṭhaṃtyeva hi sarvadā || 22 || ata āvāṃ śubhācārau jātau ca śucināṃ kule || vṛttaṃ dhūrtajanaślāghyaṃ nāśrayāvaḥ kadācana || 23 || || rājovāca || || daivatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca pitrośca pṛthivīpateḥ || śāsanasyāpyalaṃghyatvātpratyādeśo na karhicit || 24 || etairyadyatsamādiṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || kartavyaṃ niyataṃ bhītairapramattairbubhūṣubhiḥ || || 25 || aho vayaṃ hi rājānaḥ prajā yūyaṃ hi saṃmatāḥ || rājājñayā pravṛttānāṃ śreyaḥ syādanyathā bhayam || 26 || ato macchāsanaṃ kāryaṃ bhava dbhyāmavilaṃbitam || ityuktau naradevena tau tathetyūcaturbhayāt || 27 || sārasvatasya tanayaṃ sāmavantaṃ narādhipaḥ || strīrūpadhāriṇaṃ cakre vastrākalpāṃ janādibhiḥ || 28 || sa kṛtrimodbhūtakalatrabhāvaḥ prayuktakarṇābharaṇāṃgarāgaḥ || snigdhāñjanākṣaḥ spṛhaṇīyarūpo babhūva sadyaḥ pramadottamābhaḥ || 29 || tāvubhau daṃpatī bhūtvā dvijaputrau nṛpājñayā || jagmaturnaiṣadhaṃ deśaṃ yadvā tadvā bhavatviti || 3.3.9.30 || upetya rājasadanaṃ somavāre dvijottamaiḥ || sapatnīkaiḥ kṛtātithyau dhautapādau babhūvatuḥ || 31 || sā rājñī brāhmaṇānsarvānupaviṣṭānvarāsane || pratyekamarcayāṃcakre sapatnīkāndvijottamān|| 32 || tau ca viprasutau dṛṣṭvā prāptau kṛtakadaṃpatī || jñātvā kiṃcidvihasyātha mene gaurīmaheśvarau || 33 || āvāhya dvijamukhyeṣu devadevaṃ sadāśivam || patnīṣvāvāhayāmāsa sā devīṃ jagadaṃbikām || 34 || gandhairmālyaiḥ surabhibhirdhūpairnīrājanairapi || arcayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānnamaścakre samāhitā || 35 || hiraṇmayeṣu pātreṣu pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam || śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaṃ śākairjuṣṭaṃ manoramaiḥ || 36 || gaṃdhaśālyodanairhṛdyairmodakāpūparāśibhiḥ || śaṣkrulībhiśca saṃyāvaiḥ kṛsarairmāṣapakvakaiḥ || 37 || tathānyairapyasaṃkhyātairbhakṣyairbhojyairmanoramaiḥ || sugandhaiḥ svādubhiḥ sūpaiḥ pānīyairapi śītalaiḥ || 38 || klṛptamannaṃ dvijāgryebhyaḥ sā bhaktyā paryaveṣayat || dadhyodanaṃ nirupamaṃ nivedya samatoṣayat || 39 || bhuktavatsu dvijāgryeṣu svācāṃteṣu nṛpāṃganā || praṇamya dattvā tāṃbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathārhataḥ || 3.3.9.40 || dhenūrhiraṇyavāsāṃsi ratnasragbhūṣaṇāni ca || dattvā bhūyo namaskṛtya visasarja dvijottamān || 41 || tayordvayorbhūsuravaryaputrayorekasttayā haimavatīdhiyārcitaḥ || eko mahādevadhiyābhipūjitaḥ kṛtapraṇāmau yayatustadājñayā || 42 || sā tu vismṛtapuṃbhāvā tasminneva dvijottame || jātaspṛhā madotsiktā kandarpavivaśābravīt || 43 || aṃyi nātha viśālākṣa sarvāvayavasundara || tiṣṭhatiṣṭha kva vā yāsi māṃ na paśyasi te priyām || 44 || idamagre vanaṃ ramyaṃ supuṣpitamahādrumam || asminvihartumicchāmi tvayā saha yathāsukham || 45 || itthaṃ tayoktamākarṇya puro'gacchaddvijātmajaḥ || viciṃtya parihāsoktiṃ gacchati sma yathā purā || 46 || punarapyāha sā bālā tiṣṭhatiṣṭha kva yāsyasi|| durutsahasmarāveśāṃ paribhoktumupetya mām || 47 || pariṣvajasva māṃ kāṃtāṃ pāyayasva tavādharam || nāhaṃ gaṃtuṃ samarthāsmi smarabāṇaprapīḍitā || || 48 || itthamaśrutapūrvāṃ tāṃ niśamya pariśaṃkitaḥ || āyāṃtīṃ pṛṣṭhato vīkṣya sahasā vismayaṃ gataḥ ||49|| kaiṣā padmapalāśākṣī pīnonnatapayodharā || kṛśodarī bṛhacchroṇī navapallavakomalā || 3.3.9.50 || sa eva me sakhā kinnu jāta eva varāṃganā || pṛcchāmyenamataḥ sarvamiti saṃcintya so'bravīt ||51|| kimapūrva ivābhāṣi sakhe rūpaguṇādibhiḥ ||
