apūrvaṃ bhāṣase vākyaṃ kāminīva samākulā || 52 || yastvaṃ vedapurāṇajño brahmacārī jiteṃdriyaḥ || sārasvatātmajaḥ śāṃtaḥ kathamevaṃ prabhāṣase || 53 || ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha nāhamasmi pumānprabho || nāmnā sāmavatī bālā tavāsmi ratidāyinī|| 54 || yadi te saṃśayaḥ kāṃta mamāṃgāni vilokaya || ityuktaḥ sahasā mārge rahasyenāṃ vyalokayat ||55|| tāmakṛtrimadhammillāṃ javanastanaśobhinīm || surūpāṃ vīkṣya kāmena kiṃcidvyākulatāmagāt || 56 || punaḥ saṃstabhya yatnena cetaso vikṛtiṃ budhaḥ || muhūrtaṃ vismayāviṣṭo na kiṃcitpratyabhāṣata || 57 || || sāmavatyuvāca || || gataste saṃśayaḥ kaścittarhyāgaccha bhajasva mām || paśyedaṃ vipinaṃ kāṃta parastrīsuratocitam || 58 || || sumedhā uvāca || || maivaṃ kathaya maryādāṃ mā hiṃsīrmadamattavat || āvāṃ vijñātaśāstrārthau tvamevaṃ bhāṣase katham ||59|| adhītasya ca śāstrasya vivekasya kulasya ca || kimeṣa sadṛśo dharmo jāradharmaniṣevaṇam || 3.3.9.60 || na tvaṃ strī puruṣo vidvāñjānīhyātmānamātmanā || ayaṃ svayaṃkṛto'nartha āvābhyāṃ yadviceṣṭitam || 61 || vaṃcayitvātmapitarau dhūrttarājānuśāsanāt || kṛtvā cānucitaṃ karma tasyaitadbhujyate phalam || 62 || sarvaṃ tvanucitaṃ karma nṛṇāṃ śreyovināśanam || yastvaṃ viprātmajo vidvāngataḥ strītvaṃ vigarhitam || 63 || mārgaṃ tyaktvā gato'raṇyaṃ naro vidhyeta kaṇṭakaiḥ || balārddhisyeta vā hiṃsrairyadā tyaktasamā gamaḥ || 64 || evaṃ vivekamāśritya tūṣṇīmehi svayaṃ gṛham || devadvijaprasādena strītvaṃ tava vilīyate || 65 || athavā daivayogena strītvameva bhavettava || pitrā dattā mayā sākaṃ raṃsyase varavarṇini || 66 || aho citramaho duḥkhamaho pāpabalaṃ mahat || aho rājñaḥ prabhāvoyaṃ śivārādhanasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 67 || ityuktāpyasakṛttena sā vadhūrativihvalā || balena taṃ samāliṃgya cucuṃbādharapallavam || 68 || dharṣitopi tayā dhīraḥ sumedhā nūtanastriyam || yatnādānīya sadanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tatra nyavedayat || 69 || tadākarṇyātha tau viprau kupitau śokavihvalau || tābhyāṃ saha kumārābhyāṃ vaidarbhāṃtikamīyatuḥ || 3.3.9.70 || tataḥ sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ dhūrtaceṣṭitam || rājanmamātmajaṃ paśya tava śāsanayaṃtritam || 71 || etau tavājñāvaśagau cakratuḥ karma garhitam || matputrastatphalaṃ bhuṃkte strītvaṃ prāpya jugupsitam|| 72 || adya me saṃtatirnaṣṭā nirāśāḥ pitaro mama || nāputrasya hi lokosti luptapiṃḍādisaṃskṛteḥ || 73 || śikhopavītamajinaṃ maujīṃ daṃḍaṃ kamaṃḍalum || brahmacaryocitaṃ cihnaṃ vihāyemāṃ daśāṃ gataḥ || 74 || brahmasūtraṃ ca sāvitrīṃ snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ japārcanam || visṛjya strītvamāptosya kā gatirvada pārthiva || 75 || tvayā me saṃtatirnaṣṭā naṣṭo vedapathaśca me || ekātmajasya me rājankā gatirvada śāśvatī || 76 || iti sārasvatenoktaṃ vākyamākarṇya bhūpatiḥ || sīmaṃtinyāḥ prabhāveṇa vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 77 || atha sarvānsamāhūya maharṣīnamitadyutīn|| prasādya prārthayāmāsa tasya puṃstvaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 78 || te'buvannatha pārvatyāḥ śivasya ca samīhitam || tadbhaktānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ konyathā kartumīśvaraḥ || 79 || atha rājā bharadvājamādāya munipuṃgavam || tābhyāṃ saha dvijāgryābhyāṃ tatsutābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ || 3.3.9.80 || aṃbikābhavanaṃ prāpya bharadvājopadeśataḥ || tāṃ devīṃ niyamaistīvrairupāste sma mahāniśi || 81 || evaṃ trirātraṃ suvisṛṣṭabhojanaḥ sa pārvatīdhyāna rato mahīpatiḥ || samyakpraṇāmairvividhaiśca saṃstavairgaurīṃ prapannārtiharāmatoṣayat || 82 || tataḥ prasannā sā devī bhaktasya pṛthivīpateḥ || svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa caṃdrakoṭisamaprabham || 83 || athāha gaurī rājānaṃ kiṃ te brūhi samīhitam || so'pyāha puṃstvametasya kṛpayā dīyatāmiti || 84 || bhūyopyāha mahādevī madbhaktaiḥ karma yatkṛtam || śakyate nānyathā kartuṃ varṣāyutaśatairapi || 85 || || rājovāca || || ekātmajo hi viproyaṃ karmaṇā naṣṭasaṃtatiḥ || kathaṃ sukhaṃ prapadyeta vinā putreṇa tādṛśaḥ || 86 || || devyuvāca || || tasyānyo matprasādena bhaviṣyati sutottamaḥ || vidyā vinayasaṃpanno dīrghāyuramalāśayaḥ || 87 || eṣā sāmavatī nāma sutā tasya dvijanmanaḥ || bhūtvā sumedhasaḥ patnī kāmabhogena yujyatām || 88 || ityuktvāṃtarhitā devī te ca rājapurogamāḥ || gatāḥ svaṃsvaṃ gṛhaṃ sarve cakrustacchāsane sthitim || 89 || sopi sārasvato vipraḥ putraṃ pūrvasuto ttamam || lebhe devyāḥ prasādena hyacirādeva kālataḥ || 3.3.9.90 || tāṃ ca sāmavatīṃ kanyāṃ dadau tasmai sumedhase || tau daṃpatī ciraṃ kālaṃ bubhujāte paraṃ sukham || 91 || || sūta uvāca || || ityeṣa śivabhaktāyāḥ sīmaṃtinyā nṛpastriyāḥ || prabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ śaṃbhormāhātmyamapi varṇitam || 92 || bhūyopi śivabhaktānāṃ prabhāvaṃ vismayāvaham || samāsādvarṇayiṣyāmi śrotṝṇāṃ maṃgalāyanam || 93 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe sīmaṃtinyāḥ prabhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || cha ||
<3.3.10>
|| sūta uvāca || || vicitraṃ śivanirmāṇaṃ vicitra śivaceṣṭitam || vicitraṃ śivamāhātmyaṃ vicitraṃ śivabhāṣitam || 1 || vicitraṃ śivabhaktānāṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam || svargāpavargayoḥ satyaṃ sādhanaṃ tadbravīmyaham || 2 || avaṃtīviṣaye kaścidbrāhmaṇo maṃdarāhvayaḥ || babhūva viṣayārāmaḥ strījito dhanasaṃgrahī || 3 || saṃdhyāsnāparityakto gaṃdhamālyāṃbarapriyaḥ || kustrīsaktaḥ kumārgastho yathā pūrvamajāmilaḥ || 4 || sa veśyāṃ piṃgalāṃ nāma ramamāṇo divāniśam || tasyā eva gṛhe nityamāsīdavijiteṃdriyaḥ || 5 || kadācitsadane tasyāstasminnivasati dvije || ṛṣabho nāma dharmātmā śivayogī samāyayau || || 6 || tamāgatamabhiprekṣya matvā svaṃ puṇyamūrjitam || sā veśyā sa ca vipraśca paryapūjayatāmubhau || 7 || tamāropya mahāpīṭhe kaṃbalāṃbarasaṃbhṛte || prakṣālya caraṇau bhaktyā tajjalaṃ dadhatuḥ śiraḥ || 8 || svāgatārghyanamaskārairgaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || upacāraiḥ samabhyarcya bhojayāmāsaturmudā || 9 || taṃ bhuktavaṃtamācāṃtaṃ paryaṃke sukhasaṃstare || upaveśya mudā yuktau tāṃbūlaṃ pratyayacchatām || 3.3.10.10 || pādasaṃvāhanaṃ bhaktyā kurvaṃtau daivaco ditau || kalpayitvā tu śuśrūṣāṃ prīṇayāmāsatuściram || 11 || evaṃ samarcitastābhyāṃ śivayogī mahādyutiḥ || ativāhya niśāmekāṃ yayau prātastadādṛtaḥ || 12 || evaṃ kāle gataprāye sa vipro nidhanaṃ gataḥ || sā ca veśyā mṛtā kāle yayau karmārjitāṃ gatim || 13 || sa vipraḥ karmaṇā nīto daśārṇadharaṇīpateḥ || vajrabāhukuṭuṃbinyāḥ sumatyā garbhamāsthitaḥ || 14 || tāṃ jyeṣṭhapatnīṃ nṛpatergarbhasaṃpadamāśritām || avekṣya tasyai garalaṃ sapatnyaśchadmanā daduḥ || 15 || sā bhuktvā garalaṃ ghoraṃ na mṛtā daivayogataḥ || kleśameva paraṃ prāpa maraṇādatiduḥsaham || 16 || atha kāle samāyāte putrame kamajījanat || kleśena mahatā sādhvī pīḍitā varavarṇinī || 17 || sa nirdaśo rājaputraḥ spṛṣṭapūrvo gareṇa yat || tenāvāpa mahākleśaṃ kraṃdamāno divāniśam || 18 || tasya bālasya mātā ca sarvāṃgavraṇapīḍitā || babhūvaturatikliṣṭau garayogaprabhāvataḥ || 19 || tau rājñā ca samānītau vaidyaiśca kṛtabheṣajau || na svāsthyamāpaturyatnairanekairyojitairapi || 3.3.10.20 || na rātrau labhate nidrāṃ sā rājñī vipulavyathā || svaputrasya ca duḥkhena duḥkhitā nitarāṃ kṛśā || 21 || nītvaivaṃ katicinmāsānsa rājā mātṛputrakau || jīvaṃtau ca mṛtaprāyau vilokyātmanyaciṃtayat || 22 || etau me gṛhiṇīputrau nirayādāgatāviha || aśrāṃtarogau kraṃdaṃtau nidrābhaṃgavidhāyinau || 23 || atropāyaṃ kariṣyāmi pāpayordhruvametayoḥ || martuṃ vā jīvituṃ vāpi na kṣamau pāpabhoginau || 24 || itthaṃ viniścitya ca bhūmipālaḥ saktaḥ sapatnīṣu tadātmajeṣu || āhūya sūtaṃ nijadāraputrau nirvāpayāmāsa rathena dūram|| 25 || tau sūtena parityaktau kutracidvijane vane || avāpatuḥ parāṃ pīḍāṃ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ bhṛśavihvalau || 26 || sodvahaṃtī nijaṃ bālaṃ nipataṃtī pade pade || niḥśvasaṃtī nijaṃ karma niṃdaṃtī cakitā bhṛśam || 27 || kvacitkaṃṭakabhinnāṃgī muktakeśī bhayāturā || kvacidvyāghrasvanairbhītā kvacidvyālairanudrutā || 28 || bhartsyamānā piśācaiśca vetālairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ || mahāgulmeṣu dhāvaṃtī bhinnapādā kṣurāśmabhiḥ || 29 || saivaṃ ghore mahāraṇye bhramaṃtī nṛpage hinī || daivātprāptā vaṇiṅmārgaṃ govājinarasevitam || 3.3.10.30 || gacchaṃtī tena mārgeṇa sudūramatiyatnataḥ || dadarśa vaiśyanagaraṃ vahustrīnarasevitam || 31 || tasya goptā mahāvaiśyo nagarasya mahājanaḥ || asti padmākaro nāma rājarāja ivāparaḥ || 32 || tasya vaiśyapateḥ kācidgṛhadāsī nṛpāṃganām || āyāṃtī dūrato dṛṣṭvā tadaṃtikamupāyayau ||33 || sā dāsī nṛpateḥ kāṃtāṃ saputrāṃ bhṛśapīḍitām || svayaṃ viditavṛttāṃtā svāmine pratyadarśayat || || 34 || sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā viśāṃ nātho rujārttāṃ kliṣṭaputrakām || nītvā rahasi suvyaktaṃ tadvṛttāṃtamapṛcchata || 35 || tayā niveditāśeṣavṛttāṃtaḥ sa vaṇikpatiḥ || ahokaṣṭamiti jñātvā niśaśvāsa muhurmuhuḥ || 36 || tāmaṃtike svagehasya saṃniveśya rahogṛhe || vāsonnapānaśayanairmātṛsāmyamapūjayat || || 37 || tasmingṛhe nṛpavadhūrnivasaṃtī surakṣitā || vraṇayakṣmādirogāṇāṃ na śāṃtiṃ pratyapadyata || 38 || tato dinaiḥ katipayaiḥ sa bālo vraṇapīḍitaḥ || vilaṃghitabhiṣaksattvo mamāra ca vidhervaśāt || 39 || mṛte svatanaye rājñī śokena mahatāvṛtā || mūrcchitā cāpatadbhūmau gajabhagneva vallarī || 3.3.10.40 || daivātsaṃjñāmavāpyātha vāṣpaklinnapayodharā || sāṃtvitā'pi vaṇikstrībhirvilalāpa suduḥkhitā || 41 || hā tātatāta hā putra hā mama prāṇarakṣaka || hā rājakulapūrṇendo hā mamānaṃdavardhana || 42 || imāmanāthāṃ kṛpaṇāṃ tvatprāṇāṃ tyaktavabāṃdhavām || mātaraṃ te parityajya kva yāto'si nṛpātmaja || || 43 || ityebhiruditairvākyaiḥ śokaciṃtāvivardhakaiḥ || vilapaṃtīṃ mṛtāpatyāṃ ko nu sāṃtvayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 44 || etasminsamaye tasyā duḥkhaśokacikitsakaḥ|| ṛṣabhaḥ pūrvamākhyātaḥ śivayogī samāyayau||45|| sa yogī vaiśyanāthena sārghahastena pūjitaḥ|| tasyāḥ sakāśamagamacchocantyā idamabravīt || 46 || || ṛṣabha uvāca || || akasmātkimaho vatse roravīṣi vimūḍhadhīḥ || ko jātaḥ katamo loke ko mṛto vada sāṃpratam || || 47 || amī dehādayo bhāvāstoyaphenasadharmakāḥ || kvacidbhrāṃtiḥ kvacicchāṃtiḥ sthitirbhavati vā punaḥ || 48 || ato'sminphenasadṛśe dehe pañcatvamāgate || śokasyānavakāśatvānna śocaṃti vipaścitaḥ || 49 || guṇairbhūtāni sṛjyaṃte bhrāmyaṃte nijakarmabhiḥ || kālenātha vikṛṣyaṃte vāsanāyāṃ ca śerate || 3.3.10.50 || māyayotpattimāyāṃti guṇāḥ sattvādayastrayaḥ || taireva dehā jāyaṃte jātāstallakṣaṇāśrayāḥ || 51 || devatvaṃ yāni sattvena rajasā ca manuṣyatām || tiryaktvaṃ tamasā jaṃturvāsanānugatovaśaḥ || 52 || saṃsāre vartamānesmiñjaṃtuḥ karmānubandhanāt || durvibhāvyāṃ gatiṃ yāti sukhaduḥkhamayīṃ muhuḥ || 53 || api kalpāyuṣāṃ teṣāṃ devānāṃ tu viparyayaḥ || anekāmayabaddhānāṃ kā kathā naradehinām || 54 || kecidvadaṃti dehasya kālameva hi kāraṇam || karma kecidguṇānkeciddehaḥ sādhāraṇo hyayam || 55 || kālakarmaguṇādhānaṃ pañcātmakamidaṃ vapuḥ || jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā na hṛṣyaṃti na śocaṃti mṛtaṃ budhāḥ || 56 || avyakte jāyate jaṃturavyakte ca pralīyate || madhye vyaktavadābhāti jalabudbudasannibhaḥ || 57 || yadā garbhagato dehī vināśaḥ kalpitastadā || daivājjīvati vā jāto mriyate sahasaiva vā || 58 || garbhasthā eva naśyaṃti jātamātrāstathā pare || kvacidyuvāno naśyaṃti mriyaṃte kepi vārdhake || 59 || yādṛśaṃ prāktanaṃ karma tādṛśaṃ viṃdate vapuḥ || bhuṃkte tadanurūpāṇi sukhaduḥkhāni vai hyasau || 3.3.10.60 || māyānubhāveritayoḥ pitroḥ suratasaṃbhramāt || deha utpadyate kopi puṃyoṣitklībalakṣaṇaḥ || 61 || āyuḥ sukhaṃ ca duḥkha ca puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ śrutaṃ dhanam || lalāṭe likhitaṃ dhātrā vahañjaṃtuḥ prajāyate || 62 || karmaṇāmavilaṃghyatvātkālasyāpyanatikramāt || anityatvācca bhāvānāṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi || 63 || kva svapne niyataṃ sthairyamiṃdrajāle kva satyatā || kva nityatā śaranmeghe kva śaśvattvaṃ kalevare || 64 || tava janmānyatītāni śatakoṭyayutāni ca || ajānaṃtyāḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ saṃprāpto'yaṃ mahāśramaḥ|| 65 || kasyakasyāsi tanayā jananī kasyakasya vā || kasyakasyāsi gṛhiṇī bhavakoṭiṣu varttinī || || 66 || pañcabhūtātmako dehastvagasṛṅmāṃsabandhanaḥ || medomajjāsthinicito viṇmūtraśleṣmabhājanam || 67 || śarīrāṃtaramapyetannijadehodbhavaṃ malam || mattvā svatanayaṃ mūḍhe mā śokaṃ kartumarhasi || 68 || yadi nāma janaḥ kaścinmṛtyuṃ tarati yatnataḥ || kathaṃ tarhi vipadyeransarve pūrve vipaścitaḥ|| || 69 || tapasā vidyayā buddhyā mantrauṣadhirasāyanaiḥ || atiyāti paraṃ mṛtyuṃ na kaścidapi paṃḍitaḥ || 3.3.10.70 || ekasyādya mṛtirjaṃtoḥ śvaścānyasya varānane || tasmādanityāvayave na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi || 71 || nityaṃ sannihito mṛtyuḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ vada dehinām || vyāghre puraḥ sthite grāsaḥ paśūnāṃ kiṃ nu rocate || 72 || ato janmajarāṃ jetuṃ yadīcchasi varānane || śaraṇaṃ vraja sarveśaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamumāpatim || 73 || tāvanmṛtyubhayaṃ ghoraṃ tāvajjanmajarābhayam || yāvanno yāti śaraṇaṃ dehī śivapadāṃbujam || 74 || anubhūyeha duḥkhāni saṃsāre bhṛśadāruṇe || mano yadā viyujyeta tadā dhyeyo maheśvaraḥ || 75 || manasā pibataḥ puṃsaḥ śivadhyānarasāmṛtam || bhūyastṛṣṇā na jāyeta saṃsāraviṣayāsave || 76 || vimuktaṃ sarvasaṃgaiśca mano vairāgyayaṃtritam || yadā śivapade magnaṃ tadā nāsti punarbhavaḥ || 77 || tasmādidaṃ mano bhadre śivadhyānaikasādhanam || śokamohasamāviṣṭaṃ mā kuruṣva śivaṃ bhaja || 78 || || sūta uvāca || || itthaṃ sānunayaṃ rājñī bodhitā śivayoginā || pratyācaṣṭa gurostasya praṇamya caraṇāṃ bujam || 79 || || rājñyuvāca || || bhagavanmṛtaputrāyāstyaktāyāḥ priyabandhubhiḥ || mahārogāturāyā me kā gatirmaraṇaṃ vinā || 3.3.10.80 || ato'haṃ martumicchāmi sahaiva śiśunā'munā || kṛtārthāhaṃ yadadya tvāmapaśyaṃ maraṇonmukhī || 81 || || sūta uvāca || || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā śivayogī dayānidhiḥ || pūrvopakāraṃ saṃsmṛtya mṛtasyāṃtikamāyayau || 82 || sa tadā bhasma saṃgṛhya śivamantrābhimaṃtritam || vidīrṇe tanmukhe kṣiptvā mṛtaṃ prāṇairayojayat || 83 || sa bālaḥ saṃgataḥ prāṇaiḥ śanairunmīlya locane || prāptapūrvendriyabalo ruroda stanyakāṃkṣayā || 84 || mṛtasya punarutthānaṃ vīkṣya bālasya vismitāḥ || janā mumudire sarve nagareṣu purogamāḥ ||85|| athānaṃdabharā rājñī vihvalonmattalocanā || jagrāha tanayaṃ śīghraṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā ||86|| upaguhya tadā tanvī paramānaṃdanirvṛtā || na vedātmānamanyaṃ vā suṣupteva pariśramāt || 87 || punaśca ṛṣabho yogī tayormātṛkumārayoḥ || viṣavraṇayutaṃ dehaṃ bhasmanaiva parāmṛśat || 88 || tau ca tadbhasmanā spṛṣṭau prāptadivyakalevarau || devānāṃ sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ dadhatuḥ kāṃtibhūṣitam|| 89 || saṃprāpte tridivaiśvarye yatsukhaṃ puṇyakarmaṇām || tasmācchataguṇaṃ prāpa sā rājñī sukhamuttamam || 3.3.10.90 || tāṃ pādayornipatitāmṛṣabhaḥ premavihvalaḥ || utthāpyāśvāsayāmāsa duḥkhairmuktāmuvāca ha || 91 || ayi vatse mahārājñi jīvatvaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || yāvajjīvasi lokesminna tāvatprāpsyase jarām || 92 || eṣa te tanayaḥ sādhvi bhadrāyuriti nāmataḥ || khyātiṃ yāsyati lokeṣu nijaṃ rājyamavāpsyati || || 93 || asya vaiśyasya sadane tāvattiṣṭha śucismite || yāvadeṣa kumāraste prāptavidyo bhaviṣyati || 94 || sūta uvāca|| || || iti tāmṛṣabho yogī taṃ ca rājakumārakam || saṃjīvya bhasmavīryeṇa yayau deśānyathepsitān|| 95 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe bhadrāyvākhyāne ṛṣabhayoginā bhadrāyujīvanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 10 || || cha ||
<3.3.11>
|| sūta uvāca || || piṃgalā nāma yā veśyā mayā pūrvamudāhṛtā || śivabhaktārcanātpuṇyāttyaktvā pūrvakalevaram || 1 || candrāṃgadasya sā bhūyaḥ sīmaṃtinyāmajāyata || rūpaudāryaguṇopetā nāmnā vai kīrtimālinī || 2 || bhadrāyurapi tatraiva rājaputro vaṇikpateḥ || vavṛdhe sadane bhānuḥ śucāviva mahātapāḥ || 3 || tasyāpi vaiśyanāthasya kumārastveka uttamaḥ || sa nāmnā sunayaḥ prokto rājasūnoḥ sakhā'bhavat || 4 || tāvubhau paramasnigdhau rājavaiśyakumārakau|| citrakrīḍāvudārāṃgau ratnābharaṇamaṃḍitau || 5 || tasya rājakumārasya brāhmaṇaiḥ sa vaṇikpatiḥ || saṃskārānkārayāmāsa svaputrasyāpi vistarāt || 6 || kāle kṛtopanayanau guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratau || cakratuḥ sarvavidyānāṃ saṃgrahaṃ vinayānvitau || 7 || atha rājakumārasya prāpte ṣoḍaśahāyane || sa eva ṛṣabho yogī tasya veśmanyupāyayau || 8 || sā rājñī sa kumāraśca śivayoginamāgatam || muhurmuhuḥ praṇamyobhau pūjayāmāsaturmudā || 9 || tābhyāṃ ca pūjitaḥ so'tha yogīśo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || taṃ rājaputramuddiśya babhāṣe karuṇārdradhīḥ || 3.3.11.10 || || śivayogyuvāca || || kaccitte kuśalaṃ tāta tvanmātuścāpyanāmayam || kaccittvaṃ sarvavidyānāmakārṣīśca pratigraham || 11 || kaccidgurūṇāṃ satataṃ śuśrūṣātatparo bhavān || kaccitsmarasi māṃ tāta tava prāṇapradaṃ gurum || 12 || evaṃ vadati yogīśe rājñī sā vinayānvitā || svaputraṃ pādayostasya nipātyainamabhāṣata || 13 || eṣa putrastava guro tvamasya prāṇadaḥ pitā || eṣa śiṣyastu saṃgrāhyo bhavatā karuṇātmanā || 14 || ato bandhubhirutsṛṣṭamanāthaṃ paripālaya || asmai samyaksatāṃ mārgamupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi || 15 || iti prasādito rājñyā śivayogī mahāmatiḥ || tasmai rājakumārāya sanmārgamupadiṣṭavān || 16 || || ṛṣabha uvāca || || śrutismṛtipurāṇeṣu prokto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || varṇāśramānurūpeṇa niṣevyaḥ sarvadā janaiḥ || 17 || bhaja vatsa satāṃ mārgaṃ sadeva caritaṃ cara || na devājñāṃ vilaṃghethā mā kārṣīrdevahelanam || 18 || godevaguruvipreṣu bhaktimānbhava sarvadā || cāṃḍālamapi saṃprāptaṃ sadā saṃbhāvayātithim || 19 || satyaṃ na tyaja sarvatra prāpte'pi prāṇasaṃkaṭe || gobrāhmaṇānāṃ rakṣārthamasatyaṃ tvaṃ vada kvacit || 3.3.11.20 || parasveṣu parastrīṣu devabrāhmaṇa vastuṣu || tṛṣṇāṃ tyaja mahābāho durlabheṣvapi vastuṣu || 21 || satkathāyāṃ sadācāre sadvrate ca sadāgame || dharmādisaṃgrahe nityaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ kuru mahāmate || 22 || snāne jape ca home ca svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe || godevātithipūjāsu nirālasyo bhavānagha || 23 || krodhaṃ dveṣaṃ bhayaṃ śāṭhyaṃ paiśunya masadāgraham || kauṭilyaṃ daṃbhamudvegaṃ yatnena parivarjaya || 24 || kṣātradharmarato'pi tvaṃ vṛthā hiṃsāṃ parityaja || śuṣkavairaṃ vṛthālāpaṃ paranidāṃ ca varjaya || 25 || mṛgayā dyūtapāneṣu strīṣu strīvijiteṣu ca || atyāhāramatikrodhamatinidrāmatiśramam || 26 || atyālāpamatikrīḍāṃ sarvadā parivarjaya || || 27 || atividyāmatiśraddhāmatipuṇyamatismṛtim || atyutsāhamatikhyātimatidhairyaṃ ca sādhaya || 28 || sakāmo nijadāreṣu sakrodho nija śatruṣu || salobhaḥ puṇyanicaye sābhyasūyo hyadharmiṣu || 29 || sadveṣo bhava pākhaṇḍe sarāgaḥ sajjaneṣu ca || durbodho bhava durmaṃtre badhiraḥ piśunoktiṣu || 3.3.11.30 || dhūrttaṃ caṃḍaṃ śaṭhaṃ krūraṃ kitavaṃ capalaṃ khalam || patitaṃ nāstikaṃ jihmaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjaya || 31 || ātmapraśaṃsā mā kārṣīḥ parijñāteṃgito bhava || dhane sarvakuṭuṃbe ca nātyāsaktaḥ sadā bhava || 32 || patnyāḥ pativratāyāśca jananyāḥ śvaśurasya ca || satāṃ gurośca vacane viśvāsaṃ kuru sarvadā || 33 || ātmarakṣāparo nityamapramatto dṛḍhavrataḥ || viśvāsaṃ naiva kurvīthāḥ svabhṛtyeṣvapi kutra cit || 34 || viśvastaṃ mā vadhīḥ kaṃcidapi coraṃ mahāmate || apāpeṣu na śaṃkethāḥ satyānna calito bhava || 35 || anāthaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ striyaṃ bālaṃ nirāgasam || parirakṣa dhanaiḥ prāṇairbuddhyā śaktyā balena ca || 36 || api śatruṃ vadhasyārhaṃ mā vadhīḥ śaraṇāgatam || apyapātraṃ supātraṃ vā nīco vāpi mahattamaḥ || 37 || yo vā ko vāpi yāceta tasmai dehi śiropi ca || api yatnena mahatā kīrtimeva sadārjaya || 38 || rājñāṃ ca viduṣāṃ caiva kīrtireva hi bhūṣaṇam || satkīrtiprabhavā lakṣmīḥ puṇyaṃ satkīrtisaṃbhavam || 39 || satkīrtyā rājate lokaścaṃdraścaṃdrikayā nyathā || gajāśvahemanicayaṃ ratnarāśiṃ nagopamam || 3.3.11.40 || akīrtyopahataṃ sarvaṃ tṛṇavanmuṃca satvaram || mātuḥ kopaṃ pituḥ kopaṃ guroḥ kopaṃ dhanavya yam || 41 || putrāṇāmaparādhaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣamasva bhoḥ || yathā dvijaprasādaḥ syāttathā teṣāṃ hitaṃ cara || 42 || rājānaṃ saṃkaṭe magnamuddhareyurdvijottamā || āyuryaśo balaṃ saukhyaṃ dhanaṃ puṇyaṃ prajonnatiḥ || 43 || karmaṇā yena jāyeta tatsevyaṃ bhavatā sadā || deśaṃ kālaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca kāryaṃ cā kāryameva ca || 44 || samyagvicārya yatnena kuru kāryaṃ ca sarvadā || na kuryāḥ kasyacidbādhāṃ parabādhāṃ nivāraya || 45 || corānduṣṭāṃśca bādhethāḥ sunītyā śaktimattayā || snāne jape ca home ca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi || 46 || atvaro bhava nidrāyāṃ bhojane bhava satvaraḥ || dākṣiṇyayuktamaśaṭhaṃ satyaṃ janamanoharam || 47 || alpākṣaramanaṃtārthaṃ vākyaṃ brūhi mahāmate|| abhīto bhava sarvatra vipakṣeṣu vipatsu ca || 48 || bhīto bhava brahmakule na pāpe guruśāsane || jñātibaṃdhuṣu vipreṣu bhāryāsu tanayeṣu ca || 49 || samabhāvena vartethāstathā bhojanapaṃktiṣu || satāṃ hitopadeśeṣu tathā puṇya kathāsu ca || 3.3.11.50 || vidyāgoṣṭhīṣu dharmyāsu kvacinmā bhūḥ parāṅmukhaḥ || śucau puṇyajalasyāṃte prakhyāte brahmasaṃkule || 51|| mahādeśe śivamaye vastavyaṃ bhavatā sadā || kulaṭā gaṇikā yatra yatra tiṣṭhati kāmukaḥ || 52 || durdeśe nīcasaṃbādhe kadācidapi mā vasa || ekamevāśritopi tvaṃ śivaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || 53 || sarvāndevānupāsīthāstaddināni ca mānayan || sadā śuciḥ sadā dakṣaḥ sadā śāṃtaḥ sadā sthiraḥ || 54 || sadā vijita ṣaḍvargaḥ sadaikāṃto bhavānagha || viprānvedavidaḥ śāṃtānyatīṃśca niyatojvalān|| 55 || yugmam || puṇyavṛkṣānpuṇyanadīḥ puṇyatīrthaṃ mahatsaraḥ || dhenuṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ ratnaṃ yuvatīṃ ca pativratām|| 56 || ātmano gṛhadevāṃśca sahasaiva namaskuru || utthāya samaye brāhme svācamya vimalāśayaḥ ||57 || namaskṛtyātmaguruve dhyātvā devamumāpatim|| nārāyaṇaṃ ca lakṣmīśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca vināyakam|| 58 || skandaṃ kātyāyanīṃ devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm || indrādīnatha lokeśānpuṇyaślokānṛṣīnapi || 59 || ciṃtayitvātha mārttaṃḍamudyaṃtaṃ praṇametsadā || gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ śākaṃ pakvaphalādikam || 3.3.11.60 || śivāya dattvopabhuṃkṣva bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ priyaṃ navam || yaddattaṃ yatkṛtaṃ japtaṃ yatsnātaṃ yaddhutaṃ smṛtam || 61 || yacca taptaṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ tacchivāya nivedaya|| bhuṃjānaśca paṭhanvāpi śayāno viharannapi || paśyañchṛṇnvavadangṛhṇañchivamevānuciṃtaya || 62 || rudrākṣakaṃkaṇalasatkaradaṃḍayugmo mālāṃtarāladhṛtabhasma sitatripuṃḍūḥ || paṃcākṣaraṃ paripaṭhanparamaṃtrarājaṃ dhyāyansadā paśupateścaraṇaṃ ramethāḥ ||63 || iti saṃkṣepato vatsa kathito dharmasaṃgrahaḥ || anyeṣu ca purāṇeṣu vistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ ||64|| athāparaṃ sarvapurāṇaguhyaṃ niḥśeṣapāpaughaharaṃ pavitram|| jayapradaṃ sarvavipadvimocanaṃ vakṣyāmi śaivaṃ kavacaṃ hitāya te ||65|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmakhaṇḍe bhadrāyuṃ prati ṛṣabhopadeśavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || cha || ||
<3.3.12>
|| ṛṣabha uvāca || || namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ viśvavyāpinamīśvaram || vakṣye śivamayaṃ varma sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇām || 1 || śucau deśe samāsīno yathāvatkalpitāsanaḥ || jiteṃdriyo jitaprāṇaściṃtayecchivamavyayam || 2|| hṛtpuṃḍarīkāṃtarasanniviṣṭaṃ svatejasā vyāptanabhovakāśam || atīṃdriyaṃ sūkṣmamanaṃtamādyaṃ dhyāyetparānaṃdamayaṃ maheśam || 3 || dhyānāvadhūtākhilakarmabaṃdhaściraṃ cidānaṃdanimagnacetāḥ || ṣaḍakṣaranyāsasamāhitātmā śaivena kuryā tkavacena rakṣām || 4 || māṃ pātu devo'khiladevatātmā saṃsārakūpe patitaṃ gabhīre || tannāma divyaṃ varamaṃtramūlaṃ dhunotu me sarvamaghaṃ hṛdistham || 5 || sarvatra māṃ rakṣatu viśvamūrttirjyotirmayānaṃdaghanaścidātmā || aṇoraṇīyānuruśaktirekaḥ sa īśvaraḥ pātu bhayādaśeṣāt || 6 || yo bhūsvarūpeṇa bibharti viśvaṃ pāyātsa bhūmergiriśo'ṣṭamūrtiḥ || yo'pāṃ svarūpeṇa nṛṇāṃ karoti saṃjīnaṃ so'vatu māṃ jalebhyaḥ || 7 || kalpāvasāne bhuvanāni dagdhvā sarvāṇi yo nṛtyati bhūrilīlaḥ || sa kālarudro'vatu māṃ davāgnervātyādibhīterakhilācca tāpāt || 8 || pradīptavidyutkanakāvabhāso vidyāvarābhītikuṭhārapāṇiḥ|| caturmukhastatpuruṣastrinetraḥ prācyāṃ sthitaṃ rakṣatu māmajasram || 9 || kuṭhāravedāṃkuśapāśaśūlakapālaḍhakkākṣaguṇāndadhānaḥ || caturmukho nīlarucistrinetraḥ pāyādaghoro diśi dakṣiṇasyām || 3.3.12.10 || kuṃdenduśaṃkhasphaṭikāvabhāso vedākṣamālāvaradābhayāṃkaḥ || tryakṣaścaturvaktra uruprabhāvaḥ sadyodhijātovatu māṃ pratīcyām || 11 || varākṣamālābhayaṭaṃkahastaḥ sarojakiṃjalkasamānavarṇaḥ || trilocanaścārucaturmukho māṃ pāyādudīcyāṃ diśi vāmadevaḥ || 12 || vedābhayeṣṭāṃkuśaṭaṃkapāśakapālaḍhakkākṣakaśūlapāṇiḥ || sitadyutiḥ paṃcamukho'vatānmāmīśāna ūrddhvaṃ paramaprakāśaḥ || 13 || mūrdhānamavyānmama caṃdramau lirbhālaṃ mamāvyādatha bhālanetraḥ || netre mamāvyādbhaganetrahārī nāsāṃ sadā rakṣatu viśvanāthaḥ || 14 || pāyācchrutī me śrutigītakīrtiḥ kapolamavyā tsatataṃ kapālī || vaktraṃ sadā rakṣatu paṃcavaktro jihvāṃ sadā rakṣatu vedajihvaḥ || 15 || kaṃṭhaṃ girīśo'vatu nīlakaṃṭhaḥ pāṇidvayaṃ pātu pinākapāṇiḥ || dormūlamavyānmama dharmabāhurvakṣaḥsthalaṃ dakṣamakhāṃtako'vyāt || 16 || mamodaraṃ pātu girīṃdradhanvā madhyaṃ mamāvyānmadanāntakārī || heraṃbatāto mama pātu nābhiṃ pāyātkaṭī dhṛrjaṭirīśvaro me || 17 || ūrudvayaṃ pātu kuberamitro jānudvayaṃ me jagadīśvaro'vyāt || jaṃghāyugaṃ puṃgavaketuravyātpādau mamāvyā tsuravaṃdyapādaḥ || 18 || maheśvaraḥ pātu dinādiyāme māṃ madhyayāme'vatu vāmadevaḥ || triyaṃbakaḥ pātu tṛtīyayāme vṛṣadhvajaḥ pātu dināṃtyayāme || || 19 || pāyānniśādau śaśiśekharo māṃ gaṃgādharo rakṣatu māṃ niśīthe || gaurīpatiḥ pātu niśāvasāne mṛtyuṃjayo rakṣatu sarvakālam || 3.3.12.20 || aṃtaḥsthitaṃ rakṣatu śaṃkaro māṃ sthāṇuḥ sadā pātu bahiḥsthitaṃ mām || tadaṃtare pātu patiḥ paśūnāṃ sadā śivo rakṣatu māṃ samaṃtāt || 21 || tiṣṭhaṃtamavyā dbhuvanaikanāthaḥ pāyādvrajaṃtaṃ pramathādhināthaḥ || vedāṃtavedyo'vatu mānniṣaṇṇaṃ māmavyayaḥ pātu śivaḥ śayānam || 22|| mārgeṣu māṃ rakṣatu nīlakaṃṭhaḥ śailādidurgeṣu puratrayāriḥ || araṇyavāsādimahāpravāse pāyānmṛgavyādha udāraśaktiḥ || 23 || kalpāṃtakāṭopapaṭuprakopaḥ sphuṭāṭṭahāsoccalitāṃḍakośaḥ || ghorārisenārṇavadurnivāramahābhayādrakṣatu vīrabhadraḥ||24|| pattyaśvamātaṃgaghaṭāvarūthasahasralakṣāyutakoṭibhīṣaṇam || akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatamātatāyināṃ chiṃdyā nmūḍho ghorakuṭhāradhārayā || 25 || nihaṃtu dasyūnpralayānalārcirjvalattriśūlaṃ tripurāṃtakasya || śārdūlasiṃharkṣavṛkādihiṃsrānsaṃtrāsayatvīśadhanuḥpinākam|| ||26|| duḥsvapnaduḥśakunadurgatidaurmanasyadurbhikṣadurvyasanaduḥsahaduryaśāṃsi| utpātatāpaviṣabhītimasadgrahārtivyādhīṃśca nāśayatu me jagatāmadhīśaḥ||27|| oṃnamo bhagavate sadāśivāya sakalatattvātmakāya sakalatattvavihārāya sakalalokaikakartre sakalalaukaikabhartre sakalalokaikahartre sakalalokaikagurave sakalalokaikasākṣiṇe sakalanigamaguhyāya sakalavarapradāya sakaladuritārtibhaṃjanāya sakalajagadabhayaṃkarāya sakalalokaikaśaṃkarāya śaśāṃkaśekharāya śāśva tanijābhāsāya nirguṇāya nirupamāya nīrūpāya nirābhāsāya nirāmayāya niṣprapaṃcāya niṣkalaṃkāya nirdvaṃdvāya niḥsaṃgāya nirmalāya nirgamāya nityarūpavibhavāya nirupamavibhavāya nirādhārāya nityaśuddhabuddhaparipūrṇasaccidānaṃdādvayāya paramaśāṃtaprakāśatejorūpāya jayajaya mahārudra mahāraudra bhadrāvatāra duḥkhadāvadāraṇa mahābhairava kālabhairava kalpāntabhairava kapālamālādhara khaṭvāṃgakhaḍgacarmapāśāṃkuśaḍamaruśūlacāpabāṇagadāśaktibhiṃ ḍipālatomaramusalamudgarapaṭṭiśaparaśuparighabhuśuṃḍīśataghnīcakrādyāyudhabhīṣaṇakarasahasra mukhadaṃṣṭrākarāla vikaṭāṭṭahāsavisphāritabrahmāmaṇḍala nāgeṃdra kuṇḍala nāgeṃdrahāra nāgeṃdravalaya nāgeṃdracarmadhara mṛtyuṃjaya tryaṃbaka tripurāṃtaka virūpākṣa viśveśvara viśvarūpa vṛṣabhavāhana viṣabhūṣaṇa viśvatomukha sarvato rakṣarakṣa māṃ jvalajvala mahāmṛtyubhayamapamṛtyubhayaṃ nāśayanāśaya rogabhayamutsādayotsādaya viṣasarpabhayaṃ śamayaśamaya corabhayaṃ mārayamāraya mama śatrūnuccā ṭayoccāṭaya śūlena vidārayavidāraya kuṭhāreṇa bhiṃdhibhiṃdhi khaḍgena chiṃdhichiṃdhi khaṭvāṃgena vipothayavipothaya musalena niṣpeṣayaniṣpeṣaya bāṇaiḥ saṃtāḍaya saṃtāḍaya rakṣāṃsi bhīṣayabhīṣaya bhūtāni vidrāvayavidrāvaya kūṣmāṃḍavetālamārīgaṇabrahmarākṣasānsaṃtrāsayasaṃtrāsaya mamābhayaṃ kurukuru vitrastaṃ māmāśvāsa yāśvāsaya narakabhayānmāmuddhārayoddhāraya saṃjīvayasaṃjīvaya kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ māmāpyāyayāpyāyaya duḥkhāturaṃ māmānandayānaṃdaya śivakavacena māmācchādayā cchādaya tryaṃbaka sadāśiva namastenamastenamaste || || ṛṣabha uvāca || || ityetatkavacaṃ śaivaṃ varadaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ mayā || sarvabādhāpraśamanaṃ rahasyaṃ sarva dehinām || 28 || yaḥ sadā dhārayenmartyaḥ śaivaṃ kavacamuttamam || na tasya jāyate kvāpi bhayaṃ śambhoranugrahāt || 29 || kṣīṇāyurmṛtyumāpanno mahārogahato'pi vā || sadyaḥ sukhamavāpnoti dīrghamāyuśca viṃdati || 3.3.12.30 || sarvadāridryaśamanaṃ saumaṃgalyavivardhanam || yo dhatte kavacaṃ śaivaṃ sa devairapi pūjyate || 31 || mahāpātakasaṃghātairmucyate copapātakaiḥ || dehāṃte śivamāpnoti śivavarmānubhāvataḥ || 32 || tvamapi śraddhayā vatsa śaivaṃ kavaca muttamam|| dhārayasva mayā dattaṃ sadyaḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi || 33 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā ṛṣabho yogī tasmai pārthivasūnave || dadau śaṃkhaṃ mahārāvaṃ khaḍgaṃ cāriniṣūdanam || 34 || punaśca bhasma saṃmaṃtrya tadaṃgaṃ sarvato'spṛśat || gajānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrasya dviguṇaṃ ca balaṃ dadau || 35 || bhasmaprabhāvātsaṃprāpya balaiśvaryadhṛtismṛtīḥ || sa rājaputraḥ śuśubhe śaradarka iva śriyā || 36 || tamāha prāṃjaliṃ bhūyaḥ sa yogī rājanaṃdanam || eṣa khaḍgo mayā dattastapomaṃtrānubhāvataḥ || 37 || śitadhāramimaṃ khaḍgaṃ yasmai darśayasi sphuṭam || sa sadyo mriyate śatruḥ sākṣānmṛtyurapi svayam || || 38 || asya śaṃkhasya nihrādaṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti tavāhitāḥ.|| te mūrcchitāḥ patiṣyaṃti nyastaśastrā vicetanā || 39 || khaḍgaśaṃkhāvimau divyau parasainyavināśinau || ātmasainyasvapakṣāṇāṃ śauryatejovivardhanau || 3.3.12.40 || etayośca prabhāvena śaivena kavacena ca || dviṣaṭsahasranāgānāṃ balena mahatāpi ca ||41|| bhasmadhāraṇasāmarthyācchatrusainyaṃ vijeṣyasi || prāpya siṃhāsanaṃ paitryaṃ goptāsi pṛthivīmimām ||42|| iti bhadrāyuṣaṃ samyaganuśāsya samātṛkam|| tābhyāṃ saṃpūjitaḥ so'tha yogī svairagatiryayau || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottara khaṃḍe sīmaṃtinīmāhātmye bhadrāyūpākhyāne śivakavacakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<3.3.13>
|| sūta uvāca || || daśārṇādhipatestasya vajrabāhormahābhujaḥ || babhūva śatrurbalavānrājā magadharāṭ tataḥ || 1 || sa vai hemaratho nāma bāhuśālī raṇotkaṭaḥ || balena mahatāvṛtya daśārṇaṃ nyarudhadbalī || 2 || camūpāstasya durdharṣāḥ prāpya deśaṃ daśārṇakam || vyaluṃpanvasuratnāni gṛhāṇi dadahuḥ pare ||3|| keciddhanāni jagṛhuḥ kecidbālānstriyo'pare || godhanānyapare'gṛhṇankeciddhānyaparicchadān || kecidārāmasasyāni gṛhodyānānyanāśayat ||4|| evaṃ vināśya tadrājyaṃ strīgodhanajighṛkṣavaḥ || āvṛtya tasya nagarīṃ vajrabāhostu māgadhaḥ || 5 || evaṃ paryākulaṃ vīkṣya rājā nagarameva ca || yuddhāya nirjagāmāśu vajrabāhuḥ sasai nikaḥ || 6 || vajrabāhuśca bhūpālastathā maṃtripuraḥsarāḥ || yuyudhurmāgadhaiḥ sārdhaṃ nijaghnuḥ śatruvāhinīm ||7|| vajrabāhurmaheṣvāso daṃśito rathamāsthitaḥ|| vikiranbāṇavarṣāṇi cakāra kadanaṃ mahat ||8|| daśārṇarājaṃ yudhyaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhe suduḥsaham || tameva tarasā vavruḥ sarve māgadhasainikāḥ || 9 || kṛtvā tu suciraṃ yuddhaṃ māgadhā dṛḍhavikramāḥ || tatsainyaṃ nāśayāmāsurlebhire ca jayaśriyam ||3.3.13.10|| kecittasya rathaṃ jaghnuḥ kecittaddhanurācchinam || sūtaṃ tasya jaghānaikastvaparaḥ khaḍgamācchinat || 11|| saṃchinnakhaḍgadhanvānaṃ virathaṃ hatasārathim || balādgṛhītvā balino babaṃdhurnṛpatiṃ ruṣā ||12|| tasya maṃtrigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tatsainyaṃ ca vijitya te || māgadhāstasya nagarīṃ viviśurjayakāśinaḥ || 13 || aśvānnarāngajānuṣṭrānpaśūṃścaiva dhanāni ca || jagṛhuryuvatīḥ sarvāścārvaṃgīścaiva kanyakāḥ || 14 || rājño babaṃdhurmahiṣīrdāsīścaiva sahasraśaḥ || kośaṃ ca ratnasaṃpūrṇaṃ jahruste'pyātatāyinaḥ || 15 || evaṃ vināśya nagarīṃ hṛtvā strīgodhanādikam || vajrabāhuṃ balādbaddhvā rathe sthāpya viniryayuḥ || 16 || evaṃ kolāhale jāte rāṣṭranāśe ca dāruṇe || rājaputro'tha bhadrāyustadvārtāmaśṛṇodbalī || 17 || pitaraṃ śatrunirbaddhaṃ pitṛpatnīstathā hṛtāḥ || naṣṭaṃ daśārṇarāṣṭraṃ ca śrutvā cukrośa siṃhavat || 18 || sa khaḍgaśaṃkhāvādāya vaiśyaputrasahāyavān || daṃśito hayamāruhya kumāro vijigīṣayā || 19 || javenāgatya taṃ deśaṃ māgadhairabhipūritam || dahyamānaṃ kraṃdamānaṃ hṛtastrīsutagodhanam || 3.3.13.20 || dṛṣṭvā rājajanaṃ sarvaṃ rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ bhayākulam || krodhādhmātamanāstūrṇaṃ praviśya ripuvāhinīm || ākarṇākṛṣṭakodaṃḍo vavarṣa śarasaṃtatīḥ || 21 || te hanyamānā ripavo rājaputreṇa sāyakaiḥ || tamabhidrutya vegena śarairvivyadhurulbaṇaiḥ || 22 || hanyamāno'strapūgena ripubhiryuddhadurmadaiḥ || na cacāla raṇe dhīraḥ śivavarmābhirakṣitaḥ || 23 || so'strakarṣaṃ prasahyāśu praviśya gajalīlayā || jaghānāśu rathānnāgānpadātīnapi bhūriśaḥ || 24 || tatraikaṃ rathinaṃ hatvā sasūtaṃ nṛpanaṃdanaḥ || tameva rathamāsthāya vaiśyanaṃdanasārathiḥ || vicacāra raṇe dhīraḥ siṃho mṛgakulaṃ yathā || 25 || atha sarve susaṃrabdhāḥ śūrāḥ prodyatakārmukāḥ || abhisasrustamevaikaṃ camūpā balaśālinaḥ || 26 || teṣāmāpatatāmagre khaḍgamudyamya dāruṇam || abhyudyayau mahāvīrāndarśayanniva pauruṣam || 27 || karālāṃtakajihvābhaṃ tasya khaḍgaṃ mahojjvalam || dṛṣṭvaiva sahasā mamruśca mūpāstatprabhāvataḥ || 28 || yeye paśyaṃti taṃ khaḍgaṃ prasphuraṃtaṃ raṇāṃgaṇe || te sarve nidhanaṃ jagmurvajraṃ prāpyeva kīṭakaḥ || 29 || athāsau sarvasainyānāṃ vināśāya mahābhujaḥ || śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau mahārāvaṃ pūrayanniva rodasī || 3.3.13.30 || tena śaṃkhaninādena viṣāktenaiva bhūyasā || śrutamātreṇa ripavo mūrcchitāḥ patitā bhuvi ||31 || ye'śvapṛṣṭhe rathe ye ca ye ca daṃtiṣu saṃsthitāḥ|| te visaṃjñāḥ kṣaṇātpetuḥ śaṃkhanādahataujasaḥ||32|| tānbhūmau patitānsarvānnaṣṭasaṃjñā nnirāyudhān|| vigaṇayya śavaprāyānanāvadhīddharmaśāstravit||33|| ātmanaḥ pitaraṃ baddhaṃ mocayitvā raṇājire|| tatpatnīḥ śatruvaśagāḥ sarvāḥ sadyo vyamocayat || 34 || patnīśca maṃtrimukhyānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ puraukasām || striyo bālāṃśca kanyāśca godhanādīnyanekaśaḥ || 35 || mocayitvā ripubhayāttamāśvāsayadākulaḥ || athārisainyeṣu caraṃsteṣāṃ jagrāha yoṣitaḥ || 36 || marunmanojavānaśvānmātaṃgāngirisannibhān || syaṃdanāni ca raukmāṇi dāsīśca rucirānanāḥ || 37 || yugmam || sarvamāhṛtya vegena gṛhītvā taddhanaṃ bahu || māgadheśaṃ hemarathaṃ nirbabaṃdha parājitam || 38 || tanmaṃtriṇaśca bhūpāṃśca tatra mukhyāṃśca nāyakān|| gṛhītvā tarasā baddhvā purīṃ prāveśayaddrutam || 39 || pūrvaṃ ye samare bhagnā vivṛttāḥ sarvatodiśam || te maṃtrimukhyā viśvastā nāyakāśca samāyayuḥ || 3.3.13.40 || kumāravikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vismitamānasāḥ || taṃ menire suraśreṣṭhaṃ kāraṇādāgataṃ bhuvam || || 41 || aho naḥ sumahābhāgyamaho nastapasaḥ phalam || kenāpyanena vīreṇa mṛtāḥ saṃjīvitāḥ khalu || 42 || eṣa kiṃ yogasiddho vā tapaḥsiddho 'thavā'maraḥ || amānuṣamida karma yadanena kṛtaṃ mahat || 43 || nūnamasya bhavenmātā sā gaurīti śivaḥ pitā || akṣauhiṇīnāṃ navakaṃ jigāyānaṃtaśaktidhṛk || 44 || ityāścaryayutairhṛṣṭaiḥ praśaṃsadbhiḥ parasparam || pṛṣṭo'mātyajanenāsāvātmānaṃ prāha tattvataḥ || 45 || samāgataṃ svapitaraṃ vismayāhlādaviplutam || muṃcaṃtamānaṃdajalaṃ vavaṃde premavihvalaḥ || 46 || sa rājā nijaputreṇa praṇayādabhivaṃditaḥ || āśliṣya gāḍhaṃ tarasā babhāṣe premakātaraḥ || 47 || kastvaṃ devo manuṣyo vā gandharvo vā mahāmate || kā mātā janakaḥ ko vā ko deśastava nāma kim || 48 || kasmānna śatrubhirbaddhānmṛtāniva hataujasaḥ || kāruṇyādiha saṃprāpya sapatnīkānmumoca yaḥ || 49 || kuto labdhamidaṃ śauryaṃ dhairyaṃ tejo balonnatiḥ || jigīṣasīva lokāṃstrīnsadevāsuramānuṣān || 3.3.13.50 || api janmasahasreṇa tavānṛṇyaṃ mahaujasaḥ || kartuṃ nāhaṃ samarthosmi sahaibhirdārabāṃdhavaiḥ ||51|| imānputrānimāḥ patnīridaṃ rājyamidaṃ puram || sarvaṃ vihāya maccittaṃ tvayyeva premabaṃdhanam ||52|| sarvaṃ kathaya me tāta matprāṇaparirakṣaka || etāsāṃ mama patnīnāṃ tvadadhīnaṃ hi jīvitam || 53 || || sūta uvāca || || iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa bhadrāyuḥ svapitrā tamabhāṣata || eṣa vaiśyasuto rājansunayo nāma matsakhā || 54 || ahamasya gṛhe ramye vasāmi sahamātṛkaḥ || bhadrāyurnāma madvṛttaṃ paścādvijñāpayāmi te || 55 || puraṃ praviśya bhadraṃ te sadāraḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ || tyaktvā bhayamarātibhyo viharasva yathāsukham || 56 || naitānmuṃca ripūṃstāvadyāvadāgamanaṃ mama || ahamadya gamiṣyāmi śīghramātmaniveśanam || 57 || ityuktvā nṛpamāmaṃtrya bhadrāyurnṛpanaṃdanaḥ || ājagāma svabhavanaṃ mātre sarvaṃ nyavedayat || 58|| sāpi hṛṣṭā svatanayaṃ parirebhe'śrulocanā || sa ca vaiśyapatiḥ premṇā pariṣvajyābhyapūjayat || 59 || vajrabāhuśca rājeṃdraḥ praviṣṭo nijamaṃdiram || strīputrāmātya sahitaḥ praharṣamatulaṃ yayau || 3.3.13.60 || tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāmṛṣabho yogināṃ varaḥ || caṃdrāṃgadaṃ samāgatya sīmaṃtinyāḥ patiṃ nṛpam || 61 || bhadrāyuṣaḥ samutpattiṃ tasya karmāpyamānuṣam || āvedya rahasi premṇā tvatsutāṃ kīrtimālinīm || 62 || bhadrāyuṣe prayaccheti bodhayitvā ca naiṣadham || ṛṣabho nirjagāmātha deśakālārthatattvavit || 63 || viśeṣakam || atha caṃdrāṃgado rājā muhūrtte maṃgalocite || bhadrāyuṣaṃ samāhūya prāyacchatkīrttimālinīm || 64 || kṛtodvāhaḥ sa rājeṃdratanayaḥ saha bhāryayā || hemāsanasthaḥ śuśubhe rohiṇyeva niśākaraḥ || 65 || vajrabāhuṃ tatpitaraṃ samāhūya sa naiṣadhaḥ || puraṃ praveśya sāmātyaḥ pratyudgamyābhyapūjayat || 66 || tatrāpaśyatkṛtodvāhaṃ bhadrāyuṣamariṃdamam || pādayoḥ patitaṃ premṇā harṣāttaṃ pariṣasvaje || || 67 || eṣa me prāṇado vīra eṣa śatruniṣūdanaḥ || athāpyajñātavaṃśo'yaṃ mayānaṃtaparākramaḥ || 68 || eṣa te nṛpa jāmātā caṃdrāṃgada mahābalaḥ || asya vaṃśamathotpattiṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 69 || itthaṃ daśārṇarājena prārthito niṣadhādhipaḥ || vivikta upasaṃgamya prahasannidamabravīt || 3.3.13.70 || eṣa te tanayo rājañchaiśave rogapīḍitaḥ || tvayā vane parityaktaḥ saha mātrā rujārtayā || 71 || paribhramaṃtī vipine sā nārī śiśunāmunā || daivādvaiśyagṛhaṃ prāptā tena vaiśyena rakṣitā || 72 || athāsau bahurogārto mṛtastava kumārakaḥ || kenāpi yogirājena mṛtaḥ saṃjīvitaḥ punaḥ || 73 || ṛṣabhākhyasya tasyaiva prabhāvācchivayoginaḥ || rūpaṃ ca devasadṛśaṃ prāptau mātṛkumārakau || 74 || tena dattena khaḍgena śaṃkhena ripughātinā || jigāya samare śatrūñchivavarmābhirakṣitaḥ || 75 || dviṣaṭsahasranāgānāṃ balameko bibhartyasau || sarvavidyāsu niṣṇāto mama jāmātṛtāṃ gataḥ || 76 || ata enaṃ samādāya mātaraṃ cāsya suvratām|| gacchasva nagarīṃ rājanprāpsyasi śreya uttamam || 77 || iti caṃdrāṃgadaḥ sarvamākhyāyāṃtargṛhe sthitām || tasyāgra patnīmāhūya darśayāmāsa bhūṣitām || 78 || ityādi sarvamākarṇya dṛṣṭvā ca sa mahīpatiḥ || vrīḍito nitarāṃ mauḍhyātsvakṛtaṃ karma garhayan || 79 || prāptaśca paramānandaṃ tayordarśanakautukāt || pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgastāvubhau pariṣasvaje || 3.3.13.80 || yugmam || evaṃ niṣadharājena pūjitaścābhinanditaḥ || sa bhojayitvā taṃ samyaksvayaṃ ca saha maṃtribhiḥ || 81 || tāmātmanogramahiṣīṃ putraṃ tamapi tāṃ snuṣām || ādāya saparīvāro vajrabāhuḥ purīṃ yayau ||82|| sa saṃbhrameṇa mahatā bhadrāyuḥ pitṛmaṃdiram|| saṃprāpya paramānaṃdaṃ cakre sarvapuraukasām||83|| kālena divamārūḍhe pitari prāptayauvanaḥ|| bhadrāyuḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ śaśāsādbhutavikramaḥ || 84 || māgadheśaṃ hemarathaṃ mocayāmāsa baṃdhanāt || saṃdhāya maitrīṃ paramāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ ca sannidhau|| 85|| itthaṃ trilokamahitāṃ śivayogipūjāṃ kṛtvā purātanabhave'pi sa rājasūnuḥ || nistīrya duḥsahavipadgaṇamāptarājyaścaṃdrāṃgadasya sutayā saha sādhu reme || 86 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṃḍe bhadrāyuvivāhakathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || || cha || ||
<3.3.14>
|| sūta uvāca || || prāptasiṃhāsano vīro bhadrāyuḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || praviveśa vanaṃ ramyaṃ kadācidbhāryayā saha || 1 || tasminvikasitāśokaprasūnanavapallave|| protphullamallikākhaṃḍakūjadbhramarasaṃkule||2|| navakesarasaurabhyabaddharāgijanotsave|| sadyaḥ korakitāśokatamālagahanāṃtare ||3|| prasūnaprakarānamra mādhavīvanamaṃḍape|| pravālakusumoddyotacūtaśākhibhirañcite ||4|| punnāgavanavibhrāṃtapuṃskokilavirāviṇi|| vasantasamaye ramye vijahāra striyā saha ||5|| athāvidūre krośaṃtau dhāvaṃtau dvijadaṃpatī || anvīyamānau vyāghreṇa dadarśa nṛpasattamaḥ || 6 || pāhi pāhi mahārāja hā rājankaruṇānidhe || eṣa dhāvati śārdūlo jagdhumāvāṃ mahārayaḥ || 7 || eṣa parvatasaṃkāśaḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ || yāvanna khādati prāpya tāvannau rakṣa bhūpate || 8 || itthamākraṃditaṃ śrutvā sa rājā dhanurādade || tāvadāgatya śārdūlo madhye jagrāha tāṃ vadhūm || 9 || hā nātha nātha hā kāṃta hā śaṃbho jagataḥ pate || iti rorūyamāṇāṃ tāṃ yāvajjagrāha bhīṣaṇaḥ || 3.3.14.10 || tāvatsa rājā niśitairbhallairvyāghramatāḍayat || na ca tairvivyathe kiṃcidgirīṃdra iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||11|| sa śārdūlo mahāsattvo rājñostrairakṛtavyathaḥ || balādākṛṣya tāṃ nārīmapākrāmata satvaraḥ || 12 || vyāghreṇāpahṛtāṃ patnīṃ vīkṣya vipro'tiduḥkhitaḥ || ruroda hā priye bāle hā kāṃte hā pativrate || 13 || ekaṃ māmiha saṃtyajya kathaṃ lokāṃtaraṃ gatā || prāṇebhyopi priyāṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ jīvitumutsahe || 14 || rājankva te mahāstrāṇi kva te ślāghyaṃ mahaddhanuḥ || kva te dvādaśasāhasramahānāgātigaṃ balam || 15 || kiṃ te śaṃkhena khaṅgena kiṃ te maṃtrāstravidyayā || kiṃ ca tena prayatnena kiṃ prabhāveṇa bhūyasā || 16 || tatsarvaṃ viphalaṃ jātaṃ yaccānyattvayi tiṣṭhati || yastvaṃ vanaukasaṃ jaṃtuṃ nivārayitumakṣamaḥ || 17 || kṣāttrasyāyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṣatādyatparirakṣaṇam || tasmātkulocite dharme naṣṭe tvajjīvitena kim ||18|| ārtānāṃ śaraṇārtānāṃ trāṇaṃ kurvaṃti pārthivāḥ || prāṇairarthaiśca dharmajñāstadvihīnā mṛtopamāḥ || 19 || dhanināṃ dānahīnānāṃ gārhasthyādbhikṣutā varā || ārtatrāṇavihīnānāṃ jīvitānmaraṇaṃ varam || 3.3.14.20 || varaṃ viṣādanaṃ rājño varamagnau praveśanam || anāthānāṃ prapannānāṃ kṛpaṇānāmarakṣaṇāt || 21 || itthaṃ vilapitaṃ tasya svavīryasya ca garhaṇam || niśamya nṛpatiḥ śokādātmanyevamaciṃtayat || 22 || aho me pauruṣaṃ naṣṭamadya daivaviparyayāt || adya kīrtiśca me naṣṭā pātakaṃ prāptamutka ṭam || 23 || dharmaḥ kālocito naṣṭo mandabhāgyasya durmateḥ || nūnaṃ me saṃpado rājyamāyuṣyaṃ kṣayameṣyati ||24|| apuṃsāṃ saṃpado bhogāḥ putradāradhanāni ca || daivena kṣaṇamudyaṃti kṣaṇādastaṃ vrajaṃti ca ||25|| ata enaṃ dvijanmānaṃ hatadāraṃ śucārditam || gataśokaṃ kariṣyāmi dattvā prāṇānapi priyān || || 26 || iti niścitya manasā bhadrāyurnṛpasattamaḥ || patitvā pādayostvasya babhāṣe parisāṃtvayan || 27 || kṛpāṃ kuru mayi brahmankṣatrabaṃdhau hataujasi || śokaṃ tyaja mahābuddhe dāsyāmyarthaṃ tavepsitam || 28 || idaṃ rājyamiyaṃ rājñī mamedaṃ ca kalevaram || tvadhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ te'bhilaṣitaṃ vada || || 29 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || kimādarśena cāṃdhasya kiṃ gṛhairbhaikṣyajīvinaḥ || kiṃ pustakena mūrkhasya hyastrīkasya dhanena kim || 3.3.14.30 || ato'haṃ gatapatnīko bhuktabhogo na karhicit || imāṃ tavāgramahiṣīṃ kāmārthaṃ dīyatāṃ mama || 31 || || rājovāca || || brahmankimeṣa dharmaste kimetadguruśāsanam || asvargyamayaśasyaṃ ca paradārābhimarśanam || 32 || dātāraḥ saṃti vittasya rājyasya gajavājinām || ātmadehasya vā kvāpi na kalatrasya karhicit ||33|| paradāropabhogena yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || na tatkṣālayituṃ śakyaṃ prāyaścittaśatairapi ||34|| || brāhmaṇa uvāca || api brahmavadhaṃ ghoramapi madyaniṣevaṇam || tapasā nāśayiṣyāmi ki punaḥ pāradārikam || tasmātprayaccha me bhāryāmimāṃ tvaṃ dhruvamanyathā || 35 || arakṣaṇādbhayārtānāṃ gaṃtāsi nirayaṃ dhruvam || iti vipragirā bhītaściṃtayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || arakṣaṇānmahatpāpaṃ patnīdānaṃ tato varam || 36 || ataḥ patnīṃ dvijāgryāya dattvā nirmuktakilviṣaḥ || sadyo vahniṃ pravekṣyāmi kīrtiśca nihitā bhavet || 37 || iti niścitya manasā samujjvālya hutāśanam || taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ samāhūya dadau patnīṃ sahodakām || 38 || svayaṃ snātaḥ śucirbhūtvā praṇamya vibudheśvarān || tamagniṃ dviḥ parikramya śivaṃ dadhyau samāhitaḥ || 39 || tamathāgnau patiṣyaṃtaṃ svapadāsaktacetasam || pratyadṛśyata viśveśaḥ prādurbhūto jagatpatiḥ || 3.3.14.40 || tamīśvaraṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trinetraṃ pinākinaṃ candrakalāvataṃsam || ālaṃbitāpiṃgajaṭākalāpaṃ madhyaṃgataṃ bhāskarakoṭitejasam || 41 || mṛṇālagauraṃ gajacarmavāsasaṃ gaṃgātaraṃgo kṣitamaulideśam || nāgeṃdrahārāvalikaṃkaṇormikākirīṭakoṭyaṃgadakuṃḍalojjvalam || 42 || triśūlakhaṭvāṃgakuṭhāracarmamṛgābhayeṣṭārthapinākahastam || vṛṣoparisthaṃ śitikaṃṭhamīśaṃ prodbhūtamagre nṛpatirdadarśa || 43 || athāṃbarāddrutaṃ peturdivyāḥ kusumavṛṣṭayaḥ || praṇedurdevatūryāṇi devāśca nanṛturjaguḥ || 44 || tatrājagmurnāradādyāḥ sanakādyā surarṣayaḥ || indrādayaśca lokeśāstathābrahmarṣayo'malāḥ || 45 || teṣāṃ madhye samāsīno mahādevaḥ sahomayā || vavarṣa karuṇāsāraṃ bhaktinamre mahīpatau || 46 || taddarśanānaṃdavijṛṃbhitāśayaḥ pravṛddhabāṣpāṃbupariplutāṃgaḥ || prahṛṣṭaromā galagadgadākṣaraṃ tuṣṭāva gīrbhirmukulīkṛtāṃjaliḥ || 47 || || rājovāca || || natosmyahaṃ devamanāthamavyayaṃ pradhānamavyaktaguṇaṃ mahāṃtam || akāraṇaṃ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ paraṃ śivaṃ cidānaṃdamayaṃ praśāṃtam || 48 || tvaṃ viśvasākṣī jagato'syakarttā virūḍhadhāmā hṛdi sanniviṣṭaḥ || ato vicinvaṃti vidhau vipaścito yogairanekaiḥ kṛtacittarodhaiḥ || 49 || ekātmatāṃ bhāvayatāṃ tvameko nānādhiyāṃ yastvamanekarūpaḥ || atīṃdriyaṃ sākṣyudayāstavibhramaṃ manaḥpathātsaṃhriyate padaṃ te || 3.3.14.50 || taṃ tvāṃ durāpaṃ vacaso dhiyāśca vyapetamohaṃ paramātmarūpam || guṇaikaniṣṭhāḥ prakṛtau vilīnāḥ kathaṃ vapuḥ stotumalaṃgiro me || 51 || tathāpi bhaktyāśrayatāmupeyustavāṃghripadmaṃ praṇatārtibhaṃjanam || sughorasaṃsāradavāgnipīḍito bhajāmi nityaṃ bhavabhītiśāṃtaye || 52 || namaste deva devāya mahādevāya śaṃbhave || namastrimūrtirūpāya sargasthityaṃtakāriṇe || 53 || namo viśvādirūpāya viśvaprathamasākṣiṇe || namaḥ sanmātratattvāya bodhānaṃdaghanāya ca || 54 || sarvakṣetranivāsāya kṣetrabhinnātmaśaktaye || aśaktāya namastubhyaṃ śaktābhāsāya bhūyase || 55 || nirābhāsāya nityāya satyajñānāṃtarātmane || viśuddhāya vidūrāya vimuktāśeṣakarmaṇe || 56 || namo vedāṃtavedyāya vedamūlanivāsine || namo viviktaceṣṭāya nivṛttaguṇa vṛttaye || 57 || namaḥ kalyāṇavīryāya kalyāṇaphaladāyine || namo'naṃtāya mahate śāṃtāya śivarūpiṇe || 58 || aghorāya sughorāya ghorāghaugha vidāriṇe || bhargāya bhavabījānāṃ bhaṃjanāya garīyase || namo vidhvastamohāya viśadātmaguṇāya ca || 59 || pāhi māṃ jagatāṃ nātha pāhi śaṃkara śāśvata || pāhi rudra virūpākṣa pāhi mṛtyuṃjayāvyaya || 3.3.14.60 || śambho śaśāṃkakṛtaśekhara śāṃtamūrte gaurīśa gopatiniśāpahutāśanetra || gaṃgādharāṃdhakavidāraṇa puṇyakīrte bhūteśa bhūdharanivāsa sadā namaste || 61 || || sūta uvāca || || evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavānrājñā devo maheśvaraḥ || prasannaḥ saha pārvatyā pratyuvāca dayānidhiḥ || 62 || || īśvara uvāca || || rājaṃste parituṣṭo'smi bhaktyā puṇyastavena ca || ananyacetā yo nityaṃ sadā māṃ paryapūjayaḥ || 63 || tava bhāvaparīkṣārthaṃ dvijo bhūtvāhamāgataḥ || vyāghreṇa yā parigrastā saiṣā daivī girīṃdrajā || 64 || vyāghro māyāmayo yaste śarairakṣatavigrahaḥ || dhīratāṃ draṣṭukāmaste patnīṃ yācitavānaham || 65 || asyāśca kīrtimālinyāstava bhaktyā ca mānada || tuṣṭo'haṃ saṃprayacchāmi varaṃ varaya durlabham || 66 || || rājovāca || || eṣa eva varo deva yadbhavānparameśvaraḥ || bhavatāpaparītasya mama pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 67 || nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe deva bhavato varadarṣabhāt || ahaṃ ca seyaṃ sā rājñī mama mātā ca matpitā || 68 || vaiśyaḥ padmākaro nāma tatputraḥ sunayābhidhaḥ || sarvānetānmahādeva sadā tvatpārśvagānkuru || 69 || || sūta uvāca || || atha rājñī mahābhāgā praṇatā kīrtimālinī || bhaktyā prasādya giriśaṃ yayāce varamuttamam || 3.3.14.70 || || rājñyuvāca || || caṃdrāṃgado mama pitā mātā sīmaṃtinī ca me || tayoryāce mahādeva tvatpārśve sannidhiṃ sadā || 71 || evamastviti gaurīśaḥ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ || tayoḥ kāmavaraṃ dattvā kṣaṇādaṃtarhito'bhavat || 72 || sopi rājā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ prasādaṃ prāpya śūlinaḥ || sahitaḥ kīrtimālinyā bubhuje viṣayānpriyān || 73 || kṛtvā varṣāyutaṃ rājyamavyāhatabalonnatiḥ || rājyaṃ putreṣu vinyasya bheje śaṃbhoḥ paraṃ padam || 74 || caṃdrāṃgadopi rājeṃdro rājñī sīmaṃtinī ca sā || bhaktyā saṃpūjya giriśaṃ jagmatuḥ śāṃbhavaṃ padam || 75 || etatpavitramaghanāśakaraṃ vicitraṃ śambhorguṇānukathanaṃ paramaṃ rahasyam || yaḥ śrāvayedbudhajanānprayataḥ paṭhedvā saṃprāpya bhogavibhavaṃ śiva meti soṃte || 76 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe bhadrāyuśivaprasādakathanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 14 ||
<3.3.15>
|| sūta uvāca || || ṛṣabhasyānubhāvoyaṃ varṇitaḥ śivayoginaḥ || athānyasyāpi vakṣyāmi prabhāvaṃ śivayoginaḥ || 1 || bhasmanaścāpi māhātmyaṃ varṇayāmi samāsataḥ || kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyaṃti yacchutvā pāpino janāḥ || 2 || astyeko vāmadevākhyaḥ śivayogī mahā tapāḥ || nirdvaṃdvo nirguṇaḥ śāṃto niḥsaṃgaḥ samadarśanaḥ || 3 || ātmārāmo jitakrodho gṛhadāravivarjitaḥ || atarkitagatirmaunī saṃtuṣṭo niṣpa rigrahaḥ || 4 || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgo jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || valkalājinasaṃvīto bhikṣāmātraparigrahaḥ || 5 || sa ekadā caraṃlloke sarvānugrahatatparaḥ || krauṃcāraṇyaṃ mahāghoraṃ praviveśa yadṛcchayā || 6 || tasminnirmanuje'raṇye tiṣṭhatyeko'tibhīṣaṇaḥ || kṣuttṛṣākulito nityaṃ yaḥ kaścidbrahmarākṣasaḥ || 7 || taṃ praviṣṭaṃ śivātmānaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā brahmarākṣasaḥ || abhidudrāva vegena jagdhaṃu kṣutparipīḍitaḥ || 8 || vyāttānanaṃ mahākāyaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ bhayānakam || tamāyāṃtamabhiprekṣya yogīśo na cacāla saḥ || 9 || athābhidrutya tarasā sa ghoro vanagocaraḥ || dorbhyāṃ niṣpīḍya jagrāha niṣkaṃpaṃ śivayoginam||3.3.15.10|| tadaṃgasparśanādeva sadyo vidhvastakilbiṣaḥ || sa brahmarākṣaso ghoro viṣaṇṇaḥ smṛtimāyayau || 11 || yathā ciṃtāmaṇiṃ spṛṣṭvā lohaṃ kāṃcanatāṃ vrajet || yathā jaṃbūnadīṃ prāpya mṛttikā svarṇatāṃ vrajet || 12 || yathā mānasamabhyetya vāyasā yāṃti haṃsatām || yathāmṛtaṃ sakṛtpītvā naro devatvamāpnuyāt || || 13 || tathaiva hi mahātmāno darśanasparśanādibhiḥ || sadyaḥ punaṃtyaghopetānsatsaṃgo durlabho hyataḥ || 14 || yaḥ pūrvaṃ kṣutpipāsārto ghorātmā vipine caraḥ || sa sadyastṛptimāyātaḥ pūrṇānaṃdo babhūva ha || 15 || tadgātralagnasitabhasmakaṇānuviddhaḥ sadyo vidhūtaghanapāpatamaḥsvabhāvaḥ || saṃprāptapūrvabhava saṃsmṛtirugrakāryastatpādapadmayugale praṇato babhāṣe || 16 || || rākṣasa uvāca || || prasīda me mahāyoginprasīda karuṇānidhe || prasīda bhavataptānāmānaṃdāmṛvāridhe || 17 || kvāhaṃ pāpamatirghoraḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ || kva te mahānubhāvasya darśanaṃ karuṇātmanaḥ || 18 || uddharoddhara māṃ ghore patitaṃ duḥkhasāgare || tava sannidhimātreṇa mahānaṃdo'bhivardhate || 19 || || vāmadeva uvāca || || kastvaṃ vanecaro ghoro rākṣaso'tra kimāsthitaḥ || kathametāṃ mahāghorāṃ kaṣṭāṃ gatimavāptavān || 3.3.15.20 || || rākṣasa uvāca || || rākṣaso'hamitaḥ pūrvaṃ paṃcaviṃśatime bhave || goptā yavanarāṣṭrasya durjayo nāma vīryavān || 21 || so'haṃ durātmā pāpīyānsvairacārī madotkaṭaḥ || daṃḍadhārī durācāraḥ pracaṃḍo nirghṛṇaḥ khalaḥ || 22 || yuvā bahukalatro'pi kāmāsakto'jiteṃdriyaḥ || imāṃ pāpīyasīṃ ceṣṭāṃ punarekāṃ gato'smyaham || 23 || pratyahaṃ nūtanāmanyā nārīṃ bhoktumanāḥ sadā || āhṛtāḥ sarvadeśebhyo nāryo bhṛtyairmadājñayā || 24 || bhuktvābhuktvā parityaktāmekāmekāṃ dinedine || antargṛheṣu saṃsthāpya punaranyāḥ striyo dhṛtāḥ || 25 || evaṃ svarāṣṭrātpararāṣṭrataśca deśākaragrāmapuravrajebhyaḥ || āhṛtya nāryo ramitā dinedine bhukvā punaḥ kāpi na bhujyate mayā || 26 || athānyaiśca na bhujyaṃte mayā bhuktāstathā striyaḥ || antargṛheṣu nihitāḥ śocaṃte ca divāniśam || 27 || brahmaviṭkṣatraśūdrāṇāṃ yadā nāryo mayā hṛtāḥ || mama rājye sthitā viprāḥ saha dāraiḥ pradudruvuḥ|| 28 || sabhartṛkāśca kanyāśca vidhavāśca rajasvalāḥ || āhṛtya nāryo ramitā mayā kāmahatātmanā ||29|| triśataṃ dvijanārīṇāṃ rājastrīṇāṃ catuḥśatam || ṣaṭśataṃ vaiśyanārīṇāṃ sahasraṃ śūdrayoṣitām || 3.3.15.30 || śataṃ cāṃḍālanadgīrṇā puliṃdīnāṃ sahasrakam || śailūṣīṇāṃ paṃcaśataṃ rajakīnāṃ catuḥśatam||31|| asaṃkhyā vāramukhyāśca mayā bhuktā durātmanā|| tathāpi mayi kāmasya na tṛptiḥ samajāyata || 32 || evaṃ durviṣayāsaktaṃ mattaṃ pānarataṃ sadā || yauvanepi mahārogā viviśuryakṣmakādayaḥ || 33 || rogārdito'napatyaśca śatrubhiścāpi pīḍitaḥ || tyaktomātyaiśca bhṛtyaiśca mṛto'haṃ svena karmaṇā || 34 || āyurvinaśyatyayaśo vivardhate bhāgyaṃ kṣayaṃ yātyatidurgatiṃ vrajet || svargāccyavaṃte pitaraḥ purātanā dharmavyapetasya narasya niścitam || 35 || athāhaṃ kiṃkarairyāmyairnīto vaivasvatālayam || tato'haṃ narake ghore tatkuṇḍe vinipātitaḥ || 36 || tatrāhaṃ narake ghore varṣāṇāmayutatrayam || retaḥ pibanpīḍyamāno nyavasaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 37 || tataḥ pāpāvaśeṣeṇa piśāco nirjane vane || sahasraśiśnaḥ saṃjāto nityaṃ kṣuttṛṣayākulaḥ || 38 || paiśācīṃ gatimāśritya nītaṃ divyaṃ śaracchatam || dvitīyehaṃ bhave jāto vyāghraḥ prāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ || 39 || tṛtīye'jagaro ghoraścaturthe'haṃ bhave vṛkaḥ || paṃcame viḍvarāhaśca ṣaṣṭhe'haṃ kṛkalāsakaḥ || 3.3.15.40 || saptame'haṃ sārameyaḥ sṛgālaścāṣṭame bhave || navame gavayo bhīmo mṛgo'haṃ daśame bhave || 41 || ekādaśe markaṭaśca gṛdhro'haṃ dvādaśe bhave || trayodaśe'haṃ nakulo vāyasaśca catu rdaśe || 42 || acchabhallaḥ paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśe vanakukkuṭaḥ|| gardabho'haṃ saptadaśe mārjāroṣṭādaśe bhave ||43|| ekonaviṃśe maṇḍūkaḥ kūrmo viṃśatime bhave || ekaviṃśe bhave matsyo dvāviṃśe mūṣako'bhavam || 44 || ulūkohaṃ trayoviṃśe caturviśe vanadvipaḥ || paṃcaviṃśe bhave cāsmiñjātohaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ || 45 || kṣutparīto nirāhāro vasāmyatra mahāvane || idānīmāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavaṃtaṃ jagdhumutsukaḥ || tvaddehasparśamātreṇa jātā pūrvabhavasmṛtiḥ || 46 || gatajanma sahasrāṇi smarāmyadya tvadaṃtike || nirvedaśca paro jātaḥ prasannaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca me || 47 || īdṛśo'yaṃ prabhāvaste kathaṃ labdho mahāmate || tapasā vāpi tīvreṇa kimu tīrthaniṣevaṇāt || 48 || yogena devaśaktyā vā maṃtrairvānaṃtaśaktibhiḥ || tattvato brūhi bhagavaṃstvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 49 || || vāmadeva uvāca || || eṣa madgātralagnasya prabhāvo bhasmano mahān || yatsaṃparkāttamovṛttestaveyaṃ matiruttamā || 3.3.15.50 || ko veda bhasmasāmarthyaṃ mahādevā dṛte paraḥ || durvibhāvyaṃ yathā śaṃbhormāhātmyaṃ bhasmanastathā || 51 || purā bhavādṛśaḥ kaścidbrāhmaṇo dharmavarjitaḥ || drāviḍeṣu sthito mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā śūdratāṃ gataḥ || 52 || cauryavṛttirnaiṣkṛtiko vṛṣalīratilālasaḥ|| kadācijjāratāṃ prāptaḥ śūdreṇa nihato niśi || 53 || tacchavasya bahirgrāmā tkṣiptasya pretakarmaṇaḥ || cacāra sārameyoṃ'ge bhasmapādo yadṛcchayā || 54 || atha taṃ narake ghore patitaṃ śivakiṃkarāḥ|| ninyurvimānamāropya prasahya yamakiṃkarān || 55 || śivadūtānsamabhyetya yamopi paripṛṣṭavān || mahāpātakakarttāraṃ kathamenaṃ ninīṣatha || 56 || athocuḥ śivadūtāste paśyāsya śavavigraham || vakṣolalāṭadormūlānyaṃkitāni subhasmanā || 57 || ata enaṃ samānetumāgatāḥ śivaśāsanāt || nāsmānniṣeddhuṃ śaktosi māstvatra tava saṃśayaḥ || 58 || ityābhāṣya yamaṃ śaṃbhordūtāstaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tataḥ || paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ ninyurlokamanāmayam || 59 || tasmādaśeṣapāpānāṃ sadyaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ param || śaṃbhorvibhūṣaṇaṃ bhasma satataṃ dhriyate mayā || 3.3.15.60 || itthaṃ niśamya māhātmyaṃ bhasmano brahmarākṣasaḥ || vistareṇa punaḥ śrotu mautkaṃṭhyādityabhāṣata || 61 || sādhusādhu mahāyogindhanyosmi tava darśanāt || māṃ vimocaya dharmātmanghorādasmātkujanmanaḥ || 62 || kiṃcidastīha me bhāti mayā puṇyaṃ purākṛtam || atohaṃ tvatprasādena muktosmyadya dvijottama || 63 || ekasmai śivabhaktāya tasminpārthivajanmani || bhūmirvṛttikarī dattā sasyārāmānvitā mayā || 99 || yamenāpi tadaivoktaṃ paṃcaviṃśatime bhave || kasyacidyoginaḥ saṃgānmokṣyase saṃsṛteriti || 65 || tadadya phalitaṃ puṇyaṃ yatkiṃcitprāgbhavārjitam || ato nirmanujāraṇye saṃprāptastava saṃgamaḥ || 66 || ato māṃ ghorapāpmānaṃ saṃsaraṃtaṃ kujanmani || samuddhara kṛpāsindho dattvā bhasma samaṃtrakam || 67 || kathaṃ dhāryamidaṃ bhasma ko maṃtraḥ ko vidhiḥ śubhaḥ || kaḥ kālaḥ kaśca vā deśaḥ sarvaṃ kathaya me guro || 68 || bhavādṛśā mahātmānaḥ sadā lokahite ratāḥ || nātmano hitamicchaṃti kalpavṛkṣasadharmiṇaḥ || 69 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktastena yogīśo ghoreṇa vanacāriṇā || bhūyopi bhasmamāhātmyaṃ varṇayāmāsa tattvavit || 3.3.15.70 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe bhasmamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<3.3.16>
|| sūta uvāca | || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ śreṣṭhā vāmadevasya bhāṣitam || 1 || || vāmadeva uvāca || || purā maṃdaraśaileṃdre nānādhātuvicitrite || nānāsatvasamākīrṇe nānādrumalatākule || 2 || kālāgnirudro bhagavānkadācidviśvavaṃditaḥ || samāsasāda bhūteśaḥ svecchayā parameśvaraḥ ||3 || samaṃtātsamupātiṣṭhanrudrāṇāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ || teṣāṃ madhye samāsīno devadevastrilocanaḥ || 4 || tatrāgacchatsuraśraṣṭho devaiḥ saha puraṃdaraḥ || tathāgnirvaruṇo vāyuryamo vaivasvatastathā || 5 || gaṃdharvāścitrasenādyāḥ khecarāḥ pannagādayaḥ || vidyādharāḥ kiṃpuruṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāśca guhyakāḥ || 6 || brahmarṣayo vasiṣṭhādyā nāradādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ || pitaraśca mahātmāno dakṣādyāśca prajeśvarāḥ || 7 || urvaśyādyāścāpsarasaścaṃḍikādyāśca mātaraḥ || ādityā vasavo dasrau viśvedevā mahaujasaḥ || 8 || athānye bhūtapatayo lokasaṃharaṇe kṣamāḥ || mahākālaśca naṃdī ca tathā vai śaṃkhapālakau || 9 || vīrabhadro mahātejāḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ || ghaṃṭākarṇaśca durdharṣo maṇibhadro vṛkodaraḥ || 3.3.16.10 || kuṃḍodaraśca vikaṭāstathā kubhodaro balī || maṃdodaraḥ karṇadhāraḥ keturbhṛṃgīriṭistathā || 11 || bhūtanāthāstathānye ca mahākāyā mahaujasaḥ || kṛṣṇavarṇāstathā śvetāḥ kecinmaṃḍūkasaprabhāḥ || 12 || haritā dhūsarā dhūmrāḥ karburā pītalohitāḥ|| citravarṇā vicitrāṃgāścitralīlā madotkaṭāḥ || 13 || nānāyudhodyatakarā nānāvāhanabhūṣaṇāḥ || kecidvyāghramukhāḥ kecitsūkarāsyā mṛgā nanāḥ || 14 || kecicca nakravadanāḥ sārameyamukhāḥ pare || sṛgālavadanāścānya uṣṭrābhavadanāḥ pare || 15 || keciccharabhabheruṃḍasiṃhāśvoṣṭrabakānanāḥ || ekavaktrā dvivaktrāśca trimukhāścaiva nirmukhāḥ || 16 || ekahastāstrihastāśca paṃcahastāstvahastakāḥ || apādā bahupādāśca bahukarṇaikakarṇakāḥ ||17|| ekanetrāścaturnetrā dīrghāḥ kecana vāmanāḥ || samaṃtātparivāryeśaṃ bhūtanāthamupāsate || 18 || athāgacchanmahātejā munīnāṃ pravaraḥ sudhīḥ || sanatkumāro dharmātmā taṃ draṣṭuṃ jagadīśvaram || 19 || taṃ devadevaṃ viśveśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || mahāpralayasaṃkṣubdhasaptārṇavaghanasvanam || 3.3.16.20 || saṃvarttāgnisamāṭopaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍalaśobhitam || akṣīṇabhālanayanaṃ jvālāmlānamukhatviṣam || 21 || pradīptacūḍāmaṇinā śaśikhaṃḍena śobhitam || takṣakaṃ vāmakarṇena dakṣiṇena ca vāsukim || 22 || bibhrāṇaṃ kuṃḍalayugaṃ nīlaratnamahāhanum || nīlagrīvaṃ mahābāhuṃ nāgahāravirājitam || 23 || phaṇirājaparibhrājatkaṃka ṇāṃgadamudrikam || anaṃtaguṇasāhasramaṇiraṃjitamekhalam || 24 || vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ ghaṃṭādarpaṇabhūṣitam || karkoṭakamahāpadmadhṛtarāṣṭradhanaṃjayaiḥ ||25|| kūjannūpurasaṃghuṣṭapādapadmavirājitam || prāsatomarakhaṭvāṅgaśūlaṭaṃkadhanurdharam || 26 || apradhṛṣyamanirdeśyamaciṃtyākāramīśvaram || ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ praṇa nāma mahāmuniḥ || 27 || taṃ bhaktibhārocchvasitāṃtarātmā saṃstūya vāgbhiḥ śrutisaṃmitābhiḥ || kṛtāṃjaliḥ praśrayanamrakaṃdharaḥ papraccha dharmānakhilāñchu bhapradān || 28 || yānyānapṛcchata munistāṃstāndharmānaśeṣataḥ || provāca bhagavānrudro bhūyo munirapṛcchata || 29 || || sanatkumāra uvāca || || śrutāste bhagavandharmāstvanmukhānmuktihetavaḥ || yairmuktapāpā manujāstariṣyaṃti bhavārṇavam || 3.3.16.30 || athāparaṃ vibho dharmamalpāyāsaṃ mahāphalam || brūhi kāruṇyato mahyaṃ sadyo muktipradaṃ nṛṇām || 31 || abhyāsabahulā dharmāḥ śāstradṛṣṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ || samyaksaṃsevitāḥ kālātsiddhiṃ yacchaṃti vā na vā || 32 || ato lokahitaṃ guhyaṃ bhuktimuktyośca sādhanam || dharmaṃ vijñātumicchāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 33 || || śrīrudra uvāca || || sarveṣāmapi dharmāṇāmuttamaṃ śruticoditam || rahasyaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ yattripuṃḍrasya dhāraṇam || 34 || || sanatkumāra uvāca|| || tripuṃḍrasya vidhiṃ brūhi bhagavañjagatāṃ pate || tattvato jñātumicchāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 35 || kati sthānāni kiṃ dravyaṃ kā śaktiḥ kā ca devatā || kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ca kaḥ karttā ke maṃtrāstasya kiṃ phalam || 36 || etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa tripuṃḍrasya ca lakṣaṇam || brūhi me jagatāṃ nātha lokānugrahakāmyayā || 37 || || śrīrudra uvāca || || āgneyamucyate bhasma dagdhagomayasaṃbhavam || tadeva dravyamityuktaṃ tripuṃḍrasya mahāmune || 38 || sadyojātādibhirbrahmamayairmaṃtraiśca paṃcabhiḥ|| parigṛhyāgnirityādimaṃtrairbhasmābhimaṃtrayet || 39 || mānastoketi saṃmṛṃjya śiro liṃpecca tryaṃbakam || triyāyuṣādibhirmaṃtrairlalāṭe ca bhujadvaye || skaṃdhe ca lepayedbhasma sajalaṃ maṃtrabhāvitam || 3.3.16.40 || tisro rekhā bhavaṃtyeṣu sthāneṣu munipuṃgava || bhruvormadhyaṃ samārabhya yāvadaṃto bhruvorbhavet || 41 || madhyamānāmikāṃgulyormadhye tu pratilomataḥ || aṃguṣṭhena kṛtā rekhā tripuṃḍrasyābhidhīyate || 42 || tisṛṇāmapi rekhāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ nava devatāḥ || akāro gārhapatyaśca ṛgbhūrloko rajastathā || 43 || ātmā caiva kriyāśaktiḥ prātaḥ savanameva ca || mahādevastu rekhāyāḥ prathamāyāstu devatā || 44 || ukāro dakṣiṇāgniśca nabhaḥ sattvaṃ yajustathā || madhyaṃdinaṃ ca savanamicchāśaktyaṃtarātmakau || 45 || maheśvaraśca rekhāyā dvitīyāyāśca devatā || makārāhavanīyau ca paramātmā tamo divaḥ || 46 || jñānaśaktiḥ sāmavedastṛtīyasavanaṃ tathā || śivaśceti tṛtīyāyā rekhāyāścādhidevatā || 47 || etā nityaṃ namaskṛtya tripuṃḍraṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ || maheśvaravratamidaṃ sarvavedeṣu kīrtitam ||48|| muktikāmairnaraiḥ sevyaṃ punasteṣāṃ na saṃbhavaḥ || tripuṃḍraṃ kurute yastu bhasmanā vidhipūrvakam ||49|| brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vanastho yatireva vā|| mahāpātakasaṃghātairmucyate copapātakaiḥ||3.3.16.50|| tathānyaiḥ kṣatraviṭśūdrastrīgohatyā dipātakaiḥ|| vīrahatyāśvahatyābhyāṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||51|| amaṃtreṇāpi yaḥ kuryādajñātvā mahimonnatim|| tripuṃḍraṃ bhālapaṭale mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||52|| paradravyāpaharaṇaṃ paradārābhimarśanam|| paraniṃdā parakṣetraharaṇaṃ parapīḍanam||53|| sasyārāmādiharaṇaṃ gṛhadāhādikarma ca || asatyavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ pāruṣyaṃ vedavikra yaḥ|| kūṭasākṣyaṃ vratatyāgaḥ kaitavaṃ nīcasevanam ||54|| gobhūhiraṇyamahiṣī tilakaṃbalavāsasām|| annadhānyajalādīnāṃ nīcebhyaśca parigrahaḥ||55|| dāsī veśyābhujaṃgeṣu vṛṣalīṣu naṭīṣu ca || rajasvalāsu kanyāsu vidhavāsu ca saṃgamaḥ || 56 || māṃsacarmarasādīnāṃ lavaṇasya ca vikrayaḥ || evamādīnya saṃkhyāni pāpāni vividhāni ca || 57 || sadya eva vinaśyaṃti tripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇāt || śivadravyāpaharaṇaṃ śivaniṃdā ca kutracit || 58 || niṃdā ca śivabhaktānāṃ prāyaścitairna śuddhyati || rudrākṣā yasya gātreṣu lalāṭe ca tripuṃḍrakam ||59|| sa cāṃḍālo'pi saṃpūjyaḥ sarvavarṇottamo bhavet || yāni tīrthāni loke'smingaṃgāyāḥ saritaśca yāḥ || 3.3.16.60 || snāto bhavati sarvatra lalāṭe yastripuṃḍradhṛk || saptakoṭimahāmaṃtrāḥ paṃcākṣarapuraḥsarāḥ || || 61 || tathānye koṭiśo maṃtrāḥ śaivāḥ kaivalyahetavaḥ || te sarve yena japtāḥ syuryo bibharti tripuṃḍrakam || 62 || sahasraṃ pūrvajātānāṃ sahasraṃ ca janiṣyatām || svavaṃśajānāṃ martyānāmuddharedyastripuṃḍradhṛk|| 63 || iha bhuktvākhilānbhogāndīrghāyurvyādhivarjitaḥ || jīvitāṃte ca maraṇaṃ sukhanaivaṃ prapadyate || 64 || aṣṭaiśvaryaguṇopetaṃ prāpya divyaṃ vapuḥ śubham || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya divyastrīśatasevitaḥ || 65 || vidyādharāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ gaṃdharvāṇāṃ mahaujasām || iṃdrādilokapālānāṃ lokeṣu ca yathākramam || 66 || bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulānprajeśānāṃ pureṣu ca || brahmaṇaḥ padamāsādya tatra kalpaśataṃ ramet || 67 || viṣṇorloke ca ramate yāvadbrahmaśatatrayam || 68 || śivalokaṃ tataḥ prāpya ramate kālamakṣayam || śivasāyujyamāpnoti na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 69 || sarvopaniṣadāṃ sāraṃ samālocya muhurmuhuḥ || idameva hi nirṇītaṃ paraṃ śreyastripuṃḍrakam || 3.3.16.70 || etattripuṃḍramāhātmyaṃ samāsātkathitaṃ mayā || rahasyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ gopanīyamidaṃ tvayā || 71 || ityuktvā bhagavānrudrastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || sanatkumāro'pi munirjagāma brahmaṇaḥ padam || 72 || tavāpi bhasmasaṃparkātsaṃjātā vimalā matiḥ || tvamapi śraddhayā puṇyaṃ dhārayasva tripuṃḍrakam || 73 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā vāmadevastu śivayogī mahātapāḥ || abhimaṃtrya dadau bhasma ghorāya brahmarakṣase || 74 || tenāsau bhālapaṭale cakre tirya ktripuṃḍrakam || brahmarākṣasatāṃ sadyo jahau tasyānubhāvataḥ || 75 || sa babhau sūryasaṃkāśastejomaṇḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || divyāvayarūpaiśca divyamālyāṃbaro jjvalaḥ || 76 || bhaktyā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya taṃ guruṃ śivayoginam || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya puṇyalokāñjagāma saḥ || 77 || vāmadevo mahāyogī dattvā tasmai parāṃ gatim || cacāra loke mūḍhātmā sākṣādiva śivaḥ svayam || 78 || ya etadbhasmamāhātmyaṃ tripuṃḍraṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ || śrāvayedvā paṭhedvāpi sa hi yāti parāṃ gatim || 79 || kathayati śivakīrtiṃ saṃsṛtermuktihetuṃ praṇamati śivayogidhyeyamīśāṃghripadmam || racayati śivabhaktodbhāsi bhāle tripuṃḍraṃ na punariha jananyā garbhavāsaṃ bhajetsaḥ || 3.3.16.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottara khaṇḍe bhasmamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || ||
<3.3.17>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vedavedāṃgatattvajñairgurubhirbrahmavādibhiḥ || nṛṇāṃ kṛtopadeśānāṃ sadyaḥ siddhirhi jāyate||1|| athānyajanasāmānyairgurubhirnītikovidaiḥ|| nṛṇāṃ kṛtopadeśānāṃ siddhirbhavati kīdṛśī || 2 || || || sūta uvāca || || śraddhaiva sarvadharmasya cātīva hitakāriṇī || śraddhayaiva nṛṇāṃ siddhirjāyate lokayordvayoḥ || 3 || śraddhayā bhajataḥ puṃsaḥ śilāpi phaladāyinī || mūrkho'pi pūjito bhaktyā gururbhavati siddhidaḥ || 4 || śraddhayā paṭhito mantrastvabaddhopi phalapradaḥ || śraddhayā pūjito devo nīcasyāpi phalapradaḥ || 5 || aśraddhayā kṛtā pūjā dānaṃ yajñastapo vratam || sarvaṃ niṣphalatāṃ yāti puṣpaṃ vandhyata roriva || 6 || sarvatra saṃśayāviṣṭaḥ śraddhāhīno'ticaṃcalaḥ || paramārthātparibhraṣṭaḥ saṃsṛterna hi mucyate || 7 || mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau || yādṛśī bhāvanā yatra siddhirbhavati tādṛśī || 8 || ato bhāvamayaṃ viśvaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ca bhāvataḥ || te ubhe bhāvahīnasya na bhavetāṃ kadācana || 9 || atredaṃ paramāścaryamākhyānamanuvarṇyate || aśraddhā sarvamartyānāṃ yena sadyo nivartate || 3.3.17.10 || āsītpāṃcālarājasya siṃhaketuriti śrutaḥ || putraḥ sarvaguṇopetaḥ kṣātradharmarataḥ sadā || 11 || sa ekadā katipayairbhṛtyairyukto mahābalaḥ || jagāma mṛgayāhetorbahu sattvānvitaṃ vanam || 12 || tadbhṛtyaḥ śabaraḥ kaścidvicaranmṛgayāṃ vane || dadarśa jīrṇaṃ sphuṭitaṃ patitaṃ devatālayam || 13 || tatrāpaśyadbhinnapīṭhaṃ patitaṃ sthaṃḍilopari || śivaliṃṅgamṛjuṃ sūkṣmaṃ mūrtaṃ bhāgyamivātmanaḥ || 14 || sa samādāya vegena pūrvakarmapracoditaḥ || tasmai saṃdarśayāmāsa rāja putrāya dhīmate || 15 || paśyedaṃ ruciraṃ liṃgaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamiha prabho || tadetatpūjayiṣyāmi yathāvibhavamādarāt || 16 || asya pūjāvidhiṃ brūhi yathā devo maheśvaraḥ || amaṃtrajñaiśca mantrajñaiḥ prīto bhavati pūjitaḥ || 17 || iti tena niṣādena pṛṣṭaḥ pārthivanaṃdanaḥ || pratyuvāca prahasyainaṃ parihāsa vicakṣaṇaḥ || 18 || saṃkalpena sadā kuryādabhiṣekaṃ navāṃbhasā || upaveśyāsane śuddhe śubhairgaṃdhākṣatairnavaiḥ || vanyaiḥ patraiśca kusumairdhūpairdīpaiśca pūjayeta || || 19 || citābhasmopahāraṃ ca prathamaṃ parikalpayet || ātmopabhogyenānnena naivadyaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ || 3.3.17.20 || punaśca dhūpadīpādīnupacārānprakalpet || nṛtyavāditragītādīnyathāvatparikalpayet || 21 || namaskṛtvā tu vidhivatprasādaṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ || eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ proktaḥ śivapūjāvidhistava || || 22 || citābhasmopahāreṇa sadyastuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ || 23 || || sūta uvāca || || parihāsarasenetthaṃ śāsitaḥ svāminā'munā || sa caṃḍakākhyaḥ śabaro mūrdhnā jagrāha tadvacaḥ || 24 || tataḥ svabhavanaṃ prāpya liṃgamūrti maheśvaram || pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa citābhasmopahārakṛt || 25 || yaccātmanaḥ priyaṃ vastu gandhapuṣpākṣatādikam || nivedya śaṃbhave nityamupāyuṃkta tataḥ svayam || 26 || evaṃ maheśvaraṃ bhaktyā saha patnyābhyapūjayat || śabaraḥ sukhamāsādya nināya katicitsamāḥ || 27 || ekadā śivapūjāyai pravṛttaḥ śabarottamaḥ || na dadarśa citābhasma pātre pūritamaṇvapi || 28 || athāsau tvarito dūramanviṣyanparito bhraman || na labdhavāṃścitābhasma śrāṃto gṛhamagātpunaḥ || 29 || tata āhūya patnīṃ svāṃ śabaro vākyamabravīt || na labdhaṃ me citābhasma kiṃ karomi vada priye ||3.3.17.30|| śivapūjāṃtarāyo me jātodya bata pāpmanaḥ || pūjāṃ vinā kṣaṇamapi nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe ||31|| upāyaṃ nātra paśyāmi pūjopakaraṇe hate || na gurośca vihanyeta śāsanaṃ sakalārthadam || 32 || iti vyākulitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bharttāraṃ śabarāṃganā || pratyabhāṣata mā bhaistvamupāyaṃ pravadāmi te || 33 || idameva gṛhaṃ dagdhvā bahukālopabṛṃhitam || ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi citābhasma bhavettataḥ || 34 || || śabara uvāca || || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dehaḥ paramasādhanam || kathaṃ tyajasi taṃ dehaṃ sukhārthaṃ navayauvanam || 35 || adhunā tvanapatyā tvamabhuktaviṣayāsavā || bhogayogyamimaṃ dehaṃ kathaṃ dagdhumihecchasi || 36 || || śabaryuvāca || || etāvadeva sāphalyaṃ jīvitasya ca janmanaḥ || parārthe yastyajetprāṇāñchivārthe kimuta svayam || 37 || kiṃ nu taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ kiṃ vā dattaṃ mayā purā || kiṃ vārcanaṃ kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pūrvajanmaśatāṃtare || 38 || kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ mama pituḥ kā vā mātuḥ kṛtārthatā || yacchivārthe samiddhe'gnau tyajāmyetatkalevaram || 39 || itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyā bhaktiṃ ca śaṃkare || tatheti dṛḍhasaṃkalpaḥ śabaraḥ pratyapūjayat || 3.3.17.40 || sā bharttāramanuprāpya snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtā || gṛhamādīpya taṃ vahniṃ bhaktyā cakre pradakṣiṇam || 41 || namaskṛtvātmagurave dhyātvā hṛdi sadāśivam || agnipraveśābhimukhī kṛtāṃjaliridaṃ jagau || 42 || || śabaryuvāca || || puṣpāṇi saṃtu tava deva mameṃdriyāṇi dhūpo'gururvapuridaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradīpaḥ || prāṇā havīṃṣi karaṇāni tavākṣatāśca pūjāphalaṃ vrajatu sāṃpratameṣa jīvaḥ || 43 || vāṃchāmi nāhamapi sarvadhanādhipatyaṃ na svargabhūmimacalāṃ na padaṃ vidhātuḥ || bhūyo bhavāmi yadi janmanijanmani syāṃ tvatpādapaṃkajalasanmakaraṃdabhṛṃgī || 44 || janmāni saṃtu mama deva śatādhikāni māyā na me vi śatu cittamabodhahetuḥ || kiṃcitkṣaṇārdhamapi te caraṇāravindānnāpaitu me hṛdayamīśa namonamaste ||45|| iti prasādya deveśaṃ śabarī dṛḍhaniścayā || viveśa jvalitaṃ vahniṃ bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt || 46 || śabaropi ca tadbhasma yatnena parigṛhya saḥ || cakre dagdhagṛhopānte śivapūjāṃ samāhitaḥ || 46 || atha sasmāra pūjāṃte prasādagrahaṇocitām || dayitāṃ nityamāyāṃtīṃ prāṃjaliṃ vinayānvitām || 48 || smṛtamātrāṃ tadāpaśyadāgatāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitām || pūrveṇāvayavenaiva bhaktinamrāṃ śucismitām || 49 || tāṃ vīkṣya śabaraḥ patnīṃ pūrvavatprāṃjaliṃ sthitām || bhasmāvaśeṣitagṛhaṃ yathāpūrvamavasthitam ||| || 3.3.17.50 || agnirdahati tejobhiḥ sūryo dahati raśmibhiḥ || rājā dahati daṃḍena brāhmaṇo manasā dahet || 51 || kimayaṃ svapna āhosvitkiṃ vā māyā bhramātmikā || iti vismayasaṃbhrātastāṃ bhūyaḥ paryapṛcchata || 52 || api tvaṃ ca kathaṃ prāptā bhasmabhūtāsi pāvake || dagdhaṃ ca bhavanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathaṃ pūrva vadāsthitam || 53 || || śabaryuvāca || || yadā gṛhaṃ samuddīpya praviṣṭāhaṃ hutāśane || tadātmānaṃ na jānāmi na paśyāmi hutāśanam || 54 || na tāpaleśopyāsīnme praviṣṭāyā ivodakam || suṣupteva kṣaṇārdhena prabuddhāsmi punaḥ kṣaṇāt || 55 || tāvadbhavanamadrākṣamadagdhamiva susthitam || adhunā devapūjāṃte prasādaṃ labdhumāgatā || 56 || evaṃ parasparaṃ premṇā daṃpatyorbhāṣamāṇayoḥ || prādurāsīttayoragre vimānaṃ divyamadbhutam || 57 || tasminvimāne śatacandrabhāsvare catvāra īśānucarāḥ puraḥsarāḥ || haste gṛhītvātha niṣādadaṃpatī āropayāmāsuramuktavigrahau || 58 || tayorniṣādadaṃpatyostatkṣaṇādeva tadvapuḥ || śivadūtakarasparśāttatsārūpyamavāpa ha || 59 || tasmācchraddhaiva sarveṣu vidheyā puṇyakarmasu || nīcopi śabaraḥ prāpa śraddhayā yogināṃ gatim || 3.3.17.60 || kiṃ janmanā sakalavarṇajanottamena kiṃ vidyayā sakalaśāstravicāravatyā || yasyāsti cetasi sadā parameśabhaktiḥ ko'nyastatastribhuvane puruṣosti dhanyaḥ || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe bhasmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<3.3.18>
|| sūta uvāca || || athāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvadharmottamottamam || umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma vrataṃ sarvārthasiddhidam || 1 || ānartta saṃbhavaḥ kaścinnāmnā vedaratho dvijaḥ || kalatraputrasaṃpanno vidvānuttamavaṃśajaḥ || 2 || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya brāhmaṇasya gṛhāśrame || babhūva śāradānāma kanyā kamalalocanā ||3|| tāṃ rūpalakṣaṇopetāṃ bālāṃ dvādaśahāyanām || yayāce padmanābhākhyo mṛtadāraśca sa dvijaḥ || 4 || mahādhanasya śāṃtasya sadā rājasakhasya ca || yāñcābhaṃgabhayāttasya tāṃ kanyāṃ pradadau pitā || 5 || madhyaṃdine kṛtodvāhaḥ sa vipraḥ śvaśurālaye || saṃdhyāmupāsituṃ sāyaṃ sarastaṭamupāyayau ||6|| upāsya saṃdhyāṃ vidhivatpratyāgacchattamovṛte || mārge daṣṭo bhujaṃgena mamāra nijakarmaṇā ||7|| tasminmṛte kṛtodvāhe sahasā tasya bāṃdhavāḥ || cukruśuḥ śokasaṃtaptau śvaśurāvasya kanyakā || 8 || nirhṛtya taṃ baṃdhujanā jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam || śāradā prāptavaidhavyā piturevālaye sthitā ||9|| bhūtācchādanabhojyena bhartrā virahitā satī|| nināya katicinmāsānsā bālā pitṛmaṃdire||3.3.18.10|| ekadā naidhruvo nāma kaścidvṛddhataro muniḥ|| andhaḥ śiṣyakaragrāhī tanmaṃdiramupāyayau || 11 || tasminvṛddhe gṛhaṃ prāpte kvāpi yāteṣu baṃdhuṣu || sākṣādivātmano daivaṃ sā bālā samupāgamat || || 12 || svāgataṃ te mahābhāga pīṭhesminnupaviśyatām || namaste munināthāya priyaṃ te karavāṇi kim || 13 || ityuktvā bhaktimāsthāya kṛtvā pādāvanejanam || vījayitvā pariśrāṃtaṃ taṃ muniṃ paryatoṣayat || 14 || śrāṃtaṃ pīṭhe samāveśya kṛtvābhyaṃgaṃ svapāṇinā || kṛtasnānaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtadevārcanaṃ munim || 15 || sukhāsanopaviṣṭaṃ taṃ dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ || arcayitvā varānnena bhojayāmāsa sādaram || 16 || bhuktvā ca samyakchanakaistṛptaścānaṃdanirbharaḥ || cakārāṃdhamunistasyai suprītaḥ paramāśiṣam || 17 || vihṛtya bhartrā sahasā ca tena labdhvā sutaṃ sarvaguṇairvariṣṭham || kīrtiṃ ca loke mahatīmavāpya prasādayogyā bhava devatānām || 18 || ityabhivyāhṛtaṃ tena muninā gatacakṣuṣā || niśamya vismitā bālā pratyuvāca kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 19 || brahmaṃstvadvacanaṃ satyaṃ kadācinna mṛṣā bhavet || tadetanmaṃdabhāgyāyāḥ kathametatphaliṣyati || 3.3.18.20 || śilāgryāmiva sadvṛṣṭiḥ śunakyāmiva satkriyā || viphalā maṃdabhāgyāyāmāśīrbrahmavidāmapi || 21 || saiṣāhaṃ vidhavā brahmanduṣkarmaphalabhāginī || tvadāśīrvacanasyāsya kathaṃ yāsyāmi pātratām || 22 || || muniruvāca || || tvāmanālakṣya yatproktamaṃdhenāpi mayā'dhunā || tadetatsādhayiṣyāmi kuru macchāsanaṃ śubhe || 23 || umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma vrataṃ yadi cariṣyasi || tena vratānubhāvena sadyaḥ śreyo'nubhokṣyase || 24 || || śāradovāca || || tvayopadiṣṭaṃ yatnena cariṣyāmyapi duścaram || tadvrataṃ brūhi me brahmanvidhānaṃ vada vistarāt || 25 || || muniruvāca || || caitre vā mārgaśīrṣe vā śuklapakṣe śubhe dine || vratāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta yathāvadgurvanujñayā || 26 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmubhayorapi parvaṇoḥ || saṃkalpaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā prātaḥsnānaṃ samācaret || 27 || santarpya pitṛdevādīngatvā svabhavanaṃ prati || maṃḍapaṃ racayeddivyaṃ vitānādyairalaṃkṛtam || 28 || phalapallavapuṣpādyaistoraṇaiśca samanvitam || paṃcavarṇaiśca tanmadhye rajobhiḥ padmamuddharet || 29 || caturdaśadalairbāhye dvāviṃśadbhistadaṃtare || tadaṃtaraṃ ṣoḍaśabhiraṣṭabhiśca tadaṃtare || 3.3.18.30 || evaṃ padmaṃ samuddhatya paṃcavarṇairmanoramam || caturasraṃ tataḥ kuryādaṃtarvartulamuttamam || 31 || vrīhitaṃḍularāśiṃ ca tanmadhye ca sakūrcakam || kūrcopari susaṃsthāpya kalaśaṃ vāripūritam || 32 || kalaśopari vinyasya vastraṃ varṇasamanvitam || tasyopariṣṭātsauvarṇyau pratime śivayoḥ śubhe || nidhāya pūjayedbhaktyā yathāvibhavavistaram || 33 || paṃcāmṛtaistu saṃsnāpya tathā śuddhodakena ca || rudraikādaśakaṃ japtvā paṃcākṣaraśatāṣṭakam || 34 || abhimaṃtrya punaḥ sthāpya pīṭhaṃ madhye tathārcayet || svayaṃ śuddhāsanāsīno dhautaśuklāṃbaraḥ sudhīḥ || 35 || pīṭhamāmaṃtrya maṃtreṇa prāṇāyāmānsamācaret || saṃkalpaṃ pravadettatra śivāgre vihitāṃjaliḥ || 36 || yāni pāpāni ghorāṇi janmāṃtaraśateṣu me || teṣāṃ sarvavināśāya śivapūjāṃ samārabhe || 37 || saubhāgyavijayārogyadharmaiśvaryābhivṛddhaye || svargāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ kariṣye śivapūjanam || 38 || iti saṃkalpamuccārya yathāvatsusamāhitaḥ || aṃganyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyedīśaṃ ca pārvatīm || 39 || kuṃdeṃdudhavalākāraṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitam || varadābhayahastaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ paraśuṃ mṛgam || 3.3.18.40 || sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ jagadānaṃdakāraṇam || jāhnavījalasaṃparkāddīrghapiṃgajaṭādharam || 41 || urageṃdraphaṇodbhūtamahāmukuṭamaṃḍitam || śītāṃśukhaṃḍavilasatkoṭīrāṃgadabhūṣaṇam || 42 || unmīladbhālanayanaṃ tathā sūryeṃdulocanam || nīlakaṃṭhaṃ caturbāhuṃ gajeṃdrājinavāsasam || 43 || ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitam || devīṃ ca divyavasanāṃ bālasūryāyutadyutim || 44 || bālaveṣāṃ ca tanvaṃgīṃ bālaśītāṃśuśekharām || pāśāṃkuśavarābhītiṃ bibhratīṃ ca caturbhujām || 45 || prasādasumukhīmaṃbāṃ līlārasavihāriṇīm || lasatkurabakāśokapunnāganavacaṃpakaiḥ || 46 || kṛtāvataṃsāmutphullamallikotkalitālakām || kāṃcīkalāpaparyastajaghanābhogaśālinīm || 47 || udārakiṃkiṇīśreṇīnūpurāḍhyapadadvayām || gaṃḍamaṃḍalasaṃsaktaratnakuṃḍalaśobhitām || 48 || biṃbādharānuraktāṃśulasaddaśana kuḍmalām || mahārharatnagreveyatārahāravirājitām ||49|| navamāṇikyarucirakaṃkaṇāṃgadamudrikām || raktāṃśukaparīdhānāṃ ratnamālyānulepanām || 3.3.18.50 || | udyatpīnakucadvaṃdvaniṃditāṃbhojakuḍmalām || līlālolāsitāpāṃgīṃ bhaktānugrahadāyinīm || 51 || evaṃ dhyātvā tu hṛtpadme jagataḥ pitarau śivau || japtvā tadātmakaṃ maṃtraṃ tadaṃte bahirarcayet || 52 || āvāhya pratimāyugme kalpayedāsanādikam || arghyaṃ ca dadyācchivayormaṃtreṇānena maṃtravit || 53 || namaste pārvatīnātha trailokyavaradarṣabha || tryaṃbakeśa mahādeva gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 54 || namaste devadeveśi prapannabhayahāriṇi || aṃbike varade devi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śivapriye || 55 || iti trivāramuccārya dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ || gandhapuṣpākṣatānsamyagdhūpadīpānprakalpayet || 56 || naivedyaṃ pāyasānnena ghṛtāktaṃ parikalpayet || juhuyānmūlamaṃtreṇa haviraṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 57 || tata udvāsya naivedyaṃ dhūpanīrājanādikam || kṛtvā nivedya tāṃbūlaṃ namaskuryātsamāhitaḥ || 58 || athābhyarcyopacāreṇa bhojayedvipradaṃpatī || 59 || evaṃ sāyaṃtanīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā viprānumoditaḥ || bhuṃjīta vāgyato rātrau haviṣyaṃ kṣīrabhāvitam || 3.3.18.60 || evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kuryādvrataṃ pakṣadvaye budhaḥ || tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vratodyāpanamācaret || 61 || śatarudrābhijaptena snāpayetpratime jalaiḥ || āgamoktena mantreṇa saṃpūjya girijāśivau || 62 || savastraṃ sasuvarṇa ca kalaśaṃ prati mānvitam|| dattvācāryāya mahate sadācāraratāya ca || brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā yathāśaktyābhipūjya ca || 63 || dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo gohiraṇyāṃbarādikam || bhuṃjīta tadanujñātaḥ saheṣṭajanabaṃdhubhiḥ || 64 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam || triḥsaptakulamuddhṛtya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsi tān || 65 || indrādilokapālānāṃ sthāneṣu ramate dhuvam || brahmaloke ca ramate viṣṇuloke ca śāśvate || 66 || śivalokamatha prāpya tatra kalpaśataṃ punaḥ || bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulāñchivameva prapadyate || 67 || mahāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ tvamapi śraddhayā cara || atyaṃtadurlabhaṃ vāpi lapsyase ca manoratham || || 68 || ityādiṣṭā munīṃdreṇa sā bālā muditā bhṛśam || pratyagrahītsuviśrabdhā tadvākyaṃ sumanoharam || 69 || atha tasyāḥ samāyātāḥ pitṛmātṛ sahodarāḥ || taṃ muniṃ sukhamāsīnaṃ dadṛśuḥ kṛtabhojanam || 3.3.18.70 || sahasāgatya te sarve namaścakrurmahātmane || prasīda naḥ prasīdeti gṛṇataḥ paryapūja yan || 71 || śrutvā ca te tayā sādhvyā pūjitaṃ paramaṃ munim || anugrahavataṃ tasyai śrutvā harṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ || 72 || te kṛtāṃjalayaḥ sarve tamūcurmuni puṃgavam || 73 || adya dhanyā vayaṃ sarve tavāgamanamātrataḥ || pāvitaṃ naḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhaṃ ca saphalīkṛtam || 74 || iyaṃ ca śāradā nāma kanyā vaidhavyamāgatā || kenāpi karmayogena durvilaṃghyena bhūyasā || 75 || saiṣādya tava pādābjaṃ prapannā śaraṇaṃ satī || imāṃ samuddharāsahyātsughorādduḥkha sāgarāt || 76 || tvayāpi tāvadatraiva sthātavyaṃ no gṛhāṃtike || asmadgṛhamaṭhe'pyasminsnānapūjājapocite || 77 || eṣā bālāpi bhagavankurvaṃtī tvatpadārcanam || vrataṃ tvatsannidhāveva cariṣyati mahāmune || 78 || yāvatsamāptimāyāti vratamasyāstvadaṃtike || uṣitvā tāvadatraiva kṛtārthānkuru no guro || 79 || evamabhyarthitaḥ sarvaistasyā bhrātṛjanādibhiḥ || tatheti sa muniśreṣṭhastatrovāsa maṭhe śubhe || 3.3.18.80 || sāpi tenopadiṣṭena mārgeṇa girijāśivau || arcayaṃtī vrataṃ samyakcacāra vimalā satī || 81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe umāmaheśvaravratācaraṇaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<3.3.19>
|| sūta uvāca || || evaṃ mahāvrataṃ tasyāścaraṃtyā gurusannidhau || saṃvatsaro vyatīyāya niyamāsaktacetasaḥ || 1 || saṃvatsarāṃte sā bālā tatraiva pitṛmaṃdire || cakārodyāpanaṃ samyagviprabhojanapūrvakam || 2 || dattvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo yathārhataḥ || visṛjya tānnamaskṛtya pitṛbhyāmabhinaṃditā || 3 || upoṣitā svayaṃ tasmindine niyamamāśritā || jajāpa paramaṃ maṃtramupadiṣṭaṃ mahātmanā || 4 || atha pradoṣasamaye prāpte saṃpūjya śaṃkaram || tasmingṛhāṃtikamaṭhe gurostasya ca sannidhau || 5 || japārcanaratā sādhvī dhyāyatī parameśvaram || tasmiñjāgaraṇe rātrāvupaviṣṭā śivāṃtike || 6 || yugmam || tasyāṃ rātrau tayā sārdhaṃ sa munirjagadaṃbikām || japadhyāna tapobhiśca toṣayāmāsa pārvatīm|| 7 || tasyāśca bhaktyā vratabhāvitāyā munestapoyogasamādhinā ca || tuṣṭā bhavānī jagadekamātā prādurbabhūvā kṛtasāṃdramūrtiḥ || 8 || prādurbhūtā yadā gaurī tayoragre jaganmayī || andho'pi tatkṣaṇādeva muniḥ prāpa dṛśordvayam || 9 || tāṃ vīkṣya jagatāṃ dhātrīmāvirbhūtāṃ puraḥsthitām || nipetatustatpadayoḥ sa muniḥ sā ca kanyakā || 3.3.19.10 || tau bhaktibhāvocchvasitāmalāśayāvānaṃdabāṣpokṣita sarvagātrau || utthāpya devī kṛpayā pariplutā premṇā babhāṣe mṛduvalgubhāṣiṇī || 11 || || devyuvāca || || prītāsmi te muniśreṣṭha vatse prītāsmi te'naghe || kiṃ vā dadāmyabhimataṃ devānāmapi durlabham || 12 || || muniruvāca || || eṣā tu śāradā nāma kanyā tu gatabhatṛkā || mayā pratiśrutaṃ cāsyai tuṣṭena gatacakṣuṣā || 13 || saha bhartrā ciraṃ kālaṃ vihṛtya sutamuttamam || labhasveti mayā proktaṃ satyaṃ kuru namo'stu te || 14 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || eṣā pūrvabhave bālā drāviḍasya dvijanmanaḥ || āsīddvitīyā dayitā bhāminī nāma viśrutā || 15 || sā bhartṛpreyasī nityaṃ rūpamādhuryapeśalā || bhartāraṃ vaśamāninye rūpavaśyādikaitavaiḥ | 16 || asyāṃ cāsaktahṛdayaḥ sa vipro mohayaṃtritaḥ || kadācidapi naivāgājjyeṣṭhapatnīṃ pativratām || 17 || anabhyāgamanādbhartuḥ sā nārī putravarjitā || sadā śokena saṃtaptā kālena nidhanaṃ gatā || 18 || asyā gṛhasamīpastho yaḥ kaścidbrāhmaṇo yuvā || imāṃ vīkṣyātha cārvaṃgīṃ kāmārtaḥ karamagrahīt || 19 || anayā roṣatāmrākṣyā sa viprastu nivāritaḥ || imāṃ smarandivānaktaṃ nidhanaṃ pratyapadyata || 3.3.19.20 || eṣā saṃmohya bhartāraṃ jyeṣṭhapatnyāṃ parāṅmukham || cakāra tena pāpena bhavesminvidhavā'bhavat || 21 || yāḥ kurvaṃti striyo loke jāyāpatyośca vipriyam || tāsāṃ kaumāravaidhavyamekaviṃśatijanmasu || 22 || yadetayā pūrvabhave matpūjā mahatī kṛtā || tena puṇyena tatpāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ tadaiva hi || 23 || yo vipro virahārtaḥ sanmṛtaḥ kāmavimohitaḥ || so'syāḥ pāṇigrahaṃ kṛtvā bhavesminnidhanaṃ gataḥ || 24 || prāgjanmapatiretasyāḥ pāṃḍyarāṣṭreṣu so'dhunā || jāto vipravaraḥ śrīmānsadāraḥ saparicchadaḥ || 25 || tena bhartrā pratiniśaṃ saiṣā premṇābhisaṃgatā || svapne ratisukhaṃ yātu śreṣṭhaṃ jāgaraṇādapi ||26|| ṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatayojanadūrasaṃstho deśādito dvijavaraḥ sa ca karmagatyā || enāṃ vadhūṃ pratiniśaṃ manasobhirāmāṃ svapneṣu paśyati ciraṃ
