ratimādadhānaḥ || 27 || saiṣā vai svapnasaṃgatyā patyuḥ pratiniśaṃ satī || kālena lapsyate putraṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam || 28 || etasyāṃ tanayaṃ jātamātmanaścirasaṃgamāt || so'pi vipro'niśaṃ svapne drakṣyati premabhāvitam || 29 || anayārādhitā pūrve bhave sāhaṃ mahāmune || asyaiva varadānāya prādurbhūtāsmi sāṃpratam || 3.3.19.30 || || sūta uvāca || || athovāca mahādevī tāṃ bālāṃ prati sādaram || ayi vatse mahābhāge śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ || 31 || yadā kadāpi bharttāraṃ kvāpi deśe purātanam || drakṣyasi svapnadṛṣṭaṃ prākjñāsyase tvaṃ vicakṣaṇā || 32 || tvāṃ drakṣyati sa vipropi sunayāṃ svapnalakṣaṇām || tadā parasparālāpo yuvayoḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 33 || tadā svatanayaṃ bhadre tasmai dehi bahuśrutam || phalamasya vratasyāgryaṃ tasya haste samarpaya || 34 || tataḥ prabhṛti tasyaiva vaśe tiṣṭha sumadhyame || yuvayodaihikaḥ saṃgo mābhūtsvapnaratādṛte || 35 || kālātpaṃcatvamāpanne tasminbrāhmaṇasattame || agniṃ praviśya tenaiva saha yāsyasi matpadam || 36 || putraste bhavitā subhru sarvalokamanoramaḥ || saṃpadaśca bhaviṣyaṃti prāpsyate paramaṃ padam || 37 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā trijaganmātā dattvā tasyai manoratham || tayoḥ saṃpaśyatoreva kṣaṇenādarśanaṃ gatā || 38 || sāpi bālā varaṃ labdhvā pārvatyāḥ karuṇānidheḥ || avāpa paramānaṃdaṃ pūjayāmāsa taṃ gurum || 39 || tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ sa munirlabdhalocanaḥ || tasyāḥ pitrośca tatsarvaṃ rahasyācaṣṭa dharmavit || 3.3.19.40 || atha sarvānupāmaṃtrya śāradāṃ ca yaśasvinīm || vidhāyānugrahaṃ teṣāṃ yayau svairagatirmuniḥ || 41 || evaṃ dineṣu gacchatsu sā bālā ca pratikṣaṇam || bhartuḥ samāgamaṃ lebhe svapne sukha vivardhanam || 42 || gauryā varapradānena śāradā viśadavratā || dadhāra garbhaṃ svapnepi bhartuḥ saṃgānubhāvataḥ || 43 || tāṃ śrutvā bhartṛrahitāṃ śāradāṃ garbhiṇī satīm|| sarve dhigiti procustāṃ jāriṇīti jagurjanāḥ || 44 || saṃparetasya tadbharturye jātikulavabāṃdhavāḥ || tāṃ vārtāṃ duḥsahāṃ śrutvā yayustatpitṛmaṃdiram || 45 || atha sarve samāyātā grāmavṛddhāśca paṃḍitāḥ || samājaṃ cakrire tatra kulavṛddhaiḥ samanvitam || 46 || antarvatnīṃ samāhūya śāradāṃ vinatānanām || atarjayansusaṃkruddhāḥ kecidāsanparāṅmukhāḥ || 47 || ayi jāriṇi durbuddhe kimetatte viceṣṭitam || asmatkule suduṣkīrttiṃ kṛtavatyasi bāliśe || 48 || iti saṃtarjayaṃtaste grāmavṛddhā manīṣiṇaḥ || sarve saṃmaṃtrayāmāsuḥ kiṃ kurma iti bhāṣiṇaḥ || 49 || tatrocuḥ ke ca vṛddhāstāṃ bālāṃ prati vinirdayāḥ || eṣā pāpamatirbālā kuladvayavināśinī| || 3.3.19.50 || kṛtvāsyāḥ keśavapanaṃ chittvā karṇau ca nāsikām || nirvāsyatāṃ bahirgrāmātparityajya svagotrataḥ || 51 || iti sarve samālocya tāṃ tathā kartumudyatāḥ || athāṃtarikṣe saṃbhūtā śuśruve vāgagocarā || 52 || anayā na kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ na caiva kuladūṣaṇam || vratabhaṃgo na caitasyāssucaritreyamaṃganā || 53 || itaḥ paramiyaṃ nārī jāriṇīti vadaṃti ye || teṣāṃ doṣavimūḍhānāṃ sadyo jihvā vidīryate || 54 || ityaṃtarikṣe janitāṃ vāṇīṃ śrutvā'śarīriṇīm || sarve prajahṛṣustasyā jananījanakādayaḥ ||55|| tataḥ sasaṃbhramāḥ sarve grāmavṛddhāḥ sabhājanāḥ || muhūrttaṃ maunamālaṃbya bhītāstasthuradhomukhāḥ ||56|| tatra kecidaviśvastā mithyāvāṇītyavādiṣuḥ|| teṣāṃ jihvā dvidhā bhinnā vavamuste kṛmīnkṣaṇāt || 57 || tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsustāṃ bālāṃ jñātibāṃdhavāḥ || bāṃdhavāśca striyo vṛddhāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ sādhusādhviti || 58 || mumucuḥ kecidānaṃdabāṣpabiṃdūnkulottamāḥ|| kulastriyaḥ pramuditāstāmuddiśya samāśvasan || 59 || atha tatrāpare procurdevo vadati nānṛtam || kathameṣāṃ dadhau garbhaṃ śīlānna calitā dhruvam || 3.3.19.60 || iti sarvānsabhyajanā nsaṃśayāviṣṭacetasaḥ || vilokya vṛddhastatraiko sarvajño lokatattvavit || 61 || māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate ca yat || kiṃ bhāvyaṃ kimabhāvyaṃ vā saṃsāre'sminkṣaṇātmake || 62 || anirūpyamabhūtārthaṃ māyayā jāyate sphuṭam || īśvarasya vaśe māyā tasya ko veda ceṣṭitam || 23 || yūpaketośca rājarṣeḥ śukraṃ nipatitaṃ jale || saśukraṃ tajjalaṃ pītvā veśyā garbhaṃ dadhau kila || 64 || munervibhāṃḍakasyāpi śukraṃ pītvā sahāṃbhasā || hariṇī garbhiṇī bhūtvā ṛṣyaśṛṃgamasūyata || 65 || surāṣṭrasya tathā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā mṛgāṃganā|| tatkṣaṇādgarbhiṇī bhūtvā muniṃ prāsūta tāpasam || 66 || tathā satyavatī nārī śapharīgarbhasaṃbhavā || tathaiva mahiṣīgarbho jātaśca mahiṣāsuraḥ|| 67 || tathā saṃti purā nāryaḥ kāruṇyādgarbhasaṃbhavāḥ|| tathā hi vasudevena rohiṇyā stanayo'bhavat || 68 || devatānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ śāpena ca vareṇa ca || ayuktamapi yatkarma yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 69 || sāṃbasya jaṭharājjātaṃ musalaṃ muniśāpataḥ || yuvanāśvasya garbho'bhūnmunīnāṃ maṃtragauravāt || 3.3.19.70 || nūnameṣāpi kalyāṇī maharṣeḥ pādasevanāt || mahāvratānubhāvācca dhatte garbhamaniṃ ditā || 71 || asminnarthe rahasyenāṃ satyaṃ pṛcchaṃtu yoṣitaḥ || tato nivṛttasaṃdeho bhaviṣyati mahājanaḥ || 72 || tatastadvacanādeva tāmapṛcchanstriyo mithaḥ || tābhyaḥ śaśaṃsa tatsarvaṃ sā svavṛttaṃ mahādbhutam || 73 || vijānaṃtastataḥ sarve mānayitvā ca tāṃ satīm || modamānāḥ praśaṃsaṃtaḥ prayayuḥ svaṃ svamālayam|| 74 || atha kāle śubhe prāpte śāradā vimalāśayā || asūta tanayaṃ bālā bālārkasamatejasam || 75 || sa kumāro mahodāralakṣaṇaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ || avāpya mahatīṃ vidyāṃ bālya eva mahāmatiḥ || 76 || athopanīto guruṇā kāle lokamanoramaḥ || sa śāradeya eveti loke khyāti mavāpa ha || 77 || ṛgvedamaṣṭame varṣe navame yajuṣāṃ gaṇam | daśame sāmavedaṃ ca līlayādhyagamatsudhīḥ || 78 || atha trilokamahite saṃprāpte śivaparvaṇi || gokarṇaṃ prayayuḥ sarve janāḥ sarvanivāsinaḥ || 79 || śāradāpi svaputreṇa gokarṇaṃ prayayau satī || 3.3.19.80 || tatrāpaśyatsamāyātaṃ sadā svapneṣu lakṣitam || pūrvajanmani bharttāraṃ dvijabaṃdhujanāvṛtam || 81 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā premanirviṇṇā pulakāṃkitavigrahā || niruddhabāṣpaprasarā tasthau tannyastalocanā || 82 || sa ca vipro'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpalakṣaṇalakṣitām|| svapne sadā bhujyamānāmātmano ratidāyinīm | 83 || taṃ kumāramapi svapne dṛṣṭvā cātma śarīrajam || vilokya vismayāviṣṭastadaṃtikamupāyayau || 84 || bhadre tvāṃ praṣṭumicchāmi yatkiṃcinmanasi sthitam || iti prathamamābhāṣya rahaḥ sthānaṃ nināya tām|| 85|| kā tvaṃ kathaya vāmoru kasya bhāryāsi suvrate || ko deśaḥ kasya vā putrī kinnāmetyabravīcca tām || 86 || iti tena samāpṛṣṭā sā nārī bāṣpalocanā || vyājahārātmanovṛttaṃ bālye vaidhavyakāraṇam || 87 || punaḥ papraccha tāṃ bālāṃ putraḥ kasyāyamuttamaḥ || kathaṃ dhṛto vā jaṭhare bālo'yaṃ caṃdrasannibhaḥ || 88 || | śāradovāca || || eṣa me tanayaḥ svāminsarvavidyāviśāradaḥ|| śāradeya iti prokto mama nāmnaiva kalpitaḥ || 69 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā vihasya brāhmaṇottamaḥ || provāca kaṣṭātkaṣṭaṃ hi caritaṃ tava bhāmini || 3.3.19.90 || pāṇigrahaṇamātraṃ te kṛtvā bharttā mṛtaḥ kila || kathaṃ cāyaṃ suto jātastasya kāraṇamucyatām || 91 || iti tenoditāṃ vāṇīmākarṇyātīva lajjitā || kṣaṇaṃ cāśrumukhī bhūtvā dhairyāditthamabhāṣata || 92 || || śāradovāca || || tadalaṃ parihāsoktyā tvaṃ māṃ vetsi mahāmate || tvāmahaṃ vedmi cārthe'sminpramāṇaṃ mana āvayoḥ || 93 || ityuktvā sarvamāvedya devyā dattaṃ varādikam || vratasyārdhaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ dadau tasmai dhṛtavratam || 94 || so'pi pramudito vipraḥ kumāraṃ pratigṛhya tam|| pitroranumatenaiva tāṃ nināya nijālayam || 95 || sāpi sthitvā bahūnmāsāṃstasya viprasya maṃdire || tasminkālavaśaṃ prāpte praviśyāgniṃ tamanvagāt || 96 || tatastau daṃpatī bhūtvā vimānaṃ divyamāsthitau || divyabhogasamāyuktau jagmatuḥ śivamaṃdiram || 97 || ityetatatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ mayā samanuvarṇitam || paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ samyagbhuktimuktiphalapradam || 98 || āyurārogyasaṃpattidhanadhatyavivarddhanam || strīṇāṃ maṃgalasaubhāgyasaṃtānasukhasādhanam || 99 || etanmahākhyānamaghaughanāśanaṃ gaurīmaheśavratapuṇyakīrtanam || bhaktyā sakṛdyaḥ śṛṇuyācca kīrttayedbhuktvā sa bhogānpadameti śāśvatam || 3.3.19.100 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe śāradākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || cha ||
<3.3.20>
|| sūta uvāca || || atha rudrākṣamāhātmyaṃ varṇayāmi samāsataḥ || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāmapi || || 1 || abhakto vāpi bhakto vā nīco nīcataropi vā || rudrākṣāndhārayedyastu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kena vā sadṛśaṃ bhavet || mahāvratamidaṃ prāhurmunayastattvadarśinaḥ || 3 || sahasraṃ dhārayedyastu rudrākṣāṇāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ || taṃ namaṃti surāḥ sarve yathā rudrastathaiva saḥ || 4 || abhāve tu sahasrasya bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa || ekaṃ śikhāyāṃ karayordvādaśa dvādaśaiva hi || 5 || dvātriṃśatkaṃṭhadeśe tu catvāriṃśattu mastake || ekaika karṇayoḥ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ vakṣasyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || yo dhārayati rudrākṣānrudravatsopi pūjyate || 6 || muktāpravālasphaṭikaraupyavaidūryakāṃcanaiḥ || sametāndhārayedyastu rudrākṣānsa śivo bhavet || 7 || kevalānapi rudrākṣānyathālābhaṃ bibharti yaḥ || taṃ na spṛśaṃti pāpāni tamāṃsīva vibhāvasum || 8 || rudrākṣamālayā japto maṃtro'naṃtaphalapradaḥ || arudrākṣo japaḥ puṃsāṃ tāvanmātraphalapradaḥ || 9 || yasyāṃge nāsti rudrākṣa ekopi bahupuṇyadaḥ || tasya janma nirarthaṃ syāttripuṃḍrarahitaṃ yadi || 3.3.20.10 || rudrākṣaṃ mastake baddhvā śiraḥsnānaṃ karoti yaḥ || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || rudrākṣaṃ pūjayedyastu vinā toyābhiṣecanam || yatphalaṃ liṃgapūjāyāstadevāpnoti niścitam || 12 || ekavaktrāḥ paṃcavaktrā ekādaśamukhāḥ pare || caturdaśamukhāḥ kecidrudrākṣā lokapūjitāḥ || 13 || bhaktyā saṃpūjito nityaṃ rudrākṣaḥ śaṃkarātmakaḥ || daridraṃ vāpi kurute rājarājaśriyānvitam || 14 || atredaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ varṇayaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ | mahāpāpakṣayakaraṃ śravaṇātkīrttanādapi || 15 || rājā kāśmīradeśasya bhadrasena iti śrutaḥ || tasya putro 'bhavaddhīmānsudharmānāma vīryavān || 16 || tasyāmātyasutaḥ kaścittārako nāma sadguṇaḥ || babhūva rājaputrasya sakhā paramaśobhanaḥ || 17 || tāvubhau paramasnigdhau kumārau rūpasundarau || vidyābhyāsaparau bālye saha krīḍāṃ pracakratuḥ || 18 || tau sadā sarvagātreṣu rudrākṣakṛtabhūṣaṇau || viceraturudārāṃgau satataṃ bhasmadhāriṇau || 19 || hārakeyūrakaṭakakuṃḍalādivibhūṣaṇam || hemaratnamayaṃ tyaktvā rudrākṣāndadhatuśca tau || 3.3.20.20 || rudrākṣamālitau nityaṃ rudrākṣakarakaṃkaṇau || rudrākṣakaṃṭhābharaṇau sadā rudrākṣakuṃḍalau || 21 || hemaratnādyalaṃkāre loṣṭapāṣāṇadarśanau || bodhyamānāvapi janairna rudākṣānvyamuṃcatām || 22 || tasya kāśmīrarājasya gṛhaṃ prāpto yadṛcchayā || parāśaro munivaraḥ sākṣādiva pitāmahaḥ || 23 || tamarcayitvā vidhivadrājā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || prapaccha sukhamāsīnaṃ trikālajñaṃ mahāmunim || 24 || || rājovāca || || bhagavanneṣa putro me sopi maṃtrisutaśca me || rudrākṣadhāriṇau nityaṃ ratnābharaṇaniḥspṛhau || 25 || śāsyamānāvapi sadā ratnākalpaparigrahe || vilaṃghitāsmadvacanau rudrākṣeṣveva tatparau || 26 || nopadiṣṭāvimau bālau kadācidapi kenacit || eṣā svābhāvikī vṛttiḥ kathamāsītkumārayoḥ || 27 || || parāśara uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava putrasya dhīmataḥ || yathā tvaṃ maṃtriputrasya prāgvṛttaṃ vismayāvaham ||28|| naṃdigrāme purā kācinmahānaṃdeti viśrutā|| babhūva vāravanitā śṛṃgāralalitākṛtiḥ ||29|| chatraṃ pūrṇeṃdusaṃkāśaṃ yānaṃ svarṇavirājitam || cāmarāṇi sudaṃḍāni pāduke ca hiraṇmaye||3.3.20.30|| aṃbarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi dyumaṃti ca || caṃdraraśminibhāḥ śayyā paryaṃkāśca hiraṇmayāḥ || 31 || gāvo mahiṣyaḥ śataśo dāsāśca śataśastathā || 32 || sarvābharaṇadīptāṃgyo dāsyaśca navayauvanā || bhūṣaṇāni parārdhyāṇi navaratnojjvalāni ca || 33 || gandhakuṃkumakastūrīkarpūrāgurulepanam || citramālyāvataṃsaśca yatheṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭabhojanam ||34|| nānācitravitānāḍhyaṃ nānādhānyamayaṃ gṛham || bahuratnasahasrāḍhyaṃ koṭisaṃkhyādhikaṃ dhanam || 35 || evaṃ vibhavasaṃpannā veśyā kāmavihāriṇī || śivapūjāratā nityaṃ satyadharmaparāyaṇā || 36 || sadāśivakathāsaktā śivanāmakathotsukā || śivabhaktāṃghryavanatā śivabhaktiratāniśam || 37 || vinodahetoḥ sā veśyā nāṭyamaṇḍapamadhyataḥ|| rudrākṣaibhūṣayitvaikaṃ markaṭaṃ caiva kukkuṭam ||38|| karatālaiśca gītaiśca sadā nartayati svayam || punaśca vihasaṃtyuccaiḥ sakhībhiḥ parivāritā || 39 || yugmam || rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtakeyūrakarṇābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || markaṭaḥ śikṣayā tasyāḥ sadā nṛtyati bālavat || 3.3.20.40 || śikhāyāṃ baddharudrākṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ kapinā saha || ciraṃ nṛtyati nṛtyajñaḥ paśyatāṃ citramāvahan ||41|| ekadā bhavanaṃ tasyāḥ kaścidvaiśyaḥ śivavratī|| ājagāma sarudrākṣastripuṃḍrī nirmamaḥ kṛtī || 42 || sa bibhradbhasma viśade prakoṣṭhe varakaṃkaṇam || mahāratnaparistīrṇaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ taruṇārkavat ||43|| tamāgataṃ sā gaṇikā saṃpūjya parayā mudā| tatprakoṣṭhagataṃ vīkṣya kaṃkaṇaṃ prāha vismitā || 44 || mahāratnamayaḥ so'yaṃ kaṃkaṇastvatkare sthitaḥ || mano harati me sādhau divyastrībhūṣaṇocitaḥ || 45 || iti tāṃ vararatnāḍhya saspṛhāṃ karabhūṣaṇe || vākṣyodāramatirvaiśyaḥ sasmitaṃ samabhāṣata || 46 || || || vaiśya uvāca || || asminratnavare divye yadi te saspṛhaṃ manaḥ || tamevādatsva suprītā maulyamasya dadāsi kim || 47 || || veśyo vāca || || vayaṃ tu svairacāriṇyo veśyāstu na pativratāḥ || asmatkulocito dharmo vyabhicāro na saṃśayaḥ || 48 || yadyetadratnakhacitaṃ dadāsi karabhūṣaṇam|| dinatrayamahorātraṃ tava patnī bhavāmyaham || 49 || || vaiśya uvāca || || tathāstu yadi te satyaṃ vacanaṃ vāravallabhe || dadāmi ratnavalayaṃ trirātraṃ bhava madvadhūḥ || 3.3.20.50 || etasminvyavahāre tu pramāṇaṃ śaśibhāskarau || trivāraṃ satyamityuktvā hṛdayaṃ me spṛśa priye || 51 || || || veśyovāca || || dinatrayamahorātraṃ patnī bhūtvā tava prabho || sahadharmaṃ carāmīti sā taddhṛdayamaspṛśat || 52 || atha tasyai sa vaiśyastu pradadau ratnakaṅkaṇam || liṃgaṃ ratnamayaṃ cāsyā haste dattvedamabravīt || 53 || idaṃ ratnamayaṃ śaivaṃ liṃgaṃ matprāṇasaṃnibham || rakṣaṇīyaṃ tvayā kāṃte tasya hānirmṛtirmama || 54 || evamastviti sā kāṃtā liṃgamādāya ratnajam || nāṭyamaṇḍapikāstaṃbhe nidhāya prāviśadgṛham || 55 || sā tena saṃgatā rātrau vaiśyena viṭadharmiṇā || sukhaṃ suṣvāpa paryaṃke mṛdutalpopaśobhite || 56 || tato niśīthasamaye nāṭyamaṇḍapikāṃtare || akasmādutthito vahnistameva sahasāvṛṇot || 57 || maṇḍape dahyamāne tu sahasotthāya saṃbhramāt || sā veśyā markaṭaṃ tatra mocayāmāsa baṃdhanāt || 58 || sa markaṭo muktabaṃdhaḥ kukkuṭena sahāmunā || bhīto dūraṃ pradudrāva vidhūyāgnikaṇānbahūn || 59 || staṃbhena saha nirdagdhaṃ talliṃgaṃ śakalīkṛtam || dṛṣṭvā veśyā ca vaiśyaśca duraṃtaṃ duḥkhamāpatuḥ || 3.3.20.60 || dṛṣṭvā prāṇasamaṃ liṃgaṃ dagdhaṃ vaiśyapatistathā || svayamapyāptanirvedo maraṇāya matiṃ dadhau || 61 || nirvedadānnitarāṃ khedādvaiśyastāmāha duḥkhitām || śivaliṃge tu nirbhinne nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe || 62 || citāṃ kāraya me bhadre tava bhṛtyairbalādhikaiḥ || śive manaḥ samāveśya praviśāmi hutāśanam || 63 || yadi brahmeṃdraviṣṇvādyā vārayeyuḥ sametya mām || tathāpyasminkṣaṇe dhīraḥ praviśyāgniṃ tyajāmyasūn || 64 || tamevaṃ dṛḍhabaṃdhaṃ sā vijñāya bahuduḥkhitā || svabhṛtyaiḥ kārayāmāsa citāṃ svanagarādbahiḥ || 65 || tataḥ sa vaiśyaḥ śivabhaktipūtaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya samiddhamagnim || viveśa paśyatsu janeṣu dhīraḥ sā cānutāpaṃ yuvatī prapede || 66 || atha sā duḥkhitā nārī smṛtvā dharmaṃ sunirmalam || sarvānbandhūnsamīkṣyaiva babhāṣe karuṇaṃ vacaḥ || 67 || ratnakaṃkaṇamādāya mayā satyamudāhṛtam || dinatrayamahaṃ patnī vaiśyasyāmuṣya saṃmatā|| 68|| karmaṇā matkṛtenāyaṃ mṛto vaiśyaḥ śivavratī| tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi sahānena hutāśanam || sadharmacāriṇītyuktaṃ satyametaddhi paśyatha || 69 || satyena prītimāyāṃti devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ || satyāsaktiḥ paro dharmaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 3.3.20.70 || satyena svargamokṣau ca nāsatyena parā gatiḥ || tasmāsatyaṃ samāśritya pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam || 71 || iti sā dṛḍhanirbaṃdhā vāryamāṇāpi baṃdhubhiḥ || satyalopabhayānnārī prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ mano dadhe || 72 || sarvasvaṃ śivabhaktebhyo dattvā dhyātvā sadāśivam || tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya pradeśābhimukhī sthi tā || 73 || tāṃ pataṃtīṃ samiddhe'gnau svapadārpitamānasām || vārayāmāsa viśvātmā prādurbhūtaḥ śivaḥ svayam || 74 || sā taṃ vilokyākhiladeva devaṃ trilocanaṃ candrakalāvataṃsam || śaśāṃkasūryānalakoṭibhāsaṃ stabdheva bhīteva tathaiva tasthau || 75 || tāṃ vihvalāṃ paritrastāṃ vepamānāṃ jaḍī kṛtām || samāśvāsya galadbāṣpāṃ kare gṛhyābravīdvacaḥ || 76 || || śiva uvāca || || satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ bhaktiṃ ca mayi niścalām || nirīkṣituṃ tvatsakāśaṃ vaiśyo bhūtvāhamāgataḥ || 77 || māyayāgniṃ samutthāpya dagdhavānnāṭyamaṃḍapam || dagdhaṃ kṛtvā ratnaliṃgaṃ pravṛṣṭosmi hutāśanam || || 78 || veśyāḥ kaitavakāriṇyaḥ svairiṇyo janavaṃcakāḥ || sā tvaṃ satyamanusmṛtya praviṣṭāgniṃ mayā saha || 79 || ataste saṃpradāsyāmi bhogāṃstridaśadurlabhān || āyuśca paramaṃ dīrghamārogyaṃ ca prajonnatim || yadyadicchasi suśroṇi tattadeva dadāmi te || 3.3.20.80 || || sūta uvāca || || iti bruvati gaurīśe sā veśyā pratyabhāṣata || 81 || || veśyovāca || || na me vāṃchāsti bhogeṣu bhūmau svarge rasātale || tava pādāṃbujasparśādanyatkiṃcinna vai vṛṇe || 82 || ete bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye cānye mama bāṃdhavāḥ || sarve tvadarcanaparāstvayi saṃnyastavṛttayaḥ || 83 || sarvānetānmayā sārdhaṃ nītvā tava paraṃ padam || punarjanmabhayaṃ ghoraṃ vimocaya namostu te || 84 || tatheti tasyā vacanaṃ pratinaṃdya maheśvaraḥ || tānsarvāṃśca tayā sārdhaṃ nināya paramaṃ padam || 85 || || parāśara uvāca || || nāṭyamaṃḍapikādāhe yau dūraṃ vidrutau purā || tatrāvaśiṣṭau tāveva kukkuṭo markaṭastathā || 86 || kālena nidhanaṃ yāto yastasyā nāṭyamarkaṭaḥ || sobhūttava kumāro'sau kuvakuṭo maṃtriṇaḥ sutaḥ || 87 || rudrākṣadhāraṇodbhūtātpuṇyātpūrvabhavārjitāt || kule mahati saṃjātau vartete bālakāvimau || 88 || pūrvābhyāsena rudrākṣāndadhāte śuddhamānasau || asmiñjanmani taṃ lokaṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya yāsya taḥ || 89 || eṣā pravṛttistvanayorbālayoḥ samudāhṛtā || kathā ca śivabhaktāyā kimanyatpraṣṭumicchasi || 3.3.20.90 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṇḍe rudrākṣamahimavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || a ||
<3.3.21>
|| sūta uvāca || || evaṃ brahmarṣiṇā proktāṃ vāṇīṃ pīyūṣasannibhām || ākarṇya mudito rājā prāṃjaliḥ punarabravīt || 1 || || rājovāca || || aho satsaṃgamaḥ puṃsāmaśeṣāghapraśodhanaḥ || kāmakrodhanihaṃtā ca iṣṭadogdhā janasya hi || 2 || mama māyātamo naṣṭaṃ jñānadṛṣṭiḥ prakāśitā || tava darśanamātreṇa prāyohamamarottamaḥ || || 3 || śrutaṃ ca pūrvacaritaṃ bālayoḥ samyagetayoḥ || bhaviṣyadapi pṛcchāmi matputrācaraṇaṃ mune || 4 || asyāyuḥ kati varṣāṇi bhāgyaṃ vada ca kīdṛ śam || vidyā kīrtiśca śaktiśca śraddhā bhaktiśca kīdṛśī || 5 || etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa mune tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || tava śiṣyosmi bhṛtyosmi śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ gatosmayaham || 6 || || parāśara uvāca || || atrāvācyaṃ hi yatkiṃcitkathaṃ śaktosmi śaṃsitum || yacchrutvā dhṛtimaṃtopi viṣādaṃ prāpnuyurjanāḥ || || 7 || tathāpi nirvyalīkena bhāvena paripṛcchataḥ || avācyamapi vakṣyāmi tava snehānmahīpate || 8 || amuṣya tvatkumārasya varṣāṇi dvādaśātyayuḥ || itaḥ paraṃ prapadyeta saptame divase mṛtim || 9 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kālakūṭamivoditam || mūrcchitaḥ sahasā bhūmau patito nṛpatiḥ śucā || 3.3.21.10 || tamutthāpya samāśvāsya sa muniḥ karuṇārdradhīḥ || uvāca mā bhairnṛpate punarvakṣyāmi te hitam || 11 || sargātpurā nirālokaṃ yadekaṃ niṣkalaṃ param || cidānaṃdamayaṃ jyotiḥ sa ādyaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥ || 12 || sa evādau rajorūpaṃ sṛṣṭvā brahmāṇamātmanā || sṛṣṭikarmaniyuktāya tasmai vedāṃśca dattavān || 13 || punaśca dattavānīśa ātmatattvaikasaṃgraham || sarvopaniṣadāṃ sāraṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ ca dattavān || 14 || yadekamavyayaṃ sākṣādbrahmajyotiḥ sanātanam || śivātmakaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ rudrādhyāye pratiṣṭhitam || 15 || sa ātmabhūḥ sṛjadviśvaṃ caturbhirvadanairvirāṭ || sasarja vedāṃścaturo lokānāṃ sthitihetave || 16 || tatrāyaṃ yajuṣāṃ madhye brahmaṇo dakṣiṇānmukhāt || aśeṣopaniṣatsāro rudrādhyāyaḥ samudgataḥ || 17 || sa eṣa munibhiḥ sarvairmarīcyatripurogamaiḥ || saha devairdhṛtastebhyastacchiṣyā jagṛhuśca tam || 18 || tacchiṣyaśiṣyaistatputraistatputraiśca kramāgataiḥ || dhṛto rudrātmakaḥ so'yaṃ vedasāraḥ prasāditaḥ || 19 || eṣa eva paro mantra eṣa eva paraṃ tapaḥ || rudrādhyāyajapaḥ puṃsāṃ paraṃ kaivalyasādhanam || 3.3.21.20 || mahāpātakinaḥ proktā upapātakinaśca ye || rudrādhyāyajapātsadyaste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 21 || bhūyopi brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ sadasanmiśrayonayaḥ || devatiryaṅmanuṣyādyāstataḥ saṃpūritaṃ jagat || 22 || teṣāṃ karmāṇi sṛṣṭāni svajanmānuguṇāni ca || lokāsteṣu pravartaṃte bhuṃjate caiva tatphalam || 23 || lokasṛṣṭipravāhārthaṃ svayameva prajāpatiḥ|| dharmādharmau sasarjāgre svavakṣaḥpṛṣṭhabhāgataḥ || 24 || dharmamevānutiṣṭhaṃtaḥ puṇyaṃ viṃdaṃti tatphalam || adharmamanutiṣṭhaṃtaste pāpaphalabhoginaḥ || 25 || puṇyakarmaphala svargo narakastadviparyayaḥ || tayordvāvadhipau dhātrā kṛtau śatamakhāṃtakau || 26 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca madamānādayaḥ pare || adharmasya sutā āsansarve narakanāyakāḥ || 27 || gurutalpaḥ surāpānaṃ tathānyaḥ pulkasīgamaḥ || kāmasya tanayā hyete pradhānāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 28 || krodhātpitṛvadho jātastathā mātṛvadhaḥ paraḥ || brahmahatyā ca kanyaikā krodhasya tanayā amī || 29 || devasvaharaṇaścaiva brahmasvaharaṇastathā || svarṇasteya iti tvete lobhasya tanayāḥ smṛtāḥ || 3.3.21.30 || etānāhūya cāṃḍālānyamaḥ pātakanāyakān || narakasya vivṛddhyarthamādhipatyaṃ cakāra ha || 31 || te yamena samādiṣṭā nava pātakanāyakāḥ || te sarve saṃgatā bhūyo ghorāḥ pātakanāyakāḥ || 32 || narakānpālayāmāsuḥ svabhṛtyaiścopapātakaiḥ || rudrādhyāye bhuvi prāpte sākṣātkaivalyasādhane || 33 || bhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ sarve te'mī pātakanāyakāḥ || yamaṃ vijñāpayāmāsuḥ sahānyairupapātakaiḥ || 34 || jaya deva mahārāja vayaṃ hi tava kiṃkarāḥ || narakasya vivṛddhyarthaṃ sādhikārāḥ kṛtāstvayā || 35 || adhunā vartituṃ loke na śaktāḥ smo vayaṃ prabho || rudrādhyāyānubhāvena nirdagdhāścaiva vidrutāḥ || 36 || grāmegrāme nadīkūle puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca || rudrajāpye tu paryāpte kathaṃ loke caremahi || 37 || prāyaścittasahasraṃ vai gaṇayāmo na kiṃcana || rudrajāpyākṣarāṇyeva soḍhuṃ bata na śaknumaḥ || 38 || mahāpātakamukhyānāmasmākaṃ lokaghātinām || rudrajāpyaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ rudrajāpyaṃ mahadviṣam || 39 || ato durviṣahaṃ ghoramasmāka vyasanaṃ mahat || rudrajāpyena saṃprāptamapanetuṃ tvamarhasi || 3.3.21.40 || iti vijñāpitaḥ sākṣādyamaḥ pātakanāyakaiḥ || brahmaṇoṃ'tikamāsādya tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat || 41 || devadeva jagannātha tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || tvayā niyukto martyānāṃ nigrahe pāpakāriṇām || 42 || adhunā pāpino martyā na saṃti pṛthivītale || rudrādhyāyena nihataṃ pātakānāṃ mahatkulam || 43 || pātakānāṃ kule naṣṭe narakāḥ śūnyatāṃ gatāḥ || narake śūnyatāṃ yāte mama rājyaṃ hi niṣphalam || 44 || tasmāttvayaiva bhagavannupāyaḥ paricintyatām || yathā me na vihanyeta svāmitvaṃ martyadehinām || 45 || iti vijñāpito dhātā yamena parikhidyatā || rudrajāpyavighātārthamupāyaṃ paryakalpayat ||46|| aśraddhāṃ caiva durmedhāmavidyāyāḥ sute ubhe || śraddhāmedhāvighātinyau martyeṣu paryacodayat || 47 || tābhyāṃ vimohite loke rudrādhyāyaparāṅmukhe || yamaḥ svasthānamāsādya kṛtārtha iva so'bhavat || 48 || pūrvajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairjāyaṃte'lpāyuṣo janāḥ || tāni pāpāni naśyaṃti rudraṃ japtavatāṃ nṛṇām || 49 || kṣīṇeṣu sarvapāpeṣu dīrghamāyurbalaṃ dhṛtiḥ || ārogyaṃ jñānamaiśvaryaṃ vardhate sarvadehinām || 3.3.21.50 || rudrādhyāyena ye devaṃ snāpayaṃti maheśvaram || tajjalaiḥ kurvataḥ snānaṃ te mṛtyuṃ saṃtaraṃti ca || 51 || rudrādhyāyābhijaptena snānaṃ kurvaṃti yeṃ'bhasā || teṣāṃ mṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti śivalo ke mahīyate || 52 || śatarudrābhiṣekeṇa śatāyurjāyate naraḥ || aśeṣapāpanirmuktaḥ śivasya dayito bhavet || 53 || eṣa rudrāyutasnānaṃ karotu tava putrakaḥ || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi modate bhuvi śakravat || 94 || avyāhatabalaiśvaryo hataśatrurnirāmayaḥ || nirdhūtākhilapāpaughaḥ śāstā rājyamakaṃṭakam || 55 || viprā vedavidaḥ śāṃtāḥ kṛtinaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || jñānayajñataponiṣṭhāḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 56 || rudrādhyāya japaṃ samyakkurvaṃtu vimalāśayāḥ || teṣāṃ japānubhāvena sadyaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati || 57 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatirmahāmuniṃ tameva vavre prathamaṃ kriyāgurum || athāparāṃstyaktadhanāśayānmunīnāvāhayāmāsa sahasraśaḥ kṣaṇāt || 58 || te viprāḥ śāṃtamanasaḥ sahasraparisaṃmitāḥ || kalaśānāṃ śataṃ sthāpya puṇya vṛkṣarasairyutam || 59 || rudrādhyāyena saṃsnāpya tamurvīpatiputrakam || vidhivatsnāpayāmāsuḥ saṃprāpte saptame dine || 3.3.21.60 || snāpyamāno munijanaiḥ sa rājanyakumārakaḥ || akasmādeva saṃtrastaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha || 61 || sahasaiva prabuddho'sau munibhiḥ kṛtarakṣaṇaḥ || provāca kaścitpuruṣo daṃḍahastaḥ samāgataḥ || 62 || māṃ prahartuṃ kṛtamatirbhīmadaṇḍo bhayānakaḥ || so'pi cānyairmahāvīrai puruṣairabhitāḍitaḥ || 63 || baddhvā pāśena mahatā dūraṃ nīta ivābhavat || etāvadahamadrākṣaṃ bhavadbhiḥ kṛtarakṣaṇaḥ || 64 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatestanūjaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || āśīrbhiḥ pūjayāmāsurbhayaṃ rājñe nyavedayan || || 65 || atha sarvānṛṣīñchreṣṭhāndakṣiṇābhirnṛpottamaḥ || pūjayitvā varānnena bhojayitvā ca bhaktitaḥ || 66 || pratigṛhyāśiṣasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ brahmavādi nām || bhaktyā baṃdhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ sabhāyāṃ samupāviśat || 67 || tasminsamāgate vīre munibhiḥ saha pārthive || ājagāma mahāyogī devarṣirnāradaḥ svayam || 68 || tamāgataṃ prekṣya guruṃ munīnāṃ sārdhaṃ sadasyairakhilairmunīṃdraiḥ || praṇamya bhaktyā viniveśya pīṭhe kṛtopacāraṃ nṛpatirbabhāṣe || 69 || || || rājovāca || || dṛṣṭaṃ kimasti te brahmastrilokyāṃ kiṃcidadbhutam || tanno brūhi vayaṃ sarve tvadvākyāmṛtalālasāḥ || 3.3.21.70 || || nārada uvāca || || adya citraṃ mahaddṛṣṭaṃ vyomnovataratā mayā || tacchṛṇuṣva mahārāja sahaibhirmunipuṃgavaiḥ || 71 || adya mṛtyurihāyāto nihaṃtuṃ tava putrakam|| daṃḍahasto durādharṣo lokamudbādhayansadā || 72 || īśvaropi viditvainaṃ tvatputraṃ haṃtumāgatam || sahaiva pārṣadaiḥ kaṃcidvīrabhadramacodayat || 73 || sa āgatya haṭhānmṛtyuṃ tvatputraṃ haṃtumāgatam || gṛhītvā sudṛḍhaṃ baddhvā daṃḍenābhyahanadruṣā || 74 || taṃ nīyamānaṃ jagadīśasannidhiṃ śīghraṃ viditvā bhagavānyamaḥ svayam || kṛtāṃjalirdeva jayetyudīrayanpraṇamya mūrdhnā nijagāda śūlinam || 75 || || yama uvāca || || devadeva mahārudra vīrabhadra namo'stu te || nirāgasi kathaṃ mṛtyau kopastava samutthitaḥ||76|| nijakarmānubaṃdhena rājaputraṃ gatāyuṣam|| prahartumudyate mṛtyau koparādho vada prabho||77|| ||vīrabhadra uvāca|| daśavarṣasahasrāyuḥ sa rājatanayaḥ katham|| vipattimaṃtarāyāti rudrasnānahatāśubhaḥ||78|| asti cettava saṃdeho madvākye'pyanivārite || citraguptaṃ samāhūya praṣṭavyo'dyaiva mā ciram|| 79 || || nārada uvāca || || athāhūtaścitragupto yamena sahasāgataḥ || āyuḥpramāṇa tvatsūnoḥ paripṛṣṭaḥ sa cābravīt || 3.3.21.80 || dvādaśābdaṃ ca tasyāyurityuktvātha vimṛśya ca || punarlekhyagataṃ prāha sa varṣāyutajīvitam ||81|| atha bhīto yamo rājā vīrabhadraṃ praṇamya ca || kathaṃcinmocayāmāsa mṛtyuṃ durvārabaṃdhanāt || 82 || vīrabhadreṇa mukto'tha yamo'gānnijamaṃdiram || vīrabhadraśca kailāsamahaṃ prāptastavāṃtikam || 83 || atastava kumāro'yaṃ rudrajāpyānubhāvataḥ || mṛtyorbhayaṃ samuttīrya sukhī jāto'yutaṃ samāḥ || 84 || ityuktvā nṛpamāmaṃtrya nārade tridivaṃ gate || viprāḥ sarve pramuditāḥ svasvajagmurathāśramam || 85 || itthaṃ kāśmīranṛpatī rudrādhyāyaprabhāvataḥ || nistīryāśeṣaduḥ khāni kṛtārthobhūtsaputrakaḥ||86|| ye kīrtayaṃti manujāḥ parameśvarasya māhātmyametadatha karṇapuṭaiḥ pibaṃti || te janmakoṭikṛtapāpagaṇairvimuktāḥ śāṃtāḥ prayāṃti paramaṃ padamiṃdumauleḥ || 87 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmottarakhaṃḍe rudrādhyāyamahimavarṇanaṃnāmaika viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<3.3.22>
|| sūta uvāca || || evaṃ śivatamaḥ paṃthāḥ śivenaiva pradarśitaḥ || nṛṇāṃ saṃsṛtibaddhānāṃ sadyomuktikaraḥ paraḥ || 1 || atha durmedhasāṃ puṃsāṃ vedeṣvanadhikāriṇām || strīṇāṃ dvijātibaṃdhūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca śarīriṇām || 2 || eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ paṃthāḥ sākṣātkaivalyasādhanaḥ || mahāmunijanaiḥ sevyo devairapi supūjitaḥ ||3|| yatkathāśravaṇaṃ śaṃbhoḥ saṃsārabhayanāśanam || sadyomuktikaraṃ ślāghyaṃ pavitraṃ sarvadehinām ||4|| ajñānatimirāṃdhānāṃ dīpo'yaṃ jñānasiddhidaḥ || bhavaroganibaddhānāṃ susevyaṃ paramauṣadham || 5 || mahāpātakaśailānāṃ vajraghātasudāruṇam || bharjanaṃ karmabījānāṃ sādhanaṃ sarva saṃpadām || 6 || ye śṛṇvaṃti sadā śambhoḥ kathāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm || te vai manuṣyā lokesminrudrā eva na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || śṛṇvatāṃ śūlino gāthāṃ tathā kīrtayatāṃ satām || teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyeva tīrthāni munayo jaguḥ || 8 || tasmānniśreyasaṃ gantuṃ yebhivāṃchaṃti dehinaḥ || te śṛṇvaṃtu sadā bhaktyā śaivīṃ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || 9 || yadyaśaktaḥ sadā śrotuṃ kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ naraḥ || muhūrtaṃ vāpi śṛṇuyānniyatātmā dinedine || 3.3.22.10 || atha pratidinaṃ śrotumaśakto yadi mānavaḥ || puṇyamāseṣu vā puṇye dine puṇyatithiṣvapi || 11 || yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ ramyāṃ purāṇaiḥ samudīritām || sa nistarati saṃsāraṃ dagdhvā karmamahāṭavīm || 12 || muhūrttaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā pāvanīṃ kathām || ye śṛṇvaṃti sadā bhaktyā na teṣāmasti durgatiḥ || 13 || yatphalaṃ sarvayajñeṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || sakṛtpurāṇaśravaṇāttatphalaṃ viṃdate naraḥ || 14 || kalau yuge viśeṣeṇa purāṇaśravaṇādṛte || nāsti dharmaḥ paraḥ puṃsāṃ nāsti muktipathaḥ paraḥ || 15 || purāṇaśravaṇācchaṃbhornāsti saṃkīrtanaṃ param || ata eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kalpadrumamahāphalam || 16 || kalau hīnāyuṣo martyā durbalāḥ śramapīḍitāḥ || durmedhaso duḥkhabhājo dharmācāravivarjitāḥ || 17 || iti saṃciṃtya kṛpayā bhagavānbādarāyaṇaḥ || hitāya teṣāṃ vidadhe purāṇākhyaṃ sudhārasam || 18 || pibannevāmṛtaṃ yatnādetatsyādajarāmaraḥ || śambhoḥ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryātkulamevājarāmaram || 19 || bālo yuvā daridro vā vṛddho vā durbalo'pi vā || purāṇajñaḥ sadā vandyaḥ pūjyaśca sukṛtārthibhiḥ || 3.3.22.20 || nīcabuddhiṃ na kurvīta purāṇajñe kadācana || yasya vaktrāṃbujādvāṇī kāmadhenuḥ śarīriṇām || 21 || guravaḥ saṃti lokeṣu janmato guṇatastathā || teṣāmapi ca sarveṣāṃ purāṇajñaḥ paro guruḥ || 22 || bhavakoṭisahasreṣu bhūtvābhūtvāvasīdati || yo dadātyapunarvṛttiṃ ko'nyastasmātparo guruḥ || 23 || purāṇajñaḥ śucirdāṃtaḥ śāṃto vijitamatsaraḥ || sādhuḥ kāruṇyavānvāgmī vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhī || 24 || vyāsāsanaṃ samārūḍho yadā paurāṇiko dvijaḥ || asamāptaprasaṃgaśca namaskuryānna kasya cit || 25 || ye dhūrtā ye ca durvṛttā ye cānye vijigīṣavaḥ || teṣāṃ kuṭilavṛttīnāmagre naiva vadetkathām || 26 || na durjanasamākīrṇe na śūdraśvāpadāvṛte || deśe na dyūtasadane vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ || 27 || sadgrāme sujanākīrṇe sukṣetre devatālaye || puṇye nadanadītīre vadetpuṇyakathāṃ sudhīḥ || 28 || śivabhaktisamāyuktā nānyakāryeṣu lālasā || vāgyatāḥ suśravo'vyagrāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhāginaḥ || 29 || abhaktā ye kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇvaṃti manujādhamāḥ || teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ nāsti duḥkhaṃ syājjanmajanmani || 3.3.22.30 || purāṇaṃ ye tvasaṃpūjya tāṃbūlādyairupāyanaiḥ || śṛṇvaṃti ca kathāṃ bhaktyā daridrāḥ syurna pāpinaḥ || 31 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ ye gacchaṃtyanyato narāḥ || bhogāṃtare praṇaśyaṃti teṣāṃ dārāśca saṃpadaḥ || 32 || soṣṇīṣamastakā ye ca kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti pāvanīm || te balākāḥ prajāyante pāpino manujādhamāḥ || 33 || tāṃbūlaṃ bhakṣayanto ye kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti pāvanīm || svaviṣṭhāṃ khādayaṃtyetānnarake yamakiṃkarāḥ || 34 || ye ca tuṃgāsanārūḍhāḥ kathāṃ śṛṇvaṃti dāṃbhikāḥ || akṣayānnarakānbhuktvā te bhavaṃtyeva vāyasāḥ || 35 || ye ca vīrāsanārūḍhā ye ca maṃcakasaṃsthitāḥ || śṛṇvaṃti satkathāṃ te vai bhavaṃtyanṛjupādapāḥ || 36 || asaṃpraṇamya śṛṇvaṃto viṣavṛkṣā bhavaṃti te || kathāṃ śayānāḥ śṛṇvanto bhavaṃtyajagarā narāḥ ||37|| yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ vaktuḥ samānāsanamāśritaḥ || gurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ saṃprāpya narakaṃ vrajet || 38 || ye niṃdaṃti purāṇajñaṃ kathāṃ vā pāpahāriṇīm || te vai janmaśataṃ martyāḥ śunakā saṃbhavaṃti ca || 39 || kathāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ ye vadaṃti narādhamāḥ || te gardabhāḥ prajāyante kṛkalāsāstataḥ param || 3.3.22.40 || kadācidapi ye puṇyāṃ na śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ narāḥ || te bhuktvā narakānghorānbha vaṃti vanasūkarāḥ || 41 || ye kathāmanumodante kīrtyamānāṃ narottamāḥ || aśṛṇvaṃto'pi te yāṃti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam || 42 || kathāyāṃ kīrtyamānāyāṃ vighnaṃ kurvaṃti ye śaṭhāḥ || koṭyabdānnarakānbhuktvā bhavaṃti grāmasūkarāḥ || 43 || ye śrāvayaṃti manujānpuṇyāṃ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhaṃti brahmaṇaḥ padam || 44 || āsanārthaṃ prayacchaṃti purāṇajñasya ye narāḥ || kambalājinavāsāṃsi mañcaṃ phalakameva ca || 45 || svargalokaṃ samāsādya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān || sthitvā brahmādilokeṣu padaṃ yāṃti nirāmayam || 46 || purāṇajñasya yacchaṃti ye sūtravasanaṃ navam || bhogino jñānasaṃpannāste bhavaṃti bhavebhave || 47 || ye mahāpātakairyuktā upapātakinaśca ye || purāṇaśravaṇādeva te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || 48 || atra vakṣye mahāpuṇyamitihāsaṃ dvijottamāḥ || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ vicitraṃ sumanoharam || 49 || dakṣiṇāpathamadhye vai grāmo bāṣkalasaṃjñitaḥ || tatra saṃti janāḥ sarve mūḍhāḥ karmavivarjitāḥ || 3.3.22.50 || na tatra brāhmaṇācārāḥ śrutismṛtiparāṅmukhāḥ || japasvādhyāyarahitāḥ parastrī viṣayāturāḥ || 51 || kṛṣīvalāḥ śastradharā nirdevā jihmavṛttayaḥ || na jānaṃti paraṃ dharmaṃ jñānavairāgyalakṣaṇam || 52 || striyaśca pāpaniratāḥ svairi ṇyaḥ kāmalālasāḥ|| durbuddhayaḥ kuṭilagāḥ sadgatācāravarjitāḥ || 53 || tatraiko viduro nāma durātmā brāhmaṇādhamaḥ || āsīdveśyāpatiryo'sau sadāro'pi kumārgagaḥ || 54 || svapatnīṃ baṃdulāṃ nāma hitvā pratiniśaṃ tathā || veśyābhavanamāsādya ramate smarapīḍitaḥ || 55 || sāpi tasyāṃganā rātrau viyuktā navayauvanā || asahaṃtī smarāveśaṃ reme jāreṇa saṃgatā || 56 || tāṃ kadāciddurācārāṃ jāreṇa saha saṃgatām || dṛṣṭvā tasyāḥ patiḥ krodhādabhi dudrāva satvaraḥ || 57 || jāre palāyite patnīṃ gṛhītvā sa durāśayaḥ || saṃtāḍya muṣṭibaṃdhena muhurmuhuratāḍayat || 58 || sā nārī pīḍitā bhartrā kupitā prāha nirbhayā || bhavānpratiniśaṃ veśyāṃ ramate kā gatirmama || 59 || ahaṃ rūpavatī yoṣā navayauvanaśālinī || kathaṃ sahiṣye kāmārtā tava saṃgativarjitā || 3.3.22.60 || ityuktaḥ sa tayā tanvyā provāca brāhmaṇādhamaḥ || yuktameva tvayoktaṃ hi tasmādvakṣyāmi te hitam || 61 || jārebhyo dhanamākṛṣya tebhyo dehi parāṃ ratim || taddhanaṃ dehi me sarvaṃ paṇyastrīṇāṃ dadāmi tat || 62 || evaṃ saṃpūryate kāmo mamāpi ca varānane || tatheti bhartṛvacanaṃ pratijagrāha sā vadhūḥ || 63 || evaṃ tayostu daṃpatyordurācārapravṛttayoḥ || kālena nidhanaṃprāptaḥ sa vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 64 || mṛte bhartari sā nārī putraiḥ saha nijālaye || uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ kiṃcidutkrāṃtayauvanā || 65 || ekadā daivayogena saṃprāpte puṇyaparvaṇi || sā nārī baṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ gokarṇaṃ kṣetra māyayau || 66 || tatra tīrthajale snātvā kasmiṃściddevatālaye || śuśrāva devamukhyānāṃ puṇyāṃ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || 67 || yoṣitāṃ jārasaktānāṃ narake yamakiṃkarāḥ || saṃtaptalohaparighaṃ kṣipaṃti smaramaṃdire || 68 || iti paurāṇikenoktāṃ sā śrutvā dharmasaṃhitām || tamuvāca rahasyeṣā bhītā brāhmaṇapuṃgavam || 69 || brahmanpāpamajānaṃtyā mayācaritamulbaṇam || yauvane kāmacāreṇa kauṭilyena pravartitam || 3.3.22.70 || idaṃ tvadvacanaṃ śrutvāpurāṇārthavijṛṃbhi tam || bhītirme mahatī jātā śarīraṃ vepate muhuḥ || 71 || dhiṅmāṃ duriṃdriyāsaktāṃ pāpāṃ smaravimohitām || alpasya yatsukhasyārthe ghorāṃ yāsyāmi durgatim || 72 || kathaṃ paśyāmi maraṇe yamadūtānbhayaṃkarān || kathaṃ pāśairbalātkaṃṭhe badhyamānā dhṛtiṃ labhe || 73 || kathaṃ sahiṣye narake khaṃḍaśo dehakṛṃtanama || punaḥ kathaṃ patiṣyāmi saṃtaptā kṣārakardame || 74 || kathaṃ ca yonilakṣeṣu krimikīṭakhagādiṣu || paribhramāmi duḥkhaughātpīḍyamānā niraṃtaram || 75 || kathaṃ ca rocate mahyamadyaprabhṛti bhojanam || rātrau kathaṃ ca seviṣye nidrāṃ duḥkhapariplutā || 76 || hāhā hatāsmi dagdhāsmi vidīrṇahṛdayāsmi ca || hā vidhe māṃ mahāpāpe dattvā buddhimapātayaḥ || 77 || patatastuṃgaśailāgrācchūlākrāṃtasya dehinaḥ || yadduḥkhaṃ jāyate ghoraṃ tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ mama || 78 || aśvamedhāyutaṃ kṛtvā gaṃgāṃ snātvā śataṃ samāḥ || na śuddhirjāyate prāyo matpāpasya garīyasaḥ || 79 || kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kaṃ vā śaraṇamāśraye || ko vā māṃ trāyate loke pataṃtī narakārṇave || 3.3.22.80 || tvameva me gururbrahmaṃstvaṃ mātā tvaṃ pitāsi ca || uddharoddhara māṃ dīnāṃ tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatām ||81|| iti tāṃ jātanirvedāṃ patitāṃ caraṇadvaye || utthāpya kṛpayā dhīmānbabhāṣe dvijapuṃgavaḥ || 82 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || diṣṭyā kāle prabuddhāsi śrutvemāṃ mahatīṃ kathām || mā bhaiṣīstava vakṣyāmi gatiṃ caiva sukhāvahām ||83|| satkathāśravaṇādeva jātā te matirīdṛśī || iṃdriyārtheṣu vairāgyaṃ paścāttāpo mahānabhūt || 84 || paścāttāpo hi sarveṣāmaghānāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ parā || tenaiva kurute sadyaḥ prāyaścittaṃ sudhīrnaraḥ || 85 || prāyaścittāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā ca vidhivatpunaḥ || apaścāttāpino nāryā na yāṃti gatimuttamām || 86 || satkathāśravaṇānnityaṃ saṃyāti paramāṃ gatim || puṇyakṣetranivāsācca cittaśuddhiḥ prajāyate ||87|| yathā satkathayā nityaṃ saṃyāti paramāṃ gatim || tathānyaiḥ sadvratairjaṃtornabhavenmatiruttamā || 88|| yathā muhuḥ śodhyamāno darpaṇo nirmalo bhavet || tathā satkathayā ceto viśuddhiṃ paramāṃ vrajet || 89 || viśuddhe cetasi nṛṇāṃ dhyānaṃ sidhyatyumāpateḥ || dhyānena sarvaṃ malinaṃ manovākkāyasaṃbhṛtam || 3.3.22.90 || sadyo vidhūya kṛtino yāṃti śambhoḥ paraṃ padam || ataḥ saṃnyastapuṇyānāṃ satkathā sādhanaṃ param || 91 || kathayā sidhyati dhyānaṃ dhyānātkaivalyamuttamam || asiddhaparamadhyānaḥ kathāmetāṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ || so'nyajanmani saṃprāpya dhyānaṃ yāti parāṃ gatim || 92 || nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa japtvā maṃtramajāmilaḥ || paścāttāpasamāyuktastvavāpa paramāṃ gatim || 93 || sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃ bījaṃ satkathāśravaṇaṃ nṛṇām || yastadvihīnaḥ sa paśuḥ kathaṃ mucyeta bandhanāt || 94 || atastvamapi sarvebhyo viṣayebhyo nivṛttadhīḥ || bhaktiṃ parāṃ samādhāya satkathāṃ śṛṇu sarvadā || śṛṇvaṃtyāḥ satkathāṃ nityaṃ cetaste śuddhimeṣyati || 95 || tena dhyāyasi viśveśaṃ tato muktimavāpsyasi || dhyāyataḥ śivapādābjaṃ muktirekena janmanā || 96 || bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham || ityuktā tena vipreṇa sā nārī bāṣpasaṃkulā || 97 || patitvā pādayostasya kṛtārthāsmītyabhāṣata || tasminneva mahākṣetre tasmādeva dvijottamāt || 98 || śuśrāva satkathāṃ sādhvīṃ kaivalyaphala dāyinī|| sa uvāca dvijastasyai kathāṃ vairāgyabṛṃhitām || 99 || yāṃ śrutvā manujaḥ sadyastyajedviṣayavāsanām || tasyāścittaṃ yathā śuddhaṃ vairāgyarasagaṃ yathā || 3.3.22.100 || tathovāca dvijaḥ śaivīṃ kathāṃ bhaktisamanvitām || yathāyathā manastasyāḥ prasādamabhigacchati || tathātathā śanaiḥ śaṃbhordhyānayogamupādiśat || 101 || śanaiḥ śanairdhvastarajastamomalaṃ vimuktasarvendriyabhogavigraham || viśuddhatattvaṃ hṛdayaṃ dvijastriyā viveśa viśveśvara rūpaciṃtanam|| 102 || itthaṃ sadgurumāśritya sā nārī prāptasanmatiḥ || dadhyau muhurmuhuḥ śaṃbhościdānaṃdamayaṃ vapuḥ || 103 || nityaṃ tīrthajale snātvā jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇī || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgī rudrākṣakṛtabhūṣaṇā || 104 || śivanāmajapāsaktā vāgyatā mitabhojanā || baddhapadmāsanā'vyagrā satkathā śravaṇotsukā || 105 || guruśuśrūṣaṇaratā tyaktāpatyasuhṛjanā || gurūpadiṣṭayogena śivamevamatoṣayat || 106 || viśveśa viśvavilayasthitijanmaheto viśvaikavaṃdya śiva śāśvata viśvarūpa || vidhvastakālaviparītaguṇāvabhāsa śrīmanmaheśa mayi dhehi kṛpākaṭākṣam || 107 || śaṃbho śaśāṃkakṛtaśekhara śāṃtamūrte gaṃgādharāmaravarārcitapādapadma || nāgeṃdrabhūṣaṇa nageṃdraniketaneśa bhaktārtihanmayi nidhehi kṛpākaṭākṣam |||108||| śrīviśvanātha karuṇākara śūlapāṇe bhūteśa bharga bhuvanatrayagītakīrte || śrīnīlakaṇṭha madanāntaka viśvamūrte gaurīpate mayi nidhehi kṛpākaṭākṣam || 109 || itthaṃ pratidinaṃ bhaktyā prārthayaṃtī maheśvaram|| śṛṇvaṃtī satkathāṃ samyakkarmabaṃdhaṃ samācchinat || 3.3.22.110 || atha kālena sā nārī samutsṛjya kalevaram || maheśānucarairnītā saṃprāptā śiva maṃdiram || 111 || tatra devairmahādevaṃ sevyamānaṃ sahomayā || gaṇeśanaṃdibhṛṃgyādyairvīrabhadreśvarādibhiḥ || 112 || upāsyamānaṃ gaurīśaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham || trilocanaṃ paṃcamukhaṃ nīlagrīvaṃ sadāśivam || 113 || vāmāṃke bibhrataṃ gaurīṃ vidyuccaṃdrasamaprabhām || dṛṣṭvā sasaṃbhramaṃ nārī sā praṇamya punaḥpunaḥ || 114 || ānandāśrujalotsiktā romaharṣasamākulā || saṃmānitā karuṇayā pārvatyā śaṃkareṇa ca ||115|| tasmim̐lloke parānandaghanajyotiṣi śāśvate || labdhvā nivāsamacalaṃ lebhe sukhamanāhatam || 116 || sā kadācidumāṃ devīmupasṛtya praṇamya ca || paryapṛcchata me bharttā kāṃ gatiṃ gatavāniti ||117|| tāmuvāca mahādevī sa te bharttā durāśayaḥ || bhuktvā narakaduḥkhāni viṃdhye jātaḥ piśācakaḥ || 118 || punaḥ prapaccha sā nārī devīṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm || kenopāyena me bharttā sadgatiṃ prāpnuyāditi || 119 || || devyuvāca || || so'smatkathāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ kadācicchṛṇuyādyadi || nistīrya durgatiṃ sarvāmimaṃ lokaṃ prayāsyati || 3.3.22.120 || iti gauryā vacaḥ śrutvā sā nārī vihitāṃjaliḥ || prārthayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ bhartuḥ pāpaviśodhane ||121|| tayā muhuḥ prārthyamānā pārvatīkaruṇāyutā || tuṃburuṃ nāma gaṃdharvamāhūyedamathābravīt || 122 || tuṃburo gaccha bhadraṃ te viṃdhyaśailaṃ sahānayā || āste piśācakastatra yo'syāḥ patirasanmatiḥ || 123 || tasyāgre paramāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāmasmadguṇairyutām || ākhyāya durgatermuktaṃ tamānaya śivāṃtikam || 124 || iti devyā samādiṣṭastuṃburustāṃ praṇamya ca || tayā saha vimānena viṃdhyādriṃ sahasā yayau || 125 || tatrāpaśyanmahākāyaṃ raktanetraṃ mahāhanum || prahasaṃtaṃ rudaṃtaṃ ca valgaṃtaṃ ca piśācakam|| 126 || balādgṛhītvā taṃ pāśairbaddhvā vai saṃniveśya ca || tuṃbururvallakīhasto jagau gaurīpateḥ kathām || 127 || sa piśāco mahāpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ śrutvā puradviṣaḥ || vidhūya kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ saptāhātprāpa saṃsmṛtim || 128 || sa paiśācaṃ vapustyaktvā svarūpaṃ divyamāpya ca || jagau svayamapi śrīmaccaritaṃ pārvatīpateḥ || 129 || vimānamāruhya sa divyarūpadhṛksa tuṃburuḥ pārśvagataḥ svakāṃtayā || gāyanmaheśasya guṇānmanoramāñjagāma kaivalyapadaṃ sanātanam || 3.3.22.130 || || sūta uvāca || || ityetatkathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ duritāpaham || maheśvaraprītikaraṃ nirmalajñānasādhanam || || 131 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānmartyaḥ kīrtayedvā samāhitaḥ || śaṃbhorguṇānukathanaṃ vicitraṃ pāpanāśanam || 132 || paramānandajanakaṃ bhavarogamahauṣadham || | bhuktveha vividhānbhogānmukto yāti parāṃ gatim || 133 || || sūta uvāca || || yūyaṃ khalu mahābhāgāḥ kṛtārthā munisattamāḥ || ye sevaṃte sadā śaṃbhoḥ kathāmṛtarasaṃ navam || 134 || te janmabhājaḥ khalu jīvaloke yeṣāṃ mano dhyāyati viśvanātham || vāṇī guṇānstauti kathāṃ śṛṇoti śrotradvayaṃ te bhavamuttaraṃti || 135 || vividhaguṇavibhedairnityamaspṛṣṭarūpaṃ jagati ca bahiraṃtarvā samānaṃ mahimnā || svamahasi viharaṃtaṃ vāṅmanovṛttidūraṃ paramaśivamanaṃtānaṃdasāṃdraṃ prapadye || 136 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye brahmotarakhaṇḍe purāṇaśravaṇamahimavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| 22|| iti skānde tṛtīyaṃ brāhmakhaṇḍaṃ saṃpūrṇam||3|| atha brāhmakhaṇḍe tṛtīyaṃ brāhmottarakhaṇḍam || 3.3 ||
